articleTitle: Study in dynamic growth model of Coprinus Comatus based on temperature and humidity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the effect of temperature and humidity on the growth of Coprinus Comatus was studied, a dynamic model based on temperature and humidity to simulate the Coprinus Comatus growth is established in this paper. The data used to calculate the model parameters is derived from chamber experiments.The conceptions of the Growth function, thalposis function and humidity sense function are defined creatively. The relationship between the three main growth indices(the stipe diameter, the stipe height and the sporocarp weight) and the growth days is described as linear function, quadratic function and power function respectively. The growth function is established as a matrix on the basis of the three functions. The relationship between the coefficients of the growth function and the humiture is studied. Moreover, the coefficients of the thalposis function and humidity sense function are also studied. The simulation error of the stipe diameter, the stipe height and the sporocarp weight based of the model is existed during the early growth period, and decreasing along with the increasing of the growth days. The simulation error is within the scope of 10% when the Coprinus Comatus is ripe. The dynamical growth rhythm of the Coprinus Comatus is described based on the model. The daily growth of the sporocarp can be forecasted under certain humiture based on the dynamical model which provides the foundation to regulate and control the growth environment in chamber. The model which is more practicability comparatively has the virtue of real-time and dynamic estimation compared to the conventional model.

articleTitle: The research on the venture capital in Post-crisis era based on the SVM model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the decent trend of the financial crisis, the world economic begin to come back to life and this phenomenon is becoming more and more obvious. The investment on the new industry and hi-tech areas soars. The flow of the capital which is caused by the development of technology and industry impels the investors who have desire to invest in the Post-crisis to seek for the aim which is low-risky and sustainable. More and more investors hope that there is an investment method which can break the limitation of the industry and is able to supply the same accurate level in different industries. By using this method, the investors can reduce the investment risk, increase the investment return, at the same time improve the social benefit. In the paper, we construct the index system according to the special economical situation in the Post-crisis and build the SVM model to make an qualitative analysis on the real problem. In order to calculate the model accurately, we take advantage of the MATLAB tool. Finally, by a deep analysis on the result, we conclude that this model is valuable to solve the problem in the venture capital decision.

articleTitle: Convergence monitoring and numerical simulation of the distortion of high stress workings
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aimed to dissolve the question that it is difficult to maintain the developing entry during mining in the weak and fragmentized ore body, carried out the site monitoring, convergence monitoring and numerical simulation to disclose the distortion mechanism of developing entry of chengchao Iron Mine. the data provide the support for the preparatory workings deformation mechanism. the result of the monitoring and numerical simulation indicated that the displacement of preparatory workings is relative to mining course, and the displacement increase with the depth increase. The result is to provide a theoretical support to choose the system of protecting synthetically in deep mines and the right time of support..

articleTitle: The application of spatial analysis functions of GIS technology in urban planning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid progress of urbanization, urban planning is attracted much more attentions. The popularization of computer technology and GIS technology provides the technical support for urban planning. This paper introduces the concepts of spatial analysis functions of GIS briefly, and analyses the spatial analysis function of the application in urban planning specifically. How to apply the GIS spatial analysis function in the different urban planning field is demonstrated in the paper, which also gives the direction of the future application of GIS science and technology in urban planning.

articleTitle: Outside director system design and analysis for the decision-making power of public projects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The special properties of public projects have limited government (state-owned capital) withdraw from this field. Hence, outside director system is introduced to the corporate governance of public projects. By D-P index of power, the decision-making power of all benefit clusters is quantitatively analyzed. It shows that introducing outside directors to the corporate governance of public projects will help to form an effective mechanism of behalf balance, fade the government investment and generate more investment opportunities for social capital.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the Sea-ice development monitoring based on HJ satellite remote sensing data—A case study of the Bohai sea
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A cost estimation model for OEM based military software support
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Military software supportability increasingly becomes a key factor of equipment system supportability, and the proportion of software support cost in the system is rising significantly. Based on the analysis of the processes of supportability design and implementation, the paper proposes several effective methods for estimating software costs in the different stages and aspects, and constructs a general-purpose cost estimation model for military software support. Case studies on real-world projects demonstrate the feasibility and rationality of the model.

articleTitle: Analysis on fractal features of performance output index of enterprise employee time series
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the data of some enterprise, phase-space of time series was reconstructed based on the phase-space reconstruction theory. The fractal features of performance output index of enterprise employee time series were studied by using G-P (Grassberger-Procaccia) arithmetic, correlation dimension of performance output index of employee time series and delay time were calculated out The results indicate that the dynamic system of performance output index of employee has a steady correlation dimension of 0.948 after the embedded dimension comes to 6, which explains that at least one factor is controlling the dynamic changes of accidents time series, and the effective freedom is 6. The research provides much reference value for establishing predictable models of performance output index of employee time series.

Author Keywords: performance output index of enterprise employee

articleTitle: Moving targets detection algorithm based on the temporal-spatial segmentation algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To detect moving targets in an image sequence fast and accurately, a temporal-spatial segmentation algorithm of moving objects is addressed in this paper. First of all, the motion compensation is used in the received low frequency sub-images of a consecutive sequence that three frames images which is transformed with the 2D wavelet. After that, the temporal segmentation algorithm is used to extract the areas of the moving targets in the sub-images, and then the accurate areas of the moving targets in the original images are extracted with the spatial segmentation algorithm. To raise the efficiency of the algorithm, the Bisection method is introduced into the spatial segmentation method. It is shown by the experimental results that the moving targets are detected fast and accurately with the algorithm in the paper, and that the occlusion problem is solved well in the multi-target motion.

articleTitle: Single image quality assessment and creation of the best quality image
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel methods of a single image quality assessment (S-IQA) and the best quality image (BQI) creation was proposed. This method integrates visual perception parameters of human vision system (HVS) to construct S-IQA method. Use of bi-disturbance transformation (DT) method gets the BQI from an original image whose quality is not good enough.

articleTitle: Control theory based software process modeling and analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: One important aspect of software engineer is its process. Software development is an iterative feedback and modification process, like a closed-loop control system. We study the software process using process control theory such as feedback feed-forward and cascade control etc. Through using these methods and building the model of the software development process, we can easily understand the pros and cons of different process methods and can analyze software process qualitatively and quantitatively.

articleTitle: Isolation and bioinformatics analysis of LeNAC transcription factor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under biotic and abiotic stress, various genes of plant can be activated or restrained by phytohormones, especially jasmonic acid (JA) and salicylic acid (SA). The interactions between JA and SA might be synergistic and antagonistic, depending on the stress conditions. Using RACE approaches, a full-length cNDA (LeNAC) from tomato was cloned when treated with jasmonic acid. Sequence analysis showed that it belongs to the NAC transcription factor family.

articleTitle: The college student cadre organizational commitment exploring factor analysis research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Organizational commitment reflects the members of the college student community recognition and involvement, which affects the normal operation of organization enormously and is also determining the rise and fall of this student organization. In this paper, a random sample of 300 student leaders for trial, using interviews and questionnaires to collect relevant data through the data processing SPSS13.0 focus on: The dimension structure of college community are affective commitment and growing commitment.

articleTitle: An empirical research of the relationship between innovation resources and innovation performance in service enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, with the deepening of product's homogeneity, service competition is becoming focus of competition between enterprises. And innovation resource is essence of improving service competition. In this paper, the related literature is reviewed and analyzed from the perspective of service-oriented enterprise competition, on the basis of this, the theoretical relation between innovation resource and innovation performance is built. Meanwhile using quality research method and questionnaire method analyze and test the relation. The empirical results indicate that the two innovation resources have closely related to innovation performance. And the result provides quantitative decision-making basis for service-oriented enterprise.

articleTitle: The study on accumulated vulnerability of regional development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on literature review, this paper outlined the research advance in the study of vulnerability. This study further made clear the implication of regional development's vulnerability, analyzed the mechanism of regional development's accumulated vulnerability and designed an index system for evaluating accumulated vulnerability. At last this article also evaluated and predicted the accumulated vulnerability of Bejing-Tianjin-Hebei Metropolitan Circle using Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method and Grey System Model. The results showed that there was significant difference of vulnerability within Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Metropolitan Circle and the vulnerability was gradually increased and accumulated.

articleTitle: Apply 3D digital technology in HBUE virtual campus animated film
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid progress of 3D digital technology, more and more people pay attention to its application in presenting architecture, environment and art intension inside physic objects. In the progress of make virtual campus animated film for Hubei University of Economics- a one year and seven month project, 3D animation was used to present the campus environment and its art intension.

articleTitle: Spatial visualization method of pipe network section based on ArcEngine and DWGdirect.net
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Pipe network is a complex spatial distribution system. In order to define the internal structure of the pipe more, this article aims to analyze the section spatial topological structure of the pipe network from a 2-dimensional GIS pipe network map by using a generation algorithm of transverse section drawings and vertical section drawings. Based on C# and ArcEngine, this algorithm visualizes transverse section drawings and vertical section drawings of the pipe network by using of the 3 - dimensional coordinate information provided by GIS spatial vector data. It can also calculate and output related attribute data of the section drawings to achieve the section spatial topological analysis function. The function of vertical section spatial topological analysis is assisted by a connected analysis algorithm. The method of writing and saving the section drawings into a DWG format file is realized by DWGdirect.net technology according to the section drawing national standard, the generated section drawings can be edited in AutoCAD, so as to realize the interoperation of AutoCAD and GIS.

articleTitle: The research of multi-resource leveling optimization in critical chain management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The critical chain management technology is a new kind of network scheduling management methods. Based on thoroughly studying critical chain management technology and multi-resource leveling theory, this paper firstly gives different weights to various resources using the analytical hierarchy process to transform multi-resource leveling optimization problem to single leveling optimization problem. Then, it establishes a model for multi-resource leveling optimization in critical chain management and describes its basic principle and steps. Finally, combining with a numerical example, the paper verifies the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Analysis on application of near zero-nonconformity process to test laboratory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to weaknesses and deficiencies in quality control of many sophisticated testing laboratory. this paper discusses how to apply the quality control methods and statistical techniques of theory“ near zero-nonconformity process” to monitor and calibration processes of laboratory equipments, inspection processes, and the statistical process to testing reports. As well, the paper discusses how to establish the quality management system which is applied to near zero-nonconformity process. the application of theory “near zero-nonconformity process” can help the test laboratory realize effectively quality control .

articleTitle: Research on Image Retrieval based on multi-features
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Content-based Image Retrieval(CBIR) is the hotspot of image retrieval. Extracting features and computing similarity are two key points of CBIR. Color feature is the most popular feature used in CBIR, which is high efficient but always lacks the shape information. In this paper, we propose a method combining the color feature with the edge feature, and use the combing feature to retrieve images. Experiments show, compared to the original CBIR method based on color feature or edge feature, our method significantly resaises the average precision and recall ratio, while keeps the high efficency.

articleTitle: Research of reusable agent model in distributed systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The conventional SNMP (Client/Server) model has been unable to properly meet the modern network; the reusability and scalability of experimental agent-based network management system are not ideal. Aiming at these problems and people's deviation understanding and irrational use of agent, a new agent definition is proposed by introducing the multi-tuple concept; and a reusable 3-tier MAS (MAS, Multi-Agent Systems) application model is put forward, the core of which is agent layer, including Manager Agent, User Agent, Task Agent and Data Agent. As witnessed by the implemented system and the experiment, the model is reusable and scalable; can overcome the limitations of conventional SNMP model, being capable of effectively improving the efficiency of network management system.

articleTitle: Research on the formation and identification of IT project financial costs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of financial evaluation is to determine the financial feasibility of IT project, and financial costs are the core to financial evaluation. Therefore, correct identification of financial costs is the foundation to ensure the validity for evaluation results. This paper analyses the importance of the financial costs identification and introduces the meaning and characteristics of IT project financial costs. On this basis, the paper analyses the basic principles of financial costs identification. It emphatically researches the identification of IT project financial costs combined with the characteristics of IT project and put forward the formation of IT project financial costs.

articleTitle: A survey on the formal testing techniques for real-time embedded software
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, real-time embedded software testing is a hot topic, and formal methods has become an important means in real-time embedded software modeling and verification field. The real-time embedded software verification technique based on formal methods can eliminate ambiguity, enhance the accuracy and consistency of verification and improve the automation level and efficiency. In this paper, we surveyed the existing formal testing techniques for real-time embedded software, pointed out the shortcomings of current research and gave the trends of the techniques.

articleTitle: The technology of target automatic orientation basing on dual antenna GPS receiver
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper bring forward one new method of target automatic orientation and we establish the target positioning system basing on dual antenna GPS receiver. We analysis the principle of target orientation and make an emulation of the system. The results show us that the method has high precision. Then, we make many times experiments. The results of experiments show us this system has high precision and has real-time characteristic.

articleTitle: Exploration on the real estate marketing strategies in small and medium-sized cities — taking the arcadia in langfang for an example
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Real estate Marketing is the creative activities of real estate companies or agents to adjust to the new situation of the real estate market. It plays a significant role to advance healthy development of the real estate industry, urbanization and macro economy. Taking Lang Fang City for an example, this essay tries to explore the ways to develop real estate industry healthily in small and medium-sized cities in terms of the companies or agents.

articleTitle: The VB implementation of contour detection and extraction for CT images of knee joint
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In clinical medicine, CT (Computerized Tomography) scanning is often carried out on parts of the human body with pathological changes, in order to diagnose and treat disease. When it is needed to establish a model of different parts for human body, related data of establishing model could be obtained through the scanned images. In this paper, the contour detection and extraction for CT images of knee joint are implemented through the designed VB (Visual Basic 6.0) program. The detective algorithms for contour include: first-order and second-order differential operators. The image processing effects of the differential operators with horizontal and vertical direction are better than operators with single direction. The chain code method is adopted for contour extraction, and pixels information on the image contour is saved. Through this designed program it provides the foundation for independent development of digital image processing program and from 3d medical images to the three dimensional geometric model building.

articleTitle: An effective algorithm for hierarchical network topology connectivity check
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Hierarchical network data connectivity check plays an important role in preparation of building network, preprocessing of topological network and path planning. We develop an effective method for hierarchical network topology connectivity checking. The algorithm works on large graphs with time complexity near O(n). Beijing's hierarchical road network is built and topology of that is checked at the same time. The results show excellent performance and correctness.

articleTitle: Regional and cluster independent innovation ability evaluation of Anhui Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The improvement of regional and cluster independent innovation ability is beneficial to promote regional development. Firstly, this paper defines the meaning of regional and cluster independent innovation ability, and in this foundation combines with the actual development of Anhui Province, then constructs the evaluation index system of regional and cluster independent innovation ability of Anhui. And makes an empirical analysis on the evaluation of Anhui. Finally, according to the results, this paper draws appropriate conclusions and recommendations.

articleTitle: Cartographic symbols evaluation & extraction for event annotation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Events annotating in map is critical to information broadcast and management, especial to emergency respond, news report and weather prediction, etc. The pattern of annotated event context is analyzed in this paper. The necessary content factors in event context are conduced by analyzing the context pattern and statistic results of the event context annotated, which we studied the semantic content of cartographic symbols based on. A novel meaning credibility variable is proposed to measure the degree of the semantic representation between the cartographic symbol and the event. We use the symbol semantic matrix that consists of meaning credibility parameters to map the symbols set and the events set in meaning. The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is introduced to evaluate the cartographic symbol class. The sub function ƒi(ki) is designed to confirm the grade of i<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> evaluation factor(ki) in event extent. The class and the extent of the cartographic symbol are as parameters to search the symbol. By analyzing the example, the present methods are effective and viable.

articleTitle: An image retrieval method with multi-instance learning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a multi-instance learning based CBIR (content-based image retrieval) approach is presented, and multi-instance learning method is applied in CBIR, in order to deal with the inherent ambiguity of images. First of all the whole image is regards as a multi-instance bag, secondly the image is partitioned into multi-regions by using adaptive k-means image segmentation method, and then query images posed by the user are transformed into corresponding positive and negative bags and a EM-DD(expectation maximization diverse density) algorithm is employed for image retrieval and relevance feedback. Finally, it makes the users get satisfying result.

articleTitle: The discussion about foreign exchange risk measurement in the light of VaR and ES method from Extreme Value Theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article is aiming at measuring the RMB exchange rate risk against five major currencies in the approach of VaR method and ES method based on the Extreme Value Theory. The authors find that VaR and ES value based on POT model can always have better effectiveness in the case of higher market volatility and confidence level, and on the other hand, the VaR and ES value cannot show better effectiveness in the case of smaller market volatility and lower confidence level.

articleTitle: Graph coloring model and algorithm of aircraft type assignment of airline flight
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aircraft type assignment of airline flight plays an important role and has significant impact on the operation of an airline system. A graph coloring model of aircraft type assignment of flight in airline is set up by analyzing the characteristics of time intervals set that the scheduled flights use the aircraft types. And, a time slice algorithm is introduced to determinate the set of the time conflict of aircraft type assignment. The vertex sequence coloring algorithm is presented according to the rule “First-In-First-Out”. The computerizing complexity of this algorithm is O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Finally, an example is analyzed to demonstrate the application of this algorithm.

articleTitle: A technological catching-up model of modularized industry in developing countries
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article discussed the technological catching-up problem of modularized industry in developing countries. Firstly, this article analysed the relationship between technical level, technology learning capability, technological innovation capability and technological capability; then, stated that the technological catching-up of modularized industry in developing countries is the integration of catching-up in technical level and technological capability. After comparing the developing mode of modularized industries in developing countries with that in developed countries, this article puts forward a technological catching-up model of modularized industry in developing countries

articleTitle: Operon prediction based on quadratic discriminant analysis in Escherichia coli genome
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The operon is a specific functional organization of genes found in bacterial genomes. It plays an important role in constructing the genetic regulation network. Genes within most operons have more common structures and functional characteristics. These common features become the basis of operon prediction. Annotation of operons in a bacterial genome is an important step in determining an organism's transcriptional regulatory program. Quadratic discriminant analysis (QDA) approach is here used to predict Escherichia coli k12 (E.coli) operons. Three features were chosen as QDA input vectors, 1)intergenic distance, 2)the common gene ontology(GO) annotation numbers of a gene pair, 3) statistical correlation of a gene pair based on sequence. Our study show that i) intergenic distance and the common GO annotation numbers of a gene pair are very important for the operons prediction, ii) the correlation information of a gene pair based on sequence is a good supplement for the operons prediction when GO annotation lose. The prediction using statistical correlation of a gene pair is a new thought. Based on these new insights, for E.coli on our own dataset our operon prediction program obtain the prediction sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, auROC at 91.5%, 85.2%, 88.4%, 0.9317, respectively. On dataset of Taboada etc it is 94.9%, 92.2%, 93.7%, 0.9582, respectively. This result is superior to that based on intergenic distance and STRING-like scores of Taboada and colleagues.

articleTitle: Analysis on the technologies' trend of R&D industry based on WIPO patent and SCI documents
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on patent analysis and bibliometrics, the future trend and hot spots of technology development can be forecasted effectively, for the purpose of providing significant strategic planning support for the government and R&D corporations. Through the analysis, not only the market Trends, but also the development of technologies themselves could be grasped. An example of Beijing's R&D industry has been carried out. The software of Patent EX and Bibexcel were used to realize our analysis.

articleTitle: The trend of industry choice of FDI and service outsourcing base's construction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: From 1990s on, FDI had been turning to service industry, and service outsourcing is its matching way. Faced with this trend, it should become China's policy choice to encourage drawing on FDI and to build service outsourcing base.

articleTitle: A novel multi-channel access scheme in cognitive ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-channel access is often used to improve the throughput and spectral efficiency of cognitive ad hoc networks. However, there have been few methods for satisfying the requirements of secondary users while using multiple channels simultaneously. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-channel access scheme for QoS supporting. Considering the time-varying channel characteristics, we propose to calculate the Expected Transmission Time (ETT) of each secondary user based on the channel status estimate. Then, the spectrum access problem is formulated as a constrained optimization problem. The solution gives the optimal multi-channel spectrum access under the QoS constraints of secondary users. Experiment results show that our method meets the requirements of secondary users while effectively improving the stability of channel access.

articleTitle: The prize-collecting call control problem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The prize-collecting call control problem is to minimize the sum of the maximum load on the edges and the total penalty costs of the rejected calls. In this paper, we design a 2-approximation algorithm using linear programming rounding technique, and a 1.58-approximation algorithm using randomized rounding technique for this problem. We also present some optimal algorithms and approximation algorithms for some special graphs including rings, lines and stars.

articleTitle: Discovery of population distribution knowledge visually through Lorenz curve and choropleth map
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed a new visual data mining and knowledge discovery method based on Lorenz curve and choropleth map. Lorenz curve is used to discover numeric knowledge through graphic analysis objectively. The break values of classification system are determined adaptively through simplifying the Lorenz curve according to data distribution. Map readers can find and identify spatial distribution pattern on the choropleth maps under influenced by “Gestalt's Law” like continuity and closure imperceptibly. Two case studies are examined in detail in the paper. Data used here are population spatial data at the county level in 2000. Both of them verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the method in discovering spatial distribution knowledge of population and other social-economic variables.

articleTitle: An AHP-based evaluation of industry-university-research cooperation's performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, technology and market changes rabidly which means it is difficult for a single company or university to achieve innovation successfully and the only way to innovation is whether the organization can learn effectively and make good use of outer resources. Industry-University cooperation meets the new requirement. However, industry-university-research cooperation is still in the stage of exploration, and the evaluation of industry-university-research cooperation's performance is not formed system research. This paper uses analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to build up index system of performance evaluation on industry-university-research cooperation, and then constructs a comparison matrix to determine the weight. Finally the evaluation model is designed.

articleTitle: Data preprocessing methods for VLBI applications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The software correlator system (SCS) is a key module of Chinese VLBI (Very Long Baseline Interferometry) Network (CVN). The main tasks of SCS include data pre-processing, fringe-searching, correlation, and phase correction signal extraction. In this paper, we propose four approaches for high-speed VLBI data preprocessing on the universal PC-server platform, namely sliding window based time decoding, dynamic lookup-table scheme, squeeze strategy and data synchronization. The experiment results achieved a very small latency especially when the data rate was greater than 256Mbps per station.

articleTitle: A novel computerized drawings management system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper demonstrates how to build a management system of engineering drawings in the DAO way based on Jet engine in the AutoCAD software. In this engineering-applicable system, the design and management of the drawings are realized in the same environment, and the system integrates the two tasks together. As a result, with the system, the searching, modifying and filing of drawings are facilitated.

articleTitle: The evaluation of technological innovation capabilities in SMEs based on an multilevel Extension Evaluating Method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we analyzed the internal and external factors of SMEs' technology innovation and the corresponding economic and social benefits, on which we established an evaluation system on SMEs' technology innovation capacity. The traditional extension evaluation method is extended to multilevel extension evaluating method. By combination of objective and subjective factors' weight adjustment and altering correlation function, the objects are evaluated on multilevel, meanwhile, the sub-indicators are classified and sorted by levels. Dalian High-tech SMEs are evaluated here by multilevel Extension Evaluating Method, conclude their composite evaluation value, so that we can offer scientific instruction to the government and in SMEs both in designing technology innovation strategy and discovering obstacles in technology innovation.

articleTitle: Image capture of fibrous fracture surface based on BP-neural network and wavelet
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method is proposed for image capture of fibrous fracture surface based on BP-neural network and wavelet, which solved the problem of uneven luminosity image's obtaining. Firstly, the automatic focusing function of image acquiring system based on BP-neural network is realized in this method. Then get the best exposure value and choose several exposure values near the best exposure value to get more images. Finally, the images are fused based on wavelet. The practice proved that this method is a great way for image capture of fibrous fracture surface. It also can get high-brightness image and intact conservation of edge information.

articleTitle: The implementation of a global address engine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper will introduce why this engine is necessary, how to realize the engine, how to analyze the address data inputted, how to separate the input to every component, how to compare the input with truth data to judge if the input address can be delivered, how to standardize the output to make it professional and what the engine will return to the user to help users understand easily and clearly what happened when parsing the address.

articleTitle: Current analysis on the observations of sand wave SAR images in Taiwan shoal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Statistical analysis on observations of submarine sand wave SAR images in Taiwan shoal and their relationships with sea surface current are discussed. A total of 69 SAR images over 11 years are collected and 496 profiles of sand wave SAR images are used, the sea surface current calculated form high-frequency (HF) radar system are utilized for the study on the relationships between observations of sand wave SAR images and the current speed. Results show the submarine sand waves in Taiwan Shoal are mainly distributed from 117.75°E to 118.70°E and 22.7°N to 23.35°N with a high percent. The comparison between monthly mean sea surface current speed and sand waves observed by SAR also shows a strong correlation between both, which is higher wind current speed, the higher probability of sand waves observed by SAR. This may indicate that the higher observation of the sand waves by SAR is partly due to sea surface currents

articleTitle: The empirical analysis on e-government customer satisfaction in Chongqing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: E-government refers to the Government and the public. When the Government builds up a e-government Web site, it has not really formed the idea that the public is the center in using the website. This paper proposes an e-government public satisfaction measurement index system and evaluates the usage of government portal sites in Chongqing. According to the index system, it designs the questionnaire to collect sample data. It uses the weighted sum method to measure public satisfaction. And the weights are determined by AHP. Finally, it analyzes the problems in e-government construction in Chongqing and puts forward to some reasonable suggestions from the survey.

articleTitle: Analysis of P-glycoprotein structure and binding sites
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multidrug resistance is one of the major causes for the failure to successful chemotherapy. Although there are many mechanisms responsible for MDR, classic MDR is associated with the over expression of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), resulting in increased efflux of chemotherapy from cancer cells. It is proposed to operate as a “hydrophobic vacuum cleaner”, expelling non-polar compounds from the membrane bilayer to the exterior, driven by the energy of ATP hydrolysis. Usually, its efflux function can be inhibited by various reverse agents. Structure diversity is a hallmark of P-gp reverse agents, thus a structural description of poly-specific drug-binding is important for the rational design of MDR inhibitors. In this study, the analysis of structure and binding sites of P-gp was carried out based on the crystal structure of mouse P-gp (ABCB1). There were 10 pockets with the volume larger than Ǻ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> were found with the online tool of Q-SiteFinder. The docking of typical P-gp efflux pump inhibitors such as XR9576 and OC144-093 were carried out and analyzed with Accelrys Discovery Studio. XR9576 and OC144-093 may bind to the nucleotide-binding domain (NBD) and the pocket at the entrance of the transporting site respectively according to the docking results.

articleTitle: The implementation of parallel computing on the domination number of graph
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The high performance computing cluster(HPC) administered a parallel computation. A cluster node which consisted of Cluster was in charge of examining each natural number less than or equal to vertices number of the graph. The cluster can calculate the minimal domination number (MDN) effectively. In this paper, taking W(3,n) Knödel graph for an example, the definit bounds of the MDN has been worked out by parallel computation and it has been proved correctly by mathematical proof.

articleTitle: Weighted bundle adjustment method in optical measurement system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The measuring accuracy of optical measurement system can be improved by reasonable weighted bundle adjustment technique. In this paper, weighted bundle adjustment techniques have been reviewed, and then a robust weighted bundle adjustment has been provided. In every iteration, image points with big error were removed firstly by statistical analysising the residual error, then sectional weighted bundle adjustment have been carried out considering the significance level of correction. Real experiments show that the method we provided can remove image points with big error effectively, and can achieve more robust results than Helmert weighted method, selecting weight iteration method and backprojection weighted method.

articleTitle: The research on the architecture of distributed on-board self-diagnosis system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the disadvantages of existing on-board self-testing and self-diagnosis system, and the advantages of InteGRail project carried out in Europe. Based on the research of next-generation on-board network, we propose the design of on-board multi-level distributed diagnosis system. We point out the main advantages of distributed diagnosis systems, describe the system architecture and function classifications of each level, and analyze the main research works and core technologies. This work has provided the blue-print for the implementation of on-board distributed diagnosis system.

articleTitle: The effects of spatial scales on landscape indices —A case study of Beijing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking into consideration the importance of particle effects in landscaping structure, the thesis adopted 8 landscaping indexes to analyze the feedback of landscaping structure towards particle wearing and gathering in Beijing major districts. And it comes to a conclusion that PLAND, SHDI and SHEI show less sensitivity to particle change, NP, LPI, LSI CONTAG and AWMSI is on the contrary very sensitive. Meanwhile, the thesis discussed relations between particle change and spatial resolution in landscaping structure analysis as well as selectivity of scale field and particle effects therein. Spatial resolution turns out an unignorable factor in analyzing landscaping structure. When analyzing landscaping structure, adjustment should be introduced in image resolution and special granularity in accordance with needs of various research purpose.

articleTitle: Webpage malicious code defense model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper webpage malicious code and the web browser mechanism were analyzed and new defense model was proposed. This new model can defend against browser attacks by checking URL(Uniform Resource Locator), monitoring web script and preventing buffer overflow. Test results show that the model improves versatility and reduces the false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of 3-RSR flexible parallel robot
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increasing requirements of high precision and high efficiency, the flexible parallel robot characterized by both the flexible robot and the parallel robot will be a new hot topic in robotics research. The primary goal of this research is the dynamic simulation of 3-RSR flexible parallel robot. Firstly, the virtual prototype of a 3-RSR parallel robot with flexible links is established on the basis of the finite element software SAMCEF. Then, the displacement, acceleration and equivalent stress of the 3-RSR flexible parallel robot are analyzed. Numerical results show that the flexibility of link has important influence on dynamics performance of the flexible parallel robot.

articleTitle: A Study on the net security with soft switch
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the evolution of the times, the network will gradually transition to IP-based packet core network. Because of the independence of the traditional network and therefore has a higher security. However, as the core of next-generation network technology - soft-switching, due to the diversity of its support operations and open network architecture will face a more complex security environment. In this paper, soft-switching network security architecture, the main problems faced by its effective solution.

articleTitle: The safety problems exploration and analysis in technology development and application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Technologies have brought great changes to the human beings' way of living and producing. While enjoying the advance brought by technologies, worry about the safety problem it may cause spreads more and more widely. In this paper there is an analysis of technologies-developing and technologies-applying process and an elaboration on every stage of it in detail. Then a model for technologies safety problems in development and application is provided. At last the analysis has been done using the technology as example.

articleTitle: The cost model for fragmented XML streams
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The cost-model for XML stream is the theory foundation in the research of XML stream dissemination, fragmentation and evaluation. According to the matching operations in fragmented XML stream system, this paper analyzes the features of the system overhead on client, network and server, and brings in the cost model for fragmented XML stream based on Hole-Filler model. Based on the cost model, this paper illustrates the influence of the fragmentation policy on XML dissemination system by an application and proposes a series of selection policies for XML stream fragmentation to improve the system efficiency, adaptivity and scalability.

articleTitle: Design of an embedded multi-function communications control system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An embedded multi-function communications control system is designed for data acquisition and processing in this paper. It consists of two parts by hardware and software. The main applications of the system are monitoring the environment of base station for mobile communications and telecommunications terminal board room. This system can deal the data acquisition and processing for Entrance guard system, Fire fighting apparatus, Dual -Technology Sensor, Explosion-proof device and other Electronic alarm equipments. The system can support a variety of transmission Medias, such as: DDN, Modem dial-up, E1, Ethernet LAN and so on. It can constitute a point-to-point Star Network with the entire remote base stations (End Stations) by above transmission Medias. Its software system can support for the network requirements with at least 64 base stations (End Stations) and even more. Meanwhile, the software system can support the functions of Active-Standby Routing and Handover, and alarm of abnormal communications.

articleTitle: Emotion feature fusion of images based on electroencephalogram analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method of emotion feature fusion of images based on EEG analysis is proposed in this paper. At first, select the appropriate algorithm to extract color and shape feature. Then, the EEG analysis is proposed, analyses are made on emotion feature of image by way of Emotion Spectrum Analyzing. The paper uses cloth image as date, proposes the Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) method which base on multi-features including the visual feature (color and shape) and the emotional feature. The data set composed of 100 clothing images is experimented with, and the experiment results have been analyzed, some of which are satisfied, and that this method is efficient and robust.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of service bus prototype for RFID Logistics-Customs Clearance Service Platform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new SOA service bus model (SSB) is proposed. This model, based on SOA architecture, takes advantages of Web service and software bus technology as well as the message passing mechanism in order to enhance the interoperability between heterogeneous systems. SSB integrates the existing resource of IT systems and middlewares, making full use of the data and service resources of these systems. Therefore, a large integrated platform system, which has the features of good scalability, high flexibility, weak coupling, excellent reusability and convenient management, can be constructed. Finally, SSB has been successfully applied to RFID Logistics-Customs Clearance Service Platform(LCCSP).

articleTitle: Study on density of state of strained Si1−xGex
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The strained Si technology is a research emphasis in the modern microelectronic field. Density of state (DOS) is an important physical parameter in strained Si materials. Based on KP perturbation theory related to stress, the models of DOS effective mass of electron and hole near the bottom of conduction band and the top of valence band were obtained in strained Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>. Furthermore, quantitative analytical models of DOS of electron and hole near the bottom of conduction band and the top of valence band was established in the trained Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> grown from (001), (101) and (111) substrates respectively. The models were simulated and analyzed using Matlab software. It was found that their DOS versus energy were parabola curves and have significant influence under the stress. The quantized models obtained can provide valuable references to the understanding on strained Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> materials and the research on physical properties of devices.

articleTitle: Analysis of establishing innovation - oriented Human Resource management system for Private Enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This thesis analyzes the present situation of Human Resource management in Private Enterprise and points out the strategy of innovation applied in human resource management system in private enterprise that the main contents include establishing enterprise's own culture system and the concept of innovation of human resource management, and building up a set of incentive mechanism which can urge the advance, middle class and laggard as well as the training mode innovation etc. At the same time it emphasizes that innovation of human resource management system in private enterprises shall be involved in every employee.

articleTitle: GIS based on CDN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper summarized what is deferent between GIS data and normal network data by center object of CDN—data; and raised key components and transport method of data on GIS based on CDN; signed out system architecture and trends of the GIS. It thinks that service will have a great improvement by it, even then the system can support more users and more massive data.

articleTitle: A new role-to-role delegation model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Role-based access control (RBAC) model is recognized as an efficient access control model for large organizations. PBDM2 is a role-based delegation which is built on RBAC. But in many cases, not all the roles of a user can delegate to others and not every user can accept the delegation. To tackle this problem, this paper proposes a new role-to-role delegation model. The new model is based on RBAC 96 model and PBDM2 with some improvement. We divide roles into three layers and define some constrains to limit arbitrary delegation. Then we represent the model formally and use semaphore primitive to describe the mechanism of delegation and revocation. Finally the algorithm of this role-to-role delegation model is given. The delegation becomes safer in new model.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Remote sensing inversion for soil moisture of Hebei plain with MODIS data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A novel feedback-based strategy on burst contention avoidance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel source flow-rate control strategy called dual-feedback adaptive threshold window (DFATW) to resolve contention in an optical burst switching network. In our algorithm, the traffic states of network are predicted accurately, due to monitoring the traffic variation from edge-switching nodes and core-switching nodes simultaneously. We then compare the blocking performance of DFATW with the conventional assembly algorithm called adaptive assembly size, and the numerical results show that the burst blocking probability is further reduced by using the DFATW algorithm, especially when a core-switching node is at high traffic state.

articleTitle: Raising evaporative cooling potentials using combined cooled ceiling and MPCM slurry storage
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Evaporative cooling is able to generate the cooling medium at a temperature approaching to the ambient wet bulb temperature. In this paper, a low-energy air-conditioning strategy is proposed, which is a combination of cooled ceiling (CC), microencapsulated phase change material (MPCM) slurry storage and evaporative cooling technologies. The assessment of evaporative cooling

articleTitle: Application of pseudo-random equivalent sampling method in UWB-TWSR
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The main task of UWB-TWSR receiving system is to have echo signal for A/D convert and to the supply of back-end platform for processing, the TWSR signal bandwidth is usually from DC to GHz, moreover,it has periodicity, so equivalent time sampling can be used on the TWSR the signal digital-analog conversion. The implementation of equivalent hardware both in sequential equivalent sampling and random equivalent sampling has certain difficulty, pseudo-random equivalent sampling overcomes the shortcomings of the two foregoing equivalent sampling method, the advantage of this method is that random equivalent sampling data is not in chronological order according to sample and it is easier to obtain sample clock than sequential equivalent sampling, so it can reduce the requirements of the sampling clock. The application shows that the UWB Gaussian narrow pulse signal can be sampled and recovered by using equivalent sampling method.

articleTitle: The exploration of Evaluating Model for regional logistics circumstance with Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process (FAHP), as a multi-criterion decision-making method, is especially applied in the establishment of the evaluating criteria system for regional logistics circumstance in this thesis. Regional logistics planning are all the while stranded or difficult to implement, because scientific and effective evaluating method is rarely used in the evaluation of regional logistics circumstance. The seven criterions on 2-level criterion and twenty-nine criterions on 3-level criterion are designed in a model system of evaluation, based on the hardware environment and software environment of regional logistics which are on 1-level criterion. A model is schemed as the evaluating criteria system for regional logistics circumstance, by means of FAHP, AHP and Delphi method. The evaluating criteria system had been applied for the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of the regional logistics circumstance in Hebei province of China efficaciously.

articleTitle: Study on Internet economy-based consumption demand theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Internet economy brings about great changes in environment, thus new problems need to be answered and supported by new theories. In this essay, the related academic viewpoints are reviewed through analysis of current research findings in domestic and abroad range; basic features of Internet economy are further discussed, which is: from division to high cooperation, from circuitous economy to direct economy, high infiltration and self-aggrandizement etc. Hypothetical presupposition and technique path are given. Also, theoretical study model is built. Finally, it is concluded that cross-study of different subjects is conducive to make up for the deficiency on the theoretical study of consumer demand based on Internet economy.

articleTitle: Optimization of topographic index computation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The topographic index is an important input parameter for TOPMODEL. It integrates saturation deficit basin and catchment area. The catchment area is demanded while we calculate topographic index. Conventional approaches to catchment computation include recursion, backtracking and traversing. However, these approaches are resource consuming and inefficient. In this paper, borrowing ideas from water downflow, we propose a novel method for computing the topographic index. The method is simple and efficient. Experimental results on real data sets show that the proposed method is more efficient than the traversing approach.

articleTitle: Quantitative microstructure characteristics of landslide soil affected by Three Gorges Reservoir with using ERDAS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The study on soil microstructure has transferred from qualitative description to quantitative analysis as the improvement of image processing technology. However, it is difficult that how to apply the quantitative technology to solve practical problems. We used ERDAS to quantify microstructure images of landslide soil in the Three Gorges Reservoir area, and then analyzed the variations of diameter and distribution dimension of particle and those of pore during the unsaturated and 1 to 3 water-saturated processes. Using ERDAS to quantify the 1500 times magnification microstructure image after the treatment of threshold value of 120, is effective for the analysis of impacts of fluctuated water level on the landslide soil structure. With the increase of water-saturated process, the average particle diameters increased from 0.2um to 0.33um while there were few changes of the average pore diameters, at the same time, the distribution dimensions of particles and pores became smaller.

articleTitle: Security enhancement of AODV against internal attacks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ad Hoc is one sort of multi-hop, self-organization wireless network without the fixed base-station. The most challenging work is to prevent attacks of this kind of networks. This paper labors the security mechanism of a typical protocol of Ad Hoc network AODV. And a security enhanced routing mechanism is advanced which includes Credibility Management and Routing test

articleTitle: The study on vender-purchaser co-operation mechanism of Reverse Logistics with asymmetric information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Focusing on the Inharmonious coordination relation of Suppliers and Demanders of reverse logistics caused by Conflicting interests of the two parties, this paper analyzes the Benefit-Sharing Mechanisms and the Service-Punishing Mechanisms of Suppliers and Demanders of Reverse Logistics. And we propose a cooperative coordination model applicable to Suppliers and Demanders of Reverse Logistics on the basis of game theory. This model provides a solution to Inharmonious coordination relation of Suppliers and Demanders of Reverse Logistics successfully through key sub-protocols such as the settlement of contractual Liability, benefits-sharing mechanism and expenses sharing mode, etc and offers the Guarantee System for the expansion of service objects and improvement of the overall profit of the third-party reverse logistics.

articleTitle: The post-M&A cultural integration—The case study based on the China Minmetals Corporation cross-border M&A
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By the analysis of research conclusion confusion during Culture-Performance relationship in M&A, the thesis summarizes the best practice in post-M&A cultural integration of China Minmetals Corporation, and builds up a post-M&A cultural integration path.

articleTitle: The SSP*-compactness in L-topological spaces
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a good definition of SSP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup>-compactness in L-topological spaces, where L is a fuzzy lattice. We define SSP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">*</sup>-compactness on arbitrary L-sets, obtain different characterizations and study some of its properties.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of agent unit based on DEA method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: From the perspective of agent unit, through analyzing the existing problems of performance evaluation of the current agent unit, combining with agent system characteristics and project management features, following the principle of setting targets, the paper constructs Agent Unit Performance Evaluation Index System, introduces DEA method to the evaluation and provides an application example, analyzes the problems to find the solutions.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study of the effection of the future eruption of Pinatubo volcano on the environment of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a numerical simulation study on long distance transport of volcano ash from Pinatubo volcano with Hysplit-4 model of Air Resource Laboratory, NOAA,USA, has been introduced. Two conclusion are : 1) 84 case simulations with Hysplit-4 model, according to the historical meteorological fields from 1983 to 2003, show us that there are four routines for the volcano ash cloud move from Phillipine. The most dangerous routine is the northward routine. 2) The worst case is the case if the Pinatubo volcano erupts in July, 1998, The volcano ash cloud can land on the above atmosphere over the area of south China in 48 hours.

articleTitle: Dynamic image segmentation for sport graphics based on fuzzy clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a image segmentation algorithm based on fuzzy clustering algorithm are presented. The proposed image segmentation algorithm performs the segmentation in the combined intensity-texture-position feature space in order to produce connected regions that correspond to the real-life objects shown in the image. This segmentation algorithm is applied to reduced versions of the original images in order to speed-up the completion of the segmentation. As shown by experimental evaluation, this novel scheme provides fast segmentation with high perceptual segmentation quality.

articleTitle: The evaluation and proposals to the momentum of development of Jilin province biopharmaceutical industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the circumstance of supporting the development of strategic emerging industries provided by Chinese government, Jilin province biopharmaceutical industry faces hard-won developing opportunities. The industry owns comparative advantages in technology, talents, natural resources, etc‥ To evaluate accurately the momentum of development of Jilin provinces biopharmaceutical industry, to integrate rationally industry resources, to formulate effective policy of industry development mean great significance of accelerating the development of Jilin province biopharmaceutical industry and promoting Jilin provincial economy.

articleTitle: Does political connection affect information transparency?
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes whether the political connections will impact information transparency. The empirical results indicate politically connected firms have lower quality of information than non-connected peers, however, the improvement of the institutional environment can relieve or eliminate the negative influence taken by the political connections. And the substitution effect is significantly weak in the regions with high financial development and sound law systems.

articleTitle: Research on the Chinese text retrieval method using context
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method to expand query words based on the context is proposed in this paper, which aims at the problem that the retrieval effect will be affected if request words used in the text retrieval can not match text words. This method does words expansion based on the context information of the query word. Additionally, the position information between the query word and the whole query sentence or the query word is considered. Experimental results show that this method greatly improves the average precision ratio.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Land Use evolution and appraisal of eco-urban construction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Rats' navigation control scheme in a mobile ad hoc network based on multi-rats
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bio-robots, one of the hot topics, are the highly advanced and integrated product of electronic information technology, microfabrication technology and biological sciences. Owing to the short communication distance of a single animal, restrict its application in large-scare areas and complex environments. Multi-animals solved problems of short communication distance and high loss rate in complex environments. This article first simply describes the mobile ad hoc network based on multi-rats and the problems of the network. Then it details the executable scheme used for solving the problems.

articleTitle: Networked industrial agglomeration of electronic equipment manufacturing industry in Guangdong province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, the agglomeration of China's electronic equipment manufacturing industry has developed rapidly, showing a trend of networked tendency. Guangdong province is a main industrial agglomeration area of electronic equipment manufacturing industry. The research on its agglomerative phenomenon and trend is representative. Firstly, we define the networked industrial agglomeration and briefly review relevant researches both at home and abroad. Then we analyze the current situation of the networked industrial agglomeration in Guangdong province and find some problems, such as low economic efficiency, lacking of creativity and international competitiveness, serious environmental pollution, and so on. On this basis, we start the empirical study of networked industrial agglomeration of electronic equipment manufacturing industry in Guangdong province so that we could make judgment about its development stage and tendency.

articleTitle: Dual analysis on conflicts of water utilization and water quality maintenance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of our society and the growth of economy and population, the conflicts of water resources utilization and water pollution become more and more serious. As scarce and fragile resources, the quantity and quality of the carrying capacity of water resources is limited and exhaustive. It is necessary to study it further in this regard in order to ensure sustainable development of water resources. Based on resource scarcity and the limited rationality of economic entity, this paper applied game theory in water resource allocation. Currently, the phenomenon of water pollution and the conflicts in water resources utilization are coexistence in China, this paper use the game theory to build the game model of water resources allocation to explore measures to solve the “public tragedy” in current water resources utilization and propose some references in solving water crisis, water rights allocation and the reform of water management mechanism for policy makers. We hope the study can promote harmonious coexistence between humankinds in water resources protection.

articleTitle: Analysis and research on register window technique and stack frame
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article introduces the register window technique and stack frame, and analyses the process of the subroutine calls through an example program, taking SPARC v8 for an example.

articleTitle: Content aware retargeting of soccer video
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A content aware retargeting (CAR) method is proposed for soccer video in small devices. According to domain-specific knowledge, the user interested objects (UIOs) in different type of shots are detected individually, and then a region of interest (ROI) of each shot is optimized with the scaling factor, which enlarges the cropped window to contain more semantic content while keeping the proper sizes and aspect ratio of UIOs. The simulation results prove that the proposed method wins better viewing experiences than the traditional methods such as resizing in a “letter box” mechanism or cropping directly.

articleTitle: Research on the social impact of IT project
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of discussing the importance on information technology (IT), the meaning of IT project is defined. With the advent of information age, people realize the importance of IT project to today's society as well as its impact on both sides of the society gradually. The positive and negative impact on society that IT project may have is described from these points of view, such as socio-economic, politics, social culture, education and people's life. Through a comprehensive analysis of the social impact on IT projects, not only can improve awareness of IT project, but also settle the foundation for the social evaluation of IT project.

articleTitle: Analysis of multi-campus university students managing work modes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The multi-campus situation in our country is formed during the process of the colleges and universities' deeper reform and development. The students managing work, as the key component of university education, is facing an unprecedented situation and circumstances. To analyze and study the characteristics, modes and principles of our multi-campus university students managing work, possesses a definite realistic meaning and theoretical value.

articleTitle: Savings deposits analysis of residents in Shanxi Province empirical
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the theory of saving research in western, and the changes in household savings deposits caused by changes in disposable income which is caused by the development of Shanxi Province for the past two years, the paper establish the model. Through the empirical analysis and regression testing of the factors which affect the residents of deposits. The results show that the key facter, which increases household savings deposits of urban and rural residents in Shanxi Province, is increasing the disposable income. And according to the empirical analysis of the above conclusions, the paper gives some appropriate policy recommendations

articleTitle: Identify of bus incident reason based on Fuzzy cluster analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the course of the operation of bus system, once the bus incident occurs, bus dispatch center needs to develop real-time adjustment measures. Identify the courses of the incident is the basis for development online dispatching measure, the paper researches the measures of bus incident auto-detection and identification the courses led to incident. According to bus location and speed information collecting from GPS satellite positioning system, compare the actual running situation and driving program, study the method of bus incident auto-detection. According to bus stations passenger data and sections occupancy data when bus incident occurring, using Fuzzy cluster analysis method to study the measure of identifying the courses led incident. According to bus operation data comes from a bus line in shanghai, calculate the similarity of validation sample and history typical sample to identify the courses led to bus incident, and compare the simulation results with actual situation. The comparison shows the fuzzy cluster analysis is an effective method to apply into identifying the courses led bus incident.

articleTitle: Research on technology of monoclinic water storage structures automatic identification based on Geological Map
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The characteristics of distribution and burying of ground water are closely related to the nature of rocks and geological structures. The studies of this paper were based on spatial distribution law and structural features of the water control structures, combining with experiences of hydro-geological workers and expert knowledge. By using of the Geological Map and other auxiliary information, this paper presented the conceptual model and logic model of monoclinic water storage structure, as well as a set of automatic, semi-automatic identification mechanism of monoclinic storage structures. The results of this research can be referenced to modeling and identification of other types of water storage structures.

articleTitle: Domestic industrial restructuring and outbound FDI: The case of Korean investment in China
