publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The relationship between domestic industrial restructuring and outbound FDI is not concrete. Particularly it is unknown that how domestic industrial restructuring affects outbound FDI. This paper finds that the goals of Korean outbound FDI match well with the goals of Korean domestic industrial restructuring, and Korean domestic industrial restructuring promotes the development of Korean investment in China, and predicts that Korean investment in China will change to be more technology intensive structured, some transiting to knowledge seeking investment, and spatial dynamics in China will be intensified.

articleTitle: Feicheng coalfield sequence stratigraphy and correlation analysis of coal quality indicators
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the use of sequence stratigraphic research methods, we discuss Feicheng coalfield sedimentary system. The coal-bearing formation in research area is divided into three types, i.e. tidal flat depositional system, tidal flat (barrier)-lagoon depositional system and river controlled shallow water delta depositional system and division, identification, comparison and follow-up analysis of the system domain cell are also studied, then 17 small tectonic sequences of inland sea are obtained. On the basis of sequence stratigraphy research, we analyze the relationship of main coal seam sulfur and ash, sulfur and volatile, volatile and components and from depositional environment point of view, expound the depositional environment impacting on coal petrology elements, coal-forming substance and original environment. Coal quality indicators related causes are revealed.

articleTitle: SVM-based prediction of runoff in headwater region of the Yellow River
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The hydrological system is a system of high nonlinearity. Runoff is the result from the comprehensive action of climate conditions and drainage area underlying surface. The support vector machine (SVM) is a new machine learning method based on the statistical learning theory and it can solve the high nonlinearity, regression, etc in the sample space and also can be used as the hydrological system identification tool. By means of phase space reconstruction, it establishes the SVM model input/output samples; with small sample runoff series, it sets up SVM predicting models. The prediction results show that SVM model has strong generalization ability and very satisfactory prediction results. It effectively solves such problems as small samples, over-learning, high dimension, local minimum, etc. The prediction of the future runoff evolution trend with this model will provide the basis for water regulation and water resources reasonable configuration.

articleTitle: Design and application of monitoring system of Shenyang real estate market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using domestic and overseas macro economy and real estate monitoring theories and practice for reference and based on the actual situation of Shenyang real estate market (newly built commercial housing), the continuity of monitoring, evaluation and alert system is pursued; the judgment criteria (normal floating range) for market monitoring, evaluation indicator system and various indicator systems are put forward; making use of composite index of warning, signal light method and combined with BP neural network alert model, the real estate market in Shenyang is successfully studied and the results show that real estate market in Shenyang was depressed in 1998, 2008 and 2009, and the market was very good in 2007.

articleTitle: Suggestions for the fostering of entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Entrepreneurship is a source of innovation and change. The paper first analyses the exact nature of entrepreneurship and its role in economic theory, then the individual and environmental determinants of entrepreneurship is presented. At the final part, the paper gives some suggestions as to how to foster entrepreneurship. The author argues that a comprehensive approach to the promotion of entrepreneurship rests on three primary pillars: strengthening of entrepreneurial skills, improving entrepreneurial framework conditions and supporting entrepreneurship education in universities.

articleTitle: Turnover of airlines employees: Examining empirically the influence of work life-benefits
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study focuses on the soft work life environment of airlines through examing the relationships between work life-benefits and turnover intention of airlines with SPSS 17.0. A total of 528 airlines employees from Air China, China Eastern Airlines, Shanghai Airlines and Spring Airlines completed an questionnaire either online or by paper. The results suggest that of work-life benefits has a significant negative relationship with turnover intentions and service-oriented organizational citizenship mediated the relationship significantly.

articleTitle: A GIS based analysis of influencing factors of spatial distribution of rural settlements
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this thesis, Mayang County is served as an example, by means of GIS spatial analysis and landscape index analysis methods, using Land Use Data of Mayang County in 2005, It analyzes the features of spatial distribution of rural settlement. It also analyzes the three main influencing factors, including natural environment and socioeconomic environment, production environment on rural residential land distribution. Based on the analysis of the influentcing factors, the authors put forward some suggestions on the adjustment of the distribution of rural residential land.

articleTitle: Peer selection for Load Balancing in 3G cellular networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the architecture and characteristics of 3G cellular networks, peer selection algorithms with the idea of traffic localization are not suitable for mobile P2P systems in 3G cellular networks, and load balance on the cells should be taken into account. In this paper, we propose a peer selection algorithm named CFLB for mobile P2P systems in 3G cellular networks. The CFLB algorithm always chooses a peer with the highest available uplink bandwidth from a cell with the lowest traffic load until the number of peers is reached. Simulation results indicate that the CFLB algorithm can achieve excellent load balance on the cells in 3G cellular networks while ensuring favorable peer performance.

articleTitle: An improved RBF deforming algorithm in 3D face morphable model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An improved RBF (Radial Basis Function) deforming algorithm, which is based on the RBF interpolation of scattered data and aims at the deficiency of RBF algorithm in 3D face morphable model, is proposed in this paper. According to the different characteristics of feature points and non-feature points, it chooses different parameter values for the basis function to make the adjustment transformation more reasonable in the model. Then it executes a secondary smoothing on the local areas containing feature points again by use of the binary cubic polynomial interpolation method to avoid producing the distortion model, and further characterizes the specific feature details of the face organs. Ultimately it obtains a smooth and natural personalized 3D face model.

articleTitle: Explaining inter-metropolitan variation in housing rents in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the supply and demand equilibrium market model, the paper uses the panel data model of 35 cities in China from 2003 to 2008 to explain inter-metropolitan variation in housing rents in China. The main conclusions are: (1) The housing rents are positively correlated with housing prices, but negatively correlated with housing price growth expectations; (2) The proportion of non-household population is one of the important factors for the intercity housing rents differences, but the total urban population isn't statistically significant at the 0.10 level; (3) The coefficient estimates for both short-term income and long-term revenue are negative, however only for short-term income is statistically significant; (4) Urban economic development significantly affect the intercity housing rents differences, but the city's livable degree is not a significant factor.

articleTitle: Model of hole scattering of strained Si (101)
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Fermi's golden rule and the theory of Boltzmann collision term approximation, taking into account all the scattering mechanisms contributed by ionized impurity, acoustic phonon and non-polar optical phonon, the model of total scattering rate of strained Si/(101) Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> is established. By calculating the hole scattering rate of strained Si/(101) Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> and simulating it with Matlab software, it was found that the total scattering rate of hole in strained Si/(101) Si1-xGex decreases obviously with the increasing stress when Ge fraction x is less than 0.2 and the values continue to show a constant tendency. In comparison with one of unstrained Si, the total hole scattering rate of strained Si/(101) Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> decreases about 45% at most. The hole mobility enhancement in strained Si materials is due to the decreasing hole scattering rate. The result can provide valuable references to the research of hole mobility of strained Si materials and the design of PMOS devices.

articleTitle: The research of the building of competency model system in high-speed railway based on fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to “The long-term development plan of China”, to meet the rapidly growing of passengers, China will built the fast passage between big cities and capital cities, including four vertical and four horizontal rail lines and four systems of intercity high speed rail. And also will complete construction of more than 12,000 kilometers of passenger line. With the development of high-speed railway. A large number of high-quality talents are badly needed. In order to point out the professional quality of staffs in the high speed railway system scientifically and quantitatively, this paper describes the procedures and methods of constructing competence assessment system with competency model and the fuzzy AHP method, mainly including the way to determine the job responsibilities, to give job competency evaluation, to calculation weight and how to apply the results.

articleTitle: Simulation research on overall coordinated development in intra-county economic system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Solow Economic Growth Model, considering various factors affecting the overall economic coordinated development of Jiangyin, dynamic evolution model can reflect the actual conditions of Jiangyin City. The simulation results indicate that Jiangyin still can obtain better development in economy in the next 40 years: output, knowledge, capital and input will increase greatly. The growth of population will get restricted due to resources and environment and meanwhile consumption of natural resources will rise. These indicate that if Jiangyin wants to keep the sustainable development of economy, it has to adjust the industrial structure, reduce the proportion of the second industry which depends more on resources, ecological and environment, speed up the development of modern service industry, and rely on the growth of knowledge for economic growth, which is the access to sustainable development of Jiangyin's intra-county economic system.

articleTitle: Strip steel surface defect image mosaic method based on area CCD
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The strip steel surface defects which collected by area CCD are not continuous image, there are overlap between each other. In order to join the overlapped images properly, and meantime maintain the original image feature, a weighted average fusion method based on provincial characteristics is adapted. A linear interpolation image fusion method is proposed for improving the contrast of the fused image, enhance the high frequency information, and eliminate matching trace. With linear interpolation image fusion, the pixels gray value of overlap area is replaced by the corresponding weighted average of gray value in two images. Experimental results show that the fusion method can meet the requirements of strip steel defect detection. And it can effectively eliminate the traces of image mosaic, make the image clearer. This made a foundation for the strip surface defect identification and quality evaluation.

articleTitle: A novel authentication and key agreement scheme for peer-to-peer streaming
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Reasonable and efficient security mechanism is the key to operating peer-to-peer (P2P) streaming systems. To save the cost of both communication and computation, ECC-based self-certified public key cryptosystems (ECCSCPKC) is introduced to construct the system security infrastructure. And its related security schemes are used for designing an efficient authentication and key agreement (AKA) protocol, which can protect against attacks from the outsider so that only registered user can access services with data confidentiality, integrity and authenticity.

articleTitle: Research on simulating and modelling dynamics of double clutch transmission (DCT)
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Shifts in a dual-clutch transmission (DCT) are realized by torque transfer from one clutch to another without traction interruption. Thus the shift raw is quite important for the performance of DCT. Analyzing the dynamics and its raw of DCT, dynamic model and the control logic for the integrated vehicle are built using Matlab/simulink as the simulation platform in this paper. With a given input parameters such as throttle position, braking pedal position, etc. the transmission shift quality, impact index are assessed and the effectiveness of the shift control is validated as well.

articleTitle: Study on Web-GIS resource control model based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In accordance with the requirement of resource management from the big space-map information amount of the Web-GIS system, this paper proposes a new resource control model based on multi-agent. This model divides the Web-GIS system into 4 levels and 6 categories of agents, analyzes resource possession condition of agents on each level and at different states, and also studies the change process of resource control when agents are under state transition.

articleTitle: Study on power grid wind hazard precaution system based on PLS-MOS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The severe wind is one of the greatest threatening natural disasters to power grid operation. According to the difficulties encountered in evaluation and forecasting of severe wind intensity, a severe wind statistical diagnosis model is proposed in this paper by using Partial least-squares and Model Output Statistics (PLS-MOS) methods. This model can accurately predict severe wind speed in the power grid region through interpolation smoothing to the forecast result of each weather site. Furthermore, combining with the wind-resistant design parameters of transmission tower, a power grid wind hazard precaution system based on electric power GIS (EPGIS) platform is supplied in order to remind the relevant operator for their decision-making and emergency treatment through real-time SMS and GIS location display. This system can further perfect the hazard prediction and precaution system, and improve the forecast ability of the severe wind hazard. It is of important practical significance and application value for power grid disaster prevention and reduction.

articleTitle: Research and design of gateway node based on CDMA for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The gateway node for wireless sensor networks based the mobile communication system of CDMA is researched and designed. Firstly, the architecture of the gateway node with ZigBee module, CDMA module and ARM processor is demonstrated. Then, the hardware designing of the WSN gateway node is described in detail. In the forth segment, programming for ZigBee chip and ARM processor are given to illustrate the idea of software. Also, the format conversion of protocols from ZigBee to TCP/IP is described in detail. Network status of different sections such as ZigBee network, CDMA network and the whole network are tested. It is resulted that the data transmission from the sensor networks to the remote data center can be completed easily by using the gateway node developed by our teams.

articleTitle: A generalization of modified de Bruijn sequences
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the sequences created by removing a single one from the longest run of ones in period 2n de Bruijn sequences (called de Bruijn-1 sequences) are the generalization of modified de Bruijn sequences (called de Bruijn-0 sequences). De Bruijn-0 sequences and de Bruijn-1 sequences are referred to as de Bruijn-0/1 sequences. The feedback functions and linear complexities are discussed. A new symmetry called TRUE/FALSE symmetry is proposed for de Bruijn-0/1 sequences. Detailed data of complexities is presented for orders 5 ≤ n ≤ 6.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of digital lock-in amplifier based on the DSP Builder
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the design of gas detection system, in order to eliminate 1/f noise and other strong noises, the solution is usually to adopt a modulated light source and a phase-locked detection system. Therefore, for detecting harmonics signal after gas absorption, we has designed and simulated the digital lock-in amplifier with DSP Builder on the basis of the principle of the lock-in amplifier. Through checking out the existing problem with the initial design using the DSP Builder, we modify the design and finally obtain the optimal parameters. Simulation results show that the designed digital lock-in amplifier can remove the noises by applying the correlation detection approach.

articleTitle: Research on the “SHAN ZHAI” mobile telephone and the intellectual property rights strategies of the developing countries
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: “SHAN ZHAI” mobile telephone and the series “SHAN ZHAI” phenomena cause strong concerns in many fields. The problems of intellectual property rights management strategy and the national intellectual property rights system it occurs should be seriously considered and solved in time. This thesis analyses the conception and characteristics and origin of the “SHAN ZHAI” mobile telephone, together with the intellectual property rights problems it brings about, and presents the intellectual property rights strategy that China should take, as an emerging technology follower, under the national strategy of constructing the innovative country, to the “SHAN ZHAI” mobile telephone.

articleTitle: The establishment of AHP-BP neural network model and its application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional BP neural network is widely used in pattern recognition, image processing and intelligent control, and achieve satisfactory results. However the network has its inherent deficiencies. When we research complex system, for instance, society and economic system, the input variables of the neural network are hard to determine. In the paper, aiming at the characteristics of neural network structure, an idea of connecting AHP and BP is presented. The idea is to use the character that AHP can select the independent variables that affect the dependent variables essentially, and to decide the input variables of BP neural network. Moreover, we adopt this idea to build the AHP-BP neural network model, and design the arithmetic. The AHP-BP neural network model can not only make the selection of input variables easily, but also accelerate the convergence and improve the adaptability of the network. Then we put it use into the economic fields, the results show that this method is superior to the statistical modeling approach.

articleTitle: A new optimal cost model of queue systems with Heavy-Tailed distribution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The heavy-tailed characteristic has been emerged in the distributions of Internet flow sizes, web pages and computer files. So the M/Heavy-Tailed/K queue system is the highlight of the research of queue systems. In this paper, it is firstly proved that the efficiency of multiple servers is equal to the single server when all of servers work with full load. Then, with the cost objective function, the optimal number of servers for the queue systems is presented with three heavy tailed distributions, which are the bimodal distribution, bounded Pareto distribution and power-law distribution. An event-driven simulator for queuing systems is proposed to the simulation of the M/HT/K queue systems. According to theoretical analysis and numerical simulation, the optimal number of servers for the M/HT/K system with cost objective function is less than that of system with the average response time as its objective function. It implies that the latter model emphasizes the optimization of the response time, not the optimal cost which is the key of the former system.

articleTitle: The analysis of liability risk allocation for Integrated Project Delivery
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) build a model to improve project outcomes through a collaborative approach and a multi-party agreement. But IPD is short of mature laws and system like liability allocation and risk control. Thus the overall objective of this study is to make a research and discuss into the risk liability allocation problems, where basic risk allocation problems are discussed and effective mechanisms are summarized in this paper. Risk/profit sharing mechanism and liability harbor mechanism are proposed to improve the rationalization and available of IPD. And insurance coverage should be an effective complement in the actual project of construction.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal patterns of rural settlements in Jingzhou County, Hunan province, China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper applies the GIS technology to investigate the spatiotemporal patterns of rural settlement in Jingzhou County of Hunan province. First, the vector data layers of rural settlements were extracted from the land use data in 1990 and 2005, respectively. These data layers were used in GIS software to calculate such landscape metrics as TARP, TNP, MAP, LAP, MPS, LPI, which quantified the spatial distributions of rural settlement plaques in 1990 and 2005, respectively. The two data layers were also overlaid with road networks and river systems to visually examine the impact of the linear features on the spatial patterns of the rural settlements. The findings suggest that the size and the number of the rural residential points have decreased during the 15-year period. Moreover, the spatial distribution patterns of the villages in the study area were largely affected by roads and rivers.

articleTitle: Design of wireless communication nodes based on AT86RF230
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the shortcomings of existing forest monitoring method and the short communication distance of existing wireless sensor node for forest environmental monitoring, a new-style node based on AT86RF230 was designed. In this design, micro-controller is ATMega128L, radio frequency chip is AT86RF230, and a folded dipole is used. The effective communication distance of wireless sensor nodes in open field is 200m, and that is 85m in the planted forest, fully satisfying the needs of forest environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on the constitution and identification of IT project economic benefits
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: IT project economic benefit is the core to IT project economic analysis (national economic evaluation). To identify and measure IT project economic benefit in a scientific way laid the foundation for economic analysis. From the perspective of economic analysis, economic benefits of IT project are calculated in this paper for measuring the project contribution to the national economy. According to the theory of project economic evaluation, the connotation of IT project economic benefit were analyzed profoundly and the classification of IT project economic benefits were first proposed. According to the basic requirements of identification of IT project economic benefits, combined with the characteristics of IT project, we focused on the composition of IT project economic benefits, which were divided into the direct benefit and the indirect benefit.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for finding the communities surrounding a given node
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Excepting Wu_Huberman algorithm, most existing community detection methods cannot allow for finding the particular communities to which a specified vertex belongs; however, Wu-Huberman algorithm need to know in advance that how many communities should be divided and then it cannot automatically detect an underlying community structure. According to divisive methods for finding a community structure based on edge betweenness measure, a new algorithm is presented to solve this problem. This new algorithm not only can speed up the betweenness calculation, but also can allow for automatically discovering the underlying communities surrounding a given node without having to find all communities of a graph.

articleTitle: Flash vaporization forecast and control in the heavy oil production well by steam flood
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the production process of heavy oil production well by steam flooding, local pressure drop is caused by the suction of pump when the oil-water mixture flows through the fixed valve, which causes flash vaporization in the pump. Flash vaporization in the pump will cause pump air lock, tubing and pump damage, fluid production decreased. Based on borehole temperature, pressure calculation model of heavy oil production well by steam flooding, local resistance coefficient of the fixed valve is determined by the local resistance test of liquid flowing through the pump fixed valve, and then pressure drop calculation model of oil and water mixture flowing through the fixed vale is determined according to the energy equation. Combined with the critical temperature - pressure curve of saturated steam of hexane and water, flash vaporization forecast model of heavy oil production well by steam flood in the pump is established. Real-time monitoring to the flash vaporization in the pump can be achieved based on the liquid production, water content, temperature and other production parameters of wellhead and well structure parameters. Field test and flash vaporization forecast are carried out with example of Jin-45-22-K281 well, compared with the calculation results and test results, the flash vaporization in the pump can be predicted accurately by the flash vaporization forecast model of heavy oil production well by steam flood, no liquid can be avoided in time, to ensure normal operation of downstream equipment, to provide a theoretical basis for flash prevention.

articleTitle: An effective method of electrostatic potential calculation on protein binding site
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During protein molecules binding process, electrostatic interaction plays a crucial role. Calculation of electrostatic potential on protein binding site is important for studying protein structure and function. We design an algorithm to calculate electrostatic potentials between the aromatic rings in the bound ligands and nucleic acids and their cognate proteins. By analyzing a diverse set of complex structures, we have found that the electrostatic potentials of the carbon atoms of an aromatic ring are higher than those of methyl/methylene atoms in the same molecule. The discovery can greatly improve molecular docking efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The recycle of leachate in removing heavy metals from the sludge by bioleaching
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on emergency decision-making information mining based on existing “obstacle” between geographic entities in spatial topological relations
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Emergency decision-making mining must consider “obstacle” between the geographic entities in spatial topological relations and their intrinsic relationship, or the integrity and accuracy of the mining results would not be guaranteed. Based on the deep research above, the mechanism and law of geospatial information was explored, the traditional spatial topological relations were expanded. The number of topological relation between point, line and region was 11. By constructing the qualitative expression (ϑ: DIR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</inf>: DIR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>), the topological relations were expressed qualitatively, and the spatial reasoning was realized. Meanwhile, the algorithm of decision-making information mining was studied. Combining with the abstract algebra theory, the mining algorithm was constructed. Based on the expanded topological relations above, the traditional information mining algorithms were improved. Through the analysis of emergency response decision-making information intent, this paper expands the theory of traditional information extraction methods to solve the theoretical and technical problems, which provides a support for the scientific and reasonable emergency decision-making, etc. This case study demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the decision-making information mined from this study.

articleTitle: Chaotic feature of water swallowing sound signal revealed by correlation dimension
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When a person drinks some water, the water will flow via pharynx, esophagus, cardia of stomach and finally into stomach. In the process, the sound produced is called water swallowing (WS) sound. The chaotic feature of WS sound signal was investigated. WS sounds acquired with an acoustic pickup attached to the abdominal walls of healthy subjects and analyzed with a computer-aided sound analysis program. Phase space was reconstructed from the sound signal time series of 5 episode WS sound signals and attractors were plotted. Correlation dimensions (CD) of the attractors in 4-dimension phase space were calculated. All attractors exhibited complex pattern as strange attractors and all CD values were non-integer. The dynamic behavior of the WS sound signals of normal subjects was chaotic.

articleTitle: An empirical research on R&D investment and economic growth
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the panel-data of Hebei province from 2000 to 2008, this paper conducts an empirical analysis of the relationship between the R&D investment and the economic growth. The resuhs indicate that R&D investment has positive effect on the economic growth. The coefficient of R&D investment decreases gradually year after year.

articleTitle: DEA method and Traditional corporation governance efficiency evaluation methodology comparative study
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper used DEA model and traditional and carried on the positive research to the achievement of the listed company of the retail business. By DEA validity Analysis and scale income analysis on the efficiency at each the achievements of listed company, made some advices for investors, investment and offered some data to draw lessons to the listed company too.

articleTitle: Exact outage probability for decode-and-forward two-way relaying with asymmetric traffics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we conduct a new outage analysis for decode-and-forward (DF) two-way half-duplex relaying with asymmetric traffics. Starting from the description of outage capacity and outage probability, we present a definition of outage event by jointly considering outage events at the two senders. Then, we derive the closed-form outage probability expressions for a conventional three-node DF two-way relaying network in frequency-nonselective Rayleigh fading channels, where the derived exact expressions are applicable to all traffics, rate and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) values and link gains. Numerical and Monte Carlo simulation experiments are done. Our results show that for some specific traffics the performance measure of outage probability is only determined by one-way channel. Moreover, our results validate the accuracy of the derived closed-form expressions and the propositions.

articleTitle: Ensembled artificial neural networks for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma classification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to classify two types of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), which are the germinal-center type (GCB) and the activated B-cell type (ABC), non-medical methods (i.e. engineering method such as ensembled artificial neural networks (EANN)) were applied to do quantitative analysis. Sensitivity analysis (SA) for EANN was carried out to evaluate the significance ranking of the miRNAs and finally selected 5 most important miRNAs. Besides, classical linear and logistic regression models were developed for comparison with EANN classification results. Their results were both evidently worse than EANN model. This study proves that each lymphoma type has a distinctive pattern of miRNAs expression. EANN model achieved successful results. Specially, the 5 selected important miRNAs will be helpful for further study.

articleTitle: Research on the prediction model of supply risk based on DT
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an effective method of machine learning, Decision Tree machine has been widely used in prediction. Proposition the supply of risk control and prevention, based on establishment evaluation index system and questionnaire to enterprise, this paper construct the supply risk prediction model and then discuss the fitting degree of model, expect to provide the basis for supply risk management.

articleTitle: Diesel engine fault diagnosis method based on MPDE-SVM and its application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There is much difficulty in fault diagnosis because of lacking of system fault samples. So this paper presents a mixed strategy of combining differential evolution algorithm with local enhanced operator with the optimization of the parameters of support vector machine. For the diesel engine valve clearance fault diagnosis, the measured diesel engine valve vibration signals data after wavelet transform are used as the characteristic values of the diagnostic model. Then the diesel engine valve clearance fault diagnosis model of SVM based on MPDE is established and compared with the BPNN, SVM and IQPSO-RBF models, The results showed that the performance of the SVM optimized by MPDE algorithm is better than the models based on the other three algorithms. The method is practical and effective.

articleTitle: Analysis on farmers' willingness to pay forestry insurance and the counter-measurement in forest tenure reform—Take Yichun of Jiangxi as the example of the research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Forestry insurance had an important role in reducing the risk of forestry management. The evolving history of forest tenure reform and forestry insurance in China are reviewed in this paper firstly. Then, the factors which affect the willingness to pay forestry insurance are analyzed on the base of the investigation of YiChun of Jiangxi with Logistic Model. The result of analyses indicates that the biggest risk in forestry management, householder's educational level, the householder's recognizer for the awareness of forest insurance and the family income are the key factors affecting the willingness to pay forestry Insurance. The counter-measurements are proposed to advance forestry insurance.

articleTitle: Channel estimation iterative algorithm for OFDM systems based on windowed fourth Discrete Cosine Transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Pilot-Symbol Assisted Modulation (PSAM) is an usual channel method for OFDM systems. On the basis of Windowed the fourth Discrete Cosine Transform (WDCT-IV), a new channel estimation iterative algorithm for OFDM systems is proposed. By exploiting the characteristics of iterative detection, the proposed algorithm inhibits the additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) and inter-carrier interference (ICI) more effectively. Simulation result shows that the technique is effective and the system performance is better than one of Ref.[11] under the multipath fading channels.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of custom input method in J2ME environment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In programming, it is required to be designed the specific input method for the program in many cases. This is especially true in J2ME circumstance. Because of its special keyboard structure, the program in mobile phone is more complex than the computer when customized input method. In this paper, take a mobile phone custom Pinyin input method for example, it realizes the throughout process of custom input method. This method is also applied to the design of custom input method in other circumstances.

articleTitle: A measurement and modeling study of residential Internet user behavior
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Understanding residential Internet user behavior from operational networks is critical to the design, evaluation and accounting of the access network and network applications. We present analysis of a data set comprised of a week of RADIUS authentication data taken from a large city Internet Service Provider (ISP). We present basic statistics, including session counts based on time-of-day, session length distribution, session inter-arrival times, user usage time distribution, user traffic distribution, upload and download traffic. We also developed models for these behaviors. Our results provide important data for the simulation and modeling of access network protocols and applications.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model for the futures company core competence in the financial perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article is according to the news of the stock-index futures listed on t January 8, 2010 in china. With one futures company as research object, a comprehensive evaluation index system of futures company core competence is established from financial perspective. The coefficient of variation method is applied to all kinds of financial index which modify subjective tax power of expert scoring. Then, using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation analysis shows that the financial perspective of futures company core competence comprehensive evaluation can provide reference for the investor or operator.

articleTitle: Extinct regeneration: From morphology to genome, and to living animals
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The article provides a theoretical opinion on the relationship of genome and morphology, and suggests biological phenomenon is an activity of information from genome to morphology and function, while the reverse progress is also possible. Therefore, human can reconstruct the full genome of extinct animals from their morphology, and regenerate living animals.

articleTitle: Efficient fast motion estimation optimization based on the improved cross search template for H.264
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with previous video standards, the computational complexity of H.264/AVC is extraordinarily high due to newly adopted tools such as variable block size motion estimation. To reduce the high computational demands of H.264 coding standard, a hierarchical search strategy for ME is proposed by the deep research of the characteristics of motion estimation. This strategy consists of improved unsymmetrical cross search pattern. It predicts the motion range of the current block based on the computed RDO value character and the relation between the collocated blocks. Then based on this, variable search masks are applied in the following search steps. This scheme consists of the improved initial search point, search pattern, search range and match criterion. The experiment result shows that the method can save about 20% encode time compared to the current fast algorithms in the latest JM(Joint Model reference) software, while achieve almost the same PSNR as the full search algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on risk management system of large-scale transportation construction projects—Based on ecological theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of ecological system theory, this paper constructs the risk management system of large-scale transportation construction projects, studies the systematic characteristics, life-cycle characteristics, dynamic characteristics, organic characteristics and multi-factors, as well as the multi-level complex relevant features of project risk management system, analyzes and applies the ecological factor theory, niche theory, ecological matching theory and ecological regulation theory to the construction of project risk analysis sub system, project risk evaluation sub-system, project risk prior-alarming sub-system, project risk responding sub-system separately, and fulfills the comprehensive project risk management system based on ecological theory sequent, at last the feasible and actual technical route is given in this paper.

articleTitle: The simulation analysis of hydraulic energy regenerative system for the burden vehicle based on the Linear Quadratic Regulator theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The energy regenerative system of the burden vehicle based on hydraulic accumulator has arousing a wide attention because of its particular higher power density in recent years. Taking hydraulic hybrid vehicle as a study object and the speed following of the secondary component (hydraulic motor mode) as the control objective, the state space math model of the electrical-hydraulic control system has been established in this paper. The math model of the control system imported the quadratic optimal control theory or not has been simulated and analyzed all alone. The results of simulation showed that the vibration and overshoot of the response course of the control system obtained inhibited and attenuated largely when the system imported the quadratic optimal control theory and the control system behaved a better response performance at the same time. Besides that the response performance of this control system behaves well or not has a close relationship to the value of the parameter Q and R of the weighted matrix.

articleTitle: A research on how e-government promote service quality of government in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Service quality is an important index to value working effect of government. As a new type of service management, e-government could play a positive role to service quality of government. This paper research how e-government influences service quality. We find out the function, variables and the most important variables. Following that, we put forward some measure and proposals on how to improve service quality of Chinese government and some future research.

articleTitle: Research on the mechanism of undertaking the industrial transfer in Hefei
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Industrial transfer epitomizes the trend of economic globalization and regional economic integration. It is essential for Hefei City to grasp corresponding dynamic mechanism, selection mechanism, operating mechanism, coordination mechanism, excitation mechanism and security mechanism correctly, and carry on the industrial transfer of Yangtze Delta and other developed areas scientifically and effectively.

articleTitle: Urban community property management research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on residential property management of many contradictions and disputes, no longer isolated research management and residents, but the problems between the management system for the community, as a system, analyzes the whole community from community levels within the system, the relationship between elements and existing problems of the relationship, and better solution to the community management and property management, the existing problems in the community management scale and scale economy, promote the marketization of property management.

articleTitle: The urban expansion and urban green space change of Changchun City in resent ten years
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the city developing rapidly, the urban inhabitable environment has been changing in Changchun City. Based on the Landsat ETM+&TM remotely sensed data and the RS&GIS analysis technology, the urban expansion and green space change of Changchun City in resent ten years were analyzed. Over the past ten years, the urban constructed areas had increased dramatically, the average annual expansion area was 9.39km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and it was 2.2 times compared with the beginning of 21st century. In accordance with the urban planning, the main directions of urban expansion were north-east, west-east and east-south. The green coverage rate was increased of resent ten years in Changchun City. By 2010, there was 40.88km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> green spaces in the city, up 47.56% over 2001. The ecological environment for human settlements was improving in Changchun City.

articleTitle: Visual simulation of spatial information networks based on Google-Earth
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering the requirement of spatial information networks (SIN) visualization and the ideal of separating numerical calculation from graphic presentation, a visual simulation of SIN which bases on Google-Earth is proposed in this paper. Several key techniques are presented in detail. The reliability and accuracy of the simulation system are compared with STK with same parameters and the results indicate that our implementation is viable and accurate.

articleTitle: Infrared face recognition using radative energy and decision fusion
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel infrared face recognition method based on radative energy and decision fusion is presented in this paper. In this method, according to Stefan-Boltzmann's law, the raw thermogram images are transformed to the radiative energy images. Then, the block-DCT is applied to get the local features of face. Finally, a method of decision fusion based on probability is presented to obtain the final result. The experiment results show the method proposed performs better on recognition rates as compared to other methods.

articleTitle: Information extracting and assessment of soil erosion based on remote sensing information in the upper basin of Guanting reservoir
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Soil erosion of the upper basin of Guanting reservoir in Zhangjiakou was assessed based on Landsat TM5(2007-5-19) and DEM (1∶50000). <Standards for classification and gradation of soil erosion> (SL190-2007) and the multifactor comprehensive method were adopted, and land use, vegetal cover and slope were selected as assessing factors. The result shows that very low soil erosion covers 43.36%, and the intensive soil erosion patches are rather fragmentized and difficult to be treatment uniformly.

articleTitle: Optimal rates of empirical Bayes tests for a positive exponential family in the case of negatively associated samples
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By using the kernel-type density estimation in the case of identically distributed and negatively associated (NA) samples, the monotone empirical Bayes test(EBT) rules for the parameter of a positive exponential family in the case of NA samples are constructed and the asymptotically optimal property is obtained. It is shown that the convergence rates of the proposed EB test rules can arbitrarily close to O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>)under a somewhat weaker condition.

articleTitle: Total variation based wavelet packet transform for image denoising
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wavelet packet transform can preserve more details for image denoising, but it always has the ‘wrap-around’ artifacts in image. Total variation, another effective image denoising method, can preserve edges better, but image texture information will be also smoothed. An efficient image denoising method based on combination of wavelet packet transform and total variation model is proposed, and how to select the regularization parameter in this model is given. The numerical experimental results show that the new method is effective is removing gauss noise and the detail of the image is kept well.

articleTitle: The design of real-time information transmission system based on 3G technology and Pocket PC platforms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper develops a system of high-speed data transmission on Pocket PC platforms based on 3G network technology, with a high degree of programmability and portability. It is adopted by Microsoft Visual Studio. The system realizes the data collection and transmission through digital media instead of paper media. As it adopts the convergence between mobile phone networks and Internet, PPC terminal can exchange data with the central server. This paper illustrates the development and procedure of the modules.

articleTitle: Views on market value of mobile e-commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mobile e-commerce is a second-generation e-commerce. Due to its convenience and ubiquity, M-Commerce has great social and economic benefits and market prospects. No matter whether from the angle of development of production or from the needs, the mobile e-commerce shows great potential. E-Commerce, not a romance, is developing into a huge market. The industry reform aims to break the barrier of traditional monopolistic industry chain, recreate and optimize a new value chain, and eventually enable businesses to win long-lasting competitiveness.

articleTitle: Application of OPC interface technology in shearer remote monitoring system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Shearer is one of the important equipment in coal mine, which direct impact on the automation level of the entire mechanized mining face. In this paper, because at present a number of configurations and monitoring software is too expensive to buy, and operation and use is too complicated. The development cycle of the software is too long, so we put forward a OPC technology into shearer monitoring system. Successfully developed Shearer remote monitoring system based on the OPC interface. The remote monitoring system based on OPC can efficiently collect and monitor the condition of the shearer working state parameters, spend less than the configuration software, and improve the level of automation of our country's shearer industry.

articleTitle: Opposite re-ranking based on relevant sub-topic dispelling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Opposite re-ranking is a novel strategy to personalized information retrieval, it utilizes the description structure opposed to query intention, to achieve the recognition and dispelling of obstinate-negative feedback. At present, an important problem of the research in the opposite re-ranking is how to establish the maximum discriminative and representative opposite query intention. Aiming at the problem, this paper proposes an opposite re-ranking method based on dispelling of the relevant subtopics for the optimization of result list. The experiment makes use of TDT4 corpora to test, the results present this approach improves the search performance dramatically, the MAP enhances by 16 percents, P@20 and NDCG@20 increases by 14 percents and 12 percents respectively.

articleTitle: A novel P2P traffic identification model based on machine learning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: P2P traffic identification model based on machine learning is proposed. The FCBF(Fast Correlation-Based Filter) feature selection algorithm is used to select the P2P flow attribute features subset. A P2P flows identification model is built based on decision tree and FCBF. 10-fold cross-validation method is used to validate the proposed model. Experimental results show that the method of P2P traffic identification based on decision tree is feasible and the FCBF method is a useful method for extracting features from P2P flows.

articleTitle: Tuition pricing model of higher education—Based on the unity of Macroscopical and Microcosmic perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the unification of Macroscopical and Microcosmic perspective, this paper considers the society equity of higher education from Macrography perspective, colleges recovery their costs of higher education. Meanwhile, it reflects the principle of one should pay for what his or her gains in higher education from Micrography perspective. And under the direction of the principle of maximize the total utilities among society, college and individual. From the quantificational aspect, we build a programming model and combine with computer simulation to study it.

articleTitle: Bid evaluation decision-making based on the uncertain linguistic information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bid evaluation is a critical activity for a construction project. The bid opportunities are usually evaluated by a bid committee. A method for bid evaluation based on uncertain linguistic information is given. The numerical example of bid evaluation for construction project is presented to show the feasibility and effectiveness of this method. It can offer a new method for the construction project bid evaluation decision.

articleTitle: Study on multimedia IT and higher vocational English tests
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multimedia IT with forms like computerized adaptive test, human-computer interaction in oral test, computer scoring system, network scoring and data analysis used in higher vocational English tests has not only improved the efficiency, accuracy, objectivity and impartiality, but promoted the renewal and development of the idea and orientation, scope and testing design. Teachers are expected to learn more about latest testing theories and multimedia IT developments in order to upgrade their testing proficiency, enhancing the validity and analysis of results to feedback and improve English teaching.

articleTitle: The data reduction method of consistent decision tables based on rough set
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a new reduction, that is, considers the relation of attribute reduction and attribute value reduction. When making reduction, both the attribute reduction and the attribute value reduction can be done simultaneously in the process of reduction in a decision table. In comparison with the traditional methods, the complicated comparison process in the reduction of the attribute value can be omitted. the number of the comparison times can be decreased and the reduction efficiency can be raised after using the new methods in this paper, at the same time, this paper gives some proofs.

articleTitle: The research of anti-surge control on air separation compressor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly describes the reasons for compressor surge and damage, and provide the traditional control method, which can not meet the growing needs, the improved control method, which according to the data using the curve fitting least-square method and Newton interpolation method respectively determine surge control curve, and then compares the mean square deviation of the regression equation and determine the optimal curve. The least squares curve to determine surge control regression equation and make the compressor operate safely and reliably by using the fuzzy PID control algorithm on the parameter adjustment.

articleTitle: Query privacy in pervasive computing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With advance in wireless and location technology, Location-Based Services (LBSs) become the main applications in pervasive environment. Privacy of user query is becoming an increasingly important issue. In our proposed technique, user's point location has been expanded to region location. Because LBSs can't distinguish the true user from the other users in same region, user query privacy is protected. This paper has analyzed the problems that exist in the protecting of query privacy in pervasive computing. On this basis, a double threshold privacy model based on user distribution matrix is proposed for protecting user query privacy, include query location privacy and query content privacy. In this paper, we present a user cloaking algorithm to dynamic generation and modification user cloaking region. Experimental results validate the efficiency and effective of proposed technique.

articleTitle: The remote sensing recognition and extraction of waste dump in mining area using multi-source and multi-temporal remote sensing data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The long-term emissions and accumulation of tailings can occupy cultivated land and lead to environmental pollution. In the paper Jining Yanzhou mining of Shandong as an example, analyzed the spectral characteristics of tailings and typical surface features of their surroundings. And year-2006 Quickbird data as a reference combined with the ground survey points to identify the large-scale waste dumps using remote sensing, and based on which for multi-temporal CBERS-2 data to classify, and analyzed each temporal data, and analyzed the main interfering factors that affect the classification accuracy. Finally, take the intersection of multi-temporal data and extract accurate waste dump area. The result shows tailings extraction in remote sensing recognition using multi-source and multi-temporal data can do more accurate extraction and the results further for tailings management provide the basis for the investigation.

articleTitle: Influence of component shear strength on rock failure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mohr-Coulomb strength criteria is a conventional method for judgment of rock failure. Shear stress τ on the slip surface of rock is often calculated with principal stresses σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and it is used to compare with the ultimate strength τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> to evaluate the situation of rock. However, the position of slip surface, shear stress τ and ultimate strength τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> calculated with a set of parameters σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf>, σ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> and τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">zx</inf> are found different from the conventional Mohr-Coulomb method in this paper. A case is studied by numerical simulation and theoretical analysis, the results showed that when the component shear strength τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">zx</inf> is positive, the ultimate strength τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf> on the slip surface is bigger than that of the conventional method, but the rupture angle is smaller; when the component shear strength τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">zx</inf> is negative, the results are inverse. Therefore, the component shear strength τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">zx</inf> must be considered in rock failure judgment.

articleTitle: The fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of master of engineering teaching quality
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The quality of Master of Engineering Management teaching has a significant impact on the training of Engineering Management Master. The existing evaluation methods had not considered the dynamic variability of teaching quality, so it could not express the teaching quality comprehensively, and it also could not propose effective measures in improving the quality. Based on dynamic fuzzy set theory and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation by single-and multi-layer fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of teaching quality model was set. The model could not only reflect the degree of fuzzy evaluation, but also reflect the trend of its development and changes, It would help to evaluate the teaching quality of Master of Engineering more scientific and objectively.

articleTitle: Research and practice of Human-Computer Interaction in CAI of computer course
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Human-Computer Interaction has always been an important part in software's design and development, especially for CAI, how to make sure that learners can master the knowledge faster and better is what the designers of the software have to think about. This paper uses CAI for Course of Algorithm as an example, and discusses the ways and methods of the application of Human-Computer Interaction in CAI for the courses of Computer Science with abstract nature and practicality. From the practical application, we experienced the superiorities of applying appropriate Human-Computer Interaction technologies in CAI.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on the tunnel excavation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to shorten route and increase road grade, tunnel excavation road scheme will be widely used in mountain area, so tunnel stability will increasingly become important problem for design and construction. In this paper mechanical behavior of tunnel is simulated by FLAC during road tunnel excavation and support with three-dimensional Fast Lagrangian Method. It indicates through numerical simulation that regularities of distribution of displacement and stress in wall rock and supporting structure can be obtained in dynamic excavation by steps and support by steps; at the same time distribution and failure mechanism of plastic zone of wall rock is given about three different phases of without support, first support, second support.

articleTitle: From knowledge to competitive advantage: The Toyota knowledge network case study
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge creation, knowledge sharing and knowledge transfer are of strategic importance in bringing competitive advantage to companies in network settings. Taking Toyota's case as an example to show how these activities take place and how knowledge network aid to gain competitive advantage for a company.

articleTitle: A new method of bidding evaluation in Government project procurement
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In China, Government procurement system has been in its infancy stage and started to enter the management phase of the rule of law. Among them, the project procurement, the proportion of which accounting for the total size of government procurement is increasing every year, will have more and more important position. The joint bidding evaluation mode based on Value Engineering and Cost-Benefit Analysis is proposed. Thus, the bidder, who has best technical, economic and social benefits, is selected.

articleTitle: On the decay of global solutions for some nonlinear damped higher order wave equations
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The initial boundary value problem for a class of nonlinear higher order wave equation with damping and source term in a bounded domain is studied. The exponential decay of global solutions for this problem is obtained by establishing some estimates and using Young's inequality.

articleTitle: Study on the risk management of BOT project based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, according to the characteristics of BOT project risk, we combined the vertical tree of work breakdown with the horizontal tree of decomposing risk to form the WBS-RBS risk identification matrix. Based on the existing risk identification, we created the BP neural network model, and carried out the risk assessment through the learning and training of BP neural network, which has ensured the scientificalness and accuracy of risk assessment. Finally, we put forward some coping strategies against the risk of BOT project.

articleTitle: The principle and application software for the intelligent identification of sequence units
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Sequence stratigraphy is an important theory in the field of earth sciences which can analyze the stratigraphy and sedimentary. But how to divide sequence stratigraphic units quantitatively is always a challenge and frontier in this domain. Wavelet analysis is famous for “mathematics microscope”. Based on depth domain and wavelet analysis of logging data and former experts study, and by the guidance of the classic sequence stratigraphy, this article has designed an intelligent identification method to divide sequence stratigraphic units. Based on the research of the accumulative parameter of sand clay ratio and wavelet analysie, the software which can intelligently identify the sequence stratigraphic units is created. And this software has well applied in the analysis of real data.

articleTitle: Protein sequence alignment of target for entanyl analgesics μ-opioid receptor and its analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fentanyl is potential analgesics and highly selective μ-opioid receptor(OPRM) agonist protein sequences of OPRM_HUMAN, OPRM_RAT, OPRM_MOUSE was respectively obtained using NCBI GenBank, their similarity were analyzed with Clustal X softwares. The results showed that there was a higher degree of sequence similarity among them, they had higher homology and were highly conserved in evolution. There was not a much higher degree of sequence similarity between various OPRM and BRHO, not arriving at 30%; it needs intense adjustment to improve the modeling reliability. For the molecular, cell and pharmacological experiments, the alignment analysis might have certain theoretical guidance meaning and practical reference value. The aim of the project was to direct design and synthesis more effective fentanyl analogs as anti-terrorism compounds, to elucidate the interaction mechanism between fentanyl analogs and μ-opioid receptor.

articleTitle: Study of the moving object detection used ICM and ARBS algorithm in enhanced fish-eye image
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The enhanced fish-eye lens can imaging an elliptical image which has higher resolution and information capability than normal fish-eye image. It can be used in the surveillance system to get the wide range monitoring. The moving object detection algorithm of the intersecting cortical model (ICM) and the Auto-adapted Renewal Background Subtraction (ARBS) are discussed, and have been used in the enhanced fish-eye surveillance system to detect the moving object. The experiment indicated that the ICM algorithm could detected the running track of the object and the ARBS algorithm could detected the many objects all-weather in enhance elliptical fish-eye images. Using the enhanced fish-eye lens and the ICM or ARBS algorithm to design the surveillance system, it not only has super wide field of view but also has better ability of moving object detection. It can be used in the field of traffic monitor and other security domain.

articleTitle: Computer aid analysis of GHGs in dyeing and finishing process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Textile dyeing and finishing industry is one of the biggest GHG emitters on Earth. GHG is often expressed in carbon emission. In order to evaluate the emissions, a model is built on continuous dyeing process of cotton woven fabrics, which is one kind of producing procedures in dyeing and finishing industry. Computer is used to calculate and analyze the emission information in this paper. A series of analysis tools is proposed such as activity analysis tool, carbon emissions degree analysis tool and value efficiency analysis tool, which is helpful to make plans for mitigation of GHG.

articleTitle: Is it better to assimilate the Doppler radar radial velocity directly than retrieved winds with Ensemble Kalman Filter?
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The comparison of two methods of assimilating Doppler radar wind data with Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF) based WRF model is presented. One is to assimilate simulated radar radial velocity observations directly. The other is to assimilate the horizontal winds retrieved from Doppler radar Data. Result shows that the second method which assimilated retrieved winds with small retrieval error gives better analysis than the first method does.

articleTitle: No-reference image blur measurement based on wavelet high-frequency domain analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> discusses an objective image blur measurement in no reference based on wavelet high frequency domain analysis. It provides one novel statistical feature extraction for wavelet domain description, which is related with measuring score in a power law through NLREG. Evaluating the model by one carefully built database, it obtains correlation rate at 0.95 as human subjective scores, better than Tong's method about 5 points.

articleTitle: A study of urbanization analysis using remote sensing data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urbanization analysis, especially urbanization level estimation has become an urgent task for city planning, urban resources management and risk assessment of urban disasters. DMSP/OLS stable lights imagery provides an accurate, economical, and straightforward way to analyze the urbanization pattern. Most previous studies had focused on patterns of urbanization development in provincial scale. In this study, we firstly extracted the night light compositive index(NLCI) from DMSP/OLS night light data. Based on it, we utilized NLCI to estimate the urbanization level of regions on the municipal scale. By regression analysis technique, the statistical model between NLCI and the urbanization level index(ULI) on the basis of socioeconomic data was established. And the ULIs of municipal regions in Mainland China were estimated by the model. Different from other studies, regionalization proposed by National Bureau of Statistics of China (NBSC) was introduced into the process of modeling in order to increase the accuracy of models. Results of modeling based on regionalization indicated that the regionalization had greatly strengthened the correlation between ULI and NLCI. Results of verification also demonstrated that there was strong consistency between estimated ULIs and actual statistical ULIs of many years, which showed the reliability and universality of the linear models.

articleTitle: Research on the policy of finance and taxation in China's industrial clusters cooperative innovation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Adopt the relevant data of “China Science and Technology Statistical Yearbook”, and employed factor analysis methods, obtained the correlation coefficient of impact factor in China's large and medium-sized enterprise independent innovation ability, pointed out that choosing industrial Clusters cooperative innovation is an optimal strategy of the company's competing game. However, the fiscal policies of the Government Industry Cooperative Innovation Cluster still have a lot of problems. Industrial Clusters Cooperative Innovation Policy system and Corresponding countermeasures has the feature of stage, targeted, timely, and feasible where is propose creation of industry cooperative innovation in clusters and fiscal policies favorable operating mechanism model which is base on system theory in this text .This Research will play a positive role in improve the government policies.

articleTitle: Study of digital silicon piezoresistive pressure sensor with high precision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to resolve the temperature-drift problem existed in pressure sensor, a compound technique of microelectronic and nonlinearity software compensation is used for the fabrication of the digital pressure sensor. In actual application, this sensor has many advantages, such as simple structure, small volume, light weight, high precision, good stability, and broad temperature range. It realizes the accurate conversion between the temperature and the pressure.
