Comparing with the actual pressure, the maximum measurement error and relative error for the calculated pressure within 49kPa –110kPa and −40□∼60□are 0.03kPa and 0.55%, respectively.

articleTitle: Adaptive backgroud target tracking system based on TMS320DM642
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed an system of target tracking based on TMS320DM642 and discussed the overall hard design for the system. Considering the issue of poor performance for target tracking in complicated background especially when the background color is the similar with the target color. This paper combinded the method of weighted background histogram with the adaptive background Camshift algorithm, which effectively improve the tracing effects in the complex background. In the tracking process, the greedy algorithm is used for motion prediction, which reduce the numble of iterations and improve the stability of tracking. Using the Cache optimization based on EDMA, improve the efficiency of the algorithm and enhence the system's real-time. The experimental results show this tracking system has better robustness and real-time property.

articleTitle: Research on BA scale-free random graph models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Systems as diverse as genetic networks or the World Wide Web are best described as networks with complex topology. A common property of many large networks is that the vertex connectivities follow a scale-free power-law distribution. This feature was found to be a consequence of three generic mechanisms: (i) networks expand continuously by the addition of new vertices, (ii) new vertex with different number edges of randomly selected that connected to different vertices in the system, and (iii) new vertices attach preferentially to sites that are already well connected. A model based on these three ingredients reproduces the observed stationary scale-free distributions, which indicates that the development of large networks is governed by robust self-organizing phenomena that go beyond the particulars of the individual systems.

articleTitle: Using neural networks and rough set to analyze Creativity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Williams Creativity Test B (WCTB) and Adolescent Scientific Creativity Scale (ASCS) were used to measure the creative affective and scientific creativity for 550 middle school students. In these students, 70% of them were used as modeling group, and the other as testing group. Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) and multivariable linear regression (MLR) were used for modeling and testing. The result showed the fitting error of GRNN model was lower than the error of MLR. In the decision table, creative affective factors (CAF) were used as conditional attributes, and scientific creativity (SC) was used as decision attribute. The data of CAF was discretized with SOM network. The attribute reduction was conducted with SDM. Eight rules were extracted. It was found that curiosity and risk-taking were very important for scientific creativity.

articleTitle: Matching operation constrained job shop scheduling problem based on backward heuristic scheduling algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The matching operation constrained job shop scheduling problem in manufacturing field is studied based on classical scheduling theory. General job shop scheduling whose constraints mainly require working procedures to be sequential, the constraints we considered are further enriched by matching machining, results in much more complicated solvability. A mathematical model of matching operation constrained job shop scheduling problem is established. In order to assure the delivery time, the backward heuristic scheduling algorithm is proposed to solve the model. Finally, a case is presented to verify the algorithm and simulation result is given for comparison.

articleTitle: Study on multi-item spare parts ordering policies under certain demand
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The characteristic of spare parts inventory was pointed out, and the usage of multi-item joint ordering policy in the spare parts inventory was advanced. Based on analysis of three policies (independent ordering policy, unanimous ordering policy and joint ordering policy), a new method was proposed to get the ordering frequency of different kinds of spare parts in multi-item inventory. The results of research show that aggregating effect of joint ordering policy was optimal to independent ordering policy and unanimous ordering policy.

articleTitle: A generalized GCD test based affine partitioning algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Affine partitioning framework unifies many useful program transforms such as unimodular transformations, loop fusion, fission, scaling, reindexing, and statement reordering. The affine partitioning algorithm put forward by the SUIF compiler team has been proved to be successful in automatic discovery of the loop-level parallelization in programs. Generalized GCD Test is a basic dependence testing algorithm. In this paper, we proved that generalized GCD test has a strong relationship with affine partitioning algorithm. Then we presented an improved affine partitioning algorithm based on generalized GCD test. We illustrated that the compiling speed of affine partitioning algorithm can be significantly improved by our method.

articleTitle: Automated transition method from ArtiFlow to ServiceFlow
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Artifact-centric management of business workflow is facing many significant challenges, a key issue in addressing these challenges is to map logical workflow specification into executable workflow system. In the automated realization of mapping ArtiFlow specification into BPEL, business process described by ArtiFlow is extremely meticulous that leads to much difficult in realization. Hence we propose some strategies to optimize the ArtiFlow model, in which ServiceFlow is introduced. In this paper, we first present some strategies used to optimize services in ArtiFlow; secondly, the formal model of ServiceFlow is given; and then, we present a two-layer algorithm used to realize the transformation between ArtiFlow model and ServiceFlow model. Finally, in order to use BPEL to orchestrate services correctly, we apply Petri Net to analyze the possible executable services paths that artifacts “moving” in the ArtiFlow.

articleTitle: A quantitative study on coordination degree between resources, environment and economy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Coordination degree of resources, environment, economy and society in China during the years of 1995–2008 as an example is made by quantitative study. Conclusions that physical capital investment is still important input factor in the development of China, the growth mode of China is based on physical capital driving, the utilization of number of employed persons is low, and inputs of resources and the environment made inadequate contribution to the development performance are made.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation analysis of destruction characteristics of floor under goaf in seam with closed depth
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aim to the roadway under goaf in seam with closed depth have dynamic influence, the actual situation is roof rock soft stave, integrity is badly, supports and protections is difficulty. Use the relevant theoretical formula the estimated roughly damage depth of floor under coal goaf. Through the software of discrete element program to two layers is not the same thickness of floor under coal goaf mezzanine mechanical characteristics and analyzedthe stability of roadway under goaf. provides the theoretical foundation for reasonable supporting method and parameters design of the roadway under the goaf, Have a certain theoretical and practical application value.

articleTitle: Analysis on human resource management in the E-business age
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the age of cyber-economy, the human resource management (HRM) of E-business enterprises presents lots of electronic characteristics and has better advantages comparing with traditional HRM. In the Human Resource Selection strategies of E-business enterprises, the background of e- business should be taken into account and particular emphasis should be put on talents selecting, training, using and keeping.

articleTitle: Problems and solutions in the small and medium-sized enterprise intellectual property pledge financing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because of Small and Medium Businesses intellectual property pledge financing just starting, so there are many problems in the implementation process. It's far from being an important financing method, limited by its characters and the restriction of current law, policy and system. This article analyzes three main aspects of Small and Medium Businesses intellectual property pledge financing, which include the intellectual property construction, intellectual property value assessment, and treatment with hypothecation in intellectual property; and put forward the way to solve these problems, looking forward to the widespread of small and medium-sized enterprise intellectual property pledge financing in China, so that settle the financing difficulty problem of Small and Medium Businesses.

articleTitle: A research on hotel employees' career management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important part of modern human resource management, career management helps employees achieve their career goals, thus gets the co-win of individuals, organizations and community. Based on the elaboration of the concept of career management, this paper discusses the object and significance of career management in hotels, then discusses the current situation and existing problems, and puts forward several improvement countermeasures of career management of hotel employees.

articleTitle: An intersection theorem on a product of generalized convex spaces and applications to equilibria
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we give an intersection theorem on a product of generalized convex spaces, and apply this theorem to investigate the existence of equilibrium points of an abstract economy with infinite (countable or uncountable) number of agents for non-paracompact setting of commodity spaces.

articleTitle: Data exploration and study on the results of the reform of the collectively-owned forestrights system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: After the results of the reform of the collectively-owned forest rights system, there will be a large database including the graphics and the corresponding attribute data This paper has studied the spatial structure of forest resource such as the spatial concentration, diversity, evenness based on the data of Yiliang County, Yunnan province. According to the standards of mountain forest coverage in China and Yunnan province and the situation of the township, the forest cover has been broadly classified into four grades. This paper also analyzed the proportion of forest land ownership between the personal contract and collectively-owned in different township. The aggregation of spatial distribution of forest resources has been determined through the entropy, after calculated G = 0.628.It shows that the aggregation of spatial distribution of Yiliang country is not large. The diversity or evenness of spatial distribution of forest resources has also been discussed. From the study we can see that the data of the reform of the collectively-owned forest rights system can provide good foundation for the research of sustainable forest development and planning.

articleTitle: Study on multidisciplinary system of electric power steering based on dSPACE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Electric power steering (EPS) is a typical multidisciplinary system, its development period is long and process is complexity. The non-linear characteristics and uncertainties caused by different driving cycles and roads make development more difficult. To verify the EPS system, the H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> robust controller was designed and the hardware-in-loop(HIL) simulation platform of EPS system based on dSPACE was set up. The result shows that the H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> algorithm has good stability and robustness, HIL technology makes application development so much easier and faster.

articleTitle: The analysis on performance and development of participatory irrigation management in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is the basis for research of participatory irrigation management sustainable development to analyze irrigation engineering management performance and its cause. The paper quantitatively evaluates the PIM performance in hydraulic engineering by electing 13 indicators such as social, economic and water management etc and using AHP and TOPSIS two types of statistical methods, and analyzes the quantitative results from the point of water rights relationship among irrigation management participants. Results show that based on the decentralized mechanism designed for water right, in participatory irrigation management, profit-oriented contract relationship and cooperation-oriented contract relationship are formed among the irrigation management participants. These contracts promote positively irrigation effects, and can play a more visible and continuous role at the basis of improving the water pricing system, enhancing self-management awareness and organization degree and capability of peasant.

articleTitle: A new EVA/PET film separation recycling process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: PET is the base material of laminating pouch film. The PET film surface coating layer with good low-temperature hot glue, the EE, EVA or EAA material. Just like the recycling of EVA and PET composite plastic film, how to achieve the separation of EVA and PET by technology and processes may be key of the plastic recycling. This paper describes a through improving the traditional float-sink technical process in order to realize the continuity of production of plastic separation recycling of new technology. Otherwise, the key of the new process is that we added physical separation equipment and procedures before the process of float-sink. And we also improve the degree of automation, ultimately separation rate and productivity greatly improved.

articleTitle: Implementation of RS decoder based on FPGA in CMMB system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This Reed-Solomon(RS) code with perfect error-correcting performance is one of the most important technologies for Mobile Multimedia Transmission. In this paper, Improved Berlekamp-Massey(BM) algorithm is adopted in the research of RS decoder. According to the features of FPGA hardware, Galois field multiplier with constant coefficients is used in implementing RS decoder on FPGA. The hardware complexity of RS decoder is reduced and the decoding speed is enhanced.

articleTitle: On the protection of marine ecological environment under global climate change
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Global climate change has become the big background for studies on issues concerning marine ecological environment. From the perspective of thermohaline circulation change, sea-level rise and rising temperature, ocean acidification and marine disasters resulted from global climate change, this paper systematically summarizes the influence of global climate change on the marine ecological environment; addresses the process of the efforts made by the international community to cope with global climate change, points out some problems in the field of this research, and puts forward specific proposals on marine ecological management system aiming at the climate change.

articleTitle: Research of a fault diagnosis algorithm for aerospace dynamic system based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The dynamic part is failure-prone and sensitive areas in aerospace system. Based on structural stratum analysis of aerospace dynamic system, this paper analysis the traversal algorithm for tree structure using analytic hierarchy process. The fault diagnosis algorithm called GZSS-1 is put forward. Then the algorithm called GGZSS-1 is put forward based on study and ameliorate the GZSS-1. Actual application proved that using this algorithm can greatly save time and labor. Furthermore, it can improve the efficiency of fault diagnosis. According to preliminary statistics, it can save time more than 70 percent compared to traditional manual investigation. And this method only require one or two people. At the same time, the more diagnostic components, the more time is saved. The time-saving rate is stable at around 70 percent.

articleTitle: Emerging technology enterprise's strategic choice model based on Scenario planning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to make effectively strategic choices for emerging technology enterprises in highly uncertain environment the paper analyzes its basic elements of emerging technologies and characteristics of these enterprises. Based on scenario and scenario planning the paper analyzes the application of scenario planning in strategic management by proposing the main points and basic route. Finally, combining these characteristics of emerging technology enterprise the paper puts forward the basic frame of utilizing scenario planning in strategic choice in emerging technology enterprises.

articleTitle: Organophosphorous pesticides detection system based on amperometric enzyme biosensor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a pesticide detection system is designed based on amperometric acetylcholinesterase biosensor for rapid detecting pesticide residues in fruits and vegetables. This system made use of the electrochemical characteristic of enzyme catalyzing substrate of acetylcholinesterase biosensor for detecting pesticide residues. The behavior of cyclic voltammograms (CV) of the prepared biosensor is studied and based on this CV characteristic the data acquisition and processing circuit of the weak current signals generated by the biosensor is designed, which including the I/V conversion, differential amplification, low-pass filter, A/D conversion etc. Eventually, the 0∼5V voltage signal are obtained and they are proportional to the weak current from the enzyme biosensor. Four kinds of standard pesticide of different concentrations was tested with the detection system respectively, the results showed that the detection limits are all lower than 5µg/kg.

articleTitle: The benefit distribution of construction supply chain based on TOPSIS coordination method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To the cooperation between the members of a construction supply chain, the benefit pursuit is an important driving factor, the reasonable or not of benefit allocation will affect the stability and long-term cooperation of the supply chain. Construction supply chain have several benefit distribution modes, such as the fixed payment mode, the intermediate product pricing mode, the production sharing mode and the mixed mode. A variety of benefit distribution methods stemming from these modes have their own limitations, This paper will firstly establish three schemes with these methods, and then establish a more scientific and reasonable scheme with TOPSIS coordination method, which will help the members in the construction supply chain achieve a maximum satisfaction.

articleTitle: Application of the Zernike moment in intravenous infusion needle's image description
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Zernike moments are useful tools in pattern recognition and image description due to their orthogonality and rotation invariance property. In this paper, an image description method which could recognize the position of intravenous infusion needles is developed. Firstly, preprocessing and normalizing the character image are introduced; secondly, the image's rotation invariant features and the rotation phase using Zernike moments are gotten. The result shows that the Zernike moment has better invariant properties, and can describe robustly the rotation needle-image which advances on the higher assembly accuracy.

articleTitle: A word-length adaptive method of Chinese dictionary construction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Chinese dictionary is critical to the storage and search of text information in Chinese search engine. Basing on the Exclusive-OR algorithm, the machine code combined with stroke number of Chinese character was employed to hash the words with different length into the corresponding space of hash value with according to the probability statistics results of a word presenting. As a result, the collision rate of hash value is brought down to 0.034% and the search efficiency is up. This method can be used in the construction of large-scale dynamic dictionary as well as the other task of natural language processing such as the construction of Chinese corpus, Chinese word input method design and so on.

articleTitle: Research of profiling cutting control algorithm for roadheader robot
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By analyzing the mechanism of automatic drilling system, the kinematics model of profiling cutting for roadheader was built. The parameter relations of the pose of tunnel robot cutting head, intersection angle of swinging table and hinge joint of rising and falling were established. The path of tunneling process was programmed. Afterwards follow-up control and cutting control were achieved. Finally, the application of CMAC controller is introduced in the process of tunnel robot profiling cutting.

articleTitle: Reconsidering supply chain management reverse logistics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The objective of this paper is to research on the current strategies and importance of Reverse Logistic(RL) operations and their impact. This review also establishes the role of the returns policy in the fashionsupply chain. It also covers the different strategies adopted in the reverse supply chain across various supply chains and how it can be interconnected in the fashion supply chain. Retrogistics has always been considered as one of the least explored cost-oriented research areas. Beyond the handling of recycling and reuse, there is a tremendous scope for analysis of the returns in the RL process for identifying the causative factors. An analysis of causative factors may help in taking remedial measures for reduction in number of returns. Hence, several retail organizations have started giving importance in developing a best strategy and process for returns on the management program. Again, it is imperative for evolving strategy specific to the fashion industry/business to their specific needs and nature of operations. This review paper discusses different elements/strategies of operations involving RL in the fashion supply chain, different applications highlighting advantages and profit improvement/cost savings.

articleTitle: Towards repairing critical embedded software on-the-fly
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper proposes a framework for on-the-fly repairing critical embedded software which is developed using formal derivation techniques. When a failure occurs during runtime, recorded information about software derivation history helps to identify and locate the original error in early phases of the development process quickly and precisely; afterwards we can tentatively correct the error and reconstruct the software until the failure is removed. An implementation of a semi-automatic tool demonstrates the feasibility and leads to a general comprehension of the framework.

articleTitle: A new result for existence of periodic solutions for higher order neutral type delay functional differential equation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By means of the continuation theorem of coincidence degree theory, we study a kind of higher order neutral functional differential equation with deviating argument, a new result on the existence of periodic solutions is obtained.

articleTitle: The apply of GIS in flood risk management in Changzhutan city cluster
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Yangtze River is always the high-frequency area of flood disaster in China. Though the measures of defending flood and reducing disaster damage have been greatly enhanced with the development of science and technology, economic losses that flood had made are much bigger than ever before because of the advance of society and the rapid development of economy. Facing the increasingly serious flood disaster and other natural problem, governments at all levels pay much attention to how to defend disaster and reduce disasters damage, and now began to use technology to promote the development of disaster prevention system. Using remote sensing data as main data resource and considering indices of natural factor, flood control works and social and economic elements, this research discussed the thinking of fast early warning of flood in Changzhutan area and main technology of flood danger estimation with the support of city flood danger estimation model, disaster division model and disaster analysis model under the comprehensively apply of 3S technology and geographic information system platform software.

articleTitle: A web service composition model for multi-issues negotiation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On basis of the research on negotiation and composition of dynamic e-business service, this paper proposes a web service composition model for multi-issues negotiation, the algorithms of coalition net construction and the solution to web services composition search. The model can negotiate web services for some issues such as price, brand, QoS and distance according to the requests having users' constraint and preference, subsequently come into being some users' individuating and custom-built composition services. The model has better applied value.

articleTitle: Logistic IT competence and logistic service performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The role of information technology in transforming organizations and improving firm performance has been extensively examined by IS researchers. While IT has been recognized critical in influencing various aspects of service companies, empirical studies on IT impacts in service sectors remain insufficient and fragmented, especially in logistics industry. Drawing upon relational view on the firm and logistic service management literature, this study proposes a conceptual framework of logistic IT competence and its implications in logistic service. In particular, relationship orientation is proposed as a mediator between logistics IT competence and logistic service performance. Discussion and directions for future research will be finally provided.

articleTitle: Research on the forecast of the limited temperature rise of motor based on artificial neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article introduce a system based on neutral nekwork. It can estimate the limit temperature rise time of the asynchronous motor. The system avoids the defects of existing motor thermal overload protection methods. Use amount of data to verify the intelligent system can estimate the time from start status to limit temperature status.

articleTitle: Design of Touching Wireless Ordering Dishes System based on WinCE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: People regards food as their prime want, so improving the quality of catering services is the basic needs of human progress. The thesis based on Microsoft Windows CE System designed a set of Touching Wireless Ordering Dishes System (TWODS). Compared with the traditional ordering system, the Touching Wireless Ordering Dishes System has many advantages. Firstly, realistic graphics take the place of paper menus. Foreign guests don't need to worry about language barrier when they are taking orders. Secondly, the ordering system can be operated conveniently and you just need to touch the realistic graphics on the screen. The third, under the WinCE, the data transmission speed is so high that it saves customers' time and eliminates the noise generated by ordering. The forth, the system has powerful anti-interference. The concurrent use of multiple ordering equipments will not cause data conflict.

articleTitle: Design on analyzing and predicting system of old buried hill structure based on 3D digital basin
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper outlines current status of digital basin modeling, the special geological significance of old-age buried hill reservoir exploration, and necessity of establishing the modeling system, which are designed under GIS, IDL, VC# software environment, and introduces design object, design principle, main data, 3D geological modeling and basic function of the age-old buried hill modeling system based on 3D digital basin model, besides, provides some 3D result pictures about buried hill geological modeling of a basin acquired through the system. The system gives a more reasonable, dynamic, timely, and intuitional judging and analyzing method to research buried hill structure and oil & gas. Researches can abstract the subtle geological information of the structure and Petroleum, and estimate the rationality and consistency about the known basin model data according to data superposition from many different origins in 3D space, then, can discover the law of tectonic modeling and petroleum accumulation to decision support for future exploring and exploiting oil & gas.

articleTitle: The study of the development of tourism e-business in China and the countermeasures
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of online services, the tourism e-business service has developed rapidly. Tourism e-business is a new trend of the tourism economy, which emerging in the e-business industry, and developing rapidly for its own advantage. With the tourism industry full opening, the Chinese tourism e-business has developed fast, but in the lower level of e-business. This paper defines the concept of tourism e-business, and analyzes the characteristics and advantages of tourism e-business, and based the analysis of the development situation of tourism e-business in China, and analyzes the existing problems and put forward corresponding countermeasures.

articleTitle: A study on psychological contract, job satisfaction and turnover intention in banking industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper outlines the critical role of employees' job satisfaction and psychological contract in turnover intention. The discussion arises primarily based on the considerable phenomenon arise in the post financial crisis era: the rising rate of turnover intention in the banking industry. There is little research has been done concerning the facts in the banking industry according to present literature. To discover the relationship among psychological contract, job satisfaction and turnover intention, a research framework is developed in which job satisfaction and psychological contract and turnover intention are put in one model. The empirical findings from a survey of 300 employees in China's banking industry confirmed that there exists tight connection among these three factors. A psychological contract approach which emphasizes mainly to its “individual” level has three dimensions: basic obligation, work supportive obligation and developmental obligation. Job satisfaction consists of 3 dimensions which are external, internal and general job satisfaction. Turnover intention is measure with three items. Data collected are analyzed by SPSS 13.0 with methods such as factor analysis, reliability analysis, correlation analysis and regression analysis. Our main conclusions are: the general level of China's banking industry is above average; Employee's psychological contract is positively related to both turnover intention and job satisfaction.

articleTitle: Study on property management innovation in China of harmonious society
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the process of building a socialist harmonious society, building the harmonious community as an important component relates to the overall situation of building a harmonious society as a whole. This paper introduced property management innovation in residence community. In the context of building a harmonious society, the concept of property management should be updated and we make great efforts to exclude the existence of many “disharmony” in the development process to build a “harmonious property management”. How to enhance overall level of property management industry and strive to avoid the community property management disputes, and encourage property management company in the daily management services and actively to explore ways to participate in the construction of a harmonious community, is a relatively urgent and important practical significance subject.

articleTitle: A new method of training samples choose for support vector machines
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Choose of training samples is an important topic for the support vector machines applied research. This paper proposes a new image segmentation method: the two-dimensional histogram of the segmented image is used to guide to select training samples to train the classical support vector machines. First of all, calculate the two-dimensional histogram of the segmented image and then get its two thresholds by the rough estimation which proposes in the paper; then, according to these two thresholds to find the range to choices the training samples; finally, choose the appropriate number of training samples in the certain range to train support vector machines. The method have better results whether in visual or in quantitative analysis.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the agrarian capability of red hilly area of south China based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Red hilly area of south China is the most important agricultural production base of China, where account for about 1/5 of land area of China, 40% population of China and 30% of arable land. Besides, it provides food for nearly half of the population. So it is important theoretical and practical significance for research about soil fertility and agrarian capability in this area. Taking the typical hilly red soil region of south China, Longhui County as the research area, this research did spatial analyses about farmland fertility evaluation factors by choosing suitable affected factors and reasonable evaluation method. It analyses space distribution character of farmland fertility evaluation factors, and its affection to farmland fertility evaluation. Using spatial and overlap analyses based on GIS, this research made spatial variability that affect farmland fertility and its spatial distribution to informatization, and discuss the development of farmland fertility and its affected factors in hilly red soil region of south China from spatial dimension.

articleTitle: Flume structural optimization design using improved Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional method applying to solve continuous variable optimization problems is not suit for flume structural optimization design with mixed discrete variable. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm was employed to flume structural optimization design. At the same time, linear inertia weight and chaos variation operator are employed to improve basic PSO algorithm global searching capacity. Dynamic penalty function, to transform the constrained problem to unconstrained one, was adopted. The mathematical model of structural optimum design of the prestressed U-shell flumes is built. The result shows that, compared with the original design scheme, the optimization design scheme can greatly reduce the amount of prestressed reinforcement. The construction cost of both the flume and the whole project can be reduced accordingly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on entrepreneurial policies and the entrepreneurial support system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An empirical research on influence of knowledge integration to information system development performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There is growing recognition that information systems development (ISD) is a knowledge-intensive process that requires the integration of specialized stakeholder knowledge. We develop the perspective that integration of this specialized knowledge across knowledge boundaries in the ISD process drives ISD performance. Results from a field study provide considerable support for the proposed model. Collectively, these findings offer a novel knowledge integration-based perspective that complements prior research on systems development and new product development.

articleTitle: Prototyping distributed embedded operating system for NoC architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a light-weighted embedded OS (EOS) for 8051 microcontrollers used in NoC. This EOS is developed in such way that it is able to be extended as a distributed OS for NoC. Along with the development of the NoC, an operating system is demanded for managing resources and task execution flow in computing systems based on NoC architecture. To build the EOS suitable for small C51 core, the model of the EOS is built and discussed first in this paper. With the model, the structure of the EOS mainly involves multi-task management and inter-task communication. Then we verify the model. By reserve interfaces, the tasks in distributed EOS are expected to communication with each other among NoC system via routers.

articleTitle: Environmental asset value of water resources in lake calculated in applying fuzzy mathematical method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As one of environmental asset, the value of water resources in lake need to be calculated with the development of environmental accounting and the importance of macro-management. Because there are too many uncertain factors that can affect water resource's value, it is better to adopt the method of fuzzy mathematics to evaluate. The paper based on the built Fuzzy Mathematical Method and the real conditions of the Yun Long Lake, the author of the present paper, taking water quality, water resource quantity, GDP, and population density as element of criterion, made a calculation of the value of water resources, and points out that the value of the water resources in Yun Long Lake is 1.868 yuan /m3. This research try to offer data for the macro-management about water resources in lake to carry out water resources sustainable utilization, and try to make some contribution to the development of china environmental accounting.

articleTitle: Dynamic evaluation on the innovation capabilities of industrial clusters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How to dynamically evaluate the innovation capabilities of industrial clusters is a difficult issue. This paper collected the actual data of three clusters of Jiangsu Province in China. The hypotheses are tested by using the complexity science theory and social network analysis methods. The result is that moderate degree of interrelations, heterogeneity and governance among the members of the industry cluster will benefit the cluster innovation most.

articleTitle: Checking validity of topic maps with Drools
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Topic map constraint language (TMCL) provides a means to impose the topic map conforming some constraints, which can be aligned with the ontology used in knowledge represent. In this paper a novel framework is proposed to validate the topic maps which maybe a subset of standard topic map model or extended model for some special application. At first, we develop a convenient tool to customize the constraint rules quickly with the simple syntax and intuitive semantics. Second, implement the processor for checking the validity and consistency of topic maps with Drools based pattern matching algorithm, improve reasoning efficiency by grouping and deleting rules, the algorithm is more powerful on semantic reasoning and suitable various special topic maps. At last, an extended topic map which provides more effective knowledge representation and navigation in e-learning education is used for experiment to estimate the presented method.

articleTitle: Multi-objective decision making based on spatial multi-criteria evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-objective decision making is in urgent need for spatial multi-criteria evaluation and it is necessary to make further developed within GIS. Ordered Weighted Averaging (OWA) is a relatively new Multi-Criteria Evaluation (MCE) method. In GIS-based OWA method, both criteria weights and order weights are considered. According to the results of GIS-based ordered weighted averaging method, a compromise solution to the multi-objective problems with conflicting objectives is investigated. Calculation method of order weights based on Orness, and construction method of comparison matrix for criteria weights based on analytical hierarchy program (AHP), are introduced. Single objective multi-criteria evaluations with GIS-based OWA method for conflicting objectives are worked out. As an example application in Tangshan City, single-objective suitability maps are obtained, and the multi-objective problem is solved. Finally, the calculating results are analyzed, and some advice is proposed.

articleTitle: The credit rating of small and medium-sized enterprises based on the grey hierarchy evaluation model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The small and medium-sized enterprises have become to be an important power to improve the development of China national economy and society. Recently, SMEs' financing capacity is very poor. But SMEs' development need enormous capital. Therefore, building a credit evaluation system could solve the SMEs' financing problem.

articleTitle: A research on organization and rapid allocation method for large-scale 3D points cloud data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Now, 3D GIS, in the Z expansion of 2D GIS, receives more and more people's attention. It can express the real world and the surface morphology better, will certainly to be an important direction of GIS development. But no matter what kind of 3D data sources, vast amounts of data has been a major bottleneck impeding their development. In this paper, for 3D laser point cloud data, which is one of 3D GIS data sources, I try to propose one kind of method octree-based to organize and allocate points cloud data rapidly, it also lays a solid foundation for the further analysis of 3D points data. Finally, application examples demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: A fuzzy optimization model for the airline programming and a nonlinear algorithm based on the stochastic sequence
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In a given capacity and aircrew configuration conditions, how to adapt to the constantly changing of the course demand and capacity and how to make a reasonable distribution is a key problem. According to the benefit analysis of the flights, in a certain operation time, establish the dynamic stochastic programming model with some fuzzy variable which hope that the contributions maximize. Given the different variable fuzzy membership functions of the two kinds of random sequence, using the nonlinear programming algorithm for solving nonlinear integer programming, and get the optimal solution of the optimal route planning.

articleTitle: A novel algorithm for real-time adaptive signal detection in lightning location system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The VHF band intracloud lightning location and detection system consist of mutli-stations, where the VHF band intracloud lightning signal is detected and preprocessed. The detection result and the acquired data are transmitted to the central station, where the lightning location is accomplished by processing those acquired lightning data. Based on the short-time energy detection, this paper describes a novel digital signal processing algorithm for adaptively detecting VHF intracloud lightning signals. The algorithm continually computes and updates the long-term statistics of the background noise. Using this noise model, a set of adaptive thresholds is implemented to detect the lightning signal. The algorithm described herein is well suited for real-time implementation on digital signal processing hareware. This paper presents the theory of the adaptive algorithm, provides an algorithm block diagram, and demonstrate its emplementation and performance of the real-acquired VHF band lightning data at the frequency of 290MHz.

articleTitle: Credit risk control of micro-loan company on soft information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the current situation of micro-loan company in china and soft information theory in related literatures, analyzes the lending relationship between micro-loan company and its loan client by means of a simple game model. We argue that on basis of soft information theory, micro-loan company should establish series of systems on features of soft information, takes full use of soft information to control credit risk more effectively.

articleTitle: Modelling the supply chain cost of operations reordering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Operations reordering is one of the postponement strategies and a process restructuring that involves reordering consecutive stages of the manufacturing process. In this paper, we present a new model to compare supply chain costs between original and reordered operations from the perspective of supply chain management performance. Finally, we analyze the feasibility of operations reordering using an actual case. The results show that the stage having following properties should be planned prior during operations restructuring: longer lead-time, fewer feature choices or the choice probabilities for the options of the feature are more variable. These results are significant when company chooses its postponement strategy.

articleTitle: Research on oil pollution image classification of airborne hyperspectral data based on spectral angle analysis method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper first analyzed the characteristics of relevant image classification methods based on the high spectral characteristics of the acquired airborne high spectral data, and then obtained the better airborne oil pollution classification image results of hyperspectral data through the research and using of spectral angle analysis method of image classification, which verified the feasibility of oil pollution discovery and monitoring using airborne hyperspectral data.

articleTitle: Stackelberg-game solution of seller-buyer supply chain with random uncertainty
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the assumption that the product demand was composed of the dominant theoretical demand and the non-dominant random demand, this paper investigated the problem of Stackelberg-game of a single-seller single-buyer supply chain. Based on the criterion to maximize the expected individual profits, we got the explicit expressions of Stackelberg-game's optimal solutions via assuming the non-dominant random demand is uniformly distributed. Moreover, the optimal solutions of the centralized control and the Stackelberg-game without random disturbance were also given, which served as a benchmark for the random disturbance situation. The results show that the supply chain performs best under the centralized control. Compared with the Stackelberg game having deterministic demand-response function, the optimal wholesale price is higher but the optimal retail price is lower in random disturbance situation. On the other hand, as the fluctuation extent of random demand increases, the expected profits of the supply chain and the buyer become gradually less, however, the expected profit of the seller becomes larger. The given numerical results further illustrate the above results.

articleTitle: Palmprint recognition based on support vector machine of combination kernel function
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve small sample and overfitting problems as well as improve recognition performances, palmprint recognition is studied based on support vector machine (SVM). The kernel function is used to map nonlinear sample space onto another high dimension linear space. For this purpose, a new kernel function is proposed. The function consists of radial basis of functions(RBF) and polynomials, so it is a kind of combination kernel function. In the preprocessing of palmprint image, palm region of interest is cut by using the largest inscribed circle approach. Then the “eigenpalms” are extracted by means of principal component analysis. At the stage of recognition, support vector machine is used as a classified tool. An efficient algorithm is given about how to find proper weight parameters and kernel parameters for obtaining good classified performances. Consequently the accuracy of palmprint recognition can be increased. Experiments show that the method can solve sample training problems well and support vector machine of combination kernel function shows better generalization performance than that of the single kernel function.

articleTitle: Study on Partition method of 5 Stages for apparel supply-chain based on API model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Partition of Stages and their quantization, which encountered during apparel supply chain practicing small-batch Quick Response (QR) strategies, were studied. Firstly, this paper represented 5 stages such as introducing, developing, flourishing, fading, and delisting in apparel market, and which were accepted in practical now. Then, based on Apparel Popularity Index (API) model, this paper represented 5 stages mathematically, and analyzed mathematical characteristics of every stage in detail. Lastly, by computation simulation to market demands of 5 stages, results were coincided well with distributions of statistics to sells data in practical. This partition model of 5 stages and their quantization should provide useful guidance to enterprises' operations and productions during practicing small-batch QR strategies theoretically. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Quantitatively do the research of the sampling method and likelihood measurement in GLUE methodology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper the likelihood measurement and sampling method in Generalized Likelihood Uncertainty Estimation (GLUE) methodology were studied in an application to NASH model to the Yanduhe research catchment in Yangtze River basin, China. Uncertainty ratio is advanced to compare the Latin sampling method and MC sampling method quantitatively in the application of GLUE methodology, and the likelihood measurements are researched in the paper. The results showed that the sampling method do little influence to the uncertainty, however the likelihood measurements do great infect to the research result and multi-objective likelihood function was proved to be better than single-objective likelihood function.

articleTitle: Analyses of cointegration & error correction model between increase of private automobiles and consumption of petroleum in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dramatical increase of private automobiles speeds up the consumption and the demand of petroleum. Based on time-series data of private automobiles and petroleum consumption of China from 1990 to 2008, this paper carries on cointegration test and Granger Causality Test, and sets up an error correction model to quantitatively analyse the relationship of the short-term fluctuation and the long-term equilibrium between private automobiles and consumption of petroleum. The result indicates there is an unidirectional Granger causal relationship and a long-term equilibrium relationship between the two variables, the mechanism of the long-term equilibrium has the intense restriction function to the consumption of petroleum.

articleTitle: Investigation about the current life quality of college teachers in Chongqing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the scientific methods of the social researching, this research investigates the quality of Life about the college teachers in Chongqing with two sides which is life satisfaction and the happiness feelings. The research discloses the level of the life quality about college teachers in Chongqing is between the common level and the much higher level.

articleTitle: Multivariate statistical process monitoring of propylene polymerization with principal component analysis and support vector data description
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper addresses fault diagnosis and identification of propylene polymerization process for which the recorded variables follow non-Gaussian distributions. Recent work has demonstrated the effectiveness of principal component analysis (PCA) in dimension reduction and support vector data description (SVDD) in non-Gaussian monitoring statistics. This article extends this work by combining principal component analysis with support vector data description and introducing a fault identification technique to diagnose abnormal process cause. The research results confirm the utility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The study of the impact on employee's turnover intention based on organizational commitment theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the organizational behavior and organizational commitment theory in human resource management, as well as the two human factors (i.e., employee individual characteristics and organizational commitments) that affact the employee's turnover intention, we carried out the questionnaire survey in which the subjects were randomly selected from three enterprises. The survey data were consequently processed using factor analysis and multiple regression analysis in SPSS statistical analysis software, and a regression model for employee's turnover intention has been constructed from the perspective of organizational commitment in order to put forward policy recommendations of retaining and introducing talents for the enterprise management in China.

articleTitle: Research of university teachers introduction based on Fuzzy Synthesis Judgment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Universities are the most- important places to raise talents. It is the key whether the quality of the teacher troop is high or low. And if the teachers' introduction can be striated with, the quality of the teacher troop can be raised. In this essay the evaluating indicator system of the introduction teachers' qualities has been established, and the teachers' introduction has been analyzed quantitatively on Fuzzy Synthesis Judgment.

articleTitle: Inquiry into the services for bilingual learning needs of university students
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The service needs of bilingual learning of university students, is to use the concepts of services of scientific, to help the students understand and make the total planning and arrangement of bilingual learning as well as know how to make decisions on bilingual learning in order to realize the common benefits of both teachers and students from teaching and learning. The main method is that, based on the full investigations of students, the teachers improve the students ' interest in bilingual learning of different levels by enriching online courseware designing as well as improve and perfect the courseware function. The teachers should also provide guidance for learning strategies, functional complementation for a variety of learning methods and open horizons for the learning environment, and at the same time, provide a relative binding learning platform for the self-discipline of students' learning.

articleTitle: Analysis and an improvement proposal for the authentication system of SNMPv3
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The weak security of the digital digest algorithm used in the authentication system of SNMPv3 has been analyzed, an improved suggest taking SHA-2 to replace SHA-1 and MD5 used originally in SNMPv3 has been presented, and more security in application of SHA-2 comparing to MD5 and SHA-1 is described in this paper. Furthermore, a general method of compressing 256 bits into 96 bits is provided that establishes a basis of being compatible with the length of SNMPv3 authentication code.

articleTitle: The risk-based study on maintenance management of water seepage in highway tunnel operation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For groundwater seepage in highway tunnel operation, through some introduction of risk analysis methods in projects, a risk-based maintenance management model for tunnel water seepage is set up. In order to reduce the deterioration effects of tunnel structure and the impact on traffic safety, the model consists of system decomposition, risk identification, risk measurement, risk assessment, risk evaluation, maintenance activities execution and risk monitoring and control. After the model analysis and specific applications discussion of the highway tunnel water seepage maintenance problem, according to the risk level of risk factors, there is different treatment separately. It provides a new view of analytical methods based on risk management for dealing with water seepage maintenance management on highway tunnels in China.

articleTitle: Application of CSA to coal enterprise's management in safety production
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: China is a big coal producer in the world. The frequent safety accidents during coal production adversely influence the enterprises' production and the society's harmony, and bring great damage to the national economy. The enterprises should apply Control Self-Assessment to the safety in production, and evaluate its implementation of internal control. While improving the control environment, the management section of safety should try to predict all kinds of potential risks and work out solutions to avoid more accidents. Finally, it can help to build a safe working environment for mineworkers. By this way, the enterprises are able to heighten the workers' awareness of safety in production, improve the working environment of mine, and strengthen the competence for the position, and the problem of safety production can be resolved from three aspects mentioned above.

articleTitle: Application and research of Web GIS in fire command information system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to make better shoulder to protect the safety of life and property of the people, the development of City fire command information system which analyzed its functions of the system, system framework and key techniques. The system for the fire service department provides scientific basis for decision-making and related information for firemen information and provides some help.

articleTitle: A Tibetan web Text Clustering model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we design and implement a Tibetan Topic Detection system to process the huge number of Tibetan language text on Web. It classifies the Tibetan text into several categories, performs clustering in each category to get the topic. According to the Tibetan grammar features, we give a Tibetan text clustering model TTCM (Tibetan Text Clustering Model) for the text from Internet news sites. We have studied the Feature representation, feature extraction, and clustering in the model separately. From the performed tests, It turns out that the text Clustering in this model has a good accuracy ratio and a good recall ratio. So it has high application value.

articleTitle: GIS-based decision support system of leakage accident emergency for the crude oil gathering pipelines
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The leakage of crude oil gathering pipeline due to corrosion, third-part damage and other reasons can cause huge economic loss, severe life threat and environmental pollution. Here, a decision support system of leakage accident emergency for the crude oil gathering pipeline based on GIS. Focusing on the characteristics of leakage, the functions of GIS in this decision support system are analyzed. The system objects, structures, functions and operating environment are introduced. This system will help relevant department to know the information of crude oil pipeline leakage emergency fast and accurately and to make scientific emergency rescue decisions, so that the secondary disasters resulting from oil leakage are controlled and the leak consequence are lowered.

articleTitle: Information web service composition based on similarity parameters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the background of semantic web services firstly. Then we classify the services into two types: one is information acquiring services, the other is action services. According to the information acquiring services, which semantic description is simpler than general services, we propose an automatic service composition approach based on similarity computation between concept words. The key of this approach is to support users' request automatically.

articleTitle: Synthetic retrieval technology for structured data and Non-structured data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new kind of retrieval software architecture about structured data and Non-structured data was proposed in this paper. In the past, because of the great differences between them, we have to use different ways to deal with their data retrieval. We have been using SQL statements in the structured database search, and using index search in the non-structured data retrieval. But regardless of which search method was taken, it will bring the incomplete problem. Now the architecture resolve the problem.

articleTitle: Improving autocorrelation performance of Bernoulli sequence based on APAS theorem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Chaotic sequences have been widely used as pseudorandom sequences. But some well known chaotic sequence has poor autocorrelation performance, such as Bernoulli sequence, and their application are limited. Based on recently presented APAS theorem, we modified Bernoulli map to S-Bernoulli map, and S-Bernoulli sequence has excellent autocorrelation performance and simple structure, whereas its other performances are remained invariant or become better, and can be used more widely.

articleTitle: Ergodic capacity analysis of fading SIMO channel in spectrum sharing environment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider the spectrum sharing cognitive radio system, wherein single-input multiple-output ergodic fading channel is assumed. Subject to the average interference constraint of primary user, the ergodic capacity of cognitive user involving joint beamforming and power control is analyzed. We derive the expressions of ergodic capacity under different channel fadings including Raleigh fading, Nakagami-m fading and Lognormal shadowing fading. Most of the expressions are presented in closed-form or with some special integral function. Large amount of numerical simulations show that larger number of antenna and more severe channel fading can provide some gain in ergodic capacity of cognitive radio.

articleTitle: Breast lesion classification on MRI by texture features
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To explore the association between the texture feature and the lesions classification on breast MRI, we used a sixty-one biopsy-proven lesions database, using the Fisher stepwise discriminant analysis and logistic regression models.

articleTitle: Study on Reliability of Computer Network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Study on reliability of computer network has not formed a complete theoretical system yet. This paper has reviewed the major achievements and the trend of the reliability of computer network. At the same time it puts forward an integration availability concept of computer network, that is, capacity of network resources utilization in prescribed time under the network failure conditions.

articleTitle: Research on systematic metrics of network survivability
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As networks develop into large-scale systems, survivability of network systems is imperative. The systematic metrics of network survivability are used to measure or evaluate network survivability. This Paper summarizes the systematic metrics and their lack for measuring or computing network survivability while providing an easy way to reference baseline of the current state. It also provides some principles of network survivability metrics, and divides the current network survivability metrics into three types: target-based network survivability metrics, method-based network survivability metrics, and description-based network survivability metrics. At last, the trend of network survivability metrics is given: A set of quantitative, user-orientation, hierarchical and systematic survivability metrics, which can reflect full aspects and characters during the whole process of survivable networks, are required.

articleTitle: The power supply company sustainable development index system establish and evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The level of the sustainable development of the power company not only determines the overall level of development of power industry, while affecting the sustainability of socio-economic development. Evaluation of the supply companies need to establish sustainable development indicator system is described, and then select the method of the indicators measured and calculated. According to the characteristics of this measure, the establishment of sustainable development indicator system described, and propose an improved method of entropy comprehensive empowerment, combined with the TOPSIS method of evaluation index system.

articleTitle: Efficiency measurement of China commercial banks with comprehensive evaluation methodology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Following the agreement on WTO, more and more foreign commercial banks have debuted into China bank industry since 2007. Currently, the domestic commercial banks in China will face especially more challenge and competition in their running. Efficiency of commercial banks is the main factor on reflecting the competition capability of banks. The comprehensive evaluation method, denoted as Data Envelopment Analysis, was applied to efficiency measurement of China commercial banks in this paper. By using the comprehensive evaluation results, the measurements for enhancing the efficiency of China commercial banks were drawn.

articleTitle: A design method for RBF neural network structure based on rough sets
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A design method of RBF neural network construction based on rough sets and orthogonal least squares (OLS) is proposed in this paper. First, the rough sets knowledge expression system is built taking use of the large number of system sample data. The impact of input variables on output variables is analyzed through computing an accuracy measure of input space knowledge on output space knowledge with reducing the input space of the knowledge expression system, System order and the input layer nodes of neural network can be decided by this way. Secondly, the hide layer nodes and the weights of output layer of the neural network can be obtained using OLS algorithm. Finally, the research of simulations on a nonlinear system are carried out using this method in this paper, the research results show the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Research on decision fusion in underwater target recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aimed at enhancing the adaptive information fusion capability of underwater target recognition in complex environment, we employed the decision fusion technology based on the Dempster-Shafer Theory. The information fusion model presented in this paper utilized neural networks and fuzzy theory, which is the basic theory for this model, to analyze the uncertainty of probe and apply it to information fusion of underwater target recognition. By fusing several target features, the model was able to improve the recognition ratio for targets. Through the treatment of experimental data, this paper validated that the method does increase the accuracy and validity of underwater target recognition and the credibility had been greatly improved.

articleTitle: The research on existing problems of agent construction system mode in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The agent construction system mode is a type of new construction management system, related to the management efficiency and level of government's public project, but it encountered many obstacles and problems to promote in China. In this paper, three typical agent systems were contrasted and analyzed, and their advantages and disadvantages were combined to point out the existing problems of the current system mode, and based on these problems specific countermeasures were put forward. The research in this paper is important to the promotion and application of the agent system in China.

articleTitle: The lacking of social responsibility and countermeasures for marketing of transnational corporations in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the 1970s, with the developing of the concept of marketing, personalities of various circles have began to pay attention to the social responsibility in the process of marketing. This thesis briefly introduces the survey on research of social responsibility in marketing of transnational corporations in China and abroad, it also puts forward countermeasures on performing social responsibility in links of marketing through the analysis on the lack of social responsibility in marketing of transnational corporations, and comes up with the key points innovatively in performing responsibility in marketing of transnational corporations in China to help them to promote their competitive advantage of marketing in China.

articleTitle: Research on network marketing of real estate enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with Internet and home-buyer's youth oriented development, network sale has already become one of very important models. This article carries on analysis of current situation of real estate marketing network, proposes existence question, then provides specific thought for network marketing construction of real estate enterprise, implementation and CRM. This provides the thought for real estate enterprises to raise efficiency for real estate enterprises, to reduce the cost and to promote enterprise brand development. Also, this provides general home-buyers with beneficial help, such as providing fast, convenient on-line information and services, realizing online customization and procurement and improving efficiency.

articleTitle: The buyer's market structure effect on equilibrium price of coal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the prices of coal continued to rise, the business difficulties of coal-fired power plants have caused widespread concern. A lot of research literature focused on interpretation of this result from a policy perspective, while ignoring the structural causes of their market transactions. Using bargaining model, this paper analyze the impact of the Buyer's market structure adjustment that the unified purchase of coal-fired power plants on the equilibrium price of coal, point: coal-fired power plants adopt a unified purchase strategy can effectively reduce the equilibrium price of coal; The conclusion is conducive to coal-fired power plants effective improving the current coal market competition in the passive position by use of market means and policy tools, inhibiting coal costs and active controlling of business loss; not only made new ways for coal-fired power plants consciously use market means to control the cost of coal purchases, but also provides a new way of thinking for the government effectively address the “coal-power dispute” within the framework of a market economy.

articleTitle: In the pattern recognition Branch and Bound algorithm's matlab realizes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The feature selection algorithm is a key technologies in pattern recognition. The goal is in D characteristic which assigns chooses the most effective d(d ≤ D) characteristic, uses for to describe the sort feature. This article realizes the Branch and Bound algorithm programming in matlab, feature extraction by this method can guarantee the global optimal search under the premise of greatly reduced complexity.

articleTitle: Study of key techniques in variant CAPP development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Key techniques in variant Computer aided process planning (CAPP) development were studied in this paper, including global design of the system, input of part's data, generation of part's process and its documents etc. This article designed a variant CAPP global flow, proposed a method of reading Strings from AutoCAD window by iterating block table, reading data from subject bar of part's drawing by position, outputting data from database to AutoCAD interface by creating texts with text style IDs and adding them to the block table records of model space, filling process cards and sub-process cards with data from database, inserting drawing into subprocess cards by searching 2-layer paths. At last, with AutoCAD development platform, SQL Server background database, Object ARX and Visual C++ development tools, this article realized development of a variant CAPP system.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation of MNCs' technological innovation performance
