publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The evaluation of MNCs' technological innovation is a hotly debated topic around the world. This paper aims to provide some insight into the evaluation of MNCs' Technological Innovation performance. We analyze MNCs' technological innovation process in detail. Then the definition of technological innovation performance is presented. We divide innovation performance into output performance and process performance, each of which is given a detailed description in this paper. We conclude that MNCs' technological innovation performance is composed of output performance and process performance, and insist that both output performance and process performance be considered when evaluating MNCs' technological innovation performance.

articleTitle: Research on meteorological early warning of geohazards: A case study of Badong county, Hubei Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Rainfall is one of the most important factors causing geohazards, such as rock fall, landslide and debris flow et.cl. In this paper, the research basing on the geohazards monitoring data and meteorological data, the author chose 274 geohazards, and found 209 geohazards had relationship with the rainfall (76.3 %). The author chose 61 geohazards from 209 geohazards, and analyzed correlations between the geohazards monitoring data and the rainfall to get the critical rainfall and effective rainfall. Base on the analysis, the author built the model of meteorological early warning of geohazards and finished the map of meteorological early warning of geohazards. This paper provided scientific evidences for the government in the meteorological early warning of geohazards.

articleTitle: Design and realization of the project reporting and management system based on mixed-architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly introduced the system structure and realization of the project reporting and management system based on mixed-architecture, which made the Science and technology government department gain the purpose of working on network completely, including project reporting, management and checking. This system reduced the work load of the staff, and enhanced their work efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on imaging model based on CE-1 CCD imagery
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Three-line-array CCD camera was used to obtain images of lunar surface in the first step of China's lunar exploration - Chang'e-1(CE-1). This paper studies the imaging model of CE-1 CCD image, first analyses the exterior orientation elements of collinearity condition equations are multicollinearity in calculation. Then, the generalized ridge estimatation is presented. At last the parameters of generalized ridge estimatation is explained. And experiments prove that this method is very simple, steady and effective.

articleTitle: Image inpainting based on nonsubsampled contourlet transform and total varation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose a total varation diffusion to control and restore the missing or damaged regions in the nonsubsampled contourlet transform(NSCT) domain, instead of the pixel domain in which traditional inpainting problems are defined. The new techniques can efficient to preserve image edges. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can also significantly restore geometric features effectively, even with relatively large number of lost coefficients.

articleTitle: An analysis of the challenges to innovation in the context of national business
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Innovation, defined as the process of making improvement by introducing something new, is realized as a one of the vital resources, which helps organizations staying competitive. Furthermore, from a perspective of a nation, how to be innovative in the field of commerce is a difficult issue. Therefore, the authors of this paper make attempt to offer a new solution to this question by conducing an analysis of national overall innovation situation in New Zealand.

articleTitle: A survey and analysis of employee satisfaction and turnover intention
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, based on the survey of employee satisfaction and turnover intentions of real estate agent industry in Xian, from the five dimensions including the job, work payment, work conditions, work teams and the entire enterprise, the relationship between employee satisfaction and turnover intentions of the industry are analyzed. After the thorough research it turned out that: employee satisfactions with the job and the entire enterprise have greater impact on turnover intention, and employee turnover intention can be predicted by different levels, meanwhile employee turnover intentions varied as demographic variables. In the end, the defect of the study is pointed out and some recommendations are put forward according to the research findings.

articleTitle: Utilizing background corpus and dictionary to calculate similarity between unknown words
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method of utilizing background corpus and dictionary to calculate similarity between unknown words. In the method, the best concept expression of unknown word in corpus was obtained from the background of it, then constructed context for the best concept expression. The connotation meaning of unknown word was determined by the difference between the context of the best concept expression and its own context. The similarity between unknown words was calculated by utilizing semantic dictionary. This method avoids the problems of mistaken segmentation and abused segmentation, which exist in the traditional method of calculating similarity between unknown words, which is based on segmentation strategy. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper is high effective.

articleTitle: A research on strategic human resource management based on management mode evolution of private enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During the development of private enterprises, their management mode usually features gradual evolution from family management to professional management. Likewise, HR management of private enterprises often develops from enterpriser-oriented to professional manager-oriented strategic management. In this paper, the authors introduce some reference information related to strategic HR management, describe management mode evolution of private enterprises, and finally analyze the application of strategic HR management to private enterprises in different management modes.

articleTitle: An object-oriented method for adding coordinate system into Oracle Spatial
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The geospatial coordinate system is usually described by Well-Known Text (WKT) defined by the Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC). However, Oracle Spatial has different mechanism to represent geospatial coordinate system by tables and relationship between these tables. There is a problem that adding a coordinate into Oracle Spatial is complicated. This paper proposed a way to map the coordinate system in WKT format into Oracle Spatial by parsing WKT into objects by object-oriented method. Using objects as an intermediate layer and mapping these objects into Oracle Spatial, added user-defined coordinate system into Oracle Spatial. The result of experiment shows that this method is fast, efficient, and reusable.

articleTitle: Generating requirements of domain ontology evolution based on text
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ontology evolution has become more and more important to domain ontology application. The requirements are the basis of ontology evolution. This paper gives a model for auto-generated requirements of domain ontology evolution from domain text. First it extracts relevant concepts from domain text in natural language, and then uses the weighted word frequency algorithm to determine whether the concepts are the key concepts. Last, combining the ontology-search-algorithm with the rules of generating evolution requirements, it automatically generates the requirements of domain ontology evolution.

articleTitle: Analysis on product recycling profit based on disassembly-logic-net (DLN) model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Designing products aiming at minimizing their impact on the environment is becoming increasingly important. From the product recycling and life cycle engineering design(LCED) viewpoint, we should evaluate not only the economic cost but also environmental impact during disassembly process. This paper presents concepts of the disassembly activity logic network(D-L-N) modeling for product recycling assessment. According to the connection relationships and hierarchical structure among the product, D-L-N can be abstracted for disassembly, recycling analysis, etc.. D-L-N is employed for the calculation of recycling profit and the determination of product optimal recycling strategy in this paper. Recycling method based on product hierarchical structure, concept of recycling profits and the searching algorithm of recycling scheme are also discussed. A case study of a complex product recycling demonstrates that D-L-N can facilitate economic and environmental impact analysis of a product life cycle, is also the basis of product design and disassembly path planning.

articleTitle: The research of geometric correction in treat the geometry to Unmanned small aircraft at low altitude image
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Geometric distortion is important in the research of image geometric processing. This paper introduces a unique technique for image processing based on low-altitude UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) and accordingly generating the DEM and Digital Orthophoto. Through the UAV image Orthorectification and the regional network of radio beam method for adjustment of the whole deal, and then analyzes the impact of accuracy of geometric correction factors. Experiments proved the scheme is reliable which arrange ground control points more dense around the peripheral field.

articleTitle: A model of hardware component for open-reconfigurable router
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the researches of software component and the performance-sensitive characteristic of hardware component used in core router, a model of hardware component is proposed. And then, a formal description of this model, including function, resource consumption and performance (the most important one), is built up. At last, according to the model proposed in this paper, a congestion control component is designed.

articleTitle: A reconstruction method of dynamic texture video
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dynamic texture augmentation techniques are widely used. It has been a hot spot in the area of computer vision. Reconstruction is a very important technique in dynamic texture augmentation. In this paper we propose an efficient reconstruction method of dynamic texture video. First we present an efficient structure and motion recovery method for dynamic texture video. On the basis of it, a method of reconstruction for texture video augmentation is studied. Experiments show that the method is very efficient in dynamic texture augmentation and overcome more error of traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on method of product variant design of process based on tabular layouts of article characteristics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at improve the process applicability, practicality and enhance the ability for process variant design, a design methodology for it based on tabular layouts of article characteristics was proposed. Based on the basic principles of tabular layouts of article characteristics and the the modeling method of master document technology, an ideology and technologies of variable design of process for power tools system were introduced. At last, taken the rotor of power tools as the example confirmed the feasibility of the method. The results indicate that, the process diversification and individuation could be adapted by this method.

articleTitle: The analysis of competitive and cooperative relations among industries and the industrial cluster dynamic evolution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The formation and development of industry agglomeration is the result of companies' active choice. Relationship between different industries and businesses is bound to happen in the location choice. Industry cluster result from competition, adaptation, selection among enterprises. The competition and cooperation among the industries comes down to the two following: industrial symbiosis gathering duo to negative occurrence effect and industry association gathering owe to positive occurrence effect. Through mathematical analysis, this paper only gives three results between two industries in the ultimate sense: neutral symbiosis, a single industrial area and reciprocal symbiosis.

articleTitle: The research of the entity relation extraction based on statistical model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Entity relation extraction is the important research field in many languages processing, such as the knowledge management, semantic network, information retrieval and information extraction. In this paper, some specific entity relations can be extracted in the football match domain, firstly, the definition of the five types relation had been defined. Based on the conditional random fields, aiming to each relation type, the different features were discussed. The approach is effective when evaluated on the data set.

articleTitle: A spatial pattern study of auditory-motor interaction system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There is an auditory-motor system in human brain and cerebral motor cortex can be activated by a motion related sound. By training and learning, human brain can establish a relationship between a meaningless sound and a motion. Some EEG studies have demonstrated that a meaningless sound could induce desynchronization of mu rhythm at C3/C4 electrodes. However, the spatial pattern of brain activation is still unclear. In this paper, independent component analysis (ICA) was adopted to study EEG spatial pattern in 14 subjects. The result indicated that cerebral motor cortex and parietal lobe were primarily activated by an auditory stimulus after learning.

articleTitle: Exploration on applying 3S technology to Tourism E-Commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The developing of the 3S Technology has had a great impact on our society. As an exploration, firstly, the author makes a brief on 3S technology and 3S-integration technology; then she illustrates the application of 3S technology on the tourism sector and Tourism E-commerce; after that, she analyzes the prospects of 3S technology and Tourism E-commerce.

articleTitle: Study on the restraint factors in selecting methods of IT project valuation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is a scientific study to select the method of IT project valuation. Adopting scientific method of valuation contributes a more accurate IT project price, which can not only provide the basis for the financial evaluation, economic and risk analysis of the IT projects, but also provide the benchmark to implement expense (investment and cost) control effectively in the process of IT project construction, and ensure the target of IT project costs. This paper analyses two factors in selecting method of IT project valuation. They are the constraint factors of amount of valuation information in different stages of IT project and the constraint factors of the value constitution of IT project. In connection with the features of all stages of full life-cycle of IT project and different types of project, this paper elaborates separately the corresponding requests of IT project valuation as well as the principles of valuation method selection reasonably. Besides, this paper emphasizes that the human resources constitutes an important part of the value and price of IT project, thus IT project valuation should attach an importance to the evaluation of human resources as well as the selection of the corresponding method of valuation.

articleTitle: Design and application of stayed-cable's fundamental frequency analysis system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Modal parameter of stayed-cable is an important basis for the structure health monitoring of stayed-cable bridge. In this paper, the vibration signal pre-processing and algorithm for modal parameter identification are studied. And then improved algorithms about vibration signals pre-processing and modal parameter identification are proposed considering the typical characteristic of the vibration signal of stayed-cable in this paper. At the same time the stayed-cable parameter identification system is developed by the GUI tools which are contained in Matlab and the system is used in the engineering measurement of a bridge in Ningbo. And the results indicate that the parameters of the stayed-cable can be speedily, accurately and reliability got by the system. Also the performance of the system has achieved the desired objectives.

articleTitle: Research of several key technologies of business component in IMS-DATE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aerodynamic design of aero turbine engine is a complex process that requires diverse engineering disciplines to execute independent of each other in sequence, usually iteratively and interactively. It involves various scientific computing packages to provide a fast, accurate, and reliable approach to model engineering problems. The calculations of aerodynamics, thermodynamics and structure are repeated continuously by many kinds of engineering computation software. The characteristics require a modular design mode. Business component is introduced in integrated management system for aerodynamic design of aero turbine engine (IMS-DATE) to deal with those difficulties, which is defined as a combinational management module that comprises design object's attributes and corresponding processing logic, which can implement universal management of design resources and design data. Concepts of business component applied are defined, including its structure compositions and framework design. And several key technologies in implementation are illustrated, namely, hierarchical software registry, software encapsulation and parameter parsing.

articleTitle: The application of Random Sample Consensus in photogrammetric relative orientation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a method based on the rule of Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) to locate and extract gross errors in relative orientation. This method uses the coplanarity condition of stereo image pair as model to fit the data. With this method we do several experiments with different size gross errors to validate the effectiveness of it. The experiment results show the mismatching points with different size are eliminated. This improves the internal reliability of relative orientation.

articleTitle: Research of stateful Web Services implementation based on workflow
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Web service is a widely used technology, the current Web Service is mainly for non-state calculations. Because most business processes require long processing time, they need stateful calculations. This article introduces a method that combines workflow technology and Web Service technology, encapsulates workflows as business process services. We analyze different states of process services and different kinds of operational semantic impacts on the states, enable the process services can query workflow status at any time when interacting. And this method already applied in the reality, Stateful services have broad application prospect in the future.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the Mechanism of Action between three Logistics Sub-networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The networking of Logistics is a necessary developing trend of modern Logistics industry. Based on the Logistics Network Theory and the actual, This paper make a study of the Mechanism of Action of three Logistics Sub-networks, which are the Logistics Infrastructure Network, the Logistics Information Network and the Logistics Organization Network. Study the Mechanism of Action of three Logistics Sub-networks will help to realize logistics networking and the resource sharing. This paper defines the concept of the Degree of Logistics Networking. Meanwhile, it uses the Structural Equation Model (SEM) to validating the hypotheses based on the result of 245 pieces of questionnaire, then analyses the mechanism of action of three Logistics sub-networks. Finally it gives the conclusion: the effect between Logistics Information Network and Logistics Organization Network, make a positive construction of the two Sub-networks. The Logistics Organization Network promotes the construction of the logistics infrastructure network. The effecting of the three logistics sub-networks will improve the degree of logistics networking, and realize the resource sharing and resources integration.

articleTitle: Modeling of a digitally assisted 14-bit 100MSample/s pipelined ADC using open-loop residue amplification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel digitally assisted high-speed 14-bit pipelined ADC model based on matlab/simulink is proposed. The model consists of a 4-bit first-stage with nonlinearity gain error, a 2-bit second-stage with 1-bit redundancy and five ideal 2-bit stages. A backend calibration technique is used to calibrate the nonlinearity error of the first stage, which significantly improves the Signal Noise Ratio (SNR) and Effective Number of Bit (ENOB) of the Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC). Simulation results indicate that the maximum SNR and ENOB of this pipeline ADC reach the value of 82dB and 14 bits respectively under the case of the input signal frequency at 9.72MHz and the sampling clock at 100MHz after calibration.

articleTitle: Establishment of Geological Science Markup Language for heterogeneous geology data integration
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the problems of the Non-uniform storage format of the geology data, and unintegrated heterogeneous geology data, the authors put forward GSML(Geology Science Markup Language) based on XML, define semantic, grammar and extension principle of GSML, and establish the core software library model of geology data using GSML.

articleTitle: Ecological risks assessments of heavy metal contaminations in the Yancheng red-crown crane national nature reserve by support of GIS technique
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: All 83 surface soil layer samples were gathered from the north to south in Yancheng coast to study the ecological risks from heavy metals. Ten heavy metals, Cr, Cu, Fe, Mn, Ni, Sr, Ti, V, Zn, Co, were analyzed. Taking the core region as a specific zone, we did the spatial zonal statistics to get the average value of each metal within the core region. Compared this zonal average value of each metal with the average value of the 83 soil samplings, we found that the former was higher, and some metals' high peak value distributed in the core region, including Mn, Ni, Ti. Multivariate statistics of the 10 metals were also done to detect the possible inputting source of them. We found that human disturbances were the main induced sources, except the background value. Though the ecological risks from the heavy metals were now not serious, it was not robust enough that only the core region being severely managed, and an integrated management mode was proposed, based on the detailed hydrology process research.

articleTitle: Indoor location estimation system based on evolutionary matching
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The indoor Real Time Location Systems (RTLS) is attracting more and more attention while a series of challenging problem still exists such as the real-time performance, location precision, and the large amount of disturbance signal brought by complex indoor circumstances. However, existing location estimation technology cannot satisfy the requirements of indoor RTLS. In this paper, a high-precision indoor location estimation technology based on Ultra Wideband and evolutionary matching mechanism is proposed, based on which an indoor location service platform is built with intelligent alerting strategy based on Newton collision graphic engine. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves not only the location estimation accuracy but also the ability to eliminate the multipath signals with low computational cost.

articleTitle: Comparison of public health management after the two serious earthquakes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The infectious disease is the secondary disaster after serious earthquake. By comparing of Tangshan Earthquake and Wenchuan Earthquake in public health management, the paper summarizes the successful experiences of disaster epidemic prevention and analyses public health management problems in Wenchuan earthquake. Some countermeasures are proposed for disaster epidemic prevention, such as integrating epidemic prevention system, perfecting standard, establishing hygienic evaluation, planning material reserve and developing epidemic prevention equipment.

articleTitle: The design and implement of a freeway network tolling system on data stream mining and management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of analyzing characters of freeway network tolling data stream and SPEED algorithm, this paper proposes a data stream mining system using SPEED algorithm, and presents detailed design and implementation. The data stream mining system that presented in this paper includes three parts: data preparation, data stream mining and data Discard. The primary goal of our work is to establish a data stream mining system model designed for freeway network tolling at freeway's company. However this structure can be easily expanded to other areas of data stream mining.

articleTitle: Low power design for wireless remote reading heat meter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Power consumption is the key factor affecting the longevity of heat meter. The various energy-saving strategies of the heat meter were analyzed from three aspects: chip selection, circuit design and soft design. Then the wireless remote reading heat meter with low power consumption was designed and the modules of implementation were described in details. The heat meter has the remarkable characteristics in the aspects of low cost, low power consumption and so on.

articleTitle: Variable polarity TIG welding arc stability and its control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Arc blowing out and current impacting at commuting often occur in variable polarity inverter TIG welding. Equivalent capacitors and inductors of the main circuit slower the current commuting speed and cause arc blowing out. Equivalent resistance of welding arc decreases suddenly and causes current impacting when DCEP (direction current electrode positive) is commuting to DCEN (direction current electrode negative). Appending coupling inductor to the second stage inverter circuit and using a pre-cutting PI control strategy can solve the problem of arc stability effectively.

articleTitle: Research and application on a segmentation algorithm for triangle meshes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mesh segmentation has become a key ingredient in many geometric modeling and computer graphics applications. This paper proposes a new triangle mesh segmentation algorithm. This algorithm puts forward a new segmentation method for initialization based on geodesic distance and meshes region growing, and puts the same type vertices together. Geodesic distance expresses the shortest path between the vertices. The shortest path is calculated through classical Dijkstra algorithm. This algorithm is applied to mesh simplification and adaptive subdivision. Experimental results show that the algorithm not only has the stability and efficiency, but also better describes the characteristics of model features.

articleTitle: The correlation between fair value and total profit of public company
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional measurement attribute has substituted by fair value under the new accounting standards. There is an impact on the profits of public company. We carry on a empirical analysis through the selection of 92 samples from some public companies, the correlation coefficient r =− 0.725 **, the result is that change of fair value have a strong negative correlation with total profit. That is why most companies do not want to use fair value. Due to use of fair value the accounting information is more true and accurate. Lastly, it makes recommendations that develop accounting system in china.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the oil spill accident threaten degree based on the D-S evidence theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the event of marine oil spill, the first step is to evaluate the accident threaten degree, which has many impact factors including oil spill volume, spill location, oil features, ship status, weather and sea conditions, etc. Gaining these data accurately is not easy. It is a classification problem with uncertainty. In this paper the D-S evidence theory was adapted to evaluate the marine oil spill accident threaten degree. The discount ratio was used to differentiate the important degree of the indexes. The conflicting probability of the evidence was distributed to every proposition according to its average.

articleTitle: Design of simulation system about transfer alignment of SINS for shipborne equipment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A simulation system about transfer alignment of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) on moving base is designed, aim at the problems of big cost, high risk and worse repetition about the validate of transfer alignment algorithm and evaluation of the accuracy about SINS of shipborne equipment. The system consists of motion model, where the motion manner is set; the ship motion simulation is used to give the ship's motion under the motion model; then the motion is sensed by master and slave IMU respectively, which contains gyros and accelerometers, here the Flexure of the body and lever arm effect are simulated and sensed by the slave IMU only; then SINS algorithm is utilized to compute the navigation message respectively, such as velocity, attitude and position of the body, then by matching the message from master SINS and slave SINS to obtain the measurement message of transfer alignment. The validate and evaluation of many transfer alignment algorithm and transfer alignment filtering can be done based on this system, obtained the advantage of better expandability and high accuracy. The rapid transfer alignment about “velocity plus attitude” is simulated based on this system; validate the exactness and the availability of the presented method.

articleTitle: A neural network based on cluster analysis and its applications in psychological assessment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Speediness and effectively are very critical for evaluation of the psychological crisis situation, it is the important foundation and prerequisite of psychological crisis intervention. So need to simplify the index system of psychological crisis assessment scientifically and reasonability. The paper establishes neural network evaluation model based on cluster analysis, according to principles of cluster analysis, the cluster analysis can integrate the variables (or simples) with complex relationship into smaller number of classes, and greatly reduce the scale of the original data. It can be proved by the instance in this paper that the model can evaluate the psychological crisis situation quickly and effectively and can provide a fast and reliable basis for intervention and treatment of the psychological crisis.

articleTitle: Research on environmental information disclosure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is an age that science and technology innovate, the economy and technique develop quickly, the internet produced by the computer and information technique has been changing the whole world rapidly. How to deal with the environment information disclosure properly, realize the communication with the far information user, has been an important problem that must be thought over. In order to satisfy the need of the international accounting and meet the challenge of accounting revolution, in view of the weakness of the environment information disclosure of China in the internet, I shall study the problem of the environment information disclosure of the listed companies of China, and look for a real solution to standardize the system of the environment information disclosure of China in contraposing the actuality of the countermeasure of the internet environment information disclosure in this article.

articleTitle: Geomagnetic sensor random error modeling and compensation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The characteristic of the output error of the geomagnetic sensor is analysed and the finite difference method is used to smooth the non-stationary data of geomagnetic sensor. Then the ARIMA model of the non-stationary data is established by using the time series analysis method. Considered the time series model as the State equation and the present moment measurement data as the measured values, this article designs the Kalman filter based on the model of ARIMA(3,2,0) to deal with the output data of the geomagnetic sensor. The result shows that the mean square error of the measurement data reduced 73.6% after filtering. The result of the raw data has proved the validity of the proposed model and filtering method. The research methods of this article can also be used for error modeling and filtering of. other kinds of sensors..

articleTitle: Design of 16-QAM ZCZ sequences for AS-CDMA communication systems using the 16-QAM constellation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is pointed out that when a communication system makes use of sequences over the quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) constellation as its spreading sequences, in comparison with the traditional spreading sequences with the same length of sequences, the transmission data rate (TDR) of the system by applying to the former is several multiples of one by using the latter. In this paper, two families of 16-QAM ZCZ sequences are presented, and the resultant sequences can arrive at the theoretical bound on the ZCZ sequences under their own conditions. When the proposed sequences are employed by an AS-CDMA communication system using the 16-QAM constellation as spreading sequences, the high TDR of the system holds without both multiple access interference (MAI) and multi-path interference (MPI).

articleTitle: ScaEcn: A Spectral Clustering Algorithm for Automatically Estimating the Clustering Number
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an Algorithm for Automatically Estimating the Clustering Number based on Spectral Clustering Algorithm—ScaEcn, which estimates the clustering number via computing the amount of eigenvalue equals to 1 in Laplace matrix. The fabricating data-set and UCI data-set have been used in the experiment; the result indicates that the ScaEcn has satisfactory effect in both fabricating data set and UCI data set.

articleTitle: The application on statistical reports of data linkage based on metadata
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During the ordinary process of operations, telecom operators require the system to provide lots of statistical reports. As the complexity of business, the need of flexibility and Diversity of reports is increased. It's important to develop the reports contains function of data linkage.

articleTitle: Social Network based community Users' Viscosity enhanced model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Users' Viscosity is the key to the success of community application, how to improve the Users' Viscosity as much as possible is the challenge that researchers have to face. In the paper, we propose a Social Network based community Users' Viscosity enhanced model. In the model we divide the big social network into small social networks and introduce the competition mechanism among them, the number of members, the degree of Activity and Contribution of them is used to compute the live value of the small social network. Simulating experiments prove that the model can make the small social networks become more prosperous, thus it can improve the viscosity of community users.

Author Keywords: the live model of small social network

articleTitle: Supply chain reengineering for industrial transfer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes our current situation and specific reason of industrial transfer in our country. This paper analyzes the impacts of industrial transfer to supply chain. These impact factors include that stability of enterprise supply chain, transportation costs, information and personal adjustments. According to these impact factors, Enterprise supply chain will make the appropriate adjustments. Enterprises will reengineer supply chain through establishment an information platform and re-selection suppliers and the use of TPL.

articleTitle: A provably secure identity-based signature scheme without PKG in the standard model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with the traditional public key crypto-system, identity-based cryptosystem can simplify the key management procedure from the view point of the efficiency and convenience. But a trust PKG must been required in the ID-based cryptosystem and is unconditionally trusted. At present, Most of identity-based signature schemes are only proven to be secure in the random oracle model, but the security in random oracle model doesn't imply the security in the real world. Since the hash function is considered as a random generator. In this paper, we propose an efficient and provably secure identity-based signature scheme without trusted third party. Our scheme is existentially unforgeable against adaptive chosen message attacks under the computational Diffie-Hellman assumption in the standard model. Compared with the known strong identity-based scheme in the standard model, our scheme enjoys shorter signature size and less computation in terms of signing and verifying.

articleTitle: Application of the audio-visual approach in the teaching of microeconomics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Microeconomics has become a basic core curriculum for students in economics, finance and management major. But in practice, there are many difficulties in teaching and studying. Microeconomics is often considered to be too complex and too theoretical. We try to use the audio-visual approach to improve the microeconomics teaching effect. The results show that this method is helpful both for deepening the impression and for getting deeper understanding of the theories.

articleTitle: The improvement and realization of a kind of Mean-Shift tracking algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper puts forward an improved model of Mean-Shift tracking algorithm. Aiming at the problem of unchanged kernel function bandwidth in the tracking process, it puts forward the improved Camshift algorithm and discusses the object model updating algorithm based on Kalman filter. The experiment shows that the Mean-Shift tracking algorithm by using LabVIEW can track a single object and multi-objects in outdoor scenes and can be applied in video monitoring.

articleTitle: A study on technology acquisition and diffusion in “Satellite Platform” clusters at the growth stage
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The mechanisms of technology acquisition and diffusion of different types of industry clusters at different stages vary widely, and “Satellite Platform” clusters at the growth stage become the focus of attention with the development of local embeddedness of outside large companies. Based on the case study of auto parts cluster in Liujiang County, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, this article argues that the “Satellite Platform” clusters at the growth stage are mostly composed of low technological level firms with weak R & D capabilities; strongly technological dependent on outside companies; lack of internal links and technology diffusion; lack of R & D infrastructure and related public service system. On the basis of the analysis of characteristics and problems of “Satellite Platform” clusters at the growth stage, this article also suggests some policy measures: building external innovation networks, strengthening the role of industrial associations, speeding up construction of technological innovation platform, and promoting public service, to enhance capabilities of technology acquisition and diffusion of firms to promote the development and maturity of “Satellite Platform” clusters at the growth stage.

articleTitle: Licensing to a durable-good duopoly
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Optimally licensing contract are considered for a cost-reducing innovation in a durable-good duopoly for outside innovator. It is shown that (a) license to two firms is better than license to one firm. (b) The licensing contract involving a fixed fee alone can never be optimal in the case of licensing to two firms. (c) when profit opportunities (measured by the ration of the demand and the marginal cost) are large, the optimal licensing contract involves royalty alone regardless the degree of the innovation, while profit opportunities are small, the patent holder employ two-part tariff contract depending on the degree of the innovation and the nature of competition.

articleTitle: The analysis of factors which affect dining out consumption of China urban residents — Based on provincial Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Paper firstly carries on the regional classifications to 31 provinces, municipalities and the autonomous zone in china, according to the amount and the height of growth rate of the urban residents' Disposable income, and then analyzes the factors that affect dining out of each region urban residents through establishing the Panel Data Model. The analysis results indicate that the Notch Wheel Effect and disposable income are the most important factors that affect dining out of urban residents, and the influence has a big difference in the regions of different income levels, but the growth rate of the urban residents Disposable income has the minor impact on dining out of urban residents, but also shows a positive correlation with the expense of dining out. At last, put forward the proposals separately from the demand of expanding domestic and development of catering enterprises angles based on the conclusions.

articleTitle: Preliminary study of laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy detect chicken meat tenderness
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method of detecting tenderness of the chicken using laser-induced fluorescence (LIF) spectroscopy was discussed in this study. First of all, the fluorescence spectrum of chicken breast meat was obtained. Than, through the physical and chemical experiments of chicken breast meat to get the chicken tenderness data. The PLS algorithm was used to establish the prediction model between meat tenderness and Fluorescence spectrum. PLS regression model was able to predict tenderness of chicken. The relationship between predictive value and actual value of meat tenderness was quantitative predicted by the PLS model and a correlation coefficient of 0.8704 was found. It is concluded that the combination of LIF and PLS methods can be used to provide a technique of convenient, versatile, and rapid analysis for tenderness of chicken.

articleTitle: Research and practice of designing experiment on automatic control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Designing and innovative experiments are vital to the experimental teaching in high school currently. In this paper, designed four designing experiments based on the existing experiment box of automatic control, including classic control technology and intelligent control technology. The methods of operating the experiments could not only help students to understand and verify the key points of the theory in class, but also cultivate students to combine theory with practice. Especially to the controlled objects which are difficult to set up mathematical models accurately, students could design new control algorithms that applied to control objects in predestinate norms and to solve the actual problem.

articleTitle: Farmers' environmental awareness measurement indicators, scores and countermeasures in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the definition of environmental awareness, indicators, which be categorized into three kinds, and the survey questionnaire are designed. Relevant weights and scoring standards are set up to build a analysis model of farmers' environmental awareness. Then, we take 313 farmers in Beijing as an example to conduct the survey. The survey show that farmers do not score high. And the scores are related to the factors such as gender, education background and family income. As last, four countermeasures are put up, such as the establishment and improvement of the relevant incentive and monitoring mechanism.

articleTitle: On the tourism protection system of Border port cities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Tourism protection system is a series of supporting measures which supports tourism development. It may contain transportation, accommodation, catering, information consulting, tourism shopping, community tourism, sanitation facilities, environmental protection and tourism protection. At present, the tourism of Border port cities has developed rapidly and become the early scale, which has played an important role in the development of economy of border port cities. However, the tourism protection system of the border port cities is still far away from mature. So, this paper is conducted to establish a tourism protection system which consists of transportation, lodging, repast, information consultation, tourism shopping, tourism of community, sanitation facilities, environment protection and travel security.

articleTitle: College Personnel affairs management based on Personnel evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, it is laied emphasis upon human resource optimized of college Personnel affairs management more and more, and it is more scientific to make use of thought, method and tools of Personnel evaluation on personnel affairs management. But Personnel evaluation still belongs to new industry in our country, it has not developed to the utmost perfect, which would be appearing some concrete problems while being applied. This paper, aiming at the problems for discovering, puts forward homologous counterplans from thought, software and tools of Personnel evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on product resource collaborative services of steel-auto industry chain grid-based
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of industry chain, divides steel-auto industry chain from core business and value-added into steel unit, trade unit, storage unit, machining unit, auto unit and general service unit. On this basis, the whole realization process of product resource collaborative services of steel-auto industry chain is illustrated, including the digital model of product resource, formalization description, capsulation and invoking. At last, the structure of collaborative information platform of steel-auto industry chain is put forward..

articleTitle: Detection of pressure and temperature about gallstone auto-dissolving instrument
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Directly dissolving gallstone by pouring MBTE in Gallbladder is a valid therapy. Gallstone auto-dissolving instrument replace manual perfusion by auto-perfusion, while the pressure of inner gallbladder and the temperature of MBTE solvent must keep in a rational range, thus MBTE's dissolving potential can be exerted. A system made up with NORCO-6715 IPC, AC6111 Acquisition board, NPC1210 pressure sensor and BTS101 temperature sensor can ensure a precision of ±0.1kPa and ±1°C respectively. Out-body test shows the design meets the desire.

articleTitle: Statistical Process Control based on state space model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is difficult to apply traditional Statistical Process Control (SPC) technology as state variables are unmeasurable in small batch production process. A modified individual control chart based on state space model was proposed in this paper. The process state was estimated through particle filter technology. The median of state particles group was monitored by Average Moving Range (AMR) control chart to detect variation of normal distribution process. Results showed that the proposed chart was an effective tool to monitor small batch production process.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-speed token bucket based on FPGA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Token bucket is a common traffic control technique which is widely used in network equipment for traffic shaping and rate constraint. This paper proposes a realization method of high-speed token bucket, and provides theoretical analysis on selection of parameters, such as time granularity, augment granularity and bucket depth. Based on the live streaming data captured on real network, we simulate the rate constraint effects of our designed high-speed token bucket. We also implement the design in Altera FPGA. Resource usage, working frequency and power estimation are provided in the paper. Analysis and experiments show that the proposed high-speed token bucket can accurately constraint rate as well as achieve a high performance up to 1186.40Gbps.

articleTitle: An analysis of Chinese energy efficiency by the provincial Panel data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is extremely important in a low-carbon economic society to evaluate the energy efficiency of regions correctly. Data envelopment analysis (DEA) is an important method of evaluating efficiency, but the method requires that decision-making units must have the same external environment. In order to measure the energy efficiency under different time conditions, a nonparametric method for evaluating energy efficiency by the Panel data of energy indicators is given in this paper. Then we provide a corresponding mathematical model (M-DEA) for measuring energy efficiency. Finally, the energy efficiency index of 30 Chinese provinces from 1998 to 2007 is calculated by using this model, and a comprehensive analysis is given according to the calculated results. The application shows that M-DEA method not only has the advantages of traditional DEA, but also the reference set is more stable compared with traditional DEA model. Therefore, the efficiency index and corresponding suggestion is more realistic.

articleTitle: A Real Time Main Memory Database model for RFID middleware
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid growth of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) system, Real time performance is a key point of RFID middleware researching in these years. In order to improve capability of real time performance of RFID middleware, this paper presents a Real Time Main Memory Database (RT-MMDB) model for RFID middleware according to the characteristics of RFID data. Besides, some key methods to implement the modules and testing the application in a real scenario are also discussed.

articleTitle: Based on Web and SOA place county dispatcher integration system's software design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By the service-oriented architecture (SOA) and the WEB technology, this article solves the municipal county intelligence scheduling problem. Also, it introduces the construction and the software design of the system based on the dispatching features. Not only is it simple to maintain, but SOA can solve the dispatching and data-sharing issues of the inter-county, the inspection which moved to the county, the information uploaded which moved to the super rank and avoid mis-dispatching and lighten the dispatching intension.

articleTitle: Sensor fault diagnosis based on a new method of feature extraction in time-series
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new method of how to choose the key points of monotone sequences based on the basic theory of time series segmentation algorithm, which is to select the key points from monotone sequences by calculating the curvatures. With such method, time series can be well linear-fitted. This method is also used for fault diagnosis of sensor. Key point sequence of the maximum difference can be achieved by comparisons among different time series of sensors, thus the fault sensor can be determined.

articleTitle: Potential noise zone detection in Rawalpindi city:GIS view
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Noise pollution is a challenging environmental issue, distracting aesthetic quality of life for many people. It has been potentially quantified to study its effects on human and ecosystem. These impacts are resultant of the personal exposures to noise levels exceeding the standard values. In recent years, an increasing rate of urbanization and development has lead to many environmental issues in developing countries. This paper attempts to scientifically assess the noise pollution in one of major cities of Pakistan through identifying noise levels in decibel (dB) on potential spots and to demarcate the risk zones into Noise Potential Areas (NPA) based on measured noise levels. A preliminary research on noise levels are taken from seven different locations and is done in two temporal ranges namely off-peak (5-7am) and peak (6-8pm). Geographical Information System (GIS) is then used to produce NPA and map zonations through spatial interpolation. It plays significant role in mapping noise potential areas. This investigation identifies vehicular traffic as the biggest cause of noise related issues around the city. This model research has been initiated to examine the concept of spatial proximity with help of GIS techniques. The interpolated maps provide a clear visualization of correlation of noise levels with associated risks to human health.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of solar analysis based on plug-in technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Solar analysis function is the important indicator of modern civil construction and evaluation of environmental sustainable development, the increased buildings and the reduced space between buildings enhance the people's conflict of solar rights and residential environment problems. In order to safeguard the basic rights of the people and create a pleasant living condition for the citizen, it is necessary to put forward an effective method to measure the buildings' shadows, related solar analysis parameters, sunshine time, etc. The rapid development of 3D GIS, with its lifelike visual expression, powerful 3D analysis and operation functions, provides the solar analysis area a strong support. The traditional solar analysis software costs much on development, maintenance and modeling; has low independence and software portability and limited capability on function expansion. These limits couldn't match up to the need of true-3D GIS and the development of urban planning management. This paper aims at present the solar analysis module which based on plug-in technology and has successfully made it out. The thought of plug-in doesn't depend on specific software; the structure of “platform + plug-in” reduce the time of software development, giving the programmer more freedom to organize flexible functions. This paper has realized the accuracy and visualization requirement of solar analysis on the function: displaying the shadow of buildings, calculating sunshine hours and sunlight interval distance, drawing solar isochrones, solar conic surface and etc. At the end of the article, we show the results and which can clearly prove the advantage of this module.

articleTitle: Cascade centroid-based model on web pages classification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A lot of factors will affect the performance of the classification. In this paper we point out how the differences of training and test documents will affect the performance of the web pages classification, and then we put forward a cascade model to reduce the impact. The experiment shows that this model enhanced the applicability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on key technology of geographical scene based on binocular stereoscopic vision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper researched the key issues of the true 3D geographic scene visualization based on the binocular vision. Firstly the essential stereoscopic theories such as the formation of stereoscopic perception are introduced in detail, and several binocular projection models to calculate stereo pairs are given. Secondly, Based on discussion of stereoscopic theory and related experiments, this paper gives an algorithm of binocular parallax model. In the end, by analyzing geographic scene mesh file formats and introducing 3D graphics API, the stereoscopic software rendering geographic scenes in stereo pairs is developed on the parallax 3D-LCD display. That just provides a practical approach for true 3D visualization of virtual geography environment.

articleTitle: A document clustering algorithm based on improved landmark semidefinite embedding
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The document space is generally of high dimensionality, and clustering in such a high dimensional space is often infeasible due to the curse of dimensionality. In this paper, a novel document clustering method which based on improved landmark semidefinite embedding (lSDE) is proposed. Based on the general lSDE, the point selection rules is modified by Max-min distance algorithm, with a view to ensuring the stability of algorithm. By using the improved lSDE, the documents can be projected into a lower dimension kernel space in which redundant information was filtered, and the documents related to the same semantic are close to each other. On this low-dimensional representation, the processed document data was clustered by kernel K-means. Experimental results show that the new clustering algorithm gives better performance than several advanced clustering methods.

articleTitle: The region filled algorithm for the circles cutting stock problem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Pointing to the circles cutting stock problem, this paper proposes the region filled algorithm, which syncretizes the idea of subsection layout, interlace arrangement algorithm and filling algorithm. The main idea of the region filled algorithm is to continuously divide the stock into two sections by a local optimal principle, then allocate the left parts by the way of interlace arrangement and fill the blank area until the stock has been lined with. The experimental results show that the region filled algorithm not only allocates the circles more regulation, but also can get a more satisfied layout result.

articleTitle: An improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Inspired by the classical PSO method and quantum mechanics theories, this essay presents a new Quantum-behaved PSO (QPSO) algorithm using hyper-chaotic discrete system equation, as hc-QPSO. Our key novelty is to confine all the particles in the identical particle system and use 2-dimensional hyper-chaotic sequence theory and average out the search length to research and consider seasonal fluctuation's interference on particle's search route. First, the identical particle system can remove the seasonal fluctuation's interference on the particle search route in initializing the swarm and achieve better updating of the particle's position. Second, 2-dimensional hyperchaotic sequence theory can conduct chaotic search for every particle. Third, average out the search length is introduced to improve the swarm's full search capacity in the search process, and thereby prevent the particle from falling into local minimum prematurely, fasten the convergence velocity and enhance the accuracy of the algorithm. The simulation results of the classical function have demonstrated that the hc-QPSO algorithm is superior to the classical PSO algorithm and the quantum PSO algorithm in its performance.

articleTitle: The application of laser in indoor robot
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important means to sense the environment for robot, laser scanner has high accuracy, relatively simple data processing and large measurement range, compared with other sensors. The application of laser in robot is mainly used in obstacle avoidance, environment modeling and mapping. In this paper, the application of laser scanner in obstacle avoidance, automatic recharge and target tracking, is introduced through a laser-vision based robot navigation system. And the feasibility of application is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: A improved volume rendering algorithm based on convex hull
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For large amount of medical image data, the calculation for visualization is huge. It also demands the high computing ability for hardware. This paper studies the volume rending technology based on convex hull. It describes the work steps and details of this method used OpenGL. On the conclusion, this algorithm is suitable for the common video card. It can also attain the 18fps interactive volume rending effect.

articleTitle: Periodic update based estimates of subband system noise powers for subband adaptive filtering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Subband adaptive filters (SAFs) have been widely used due to their fast convergence rate for colored input signals. In order to meet the conflicting requirements of fast convergence rate and small misalignment of SAFs, a variable step-size matrix (VSSM) has been presented for the recently proposed normalized SAF (NSAF). The VSSM is derived by letting the powers of the subband a posteriori errors of the NSAF equal the powers of the corresponding subband system noises at each time instant and therefore the subband system noise powers should be estimated. In this paper, we propose to incorporate the concept of periodic update into the subband system noise power estimates to reduce the computational complexity of the VSSM-NSAF. Simulation results in a system identification context show that the proposed periodic update based method can achieve a good performance close to that of the full update one.

articleTitle: An embedded environmental monitoring data collecting system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Regarding the data collection process for a comprehensive automated environmental monitoring and precaution platform, this paper first analyses the key issues and challenges, including setting of monitoring targets, heterogeneity of monitoring equipments, diversity of communication methods, and online monitoring. Based on this, an embedded real-time environmental data collecting system is proposed. The contributions of the paper are as follows: we have designed an embedded environmental data collector which supports three collecting modes; we have proposed a novel integration technique for heterogeneous monitoring devices and an adaptive internetworking approach. The proposed system is a component of a distributed environmental monitoring platform which will be deployed in Guangzhou city.

articleTitle: Study of entrepreneurship enterprises cluster's collective innovation mechanism based on social capital theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There is great contradiction about the role of science park in developing high-tech industries. Based on the social capital theory, this paper comprehensively studied collective innovation behaviors existing enterprises in high-tech enterprises clusters. Taking the Zhongguancun software park as an example, we analyze the reason of keeping continuous power and lasting competitive advantage of innovation enterprises cluster.

articleTitle: TRIZ theory-based single-piece and small batch products design innovation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Single-piece and small batch production mode is applied more and more, and to improve the speed of the single-piece and small batch product in innovating design, the blocking collision matrix of TRIZ theory is brought in the process of products innovating design. Knowledge base based on TRIZ theory of single-piece and small batch products is established. It can give reasonable solution timely when we encounter conflicts in the product innovation process. In addition, this article introduces the implemented processes of the innovative design system of single-piece and small-lot products, in which bring in the blocking collision matrix of TRIZ theory.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable assembly line balancing with the hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Firstly, aimed at the existing problem of reconfigurable assembly line (RAL) balancing, the characteristics of RAL are analyzed and the special requirements of balancing are studied. Secondly, the mathematical model is proposed based on two factors, which are integrated including the cycle time and the assembly line efficiency. Then a new hybrid genetic algorithm is developed for finding optimal solution of the problems. Finally, example verification is carried out, and which indicates the validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Campus Recruitment management platform based on dynamic electronic commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Now, the employment for college graduates is becoming a focus-point problem for the society and livelihood in China. With the rapid development of information technology and electronic commerce applications, more and more people realized that only to promote the symmetries and transparency about information can provide more equal opportunities for various graduates. In order to solve the deficiency about existed employment management system, a core business scenario is proposed in the paper for the whole process of employment, which includes five roles, such as government, enterprise, university, student, and platform administrator. Based on analyzing the five meta-models for employment in dynamic e-Commerce, i.e., B2C for student, B2B for enterprise and university, C2C for personal society network, mobile Commerce and collaborative e-Commerce for employment application, a new dynamic e-Commerce model, enterprise-University- Student Trading Model (DEC-EUST) about recruitment for college graduates is proposed in the paper. Furthermore, an independent management platform for Campus Recruitment, XiaoZhen website, is designed, which integrates the five meta-model for employment channel and provides comprehensive information services for every platform role.

articleTitle: Probabilistic based k-coverage configuration in large-scale sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, coverage is an important measurement of quality of service (Qos). In this paper, a k-coverage configuration protocol based on the probabilistic detection model (Pro-CCP) is proposed. Pro-CCP is fully distributed and localized. Using our previous work named coverage eligible rule (CER), the proposed protocol is able to configure sensors into several disjoint active sets, each of which can maintain the monitoring area being covered no less than probabilistic γ. In addition, the scheduling scheme after the coverage configuration is presented in details. Simulations and analysis show us that Pro-CCP is a robust algorithm that can configure network coverage for various requirements, and it outperforms than the CCP on the ability of turning off redundant nodes.

articleTitle: An effective method on increasing the null depth of beam forming via virtual array transformation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When conventional virtual array transformation algorithm is used in adaptive beam forming, the nulls formed in the directions of interferers are relatively shallower, especially when hyper degrees of freedom coherent interferences incide on array sensors, the performance of virtual array will decrease, sometimes it can't reach the index of output signal to interference and noise ratio(SINR) which the system demands. Aiming at this disadvantage, an improved method is proposed in this paper, it is based on subspace projection concept, the interference direction information is imported into transformation matrix, thus the interference components in sampling covariance matrix can be enhanced. With this approach, the nulls can be steadily formed, and the interferers can be suppressed fairly deeply, simultaneously a high output SINR is also ensured. The validity of this presented algorithm is verified by theoretical analysis and computer simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem in emergency logistics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, all kinds of disasters have happened frequently. Therefore how to properly distribute disaster relief supplies becomes more and more important. In this paper a mathematical model with time window and capacity limits is built for the Multi-Depot Vehicle Routing Problem (MDVRP). Then a solution strategy for this model is presented, which integrates table dispatching method and improved C-W algorithm. At last a case is given to test the effectiveness of the solution strategy. This study indicates that this solution strategy can reduce the distribution cost. Meanwhile the research result is easier to put into practice, because the premise of the mathematical model is very consistent with the reality.

articleTitle: Research on AS path betweenness based filtering policy against BGP prefix hijacking
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: BGP prefix hijacking is a sort of security threaten of the Internet. The current effort on hijacking defense is to deploy filters for hijacking route on the edge of the Internet. In order to reduce the deployment cost of defense filter, we proposed an AS path betweenness based filter policy. By simulating a large amount of prefix hijacking experiments, we found that deploying defense filters on the core of the Internet is an effective and efficient way to gain high resilience of the network.

articleTitle: Numerical calculation method of a type of curved reflector with linear optical amplification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new linear amplification optical path design is proposed which can raise the liquid level detection resolution through amplifying linearly the small displacement of liquid level to light-spot displacement of photoelectric detector. The numerical calculation method for the linear amplification curvilinear function expression of the curved reflector is presented, and simulation research on how the variations of variable parameters affect detection error and linearity of linear amplification curve is made. The experiment results indicate that the designed curved reflector can achieve linear amplification function and the detection resolution of the laser triangulation liquid detection system can be enhanced effectively with less nonlinearity error by choosing appropriate values for the variable parameters.

articleTitle: An econometric analysis on business efficiency factors of insurance industry of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the analysis of business efficiency factors, this essay will mainly concentrate on effect from inner and micro factors. Moreover, the essay adopts company scale, proprietorship, human capital, and market share rate as independent variables, and the malmquist index, Technical Change and Efficiency Change as variables to set the model. Then it is found that the employee quality and market share rate is the most significant inner factors of business efficiency and determinate factors for insurance companies.

articleTitle: Analysis on influence factors of farmer desire in farmland circulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze the influence factors of farmland circulation to offer the quantization basis and support for qualitative analysis on farmland circulation. Methods of sampling survey and Logistic were employed. The results indicate that following contribution rate in descending order, the influence factors of farmland circulation list the non-agricultural employment rate, the Engel coefficient, agricultural income in unit area, smooth transportation, the rate of signing a contract, the dominating factor of farmland circulation, the highest education degree of family, the food security rate, the development of economy, family members, agricultural labor members and the respondent age. It is concluded that the farmer desire of participating in farmland circulation is affected and restricted by many factors. The study proposed that we should create more employment opportunities for farmers, raise benefit of agriculture, enhance the construction of the rural base, strengthen the governmental function of supervision administration and service, enhance the ideological of some farmers, expand the ways to educate farmers and raise cultural qualities of farmers.

articleTitle: Research of service outsourcing in incomplete contracts governance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The important reason for the failure of service outsourcing activities is that bilateral cooperation contract can not effectively prevented the various risk factors arising from information asymmetry.
