To this problem, agent relationships in incomplete contract governance was studied in this paper in the process of service outsourcing, the results showed that customers can save more incentive costs in incomplete contract conditions compared to that of official contracts.

articleTitle: Feature recognition based on borehole image processing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image processing plays an important role in the industrial and engineering fields. The paper is mainly about feature recognition based on borehole image process. With the technique of image segmentation and edge detection, two important geological structures—fractures and vugs on the borehole image were identified, and quantitative geometric parameters were defined. Several case studies were included to verify the applicability and the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Performance analysis and simulation of DSSS system in classical urban fading enviornments and pulse jammer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We first build a simulation model of a direct sequence spread spectrum communication system with several classical pseudorandom noise sequences. Then analyze the symbol error rate of DSSS system in a fading and pulse interference environment. Monte Carlo simulation experiments are also done based on the DSSS communication system simulation platform. The BER performance of DSSS communication system in a classical urban fading environment is analyzed and simulated finally.

articleTitle: Deployment strategies of wireless sensor network mobile nodes based on graph theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem of decline in monitoring performance, caused by failure nodes, of wireless sensor network. We propose an effective wireless sensor network deployment program based on the foundation of completing setting the fixed nodes, focusing on considering the case on condition that the fixed node uneven distribution and discuss the significance of nodes in cut vertex of wireless sensor network topology. By employing the k-means clustering algorithm, the initial number and location of the mobile nodes in this configuration program can be determined and selected effectively. Furthermore, we analyze the stability and lifetime of the network topology. Experimental results show that the proposed program can improve the stability of sensor network by introducing the least number of mobile nodes.

articleTitle: Research on multidimensional tree model for XML documents by structrue and data feature
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In currently researches, feature of data is ignored while constructing models of XML documents. To solve this problem, a model named multidimensional tree for XML documents is presented in this paper. The model can describe feature of structure and data in XML documents by extending definition of structural summary. Sets of relationship between sibling elements will be added in structural summary and sets of elements in XML documents will be extended in dimension by vector of data feature. Experiments show that multidimensional tree is effective for describing structural and data feature of XML documents.

articleTitle: The ant system-genetic algorithm particle filter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Particle filter is a statistic filtering method based on sequential simulation. It has an outstanding contribution to the nonlinear non-Gaussian dynamic system. But how to choose particle probability distributing function and deal with particle degeneration is the key to the algorithm. A new evolutional algorithm called ant system is used during the iterative recurrence of sequential important sampling. Furthermore, the particle diversity was great increased by the using of genetic across, aberrance and selection. Simulation results show that this evolutional is better than traditional particle filter in the average absolute error and variance within a short time.

articleTitle: OpenGL based visual modeling for luffing mechanism of portal crane
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to realize the rapid visual modeling luffer mechanism of portal crane, a special visual modeling platform based on OpenGL and C mixed programming in the Windows XP operation system for four-bar linkage structure was developed in this paper. Firstly, use the beam element to simplify the four-bar linkage structure, in which the driving parameters of the model were analyzed, and combining the model geometry size its spatial position parameters was estimated. Then applying the object-oriented programming, the four-bar linkage structure was represented by the relevant class and construct the model data structure according to NX Nanstran finite element preprocessing data format standard. Finally, establishment of OpenGL visual platform was described, and the drawing method of the model based on units was given, which could make the description of units be directly reflected by the visual model entity. The practice proved this platform could greatly improve the luffer mechanism of portal crane modeling speed and has visual and precise advantages.

articleTitle: Forecast of Chinese feed grain demand based on system dynamics model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapidly increasing the population, growing urbanization level and rising income of urban and rural residents, the food consumption structure has undergone tremendous changes in China, which further impacted on China's future food consumption demand profoundly. Based on system dynamics (SD) method, a predicting model, named FSD, for China's food consumption demand is established in this paper. FSD not only effectively solves the problems that traditional model are commonly encountered, such as lack of data and the difficulty to quantify data, but also improves the prediction accuracy of the overall system. Based on the predicting results, related policy options for Governments are proposed to ensure the safety of future food consumption in China.

articleTitle: Estimating localization algorithm based on virtual-derived points in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at great positioning error and “invagination” of boundary region by the method of weighted centroid algorithm, it is proposed in this paper that the algorithm named estimate based on virtual-derived points (EVD) would be applicable. By the method of analogous projection of unknown node, we can obtain the virtual-derived point in monitoring area, then we can treated the practical value of virtual-derived points as the estimated value of unknown node. The monitoring area in which contains unknown node is narrowed by EVD and the approximation degree between virtual-derived points and unknown node can be reflected by the homomorphism factor, then this paper proposes EVD algorithm procedure. Theory and simulation results all indicate that EVD behaves noticeably on condition of simple positioning algorithm and low communication cost, and overcomes the defects of great positioning error and “invagination” of boundary region. EVD is performing its excellent adaptability under anisotropic environment and can provide reference for wireless senor network with practical application.

articleTitle: Sensitivity analysis and improvement of front suspension structure parameters for electric car
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper is for some bad performance issues of front suspension of the electric car which is being developed by company. Using Design of Experiments of ADMAS/INSIGHT, sensitivity analysis of the McPherson structure parameters is conducted. And based on the results of sensitivity, an improvement measure is put forward. Through comparing, the improved front suspension structure is able to meet the design requirements better.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of green construction supply chain based on improved BSC
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the conception and characteristics of green construction supply chain, the article improves the balanced scorecard to build a performance evaluation indicator system which is more comprehensive and quantitative. Taking into account the general problems including indicator confusion and subjective weighting in performance evaluation, the article chooses principal component analysis to reduce dimensions of indicators established above. Then attempt to build a target weight optimization model based on AHP indeterminacy interval matrix and use genetic algorithm for final solution. All of these suggest a set of scientific evaluation process. Case analysis shows its theoretical feasibility and important practical application.

articleTitle: Load balancing parameters for geographic routing protocol in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Geographical routing protocol has been proposed to reduce the complexity of routing protocols, which are based on topology information in wireless/mobile networks. This kind of protocol is regarded as good working protocol in wireless sensor networks because reduced control overhead in geographic routing protocol is very suitable for each battery-powered sensor node. However, despite of several advantages, original greedy forwarding technique is very likely to cause different type of problems such as congestion. In this paper, we develop new parameters and apply existing possible parameters into original greedy forwarding in order to balance load efficiently. These parameters are derived from key characteristics of wireless sensor networks. Simulation results show that higher packet delivery ratio is achieved by proposed parameters in greedy forwarding.

articleTitle: The iterative graph cut optical flow estimation with space term disturbance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a novel iterative α -expansion move optical flow estimation with space term disturbance to decrease the local error caused by outlier points. At first, the reason for less smoothness of the discrete optical flow estimation is analyzed. And then, the truncated linear function is adopted and inhibits outlier points caused by the noise and the occlusion because its disturbance makes the solution jump out of the local minimum. Given the theory of the graph cut, the property of decreasing further the energy by disturbing the space term is proven. The experiment shows that this approach could reduce outlier points and smooth further the optical flow field than the estimation with fixed space term.

articleTitle: Study of urban planning information integration technology based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban and Rural planning information is the most active field in government departments information with earlier carrying out, broader popular and fastest growing. As an important part of Digital City, Digital Plan is the foundation and leading role of Urban planning. Considering the problems of sharing, redundancy and other issues in the process of Urban planning information, this paper proposed the concept of Urban Planning Information Model and integrated the information for management. Through the establishment of integration platform, users could access various application systems, achieving kinds of planning information and collaborating with others. Finally, this paper introduced an integrated platform for planning construction project and completed the information gathering and analysis.

articleTitle: Assessment of rotamer library for protein structure prediction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Side chain packing is a crucial step for protein structure prediction. And the quality of rotamer library has important implications in side chain packing. This paper assess dunbrack rotamer libraries and simple sampling rotamer libraries for certain structures by comparing the native structure and solutions come from rotamer libraries. Results of eleven hard targets in CASP9 show that the best solution is near to the native structure. Otherwise, there is no native structure in protein structure prediction.We compare the best solutions which choosing by lower RMSD and energy, it shows that the best solution which choosing by lower energy is near to the best solution which choosing by low RMSD. So, in the case of unknown native structure, the energy guided choosing is necessary, but it must adopt some other method such as clustering to select the best solution.

articleTitle: GPU based acceleration architecture for image enhancement in spatial domain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce the processing time of image enhancement in spatial domain, a GPU (Graphic Processing Unit) based acceleration architecture is proposed and implemented. With structured design method, computing model, data and algorithm resource which are indispensability in GPU computation are encapsulated, and computed directly in high performance with CUDA (Compute Unified Device Architecture). This architecture shields the configuration details of GPU computation and reduces repetitive work. In addition, new algorithms of enhancement in spatial domain could be added conveniently in the architecture. More importantly, the executing time of algorithms could be reduced 12–38 times than before in CPU, which is useful for the applications in real time system. For the neighborhood algorithms of image enhancement, a better solution of texture memory is used. Though this way, the time of executing algorithms could be reduced 36–135 times.

articleTitle: Flood optimal operation of Panjiakou cascade reservoir based on SA-PSO algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A swarm-intelligence-based algorithm of particle swarm optimization is proposed, which is simply implementing, fast convergent and only with few parameters. Aimed at the disadvantage of normal PSO, the mechanism of simulated annealing is involved into particle swarm optimization, and a simulated annealing-based particle swarm optimization algorithm is presented. The novel algorithm is almost as simple for implement as particle swarm optimizer, but can improve the abilities of seeking the global excellent result and evolution speed. Modified particle swarm optimization algorithm is used in Panjiakou reservoir optimal operation according to the rules of the reservoir operation. The effectiveness of this algorithm is verified by the sample application.

articleTitle: Industrial landscape analysis with high spatial resolution grid in GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Industrial landscape (IL) is the spatial consequence of industry behaviors. Aboundance of industrial spatial pattern and dependence can be observed due to the variation of different geographical factors. Location of work-force and capital also differ along the earth surface. Because of data collection difficulty, administrative area is often used as the basic spatial analysis unit and high spatial resolution less introduced. In the paper, data of the 2nd National Economic Sensus of China are employed to carry out high spatial resolution IL analysis. Spatial statistics methods are conducted to find industry cluster, special industry zone and spatial dependence at 1Km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> resolution grid in GIS software. It's argued that subtle spatial segmentation will violate industry characters in some spatial cells in which only few enterprise sites. Therefore supernumerary filters should be introduced to exclude these cells.

articleTitle: Group decision making model of public project based on entropy theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to provide an alternation to the currently used decision making method, this paper starts with a new method named multi-objective collaborative group decision making of public project. In the beginning of this paper, entropy and REM of entropy theory, as well as the concept of weight of decision-makers are introduced. Following by this, group decision REM model and algorithm for public project are constructed. In the last section, a case is used to demonstrate effectiveness and practicality of the method.

articleTitle: The analysis for roundness error of revolution body based on hypothesized instrument
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper picks up a analysis system for roundness error of revolution body based on hypothesized instrument. Aiming at the signal can be interrupted from outside, this paper uses wavelet denoising algorithm and “53H algorithm” which made by LabVIEW and MATLAB to finish error segregation. According to the smallest region method of roundness error, this paper adopts the real number code to evaluate the roundness error based on the improved genetic algorithm. It carry on directed mutation and change mutation step size adaptively as the trend of search points' adaptive value. It can achieve the high precision, and has good robustness.

articleTitle: Status quo, problems, and solutions: The reform of China's treasury management system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Treasury management is an important component of budget implementation, and the treasury management system is the foundation of the budget management system. Presently, the treasury management system in China is still in the process of reform, in which different problems and situations may appear. Starting with the status quo of China's treasury management system, this study briefly analyzed problems in the system with the public choice theory and the principal-agent theory, and proposed relevant policy proposals.

articleTitle: Contract WBS applicants in the deputy construction project cost regulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Contract WBS the summaries in the research achievements related to the supervision of the construction projects, the thesis emphatically analyses contents and key points in supervision of the agent construction management from the construction agent and the government perspective, all of which aims at the current situation and the solution to the implementation problems. This thesis constructs cost vertical control system and set up the crosswise coordination supervisory mechanism. Finally, this thesis integrated these two systems, and designed funds coordination supervision system of the agent construction project, then elaborated this system's movement pattern in detail. The system is carrying on the supervision to the funds from inside to outside, which guaranteed security effective use of the funds in the agent construction project.

articleTitle: Algorithm of 3D reconstruction based on point cloud segmentation denoising
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The triangular mesh has am undesirable noise. By the point cloud segmentation approach we can denoise the data just only for the characteristic point, thereby reducing the number of point cloud processing and precision. This paper proposes an algorithm which can smooth nosing data quickly and use this method to reconstruction 3D model. Experimental result proves the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The implementation of coupling algorithm for MOM4 and BCC_CSM Model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The parallel coupling between BCC_CSM climate modeling system was realized, in order to provide scientists with more selections of the ocean component model than before, and promote the performance of BCC_CSM climate modeling system. In this paper, we analyzed and studied the interpolation scheme for the data on the coordinator systems between Gaussian (BCC_CSM) and Tri-pole (MOM4), and the fusion of communication modes of Multiple Program Multiple Data (MPMD) used by BCC_CSM and Single Program Multiple Data (SPMD) used by MOM4. The coupled system has been set up on the high-performance computing platform SunWay4000A. With this system, the simulation has successfully integrated for approximate 1,000 years. The simulation results show that the coupling algorithm is correct and feasible, and a better service for the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (AR5) of climate simulations is guaranteed.

articleTitle: How international financial crisis affects industries in Beijing, capital city of China?
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Beijing's industrial structure is service-oriented with a high degree of economic openness, and GDP has maintained rapid growth. This paper analyzes the international financial crisis and the impact of China's anti-crisis policies on Beijing's economic development as well as its transmission mechanism. Impact Index (excluding seasonal factors) and ARMA Model are employed in the empirical study which involves the crisis affection on output and stability of Beijing's top ten industries. Such conclusions are revealed: Beijing's GDP losses more than 10% compared with its potential value; the growth rates of over 70% industries are decreasing in Beijing; shocks in financial and real estate are intensified. In the anti-crisis process, manufacturing, real estate, scientific research, technical services, geological prospecting, transportation, storage and postal industry have gained significant growing opportunities.

articleTitle: XPC: A novel method for retrieving massive smallscale XML documents via path constraints
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for searching massive and small-scale XML documents via path constraints, referred to as XPC, to overcome drawbacks of conventional approaches. Firstly, we propose employing keywords with simple path constraints to retrieve XML data, which provides a user-friendly way without need of understanding complex knowledge and could express user demand accurately. This paper further proposes a novel method for computing term weight in documents via path constraints, called rtf-idf. It measures the similarity of path constraints by N-Gram and other factors according to the structure of the XML documents. Then we rank the relevant documents by an extension of the vector space model. The experimental results show that XPC indeed outperforms the baseline methods such as VSM in plain text and JuruXML.

articleTitle: Application in nonstationary signals with improved kalman filter technique
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve operation speed slowly for traditional kalman filter technique and the effectiveness is not ideal in processing the nonstationary signals, the traditional kalman filter is improved and applied into the actual measurement nonstationary vibration signals. Firstly, the traditional kalman filter technique is analyzed and the shortcoming using in gearbox fault diagnose is discovered, and then the improved method is brought forward. Secondly, the nonstationary vibration signals in time-domain are analyzed with the new method, but the outcome couldn't be diagnosed the fault in gearbox. Thirdly, the nonstationary signals in time-domain are resampled with order analysis arithmetic. The data at constant angle increments in angle-domain are obtained. Therefore, the instantaneously signals in time-domain is changed into pseudo-stationary ones in angle-domain. Then, the signals in angle-domain are analyzed with the improved kalman filter technique. At last, the mesh character of the gearbox is obtained. The outcome shows that the operation speed is enhanced than the traditional method. The nonstationary signals in time-domain are translated into pseudo-stationary ones in angle-domain. The precision of the data in angle-domain is exactly than the data in time-domain. It is trenchancy supplement for traditional kalman filter technique and has more amplitude appliance foreground.

articleTitle: Foreign ownership and stock return volatility
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper examines the impact of foreign ownership on stock return volatility in China A stock markets. Foreign investors will be divided into two categories, we show that mutual fund ownership is negatively related to stock return volatility. We also demonstrate that the measures of foreign ownership in this paper differ substantially from the measure used in the recent literature.

articleTitle: A case study of the frontal eddy in the northeast of the East China Sea
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using muti-sensors satellite data, a frontal eddy was found at 127.98 E°, 29.8 N° in June 2006, with 7 days period and the 200km west-east spatial scale. Longtime satellite measure show that it occurred many times in this area. The whole process includes generation, motion, combination and evanescence was observed. Combining the wind satellite data, we analyzed the effect of Sea Surface Wind (SSW) on the generation and evanescence of the frontal eddy. This study shows that the SSW was the main inducement, and it conduced the evanescence of frontal eddy.

articleTitle: Application of simulated annealing algorithm to grid computing scheduling based on GridSim
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Simulated annealing algorithm has lots of advantages, but so far there was little research on how to apply it to grid scheduling. The main cause had two problems. One was how to decrease its overhead; the other was how to obtain its parameters. After introducing characters on scheduling in grid, one scheduling algorithms was proposed. In order to get the appropriate algorithm's parameters and to test its efficiency, a newly tool kits called Ana-GridSim based on GridSim was developed. Results of experiments showed the algorithm nice and the Ana-GridSim effective, feasible and convenient to study grid scheduling.

articleTitle: Analysis of factors affecting Chinese college English teachers accepting and adopting E-learning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The application of E-Learning has changed the traditional teaching mode, in which teachers are facing many challenges in the process of change. Through questionnaires, interviews and other methods of access to relevant information and analysis of the data obtained, the factors which affect college English teachers accepting E-learning are summarized as these-teaching ideas, teacher's personal capacity, technology, management mechanism. The paper is to put forward the relevant strategy and proposals according to the factors and points out that blended learning is the best college English teaching mode at the present period and this study is of positive significance for promoting the reform of the college English teaching mode.

articleTitle: An improved handover algorithm of Wireless Sensor Networks in high-speed mobile environment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the application features of Intelligent Transportation System based on Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), a simplified topology and an improved handover algorithm in high-speed mobile environment have been proposed. According to Okumura-Hata path loss model, the rxlevel (receive level), speed, distance and the data transmission interruption probability of four polynomials relations, the theoretical optimal handover time can be found. The improved handover algorithm trains and finds the best weights and threshold matrix by using BP neural network algorithm. Finally the output layer decides whether to trigger handover, in order to minimize the probability of data transmission interruption. Simulation experiments show that the improved handover algorithm can reduce 2.29% of the data transmission interruption probability in high-speed environment.

articleTitle: Attitude plus angular rate rapid transfer alignment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Transfer alignment is applied for the alignment of strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) on moving base conventionally, and ‘velocity’ is often utilized as the observation message of the transfer alignment filter, but the leaver arm error will induced simultaneously, which can't be compensated accurately. An improved rapid transfer alignment algorithm called ‘attitude plus angular rate’ matching is presented in this paper, which is based on the rapid transfer alignment model introduced by the American scientist Kain, while the ‘velocity’ measurement is replaced by ‘angular rate’, avoid the compensation of the leaver arm error. The widely used Kalman filter has been chosen to estimate the misalignment of the SINS. A simulation system has been investigated to test the ‘attitude plus angular rate’ matching transfer alignment algorithm, compared with the ‘velocity plus attitude’ matching algorithm, results show that the method presented here can achieve the accuracy better than 1 mrad in 10 second, without leaver arm error compensation.

articleTitle: Manufacturing upgrading and development of modern service industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, most manufacturing products in Zhejiang are in urgent need of upgrade with excess resource consumption and low production efficiency, facing land, energy and environmental constraints, and the environmental pollution is serious but with low added value. While the modern producer services can lower transaction costs of manufacturing and help to promote industrial concentration and economic growth; to improve production efficiency, effectiveness and operational efficiency of manufacturing; and play an important role in upgrading and competitiveness promotion of the manufacturing industry. This paper argue that the performance of the whole interaction of the modern service industry and manufacturing industry in Zhejiang Province is in the early stages of interactive development, and we should make efforts to promote competition and break the monopoly of services administration by opening up of modern service industry, building interactive information platform for manufacturing and modern services to facilitate the upgrading of manufacturing and development of modern service industrial clusters.

articleTitle: A study on integration of automobile supply chain —based on hubei province of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Automobile industry is one of the pillar industries in Hubei Province, integrating the automobile supply chain efficiently will help to promote the automobile industry in Hubei. There are some problems in Hubei automobile industry, such as the big entire scale, the backward reaction mechanism, the self-operating logistics and the low level of information. So in view of existing situation, this paper proposes countermeasures from the core enterprises integration, supplier integration, information construction, and so on.

articleTitle: Research on traffic organization and command support system under the emergency
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the problem of emergency traffic organization, designed the architecture of traffic emergency organization and command support system. Firstly analysised the emergency transportation organizational processes in-depth, and then put forward the route and possible projects of emergency traffic organization program. Finally, designed a traffic organization and command support system, and requested the system structure and function, and definitude the flow of traffic organization and command.

Author Keywords: Traffic organization and command support system

articleTitle: Membership function knowledge expression and fuzzy inference decision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the characteristic of the medicine diagnosis knowledge, the paper gave the kind of knowledge expression in the fuzzy expert system based on the membership function. Imitated thinking process which the expert diagnoses, gave the fuzzy diagnosis inference strategy based on the match. Finally introduced the application in the disease control expert system.

articleTitle: Design and construction of GIS-based China Major Natural Disaster Integrated Assessment System
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: China is one of the counties in the world that suffers the most natural disasters. Geographic Information System (GIS) plays a significant part in different stages of disaster prevention and reduction. However, current systems existing for disaster reduction in various sectors mainly serve for single kind of disaster and usually have their own special data formats for input and analysis that result in low efficiency, digital divide and incompatible among them. Consequently, to build an integrated platform to facilitate disaster reduction and standardize disaster management in national scale is urgent and necessary. This paper describes the design and construction of such a system combing natural disaster models with capacity provided by GIS in a uniform and flexible decision support environment. Especially it presents a mean leveraging ArcGIS technology to build a software system loosely coupled between common GIS component and model bank containing expert knowledge.

articleTitle: The effects of value of city on urban house price: An empirical study based on factor analysis and Panel Data model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the panel data of 35 large and medium-sized cities in China from 2004 to 2008, this paper empirically analyses the effects of value of city on urban house price by using the factor analysis and the econometric model of Panel Data. The result of study shows that the value of cites in our country are increasing. The value of city for urban house price is relative. The value of city decides urban house price. The difference of value of the city is reflected in urban house price. Finally, using deviation value evaluates matching degree between value of city and urban house price.

articleTitle: Application of ZOPP theory on TOT project financing mode—A case study on NBJ Water Plant of Zunyi, Guizhou Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The TOT project of NBJ Water Plant in Zunyi, Guizhou Province had to end up due to many factors. With the actual situation of this case, this paper tries to use ZOPP (OOPP, Object Oriented Project Planning) method to identify the core problem and other problems impeding the operation of the NBJ Water Plant TOT project. The significance of this study lies in: improving the living standards of people in Zunyi City; giving some useful suggestions and effective measures on infrastructure TOT project operation, such as water plant.

articleTitle: Simulation of pressure effect on oxygen in the cathode for the PEM Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to understand the pressure effect on oxygen mass fraction in the cathode for the PEM(Proton Exchange Membrane) fuel cell, a model was set up by three conservation equations, and it was considered the Gravity in source item. The modeling domain consists of the membrane, two catalyst layers, two diffusion layers, and two channels. It is simulation of species mass fraction in this paper. The results of simulation were drawn six pictures. On analyzing of pictures, it got conclusion as follow: Oxygen mass fraction increases along with pressure increasing in channel. When the case is anode-upward, gravity exerts effect on the liquid water transport. The gravity is helpful for water transport from anode to cathode leading to the water mass fraction increase and oxygen mass fraction decrease. Oxygen mass fraction in cathode of fuel cell with anode-upward is lower than that with cathode-upward because of the effect of gravity.

articleTitle: Velocity distribution numerical simulation and indirect verification of cesium atomic clock
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a numerical simulation model for compact single beam magnetic state selection cesium clock to study cesium atomic velocity distribution on detector. In the model, cesium atoms ejecting from oven are accord with Maxwell distribution of thermal motion and are sampled with Monte Carlo method, then move into two-wire field magnets and take place transition with given probability in Ramsey microwave cavity. The theoretical conclusion is verified with the numerical simulations that oven temperature and feed-in microwave frequency offset has nothing to do with velocity distribution. Moreover, the velocity distribution on detector is acquired with Fourier transform method based on Ramsey lineshapes from numerical simulation and compared with that directly from numerical simulations. It shows that these velocity distributions are similar, which validates the numerical model.

articleTitle: Co-evolution mechanism based on sustainable development for logistics network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Biological co-evolution theory is introduced to analyze the sustainable development of logistics collaboration capabilities. So Lotka-Volterra model of population evolution is borrowed to build up a co-evolution model for logistics network under the combined effects of collaboration and competition. And the model stability is analyzed by intersection situation of singularity isoclines. The co-evolution results under different conditions provide useful guidance for logistics coordination to achieve win-win cooperation.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation on the level of regional rural economy development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the grey cluster, this paper establishes the evaluation index system of rural economic development based on the analysis of the present situation of rural economy in Henan Province, evaluating the 18 prefectures of Henan Province according to the level of rural economic development, making a conclusion from the results that the rural economic development level of Henan Province is varied widely. This will provide guidance of policy making for rural economy development.

articleTitle: Synthetical Generalized Discriminant Analysis for radar HRRP target recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The prevalent applications of traditional statistical discriminant methods for radar High Range Resolution Profile (HRRP) target recognition are designed to obtain Common Discriminant Information (C-DI) among all classes at the expense of Individual Discriminant Information (I-DI) between them, so they may lose slight I-DI between close-set classes and result in a dissatisfied recognition performance. To overcome this weakness, we design a Distributed Generalized Discriminant Analysis (D-GDA) for I-DI extracting, and accordingly, a new variation called Synthetical Generalized Discriminant Analysis (S-GDA) is presented to deal with C-DI and I-DI equally. Experimental results for simulated data show that GDA and D-GDA are complementary in many facets and can be considered as a feature extraction method couple. Furthermore, compared with GDA and D-GDA, the proposed S-GDA not only achieves the best recognition performance, but also is more robust to many challenges, such as noise disturbance, aspect variation and Small Sample Size (SSS) problem. All these experimental facts confirm that C-DI and I-DI are different as two aspects of Discriminant Information (DI) but both are beneficial to target recognition.

articleTitle: Study on traffic information coverage of probe vehicle system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traffic information coverage is an important indicator to probe vehicle system. In this paper, the variation of coverage to different probe vehicle number is analyzed firstly based on the data collected from Nanjing system, and sensitivity analysis is also executed. Then, a coverage model including probe vehicle number and road network characteristics is estimated through multiple regression analysis, and validated with high preciseness. This model is characterized with high transferability by involving urban road network characteristics, and possible be applied to other city to get the necessary probe vehicle number for a defined coverage.

articleTitle: Fabrication of RF-ZnO buffer for epitaxial GaN layer on Si(111) substrate
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Satisfactory ZnO buffer has been fabricated through radio-frequency (RF) sputtering on Si(111) substrate. Ulteriorly, a low-temperature GaN (LT-GaN) interlayer growing on RF-ZnO/Si(111) can reduce the lattice mismatch and coefficient of thermal expansion mismatch between GaN epitaxial layer and Si(111) substrate. The optimal process conditions of RF-ZnO layer are as follows: background vacuum gets 6.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>Pa; sputtering power adopts 60W; pressure of Ar gas is 1.5Pa; heating temperature of Si(111) substrate is at 200°C. The RF-ZnO buffer has the unique (0002) crystal orientation, and the roughness of ZnO layer surface gets 1nm. The surface of GaN epitaxial layer grown on LT-GaN/Si(111) substrate is smooth and crack-free.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship of the protection for investors, related transactions and company efficiency: Taking Pan-Yangtze River Delta as example
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The company managing efficiency and the protection level for investors are closely related. Taking the listed companies during period from 2007 to 2009 of the Pan-Yangtze River Delta as sample, this paper started from the protection of investors, and analyzed the influence of the protection of investors and the related transactions on the managing efficiency. The results shows: firstly, the listed companies of the Pan-Yangtze River Delta are commonly having controlling shareholders. Secondly, the corporations with chairmen of board coming from the controlling shareholders have obviously more related transactions than others. Thirdly, the related transactions are not obvious in the corporations with general managers from controlling shareholders. Fourthly, the related transactions are negative correlated with the protection of investors. Lastly, there is a positive correlation between the protection of investors and the managing efficiency.

articleTitle: Time series forecasting by hybrid artificial intelligence architecture and its application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed a hybrid model to improve the single SVR model. The hybrid model that is composed of neural network and support vector machine (SVR) has a two-stage neural network architecture. In the first stage, self-organizing feature map (SOM) can be used as a clustering algorithm to partition the whole input space into several disjointed regions. In the second stage, based on the principle of least error, SVR which best fit partitioned regions are constructed by finding the most appropriate kernel function. The application of GDP, CPI and Total Foreign Trade Volume prediction shows that SOM-SVR models achieve significant improvements in the generalization performance compared with the single SVR model. Additionally, the SOM-SVR models also converge faster.

articleTitle: A simulation study on synchronous performance of automatic sending drill of spiral drilling machine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has more studied detialedly on synchronous control of spiral drilling machine driven by double motors. In the article, the systematic control scheme has been put forward and the method of fuzzy control is adopted as well. The control system can make satisfactory performance through simulation research, and can make more than one motor runs well coordinated.

articleTitle: Safety evaluation for inclined cable of existing cable-stayed bridges
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the fact that steel cables for cable-stayed bridges are susceptible to corrosion damage and tend to get stress relaxation after long-term service, it is essential to be considered the time-dependent effects into consideration in structural analysis to ensure safety of the existing bridges. However, most of the recent methods are based on the cable material in perfect state and the effects of time-dependent behavior associated with cable corrosion and stress relaxation are neglected, which makes the application of the current methods difficult in dealing with in-service cable structures. By introducing equivalent strain principle and geometric damage theory, the corrosion mechanism of cable is described. A cable-damage model for safety evaluation in long-span cable-stayed bridges is presented. With the approach, cable corrosion as well as stress relaxation effect has been taken into account in the structural analysis, which leads to good precision and validate a new approach to evaluate the safety of cables in existing cable-stayed bridges, and it also could be applied in structural health monitoring of long-span cable-stayed bridges.

articleTitle: Spatial information integration based on REST style
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increasing application of spatial information system, spatial information integration and sharing are in great urgency. In this paper, a model and a schema of spatial information integration based on REST style are proposed, the feasibility is verified. It provides the spatial information integration with a completely new solution.

articleTitle: An initial simulation study of PET imaging by GATE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The approach of simulation plays an essential role in the research of PET/CT imaging technology. In this paper, a simulation study of the GE ST PET/CT acquisition implemented by GATE (Geant4 Application Tomography Emission) software packages was presented. GATE provides abundant of functions to simulate both SPECT/PET imaging procedure and phantom generation. The simulation experiment based on the geometry phantom was designed and implemented. The simulation output of GATE was converted to the data format that the STIR (Software for Tomographic Image Reconstruction) requires to reconstruct image by the OSEM (ordered subsets expectation-maximization) algorithm and the result of image reconstruction could be present in a 3-D space. The initial simulation result shows that GATE and STIR can be used to simulate PET/CT imaging.

articleTitle: Efficient region merging method based on classified merging cost
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During image segmentation, the hierarchy queue in the traditional region merging method has lots of redundant links, and it spends too much time on searching and sorting for keeping links in order. These have seriously affected the merging efficiency. Therefore a new region merging method based on quantified merging cost was proposed. It proposed several constraint conditions to shorten the queue length. Those links which should be put in the queue were quantified according to merging costs so that links with nearly the same cost were put in a same category, and their sorting were unnecessary and skipped. Furthermore, the MAP class in STL was utilized to build a two-dimensional dynamic queue, so that the time consuming will be reduced owing to its advantages in searching and auto-sorting. Comparative experiments showed that his method could not only guaranty the segmentation accuracy, but also obviously improve the merging efficiency.

articleTitle: An novel method of soft tissue haptic rendering based on the spherical harmonic representation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Haptic rendering is the process of computing and generating forces in response to user interactions with virtual objects. Due to the complexity of tissue properties and interactions in human body, soft tissue haptic rendering is a challenging task. This paper presents a novel method for soft tissue haptic rendering based on spherical harmonics(SH) representation. Firstly, it gives a brief survey on the methodologies for soft tissue haptic rendering in the literature. Secondly, efficient SH representation of 3D objects, collision detection, deformation and force response algorithms are introduced. Experiment results demonstrate that the computational cost required in computing the updates and the force feedback is significantly less than that encountered in, due to the fact that in this case merely the surface mesh points are stored, and only the contactable surface is displaced as opposed to displacing both the contact surface and internal points. For a given number of facets, the spherical harmonic force calculation update rate was faster (850–1,200Hz) than the facet representation (400–900Hz).

articleTitle: Spatial and temporal evolution of grey effect of infrastructures on oasis city comprehensive scale of Xinjiang
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed Grey Effect of infrastructures on city comprehensive scale of 22 cities in Xinjiang by Comprehensive Grey Relation Degree (CGCD) method with city date in 1978–2007. The results showed: (1) Grey Effect Degree(GED) of infrastructure on city scale are middling effect and strong effect types. (2) The cities which economic scales are impacted most by infrastructure are of 45.5% of total cities. (3) GED increase mainly in 1978–2007.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of production water prediction system about coalbed methane (CBM) vertical well
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The accurate prediction of Coalbed methane vertical well production water is an important guarantee for reasonable work and CBM high-production during the drainage gas recovery. Based on different logging response in different coal reservoir, using logging curve, original permeability of the coal reservoir is predicted. According to the rock mechanics and hydraulic fracturing, the permeability prediction model is built. The production water prediction can be done using the history matching in the area with drainage gas recovery data, while in the area without the data; the production water prediction model can be gained by the characteristics of pressure transmission. In the paper, the CBM vertical well production water prediction system is designed and implemented based on the C#. The system is of applied good prospect be used in the Panzhuang block of Qinshui basin.

articleTitle: Infrared gas detection technology based on quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Owing to the need for the environment detection of the industrial control, the gas sensor system based on the principle of infrared absorption spectrum has attracted more and more attentions. It has been proved that the quantum cascade laser (QCL) which is a new-style laser based on the transition among subbands, has the different irradiancy theory compared with the traditional diode laser. In theory, the laser radiation wavelength of the QCL is well adjustable, so it is very promising in the application. This paper focuses on introducing the infrared gas detection technology, development, working principle and the applications of gas detection system based on the quantum cascade laser.

articleTitle: The construction of servers monitoring platform based on Web Services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many web services which are called by users as data or function interface in the digital platforms of campus. It is an urgent problem to be solved that monitoring the management and performances of those web services. This paper constructs a managing and monitored platform for servers based on the B/S architecture by using the technology of Web Services and Flex. The business logic of this system is promoted by the technology of Web Services combined with JavaEE architecture, which also provide data interface for the system. While the web page presentation of the system is supported by Flex technology. According to the test of the system, the utilization rate of CPU and memory and other information of Windows, Solaris and Linux OS can be obtained and monitored real timely by the system for these valid hosts. Besides, the system can make classification and presentation, and do the operations that contain adding, deleting, altering and searching to the web services.

articleTitle: Solving the general elliptic equations with the incremental unknowns methods on floated grid
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through numerical solutions of two-dimensional secondorder Dirichlet boundary-value, The discretization of the article is more simply than the classical grid. the incremental unknowns is linear stationary of linear problem in this paper and [1], as well as the matricial framework of article is more simply than [2].

articleTitle: Research of subjective trust comprehensive evaluation model based on multi-element connection number
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Trust management model is fundamental for information security in the open network environment. Subjective trust has fuzziness and uncertainty dual characteristics. The multi-element connection number is introduced into subjective trust management, and then a new representation method for subjective trust based on multielement connection number was proposed. This method takes into account uncertainty and fuzziness of subjective trust, overcomes a shortcoming that is expressing strictly the fuzziness concept using a precise, unique membership function in fuzzy math, and provides a new valuable way for studying subjective trust evaluation.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of natural gas compressor based on EEMD and Hilbert marginal spectrum
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper utilizes ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) and Hilbert marginal spectrum for the fault diagnosis of the reciprocating compressor on the offshore platform of WZ12-1, aiming at the non-stationary and nonlinear characteristics of vibration signals collected from the faulty compressor. First, the EEMD algorithm self-adaptively anti-aliasing decomposes the vibration signal into a set of intrinsic mode function of different frequency bands. Then, the Hilbert marginal spectrum with some advantages in frequency resolution is used to extract the fault feature. Next, the proposed method succeeds in diagnosing the fault of the reciprocating compressor. The results show that the proposed method is feasible.

articleTitle: Post-processing method of unknown word segmentation based on statistic of word frequency
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Unknown words recognition is a difficult problem. Taking advantage of segmented corpus, closed and open corpus (network resources) with word frequency statistics is a good method for unknown words recognition after general segmentation. The purpose for this method is segmenting character fragment after general segmentation and recognizing the unknown words which were not recognized in general. Here combining the maximum matching method and statistical method to calculate the frequency of strings for recognizing unknown words. Matching character fragments in three kind of corpus after general segmentation and that helps to recognize more unknown words. Experiments showed that recall increases by 12.14%, precision increases by 6.67% in the improved method. The results show that this method plays a good effect for unknown words segmentation.

articleTitle: A text clustering algorithm based on category resolve power
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an unsupervised machine learning technology, document clustering has been widely used in many fields, such as Information Retrieval (IR) and Text Categorization (TC). But, because of the bag of words used in document clustering as document index, the feature space of corpus must be high dimension space. This problem makes a negative effect to the efficiency and precision of text clustering. Based on category resolve power, a new feature selection function is constructed. Through integration between this function and document clustering algorithm, a high-powered text clustering algorithm is presented. Experiments on a universal corpus show that it has a good performance.

articleTitle: The research on the fitting vegetation index of vegetation degeneration measurement in arid region
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The ground is intensively heterogeneous and fragmentized, and the vegetation is very sparse in arid region, so the selection of the vegetation index of vegetation degeneration measurement is the research hotspot on vegetation remote sensing. In this study, the project area of controlling the sources of dust storms affecting Beijing and Tianjin was selected as the research object. The vegetation indexes of vegetation degeneration measurement fitting the research area were studied from the tow aspects on reducing the impact of soil background and the ability of detecting low coverage vegetation. The results have shown that GEMI had a maximum effect to reduce the soil impact, and NDVI had the strongest ability to detect low coverage vegetation. This research deems that NDVI is the best selection to measure vegetation degeneration in arid region, and GEMI is the following selection.

articleTitle: A new two-stage particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As inertia weight is an important parameter to balance global research and local research, a two-stage particle swarm optimization algorithm was proposed. In the first stage, the algorithm used dynamic and self-adapting inertia weight based on different dimensions and different particle to accelerate the convergent speed; in the second stage, it used linear inertia weight and chaotic mutation to prevent local optimum. At last, experimental results for seven typical test show that this algorithm(2-SPSO) is better than PSO and LDIWPSO in speed, precision of convergence and capacity of global optimization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of consumption characteristics and choices of marketing strategy about China's elderly market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Satisfiability-based checking for user interface model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The design of user interface is closely related with system quality and usability. Many researches have been done on user interface testing method, test case generation and user interface model syntax checking, but less have been done on state attribute checking of user interface model. Because model state space is large and dynamic, this kind of checking of user interface is difficult. This article introduces the user interface model, presents encoding transform from user interface model to proposition formula. Then we encode the proposition formula and the checked attribute, translate into satisfiability instance, and input the instance into satisfiability tools for solve. The problem of state attribute checking of user interface model becomes the satisfiability of the proposition formula. We illustrate an example to demonstrate the validity of our checking method for user interface model.

articleTitle: Water use efficiency evaluation of rainfed maize under future climate scenarios in Loess Plateau
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Climate change impacts on food production have become an interesting topic to most agricultural researchers. This paper mainly discusses the rainfed maize water use indices in the subareas of Loess Plateau under the A2 and B2 future climate scenarios with SWAGMAN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> Destiny model. The result shows that evapotranspiration will increase in future under both scenarios while the water use indices will decrease for rainfed maize production in the whole Loess Plateau. Although the study indices mentioned in this paper have the same tendency under both scenarios, the variability under the A2 scenario is higher than that under the B2 scenario.

articleTitle: Study on concurrent design facing CPC
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Collaborative Commerce and Concurrent Engineering which have been emerging in recently years, are both two kinds of product developing model and organizing manner of enterprises. They play a important role in manufacturing especially. In the range of global, they are widely popularized either in science or in enterprises and industry. In this article, we attempt to reveal similitude of the both, and then make the observations on the possibility and reality of association of them. Then we try to give a brief evolvement of a new manufacturing model on the basis. That is A4D design system, and then we analyze the complexity of this system.

articleTitle: Performance Prediction of SERS in the supermarket building
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A computer program based on existing one dimensional ejector theory has been developed to carry out a study on performance of the system. The performance of solar ejector refrigerant system(SERS) offer air conditioning for supermarket building are predicted under a climatic conditions of zhengzhou region, the results show that the η<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf>, COP and μ of the system change in time sequence, and the average COP about the specific days from May to September can arrive to 0.14, 0.15, 0.27, 0.20 and 0.32, and the average η<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf> are 0.58, 0.57, 0.53, 0.49 and 0.53, and the average μ are 0.16, 0.17, 0.30, 0.23 and 0.36, respectively. In addition, the results also show that solar ejector refrigerant can provide 41 percent cooling load that the supermarket building needed with 20000m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> when the evacuated tube solar collector is 8400m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in zhengzhou specific days from May to September during the hours(8:00∼18:00).

articleTitle: The design and implementation of the method of entity modeling in coalmine 3D visualization system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development and maturation of the mining information technology, computer networks and communication technology, digital mine has become a new trend. In this article, the author makes research on the key technology and algorithm of entity modeling in three-dimensional visualization system of the coalmine, particularly in relation to the modeling algorithm of the laneway and the mine industry square. On this basis, establish the database in which we put the basic data of the model of laneway cross-section. By modeling, the physical situation of the mine is displayed more clearly, and this can facilitate people to understand the situation of the underground coalmine more clearly and comprehensibly.

articleTitle: Reach on government management functions in global carbon emissions control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In response to global climate change, protect the global environment security is a common challenge for governments. Carbon dioxide, methane and other greenhouse gases gathered in the atmosphere. They are from the transportation, industrial and agricultural hindered heat release. Temperature increase, bringing droughts, floods, rising sea levels and other potential damage. Therefore, this paper discusses the government management function in the dimension of global carbon emissions control functions and effects.

articleTitle: The analysis of the laddering water price in urban household water based on the ELES model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Regarding to the urban household water—running water as a kind of special commodity, through the improvement of “Extended Linear Expenditure System” model, which deduces the logical relationship between per capita consumption water, laddering water price and per capita income disposable. With the income distribution function of linear stagnation rate adding, and case analysis of Hangzhou in 2008, it can simulate the three-stepped ladder pricing model of household water, and compared with the existing pricing model, it can dramatically save 14.3 ton per capita consumption water.

articleTitle: Extremal optimization for the 3D protein folding based on the lattice model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Much of the previous work in the protein field focused on the 2D protein folding due to its simplicity but ignored the 3D protein folding problem. In this paper, based on the work of 2D protein folding problem by primary extremal optimization (EO) algorithm, we study the more complicated 3D protein folding problem with its variation (τ-EO) for the first time. The parameter τ is set as a random value near a constant in each iteration. For the protein with not too long sequence, the experimental results show that the proposed EO algorithm is very efficient.

articleTitle: DEM construction based on meshfree method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Meshfree method is a new numeric method which is evolved from Finite Element Method (FEM). It obtains remarkable achievements in computational mechanics fields. It can solve special problems which can't be solved by FEM. Grid is not needed when scattering research area. This is the most significant characteristic of meshfree method compared with FEM. In this paper DEM is constructed by Reproducing Kernel Partical Method based on the discrete points in YunNan area and Gauss Synthetic Surface. And the quality of constructed DEM is analyzed based on RMSE. The result shows that the accuracy of DEM constructed by meshfree method is acceptable, and it is mesh free.

articleTitle: Research and application of methods of developing industry- domain system based on software reuse
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software reuse can improve the efficiency of development and reduce the costs of maintenance. It's particularly effective in the domain of specific industry. This paper studies the methods and procedures of software reuse used in the development of the domain specific of industry. In accordance with the development process, requirements analysis, system design, system implementation, use respectively the domain analysis, chromatographic analysis and architecture design, component technology, establish the demand model of the industry domain, the architecture model of the industry system and develop the system with components with an example of project cost industry. This paper verifies the method of software reuse development, proved that the demand model of the industry domain, the architecture model of the industry system and components have high reusability and scalability in the same industry, meanwhile the method greatly improves the efficiency of software development in industry domain.

articleTitle: Beam alignment in Laser Interference Nanolithography
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Laser Interference Nanolithography (LInL) can produce nanostructure patterns by two or more coherent laser beams on the sample surface. In LInL, incident positions, incident angles and space angles of beams determine the lithography pattern and exposure area. In this work, a method for beam alignment in LInL was described. The method is based on the detection of the light spot which is formed by the incident beam on the sample surface, obtaining the parameters of the light spot by image processing including the incident position, incident angle and space angle of the beam. Proper system alignment can eliminate errors of beam incidence to ensure that the final lithography pattern and the exposure area can comply with the design. Computer simulation and experimental results have shown the accuracy, repeatability and limitation of the method, and it can be used in laser interference nanolithography.

articleTitle: A way of Fuzzy Cerebellar Mode Articulation PID controller design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive robust Fuzzy Cerebellar Model Articulation Proportional-Integral-Derivative controller for nonlinear complicated system is presented. Embedding robust control assures the stability of system, the compensated controller eliminates the noise of environment and the uncertain. Because of the chattering control signal, the optimization and redesign adaptive laws are presented. All of them are based on Lyapunov function such that the stability and error convergence are assured. Finally, an illustrated example of Electronical Driver system is utilized to show the performance of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of three-dimensional scene display system based on GIS components and plug-ins
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Component and plug-in technologies took GIS into a new development stage. Using GIS components and plug-ins, many GIS functions can be rapidly integrated into various GIS application systems, which greatly reduces the complexity of secondary development of GIS. VRmap, a three-dimensional geographic information system software, provides a powerful three-dimensional GIS components and plug-ins, This paper first introduces the VRMap's components and plug-ins, then, with Visual Basic as a development platform, carry out the design and development of three-dimensional scene display system based on VRMap's components and plug-ins, and many functions have been achieved, such as three-dimensional scene view, edit, particle creation, three-dimensional analysis, flight control, animation making, et al.

articleTitle: Perceived risk in E-commerce transaction conceptualisations and applications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper reviews the literature on consumer-perceived risk under E-commerce context over the past 15 years. It begins by describing new risk of new shopping mode—E-commerce, and the specific definition of consumer perceived risk. Then, it summarizes the risk-reduction strategies in the new mode of shopping, and the main application of E-commerce perceived risk. In the end of the paper, the reviewer suggests that researchers in this area may further modify the classic perceived risk mode from three aspects: sampling, modeling and measuring.

articleTitle: Validating SERVQUAL in information system empirical results from an e-learning system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: User's experiences are affected by service quality of information systems. Hence, measurement on information system service quality is urgently needed for the related quantitative research. An empirical study is proceeded to validate an IS-adapted SERVQUAL model in the context of e-learning system use. The data from a survey on e-learning system users are employed to validate the model with confirmatory factor analysis. Results show that the IS-adapted SERVQUAL model bears good fitness and effectiveness, and it can be used in future research relating to service quality.

articleTitle: Quantifying transpiration in a coniferous forest: Assessment of the summed components methods, sap-flow, and stable isotope techniques
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vegetable transpiration is one of the most important processes in the soil-plant-atmosphere-continuum (SPAC) water cycle. The objectives of this study were to (1) evaluate the efficiency of the different research methods, (2) investigate and quantify evapotranspiration and its components in an alpine watershed from April to October 2009. We investigated evapotranspiration and its components in the Gongga Mountains, which are located on the southeastern fringe of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, using summed components methods, sap-flow, and stable isotope techniques. The annual evapotranspiration calculated by summed components methods was 747 mm accounted for 50% of the total water input. In which, soil evaporation was account for 6% of the total evapotranspiration. The vegetation transpiration calculated by sap-flow techniques accounted for 19% of total evapotranspiration. The intercepted rainfall evaporation accounted for 75% of total evapotranspiration.

articleTitle: Study on evolution of Third-party logistics and industry cluster based on symbiotic perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analysis of the symbiosis relationship between Third-party logistics and industry cluster, the paper obtained six major symbiosis patterns; and symbiosis patterns between third-party logistics and industry cluster evolutes in different lifecycle of cluster using lifecycle of cluster theory, which provide a theoretical basis for the synergetic evolution. Finally, taking ShaoXing textile industry cluster as study case, symbiosis relationship is specifically discussed.

articleTitle: WSXP:A universal data exchange platform based on Web Services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data exchange is the kernel of distributed computing, and data sharing and exchange is one of the crucial problems in data systems over the wide area network. This paper proposes a new data exchange protocol based on Web Services, which defines service primitives and operation rules so as to provide a reliable transmission between both structured and unstructured data. Besides, it can resume transmission after break point. A universal data exchange platform based on Web Services is designed and implemented with respect to the proposed data exchange protocol, the transmission and adaptor mechanisms of which are also discussed. Furthermore, this paper proposes a new method using sliding windows for transmitting SOAP messages to improve the transmitting efficiency during data exchange, which would speed up SOAP message transmitting. Simulation results show that transmission efficiency and data exchange reliability are effectively improved.

articleTitle: Building mechanics laboratory booking system to promote development of laboratory management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: University laboratory is an important part of teaching, while the management becomes more complicated after the opening of laboratory. So it's urgent to adopt the computer-aided management. Directed to the specific circumstances of Henan Polytechnic University's mechanics experiments, the paper indicates that an object- oriented and multi-tier architecture mechanics laboratory booking system can solve inefficient problems posed by artificial management, and provide new idea for booking system, making laboratory management more scientific.

articleTitle: Study of Ant Colony Algorithm based on adaptive signal processing
