publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper researches Ant Colony Algorithm (ACA) for anti-jam based on adaptive signal processing. The traditional adaptive processing algorithms usually obtain the partial optimum solution, but paper proposes ant colony algorithm (ACA) can find the desired solution which is a global search method. According to the theory of adaptive signal processing and minimal mean square error (MMSE) criterion, we find the objective function of ACA and found its mathematical model. We define the space of weight vector and deduce the step of ACA in detail in order to compute multidimensional weight vector of element of array antenna. The simulation results show ACA is adapt to adaptive anti-jam technology and can effectively suppress the multi-jam. By comparing with other algorithms, ACA shows the better performance of suppressing interference and protecting desired signal.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the spatial evolution of rural landscape in urban fringe areas—A case in Zengcheng
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Establishment and application of digital forest resource management system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the requirements of the forestry construction and development, this paper discusses the inputting method of forest resources graphical data and the attributive data and the establishing of the process of forest resources management system in Anshan by using GIS software Arc View, database software Foxpro and the image software Photoshop, which computerizes the forest resources data management in this region. Through this analysis, it provides a good basis for improving the work efficiency in forest industry, making the correct decision and realizing the information management.

articleTitle: Scientific value Strategy of the Experts Database
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes that the value of Experts Database in scientific research work, including the role of advancing, the role of check, and the role of talents nurturing in ensuring the project quality, and promoting the competence of the project. Also, this article discusses the important value of Experts Database in Macro Strategy decision-making of our country.

articleTitle: Study on influence factors of technological innovation capability for Chinese private enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The private enterprises had already become the important component of national economy in China. It put in invisible chains for upgrading quality of private enterprises because of excessively relying on low cost to win the market, which would bring extremely unfavorable negative effect for a new round of international division position. We found that the main influence factors of the technological innovation capability were product innovation ability, process innovation ability, technician resource, financing environment, and innovation policy through empirical research on private enterprises in China, and their differences also been examined. Appropriate innovation mode and public policy should be made to foster the technological innovation ability of China's private enterprise.

articleTitle: A Method Approach to the Extraction of the signal arrival from sonic logging signal on energy operator
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In accordance with the waveform characteristics of sonic waves which have different experience of propagation paths, a method based on energy operator for detecting the sonic logging signal arrival was proposed. This method can well achieve the extraction of each wave's arrival. While, for the actual logging signal, it is required to pass through an ideal low-pass filter. Fourier inverse transform is used to obtain the signal envelope and the local maximum's method is applied to find the trough positions of this signal, which are the arrivals of each wave. By using the method, we can precisely implement the extraction of signal arrival for the real drilling acoustic signal.

articleTitle: Supply chain contracts with endogenous information structure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we analyze supply chain contracts with endogenous information structure. Especially, we consider a supplier and a buyer during a single selling season. The supplier offers two wholesale-price contracts. one is no information gathering for the buyer, the other is that the buyer is induced to gather information with cost beta. We analyze the impact of information gathering on wholesale price and order quantity, and compare the profit of supplier and buyer in two different cases. Finally, numerical example is presented, seeking to compare results between the different contracts considered.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of land use change in Nianchu river basin supported by RS&GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through the methods of change rate, dynamic degree index and transfer matrix, land use changes were analyzed, based on the land use data in 1980s and 2000. The major results could be summarized as follows: (1)A large amount of grassland, water body and barren land were transferred to forest land in 1980s–2000 in this region, because of the ecological protection and forestation. (2)Land use changes were greater in the neighborhood of the main stream of Nianchu River than in other areas, from the spatial differences of the changes. (3)The two major reasons contributing to the land use changes in this region, ecological rehabilitation and urbanization, were the important driving factors of land use change.

articleTitle: Disruption management for complicated operation systems: A model study on CTC in 2006
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The disruption management of China Telecom Corporation (CTC) in 2006 is firstly reinvestigated. Interestingly, similar practices are found in other complicated operation systems, such as communication system, refinery and semiconductor fab when their critical capacities are injured by earthquake, fire, intentional attack et al. In this paper, a mathematical model is presented to describe the actions after disruption: injured capacity could be restored in a multiple period and shortage capacity could be acquired (or supported) from capacity-sharing partners in regular and expedite support modes. And the risk attitude of decision maker is considered as another important factor in this model. The model is proved to be convex in a loss function which means a minimum loss could be promised. Finally, a genetic algorithm is used to sensitive analysis towards some key parameters, and 3 interesting managerial insights are obtained.

articleTitle: Target selection and development in 3D laser scanning based on sampling interval
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In 3D laser scanning technology, it is very important for targets to the point cloud registration. Because of the difference of noise, target types and target materials, the difficult extent is different to extract target centre, even the target centre could not be extracted, which affects eventually point cloud registration and its accuracy. This requires scanning job must select rightly targets and arrange the target legitimately in scanning. The paper set different sampling intervals, scanned standard target, self-made material targets and extracted target centre coordinates. Taking the total station surveying data as true value, the paper compared scanning center and fitting center of the total station surveying data, and got the best in application with a sampling interval, which provides a reference for scan working or project practice.

articleTitle: Design of distributed data acquisition system based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To achieve of the goal of lower cost and higher efficiency of the civil aircraft maintenance, a distributed data acquisition system integrated with embedded and CAN-bus technology was designed based on virtual instrument. In this system, the obtained parameters can be concentrated on processing and managing by CAN-bus. And the sensor's capability of self-marking and self-correction is achieved by TEDS (Transducer Electronic Data Sheets) defined in IEEE1451.2 standard. The general design scheme of the distributed data acquisition system was presented in the paper, and hardware architecture of data acquisition terminal and the design of system's software were described. System PC software platform was structured by LabVIEW language. According to the aircraft maintenance manuals, the system was designed to meet the airworthiness requirements, so as to improve the security of aircraft operations.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithms for parallel machine scheduling with setup times
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of scheduling a set of jobs on parallel machines considering sequence-dependent setup times. The processing sequence of jobs assigned to each machine is determined to minimize the makespan. Since it is a NP-hard problem, even for instances with small sizes, the computational effort may be prohibitively large. Then genetic algorithms with two types of assignment scheme are presented to obtain near optimal solutions. The popular scheme of random assignment is used in the genetic algorithm (GA-1). Unlike GA-1, the scheme of greedy assignment is employed in the genetic algorithm (GA-2). The computational experiments are carried out to compare the performance of GA-1 with that of GA-2. Computational results show that GA-2 has better performance than GA-1.

articleTitle: A structure first image inpainting approach based on self-organizing map (SOM)
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a structure first image inpainting method based on self-organizing map (SOM). SOM is employed to find the useful structure information of the damaged image. The useful structure information which includes relevant edges of the image is used to simulate the structure information of the lost or damaged area in the image. The structure information is described by distinct or indistinct curves in an image in this paper. The obtained target curves separate the damaged area of the image into several parts. As soon as each part of the damaged image is restored respectively, the damaged image is inpainted. The efficiency of the proposed method is demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Modeling methods for tidal flat digital terrain based on neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to model tidal flat digital terrain. The study tidal flats are in the yellow sea radial sand ridges eastern China. Based on the regularity and variability characteristics of changeable tidal flats, combined with remote sensing and remote surveying technology and information, this research focuses on tidal flat digital terrain modeling by neural network. The model structure is 2 hidden layers, 11 neurons in every layer. The terrain calculated is very close to the terrain actual surveyed. RMSE is 0.1564 m. R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is 095817. Residual distribution is normal. The study value is creative to get dynamic tidal flat terrain information fast and efficiently.

Author Keywords: the yellow sea radial sand ridges

articleTitle: Social capital roles in inter-organizational networking
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Social capital refers primarily to resources, knowledge, and capability accessed in a social network, and resources mobilized through ties in the network. How does social capital influence the knowledge flows and innovations in inter-organizational networks in developing countries? This article will answer this question based on the data of software companies in Zhangjiang Software Cluster, Shanghai, China. This article finds that social capital plays a vital role in facilitating knowledge flow between firms and consequently innovation.

articleTitle: Requirement analysis and structural design on an agricultural product quality fast traceability system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In a sense, the agricultural product quality traceability system is regarded as one of the most important aspects in the construction of agricultural product quality supervision. By defining and delineating the relevant concepts, this paper aims to encourage some new approaches to accomplishing the connection of isolated enterprise information islands and the abstraction of agricultural product unit flow process at a higher level, and through exclusive coding, data collecting and data converging to establish a mode of agricultural product quality fast traceability system in China. At the same time, the requirement analysis on a fast traceability system leads to the study on the system structural design of the mode.

articleTitle: A dynamic iteration algorithm of classic Newsboy Problem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new iterative method for the classic Newsboy Problem based on the dynamic programming principle. The optimal inventory of the classic Newsboy Problem then can be derived. It has been found that this method has fewer steps than those of others, with which the optimal inventory can be obtained more conveniently. This method applies to various distributions and provides a new way to apply and extend the Newsboy Problem.

articleTitle: Economic integration based on FDI agglomeration: An empirical analysis of the Yangtze-delta
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The agglomeration of foreign direct investment (FDI) has made a great influence on the economic integration of regions in China like the Yangtze-delta. This paper identifies two kinds of index factors that reveal the trend of GDP and FDI in the Yangtze-delta, and the method of time-series analysis and cross section analysis are used. The conclusion reveals that economic integration is in close relation to the agglomeration of FDI, with an investment creation function in FDI polarization and investment diverse function in FDI proliferation. These two processes may also promote the economic integration in undeveloped regions.

articleTitle: Does open source software decrease profit of proprietary software producer and increase social welfare
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By extending Cournot model, this paper explores the impact of open source software (OSS) to the price, output and profit of proprietary software (PS) and social welfare in a software market. In this paper, we assume that proprietary software producer aims at maximizing profit, the open source software is freely available and the market exhibits network externality. We find that the appearance of open source software in a software market monopolized by the proprietary software doesn't necessarily lower the price of proprietary software, decrease the output and profit of proprietary software producer and increase the level of social welfare, what happens in reality depends on the learning (maintenance or development) cost of open source software.

articleTitle: Discussion on role of credibility failure punishment cost in game between the government and the public—Model analysis based on Prisoner Dilemma
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on classical case of game theory—Prisoner Dilemma, this article discussed the game result between government and the public with and without credibility failure punishment cost respectively. The research showed that, credibility failure punishment cost offered us a possibility to resolve the problem of prisoner dilemma, or once the credibility failure punishment cost reaches certain level; both sides of the game would tend to choose cooperation. Meanwhile, the author made explorations on perspectives of morality, regulation and law accordingly.

articleTitle: Synchrony evolution of multiple network and technological innovation of Chinese industrial cluster
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Technological innovation of industrial cluster is a focus in resent innovation research, which also has essential practical meanings to Chinese industrial transformation and upgrading. Based on existing research, this study analyses the relationship between network evolution and mode of industrial cluster technological innovation, applying multiple network theory. The following conclusions have been researched from this study. First, manufacturing network facilitates process innovation of industrial cluster, while R&D network facilitates product innovation. Second, evolution path of technological innovation network is manufacturing network upgrading to R&D network development or R&D network upgrading to manufacturing network development. This study deepens the understanding of industrial cluster innovation process and has some practical implications for industrial cluster development.

articleTitle: A MT-NT-MILP combined method for gross error detection and data reconciliation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data reconciliation is an effective technique for providing accurate and consistent value for chemical process. However, the presence of gross errors can severely bias the reconciled results. In this paper, a MT-NT-MILP (MNM)combined method is developed for gross error detection and data reconciliation for industrial application. An improved MT-NT method is proposed in order to generate gross error candidates before data rectification. Candidates are used in the MILP objective function to improve the efficiency by reducing the number of binary variables. Simulation results show that the method is effective especially in a large-scale problem.

articleTitle: Research on in power smart sensor base on LSM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the methods of error minimum mean voltage in the power smart sensor component of the application. Proposed and analyzed and compared to obtain the power smart sensor is difficult to predict important parameters of voltage RMS power, the initial phase angle of the several methods are methods that minimize the error on the circuit performance due to reduced demand. And can effectively simplify the system and reduce costs. Simulation results show that the use of new methods for voltage RMS in the time available to reduce the sampling frequency, the amplitude of the signal in the initial phase angle disturbance requirement from less than 5% of the signal amplitude can be relaxed to 15% of the signal amplitude.

articleTitle: Inventory management and performance in wholesale industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Inventory, as an important asset in wholesale industry, has two different effects on the performance. As the cost, inventory will decrease the performance; as the goods variety and service level, it will increase the performance instead. By now, the relationship between the inventory and performance still remains unclear. This article just aims to fill this gap and make an empirical research with the time series data of China and US. By dividing the wholesale industry into four different semi-industries, this article tests the relationship between inventory and performance in different industries, and makes a comparison between China and US. Finally, based on the experience of US, the article gives some suggestions to the Chinese wholesalers.

articleTitle: Statistical multiple regression analysis' application in the cure on diabetes mellitus
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, data are analyzed with the help of SPSS, correlation analysis and multiple regression analysis et al., which are based on the data from the patients in hospital. The correlation relationship between the preliminary insulin dosage about diabetes mellitus patients and sex, age, height, weight, dietetic quantity, motion quantity, blood sugar, urine sugar, urine protein, serum creatinine, infection et al. are studied, and the relation formulate between Insulin dosage and its key influence factors: blood sugar and urine protein are derived, which may give some guide to clinical medical treatment.

articleTitle: A study on quantum key expansion method based on Chaos
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to quantum key distribution of discrete variables, especially in the free space, it is difficult for single photon to be generated and detected, and high information transmission rate is no easy to get. This paper puts forward a kind of key expansion method based on chaos, initial key that is generated by information coordination is divided into blocks, and using Chaos system sensitivity for initial value can get new initial key with excellent performance. Experiments have proved that this method can effectively lengthen key and improve information transmission rate, at the same time, the new initial key has good randomness. Thus it can effectively reduce eavesdropper's useful information from the initial key, and improve security of information transmission.

articleTitle: A novel AODV routing algorithm based on local route maintenance in Tactical MANETs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aim at improving the performance and efficiency of AODV protocol in Tactical MANETs which has large scale and fast changing topology, a novel AODV algorithm - LRM-AODV based on local route maintenance is proposed. According to the feature that there always exist many idle nodes, LRM-AODV adopts reverse route search procedure for idle nodes to produce many local routes and increase the route redundancy in the network, this speed up the route discovery and make the fast route repair possible. The simulation results indicate that the performance of LRM-AODV is superior to AODV in packet delivery ratio, end-to-end packet delay and routing overhead.

articleTitle: The influential factors of knowledge transfer in supplier network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the circumstance of economic globalization, interfirm network has been utilized as a channel to transfer knowledge by increasing number of enterprises. While what kind of network is needed to achieve effective knowledge transfer? This paper analyzed the influential factor about transfer knowledge in terms of supplier network from the structure and tie perspective. According to the empirical study of questionnaire, the paper draw the conclusions that the tie quality and network centrality are positive correlated with knowledge transfer in the suppliers' network, but tie intensity and knowledge transfer are not significantly correlated. These conclusions have significant effect on the construction of effective supplier network.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a real-time L2C IF signal simulator
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Commercial GNSS RF signal simulators are expensive and few of them provide modernized GPS L2C signal simulation capability so far. Based on the SDR architecture of a GNSS RF signal simulator developed by Beihang University, China, this paper focuses on the design and implementation of the L2C IF signal generator. The calculation and updating of waveform control parameters, the modulation of baseband signals, the combination of multiple satellite channel signals, and the generation of analog IF signal are implemented using DSP + FPGA + DAC. A method of fast alignment of the initial phase of L2C CL code is proposed, and the power control of the combined signal is also explored. The accuracy and quality of the simulated signals are validated by the acquisition, tracking and positioning results using a software receiver. The L2C signal simulator can serve as a signal source for the development of high-performance receivers.

articleTitle: RFID technology in the costume sales application system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is an increasingly widespread and applied technology of automatic identification. Its advantage is non-contact data reading, and it can easily realize automatic data acquisition (identification). In current business of costume industry, identification of costume has features such as large amount of information, multifarious contents and so on; meanwhile manual method of data-inputting has a lot of shortcomings such as slow speed, low efficiency, high error rate, and poor interaction with customers. In order to meet the demand of large scale production and precise sales in modern enterprise, this thesis proposes the Costume Business System based on RFID. The system stores basic information in the RFID tag, so as to realize the information management and exhibition in WEB environment. This thesis analyzes the research background and significance of Costume Business System based on RFID, and then introduces RFID Middleware's concept, characteristics and the process of its secondary development. In the view of actual development process in software engineering through the analysis of business in costume industry, this thesis completes the division of system function module, system architecture and the design of application process.

articleTitle: Bandwidth estimation methods in broadband multimedia satellite communication system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of broadband multimedia satellite communication, people focuse more and more on how to make better use of the bandwidth and guarantee the Qos. The bandwidth request methods of different businesses are not the same: When confronted with the real-time demanded multimedia services, the adopt of the peak distribution may waste the bandwidth, thus it's necessary to find more efficient methods; and how to further reduce the transmission delay for the non-real-time business in case of the reliable transmission also need our continuous study. This paper discusses different request and distribution methods in the broadband satellite communication systems: FODA, FEEDERS and DRIFS, and briefly analyzes and compares their performance.

articleTitle: The research on the rights and right structures in the corporation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on five rights theories of justice, promising, qualifications, free and interest, we have come to the conclusion that the doctrine of natural human rights was based on the pursue on ideal, while doctrine of artificial human rights was based on the pursue on reality to reach an empirical conclusion, the ideal is to pursue, but it cannot be divorced from reality. The final expression of the rights is interest. By the interpretation of evolvement histories of right structure in corporation, we believe that business rights are more of a group, management system and rights of investor and management, but not other personal right in law and other stakeholders rights of employees, customers, the government and suppliers. With the trend of business boundless, that the suppliers, customers, and even the government to become a member of the rights sharing so that interest right for stockholders, feedback rights for customers and charities rights for society, will appear in the right structures.

articleTitle: The optimal path of logistics distribution in electronic commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Efficient and fast logistics distribution system is of paramount significance for enterprises, especially for the development of e-commerce. At present, the problem that e-commerce puzzles businessmen is logistics distribution. Based on Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm, an intelligent optimal path algorithm is presented with the aid of the thoughts of state space searching and dynamic cut branch in artificial intelligence. The intelligent algorithm can optimize searching path, reduce searching scope, raise searching speed, and can be applied to solve the shortest paths in multi-graphs. Furthermore, GIS is introduced into e-commerce logistics distribution, and electronic map is displayed through the integration of MapInfo and Visual Basic. The experiment results show that the optimal path algorithm is applicable to improve the efficiency in spatial analysis of the net system.

articleTitle: Humanistic education in higher vocational colleges of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to train all-round development of high-quality skillful talents, and solve the general problem that higher vocational colleges in china over-emphasis on skills training and despise the status of vocational humanistic education, A Survey research method was adopted to study the manifestations of over-emphasis on skills training and despise the status of vocational humanistic education. Results shows that vocational humanistic education in higher vocational colleges has following problems: lack of systematic planning, vague and marginalization of vocational humanistic education, lack of humanity heritage in higher vocational colleges, weak in teaching ability of vocational humanistic education, lack of evaluation mechanisms for vocational humanistic education. In order to realize the ultimate goal of education and the true meaning of education, based on the results, we recommend that higher vocational colleges should establish the educational concept of “the all-round development of human being”, take positive and effective measures to make technical education and vocational humanistic education in close connection. Higher vocational colleges should also change the concept, emphasize professional penetration, focus on education by environment, enhance the teaching ability and improve the evaluation mechanism.

articleTitle: A modified amino acid network modle
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on a self-consistent contact energy, an amino acid network model is proposed to improve the shortcoming of the model constructed early. The model used in this paper contains two types of weight - similar weight and dissimilar weight. The definition methods of the distance between nodes are compared and the small world character of the amino acid network is investigated. Finally, the network parameter - average shortest path length is used to reflect the conformation change on an unfolding pathway.

articleTitle: Asymptotic behavior of global solutions for a class of wave equation with nonlinear damping and source terms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we study the initial-boundary value problem for a class of nonlinear degenerate wave equations with nonlinear damping and source terms. We prove the asymptotic stability of global solutions to this problem by using a difference inequality.

articleTitle: Noise image restoration based on mathematical morphology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional restoration approaches for blocky noise images have the disadvantages of making the image be fuzzier, or losing the useful information. According to the particularity of blocky noise, a new restoration approach is proposed based on mathematical morphology including dilation, erosion, open and close operations. Firstly, the suspected noise is determined after the color classification. Secondly, the suspected noise region is eroded and filled by other region. Finally, a dilation operation is applied to the image. Some noise radar images are utilized to test this approach: the experimentation indicates a better restoration result in comparison with the traditional approaches. In addition, discussion is introduced to the running complexity of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Feasibility study on prediction of springiness of goose meat using laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The present work aimed to evaluate the ability of laser-induced fluorescence spectroscopy (LIFS) in predicting the springiness of goose meat. Correlation coefficient of calibration (r) and validation (r), standard error of calibration (RMSEC) and error of prediction (RMSEP) were used to evaluate the quality of the model. The calibration models between original value and LIF spectra were developed using partial least squares (PLS) regression The correlation coefficient (r) of the calibration and prediction sets were 0.8982 and 0.8296, respectively; RMSEC and RMSEP were 0.0238 and 0.0236, respectively. It is confirmed that LIF is feasible to predict the springiness goose meat.

articleTitle: The organization mode of professional service firms' business development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Research and development is becoming increasingly business-oriented, and corporate reliance on new business R&D is greater than ever. How could business R&D activities in PSF (professional service firm) be organized to yield the greatest value for the enterprise? Through the literature study and field research and the in-depth interview with the managers in the engineering consulting firms illustrates how three organizational designs are being used to manage the flexible R&D organizations: (I) decentralized. (2) centralized, and (3) integrated. Decentralized designs limit the role of a central R&D group: they direct R&D resources more toward products and markets rather than basic scientific activities. Networked designs push the boundaries of R&D outside the confines of a central R&D group and the firm as a whole. Integrated models use sophisticated communication linkages to tie centralized, science-based activities with the business needs of the corporation.

articleTitle: A novel method for extracting license plates in complex background
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new method of extracting license plates in complex background from rough search to accurate location based on different features and relative position. The whole process can be divided into three parts: in the first part, cars' front or rear wheel is to be located, which is used to locate the rough position of license plates according to the relative position, in the second part, we will search the stronger density regions in the form of blocks and form final connective components. After that, a accurate search will be handled in final bounding rectangle of connective components, because the final bounding rectangle are relatively small region with a little noise or interference, in which we can use the fastest way to extract license plates candidates. Finally the license plates candidates will be verified by different ways. The experiment shows that this proposed method has less constraint, and have a fast process of extracting, plus a satisfied accuracy.

articleTitle: Countermeasures in expanding the pioneering enterprises around the refocusing strategy on the core competitive power
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When the pioneering enterprises have gone by the growing stage and entered into the grown-up period, the bottleneck to curb their development is the strategy choice and its expansion countermeasures. So, the paper explores the main internal and external issues of the pioneering enterprises in today's global economy and puts forward the points of view of the refocusing strategy on the core competitive power by combining the theoretical study with the authentic proof. The paper thinks that the refocusing strategy on the core competitive power is an optimum choice for the pioneering enterprises to elbow their way through this intensively competitive society and their development countermeasures should be formulated around this strategy. Namely, they are obliged to integrate their limited resources into the core competitive power so as to seek for a survival. Also, the paper designs a framework of the countermeasures on the base of the refocusing strategy on the core competitive power and makes a detailed study of them. Finally, a conclusion is drawn that the key to survive for the pioneering enterprises is to establish the refocusing strategy on the core competitive power first, and then formulate the development measures so as to form and maintain the core competitive power catering for the market.

Author Keywords: refocusing strategy on the core competitive power

articleTitle: Customer Participation—An important dimension in tourism service innovation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Customer Participation has become a relatively mature theory in marketing with its fast development in the recent 30 years. This article brings this theory into the research of service innovation in tourism and holds the view that customer participation has changed into an important dimension in it. The external causes can be found in that it follows the shifting background setting from product economy to service economy, conforms to the competitive customer-centered environment in present-day hospitality industry, embodies the latest international trend in innovation theory and gains the full support of modern information technology. The fact that it represents the essence of all-round customer experience in modern tourism, helps the service providers with the actualization of their economic and social values, satisfies the mental needs of the service consumers accounts for the internal causes. The four basic and evaluative conclusions that the paper draws is that the atmosphere for tourism service innovation with customer participation is well-formed, it is high time to innovate tourism service to make customer participation a mainstream in the industry, and more researches on China's local practice of customer service innovation and cross-disciplinary studies are required. But meanwhile the author points out the limitations of the theory as a new perspective in tourism service innovation and warns the impossibility of it as a therapy to all problems.

articleTitle: Exploration and thinking of information-based learning models of normal university students from the perspective of E-Learning2.0
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Higher requirements are imposed on the overall quality of normal university students against the background of rapidly developing information technology and basic education reform. Considering that the learning model of normal university students must be reformed, from the perspective of E-Learning2.0, this paper explores two learning models respectively based on the interactive whiteboard (IWB) and the network platform and has a discussion about the scope of application of the two learning models with the course Biology Teaching Theory as an example.

articleTitle: A transmitting knowledge of calculus of processes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In MAS (Multi-Agent System), communicating among agents is an important characteristic as it's important in transmitting information among agents, recognizing the status changing, and scheduling and accomplishing cooperation tasks. Different from the research in the field of computer science or others, communicating is to transmit knowledge in MAS. The existed works about transmitting knowledge of communicating were seldom. This paper proposed a transmitting knowledge of calculus of processes based on Robin Milner's CCS and studied its semantic features. This work constructs a fundament for the further developing of MAS formal semantics.

articleTitle: Simulation research of semi-active suspension system of engineering vehicle
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In poor driving conditions, the vibration of engineering vehicle greatly increased driver's labor intensity. Taking engineering vehicle as the study object, dynamic model of semi-active suspension system of engineering vehicle with five degrees of freedom is established according to the reasonable simplification of the actual vehicle. Based on the PID control and adaptive fuzzy PID control, the paper establishes semi-active suspension model of engineering vehicle and compares vibration control and suspension performance among the semi-active suspensions. Through the further simulation research, from the comparative analysis performance indexes of riding comfort, The conclusions are that the control effect of adaptive fuzzy PID control improves by different degrees than the passive suspension and PID control suspension. The results show that adaptive fuzzy PID control suspension can reduce the vehicle vibration commendably.

articleTitle: A research of performance evaluation of human resources of leading agricultural enterprises based on the BAGA-PPC model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper adopts accelerated genetic algorithm and projection pursuit method of combining model and selects 15 General Managers of leading agricultural enterprises as research samples to performance evaluation of human resources. The results achieves that make the analysis of the complex problem through optimal cube projection direction into a one-dimensional vector for analysis and draw the performance rankings of 15 General Managers among all obtained,at the same time, reflect the importance of various evaluation indicators for the evaluation of the entire population by optimizing the projection direction. The results of the study has important significance on the promotion of implementation of modern large agriculture and the talent rapid development of reclamation area.

articleTitle: The empirical analysis on the relationship between foreign direct investment and China's service industry growth efficiency
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, foreign direct investment focus from manufacturing to service industry. China's total service sector has also been rapid growth, however, its output efficiency is still at a low level. This paper has tested the Cointegration and Granger causality between China's FDI and services output efficiency. And the result shows that there is no clear causal relationship between both of them. The paper also analyzes the reasons why both of them have no Granger causal relationship and gives some suggestions on how to utilize FDI efficiently.

articleTitle: Output feedback control of nonlinear systems via deterministic learning theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a deterministic learning based output feedback controller is designed for a class of nonlinear systems. Firstly, with the appropriately designed observer and controller, it is shown that the state observation and control error converge to a small neighborhood of zero exponentially in finite time, and a partial persistent excitation (PE) condition is satisfied. Secondly, by imposing an auxiliary filter and constructing a new Lyapunov function, the accurate approximation of closed-loop control system is achieved. Then, it is obtained that the neural weight estimation errors also converge to a small neighborhood of zero. The uncertain dynamics along the periodic trajectory can be locally-accurately identified by the radial basis function (RBF) neural networks (NNs) and stored in a constant RBF NNs. The obtained knowledge of system dynamics can be reused in the constant weight observer and controller with good performance. Simulation studies show the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: The role of logistics capabilities in promoting air cargo flows
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using data from 18 Asia Pacific states, this research explores the key antecedents of air cargo flow of Asia Pacific at state level. The result indicates that logistics capabilities of a country, measured by Logistics Performance Index (LPI), is the most significant influencing factor, shadowing other three factors including GDP per capita, air freight cost and the connectivity.

articleTitle: Data-based process fault detection using Active Cost-sensitive Learning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fault detection for industrial process is important to improve the qualities and quantities of products. Since it is difficult to obtain exact mathematic model for fault detection, data-based model for fault detection is popular in many industrial process applications. There are two class-imbalanced problems in fault detection for industrial process: the problem between unlabeled instances and labeled instances, the one between normal instances and fault instances. Active Cost-sensitive Learning (ACL) is proposed to solve the above two class-imbalanced problems in this paper. Margin sampling, one step of ACL algorithm, is used to select an informative instance from unlabeled instances. Cost-sensitive support vector machine (CSVM), the other step of ACL algorithm, is trained to predict the class label with minimum expected cost for an unlabeled instance. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is demonstrated by the benchmark Tennessee Eastman problem. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce average cost and increase fault sensitivity.

articleTitle: Evaluation study of the new countryside construction based on factor analysis — As a case study in Liaoning province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The construction of new countryside is a complicated systematic project, and evaluation of new countryside construction is a basic work of developing a new countryside development strategy, guiding new countryside health and harmonious development. This paper applies factor analysis, takes comparative evaluation of new countryside among Liaoning province regional, and provides countermeasures to the future construction of new countryside in Liaoning province.

articleTitle: Based on dynamic regression model medium and long-term demand forecast and analysis of China's electric power
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on comprehensive analysis of the current methods on medium and long-term prediction of electric power demand, a new model-dynamic regression model is represented to forecast and analyze China's electricity demands. Combined with time series method and multivariate regression method, this model can be more comprehensive, reasonable to reflect the operational laws and long-term trends of electric economic system. Through applying the software Eviews6.0 to analyze the case, forecasting model is more stable and more accurate than ever. In conclusion, this model is more suitable for forecasting and analyzing the medium and long-term demand trends in China's electric power.

articleTitle: Improved method for predicting RNA-binding residues using random forest from primary sequence
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Protein-RNA interactions play important role in a variety of biological processes in cells. An improved method is proposed for predicting RNA-binding residues from amino acids sequences which combines a novel hybrid feature with a random forest (RF) algorithm. The hybrid feature contains the evolutionary information, the secondary structure information and two novel features reflected the information about correlation of amino acids with regards to hydrophobicity and polarity-charge in protein sequences respectively. The prediction classifier achieves 0.5042 Matthew's correlation coefficient (MCC) and 85.17% overall accuracy (ACC) with 52.40% sensitivity (SE) and 92.89% specificity [1] respectively. Further analysis proves that two novel features and the evolutionary information contribute most to the prediction improvement. The results obtained from the comparisons with previous works clearly show that our prediction model has significant better prediction performance of RNA-binding residues in proteins.

articleTitle: The impact Of LMX to career success Based on the psychology capital perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper focused on the relationship between LMX and subordinate career success. By employees' psychology capital, author open the black box of the process LMX to subordinate career success. From 312 samples in Beijing IT industry, author used the SEM to test the mediation of employees psychology capital between LMX and career success. The result showed that LMX indicated positive impact on subordinate psychology capital, and subordinate psychology capital indicated positive influence on career success. At last, author gave some advice to management practice for managers.

articleTitle: Research on the generation and discharge characteristics of domestic pollutants from urban households
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to analyze the generation and discharge characteristics of domestic wastewater pollutants from the residents of different genders, ages and regions, the whole generation process of domestic wastewater from typical households was investigated in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Kunming and Lanzhou. The results showed that the daily per capita load of domestic wastewater pollutants were influenced by urban economic development level, living habits and dietary structure, while the daily per capita loads of CODCr, BOD5, and TN in Beijing and eastern costal cities such as Shanghai and Guangzhou were higher than those in western cities like Kunming and Lanzhou. Ages were significantly correlated to the domestic wastewater quantity of urban residents, daily per capita pollutant load, and the pollutants producing coefficient in such sequence as the middle-aged and youth > the elderly > children. The average daily pollutant load from washing wastewater were in the sequence as female > male, which was related with living habits caused by gender difference. The discharge quantity and the daily per capita pollutant loads of urine, stool and wastewater were determined by metabolic rate of different ages in such sequence that the middle-aged and youth > the elderly > children.

Author Keywords: Generation and discharge characteristics of pollutant

articleTitle: Design and development for automatic generation system of water resources Bulletin
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the depth and workload of water resources management increased, it is more efficient to build an automatic generation system to organize and manage the water resources bulletins. A practical automatic generation system for water resources bulletin has designed and built in this paper which includes 3 modules: Figure generation module, Data chart generation module and Bulletin text generation module. In addition, taking Jiamusi (a city in Heilongjiang Province) as an example, a Jiamusi automatic generation system for water resources bulletin has been designed, developed and analyzed, which is expected to provide references for relevant researches.

articleTitle: Study on vibration characteristic of hoist cage and fault diagnosis of steelwork
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, 6 degrees of freedom vibration model of hoist cage excited by steelwork faults was established first. Then horizontal and vertical vibration characteristics under local faults and whole faults were simulated through MATLAB, based on which a wavelet singularity method was proposed to process the vibration to determine the position and seriousness of the steelwork faults. Finally, simulation model and the signal processing method were verified by test.

articleTitle: The Process Strategy in Rework Production
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Rework is defined as the transformation of production rejects into re-usable products of the same or lower quality. Rework can be very profitable, especially if disposal costs are high and if materials are expensive and limited in availability. This paper deals with the reworking in a production line that is dedicated to a single product and that uses the same facilities for production and rework. Produced lots may be non-defective, reworkable defective or non-reworkable defective. Reworkable defective lots deteriorate over time, which effects the rework time and the rework cost. We consider a disposal strategy and two types of rework strategies. We derive expressions for the average profit per time unit, including costs for production, rework, disposal, procurement of input materials, and storage of reworkable defective lots. Using those expressions, the strategies can be compared numerically.

articleTitle: Bivariate point process model of relief factors of debris flow
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study the bivariate point process model of relief factors of debris flow of drainage area and drainage height difference. This model can make use of more observation points outside the radius r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> than bivariate exceedance model. Using 95% and 98% quantile as the initial value of r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> respectively, we get the estimation of the fitting density function. If r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is equal to 98% quantile, i.e. = r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> 46.14936, the appending density function curve is successfully simulated with the histogram.

articleTitle: A new re-sampling method for network traffic classification using SML
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The way of internet traffic classification using machine learning has been a hot topic for a long time as it is independent on the packet payloads. However, the problems of classifier biasing towards the majority classes have not been solved effectively now. The uniform sampling is a popular technique to alleviate the data skew in machine learning traffic classification. But the original traffic data distribution would be destroyed by it. A new re-sampling method named tuning sampling for supervised machine learning (SML) is proposed to ease the problem of data skew in internet traffic classification. And it is compared with uniform sampling and stratified sampling methods using C4.5 classification algorithm. Our experimental results indicate that the classifier using tuning sampling gets the accuracy of minority classes are higher than the results of stratified sampling and the overall accuracy is higher than the result of uniform sampling.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Determinants of locations of Japanese FDI in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Automatic generation algorithms of network models for complex systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Presently, lots of theory achievements have been gotten on the modeling of complex systems. However, it is necessary that theory achievements are applied into practice. In addition, it is difficult that models of complex systems are automatically constructed. So, a novel “draw-net” algorithm based on a structure space is presented to realize automatic network model graph generation for complex systems. The structure space is designed with a special data structure, which is used to save the basic information of the network model. Then different spaces are defined to manage the classified information according to certain operating sequence. The generation model is based on classification spaces, and these works contain the computing and the drawing of graphic objects. In the generation process, the iterative calculation is used; the whole model is produced with nodes, relationships, and parameters eventually. Finally, an example on making network models is used to illustrate the proposed algorithm. It shows this algorithm is feasible, and can satisfy realistic requirements. Simultaneously, it is discovered that the auto-generation arithmetic has a good universality, and can be widely extended in the practices.

articleTitle: The auto shape recognize method of well logging curve
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to research the well logging sedimentary and sequence stratigraphy, shape of well logging curve should be recognized first. The first and second rank derivative should be computed at beginning of all part, if the sign of the second rank derivative has changed, the correspondence depth point represent the inflexion of Geophysical logging curve, it's also the interface of stratum, after that, according to the change trend of correspondence logging data within inflexion to define the curve shape, that is, if data is decreased, then the shape be called bell, if data is increased, then the shape be called funnel, if data changed in small range, it be recognize as cylinder, then the well logging curve shape be recognized automatically. According to the method talked above, the data process and shape auto-judgment from well logging curve of a coring well is done. Case result indicated that curve shape can be better recognized through computation of the second rank derivative, identify of inflexion and analysis of the change trend of correspondence logging data within inflexion.

articleTitle: Simulation strategy of transfer about hongqiao railway hub's arrival
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important component of transportation system, pedestrian traffic is attracting more and more attentions. Basing on analyzing the layout of hongqiao railway hub, this paper discusses the transfer mode of arrival and puts simulated optimization strategies forward. Moreover, the result can be provided reference for further studying.

articleTitle: A study on the constitutive model and parameter identification of polystyrene plastic foam
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mechanical properties like tensile stress-strain curves of polystyrene plastic foam were measured under different loading conditions, thus the influences of various factors on mechanical behaviors of polystyrene plastic foam were systematically analyzed. The results indicate that the material density, thickness and loading speed have effect on the mechanical properties. The ultimate strength tends to increase as the material density increases and it increases rather much as the loading speed goes up whereas it tends to decrease as the material become thicker. An empirical constitutive model for describing metal materials was proposed for polystyrene plastic foam, and model parameters were obtained by fitting the material compression experimental data performed under different densities, thickness and loading speeds. A comparison made between the calculated and experimental results indicates that the proposed constitutive model may describe the stress-strain relationship of polystyrene plastic foam material rather well within certain loading speeds. The results obtained for polystyrene plastic foam are expected to provide necessary information for cushioning packing structure design.

articleTitle: Error analysis of compact finite difference schemes for the biharmonic equation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we borrow some techniques in finite element method to prove some error estimates of some compact finite difference schemes for biharmonic equation with Dirichlet boundary condition.

articleTitle: Evaluation research of regional information industry competitiveness—Taking Heilongjiang province as the example
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the arrival of knowledge economy, the degree of competitiveness in information industry has already become one of the important standards of regional and even national economic development. The article constructs an evaluating index system of competitiveness in regional information industry, which is on the basic framework of foundational competitiveness, operational competitiveness, environmental competitiveness, innovational competitiveness. And then, the article makes an evaluation research of information industry competitiveness in Heilongjiang province, which is based on the analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy evaluation method. Finally, the corresponding countermeasures and suggestions are given.

articleTitle: Leakage-resilient IBE from lattices in the standard model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We present an identity-based encryption in the relative-leakage model. In our construction, we firstly make use of a notion of new cryptographic primitive, identity-based hash proof system (IB-HPS), to construct a leakage-resilient IB-HPS from lattices in the standard model, which has the same amount of relative leakage as that in [11]. Then, based on our IB-HPS scheme, we construct directly an efficient leakage-resilient identity-based encryption scheme in the model.

articleTitle: Moving target detection based on particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new moving target detection method based on particle swarm optimization was proposed. The moving target detection problem was transformed into the problem of independent component analysis. The blind source separation algorithm based on modified particle swarm optimization was used for solving this problem. Experimental results show that the method proposed can achieve good results for finding out the moving trajectory of the object.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Parallel radix sort and its application in ray tracing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A study of the impact on during construction period
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Infrastructure projects have huge impacts on the traffic condition in urban areas, so the author suggests that the traffic impacts should be estimated for the construction period. This paper takes the Harbin Subway Line No.1 project as an example, demonstrating how to analyze the traffic impact factors, to find the optimal paths, and to forecast the traffic flows, so as to make the corresponding regulations to solve the congestion problem efficiently.

articleTitle: Design of the indoor alarm based on S3C2440
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents the design of an indoor alarm system, which uses embedded processor S3C2440 as a system of central control unit, and combines with the powerful Linux operating system management functions. The system starts the camera to take a photo and alarm when there was illegal to carry into room, and then send the photos to the computer with wireless network to prompt security personnel. The performance of system is real time, stable and reliable, which avoids the drawback of traditional alarm warning.

Author Keywords: Design of Embedded Systems S3C2440 alarm design

articleTitle: Camera paramters estimating and 3D reconstruction with bundle adjustment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Camera paramters estimating and 3D reconstruction are key issues in computer vision and photogrammetry community. In this paper, we present a method of camera parameters estimating and 3D reconstruction with bundle adjustment. Ont only the camera intrinsic parameters can be solved, but also the camera external parameters, lens distortion coefficients and 3D coordinates of space object points can be solved at the same time. Real experiments show high precision of parameters can be got with the method we presented‥

articleTitle: A homotopy method for solving nonlinear complementarity problems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study the following Linear complementarity problem. We construct a combined homotopy equation, prove the existence and the convergence of the homotopy path, which is from any interior point to the solution of the problem. Numerical example shows that this method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Location-allocation problem of multi-source and multi-variety under special conditions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of multi-source and multi-variety material supply under special cases such as wartime, this paper sets up a multi-objective programming based on time, cost and safety objectives, gives an algorithm combining tolerance layer evaluation method with fuzzy programming for this model, and finally illustrates the algorithm's effectiveness for this model by an example.

articleTitle: Construction cost estimation method based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a nonlinear model based on RBF Neural Network is presented. There are some ameliorated measures in leaning algorithm of Radial Basis Function (RBF) neural network. The number and the centric value of hidden layer are determined by using immune algorithm. The supervisory algorithm is taken as method of adjustable weight of output layer. Using above measures, the network is optimized, and the forecast model obtains the precise and objective solution. The construction cost forecasting model based on RBF neural network, realized the classification, analyzed and forecasted the construction cost and realized the intellectualized management of construction project, which also provide the construction manager with better decision-making basis. After considering a number of uncertain factors, the result is more accurate. Moreover, the result of the experiment had indicated that the validity and superiority of the method of RBF neural network. So it has broad application prospect in other fields.

articleTitle: Research on application of clustering algorithm in detection of ancient river
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since ancient ritual is usually near the water, so, there are large quantities of precious cultural relic buried ancient river. Search for ancient river has a great significance in the archaeological exploration. Traditional methods of the search ancient river entirely by manual interpretation. Interpretation by using a lot of consecutive geological cross-section diagram. The interpretation work need a professional knowledge and rich experience. Using of data mining and database technology can quickly identify the direction of ancient river. The paper based on the physical differences between the ancient river geological characteristics, propose using K-means algorithm to quickly identify the direction of ancient river. The clustering results according with the experts explain and match the actual excavation. The efficiency of the identification has been improved significantly. Data mining techniques applied to archaeological exploration geophysical data processing is the future of intelligent data-processing development trend.

articleTitle: Biomimetic segmentation of unconstrained touching numeral strings
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new bionic segmentation method which chooses principal curves to extract strokes of characters and form the stroke sequence. The training sample space is constructed by the Affinity Propagation (AP) algorithm and Bionic Pattern Recognition (BPR) theory. The stroke sequence is divided by calculating the distance of each subsequence to the relative subspace. Experimental results indicate that the method is effective in the segmentation of unconstrained handwritten numeral strings.

articleTitle: What is the underlying relationship between unilateral two-dimensional LDA and block-based LDA?
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Although it has been verified that unilateral two-dimensional linear discriminant analysis (U2DLDA) is not identical with a special case of block-based LDA, the underlying relationship between U2DLDA and block-based LDA stays open. Here we find that U2DLDA on one training set is equivalent to the special case of block-based LDA on another training set, where each class of centered 2D samples in the former set is divided into n subclasses corresponding to n columns (rows) of the 2D samples. Furthermore, a reasonable interpretation why U2DLDA potentially outperforms the special case of block-based LDA and the corresponding experimental results based on Yale and ORL face databases are given.

articleTitle: Optimization analyses of Velvet algorithm based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Velvet is a very effective de novo assembly algorithm specifically designed for assembling read data from next generation sequencing platforms. Velvet runtime parameter “Hash Length” essentially affects the performance of assembly. This study proposed an effective method to resolve the problem that determination of optimal hash length greatly depends on the experience of the user. Firstly, we analyzed the effect factors of optimal hash length, including depth of coverage, base calling error rate and complexity of read data. Then, we set up a RBF (Radial Basis Function) Neural Network trained by various assembly data sets, which could automatically suggest optimal hash length for Velvet algorithm based on the effect factors. The experimental results proved the validity of our method.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation in MPLS/IP datanetworks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper shows the results from a study on data transmission with different characterization (best-effort, high-priority best-effort and two types of real time traffic) through the switching protocol for multi-protocol labels in IP networks, compared to the IP data transmission using the Asynchronous Transfer Mode. This study illustrates the best performance the MPLS shows under a network congestion. The NS_2 discrete event simulator was used as experimentation tool.

articleTitle: Predicting coke price by semiparametric regression method based on cointegration analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of consumption of coke, based on the analysis of Co-integration theory, the article utilized the model of semi-parametric regression to forecast coke' price by giving the data of coke' consumption market from January 1997 to April 2009 and so as to raise estimation precision of short-term coke' price. The test results of coke and iron price series for both Augmented Dickey Fuller (ADF) and co-integration analysis demonstrated that there was a co-integration relationship between the coke and iron price series. And then, the article suggested the parametric sectors was replaced by error correction operator. The result of linear analysis proved that the yield of coke was selected in non-parametric part. The semi-parametric regression combined with error correction operator was constructed. The article utilized cross validation method to select optimum bandwidth, choosing the Parabola kernel for the Kernel function. The least squares estimation was selected in new modeling estimation. The estimation results of real case was demonstrated that the semi-parametric regression model based on error correction operators not only reduced boundary estimation error but also strengthen economical interpretation. It is effective method to forecast coke' price in short-term.

articleTitle: GSP based Internet ads auction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Internet, which is developing so rapidly as an advertising media, is becoming an irreplaceable marketing channel. In recent years, search engine giant Google uses a new mechanism of advertising auction based on Generalized Second Price (GSP) is a global research hot spot. How to extend this mechanism to more websites where there is sales auction is becoming a hot question in this industry. Based on this purpose, this paper presents a model of GSP based Internet advertising auction and discusses the advertiser revenue and the conditions of Nash equilibrium under it. According to the Nash equilibrium conditions, the numeric area of seller revenue is caculated.

articleTitle: Research on vague evaluation of diversified strategic environment of private enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to seek survival and development, many enterprises expand its scale and enhance their competitiveness through the implementation of diversification strategies, but the diversified operating effects of many private enterprises failed to meet their business objectives. The paper analyzes the environmental factors of private enterprises' diversification strategy. Then establishes the system of diversification strategy of environmental indicators of private enterprises and builds a vague assessment model. And what's more, it proved to be a scientific and practical model by empirical analysis. It provides an effective reference for the scientific evaluation of quantitative indicators.

articleTitle: Synchronization method based on embedded training sequence for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: More efficient and accurate synchronization in time and frequency is required for the next generation packet-based mobile communication service system. The embedded synchronization scheme is introduced in this paper, which embeds the training sequence directly into the OFDM symbol stream. This method has important research value, offers the potential to save bandwidth resources and provide a flexible air interface mode. The theoretical derivation and implementation method are also presented. The paper also analyzed and compared many algorithms among the embedded synchronization schemes for OFDM systems in recent years, than summed up the focus and difficulties of the embedded synchronization scheme. The future research directions is given at last to subsequent OFDM synchronization, which has important guiding significance.

articleTitle: Research on technological innovation network of multinational corporations based on complex network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with the development of globalization, the process of multinational companies' technological innovation becomes increasingly complex. This paper systematically expounds related theories of multinational corporations' technological innovation and complex networks, and points out that multinational companies' technological innovation is the formation process of a complex network, and describes BA scale-free network model in detail, which is introduced into technological innovation networks of multinational corporations. Finally, the corresponding results are obtained by means of in-depth analysis of technological innovation networks' elements of multinational companies, BA scale-free effect, searching of key nodes and natural language description of building process.

articleTitle: Study on the application of integrated marketing theory by engineering consultation companies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
