abstract: Engineering consulting industry growing domestic and international market competition forced the engineering consulting companies must find new ways to enhance marketing capabilities. This study combines the latest integrated marketing theory in the analysis of the characteristics and marketing issues of engineering consulting industry, at last the author gives some suggestions as how to apply integrated marketing theory based on to integrated marketing theory.

articleTitle: An initial study on hotel low-carbon procurement management—A perspective of China mainland
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a sustainable practice, green procurement has been done by the hotel industry for about 20 years. It has huge potential for sustainable development. Green procurement has changed the traditional procurement mode and has facilitated expansion of hotel environmental management. Yet, due to that in the current green procurement management, only such factors as using, machining, and substituting process of the goods or service procured have been regarded in the case of their environmental impact, with other factors as producing, transportation, consumption and decomposition (of waste) being ignored, thus it is difficult for traditional procurement to provide suitable services to meet the multiple requirements of both economic benefit and environment protection. The problem has caused researchers to rethink the current green procurement, which leads to an increasing research attention to a new form of procurement. This paper firstly puts forward the definion of hotel low carbon procurement and describe its connotation; It then analyzes the low-carbon procurement management mode, and explores the necessity and feasibility of realizing low carbon procurement management; Lastly, it points out the main realisization approaches of low carbon procurement, including: 1) for the government to push the low-carboned policy and mechanism environment; 2) for the owners and managers of the hotels to build up low-carbon consciousness; 3) to select specialized and intensive low-carbon procuring mood; 4) to obtain technological support from related research groups; 5) to provide professional personnel guarantee. It is hoped that the adoption of low-carbon procurement will lead to the greater popularity of green hotel establishment.

articleTitle: Investor sentiment and stock index: A test of causality based on vector error correction model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we use Granger causality test based on VECM to analyze the relationship between investor sentiment and Shanghai Composite Index. We describe the call warrants' deviation as a proxy variable for investor sentiment. Empirical analysis shows that there exists the long-term negative influence between investor sentiment and stock index and there is no causal relationship between them in the long and short run. Our findings have important implications as investors can predict the market trend and make decisions on investment.

articleTitle: An evaluation on the e-commerce internet marketing function of Jiangxi local municipal governments' official tourism websites
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper does an evaluation on the e-commerce internet marketing function of 11 local municipal cities' official tourism websites in Jiangxi Province in mainland China. The assessment is conducted mainly from the following five aspects: green marketing strategy, information serving, transaction processing, technology supporting and website operating. The results indicate that most official tourism websites are at the preliminary stage of information providing. It is necessary to improve the functions of implementing the destination green marketing strategy, transaction processing and so on. As far as the middle, northern, eastern, southern and western parts of China are concerned, there are no significant differences among different cities in the official tourism websites' Internet marketing function. For further development, it is suggested that official tourism websites' Internet marketing function must be integrated with local tourism green marketing strategy and be supported by governments at all levels.

articleTitle: Theory analysis for the virtual current distribution in an electromagnetic flowmeter with one bubble
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the theory of electromagnetic flow meter, the effect of bubbles on the virtual current distribution was studied by using two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) analysis. To solve this problem, it was to establish the physical equation and boundary conditions used for the virtual current distribution of the flow meter. The method of separating variables was used to solve the physical equation to obtain a semi-analytical solution, and then the method of alternating iteration was used to work out the unknown coefficients in the semi-analytical solution. The solution analyzes the virtual current distribution with one bubble at radial position, at radial position in 2D coordinates, and at random position in 3D coordinates. The bubble has some effects on the distribution of the virtual current distribution. The greater the bubble, the greater the effects; the closer the bubble from the electrodes, the greater the effects.

articleTitle: Fusion and classification evaluation of SPOT-5 panchromatic and multi-spectral image
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: SPOT-5 multi-spectral image is rich in spectral information. Its four spectral bands are red, green, near-infrared and short-infrared, which have a good value in the area of forest vegetation application. SPOT-5 panchromatic image has high spatial resolution of 2.5 meter, in line with the requirements of the general application. So the application of SPOT-5 satellite data in optical image is very extensive. In this paper, by the software of ERDAS, SPOT-5 high-resolution and multi-spectral image are fused with method of PCA (Principle Component), Multiplicative and Brovey-transformation. The fused images retain multi-spectral information while maximizing the spatial resolution, which can not only improve the visual effects of image, and also can be used in classification. It provides professional graphics for the measurement and favorable data for remote sensing image interpretation. Classification is carried out to evaluate the effect of fusion with three different methods. And classification results of fusion images are compared with thee classification of original SPOT-5 multi-spectral image. The conclusions are: among the three integration methods, Brovey-transformation has the best visual effects, and its fused image retains better spectral information of the original image while maintaining sharpening the image effect. The classification accuracy of Brovey-transform fusion reaches 85%.

articleTitle: Landscape pattern analysis with GIS based on the principle of landscape ecology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: GIS provides quantitative method for studying land use, such as landscape pattern analysis. It is convenient to analyze landscape pattern with ArcGIS for its simple operation and friendly graphical user interface. In this paper, ArcGIS was applied to study the land use in Changping Town??Dongguan City in Guangdong province, China. We compiled the land use actuality landscape map and land use planning landscape map, and then calculated and analyzed some landscape metrics, such as area metrics, patch density and size metrics, shape metrics and diversity metrics. The result shows that the landscape structure and function in Changping Town tend to be improved after land use planning.

articleTitle: Monitoring of vegetation cover changes based on CBERS images
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vegetation monitoring based on remote sensing technique is very important for the policy making of ecological restoration. Two CBERS images of Yanchi County, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region of China, accepted in August 23, 2002 and September 5, 2006 respectively, were selected for this study. Based on two components sub-pixel model, the vegetation coverage of 2002 and 2006 and changes between them were calculated and analyzed. The result showed that the vegetation coverage decreased from 45.6% in 2002 to 30.6% in 2006; the main change of the vegetation coverage showed slight degradation during these years. And local improvement and general degradation coexist on the space pattern.

articleTitle: A unified measurement model for meteorological computing resources
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High performance computer (HPC) capability building has made raped progress in national headquarter and regional centers of China Meteorological Administration. To resolve fine-grained resource allocation, distributed resource sharing and scheduling, and system introduction evaluation, a unified measurement model for meteorological computing resources with wide applicability and practicability must be established. Taking into consideration related research and existing methods, a general, hybrid measurement model is proposed, integrating both the conventional industry benchmarks and meteorological domain-specific applications. As the core of the model, GCUP (General Computing Unit Productivity) is introduced as a common form to implement quantitative representation of heterogeneous computing resources. An implementation of the model has been made, including 5 object parameters. Performance benchmark and meteorological numerical model tests are run on 4 representative HPC systems distributed in national headquarter and regional centers of China Meteorological Administration. Based on GCUP data determined, an initial nationwide HPC resource usage statistical analysis is made.

articleTitle: Study on remote sensing classification of Ejina oasis landscape
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The accuracy improvement of remote sensing images has been always one of preceding issues in the filed of remote sensing. maximum likelihood to new decision tree, neural networks, wavelet transform and fuzzy recognition system, the classification accuracy has been improved. In this work, based on 3S technology and Landsat ETM data, using 3 classification methods (K-Mean, maximum likelihood and decision tree), Ejina oasis landscape is classified into 6 types: farmland, forestland, grassland, waters, saline land and desert; and the accuracies of the classification results are analyzed. The results indicate that the built decision tree model through NDVI, K-T transformation and principal component analysis is reasonable; the overall accuracy is up to 93.28%, higher than that of K-Mean (86.32%) and maximum likelihood (85.82%) obviously. It can provide scientific basis for the ecological health dynamic monitoring and regional sustainable development of Ejina oasis.

articleTitle: Thinking and understanding of the management theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through the analysis of management as a science and some existing problems in the management theory to explore the essence of management theory, this essay points out that in the era of knowledge management, management ideas must widely absorb the advanced achievements, and combine the ethnic culture background, so it can make the management theory to the new brilliance.

Author Keywords: Studying the western and Serving the eastern National culture

articleTitle: The study of sphere radius based on multiple symbol differential unitary space-time system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem of high complexity for multiple symbol differential detection (MSDD), a series sub-superior detect algorithms have been proposed at present, wherein the depth-first sphere decoding is a classical algorithm whose performance approximates to the maximum likelihood detection. But it still has high computing complexity, and the pipeline and parallel operations are very difficult, so it is impossible to use widely in practice. At present the sphere decoding reduces complexity mainly by two ways: First, choosing the appropriate radius, second, combining with the K-Best algorithm, but the latter will cause some loss of performance. This paper focuses on the former, and researches two low-complexity radiuses based on the width-first tree detection. The performances of sphere decoding with two radiuses and maximum likelihood detection are compared. The simulation results show that the performances of the three are very similar at the low SNR, but as the SNR increased, the maximum likelihood is superior to the performance of nonlinear radius, nonlinear radius is better than linear radius, but the gap is smaller than 0.5dB. Complexity analysis shows that the complexity of sphere decoding with the appropriate radiuses can reduce a lot compared with maximum likelihood detection.

articleTitle: An improved variable step Frequency-domain Block LMS algorithm with adaptive filtering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem that the convergence performance of classical adaptive filtering algorithms is sensitive to input signal power and is hard to balance between convergence speed and steady-state misadjustment, this paper, based on the traditional Frequency-domain Block LMS (FBLMS) algorithm, presents a variable step algorithm which step with easy and reliable parameter tuning is controlled by current input signal energy and filtering error energy together. In addition, a new convergence performance indicator that is filtered-source block gain is proposed specially for block LMS algorithms during simulation. Simulation results for adaptive filtering are presented to demonstrate the performance improvements in convergence speed and steady-state misadjustment compared with other existing algorithms such as the normalized LMS (NLMS) and traditional FBLMS.

articleTitle: Research on improving methods of preprocessing in web log mining
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the web logs by using data mining technology. Through structure mining, usage mining and content mining, analyzes and studies the existing problems in current mining technology. Aiming at relevant key preprocessing schedule such as Frame page filtration, time-out threshold value setting and long-time setting, etc. this paper puts forward a modified data preprocessing technical method and compares the mining results through tests before and after the modification. Experiment proves that, the modified preprocessing technology is feasible and it can solve problems existing in relevant preprocessing effectively.

articleTitle: Discussion about the ecology landscape pattern design of riverside hilly urban water system based on corridor theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: River system is important corridor with hierarchical structure, and has the function of ecology, recreation, historical and the cultural protection. Its material flow, energy flow, species circulate are flowed and exchanged through corridor network. Corridor network is effective way to maintain the healthy movement of landscape flow, and its function and network is hierarchical. In the riverside hilly area, the terrain is the primary factor affecting river system pattern, the area of riverside and the headstream of river branch is biological shield sensitive area of water source. Differentiating rank in river landscape could make clear not only the importance of various river landscapes in integral development, but also their function network and their primary and secondary relations of various river courses. In this study, according to the specific characteristics of hilly areas and the corridor network theory, and based on the characteristics analysis about natural ecological environment, cultural heritage, water environment and tourism of Jiangning county in Nanjing city, and take the integrity, continuity, non-uniformity, ecological rank, water affinity, public participation as the design ideas, to constructs the ecological protection frame dominated by river corridor skeletons and supplemented by other green corridor, and distinguished the primary and secondary relations of corridor and the ecology node in network, proposed the plan protection strategy for recreation and the cultural heritage corridor, and discussed the water system landscape divisional design of research area based on the corridor theory.

articleTitle: Research on the designing of the interpretation panel of geoparks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Geopark is a plan to promote the protection and sustainable development of geological heritage, which is supported by UNESCO. In order to achieve this function of popular science education, it is necessary to build a set of interpretation system with prominent feature of advanced, scientific and perfect popular science education. This paper defines the interpretation system of geoparks, and studied the designing principles and methods of interpretation panel, including the information, content and appearance. It would provide a scientific basis for geoparks to set up some good interpretation panels.

articleTitle: Research on the mode of emergency evolution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Whether an emergency happens depends on the input of the environment and the structure of the hazard bearing body. And the spread and chain-reacting of the emergency are based on the relation between the hazard bearing body and the emergency, also the characteristic of it, besides the structure of the hazard bearing body. Because of the complexity for the occurrence and evolvement of the emergency, we give a method that the chain-reacting network of emergencies shifts to a hierarchical network, and a layer stands for one kind of disaster. In this article, we analyze the characteristic of the hierarchical networks, and explain it with an example.

articleTitle: Estimating chlorophyll content of rice leaves on different layers based on scanning images
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Real-time and accurate method of diagnosing and monitoring crop nutrition is the foundation of scientific fertilization management. In this study, color characteristic information was acquired from scanning images of rice leaves at the jointing by MATLAB, through analyzing the relationship between chlorophyll content which were abstracted from leaves on different sites and 27 color characteristics, the result showed that flag (first) leaf can predict nitrogen content optimally, and H value was used to establish the best estimation model of chlorophyll content. Finally, the regression models were verified by using other samples, and RMSE of Chl a, Chl b, Chl (a+b) was 0.98, 0.42 and 2.10 respectively, It is concluded that the scanner could be utilized to predict chlorophyll content of rice leaves.

articleTitle: Review of calculation methods for solving sunlight sheltered problem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The process of sunshine calculation is extremely complex, involving geography, astronomy, computer, construction, planning, geometrical optics and other disciplines. With the rapid development of information technology, a variety of terrain analysis algorithms or artificial intelligence algorithms have been introduced to the process of solving the problem of sunshine calculation. Moreover, sunlight sheltered or visible calculation is always the core and basis of above problem. This paper discusses the four major calculation methods related to solving sunlight shelter, since 70s of last century, including traditional estimation method, geometric optics, construction CAD method, visible analysis and the inverse analysis combined with artificial intelligence, and the principle and implementation of specific methods is described in detail.

articleTitle: The stability of exchange rate model with diffusion and Poisson jump
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We study the stability of diffusion model with Poisson jump, the exchange rate and their generalizations are studied. Then a equivalent condition of mean-square stability for semi-implicit Euler method are obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of external environmental influencing factors on the evolution of resource-based industrial system based on DEMATEL method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Resource-based industrial system is composed of many interacting elements. Based on the comprehensive academic research and extensive investigation, this paper proposed the model of external environmental influencing factors on the evolution of resource-based industrial system. The paper employed the DEMATEL method to analyze the model, and considered industrial policy as the key influencing factors on the evolution of resource-based industrial system.

articleTitle: Research on customer churn prediction model based on IG_NN double attribute selection
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of customer churn prediction, and proposes the customer churn prediction model based on double attribute selection of information gain (IG) and neural network (NN) by analyzing the characteristics of customer churn data. That is, firstly, undertake the main attribute selection for customer churn data by using IG, and then analyze every main attribute by using NN, which output results are analyzed by 80–20 rule to get the key attributes affecting customer churn; secondly, construct the prediction model based on IG_NN by taking the key attributes as input and customer churn probability as output. The model predicts lost customers next month by carrying on data acquisition about customer behavior and payment information of a telecom operator during first three months. Provably, there is improvement of various degrees of accuracy, coverage rate and hit rate than other methods for customer churn prediction. This model has a good prediction performance for dealing with a large quantity of non-equilibrium data set.

articleTitle: Study on the formation and identification of economic costs of IT project
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data of Economic costs of IT project consist of core and base data in economic analysis (national economic evaluation) of IT project. Scientific identification and calculation of economic costs of IT project lay a solid foundation for the economic analysis of IT project. From the point of economic analysis, this paper calculates the economic costs which represent the cost of national economy in IT project. On the basis of economic evaluation of project, this paper analyzed the meaning and features of economic costs of IT project. Furthermore, according to the basic principles of economic costs identification, this paper emphasized on the formation of economic costs with whose features taken into consideration and proposed that the economic costs be composed of direct costs and indirect costs.

articleTitle: Resource shadow price calculation under long-term and short-term production
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Shadow price has important guiding significance for resource allocation. However, the definition of shadow price is usually associated with short-term production. while the adjustments of multiple resource elements in the long-term production have always been ignored. In this article, the author consider the total revenue function as a piecewise linear function of resource combination, and use the directional derivative to calculate the shadow price in view of short-term production and long-term production respectively. This method is not only suitable for the calculation of shadow price under a single resource element adjustment, but also multiple resource elements adjustments.

articleTitle: Research of predictive control based on OS-LSSVMR
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The accuracy of modeling is important for control accuracy and stability in predictive control. So, SVMR (Support Vector Machines Regression), which supports by mathematics theory and has a simple structure and nonlinear modeling properties, compare with other modeling algorithm, such as neural networks, has been applied in the predictive control. Here, OS-LSSVMR, which has good online modeling properties, has been used to model the nonlinear system process based on empirical data in Model Predictive Control, which recede optimization using LM (Levenberg-Marquardt) non-linear least square optimization. The simulation shows that the control algorithm is a good stability and real-time.

articleTitle: Research on land use change and non-agriculturalization of land in traditional agricultural region—A case study in Neihuang County of the North China Plain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper supplies academic reference and scientific base for grain supplying security sustainable development and regional land use optimization by means of land use change and exploration into non-agriculturalization of land in traditional agricultural region in the North China Plain from 1979 to 2000. Constructed non-agriculturalization of land evaluation model and gained land use data by application of 38 technique, and analyzed non-agriculturalization of land use in the study region. Cultivated land sustainably reduced, while forestalled and construction land rapidly increased in the study region. The non-agriculturalization of land accelerated dramatically, and total grain yield was subject to coercion. In the study region, land use change greatly varied and non-procentralization of land accelerated, an increase of grain yield per unit area weakened the effect of non-agriculturalization of land on grain yield. In order to ensure grain supplying safety, we should control construction land scale, make non-agriculturalization of land degree and national economic growth rate consistent. Because forest land proportion of non-agricultural land significantly increased, the united agriculture and forest bureau should be established to prevent agriculture and forest from seizing land.

articleTitle: Base on GIS-ERDAS of the evolution of structure of per capital GDP of Economic Belt of the Northern of Tianshan Moutains
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the evolution of the spatial pattern of economic structure of the Economic Belt of the Northern of Tianshan Moutains in Xinjiang in 1978–2007 with the relative information and data by the combination of methods of ESDA-AcrGis. The results showed that: (1)The economic pattern of EBNSTM in the study period is not obvious change, and the economic differences had reduced in 1978–1990 and rapidly had expanded in 1990–1995. (2)The economic center as Urumqi, Karamay and Shihezi cities are in the accumulation stage, and have been weak diffusion to the surrounding counties. The “Space Matthew” in the cities and countries of economy backward are effecting significantly. (3)Both differences in resource endowments and economic development strategy are the important factors to the evolution of economic structure of EBNSTM.

articleTitle: A fuzzy congestion control algorithm for Differentiated Services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering the shortages of traditional RED algorithm, that are difficulty of setting parameters and lack of fairness, and the unique advantages of fuzzy control in dealing with network congestion issues, a new fuzzy congestion control algorithm for Differentiated Services named DSFCC is proposed. The algorithm adequately considers the user's requirements of Quality of Service (QoS) of different traffic flows, and adopts the methodology of combining Sharing Index and queue length to deal with congestion problems. It uses the fuzzy relational matrix to describe the real-time status of the various types of queues and traffic flows, and intelligently controls the network congestion based the fuzzy rule. Theoretical analysis and NS simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has smoother delay characteristic, better adaptability and fairness in the case of QoS implementation. It really improves the system's ability to deal with network congestion.

articleTitle: Possibilistic reliability ananlysis for complex structure system based on neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Steel structure system deteriorates over time due to environmental effects, material fatigue, and overloading. Safety assessment of existing steel structure system requires the development of a methodology that allows for an accurate evaluation of reliability. Steel structures are the supporting elements. Recent accidents occur in steel structures. The fuzzy reliability analysis of complex structure systems is important in engineering. Through calculating possibilistic reliability on complex structure system and simulating the actual distribution of load by Neural Network, a new methodology for accessing complex steel structure system safety is developed. The Range of CAP(Control ambit parameter) and failure road length is suggested. The method used for modeling and reliability of engineering project provides a theoretical and practicing reference for engineering.

articleTitle: A qualitative prediction model based on rough set for rainstorm applied to numerical prediction products
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new attribute reduction algorithm for decision table in rough set theory has been developed based on factor combined analysis method instead of using the common reduction method of Boolean function in traditional rough set theory, due to the fact that Boolean function reduction hasn't considered the combination analysis of predictors. Using decreasing FAR calculation with Japanese model products, Chebyshev Polynomial Expression method and Empirical Orthogonal Function (EOF) method, predictand and predictors from model products in Europe center were computed, and a qualitative prediction model based on rough set and factor combined analysis method was established for rainstorm with heavy rainfall. Results show that the Threat Score (TS) of the modified model is higher than that of the traditional stepwise regression method in the qualitative prediction of rainstorm.

articleTitle: Stability analysis and application of output feedback control in the continuous stirred tank reactor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The objective of this work is design the bounded output feedback control law for the stability analysis of a class of continuous stirred tanker reaction by Lyapunov theory. The result shows the controller yield uniformly asymptotic stability under certain conditions, and it is verified by a case study: the van der Vusse reaction mechanism.

articleTitle: Subscription based or not?
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Video game providers release a game either in online, offline or both versions with online release allowing players to cooperate and/or compete with real persons and bringing them utility of being related to others. We drew insights from Self-Determination Theory and derived three important factors to analyze players' adoption of different versions of video games. We then build a two-dimensional Hoteling model to study the product differentiation and optimal pricing strategies for game releases.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of enterprise R&D alliance based on SPA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper determined the risk factors and risk index of enterprise R&D alliance, and according to the AHP method, determined the index weight, constructed the risk assessment model that based on SPA (Set Pair Analysis), provided the basis for evaluating risk level of alliance and risk prevention.

articleTitle: Evaluation of security investment based on blind number theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve security investment evaluation with multi-factor, multi-variable and multi-level attributes, the blind number theory is applied to this paper. By introducing comprehensive faith degree and unascertained measure, multi-agent system based on the blind number theory can efficiently solve the problems such as uncertainty, fuzziness and randomness. The analysis of CNPC shows that the uncertain conclusion synthesis of multi-agent system based on blind number is effective and credible in security investment evaluation. The blind number theory is a reliable method for security investment evaluation both in theory and in practice.

articleTitle: A study on correlation between research and development investment and enterprise value of manufacturing enterprises in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the new economic era, which characterized by information and knowledge, enterprises can not develop without Research and Development(R&D) Investment as it becomes the source of core competence and also can determine enterprises' status in the future competition directly. As China's strategic industries, manufacturing industry plays an important role in China's national economy. What kind of correlation does R&D investment and enterprise value have in manufacturing enterprises? Taking this as a clue, this paper refines the index of R&D investment to the intensity of R&D capital investment and the ratio of technical personnel, carries on empirical analysis on correlation between R&D investment and enterprise value by information collected from Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchange. The results reveal that the intensity of R&D capital investment and the ratio of technical personnel have significant positive correlation with enterprise value, showing hysteresis to a certain extend.

articleTitle: Insist on educating people to be people-oriented, push forward the ideological and political education of college students
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: People-oriented modern moral values and ideals and the origin of thinking. In this paper, on ideological and political education of existing problems, ideological and political education that college students should be people-oriented, continuous improvement and innovation ideological and educational work, and actively improve the ideological and political education, effective, attractive, appealing.

articleTitle: Bioinformatics analysis of the lir1 gene and its promoter sequence in Rice
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bioinformatics analysis of the gene coding Light Induced Rice1 (lir1) protein and its promoter sequence in rice was preformed. The results demonstrates that LIR1 is an unstable hydrophilic protein consisting of 128 amino acids and contains the α-helix and random coil structure. Glycosylation sites, phosphorylation sites and myristoylation sites exist in LIR and transmembrane helices have been found between the position of 13 and 19 amino acid. In addition, the deduced amino acid sequence includes a signal peptide of 21 amino acids, which shows it may locate in the cytoplasm of some organelles. Prediction of the physiological function of LIR1 indicates that it may involve in energy metabolism. The promoter sequence contains light-related response elements, which indicates that it might work in a unique pattern in lir1 expression under the control of light.

articleTitle: Study on configurable computer-aided turbocharger assemble system to order
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Assemble to order is a method to realize the idea of the customization. Under the analysis of the disadvantages of the traditional turbocharger assemble systems, this paper introduces a configurable computer-aided turbocharger assemble system to order. This system proposed uses Siemens S7-200 PLC as controller, and PC Access as OPC Server. Siemens S7-200 PLC can establish different types of turbocharger assemble process control module. PC Access can realize assemble software communication with PLC controller. The computer-aided software is designed under Visual Basic development environment and realizes seamless integration with enterprise management system. The application result indicates that the proposed system can improve the quality and efficiency of turbocharger assemble.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the influence of real exchange rate volatility on US FDI in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper carries on an empirical research on the influence of real exchange rate of RMB's volatility on US FDI in China, adopting GARCH model, the VAR model and cointegration theory, based on quarterly data from 1994 to 2009. The result demonstrated that there is a stable relationship among the volatility of real exchange rate, real exchange of RMB and US foreign direct investment in China. The appreciation of RMB and the increase in volatility of exchange rate significantly hindered the US foreign direct investment in China.

articleTitle: The economic judgment of the agricultural insurance in modern agriculture development phase
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of modern agriculture causes the planter, the processing and the agricultural product circulation to link together closely. The agriculture whose feeble constitution characteristic is obvious not only needs to undertake the output risk (natural disaster), but also needs to undertake the price risk from the second industry and the third industry. The feeble constitution of agriculture and the public goods constitution of agricultural product circulation request government to protect agriculture. The agricultural political insurance is the best choice for the government to protect the agriculture and control the risk of agricultural income.

articleTitle: Customizable and scalable network architecture modeling and analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By summing up domestic and international research on next-generation Internet architecture, advantages and disadvantages, a customizable and scalable Web services architecture modeling and analysis. Defines the basic elements of the network include: port, network entities, network connectors and network system framework model. The method takes into account to customize and extend the application requirements, on three major issues facing the computer network - user management, resource control and service customization, theoretically provides a better solution. Various entities, the use of resources is no longer a simple competition, network management entity will control the port by the network to manage the situation. Network entities within the service unit within the service specifications and business rules can be generated by downloading the port to re-download. Users interact with network connections and communicating, you can specify the service requirements, such as transmission rate, delay requirements, these requirements will be transformed for the control of information be sent to the network service entity special Chu Li. Port and control port to download separate, dedicated port to ensure quality of service, improve network management and control capabilities.

articleTitle: Study on the risk assessment based on the D-S theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the existing uncertainty in risk assessment, this paper takes advantage of the D-S theory in processing uncertain information to discuss the problems in risk assessment. Through modeling the hierarchy index system of the risk assessment, computing the value of the evaluation indicators and fusing the uncertain information, this paper illuminates the common steps that how to use the D-S theory to value the risk, and finally takes an example to prove the feasibility. This paper offers a new and more reasonable approach to deal with the uncertainty in risk assessment.

articleTitle: On the application of humanistic management to the training of university student cadres
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Humanistic management is an important symbol of modern civilization. It has been a worldwide common research topic for nowdays higher education to build and implement humanistic management in universities, and cultivate all-round high qualified talents with self-awareness creativity. This paper analyzes the contents of humanistic management and its application to the student cadres training, and testifies its results on the student cadres training by presenting some humanistic management examples in my university.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis-based DCT method for face recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It's critical for feature recognition of DCT (Discrete Cosine Transform) coefficient selection in the new Data Field which commutated from the DCT; however, the DCT commutating does not have the capability for data compression. This paper proposes a new method combined with the DCT commutates and the statistical analysis to select DCT's coefficient. Firstly, calculate each capacity of DCT's coefficients. Secondly, select the data as a feature which has a higher discriminate ability, and then combined with the PCA method for data decorrelation. Finally, do the classification and recognition. Experiments show that this method of classification efficiency greatly improved compared to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Research on powerline communication and design of PLC modem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Powerline communication was a competitive solution to “Last Kilometer” technology because of its advantages such as layout independent and wide coverage. The paper studied deeply the application of OFDM to powerline communication and designed the MODEM in powerline communication utilizing the PLC chips—INT5500CS—of Interllon. And its application to remote ammeter was also presented and the Internet access based on powerline communication was implemented.

articleTitle: Modified decoding algorithm for IRA code in MIMO-OFDM communication system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Irregular Repeat Accumulate(IRA) code has drawn a lot of attention recently to its prominent decoding algorithm, whose performance approaches to Shannon limit. Belief propagation decoding algorithm is the best decoding algorithm for IRA code, which has great hardware complexity when implemented. Min-sum decoding algorithm modifies belief propagation decoding algorithm at the cost of decoding performance. A modified decoding algorithm is proposed to simplify belief propagation decoding algorithm with a little of loss in decoding performance according to minimum mean square error rule. The modified decoding algorithm can be applied to MIMO-OFDM communication system to decrease Inter-Carrier-Interference. Simulation results show that if MIMO-OFDM system needs SNR to be 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup>, the encoding gain of modified decoding algorithm can be 0.25dB and 0.15dB better than normalized decoding algorithm and offset decoding algorithm respectively. And the modified decoding algorithm also has lower hardware complexity.

articleTitle: Policies and strategy analysis encouraging teachers' initiative in higher education institutions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Construction of teachers in higher education institutions has made great achievement for recent decades. It is benefited from policies encouraging teachers' initiative. Drawing up suitable strategy in higher education institutions has the advantage of teachers been driven to show the initiative. In this way, educational quality will be improved.

Author Keywords: Teachers' Initiative in Higher Education Institutions

articleTitle: Combined method for single satellite passive localization based on PSO
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Enlightened by the combined method (CM) for traditional passive localization of ocean and air based applications, and considering that passive localization is a typical nonlinear filtering and optimal estimation problem, CM for single satellite passive localization is examined based on Particle swarm optimization(PSO), which provides an evolutionary computation method to solve the nonlinear optimal problem. However, PSO can not be straightforwardly applied to satellite passive localization because satellite passive localization is a constrained nonlinear optimal problem when using the constraint condition of the earth surface. We suggest calculating the particle swarm directly using the earth surface constraint, and the uncertainty of particle position can be resolved by the angle measurements. Computer simulation experiments are performed to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of organization form selection for business model design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyze the choice on organizational form of business model from three different perspectives. The transaction cost theory perspective pays attention to ‘behavior uncertainty’ while the core competence perspective analyzes the ‘demand uncertainty’ and the real options theory perspective focuses on ‘capacity uncertainty’. The decision maker should synthesize these three different perspectives to make the right decision.

articleTitle: Research on the method of parallel software PLL
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of software PLL(SPLL), a method of parallel SPLL based on the redundant data is presented according to the data block transmission mode in the virtual radio system. The method keeps the basic structure of PLL, avoids the affection on the performance of SPLL by discontinuous parallel data block. It also makes good use of the parallel capability of computer, improves the parallel efficiency and is convenient to be realized by software. This paper discusses the basic theory and the course about the method, and analyses the performance of real-time with acceleration ratio, parallel efficiency and multithreading. The results of simulation show that the parallelized SPLL has the very similar tracking precision and dynamic performance as the single SPLL. The performance of real-time of this method is proved valid by demodulation PM signal on the general computer.

articleTitle: Application of concept maps to teaching and learning the course of Electrotechnics and Electronics Technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Understanding the accurate basic concept is primary task in course teaching of Electrotechnics and Electronics Technology. The framework of important concepts in the course of Electrotechnics and Electronics Technology was built using the theory of concept maps. After the teaching practice to grade 2008 of Thermal Energy and Power Engineering Major, the effects of teaching, learning and teaching evaluation tools were analyzed. And the shortages of concept maps teaching were pointed out.

articleTitle: Development of traffic analysis system using GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper reports on our development of a GIS-based traffic network analysis system, named GIS-based Transport Decision Support System, which provides a graphical analysis platform to transportation planners and researchers for transportation network analysis. The system has the functions of designing traffic networks on digital maps and doing traffic equilibrium analysis, as well as a novel, function to integrate local detailed structures of intersections into global networks. The latter is particularly useful for the analysis of large traffic network where the detailed local network structures of some intersections have to be taken into account. The system links great volumes of traffic data and geography information data accumulated for visualization traffic analysis. We added information data on the following: road structure data, zone geography information data and node geography information data. The system also enabled us to extract traffic data by road section and by specific condition.

articleTitle: The estimating models of assessing Forest Biomass using Remote Sensing Technology based on field investigation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Forest biomass models are important methods in assessing forest biomass at landscape, regional, and national scales, and play an important role in studying terrestrial carbon budget and global changes. Literature study on the estimation of Forest Biomass using Remote Sensing Technology, three common methods of forest biomass estimation based on field investigation were summarized, and shortages were analyzed. Based on these analyses, the development trend of forest biomass was pointed out.

articleTitle: The empirical study on the effect of ultimate controlling shareholders' excess control right on fund embezzlement
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering the tunneling and the propping synthetically, this paper studys the net effect of ultimate controlling shareholders' excess control right. This paper shows that the relationship between the excess control right on stockholders' meeting and the net fund embezzlement takes on U-shape relationship. In other words, with the increase of the excess control right on stockholders' meeting, the net fund embezzlement first decreases and then increases. The relationship between the excess control right on board of directors and the net fund embezzlement is just the same as the relationship between the excess control right on stockholders' meeting and the net fund embezzlement.

articleTitle: Trellis pre-coding in filtered multitone modulation system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A joint-design transceiver of filtered multitone modulation is proposed. The scheme combines Tomlinsom-Harashima pre-coding with trellis shaping and trellis coding to eliminate the inter-symbol interference of the FMT system, and thus obtains coding and shaping gain. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme could obviously improve the FMT performance.

articleTitle: To implement the LBGK model on parallel system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The LBGK method based on microcosmic model is a numerical method which can be used to solve partial differential equation and simulate fluid flow phenomena. It has these virtues such as parallel computing, easy disposal for geometry boundaries and simple arithmetic. By simulating the liquid-gas variation, this paper introduces in detail the steps of realizing Boltzmann model by calling the parallel MPI library functions, studies the parallel efficiency of Boltzmann model when we use different communication models and different region partitions.

articleTitle: Linear interference suppression for prestack seismic data based on curvelet transformation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking advantage of the characteristic of curvelet—multi-scale, locality, and directivity, a curvelet-based method for the suppression of linear interference in prestack seismic data is proposed. In this method, the seismic data is represented with curvelet by different frequencies and directors. By analyzing the curvelet coefficients, four different combinations between effective signal and linear interference are found. For the sake of reducing the damage of effective signal, a special solution is designed for each situation, according to the characteristic of the situation. It is shown from the simulation that with this method, the linear interference can be suppressed simply, rapidly and effectively, while minimizing the damage on effective signal.

articleTitle: A novel model of the cross-layer architecture for wireless ad hoc networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A model of architecture for cross-layer interactions is crucial to the design, analysis, and optimization of network protocols for wireless ad hoc networks. While a various number of research works have been conducted on different aspects of the cross-layer design, very little attention has been given to modeling the cross-layer design and standardizing the open architecture issues. This paper presents an in-depth analysis of information exchange, adaptation process, and delivery method for wireless ad hoc networks, and proposes a novel cross-layer conceptual architecture containing information manager and adaptation coordinate scheduler to satisfy the requirement of cross-layer interactions and adaptations.

articleTitle: Study of prediction algorithm based on grey neural network GMNN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, Grey model (GM) and artificial neural network (ANN) was employed to predict the alkalinity in sintering process. The fluctuation of data sequence is weakened by the grey theory and the neural network is capable of processing non-linear adaptable information, and the GMNN is a combination of those advantages. The result showed that prediction model has good precision and better generalization ability.

articleTitle: A method of generating global view texture images in 3D face modeling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Construction of 3D special face model with 2D face photographs has become the focus of study on 3D face modeling, in which generated texture will affect directly the sense of reality of the 3D face model. Based on the details of texture mapping and image stitching, a method of generating global view texture images in 3D face modeling is proposed in this paper. Firstly, it obtains overlap regions by means of column feature matching and confirms the regions according to the grey values, and then stitches the images accurately; Secondly, it blends the texture with weighted smoothing algorithm to eliminate image mosaic gaps; Finally, it tries the classic Laplacian pyramid method to get a new global-view face texture image, which makes the texture image more realistic and natural.

articleTitle: Investigation in the problems and countermeasure of women human resource development and management in Zhoushan fishing villages
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Women in the fishing village in Zhoushan are the main force for the economic development, and also the important part to pushing forward the construction of democratic politics and to taking part in the management of its social issues. However, there are certainly gaps of human resource development between women in the fishing village in Zhoushan and women in city and rural areas around Yangtze River Delta, which restrict the development of the women themselves, and harmonious development of the new fishing and farming society to a certain degree. In this article, the author makes a detailed investigation about educational level, the condition of learning and training, the channel to employment, the state of political participation, family status and leisure style, health condition and so on of the women in Zhoushan Island, so they can grasp the current situation of their human resource, such as amount, quality, structure and so on, then they can make an appropriate analysis about their cultural degree, professional skills, health status according to the specific situation. The research object of the paper is to promote to the development and utilization of the fishing village of woman human resources., offer assist measures by getting political support from government, human resource department and women's organization to promote the utilization of human resource of women in the fishing village and and accelerate the current pace of the construction about the new fishing village of Zhoushan.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Preliminary research on theory and experiment of microwave deresination for Pine wood
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis calculation of eccentric annular aperture throttle based on turbulent state
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With regard to the situation that there isn't a turbulence flow equation of eccentric annular aperture, an aperture throttle analysis calculation method based on turbulent state is provided. At first, the three-layer speed distribution formula of fluid in turbulent state is given by using boundary layer theory. When the aperture is lager than the eccentricity, the phenomenon that the transition layer and the logarithm layer may disappear is analyzed. The corresponding critical round angle equation is deduced inventively for the integral of the speed distribution of flow. The correctness of the turbulence flow equation of eccentric annular aperture is validated by comparing with CFD arithmetic solution, and the influence rule of the relative eccentricity on the pressure difference between two ends of the aperture and the possible heavy result are researched.

articleTitle: A study of aster GDEM denoising based on hydrological analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In Aster GDEM (Version 1), there exist some exceptional values which are much lower or higher than surrounding elevations in the area of high mountains and valleys. Due to the characters of noise in Aster GDEM, such as local and discrete form, irregular distribution and different noise intensity, this paper proposes a denoising method based on hydrological analysis. The shape and location of noises are extracted by using depress filling and peak clipping in hydrological analysis firstly. Then for the noise part, a new DEM is generated through interpolating contours. The experiment in North Shaanxi of China shows that this denoising method can remove most noises effectively without the premise of reducing DEM accuracy. Meanwhile the DEM denoised can maintain topographic characteristics very well.

articleTitle: Research on performance evaluation system of power based on sustainable development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This text mainly starts with the defect of traditional performance evaluation system of power and takes sustainable development view as the guidelines, then reconstructs performance evaluation system of power in the way of certain principle and method from finance, inside management, community responsibility, customer satisfaction, study and grow up, solving the problems of existing performance appraisal system. Only in this way can better reflect the requirement of enterprise's long-term sustainable development.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The consumption capital guidance's enterprise marketing pattern innovation studies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: 18 bit Delta-Sigma DAC in 0.18um CMOS process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Delta-Sigma Digital-to-Analog Converter ( Δ - Σ) is designed in Verilog HDL for stereo video system. This DAC supports 16-bit or 18-bit input data and includes an 8x digital interpolation filter followed by a 64x oversampled delta-sigma modulator. The modulator output controls the reference voltage input to analog low-pass filter. The architecture allows for adjustment of sample rate by changing the master clock frequency. This DAC is implemented in 0.18um CMOS process with the advantages of lower power consumption and higher performances demonstrated by chip test. It has been successfully used in practice.

articleTitle: Educational equipment replacement decision based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Educational equipment replacement needs to consider educational adaptability, technicality, maintenance, reliability, economy and other factors. In this paper, firstly, the index system diagram of educational equipment replacement was given and secondary fuzzy comprehensive judgment model of educational equipment replacement was established. The experts only judge their own areas of expertise. Secondly, in the process, the characteristics of different levels were fully considered. Expert scoring and Analytical Hierarchy Process method were used to determine weight. The weighted average of model was applied to fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Finally, the model was illustrated to be accurate and has great practical value.

articleTitle: A novel Particle Swarm Optimization with special boundaries restriction strategy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the performance of the recently proposed unified Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) with a novel boundaries restriction (BR) strategy is investigated on unstrained optimization problems. The BR strategy is to preserve feasibility of the encountered solutions in the process of different PSOs. The algorithms are illustrated on four well-known problems with promising results. Comparisons with the standard local and global variant of the methods are reported and discussed. To exhibit the performance of the new technique, simulations on the famous question min V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>(X,α) for distributing 5 points on the sphere are done. Numerical results are obtained, and the minimum energy of Thomsons problem min V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>(X, 1) = 6.47469149468816 is obtained.

articleTitle: A study on the impact of producer services on competitiveness of the automotive industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The theoretical analysis describes the impact of producer services in building and maintaining the competitiveness of the automotive industry. Using the China's input-output tables of 2002 and 2007, we find that the dependence of China's automotive industry on the emerging producer services of high knowledge-intensity and capital-intensity is rising. And in the future advanced producer services will be of great importance to the competitiveness of China's automotive industry.

articleTitle: The application of data mining technology in analysis of college student's performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data Mining is deeply data analysis method; it can take many goods to evaluate the high school students studying effectiveness. This paper take a high school computer department student's information analysis as an example, according to the implementatation of data mining program, realized the whole process of classification and excavation of the data completely. The process includes making sure the Data Mining target, collecting the data, preprocessing data, classifying and generating the classification rule. ID3 is used to generate a decision tree and post-pruning method is used to pruning the tree. And the according to the decision tree, the classification rule is obtained. The results of Data mining can guide teaching scientifically and improve the quality of teaching.

articleTitle: Commercial bank efficiency's empirical analysis based on the DEA — Malmquist model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper carries on an empirical analysis on productivity changes of 11 listed commercial banks in 2004-2009 by DEA-Malmquist model, explores the main reason and makes recommendations to improve total factor productivity(TFP). Since 2004, Malmquist index is at first increased and then decreased, remaining at a slowly rising trend of growth, and the main power source is technological change. From the composition point of view, accompanied by creativity of technology, products and other aspects, monetary policy and other financial operating environment are the main reasons that affect technology change; most commercial banks are in decrease return to scale or constance return to scale,so we should reduce redundancy and combine loss of the network to enhance TFP further.

articleTitle: Study on optimum scale of China's Outward Direct Investment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper studies the optimum scale of China's Outward Direct Investment (ODI) from two aspects: economic growth and economic security. On the basis of theoretic model, some calculation on statistics would show us the essential scale from the perspective of economic growth and the safety scale from economic security which go with our economic development. Then we will compare and analyze theoretic scales with realistic scale so as to propose a method for building an optimum scale of China's ODI. Generally speaking, China's ODI scale has been in safety condition in recent years. However, it is still far behind essential scale. Much more efforts should be made to promote ODI in order to give it full play in economic growth within safety scale.

articleTitle: Local-global algorithm for optimization of triangular image feature mesh
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the process of image resizing based on mesh deformation, the quality of mesh generated by feature-based mesh algorithm is not very good. In order to improve the quality of triangular mesh characteristic of the image structure, a novel mesh optimization algorithm is proposed which based on local-global iterative scheme. With mesh topology preserved, the algorithm moves node positions in a sense of certain optimality, which seeks to adjust the mesh triangles as equilateral as possible. Constraint conditions can be set to keep certain nodes without being moved. The experimental results demonstrate the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Village Infrastructure FDEA Evaluation Model and empirical
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: based on The Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method and the Data Envelopment Analysis method, this paper establishes the Village Infrastructure FDEA Evaluation Model and also takes one model village in Shaanxi province as an example. The results of model are corresponding with the subjective assessment which proves the FDEA evaluation model is scientific and advanced.

articleTitle: A distributed node self-monitoring mechanism in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Self-monitoring is an important mechanism for the security of wireless sensor networks. In this work we propose a novel distributed node self-monitoring mechanism for wireless sensor networks. Assuming a sensor node can detect the communications (sending message) of its neighboring nodes, we design a one-to-many self-monitoring mechanism, in which the selected nodes, named Monitor Nodes (MNs), can monitor their neighboring nodes. A distributed dominating set approximation algorithm is design to obtain the MN set. The cooperation among MNs guarantees all regular nodes (RNs) are monitored. However, the MNs may be compromised by external attackers and produces false alarms. To improve the one-to-many self-monitoring mechanism, we design a many-to-one dynamical monitoring approach to take the MNs under surveillance. The neighboring nodes of a MN are dynamically selected to monitor their MN. In the proposed mechanism, a node produces an alert when it detects abnormal behaviors of the node under surveillance. The sink node collects the alert messages to make judgment to the potential abnormal nodes. The proposed self-monitoring mechanism can be used to detect and position multiple inter-network attacks, including selective forwarding, black-hole and DoS. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed node self-monitoring mechanism.

articleTitle: Econometric analysis of the dynamic effect of fiscal expenditure shocks to the output
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we establish the research framework to study the dynamic shock effect of two-levels financial expenditure on output, by using 1979–2007 annual macroeconomic data and SVAR model, in order to analyze the effect of two-levels financial expenditure on output, and introduce private investment and consumption to the model to study the pathway which the fiscal expenditure variables effect output. The results show that the two impact response function of output have differences from each other, the reason is that the central and local financial expenditure have different focus areas which they invest in, so it is necessary to make sure the responsibility of all levels of government, in order to make the financial expenditure more effectual.

articleTitle: Study on construction engineering quality based on group factors theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By analysising a variety of factors that affect the quality of construction engineering quality, and using group factors theory, a group factors structural relations model that affect the project quality was established, the relationship between these factors and the degree that they impact on project quality was also analyzed. The results show that among those factors that affect the project quality, proprietor, investment and financing way, supervision, construction unit as well as bidding have the most far-reaching impact on project quality. The study also found that these five factors are mainly through construction supervision and building materials to play a role in project quality. So in order to improving the project quality, it is particularly important to seize these two points, and it is also important to monitor point of project quality.

articleTitle: Development of application system for mobile location-based services based on TDOA technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Location-based service (LBS) is a kind of mobile valueadded services in mobile communication systems. The development of mobile positioning techniques promotes application of LBS. This paper presents a type of architecture of LBS. In this architecture, TDOA positioning modules are appended into the mobile basestations in order to implement LBS. LBS gateway and application platform are two vital parts in this architecture. LBS gateway modules are added into MSC of the mobile communication networks. LBS application platform is similar to a mobile location server. TDOA positioning modules deal with rough location testing and simple data computing. LBS gateway is a comprehensive management device which processes location information related to the mobile users. LBS application platform incepts location information processed in LBS gateway, cooperates with the mobile terminal and sends location information to the mobile users by proper data format. LBS application platform is developed based on ArcIMS map server which provides a lot of APIs. The application programming flowchart for LBS is implemented in detail in this paper. The real testing in the mobile communication systems shows that the proposed LBS can provide exact location services for mobile users.

articleTitle: A study on the selection of China's regional leading high-tech industries by grey incidence analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the statistical data of some provinces or cities of China from 2003 to 2007, this paper established the selection criteria of regional leading high-tech industries and conducts empirical research by gray relational analysis. The results mainly showed that: Only on the basis of the regional advantages to develop the leading high-tech industries and the strategies of specialization and clusterization can regions resolve the problems of the homogeneous industrial structure and low level of competition and make high-tech industry play on regional economic growth.

articleTitle: Speech transcoding from AMR to G.729 in excitation domain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When speech communication happens between two networks which adopt different speech coding standards, transcoding is always needed. In the transcoding between coding standards based on code-excited linear prediction, the fixed codebook usually needs to search due to the different structures between them. A transcoding method in excitation domain from AMR in modes with different fixed codebook structures to G.729 is presented, including transcoding with and without periodicity enhancement. In this transcoding, besides the translation of LSPs, pitch delays, and gains of adaptive codebooks and fixed codebooks as usual, fixed codebooks of different coding standards with diverse codebook structures can be translated efficiently according to MMSE rule. Experiment results indicate that, the transcoding without periodicity enhancement has less computational complexity than that with periodicity enhancement, even much less than tandem transcoding, yet maintains similar speech quality. In most cases, their PESQ scores are very similar.

articleTitle: Retrieving wind field in vertical cross-section from phased-array radar echo movement
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The previously developed 2-dimensional simple adjoint method is upgraded to retrieve wind field in vertical cross-section from phased array radar rapid scans. The upgraded method includes two steps. First, the horizontal wind field is retrieved on the conical surface at each elevation angle of radar scan. Second, the vertical velocity field is retrieved with the horizontal advection terms given from the first step.

articleTitle: Study on the countermeasures of low-carbon transformation of construction industry in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Low-carbon construction is the inevitable development direction of the construction field in the process of dealing with the climate change. The essence of low-carbon construction is improving the energy efficiency, reducing the emission of greenhouse gas and then to achieve the purpose of energy saving. Starting with the energy consumption and CO2 emission situation in the construction field of China, this paper proposes the energy conservation and emission reduction paths in the construction field. At the same time, for the emission reduction paths, this paper respectively analyzes the strict construction energy-saving standards and the construction carbon emission reduction potential of the new energy and renewable energy sources. Lastly, according to the actual national conditions of China, this paper presents the technology and policy countermeasures for the development of low carbon construction.

articleTitle: Volatility transmission between Hangseng index futures and option markets
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By using bivariate EC-EGARCH model to test the daily data, the paper explore the information spillover effect between stock index futures and options markets. The results show that as follows: (1) there exists long-term balance between Hang-seng index futures and options prices; (2) the co-integration residual can explain the conditional return equation; (3) stock index option market plays a dominant role in price discovery.

articleTitle: Research on mobile robot mapping on binocular stereo vision system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
