abstract: Mapping is an important research direction in the field of robot navigation. Map represents the robot's working environment has very important effect on localization and path planning. Vision sensor is simple and reliable, and has been widely used in the field of mapping. The paper introduces the process in which the binocular stereo vision system is adapted to imitate the double eyes of mankind in order to realize computer vision. The autonomous mapping algorithm in this paper is based on GSOM (Growing Self-organizing Map) algorithm. By continuously increasing new neurons in the growth of network scale, the GSOM mapping algorithm applies a small number of SOM neurons to generate a topologic map describing the environmental characteristics. The experimental results show that: we applied GSOM algorithm to autonomously generate a topological map, which was accurately described by a small number of SOM neurons.

articleTitle: The filtering technology of spam based on Re-Study Bayes arithmetic
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Email has been one of the most important communication tools in modern society. Email spam has been around for more than a decade and its quantity greatly exceeds the ham. How to prevent spam spreading becomes an important problem and the anti-spam technology has become a hotspot both in research and industry area. This paper proposes a Re-Study Bayes method which uses information gain(IG) to calculate email characters and updates the characters set by re-study mode. By this method, the feature dimension is reduced, while the efficiency of extracting characteristics is highly improved. And the experiment in this paper gets more accurate results than previous methods.

articleTitle: Standardization research of forest resource database both at home and abroad
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Forest resource database construction is the most important parts of forest informatization, so its standardization will assist forest departments in protecting forest resource and improving utilization efficiency of forest resource. This article mainly discusses the standardization construction of home and overseas forest resources database. According to the comparison, Chinese government should strengthen management and integration of forest resource database construction. In addition, the paper provides suggestions of Chinese forest resource standardization and considers the obstacles in the way of Chinese forest informatization development.

articleTitle: Spectrum characteristic interpretation of wetland vegetation based on detrended canonical correspondence analysis ordination in Wild Duck Lake
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Relating the characteristics of vegetation surface features to patterns of reflectance is a vital stage in the interpretation of remotely sensed imagery. This study applied the survey of communities, and the spectrum characteristic measuring, the detrended canonical correspondence analysis (DCCA) to analyze the relationships of community types and its spectrum characteristic in Wild Duck Lake,China. The results are as follows: the DCCA expresses the gradients and the variation characteristics of the community structure and spectrum curve. The first DCCA axis represent variation in blue-green reflectance, and the second DCCA axis represent variation in near infrared reflectance. The diagonal of the DCCA represent the community types gradients, representing the space variation of submerged hydrophyte, free-floating hydrophyte, Ochtholydrophyte, hygrophyte and alttophyte. The spectral data are converted to simulate a GEOEYE-1 banset and corresponding band combination. There are significant relationship between vegetation space pattern and the gradient of ND12 and R14. The sensitivity of vegetation index to vegetation gradient are Normalzed vegetation index, Ratio vegetation index and Difference vegetation index.

articleTitle: A control method of the three-phase four-leg active power filter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper present a novel all-digital approach applied to three-phase four-wire active power filters, which is made up of a three-phase four-leg voltage source converters. The controller just detects main current and DC side capacitor voltage and duty cycle of the switches can be calculated simply. This controller has fewer measurement, higher robustness and simpler calculation as comparing to traditional controllers. Calculation method of the switch duty cycle is deducted on the base of mathematics model formed. Simulation result verify that the APF with proposed controller can compensate the harmonics, reactive power current and zero sequence current effectively.

articleTitle: Study on seawater metal corrosion modeling based on Partial Least-Square Regression
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The seawater environmental factors are high dimensional, with strong correlations, while the metal corrosion data are small sample. It makes metal seawater corrosion modeling difficult. The scheme of metal seawater corrosion modeling is given out based on Partial Least-Squares Regression. Adapting small sample, the multi-input, multi-output models for more than 20 metals are established to describe the metal seawater corrosive behavior comprehensively. In purpose of reduction the error of certain outputs individually, an improved components extracting principle is proposed, which combines the cross validation with individual relative percentage error judgment. It effectively reduces the error of certain appointed outputs to meet the engineering precision requirement. The modeling procedure facing small sample is simple and convenient, effective, error controllable individually. It could provide the balance between the modeling precision and model prediction accuracy. Therefore it is applicable for metal seawater corrosion modeling and the other situation similar.

articleTitle: Active rules termination analysis based on enhanced formula of a triggering cycle
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Current methods remain largely uncertain of rules termination decision. Some methods are based on a logical formula for a rule set, but only those non-updatable or finitely updatable variables can be contained in a formula. Some other methods are based on triggering and activation graphs, but they do not consider whether all rules of a triggering cycle can be executed infinitely within a single execution cycle. Most methods cannot conclude termination if a rule set contains only those cycles that can be executed a finite number of times. This paper explicates the concepts of activation path and the execution sequence of a triggering cycle and the method to construct a formula that is able to include updatable variables, many termination cases that cannot be determined by previous methods, can now be detected.

articleTitle: Quotient lattice and incremental construction of concept lattices
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Concept lattice which is the core data structure in formal concept analysis has proved to be a useful tool in many applied domains: machine learning, software engineering and information retrieval, etc. The problem of constructing concept lattices is extensively studied and among various kinds of algorithms published so far, incremental ones which incrementally update existing concept lattice with the inserted new object are of comparative advantage in execution efficiency. This article, on the basis of further study on incremental algorithms, develops quotient lattice theory and uses it to describe the relationship between original concept lattice and the new one. Furthermore, through construction of quotient lattice, a conclusion that all modified nodes and new nodes form a complete lattice with the same structure as the one formed by those corresponding ones in new concept lattice is drawn, which is helpful to deeply understanding of the inherent characteristics of generators and provides theoretical foundation for further improvement of such kind of algorithms.

articleTitle: A semantic geospatial service matching algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The service matching algorithm is key to service discovery. In this paper, according to the four-level matching algorithm, the geospatial services discovery algorithm is also designed, which uses hierarchy matching, and uses ontology classification tree in I/O matching to converse the ontology similarities into the distance between nodes. It is proved that the new algorithm not only differentiates the geospatial services matching level, but also differentiates the similarities between the identical matching level, and can meet the geospatial services discovery well.

articleTitle: Types of land use classification on the TM imagery—As Shenyang TM images of 2004 for an example
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The object of this paper is the classification of land coverage types of the Shenyang TM images of 2004. After introducing the brightness values of TM images and the methods of the classification of land coverage types, we classified the land types of the Shenyang TM images of 2004 in the methods of Supervised and decision tree using ENVI software. The results shows that the method of decision tree is more effective to distinguish classes some types whose reflective luminance are so similar that easy confused than Supervised. Decision tree will be further developed and applied.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of ISDMVG based on X3D
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on X3D which is the new generation internet 3D graphic standard <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, this paper studied the technology in the construction of a information system. The paper imported the layer method in GIS to the 3D modeling of the system. And also the optimization and conformity technologies were expatiated. From the aspect of system development, the construction with an instance of Information System of Dalian Maritime Virtual GeoPark (ISDMVG) was displayed.

articleTitle: Research on the multi carrier waves radiolocation systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The means that multi carrier waves are applied in traditional spread spectrum location system is researched. In transmitter, orthogonal carrier waves that modulated by several low speed narrowband signals that are divided from traditional extended signal are transmitted. In receiver, the demodulated high speed sequence is the same with the original one but has a difference in time. The range of between transmitter and receiver can be calculated by this time difference. Emulated results state that in the condition of using almost half bandwidth of the traditional extended location system, this means has the same performance with the traditional one and has higher frequency using rate.

articleTitle: Multi-agent information fusion based trust routing framework for mobile ad hoc network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile ad hoc network, security and trust are important to the network. Trust routing framework is the main issue in mobile ad hoc network. Trust routing is related to many factors such as hop number, node residual energy and node behavior. To use the multi-source information fully, multi-agent information fusion method is used to design trust routing framework. The definition of trust routing is proposed in the paper. Ad hoc On-Demand Distance Vector (AODV) routing protocol is used to validate trust routing framework, Route Reply (RREP) Message is extended to record node residual energy and behavior information. Ns-2 is used to simulate different network scenarios. Simulation results show that the trust routing framework can improve the efficiency of network and extend the service lifetime.

articleTitle: Price and advertising based information forecast in direct market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The focus of this paper is information forecast value and the profound impact it has in today's market. When a firm sells its new product through the direct market, the accuracy of marketing forecast information plays important impact on price and advertising spending, and thus expected profits. We develop a price-advertising model to see how the effect of marketing forecast information on the price and advertising spending, and expected profit are moderated by product quality, product acceptance of a direct market, and the customers' preference, respectively. Research results suggest that forecast information precision is more valuable when product quality is high and product acceptance of a direct market is large. It also suggest that the customers' preference does not affect the value of information at all.

articleTitle: The case study of a contingent diffusion theory model of adoption for the products
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: a contingent diffusion theory model is constructed based on Norton model after researching the relations of the contingent diffusion products and the substitution for successive generations products, and experimented by the example of the contingent diffusion of mobile, mobile Internet and 3G subscribers in Taiwan. Genetic algorithms is chosen to estimate the parameters of the contingent diffusion model rather than the traditional NLS(Non-Linear Least Squares). The paper draws the conclusions from the results of the experiment in the end: the contingent diffusion model is fitted well and gets better forecasts, so the rationality of the contingent diffusion model is proved.

articleTitle: Research on the NGN network security based on the IMS technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, NGN network based on IMS technology about its basic conception, characteristic and development status was studied. The architecture model of NGN was analyzed. Aiming at the status of network convergence, emphasis is put on the network access security and its implementation of NGN based on IMS.

articleTitle: Reliability-based robust optimization design for cantilever structure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Take the cantilever beam for example, Basic thought of reliability and roburt design are used to obtain the main dimension parameters of optimization reliability. The reliability sensitivity is added to the reliability-based optimization design model, combining reliability-based robust optimization design into multi-objective optimization question meeting reliability requirement, giving mathematical model of strength reliability-based robust optimization for cantilever structure which obey normal distributional parametric.

articleTitle: An energy-saving MAC protocol for Underwater Acoustic Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The life time of network is an important performance of Underwater Acoustic Networks(UWAN). The target of energy-saving technology is to improve the energy efficiency and prolong the life time. In this paper, energy-saving strategies in Data Link Layer are mostly discussed. Some existing MAC protocols are studied, the advantages and disadvantages of which are analyzed. Then an improved protocol is provided which not only bases on the former protocol but also superiors to it. The improved protocol optimizes the data receiving and sending strategy that can reduce the data collisions between nodes and improve the energy efficiency. The efficiency of the improved protocol is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Based on image processing recognition line system of high-voltage overhead lines
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Power system is an important pillar industry of national, Transmission line technology of high-voltage overhead lines is important and difficult to safe operation. This study introduced several major transmission line approach, and designed a system of transmission line based on image processing. The system uses computer image recognition technology and on-site sensors, automatically determine the abnormal power transmission lines, and alarm. Central control room staff can accurately determine the situation of field failures according to images and sensor information, and can selectively measures, and command a variety of linkage action.

articleTitle: Dimensions of financial liberalization in transition economies: A case of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In 2010, China proposed the strategy to accelerate transformation of economic development models in order to lay a base for sustainable development. In this paper, we definite transition economies as those economies transferring from socialist-centrally-planned economies to market-oriented economies. Basically, there are two kinds' types in transition economies, “big-bang” types as Russia and gradualism types as the mainland of China. There are serious problems in both types of transition economies. Russia have experienced economic recession in large scale. In contrast, the macroeconomic performance of China seems to be much better. But in its economic system, especially in its financial system, there are some unsolved problems besides non-performing loans, which had been one of the most critical problems for the system in history. The financial global crisis promoted China to enter a new transition stage so that there is demand to study the basic dimensions of financial liberalization. There are three dimensions in financial liberalization of transition economies, the developing dimension, the transitional dimension and what type of financial system should be chosen between the capital-market-oriented system and the bank-based system that has adopted by many new economies, especially the post-war Japan.

articleTitle: Performance assessment model for university subject leaders based on competency theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional evaluation methods to the subject leaders have single form and poor effect. Many universities still use low-level and batch-based appraisal management model centered at annual evaluation, which have more limited to the shallow research and is lack of specific measurements. We strive to combine quantitative and qualitative analysis, establishing performance assessment indexes system and using analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to determine the weight of each index is essential to construct competency model for subject leaders. Further examples have been evaluated in this essay which suggests the validity of model established for performance assessment of subject leaders.

articleTitle: Improving sparsely labeled text classification with data editing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an active semi-supervised framework combining with data editing is proposed to improve sparsely labeled text classification. It integrates semi-supervised learning with active learning, and fully utilizes the advantage of active learning by fusing it with a data editing technique. The algorithm works in an iterative fashion in which the steps of self-labeling, active labeling and editing are iterated alternatively. Active learning and data editing techniques are designed to cope with the training data bias and sparsity. According to our knowledge, the fusion of active learning with data editing technique to eliminate self-labeled noise is novel. Extensive experimental study on several real-world data sets shows the encouraging results of the proposed text classification framework for sparsely labeled text classification compared with several state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Research of position sensorless control for PMSM based on sliding mode observer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor(PMSM) field-oriented control system, the information of rotor position and speed are necessary in order to achieve high performance. This method is based on sliding mode observer theory using Lyapunov stability criteria. The proposed estimation method is implemented using a stator flux/current and a modified back Electromotive Force(EMF) observer connected in cascade. The flux/current observer based on sliding mode techniques ensures stator currents convergence while the modified back EMF observer provides accurate rotor position estimation at a wide range of motor speeds. Also the variations of the parameters, such as resistance and inductance variations are analyzed. Simulative results show that the observer is robust to parameter variation and able to observe the position of rotor so as to achieve sensorless vector control of PMSM.

articleTitle: Traffic forecast of multilayer Rough fuzzy traffic controller
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present a systematic approach to improved fuzzy traffic controller. Firstly, the choice of signal phases is determined by the traffic flows, then the fuzzy traffic controller based on Rough Sets is used to control the extension of the present green phase, the result of the simulation proves that the total delay can be less than the traditional control.

articleTitle: Study of embankment reinforced mechanism based on discrete-continuous coupling calculation method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Combination of respective advantages of discrete and continuous numerical methods, this paper developed a discrete-continuous coupled analysis method. Using the contact computation model to compute particle and the unit mutually contact action on discrete-continuous interface region. Through Particle Flow Code(PFC) and Fast Lagrangian Analysis of Continua(FLAC) Socket I/O connections, the two-dimensional discrete-continuous coupling computation can be realized. Based on the discrete-continuous coupling computational method, the reinforcement embankment carries on the coupling analysis. The results indicated that it can be realized the reinforced mechanism of geogrid treatment the old and new embankment, by using FLAC as external boundary condition, exerted on the discrete system PFC model. The geogrid plays the reinforcement role gradually from the embankment edge to the embankment center.

articleTitle: Incremental document clustering using Multi-representation Indexing Tree
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Incremental Document Clustering is a powerful technique for large-scale topic discovery from incremental documentation set. Indexing tree algorithm is advanced in efficiency. However, it tended to process spherical data. To address this problem, we present a novel Multi-Representation Indexing Tree (MRIT) algorithm for constructing a hierarchy that satisfies arbitrary shape clusters with a good performance. Compared with the Indexing tree algorithm, a cluster is decomposed into several sub clusters and is represented as a union of the sub clusters rather than the center of the cluster. Similarity of a document to one cluster is the distance to the nearest neighbor among the cluster's representative points. The experimental results on a variety of domains demonstrate that our algorithm can produce a quality cluster. It's insensitive to document input order, and efficient in terms of computational time.

articleTitle: Design and research of the teaching website for agricultural colleges
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This essay provides suggestions for teaching website planning of agricultural colleges, as well as supportive references for the design and improvement of the websites, on the basis of the study of status quo and characteristics of the design and construction of such websites for agricultural colleges.

articleTitle: Research on product innovation project risk identification thought
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Product innovation is the main way for the economic development of enterprise, but product innovation project is high ricky and uncertainty, so the risk assessment and management of product innovation project has become concerned about academic and business community. For the product innovation project, risk identification is the basis for risk assessment and the premise and key for establishing the risk assessment index system. This paper tries to do a study on the thought of product innovation risk identification based on product innovation features.

articleTitle: A research on improving the performance of OFDMA system by using DCT / IFFT structure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The overall performance of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) system is greatly affected by the peak-to-average power ratio(PAPR). To address the PAPR problem, a tone reservation(TR) method based on FFT/IFFT structure is discussed, then we propose to replace FFT by the fast discrete cosine transform(DCT) which could reduce the computational complexity. Moreover, the experiments prove that the system bit error rate(BER) will not be affected and higher PAPR reduction can be achieved.

articleTitle: Displacement forecast of rockstrata around deep roadway under dynamic pressure utilizing PSO-BP network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering the main affect factors of displacement of rockstrata around deep roadway under dynamic pressure, using PSO-BP and BP network respectively to forecast the displacement of rockstrata around deep roadway under dynamic pressure. As a result, it comes to a conclusion that the convergence speed and the predicted accuracy of PSO-BP network are obviously better than that of BP network.

articleTitle: Pilot interval design for linear interpolated channel estimation in SC-FDE system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the effects of pilot interval design on linear interpolated channel estimation in single carrier frequency domain equalization(SC-FDE) system. Based on the properties of noise accumulation and fading channel correlation, the optimal pilot interval design is proposed. Simulations are finished over the four-ray Rayleigh channel, and the results prove that the proposed method is finally practicable. The experiential value of the optimal pilot interval is given, and is provided reference for engineering design.

articleTitle: Attenuated iterative reliability-based decoding algorithm for LDPC codes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An attenuated iterative reliability-based majority-logic (AIML) decoding algorithm for low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes is proposed. This novel algorithm is devised based on the orthogonal check-sums of the one-step majority-logic decoding algorithm in conjunction with certain of reliability measures of the received symbols. The computation of reliability measure of the syndrome sum is refined by introducing an attenuation factor. Simulation results show that in binary input-additive white Gaussian noise channel, the AIML algorithm outperforms other popular iterative reliability-based majority-logic decoding algorithms with a slight increase in computational complexity. With maximum iterations five and fifty, the AIML algorithm can achieve almost identical error performance for LDPC codes. No error floor effect can be observed for AIML algorithm down to the bit error rate (BER) of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup>, while error floor appears for sum product algorithm (SPA) around the BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−7</sup> even with maximum iteration 100. The inherent feature of parallel decoding for AIML algorithm enforces the decoding speed in contrast to those serial decoding schemes, such as weighted bit-flipping algorithm.

articleTitle: Modeling and optimization of Web service process based on Petri net
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Web service is a service-oriented distributed computing model, which provides a platform-independent, self-described, distributed software component. It is a loose-coupled and application interoperability platform to implement business processes. The key goal of Web service composition is integration and collaboration of Web service process. And, the Web service process model plays an important part in integration and collaboration. With the advantages of formal semantic definition, visually graphical expression, rigorous mathematical foundation and description based on state, the Petri net is more and more widely applied to model and optimize the workflow process. We establish web service process model based on Petri net, then we verify and analysis the correctness of the model of Petri net with strong analytical skills and means. A practical application of the Web service process modeling based on Petri net is presented in this paper. We convert the actual business processes into Petri net model and use reachability and dynamic simulation to verify the correctness of the model to achieve the desired results.

articleTitle: Expert system for steel plant accident processing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of accident processing in steel plants, the expert system for steel plant accident processing (ESSPAP) was established. In ESSPAP, knowledge was acquired from experts in manufacturing management, production operators, anticipation plan manuals, and logistics control models. The knowledge was represented by semantic network. Moreover, the nodes in the semantic network were expanded into two-dimensional and three-dimensional frames. Accident anticipation plans were represented by production rule. Reasoning strategies and search strategies were used to knowledge reasoning. Two evaluating indicators (coverage rate and accuracy rate) were put forward to assess ESSPAP. According to the simulation results, ESSPAP has higher response speed (≤10 s) and accuracy rate (93%) than steel production management experts. ESSPAP can improve the efficiency of accident processing and reduce losses caused by accidents.

articleTitle: The countermeasures study of enhancing the core competence of enterprises by knowledge management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the era of knowledge economy, knowledge and knowledge management is a key factor of constituting the core competence of enterprises and a basis of the formation of core competence. It can enable enterprises to be an invincible position in the fierce competition that knowledge management will be involved in building the core competence. This paper firstly analyzes and summarizes the concepts of the knowledge management and core competence, based on this, analyzes the main content of the knowledge management of Chinese enterprises; secondly, it analyzes important roles of the knowledge management to the formation of the core competence of enterprises; Finally, based on the relations between the constituent elements of the core competence of enterprises and knowledge management, the paper proposes the countermeasures of enhancing the core competence of enterprises by knowledge management..

articleTitle: Computer simulation about three dimensional random structure model of karstic rock
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Karstic rock contains many karst caves, which determines the engineering characteristics of the whole rock in a large extent. Ellipsoid is adopted to simulate the karstic caves in this paper. Firstly, mathematical description of the three-dimensional geological rock mass that is the carrier of the karstic caves is given. Secondly, the determination of the shape and size of ellipsoid is introduced and the method of generating complex caves is discussed also. Thirdly, the mathematic model of three-dimensional random caves and the mathematic description of the deterministic caves are discussed in detail. Lastly, a real three-dimensional random structure model of karstic rock based on actual observation record is given. The mathematic model for three-dimensional random caves of karstic rock put forward in this paper provides visualization means for the study of karstic rock, so it can be very helpful to the engineering activity of karstic rock.

articleTitle: Research and design on Transmission Power Network Maintenance Plan Arrangement algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes mathematical model of Transmission Power Network Maintenance Plan Arrangement algorithm, and designs Transmission Power Network Maintenance Plan Arrangement on Ant Colony algorithm, which is TPNMPAAC algorithm for short. The paper analyzes the constraints existing in TPNMPAAC algorithm, and presents information element renewal strategy at the time the wrong search path occurs as well as computational method of heuristic function value.

articleTitle: Survey of SVG_based representaion and construction of spatial data in LBS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) used in Location Based Services (LBS), the presentation and organization of spatial data based SVG became a burning question. The paper extracted the key technologies about presentation and organization of SVG_based spatial data according to the trend of development. The main points concluded acquisition of SVG data, presentation of attributes, construction of spatial data, and compression of SVG data etc. The paper also pointed out some current problems and research orientations in the future in some areas which concluded transform from multiple heterogeneous data to SVG data, presentation and construction of SVG_based data, and data compression etc. The paper can serve as a guide to used SVG in LBS.

articleTitle: Design of vinyl chloride dehydration-type hydrocyclone based on test research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vinyl chloride(VCM) and water were be the research objects, by changing the swirl cone angle and inlet flow, Phase Doppler Particle Analyzer (PDPA) was used to test the hydrocyclone's flow field. By comparative analysis its internal laws, the best operating conditions of vinyle chloride dehydration were obtained. A 35mm diameter VCM dehydration-type liquid-liquid hydrocyclone was developed, and it was used in PVC production industry, product quality and devices continuous operation were improved. Significant economics and social benefits were obtained.

articleTitle: An introduction to a new entrepreneurship education method—camp model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Important factors that determine the emergence of new start-ups are the existence of the individuals' entrepreneurial motivation, knowledge and skills. Entrepreneurship education (EE) plays an important role in developing these attributes. The paper tries to claim that future EE should desist from simply teaching knowledge on business creation and rather focus on experiencing entrepreneurship. A new EE method—the camp model is introduced.

articleTitle: Research on storing raster metadata in spatial database
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Storage of raster metadata is a key topic in spatial database. Although there are a few of abstract standards on raster metadata, there is not implement standard about it. This paper concludes three storage models implemented in current spatial databases and discusses their advantages and disadvantages. After that analyzing, the paper proposes a mixed storage method which is used the relational table to store structured metadata and used XML to store non-structured metadata, and gives its implementation solution.

articleTitle: Implementing Ad hoc On-demand Multipath Distance Vector routing protocol in Linux
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-path routing protocol attracts more and more attention because the routing performance can be improved by making use of advantages of multi-path routing protocol, such as fault-tolerant and load balance. To validate multi-path routing protocol in real environment, the Ad hoc On-demand Multipath Distance Vector (AOMDV) routing protocol is implemented in Linux based on AODV-UU. The functions of AOMDV protocol are implemented in user space, and the interaction with the kernel is implemented based on Netlink and Netfilter. Experimental results validate the implementation of AOMDV.

articleTitle: Design of the web services platform for the self-driving tour
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: First, the advantages and disadvantages of the services platform for the self-driving tour were analyzed in the paper. On this basis, using a variety of tools and software modules, the web services platform was designed based on Windows XP. Then, the scheme and web services platform elements were introduced. The platform can basically meet the current needs of the domestic self-driving tour market and users can master all kinds of information without leaving home. The platform can run properly by testing on the server of all more than Windows XP systems.

articleTitle: An empirical study on location selection for ODI of China's bulk commodities an example of agricultural products
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: First, we selected the data of 71 countries, from 2003 to 2008, to verify the relationship between Chinese agricultural enterprises' outward direct investment (ODI) and the exports of agricultural products. The results indicate that the above two is positively related. Second, we built a panel data model, using the data of 64 countries from 2003 to 2007, to indirectly study the factors which influence location choice of Chinese agricultural enterprises' ODI. The conclusion is that GDP, GDP per capital, arable land per capita of the host countries significantly effect Chinese agricultural ODI. Finally, we borrowed the method of principal component analysis to decide each factor's weight and deduced an assessment formula. Then, we figured out the index and made the location choice.

articleTitle: Equilibrium research between “winner's curse” and seller's earnings in uniform-price synchronization auctions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The auction mechanism of spectrum has become a key point in China with the issuance of 3G licenses and the coming of 4G. The uniform-price synchronization auctions which aim to reduce the risk of “winner's curse” is proposed in this paper. Though the signal correlation model of bidders, this paper discuss the seller's profit equilibrium when bidders are restricted to bid only one or multiple bands. This equilibrium study which can reduce the risk of “winner's curse” and guarantee the seller's earnings will be a theoretical reference for spectrum auctions in China.

articleTitle: The novel arithmetic and realization based on FPGA module design for the real time compensation of the reset error in FOG
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce the size of the processing circuit, and realize the real time compensation of the reset error in fiber optic gyro (FOG). A new arithmetic and realization base on field programmable gate array (FPGA) is presented in this paper. At first the reset error and the insufficiency of usual compensation scheme are analyzed. Then a novel arithmetic which based on binary algebraic operation is described. And the functional design of arithmetic implementation was completed by using modular design method. Thus the embedded module substitutes part of the processing circuit, and the small volume, light weight, low power consumption are achieved. At last the function of the module was tested, and the result indicates that the arithmetic and implementation are valid and available.

articleTitle: Parallel matrix algorithm autotuner on multi-core architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper develops a performance autotuner of the parallel sparse matrix multiplication algorithm. This autotuner can utilize the cache characters of multicore computers. It can optimize the value of performance parameters in multicore and achieve the better performance of parallel matrix multiplication algorithm. This paper proposes a parallel matrix multiplication algorithm by Using the CSR compression and cache blocking technology. The cache blocking parameters are optimized to get the better performance. From the matrix experiments, we can consult that the autotuner system can achieve the sparse matrix multiplication algorithm better performance on the multicore hardware.

articleTitle: A multi-factor integrated fault diagnosis method for distributed applications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fault management is a key research part in the field of distributed applications management. Fault Management based on active probing is divided into two phases: fault detection and fault diagnosis, considering probe costs in these two phases, this paper proposes two algorithms: PSFD and PSFL. Finally, MATLAB is used as the experiment platform and BNT toolkit is adopted. Simulations show the effectiveness of the algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and establishment of mineral geography database based on Geodatabase
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The data structure of GIS is complex and it is difficult for the traditional GIS data model to express the existence of unstructured data. Meanwhile, traditional GIS data model can not express the complex relationship such as inheritance and aggregation which widely used in GIS. This article will propose a new way of establishing mineral geography data model based on Geodatabase. Through the analysis minerals geography data, the division feature classes and the definition of feature classes and relationship classes, the characteristics of mineral dynamic data structures will be analyzed on the base of Geodatabase data structure. The objects, elements and the corresponding relationships between spatial entities will be established by the use of UML and CASE tools. The mineral geography database will be automatically generated and the accuracy of mapping relationships between data will be ensured by the use of this method.

articleTitle: Factors constraining the adoption of e-commerce among China's small and mid-sized enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of internet technologies, e-commerce has already become a common practice among Chinese small and mid-sized enterprises. This research, based on an empirical survey in Wuhan, examines the external as well internal factors affecting small and mid-sized enterprises' adoption of e-commerce, and discovers that small and mid-sized enterprises' present technological capacities, organizational goals, external environment and enterprise culture may take a positive impact on their decision-making process.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm with simulated annealing for laser antimissile optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A dynamical laser antimissile problem is solved based on genetic algorithm with simulated annealing considering the real time application. When faced with multiple attacking targets, it is clearly important for the laser antimissile system to determine the sequence of the attacking targets to be intercepted so that the maximum attacking targets are destroyed. Conceptually, this laser antimissile problem can be seen as a dynamical traveling salesman problem, which is much harder than a pure traveling salesman problem. There are many barriers for finding the global optimal solution, especially when the number of the targets is greater than six. The genetic algorithm has the capability of searching in wider space. While the simulated annealing algorithm can jump from the local optimal solution. Therefore, the combination of the genetic algorithm and the simulated annealing algorithm has their merits. Taking ten targets as an example, the simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has the better property and can be used in the real application.

articleTitle: A study on wetland change information image segmentation based on remote sensing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the region-based image segmentation method is adopted to segment the remote sensing images after continuous analyzing and testing. The author extracts the wetland information from the remote sensing image by region-based image segmentation, and compares the segmentation results with the interpretation results by conventional methods. According to the result of the comparison, the author evaluates the image segmentation accuracy based on the common evaluation criteria that are used to evaluate the image segmentation. After analyzing the result of the segmentation evaluation, the author confirms the reliability that wetland information is extracted from the remote sensing images through the methods of region-based image segmentation.

articleTitle: Metallogenic prognosis with multi-information based on MapGIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As prospecting has become an increasingly difficult activity, it is gradually developing towards a method of metallogenic prognosis with Multi-information that comprehensively integrates geological, geophysical, geochemical and remote sensing data. MapGIS has become an effective tool for the inside multi-information retrieval and integration, as well as metallogenic prognosis with diversifying information. In the process of metallogenic prognosis with MapGIS it will be carried out on the basis of summary of regional metallogenetic regularity and under the guidance of metallogenic theory. Data acquisition, geological unit division and abstraction of diversifying prospecting information including geological, geophysical, geochemical and remote-sensing data can be implemented by MapGIS, so as to analyze metallogenic favorability degree, delimitate favorable prospecting sections and realize metallogenic prognosis.

articleTitle: The application of Monte Carlo computer simulation in investment risk analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By constructing the suitable model and using Monte Carlo simulation methods, the randomness and uncertainties can be processed efficiently and analyzed in the decision and analysis of investment risk, which makes up the deficiencies of traditional decision-making tools and provides a good solution ideas for investment risk decision-making.

articleTitle: Use human resource brand to gain competitive advantage
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Human resource brand predicts the trend of human resource management. This article, based on illuminating connotation, has analyzed functions of human resource brand, generalized procedures for constructing human resource brand. At knowledge economy times, human resource brand is able to brand winning. We should pay attention to it to help us gain competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Matter-element model of quality evaluation of railway project based on supply chain thoughts
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the railway construction project quality evaluation involves many complex features, though using the supply chain thoughts and extension theory and analyzing the influence factors of the project quality, The matter-element model was put forward based on supply chain thoughts, Which applied to high-speed rail project quality evaluation, We found that this model can be more concise and reflect the quality of the rail project level.

articleTitle: Effect of employees' turnover rate on industrial firms' production efficiency: A conceptual model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a widespread phenomenon in modern industrial firms, turnover is exerting much stronger effect. Aiming at some studies and many practitioners think that the employees' turnover rate influences industrial firm production efficiency negatively, the paper makes investigation on the relationship between the production efficiency of industrial firm and the turnover rate of employees by a conceptual model. The model shows that the relationship between the two is somewhat like an inversed U-shaped curve, which indicates that when the turnover rate is lower than a certain level of the turning point, there is positive relationship between them, otherwise turnover rate has the negative effect on production efficiency of industrial firm. For industrial firm managers, the employees' turnover rate should be controlled within a certain range in order to improve industrial firm production efficiency; on the contrary, with the increase of employees' turnover, industrial firm production efficiency will collapse.

articleTitle: The innovation of based on game theory Management Mechanism in the Price of Banking Services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the current problems of development of china's banking industry, service competition, competitive advantage and so on. Based on the current situation analysis of banking services market, trying to use the game theory analysis of modern industrial organization theory guides the innovative approach of Management Mechanism in the Price of Banking Services. Propose the application and effect of the game theory in pricing strategies for specific services. And then put forward innovative proposals of banking services.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis of high-voltage circuit breaker based on the improved BP neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High-voltage circuit breaker is the most important control and protection equipment. Doing fault diagnosis to high-voltage is very important to realize the power system stable and reliable running. The improved BP neural network momentum gradient descent algorithm was used in high-voltage fault diagnosis comparing with traditional BP neural network in this paper. The simulation indicated that this algorithm makes the fault diagnosis more accurate and functional through adjusting the learning rate and weights.

articleTitle: Tourism industrial development strategic research of Shenyang economic region
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The regional economies integration has become a trend to promote socio-economic development. As the region's economic development components, tourism industry are taking into an active role which is played by the increasingly manifest. Shenyang economic region's preparations and constructions are gradually taking shape, therefore a reasonable co-ordination about tourism resources within the region and scientific planning & development should be the only way to achieve sustainable development of tourism industry within the region and also an effective protection to promote this region's harmonious development.

articleTitle: Design of RTD-based programmable logic gate and its application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Resonant tunneling diode (RTD) is nowadays considered the most mature type of quantum device which is used in high speed and low-power circuits. This paper presents a novel topology of RTD-based programmable logic gate (PLG) and takes three-variable PLG as an example. Then a realization algorithm is introduced to implement Boolean functions using PLG. They also can be used in nanopipelined architectures as a basic element for the design of complex functions.

articleTitle: Research on innovation policy system of regional clusters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Regional clusters have different characteristics of industry, of product and of technology, the area manager has to poise itself on the balance between economic efficiency and corresponding costs. This paper analyzes the innovation dynamic mechanism of enterprises in the system by using mathematical models, searches for the influence factors of innovation development of enterprises, and based on the above contents, this paper also designs an innovation policy system of regional clusters to give references to governments for perfecting innovation system and developing regional economy.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Task Management system for large-scale Virtual Screening applications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Virtual Screening (VS), a productive and cost-effective technology in quest for novel lead compounds, is a new approach in the pharmaceutical industry. This kind of applications belongs to the family of large scale loosely coupled parallel applications, whereas concurrent tasks are independent of each other, and are most suited to run on the Grid environments. However, there are some important practical issues should be investigated, namely, the complicated scale of VS applications with diverse data sets, complexity of Grid Job Description Language and dynamic and heterogeneous grid environments. In this paper we propose a Comprehensive Task Management in the context of performing VS applications on Grid environments. First, we propose an extension of the Job Submission Description Language (JSDL) to specify the large scale data set packet strategy and a visual Task Editor to make the complexity of underlying task description transparent. Then we provide a coordinating mechanism to integrate multiple Grid platforms for VS applications. Furthermore, we present a task-level predictive model on estimating of execution time from historical information. Finally, we conduct a case study on discovering leads drug against Avian Influenza Virus H5N1 to highlight technical feasibility of our proposal.

articleTitle: Study of the monitoring model for securities trading network Quality of Service
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the context of modern high-speed internet network,monitoring model is often complicated by the notion of guaranteed Quality of Service (QoS). we first analysis the conventional network quality of service,then we proposed a monitoring model for securities trading network quality of service,the main functions include network quality of service monitor, fault alarm,analyse and so on which can better support the critical business traffic through information collection, storage, analysis etc in the network equipment of securities trading network. The monitoring model includes five parts: network infrastructure layer, the data acquisition layer, data storage layer, real-time alarm layer and monitoring the business logic layer. Meanwhile,we give the system hardware architecture, software architecture and the flow chart of SNMP collect module and sFlow collect module. This proposed monitoring model is well suited for various applications and has good prospects.

articleTitle: Research on teaching experimental platform design for intrusion detection courses
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Intrusion detection (IDS) and intrusion prevention (IPS) are important technology means to ensure the security of e-commerce. The IDS course construction whose target is the training of e-commerce security professionals also needs developing synchronously. IDS and IPS courses applying to e-commerce security combine theory with practice closely. The perfect teaching experiment platforms are essential for students to do the e-commerce security-related experiments. In this paper, according to the characteristics of e-commerce, we researched and designed the corresponding application-oriented teaching experiments and implemented a completely controllable e-commerce IDS courses experimental platform, which can help students grasp the course contents and obtain the practical skills.

articleTitle: DEA-based performance evaluation and sustainable research on securities firms' CAMS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper, based on data envelopment analysis (DEA) method, carried out a performance assessment of the CAMS between 2007 and 2009 in China. The results showed that too high operating costs and too much investment risk are the main reasons for inefficiency.

articleTitle: The influence of urbanization on the land resource security in Jiangsu province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the influence of urbanization on the land resource security, and examined how to ensure the process of urbanization in while to ensure the security of land resources. Methods employed include system analysis method and combining qualitative and quantitative approach. The results indicate that urbanization of Jiangsu province is undergoing a well rapid stage, which rises economic power of Jiangsu Province, and leads to the security of land resources becoming increasingly prominent. The rapid development of urbanization, industrialization led to the degradation of land quality and ecological function, such as the falling sharply quantity and quality of arable land, soil pollution soil erosion, etc. The conclusion is that, empirical research based on Jiangsu Province is enhanced the theory and maneuverability of urbanization and land resources of security studies. and the paper put forward practical measures according to the problem of land security in the process of urbanization.

articleTitle: Comparison of factors influencing job satisfaction in domestic and foreign banks in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The present study has been designed to examine the main factors that affect job satisfaction of two foreign banks and two state-owned banks in Shanghai, China. The banks were selected and from each organization 75 subjects were selected randomly. A questionnaire developed by Lujia (2001) was used for ascertaining the most important and different factors that influence job satisfaction in 4 organizations with different cultural background. Data were analyzed employing Spss13.0. five factors were found significantly different from one another. The result indicates that lower salary level and less welfare schemes, unfair promotion policies, lower social status, organization commitment and personal fulfillment make the job dissatisfaction of domestic banks lower than foreign banks.

articleTitle: The mechanism of how Transactive memory system influences team performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the former researches about transactive memory system and team performance, this article argues the relationship between team member, expertise, team stability, trust, communication and specialization, credibility, coordination of Transactive memory systems. Added team size as a control variable and task complexity as a moderator, we build a rudimentary model to show the mechanism that how TMS influences team performance, and hope it will help the following theoretical and empirical study.

articleTitle: Dynamic causal relationships between energy consumption and SO2 emissions in Jiangsu, China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Jiangsu Province, with high energy consumption, has showed an upward trend in SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions between 1985 and 2007. To quantify the dynamic causal relationships among SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions and some energy consumption indicators in Jiangsu, such as the total energy consumption, energy structure and energy efficiency, Vector Auto-regression (VAR) Models are established, and impulse response function (IRF) as well as variance decomposition are adopted to describe the dynamic processes of the above energy consumption factors influencing SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission and their dynamic interactions. The results and their policy implications are as follows: (1)industrial SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions will make a fluctuant and gradually weakening response to the changes of energy consumption factors; (2)the evolution of industrial SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions mainly results from its dynamic interaction with the total energy consumption and energy structure; (3) the growth control of energy consumption could help reduce the total SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> generation; (4) in the short term, the promotion of energy efficiency could benefit the growth control of energy consumption, as well as the reduction of generation rate of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>; in the long term, Jiangsu energy structure should be greatly changed, that is, more and more clean and renewable energy are used instead of fossil fuel, in order to arouse the long-acting effect of energy structure change on the reduction of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions.

articleTitle: Estimating the size of applications in MDA environments
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software effort estimation is a significant challenge for software management. This paper mainly focuses on a Functional Size Measurement procedure for Object-Oriented applications generated in MDA environments based on COSMIC-FFP. According to COSMIC-FFP version 3.0, this procedure is divided into three phases: strategy phase, mapping phase and measurement phase. Firstly, the mapping rules and measurement rules are summarized upon previous research results. Then, a case study is introduced to interpret the measurement process in brief. Finally, an idea about improving Object-Oriented conceptual models is proposed combining with the practical measurement procedure.

articleTitle: Dynamic game analysis of Indirect Financing Difficulties for SMEs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Indirect Financing Difficulties for SMEs is a widespread problem, which is even more prominent and complicated in China because of lags of the reform and imperfectness of the financing system. Based on the background of China's macro economy in the period of transition, the paper tends to analyze indirect financing difficulties for SMEs in order to draw some inspiring conclusions by establishing the dynamic game model of bank-enterprise relations.

articleTitle: Research of phase-to-ground Fault Location in the distribution line based on Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The phase-to-ground fault occurs frequently in power system, Fault Location is a knotty problem for a long time. This paper presents a novel method to get Fault Current between Adjacent Nodes according to the characteristic of transient current based on WSN (Wireless Sensor Networks). It is used to identify and locate the current fault. The power system is divided into pieces by WSN nodes that could sense the transient three-phase current and identify the fault information based on communication between adjacent nodes. The principle of arranging WSN nodes is also presented. Through the simulation in Matlab, it shows that the method could extract the fault component correctly bypass the influence of variant load and harmonic.

articleTitle: Digital wire-feeding system based on fuzzy adaptive PI control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The relationship between armature induced voltage and speed of wire-feeding motor in buck chopper PWM speed-control system is analyzed. A pulse-width modulation (PWM) speed-control system based on digital control is used to adjust the speed of wire-feeding motor, which can eliminate the effect of load current on the speed of wire-feeding by sampling armature voltage synchronously at the moment of zero current. The fuzzy adaptive PI regulation method is used for adjusting the PWM duty-cycle to change the armature induced voltage and the motor speed. The test results show that fuzzy adaptive PI regulation can improve the startup performance of wire-feeding motor and get better regulation performance and smaller overshoot rather than traditional PI regulation.

articleTitle: Application of radar data in a squall line simulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: June 14, 2009, in Anhui province and Jiangsu province, there was a squall line weather process which causes the thunderstorms, hail and high winds and other severe convective weather. Based on the radar echo and NCEP reanalysis data of 0.5°×0.5° with the 6h interval, a squall line event in the large scale and meso-scale weather background were analyzed comprehensively. The radar echo displays “bow” shape, with a clear outflow boundary (gust front) in the front of it. Corresponding to the bow echo in reflectivity factor echo, the velocity echo shows significant mid-level radial convergence (MARC), indicating strong wind in surface afterwards. It is found with analyzing of squall-line convective cells within the overall evolution that the squall line is shaped by the joint type of discontinuity line and line of rearward continuity, and partial disturbance of the strong convective weather provides a trigger mechanism. In addition, the squall line is successfully simulated using WRF model. By analyzing the evolution of squall line system and the precipitation region, it is shown that WRF model possesses the capability of simulating the squall line; contributes to the characteristics and evolution of squall line mechanism analysis.

articleTitle: Network sniffer component program design based on promiscuous pattern
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The computer network fault diagnosis is the important information technology. This article introduces the network sniffer component program design method based on the promiscuous pattern. This way can solve some fault problem in the local area network through the analysis of the TCP/IP communication protocol. The sniffer program scheme and the data capture program module by Visual C++ can be showed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on combined asymmetric AdaBoost for face detection
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Face detection is a widely studied topic in computer vision. Despite of its great success, several key problems are still unresolved for AdaBoost algorithms: how to select the asymmetric weak learners and how to combine added sample sets.In this paper,a new combined asymmetric AdaBoost algotithms is proposed to make improvement in the two aspects.First we select the asymmetric weak learners by computering sample distribution of positive sample and negative sample. Second,we combine the added sample sets by boosting chain. Last, we have used this new method for face detection. Experiments with synthetic and real scene data sets show our algorithm outperforms conventional AdaBoost.

articleTitle: Compact trapezoidal antenna for ultra-wideband applications with band-notch filter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel compact trapezoidal ulra-wideband (UWB) antenna with frequency notch characteristic which is fed by a 50 microstrip line is proposed and investigated. Details of the antenna design and simulation results on the return loss, voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) and the E-and H-plane radiation patterns of the proposed antenna are presented. The antenna is very small in size, only 0.15λ square at 3GHz. By etching a complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) in the radiating patch near the feeding point, a very sharp notched band of 4.8GHz–5.4GHz with return loss larger than −7dB at which the wireless LAN service is assigned is obtained. The −10dB return loss bandwidth of the proposed antenna is 3GHz–12.4GHz covering the entire band assigned for the UWB application, which is about 122% with respect to the center frequency of 7.7GHz. The radiation patterns of the proposed antenna are not deteriorated by the inclusion of the CSRR and are relatively stable over its operating band.

articleTitle: Rough rule extraction of extension group decision-making under incomplete information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and the reliability of data mining of extension group decision-making by making comparison, selection and identification of objects under incomplete information, this paper studies extension classification, attribution reduction, rule extraction and data forecast of extension group decision-making based on combining extension transformation and group decision optimization. Not only does this method take the advantages of dynamic classification and data mining, but also achieves the promotion of the classification results of multi-factor analysis and multi-project evaluation in extension group decision-making.

articleTitle: DSP-based high-power semiconductor laser fully digital temperature control system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To eliminate the great influence of temperature variation on the high-power semiconductor laser, we propose an approach using digital temperature sensor to control the temperature of the laser. Compared to the traditional analog temperature sensor RTDS, the digital temperature sensor has an advantage of high sensitivity, linearity, fast response and easy use. This system contains a digital signal processing (DSP) device TMS320LF2407 as the central processor and a 12-bit D/A converter as high-precision converter. To regulate the laser temperature, we use Fuzzy-PID algorithm instead of conventional PID algorithm to control the output power of thermoelectric cooler (TEC). We perform the experiment of setting the characteristic temperature of the laser as 25.0 □ with the designed control system. The results show that the regulation time can be reduced to 50 s, and the stability of temperature is better than ±0.1 □.

articleTitle: A target localization method for soccer robot based on Omni-directional vision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Target localization for soccer robot based on Omni-directional vision is considered. The vision system of the MT-R robot is described. For Omni-directional vision, the target is recognized from the image through the threshold value division method. The corresponding relationship of the target position between the image coordinate and the robot coordinate is analyzed. The method of image polar coordinate transforming and piece-wise defined Lagrange interpolation for target location is adopted. Experiments have been carried out on the soccer robot M-TR for the ball recognition. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed localization method.

articleTitle: The forest vegetation NPP spatial pattern analysis of Jing-Jin-Ji region
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The estimation of vegetation net primary production (NPP) is the basis and important content of global carbon cycling research. The development and application of remote sensing technology provided a new method for the estimation of NPP. Based on the application of remote sensing and GIS technology, using the improved Carnegie Ames Stanford Approach (CASA) model, the vegetation NPP of Jing-Jin-Ji region in 2004 was estimated. And on this basis, this paper analyzed the forest vegetation NPP spatial pattern in the study area, including the overall distribution of NPP, NPP in each region and NPP of various forest types, et al. The result shows that the vegetation NPP gradually decreased from northwest to southeast, and had certain latitude zonal and vertical zonal rule, but the longitude zonal rule was not obvious.

articleTitle: Feature-oriented re-engineering using product line approach
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software product line is a well-known approach in the field of software engineering. Feature-Oriented Reuse Method is one of the methods used to carry out product line approach. However, it is not quite suitable for the case of re-engineering using product line approach. We refined the processes, and it turns out that the new processes work fine. This paper describes the processes performed by the team of Court Business Management System (CBMS) during the re-engineering of existing products, and summaries the lessons learned during the process of carrying out product line approach.

articleTitle: Research and analysis on Encryption Principle of TrueCrypt software system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Disk encryption is a special case of data at rest protection when the storage media is a sector-addressable device such as a hard disk or a flash card. Disk encryption has two main facets: Disk encryption theory and Encryption layer in storage stack TrueCrypt is a software system to finish Disk encryption. It performs satisfactorily in operation, encryption efficiency and availability factor. TrueCrypt encrypts data stored on a computer's mass storage and transparently decrypts the information when an authorized user requests it, and no special action by the user is required. Overall information and features of TrueCrypt software system are comprehensively discussed, and Encryption Principles of system, such as Encryption Algorithms, Hash Algorithms and file system filter driver, are comprehensively mainly discussed.

articleTitle: The design of test case based on combinatorial and orthogonal experiment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The combinatorial testing technology and the orthogonal experiment method were studied, optimizing of the design of test case, decreasing the workload of test case. The method of test case was designed with AETG algorithm. A load testing solution was suggested with orthogonal theory and Range analysis method. The load testing factor of system response time was analyzed, including network bandwidth, processor speed, concurrency users etc, the optimization performance criteria of system and testing combinatorial factors were selected.

articleTitle: Approach on mechanism of manufacturing-service-value chain based on game analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Transition of manufacturing is pushed by service industry. Especially when producer service rises, traditional model of processing and manufacturing in manufacturing industry is transformed into producer service and more profits are gained. Due to this transformation, traditional value chain on manufacturing is upgrade to service-value chain. Through three-dimensional graph which explores the value-added in value chain, value-added of service in manufacturing value chain is outstanding.
