By establishing manufacturing-service-value chain based on game analysis, mechanism of manufacturing-service-value chain in three-dimensional model graph—driving source, condition and balance of manufacturing-service-value chain's operation—is more definite and economic sense of establishing service-value chain in manufacturing is illustrated.

articleTitle: Studying on the adverse selection in e-commerce market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In response to the information asymmetry problem in e-commerce market, the solution involves in the process of building the adverse selection model in e-commerce market and analyzing the effect of adverse selection on businesses and consumers. Then the results derived from establishing e-commerce transaction law, building third-party organization by using signal transmission and other measures.

articleTitle: The study on customers' trust in internet communication
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the internet is developing rapidly, more and more customers obtain the product and brand information by internet communication. Through the questionnaire survey, the paper used statistical analysis methods such as the pairs T-test and variance analysis to discuss customers' trust in internet communication. The result showed that customers trusted differently in various forms of internet communication and types of network information. Among the internet communication forms, specialized forums were at the highest level while online advertisement the lowest. On the other hand, of the network information types, customers kept the highest level of trust in science & culture information, and the followings were current news information, reference information, commercial information and entertainment information. In addition, the male trusted network information less than the female, the survey also showed high-income groups trusted less not only in different types of network information, but also in search engines and chat rooms than the low-income earners.

articleTitle: Susceptibility assessment of secondary geological disaster based on GIS and Information value methodology for Yushu earthquake region
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Yushu MS7.1 earthquake, occurred on 14 April 2010 in Qinghai province induced a kind of secondary geological disasters. Based on GIS and information value methodology, taking slope, aspect, altitude, slope shape, fault and lithology as assessment genes, information value of disasters in different assessment genes were calculated by geostatistical analysis. Information value map was obtained based on spatial analysis of GIS and categorized into three classes, specifically, “low”, “moderate”, “high”. According to the disasters acquired from remote sensing, the result can be summarized as follows: The hazard classes calculated by GIS and information value methodology inoculate preferably with the fact. and would provide the valid basis to the rebuild of Yushu earthquake area in future.

articleTitle: Computer control system of hot rolling finishing section
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Primary configuration and function of renovated computer control system in finishing section of hot strip plant is introduced Because of demoded equipment and control system before renovation, quality and production of hot strip did not satisfy customers. The factory attached primary importance to the hydraulic position control system in its renovation, and added automatic gauge control function. Renovated system was steady and dependent, and had good control effect.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: One kind of auto-adapted color image watermark algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of ATO System with impatient waiting
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We study a multiproduct ATO System with impatient waiting. By using Matrix Analytic Methods, we derive the stationary distribution of the Markov process X(t) and obtain performance measures of item, order and system.

articleTitle: Transient NO emissions during cold start in an LPG SI engine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: normally, cylinder pressure was used as a criterion of combustion occurrence, while in some conditions, it may be unreliable when identifying lean mixture combustion. This is particularly important for fuels like liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), which has good capacity for lean combustion. In this study, a fast response NO detector- Combustion fNOx400, based on the chemiluminescence's (CLD) method, was used to measure real time NO emissions in order to evaluate the technique as a criterion for establishing combustion occurrence. Test results show that real time NO emissions can be used to identify the cylinder combustion and misfire occurrence during engine cranking, and real time NO emissions can be used to understand the combustion and misfire occurrence. Real time NO emissions mostly happened in first several cycles during cold start, and NO emissions increased with the spark timing advancing.

articleTitle: Unsupervised image change detection means based on 2-D entropy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a novel image change detection means based on 2-D histogram formed by pixel gray levels and the local average gray levels is proposed. First, the 2-D histogram is segmented by a line passing through the diagonal of 2-D histogram in a certain direction. Second, the improved 2-D entropy is defined to acquire the optimal segmentation direction and the optimal threshold. And the 2-D histogram is segmented into unchanged region and change region. Then the change area is detected based on the change region of 2-D histogram. Finally, the change detection means is compared to traditional means Theoretical analysis and experiment result show that this algorithm is more accurate on detection precision and faster on detection speed.

articleTitle: Dynamic risk analysis based on entropy measurement for the construction of deep excavation engineering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the quick increase in the number of various construction projects in China, many accidents related with deep excavation engineering have been reported. The risk analysis for the construction of deep excavation engineering has been paid more and more attention to recently. In this paper, a dynamic risk analysis based on entropy measurement for the construction of deep excavation engineering was investigated. Both the systematic entropy and the systematic entropy weight for each section of the whole construction of deep excavation engineering were figured out using the entropy measurement method. By analyzing and comparing the obtained values, the major risk factors were identified. These risk factors are suggested to give more concern during the construction of deep excavation engineering. The developed dynamic risk analysis method was successfully applied to the construction of a deep excavation engineering in Shanghai, China.

articleTitle: Research on Vegetation Moisture Content Monitoring from MODIS data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vegetation Moisture Content Monitoring originated from the needs of forest fire assessment. On the one hand, the water content of vegetation affects the forest ignition point; the other hand, it affects the burning rate if the forest is on fire. This study is based on the above reasons, using the GVMI exponential model, inversion of vegetation water content information in Daxing'anling region, Preliminary analysis the relationship between the water content of vegetation and forest fire conditions.

articleTitle: Knowledge management in vocational education
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Most organizations realize that “knowledge” is a strategic resource that gives them sustainable competitive advantage. With the realization that knowledge is a key resource, organizations are now attempting to manage knowledge in an effective way. However, although some examples exist, the use of KM in vocational education is the exception rather than the rule. Knowledge management is a new field, and experiments are just beginning in vocational education. This paper explores how KM practices might be useful in a vocational education setting

articleTitle: Research on 3D laser scanning field working method of ancient architecture scene
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because it is neoteric technology to three-dimensional (3D) laser scanning which may be applied in protection and reconstruction of ancient architectures, its data acquisition model of field working and error sources need further research. The paper proposes three schemes of field working based three-dimensional laser scanner. They are respectively introducing external coordinate system methods with the total station, neighbor stations registration method based on targets, no target registration method. With Leica HDS3000 scanner, the rigorous experiments have been carried out for above each scheme. The results verified their feasibility and gained rich practice experience, which will provide guidance for field working of three-dimensional laser scanning, and also has important significance to draw up working norms of three-dimensional laser scanning.

articleTitle: A novel computational method for solving Markov model in wireless communications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper a method is proposed to decompose and calculate Markov chain model with hysteresis. A Markovian modeling approach is pervasively used for performance analysis in various kinds of research fields. We propose a model of channel allocation algorithm for wireless communications, and use the Markov modeling approach to verify its correctness. A derivative process of formulas is described in detail to calculate the state probability and related parameters.

articleTitle: Design of RC constant auto-calibration circuit for GSM handset
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the device error caused by the IC process, this paper designed a RC constant auto-calibration circuit for polyphase filter module in GSM system. The circuit used programmable capacitor arrays and search algorithm to rapidly tune the parameters to ensure the stability of the module. Simulation results show that: with 5 CNC mode tuning capacitor array, the tuning time error is not more than three clock cycles to meet the system requirements.

articleTitle: Satellite sensor data analysis of urban surface temperatures and land use / land cover
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid population growth, urbanization has become a common trend all over the world since the 20th Century. Meanwhile, urban air temperature is rising gradually in all the cities. In this paper, we took an oasis city—Urumqi as an example, investigated application of integration of remote sensing and geographic information systems (GIS) to detect the land use/cover change and urban growth, besides assessed their impacts on land surface temperature in this region. The results indicated as fellows: 1) during the last 20 years from 1990 to 2009, land use of Urumqi appeared a dramatic variation; 2) The mean annul temperatures of the land surface in Urumqi were 21.63°C and 25.39°C in 1990 and 2009, respectively. 3) According to the characteristics of the standard classification maps of land surface temperature and they revealed that the urban development had raised the land surface temperature of the urban. 4) Integration of remote sensing and GIS was an effective way to monitor and analyze urban growth pattern, and evaluate the urbanization impact on land surface temperature.

Author Keywords: Land use and land cover change

articleTitle: The nonlinear effects of satisfaction rating and seller reputation on consumer repurchase behavior: An empirical investigation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the nonlinear effects of consumers' satisfaction ratings and seller reputation on consumers' repurchase behavior. This paper is unique from two perspectives: (1) it studies consumers' repurchase behavior rather than consumers' repurchase intention; (2) it hypothesizes nonlinear effects rather than linear effects. To verify our theoretical hypotheses, we collect actual transaction data and conduct a two step analysis. Our findings and the implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of a multipul modulation scheme for UWB communication system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper makes a key research of a combined modulation scheme (TH OPPM-BPSM) for UWB systems. The proposed scheme achieves higher data rate by introducing more number of orthogonal pulses in the same pulse repetition interval. It also reduces the system complexity by half by introducing antipodal version of orthogonal pulses. The proposed transmission scheme is analyzed through computer simulations under additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel without multipath and with mutipath respectively.

articleTitle: A cognitive service provision method based on context-aware computing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of network technology, the growing demand of the user service makes the user environment more and more complex. But the present service creation methods don't make the best use of the context information, which can't adapt very well to meet the user's needs. This paper proposes a context-aware computing based service provision method. This method makes use of the context-aware computing, taking advantage of the ECA rules to control the service combination, so as to provide the services with the environment adaptive capabilities.

articleTitle: Way of the Development of Solid biomass fuel Industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to promot the development of solid biomass energy industry in China, this paper based on data of survey in 2009, used qualitative research methods on the sample area of solid biomass fuel industry and summed up problems and obstacles in the development of the solid biomass fuel industry. The results show that the industry is the rise of the industrial development phase and should be taken to rural areas surrounding the cities, technology development and government support three major means to promote its emergence and development.

articleTitle: Hierarchy structure of XBRL and financial information data mining
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: XBRL is the standardization of XML in the commercial reporting domains. It develops very fast. XBRL has absorbed structure-level features of the XML. Through the hierarchical mechanism it is advantageous to grasp the internal semantics of commercial facts, facilitate computer understanding and promote the financial information data mining.

articleTitle: Research of Telecom Global Eye project in a region of Xinjiang on risk identification and evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This is a paper about using Telecom Global Eye project in a region of Xinjiang as a research object. At first the Delphi method is used to identify the risk factors for their projects, establish a risk management system model to strengthen the risk management and control of the project. And then the comparing with each of two Sub-risk factors of risk factors by AHP method can calculate the weight value of each risk. Through evaluating the risk of the project, we have concluded that investment risk is the biggest risk in the Telecom Global Eye project and it provides management recommendations for the Telecom Global Eye project's management at the same time.

articleTitle: Development of PC-based virtual radio frequency signal generator
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In respect to the realization of virtual radio frequency signal generator (VRFSG), the principles and methods for realizing physical instrument (PI) drive library, virtual instrument (VI) drive library and instrument soft panel software are presented, the sampling functions of various output waveforms of the signal generator are given, and two dynamic linkage libraries for driving PI and VI as well as an instrument soft panel software are developed. Finally, tests with selected radio frequency, amplitude modulation and low-frequency signals were conducted to carry out comprehensive evaluation on VRFSG that uses above principles and methods. The evaluation results showed that, the VRFSG can simulate various operations and functional modules of PI, and outputting of radio frequency signals, modulation signals and low-frequency signals, etc. The VRFSG using above technology can be useful for remote program controlling of PI and simulating PI.

articleTitle: The study of port hinterland segmentation based on Newton Model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The hinterland is very impartment to a port, so we must improve the scientific and rationality of the present port hinterland segmentation. This thesis chooses Newton Model as Empirical Methods, establishment of evaluation index system of the port gravitation. Then chooses Guangzhou port and Shenzhen port as the example the finally result is obtained with Multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. It's easy to found that the hinterland distinction circle closer to the vertical bisector and hinterland division have to do with the distance between two ports in a more recent area. But the advantage of Shenzhen Port hinterland gradually emerges in the remote region.

articleTitle: A community detection algorithm of email based on separation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a solution to detect the weighted and directed communities of email network, based on gradually separate method. Then analysis the structure of communities, determine the community structure, form, the core-persons and division accurately. To find the overlapping communities is another advantage of this method.

Author Keywords: the weighted and directed community of email

articleTitle: Compensation Management based on mental accounting theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mental Accounting is the psychological process of individual, family and company making decision of economic result. People always divide wealth into different mental account unconsciously, while different mental accounting has different booking ways and psychological running rules. Compensation management based on mental accounting theory provides a more real and feasible theory framework for human resource management. This paper analyses the appliance criteria of mental accounting on compensation management, and proposes the key points of compensation management design based on mental accounting.

articleTitle: Application study of ANP in risk evaluation for water resources and hydropower project
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Water resources and hydropower engineering is a complex project, and it faces many risks which interact and interrelated with each other. To solve this problem, this paper selected 17 indicators from the five aspects, then built ANP model to evaluate the risks of water resources and hydropower engineering projects, expecting to provide reference for risk identification of water resources and hydropower engineering project.

articleTitle: Study on landslide hazard susceptibility assessment of Chengdu city based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Landslide is a serious secondary disaster, which has complex geological and geomorphological conditions and numerous event-controlling factors. It has aroused the widespread attention because of its tremendous harm to people's lives and properties. Therefore, to avoid and mitigate such disaster, it is important to establish a kind of reliable and effective method to appraise regional landslide susceptibility. Here, taking Chengdu city as research area, the factors chosen that influence landslide occurrence were: slope gradient, slope aspect, elevation, lithology and cutting depth. Landslide hazardous areas were analyzed and mapped employing the contributing weight model based on GIS technology and the hazard area and landslide distribution density in the areas with different hazard levels were obtained. Simultaneously, this study case also proved the contributing weight model to be effective in landslide susceptibility appraisal and its results can provide the research foundation for the risk management and the reference for the regional planning.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of initial value estimation on image super resolution reconstruction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the quality of images, an image super resolution reconstruction algorithm based on initial value estimation is proposed. In iterative back projection (IBP) algorithm, the reference image is restored through Wiener filtering. Bilinear interpolation is performed on the restored image, other than interpolating the reference image directly adopted in the traditional methods. The generated image is taken as the initial value of IBP algorithm. Image super reconstruction is performed on multiple simulated low resolution images. The experimental results shows that the initial value plays an important part in image super resolution reconstruction algorithm. The reconstructed image achieves higher peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) and better visual effect than that in traditional way. The IBP algorithm in this paper has fast convergent speed and small amount of calculation. This initial value estimation method may be extensively used to other iterative solving methods, such as project onto convex set (POCS).

articleTitle: The undrepricing of venture backed & non venture backed IPOs in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: IPO underpricing is common and there are lots of evidence and theory for that. In this article, we compare the underpricing of the venture backed and non-venture backed IPOs in China. We discover that the venture backed IPOs in China tend to underprice more than non-venture backed their counterparts; however, the T test is insignificant which is inconsistent with Lee and Wahal's discovery in US. We are also explore the reason behind

articleTitle: Fault tolerant mechanism in grid based on Backup Node
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Grid is a very efficient technology to performing heavy processing with distributed resources. These resources at geographically distributed widely and without central control unit. One of the important challenges in grid is fault tolerant, because the grid resources in this environment are not reliable. And to avoid duplication with processing done by a resource, the Check Pointing mechanism has been proposed. The state of application at particular point of time can be store and in case of failure the status information can restore on new node and computation can continue. Check Pointe storage location is a major challenge in the fault tolerant techniques. In this paper we presented a new method by using a backup node. Adding a component to GRAM to improve efficiency and fault tolerant. With clear Backup Node the Check point information can save on it. This method increases the efficiency and system reliability.

articleTitle: Modelling and analysis of real-time systems on multi-core processors
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we study and model the schedulability problem for multi-core real-time systems using an extended task automata, which was first proposed as an event-driven task model for real time systems with non-uniformly recurring computation tasks. Original task automata allow only one calculation unit to process tasks, i.e. on a single-core processor. With the extension presented in this paper, we eliminate this restriction and allow more calculation units, i.e. on a multi-core processor. The most significant application of this extension is in the analysis of schedulability on a multi-core processor with implicit task migration. We use task automata to model the non-deterministic arrival times of tasks. Schedulability problem is to check whether all the released tasks may finish within their deadlines on multi-core systems. We shall show that schedulability of a multi-core task automaton is decidable under such circumstances as (1) task feedback is not allowed, (2)task execution time is fixed, i.e. best and worst execution time are equal.

articleTitle: The building and practicing of an assistant platform for reciprocal peer tutoring
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Peer tutoring have a positive impact on students' academic performance, interest in learning, attitudes and self-efficacy and so on. Through the teaching practice, the author finds that there are some problems on the implementation of peer tutoring in university, and then we try to build an assistant platform to solve these problems with the help of information technology, and put it into teaching practice.

articleTitle: Parameters estimation of polarimetric Gp0 distribution with MoLDC method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> distribution has recently been proposed as a good model for characterizing multilook polarimetric SAR images of different homogeneity. Nevertheless, parameters estimation has always been a problem that hinders its use in practical application. In this paper, we first describe the shortcomings of classical maximum likehood method(ML) and moment based method(MoM), then starting from the second kind statistics and Mellin transform, we derive a new and simple method to estimate parameters. Experiments on real SAR images demonstrate its validity and superiority over the ML and MoM methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of grid side converter based wind power generation system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Voltage oriented control PI is combined with space vector modulation and phase locked loop to control the grid side converter in wind power generation system in this paper. First the mathematical models of grid side converter and LCL filter as well as grid are given. Then the control strategy of grid side converter-based wind power generation system is given in detail. Finally the simulation model consisting of the grid side converter wind power generation system is set up. The simulation results have verified that the control strategy is feasible to apply for gird side converter-based wind power generation system and the grid side converter is controlled well. It has laid a good basis for the real system development.

articleTitle: Research on low carbon-oriented development model of solar PV industry in Wuhan
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the requirements of low-carbon economy to new energy, this paper firstly points out the main problems existed in the evolution of solar PV industry and analyzes the strategic position of developing solar PV industry in Wuhan, and then puts forward a low carbon-oriented development model based on the circular, green and ecological pattern. Finally, it proposes a series of guarantee measures to support the healthy, stable and orderly development of PV industry in Wuhan.

articleTitle: A heuristic algorithm research based on the selection of optimal level of multi-factor combination
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Heuristic algorithm using some special information which is contact with problems we want to resolve is a process to control the search state space. Heuristic algorithm could play a unique role in resolve some problems which are difficult when we use theoretical methods. Here we propose a best level of multi-factor combination selection heuristic algorithm which is convenient to implement for computers, and it is an effective algorithm according to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on the technology of sonar target system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The major function of sonar target is to simulate underwater object at a certain distance. Hence, the main responsibility taken in sonar target system design is to simulate underwater environment. As to unavoidable defects of certain kind of methods at present, this paper offers AT-based (Acoustic Toolbox) channel modeling. This method could improve the performance of sonar target systems.

articleTitle: A Bayes network based model of stranded passengers transfering among transportation hubs in climate disaster
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming to the case of large number of people being stranded at the major transportation hubs (such as bus station, railway stations, airports, etc.) in climate disasters, we developed a model to describe passengers' delay and transfer among transportation hubs. The authors believe that the weather, traffic node status (open or closed), the service status (normal, delayed or canceled), estimated wait time and estimated transfer cost are the main factor in decision-making of passengers. Bayesian network and influence diagram are used in model to simulate passenger's decision-making process. The research of this paper establish a theoretical foundation for further study of stranded passengers distribution and transfer pattern at traffic hubs, then for giving the propose to the government emergency management decision-making.

articleTitle: Framework model of e-commerce trust management based on trust evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on analysis of the current situation of e-commerce trust model and research method, This paper proposes a framework model of e-commerce trust management, disccusses the various problems involved and their solutions.

articleTitle: Construction of the information resource platform based on 3D-GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: 3D-GIS is the current research hot spot, which defines the topography, not the internal structure. Therefore, 3D-GIS based on 3D-LD is proposed, which applies the 3D visualization management of person and things. The simulation indicates that it is feasible and has broad market prospect. Moreover, the information resource platform based on the 3D-GIS is constructed. It actively pushes on the cities' informatization construction, and provides government functions with technical support.

articleTitle: The application of singular value decomposition in exhaust noisy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The singular value is the main characteristic of the matrix. This paper introduces the specific method of separating signal using the singular value by the theoretical analysis of the singular value matrix. The exhaust noisy signal acquired by sound sensor was decomposed and reconstructed as the application of singular value decomposition in allusion to the character of the exhaust noise in the single cylinder dies. Based on short time Fourier Transform, the character of signal was obtained and it is provided a rationale on selecting the structural parameter of the muffler.

articleTitle: A research on the influences of foreign capitals' mergers and acquisitions on China's automotive industry security
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with the opening up of China economy, foreign capitals' mergers and acquisitions exert a greater effect on China's industrial security. This paper is chiefly to discuss the influences of foreign capitals' mergers and acquisitions on China automotive industry security. Based on convincible investigations and researches, this paper analyzes China automotive industry's domestic demand conditions, self problems, and foreign capitals' mergers and acquisitions' influences on the industry, and advances relevant countermeasures and suggestions for improving China automotive industry security.

articleTitle: Application of the improved multi-attribute group decision model based on TOPSIS to select construction-agency
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Government investment projects play a pivotal role in socialist economic construction, and government indicate clearly that implementation construction-agent system in government investment projects. The key of implementation construction-agent system is to select a professional construction-agency by open competition. We know that science selecting system can control the risk source of government investment projects effectively, and evaluation and determination bidding is the critical process of tender, so the core problem of evaluation of bidding is how to select a rational, scientific decision model which to select optimal solution from finite solutions. In order to increase the efficiency of construction-agency evaluation, the improved multi-attribute group decision model based on TOPSIS is proposed in this paper, we adopt the Minkowski distance to improve TOPSIS model, which solve the over weighted problem in the original TOPSIS model. Finally, a representative case to illuminate the application of the model, which picture the calculation procedures and verify the operability of the model, the model is an effective method to evaluation construction-agency

articleTitle: Evaluation on the human resource management of enterprises based on analysis hierarchy process by using spider graph
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Scientific and reasonable human resource management not only can realize development strategy of enterprise, but can reduce the cost of bargaining and have higher competitive competence of enterprise. Based on the theory of analysis hierarchy, the power of evaluation indexes of human resource management in enterprises was defined by gemination compare judgment matrix, then an appraisable model was set up by using spider graph, status of human resource management of some enterprise was analyzed by the model. In summery, the method has the advantages including it was visual, quantitative and operable.

articleTitle: Complex task query based on cloud computing Resource: Improved approximate skyline algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cloud computing aims at sharing all resource completely, which include CPU's computing ability, store capacity, network bandwidth and etc. Most cloud computing users task requisitions are among multiple target requisition which are hard to be met by these requisition conditions simultaneously. So it is the key to find out the most approximate node machine among large number of node machines in cloud computing model. This paper presents an improved approximate skyline algorithm to hunt to most approximate node machine economically, and provides an alternative reference for the coming task allocation.

articleTitle: GIS-based study on land use and landscape pattern change and their influence on eco-environment - A case study of Miyun County
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the fields of global environment change and sustainable development, analysis of land uses and landscape patterns plays a very important part. Using the TM remote sensing images of Miyun County in the years of 1997, 2001 and 2007, this paper made them interpreted and classified. This paper analyzed the changes of land uses and landscape patterns in Miyun County according to the land use type transfer matrix and landscape pattern indices, and made an assessment of the ecological environment by using ecosystem service value per unit area of different terrestrial ecosystem types in China. The result showed that the main land use types of the study area are forest land, grassland and agricultural land, and grassland decreased and construction land increased under human influences. The diversity of the area was low and the increment of the degree of fragmentation was relatively significant. The overall ecological value of the area lay in the middle or high levels and didn't change much during the study periods. The temporal and spatial variations of ecological values demonstrated the influences of land use and landscape pattern changes and structures towards the ecological environment.

articleTitle: Online batching scheduling with delivery times related to processing times
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We study a single batch machine on-line scheduling problem with delivery times, which is related to processing times. Once the processing of a job is completed it is delivered to the destination, the objective is to minimize the time by which all jobs have been delivered. For each job J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>, its arrival time, processing time and delivery time are denoted by r<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>, p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf> and q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>, respectively. Two variants are considered: 1) p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>≥ βq<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>, we provide an optimal on-line algorithm with competitive ratio (√5+1)/2; 2) q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>= βq<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</inf>, we provide an on-line algorithm with competitive ratio(√β<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>+2β+5−β+1)/2, and give a lower bound (√β+5)/(β+1)+1)/2.

articleTitle: Attitude determination of small, dim and high-speed targets based on multi-CMOS intersecting system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to measure attitude of small, dim and high-speed targets in shooting range, intersecting system based on multiple high-speed CMOS cameras was introduced in this paper. CMOS cameras were laid near from objects for small size, using multiple CMOS cameras to compose intersecting system for big number of targets tested, and selecting CMOS camera between CMOS and CCD for low cost and considering damage to measurement equipment of objects tested. Pitch angle and yaw angle were measured by extracting axle wire through image processing, image sequences were obtained from cameras laying on two sides. Velocity of objects was calculated by least square curve-fitting, acquiring coordinate of centroid on image received by CMOS camera laying below effective viewing field. One CMOS camera was laid on right ahead for measuring roll angle. Station mode introduced in this paper has virtue of low cost and free extending.

articleTitle: Analysis of impacts of human resource retaining innovation-oriented on enterprise performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This research constructed system of human resource retaining innovation-oriented and discussed its relation with enterprise performance. 300 samples from 21 organizations in Meizhou were surveyed through questionnaire investigation (Effective ones are 208, accounting for 69.33%). The research carried on reliability analysis and validity analysis using SPSS 13.0. This research also executed regression analysis on the independent variable indexes and the extracted performance indexes. The result shows, concept of human resource retaining is negatively correlated with enterprise's financial performance and irrelated with non-financial performance. That is, the hypotheses are not supported by data.

articleTitle: Multiple project scheduling based on an improved hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid genetic algorithm to solve the resource-constrained multiple project scheduling problem. Objective described in this paper is to minimize total project time. The paper firstly analyses multi-task of many resources in a group of projects, and sets up the mathematics model. Then it brings an improved genetic algorithm, and changes the problem into the chromosome or the sequence of genes with the corresponding priority. The corresponding algorithm is proposed to optimize the objective of time. Finally, this paper gives an example to show the application.

articleTitle: VMI coordination based on the inventory competitive products
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During the studying of the supply chain benefits under VMI(Vendor Managed Inventory) environment with inventory competitive products, the separation of decision-making power between suppliers and retailers will lead to the revenue's declining of the whole supply chain. To solve this problem, a cost-sharing contract is proposed to strengthen the coordination and cooperation of the supply chain. With the cost-sharing contract, the retailers will undertake a part of the suppliers' product costs. The suppliers are willing to provide more products, and the suppliers, the retailers and the whole supply chain's profits will increase.

articleTitle: Complete automata for fast matching of multiple skewed strings
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multiple string matching is required to handle massive amount of data in many applications including pattern recognition, intrusion detection, and biological sequence analysis, etc. However, the matching process is often disturbed by intentional or unintentional skewing of the strings being matched. This paper presents a new automata formation to perform fast and accurate string matching under such disturbances. This automaton will significantly enhance the accuracy of the skewed string matching process. We present a new algorithm for fast skewed string matching based on the new automaton.

articleTitle: Status quo of CSR reports in China: General characteristics and management system aspects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important component of modern management system, corporate social responsibility (CSR) reporting in China is investigated in this paper, based on 162 stand-alone CSR reports published by 116 Chinese enterprises till the end of 2008. The general characteristics of these reports such as ownership/sector distributions, report types, or disclosing forms are presented firstly. Secondly, disclosed CSR reports are analysed from different aspects of management system like CSR strategy, drivers and guidelines, feedback channel, assurance, etc. Finally, main findings are summarized, and recommendations are proposed to possibly accelerate the CSR reporting progress in China.

articleTitle: Design of optimal stack filters using QPSO
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Stack filters are a class of slip window nonlinear digital filters that satisfy a weak superposition property known as the threshold decomposition and stacking property. They are suitable to parallel processing. Stack filters include many kinds of nonlinear filters in theory, being an important tool for nonlinear research. Beginning with stack filters's fundamental theory, optimization algorithms and their application in image processing of stack filters are studied in this paper. Experimental results show that optimal stack filters based on MAE criteria, which are found by Binary QPSO (BQPSO) algorithms preserve details of images perfectly and suppress noise passably.

articleTitle: Fuzzy synthetic judgment modeling and enlightening of the performance influencing factors of the innovative talents in Wuhan
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The effectiveness of the innovative input depends on the objective evaluation of the performance influence factors of the innovative talents. To raise the efficiency of the innovative input in Wuhan, the paper adopts the fuzzy synthetic evaluation method to make a study of the performance influence factors of the innovative talents. First, the paper sets up the indicator system of the factors, and then the fuzzy synthetic judgment model based on the fuzzy analytic hierarchy processing (FAHP). Through FAHP, the paper has solved the relative importance weights of each factor in influencing the innovative performance by establishing the weight matrix between the indicator level and the sub-indicator level, and next, combining the assessment set and the value set, the paper makes a fuzzy synthetic judgment of the indicator level and the sub-indicator level and solves the overall influence level of all the factors to the innovative performance. In this way, the paper has found a relative scientific approach in evaluating the performance influence factors of the innovative talents and proposed comparatively objective conclusion for the input decision of the innovation in Wuhan.

articleTitle: Study on the management of marine industry based on ecosystem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The management for ecosystem has become the development trend of marine industry management, this article analyzes the effect of marine industry on marine ecosystem including excess fishing's directly leading the decrease and extinction of population, marine pollution's leading deterioration of specie inhabitation environment, sea-closure and filling engineering's leading the damage of marine ecosystem and etc; the article shows the law framework, international organizations relevant countries' practice and main measures of international ecosystem of marine industry management and points out China's problem in this aspect. This article draws the path of how does China's marine industry management to apply ecosystem approach with foresighted thinking manner from the visual angle of state's development strategy. This path is: enhance the basis scientific research of marine ecosystem; deploy the rehabilitation work research of marine ecosystem; establish citizens' participation system of marine ecology protection and establish and perfect the basic framework of relevant law system.

articleTitle: A timing synchronization method for MIMO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a time and frequency synchronizaton algorithm for MIMO-OFDM systems. This algorithm designed a training sequence that based on CAZAC sequence, it has sleep timing measuring function waveform, it shows satisfactory performance of delay estimation of each antenna. Simulation results indicate that this timing synchronization algorithm shows satisfactory performance in Rayleigh and AWGN channel at a low signal-to-noise ratios(SNR).

articleTitle: Molecular cloning and bioinformatics analysis of genomic DNA of LeWRKY1
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: WRKY transcription factor proteins belong to the WRKY super family of zinc finger transcription factors that have been subject to a large plant-specific diversification. Using RT-PCR approaches, a genomic DNA from tomato was cloned. Sequence analysis showed that it contained 3 introns and 4 extrons, and it encoded a protein, named as LeWRKY1, which consisted of 399 amino acids. LeWRKY1 belongs to the group II WRKY transcription factor. LeWRKY1. Phylogenetic analysis showed that it had the same origin with Capsicum annuum's WRKY (ADD62692).

articleTitle: Design of high-intensity ultrasonic sound intensity measurement based on narrow pulse method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The research on high-intensity ultrasonic has taken the delectable achievement in the treatment of cancer and the detection of internal structure for the dam. The rapid and accurate sound intensity measurement of high-intensity ultrasonic transducer is necessary for its application and generalization. The paper introduces the principle of sound intensity measurement, proposes measurement scheme on the basis of the narrow pulse method and also discusses the design of hardware circuit and software.

articleTitle: Research on ontology-based maintenance knowledge expressing of power plants
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As maintenance knowledge management is an important issue of maintenance of power plants, expresses and organizes the maintenance knowledge effectively is the key link in this field. Taking the ontology research results used in knowledge management field for reference, ontology technology is introduced to conception modeling for maintenance of power plants. S-B-F-P maintenance knowledge expressing model based on ontology is proposed and the classification method of maintenance ontology is created. It makes the knowledge reused and shared possible and brings an effective settlement method for increasing the swarm cooperative maintenance decision.

articleTitle: Research on emergency system of China local government - a case study of the emergency system in a area of Shanghai
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking the focus on emergency systems of Chinese local governments, this paper explores and analyzes the strategies, principles, targets and system framework of emergency system construction. By applying the theories in practice, we also conduct a case study on the emergency system of Shanghai Pudong New Area, which includes the introduction of its two workbench systems and seven sub-systems and the analysis of its grid-based processes. The future tendency of this area is discussed as well.

articleTitle: Based on the CB of the economic and policy analysis on wetland ecosystem compensation in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As one of the world's three ecosystems, wetlands is an important part of the ecosystem. The farmland development and the lack of water resources led to reduction of wetland resources. Therefore, China has taken a series of measures to protect the ecological environment of wetland. Wetland Ecological compensation as a compensation system for the various stakeholders, it can not only inhibit the right over-exploitation of wetland resources effectively, encourage wetland protection acts, and mitigate the contradiction between protection and utilization, but also help to establish the effective value mechanism in the wetland conservation, then to form long-term, stable wetland interests. Based on the diversity and the external of wetland, the main line of cost- benefit analysis, this paper analysis the wetland ecological compensation from the property rights, public goods perspective on China. At last, the paper put forward the policy suggestion.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the motions of main crop seeds underwater
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this article, the physical equations of spherical objects moving in the viscous liquid have been formulated. These equations are then solved by the method of fourth-order Runge-Kutta to obtain numerical simulations and the law of the motions of soybeans, rice and wheat in the viscous liquid and analyze the factors affecting the motions of seeds underwater. The simulation results show that, for the homogeneous seeds, the velocities are proportional to the radiuses, the longer the radiuses are, the higher the ending velocities. However, for different kinds of seeds, the velocity variables are proportional to the seed densities, the higher the densities are, the higher the accelerations. Therefore, the above laws would be helpful to further study the motions of crops underwater and select and cultivate seeds.

articleTitle: A research on synchronization algorithm and highly reliable routine protocol of industrial wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Industrial wireless technology is a newly emerging wireless communication technology for managing the short-range, low-rate information interactions among devices. The use of Pair-wise broadcast time synchronization algorithm (PBTS) and multi-hops routine protocol based on reliability for the industrial wireless sensor network was included in this paper. PBTS has both declined the energy cost for synchronization and gained the synchronize precision; The multi-hops protocol based on reliability has gained the multi-hop quality.

articleTitle: Dynamic stability analysis of a class of recurrent neural networks with uniform firing rate
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the dynamic stability properties of 1-D nonlinear neural networks with uniform firing rate. By employing Taylor's theorem, a class of recurrent neural networks model with uniform firing rates is proposed, in which multiple equilibria can coexist. The contributions of this paper are: (1) An invariant set of 1-D neural networks is expressed by explicit inequality and boundedness is proved. (2) Complete stability is studied via constructing a novel energy function. (3) Examples and simulation results are illustrated to validate our theories.

articleTitle: A short time measurement based on length vernier
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on high-stability and high-speed of signal transmission and the relationship between time and space, a new measurement approach of a short time interval is proposed. Because the transmission length of the time signal is easier to be measured and processed with high-precision, combining with the phase coincidence detection, the measurement precision of the approach is much higher than that of the unit subsection of transmission lines for start and stop signals. This technique can show much finer than several tens of ps resolution and even better in the future.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of oil derrick on the mechanical properties based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By means of the finite element analysis software-ANSYS, the three-dimensional finite element mechanical model is established. According to the practical working conditions of the derrick of under pressure, the static analysis, modal analysis, are carried out. We obtain the stress and deflection distribution law as well as the natural frequency and modal shape of the derrick The findings indicated that this method may effective acquisition the result which tallies with the real industry and mining, avoids accident's occurrence, and the result proves that it can primly meet the request. Establishing and analyzing large complex structures as derrick with ANSYS may economize manpower and material resources. At the same time, it has higher simulation precision and solves the real problem in the engineering. Furthermore, the interrelated calculation methods have also same reference values to the design and analysis of the structure such as derrick.

articleTitle: Inhibition of free nitrite acid on nitrification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A sequencing batch reactor (SBR) was used to investigate the inhibition of free nitrite acid (FNA) on nitrite-oxidizing bacteria (NOB) and the effect of free nitrite acid (FNA) on the nitrification of waste water rich in nitrogen on the premise that the nitrogen were removed. The results showed that the inhibition of FNA on NOB was significantly, and short-cut nitrification can stated up successfully by using this way. When the lowest FNA was above 0.04mg/L, the processing efficiency of NOB was only 80% compared the highest FNA was below 0.015mg/L. When the lowest FNA was above 0.03mg/L, the processing efficiency of NOB was only 75% compared the highest FNA was below 0.02mg/L. FNA will need to reach a certain concentration produced significant inhibition on NOB effect.

articleTitle: Design of the wireless points-scoring system in sports competition based on PDA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This system mainly consists of the PDA control terminal which is responsible for collecting the result data, the PDA client terminal which is used for transmitting data and sending instructions to the PDA client terminal, web server which provides the accessibility of the website and storage of the database. The adoption of the OO technology is included in the design development of the system. The PDA client terminal is developed by C# language in the development environment of ASP.NET 2.0, while the PDA control terminal is developed by Delphi 2006. This essay analyzed and designed the system, giving the comparison of different pattern of the network transformation and the reason of choosing UDP as the communication mode to ensure the real-time of the system. In addition, the author summarized the problems occurred in the on-site application and put forward the solution of data submission by multi-customer.

articleTitle: Information relationship identification method in group decision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Comparing to conventional group meetings, computer-mediated group activities provide much more redundant information, thus resulting in information overload. In this paper, the method for identifying the semantic relationship between the solution and the comment is proposed and researched. On the basis of Support Vector Machines and Chinese text mining, the semantic relationship identification model is built and applied in the group decision. The results show that the method realizes the identification of the strongly supportive, supportive, neutral, strongly against, and against relationship between the solution and the comment effectively. It can help group members to organize the large amount of group comments effectively and increase the efficiency of information organization.

articleTitle: Multi-disciplinary simulation and optimism method's research and application of multifunctional loader
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-functional loader is a complex system which is made up of so many parts and subsystems, the parts and subsystems have some degrees coupled relationships, which generate so big trouble to design. The paper builds the dynamitic mechanical simulation model, hydraulic system and control system model of loader firstly, then integrates the separate subsystems by multi-disciplinary optimization software to these isolated models, at last, gives an application example by loader executive structure's optimization design method. The results of the data can offer a guiding role and reference for the development of multi-functional loader.

articleTitle: The research of balanced optimization of related resources based on multiple mode of activity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The balanced optimization of traditional multiple resources do not take into account the correlation in the amount of resources and the model of the execution of activities is assumed as the single mode. This assumption is incompatible with the actual situation that the resources are correlative and activities have multiple modes. So in this paper based on the former research, the introduction of the concept of multi-activity mode and the resource entropy associated with the establishment of resource-based comprehensive evaluation index function, build a multi-mode activities resources optimization model of association and apply the ACO to find good solution. In addition, an example is given to demonstrate the application of the model and method, the results show that the model is reasonable and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Reasearch on the technology of electronic sand table based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Electronic sand table is a new high-tech product by integrating computer application, geographic information systems (GIS) and virtual reality with multimedia. In this paper, an electronic sand table system of target areas is made under the platform of ArcGIS. The design and realization scheme of electronic sand table system is introduced at first. Then, the key techniques for electronic sand table, such as data processing, terrain modeling and feature matching, are described in details. Finally, the electronic sand table system is carried out on the platform of ArcGIS based on digital elevation model (DEM) and satellite remote sensing image. It can give users a real-time and interactive operation circumstance, and provide some references for the decision-makers to get a better understanding of the regions.

articleTitle: Factors effect on Hilbert fractal antenna performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As effective solution on the design of miniature antennas, Hilbert fractal antenna has attracted much attention since it was advanced. Because of the characteristics of large fractal dimension, high miniature extent, good self-filled ability etc, the Hilbert curve is used in many new-designed antennas which are proposed in recent scientific papers. However, the current research on this antenna type home and abroad is mainly focused on how to improve the performance itself, but a certain extent ignores the other actual engineering-oriented factors, which will slower the antenna application course. So, this paper researches the impacts of feed point, medium backboard and ground plane on the Hilbert fractal antenna respectively, analysis the relation between them and the main antenna parameters, for instance working frequency, VSWR, bandwidth, and expatiate its general law. Also, this paper proposes design method of the Hilbert fractal antenna which is beneficial to its application.

articleTitle: The factors of Ewenki's desertification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Ewenki Autonomous County is located in the northeastern part of Inner Mongolia, the southern end of Hulun Buir grasslands, mainly in animal husbandry. This article from 1999–2004 Ewenki each town and tree farm, the types of aquaculture animals and meteorological data analysis, study their desertification affects the overall situation, looking for all the major factors of desertification, as desertification work provides some advice. Using GIS Software in 2004 Ewenki Autonomous county sandy area of distribution, description of the image of the sand distribution.

articleTitle: A fast MPEG-4 to H.264/AVC intra frame transcoding algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an intra-frame coding mode decision algorithm for MPEG-4 to H.264/AVC transcoding in integer transform domain. The edge direction inside a block is estimated in the integer transform domain to reduce candidate prediction modes. Based on the analysis of the variance of the sixteen subblock DC coefficients inside a macroblock, “transition interval” and “double thresholds” intra prediction size selection are proposed to reduce wrong judgments. According to statistical results of high probability of neighboring blocks having the same intra prediction mode, a decision rule is given to predict the coding mode of the current block from its neighbors. The proposed transcoding algorithm can reduce computation time by more than 75% comparing with the pixel domain cascaded intra-frame transcoder, while maintains similar picture quality and bitrate.

articleTitle: Study on the Safety Risk Early Warning System of project construction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the current status of the project construction safety, establishing The Safety Risk Early Warning System is necessary. Then, the modules and workflow of the safety risk early warning system are introduced. After selecting security risk factor indexes, this paper established an early warning index system, and provided a way to evaluate project construction safety risk using Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation. On the basis of evaluation results, the degree of safety is selected as comprehensive early warning indicator, which could alert and conduct related departments adopting measures to reduce the safety risk of project construction.

articleTitle: Research on management of unit price contract based on the contractors perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the management problems of unit price contract for the contractors, this paper analyzed the entire management process of unit price contract through the transmission mechanism model, and further to put forward some countermeasures for the contractors' weak legal awareness and risk awareness. It hopes to improve the management level of unit price contract for contractors.

articleTitle: Application of BP neural network based on principal component analysis in grain yield prediction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the problem that when BP neural network is used in grain yield prediction, if the input space is too self relevant, the predicting accuracy of BP neural network would drop. This paper introduces the method handled on input variables in advance by the principal component analysis. Comparing with the common BP neural network model, the result indicates that the model of principal component analysis method in BP neural network has the characteristics of higher precision and faster convergence speed.

articleTitle: The application of weight of evidence for gold prospecting in Laogou-Mohe of Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The application of the Geographic Information System (GIS)is the important way to increase the level of the metallogeneic prognosis. The metallogenetic prognosis based on GIS using the weights of evidence model can be do through overlaying the information of geoseience related with the mineral resources. This paper describes the basic principle of the weights-of-evidence method. Take for example the northern segment in the Laogou-Mohe area of Heilongjiang Province, quantitatively analyzed by using the weights-of-evidence method on the basis of extraction of ore-forming information from geological, geophysical, geochemical and remote sensing geological data. The weight evidence method is applied to simulate the mine evaluation of the study area. Based on the posteriori probabilities, three-grade prospective subareas have been classified and two first-grade metallogeneic targets have been outlined. It provides a way of selecting target area in the process of looking for mineral resources.

articleTitle: EPC contractor risk early-warning model based on principal component analysis and neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with engineering projects scale's expansion and projects quantity's increase, the owner more and more use EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) contract management pattern to raise the efficiency, reduce costs and transfer the majority of the project risks to the contractors. EPC contractors face bigger risks whose factors are complex throughout the processes of design, procurement and construction. Therefore, risk controlling has become an important part of the EPC contractor management. If the risk rank can be identified as soon as it appeared, followed by appropriate measures taken by the contractor, the loss of the contractor can be substantially reduced. In this paper, we combine the methodology of principal component analysis and neural network to choose projects statistical data that the contractor has completed as training data of the neural network. Then the EPC contractor risk early-warning system could be established. This system could divide the rank of the risk among the project process into three grades: slight risk, medium risk, and heavy risk, so that the contractor could make accordingly decisions in time based on the result of this system. Abstract—This electronic document is a “live” template.

articleTitle: Design of ball and beam system controller based on kernel function principal component analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To simulate the actions of human, in this paper a controller of the ball and beam system has been designed based on kernel function principal component analysis (KPCA). The sampling data were acquired by controlling ball and beam system manually, the time sequence of embedded dimensionality were determined by fault nearest neighbours dot algorithm, their features were extracted in the space of nonlinear supporting variable through KPCA algorithm and phase-space are reconstructed, then the linear regression were realized by the least square method and mathematical model was built. Experiments indicated that the controller was effective. It can simulate the behavior of human and possesses high precision and stability.

articleTitle: Soil erosion characteristics of Kyirong County in Tibet based on RS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study applies GIS and RUSLE to analyzing the soil loss characteristics of Kyirong County in Tibet. The results show: (1) the R value is about 212.95 MJ·mm/(hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·h·a). (2) average K value is about 0.332 t·hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>· h/(hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·MJ·mm). (3) The average slope length is about 954.60m. And the average LS value is about 0.49. (4) the average annual soil loss of Kyirong County is about 4157.38 t/km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·a which is medium in intensity classification of soil loss. (5) The east-north of this county have less soil loss which is primarily slight degree. And the west and south of this county is mostly the intense degree. (6) The spatial soil loss distribution shows typical characteristics by comparing different slopes, elevation and land use types.

articleTitle: Monitoring phenological key stages of winter wheat basing on temporal series of EVI data in Anhui China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important factor during crop growing period, phenological stages is widely used in growing monitoring, field management and output forecasting. Temporal series MOD09A1, the 8-day reflectivity composite productions provided by NASA, which derived from TERRA/MODIS(Moderate Resolution Imaging Speetroradiometer) images from October in 2007 to June in 2008 were used to calculate enhanced vegetation index(EVI). Based on winter wheat's whole growing stages, four key phenological stages were defined from temporal series EVI as following: seedling stage, greenup, heading stage and maturity, then the spatial-temporal distribution of four phenological key stages were researched. The statistic temporal scale (a period of ten days) monitoring on ground has different with EVI temporal scale (8d) for winter wheat growth period, but they have better coincidences in seedling stage, greenup, heading stage and maturity. The seedling stage was from last ten-days of October to first ten-days of November, the greenup was from the middle ten-days to last of February of the next year, the heading stage was from the first ten-days to middle of April and the maturity was from the last ten-days of May to first ten-days of June. From the south to the north, with the increasing of latitude, the difference of every phenological key stage was not very obvious in winter wheat planting areas in Anhui Province. Only the maturity of samples in north of Anhui Province were postponed for about 8d. From the east to the west, with the decreasing of longitude, the greenup and maturity stage were postponed for about 8d in winter wheat planting area in Anhui Province and the seedling stage and heading stage have not obvious difference. On the whole, spatial distribution of phenological key stages of winter wheat is monitored and precision and accuracy of agricultural monitoring is improved basing on temporal series of EVI data.

articleTitle: Research on three-dimensional geological model construction and application of the open pit mine based on sections
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Three-dimensional geological modeling (3DGM) is one of key issues to be solved in the three-dimensional geographic information system (3DGIS) and virtual mine technical research. Mine 3D geological modeling and visualization play a very significant role in the process of the mine exporting, designing and developing. Regarding the information of drilling hole and section charts as fundamental data, the author presents a general process of 3D geological modeling based on sections with the utilizing object-oriented programming. The essay builds the three-dimensional geological model in some mine taking the practical project for example and realizes the functions of 3D dynamic display, simulative mining and so on of this mine.

articleTitle: Wideband circularly polarized antenna for GPS/Glonass
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a novel circularly polarized, single-feed microstrip antenna is presented. The operating frequency can be controlled by adjusting the S-slot arm lengths and the feed point. The design has a reduced antenna size compared to the conventional circularly polarized microstrip antenna at a given operating frequency. Further more, the circularly polarized radiation quality is excellent over the entire upper hemisphere. The simulated 10dB return loss bandwidths is about 10% (1500M∼1655M), which covers the global positioning system and Glonass.

articleTitle: The security model design for collaborative mobile e-commerce based on wireless middleware
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper puts forward the concept of collaborative mobile e-commerce by applying the theory of collaborative commerce to mobile e-commerce. For the security issues faced by collaborative mobile e-commerce, the paper proposes the wireless middleware based security model for collaborative mobile e-commerce. The model can first solve the security problems in the collaborative enterprise cluster, and meet requirements of mobile commerce as well. The model is well made to meet the security demand of the operation of collaborative mobile e-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic emergency task allocation with MDP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the sudden, multi-stage, uncertainty of emergency tasks and the resource constraints of rescue team, a dynamic emergency task allocation scheme is proposed, and a Markov Decision Processes(MDP) model of dynamic emergency task allocation is constructed.
