Taking the emergency task space and the rescue team space for the system state space, the MDP model is used to determine the optimal emergency tasks allocation under resource constraints.

articleTitle: Application of intelligent power module IPM in wind power system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The wind energy which is used as a kind of clean and reproducible energy, nowadays gets more and more important in the energy scarcity cases, capacity of the single machine in wind power generation continuous enlarge. Owing to the shortage of traditional inverter, to Mitsubishi PM100DSA120 for example, the basic electrical characteristics of IPM was analyzed. A design of inverter for the wind power system is provided in this paper. The results of experimental test show that the inverter for the wind power system can work well.

articleTitle: Data fusion estimation of MEMS based wavelet domain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, wavelet based data fusion algorithm is presented. Multiple sensors are used to measure the same physical quantity at the same time. The measurement results are transformed by discrete wavelet transform. Multiple sensors measurement values at the different wavelet scale are fused. The true value of the physical quantity estimated is got through the inverse wavelet transform. From the modern mathematics of wavelet multi-scale analysis theory, according to the basic principle of Kalman filter estimation algorithm, we derive the wavelet domain data fusion estimation algorithm and apply the algorithm to MEMS gyroscope. Experiment shows that bias stability of MEMS gyroscope was improved by one order of magnitude. The results prove the superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A detailed design model based on trust chain for seam tracking system of gas metal arc welding
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software development process is the most important part of software project management, and the detailed design model is an important mean of implementing the software process in any software development process. Different to other software process, the optical seam tracking system based on CCD for root pass pipe welding of gas metal arc welding has its special characteristics. We need a system which perhaps can not attain accurate measurement, but must concludes correct calculation, then drive the torch to the center of the groove. Our research proposes some quality improvements in existing software engineering process models through the application of trusted transitive chain. Divide the system into several modules and create the trusted transitive chain, design a kind of integrity measurement of each module, only if the pre-condition is trustworthy, the module has a chance to do next action. The experimental results show the better tracking results.

articleTitle: Reliable stateful Web Services through status monitoring and replication network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The reliability of web services is a critical problem when use web service infrastructure, especially when the states of different web services are involved. This paper presents a new-designed reliable web service system through status monitoring and replication network. Traditional web service is regarded as stateless, though the state has great impact on the success rate of execution. In this paper, during the period of service execution, we maintain a list of functionally interchangeable service nodes to form a replication network. The states of the services in the replication network are well monitored through mechanism based on Web Services Resource Framework (WSRF). The component nodes of the replication network are carefully selected in consideration of both system reliability and the cost of maintain such a network. In this way, proper replica can be activated when current web service fail to fulfill user's demand and the success rate can be improved.

articleTitle: Aeolian desertification monitoring in the Source Region of Yellow River by remote sensing technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Source Region of Yellow River locates in the hinterland of Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, which is especially sensitive to global environment change because of its high elevation and cold environment. Under the influence of global warming, aeolian desertified land expanded rapidly in this area during the last decades. To assess the trends of aeolian desertification from 1975 to 2005, we employed remote sensing and GIS technology to monitor the extent of aeolian desertification at four times (1975, 1990, 2000, and 2005). The data sources included Landsat multi-spectral scanner (MSS) images acquired in 1975 with an 80-m spatial resolution, Enhanced Thematic Mapper (ETM+) images acquired in 2000 with a 30-m resolution, and Thematic Mapper (TM) images acquired in 1990 and 2005 with a 30-m spatial resolution. The remote sensing monitoring result shows that the area of aeolian desertification land increased rapidly between 1975 and 1990, kept stable between 1990 and 2000, and turned to decrease slightly between 2000 and 2005.

articleTitle: Advantages and disadvantages of Computer-based Testing: A case study of service learning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Computer-based Testing (CBT) has developed successfully with its adoption by educators. The authors of this paper point out the advantages and disadvantages of CBT by taking the case study to probe into the scoring algorithm in CBT. The case is the experimental graduates of service learning, who take some pre- tests and post-tests by CBT.

articleTitle: Research on the urban expansion monitoring and evaluation based on spatial information technologies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban construction and development are important symbols of social progress. The process of urbanization is one of the most important factors affecting urban construction and development. Therefore, monitoring and evaluating of urban expansion seems extremely important. In this paper, we use Zhifu District in Yantai City, Shandong Province as the research area, collecting remote sensing images and statistical data in 2000, 2004, 2007 these three years. Urban expansion of the research area which we qualitative analysis based on urban expansion changes monitoring and evaluating index system, quantitative analysis using remote sensing survey methods as well as GIS Techniques, proposing the preliminary framework of urban expansion land-use changes monitoring and evaluating index system based on Remote Sensing (RS) and Geographic Information System (GIS). Through this research, technical support for Urban Land-Use Planning establishment and implementation effect evaluation is expected.

articleTitle: A novel method for overdetermined blind source separation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the blind separation of overdetermined mixtures is considered, i.e., the case where more sensors than sources are available. The contrast function for overdetermined blind source separation problem is studied, and the gradient of the contrast function is presented. Based on the gradient, a novel learning algorithm is proposed to solve the overdetermined blind source separation problem. A computer simulation example demonstrates the performance of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a new architecture to share cross-platform resources and services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper is based on the “China Equipment and Education Resources System” project, aiming to share large equipment resources and related services nationwide. Based on the existing resource and service integration solutions, a new resource-service registry based architecture is proposed in this paper. The new architecture consists of two parts: resource registry and service registry. A service query optimization algorithm is proposed to improve the efficiency of the architecture. To validate the feasibility of the architecture, a prototype system is developed and the running effect is given.

articleTitle: A novel method of dead-time compensation for SVPWM modulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The influence of dead-time on three-phase voltage source inverter output voltage using SVPWM modulation is analyzed in the paper. In order to reduce the voltage distortion, current harmonics and torque ripple caused by the dead time effects, dead-time compensation is needed. This paper presents the method of estimating current vector angle indirectly by power-factor angle, and gives the relationship between the position of output current vector and the direction of three-phase current. On this basis, the compensated voltage value is calculated. At last, in order to test the performances of this method, experiments are carried out using TMS320F2812 controller. The experiment results proved the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: How East Asian Monsoon responds to solar forcing at multiple time scales during the Holocene with EMD method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The forcing of variability in East Asian Monsoon (EAM) at millennial- to decadal-scale is always on debates. In this paper, we will decomposed the ´ <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O (East Asian Monsoon record) and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>C (solar activities record) time series into variations at different time scales with EMD method to reveal how EAM responds to the solar forcing at different time scales. The results show that: 1) The variability of EAM is mainly forced by solar activities at millennial- to decadal-scale; 2) The responses of EAM to solar changes may change at different time scales such as delayed or synchronous responses; 3) Weak EAM events are, in great part, ascribed to solar activities and less influenced by North Atlantic drifting ices.

articleTitle: Research on training mode of service outsourcing in capital university
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Faced with increasing pressure on university graduates as the result of the college enrollment expansion, service outsourcing as an emerging industry is promoting industrial restructuring, changing the foreign trade development mode, increasing opportunities for college graduates. This paper firstly gives an overview of the current service outsourcing, and analyses status quo and characteristics of China's service outsourcing. Then it analyses the limitations of the traditional training mode of university and studies its existing problems. Finally it gives suggestions and countermeasures for applying training mode of service outsourcing in capital university.

articleTitle: Predicting short-term coke price by neural network—semiparametric model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many factors that influence the short-term prices of coke. And the relations between those factors are difficult to be analyzed quantitatively. So, there are big errors in predicting short-term coke prices by the Common Industrial Prediction method and Parametric Regression Method. In order to improve the accuracy of the prediction of the short-term coke prices, an innovative Semiparametric Regression Method was applied in this Article. The neural network—semiparametric model was built by taking the functional relation, which was obtained through the neural network training, as the parametric part and the price of cast iron as the nonparametric part of the semiparametric model, thus to create a neural network—semiparametric regression model. Sample estimates demonstrates that neural network—semiparametric model is not only reduced the boundary estimation error,but also increased accuracy. It is an effective tool for prediction of the short-term coke price.

articleTitle: The initiation of brand purchase on consumer goods — The effect of hygiene factor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For a consumer goods brand manager, one of his/her key jobs is to encourage brand purchase and then, improve brand value. Brand purchase is an important index to assess the performance of brand manager; however, it is usually influenced by complicated factors which can hardly be classified and clarified. Based on previous established Two-factor model in brand selection process, this paper investigated the “initiating” effect of brand purchase by studying the working mechanism of hygiene factor. As the results, it has been clarified that factors which can initiating brand purchase is different with factors which can further encouraging brand purchase. The difference reminds brand managers to adjust marketing resources according to different brand developing status. Therefore, the operation of brand system can be better controlled and marketing activities can be made more accurately and timely.

articleTitle: On mosaicing 3D broken objects based on multiscale Fourier descriptors
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Technique of mosaicing 3D broken objects and 3D contour curves matching was researched. Representing method of contour curves using multiscale Fourier descriptors was analyzed. A 3D contour curves matching method for recovering 3D broken objects based on multiscale Fourier descriptors was presented. Contour curves were filtered by Gaussian function at different scale. The feature vectors of contour curves were represented by Fourier transform coefficients. Contour curves were segmented into curve subsegment by local maximum of product of curvature and torsion. The similarity between two contour curves was determined by comparing feature vectors of two contour curve subsegments, and contour curves matching and fragments mosaicing were realized for recovering broken objects. Experimental results showed that this approach was robust, fault tolerant and effective in 3D curves matching and fragmented objects mosaicing.

articleTitle: Sonic audio watermarking algorithm for cable-transmission
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on wavelet decomposition and relative energy compare, a sonic audio watermarking algorithm was proposed in which the wavelet coefficients were chosen for relative energy calculation and compare, and the embedded watermark had large capacity. Experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm can be applied to cable-transmission situation with good hidden effect and strong robustness, and bit error is from 0.01% to 0.68%.

articleTitle: Cloud Loading Balance algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, there are many algorithms used to balance the task of Cluser-servers, but not sufficiently take into account common method of heterogeneous servers and real-time load condition in each servers; In cloud computing environment, these algorithms don't adequately consider the loade-balacing in the environment of heterogeneous cloud. The paper proposed a Cloud Loading Balance algorithm, adding capacity to the dynamic balance mechanism for the cloud. The experiments demonstrate: the algorithm is obtains better load-balancing degree and using less time in loading all tasks.

articleTitle: Simulation of landslide based on physical engine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a simulation method for the process of landslide is presented based on physical engine. During the process of sliding, the cut surfaces of rocks are calculated using principal component analysis. Experiments show that this method can continuously express the state of landslide, and offer a new thought of constructing 3D emulation system.

articleTitle: Research on affective computing application in E-learning system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper attempts to introduce affective computing into E-learning system in order to compensate and supervise learner's emotion aiming at the scarcities of emotional exchanges in E-learning. An E-learning model based on affective computing and it's function modules including the learners' emotional interface, the learners' portfolios and emotional tutor agent, as well as the key technologies are expatiated according to their characters.

articleTitle: Simulation and implement of traditional Chinese finger-kneading based on hybrid force position control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studied a hybrid force position control strategy to reproduction the finger-kneading manipulation. After research on the motion trace and the force pattern, a finger-kneading manipulation model based on pain threshold was presented. On this basis, a hybrid force position control strategy was exploited to track position and force at the same time. The control strategy was simulated in MATLAB with Simulink and SimMechnics modules, and the results shows the force error is less than 0.7N and the position error is less than 0.1mm. The accuracy and effectiveness in practical application was proved by accuracy testing and clinical experiment.

articleTitle: Optimization for the parallel test task scheduling based on GA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The mathematical model for the parallel test system with multi-UUTs and resource constraints by type are is established. The GA algorithm order-independent and arrange-by-order gene coding method which could satisfy the resource constrains and task restriction are introduced. The result of simulation shows that the algorithm is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Survey of resource-searching algorithms in structured P2P network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Nowadays resource-searching algorithm in structured P2P network becomes a hot subject of research. Based on introduction of the resource-searching algorithms in P2P network, the algorithms of structured P2P resource researching called DHT including Chord, CAN, Pastry, Tapestry were mainly discussed, and the advantages and disadvantages of them were analyzed in this paper. It will lay a foundation for the further studying of high performance P2P resource-researching algorithms.

articleTitle: Supply chain finance performance based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the influence of supply chain finance to supply chain performance management. We apply system dynamics to establish a supply chain finance model based on logistics, information and cash, and take quantitative analysis to the change of supply chain performance considered initial cash of retailer, Loan-to-value Ratio, average loan costs as control variables. It turns out that, this model can be used to optimize supply chain performance management.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation in remote-sensing reflectance of suspended sediment water
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The aim of this paper is to study relation between physical property of suspended sediment and remote-sensing reflectance using numerical simulation. We studied the transport mechanism of light in dense suspended sediment water body by the aid of numerical simulation. The T-Matrix method (TMM) and the Invariant Imbedding Methods was selected as basic methods of numerical simulation. Two formulas was applied in the simulation. The first one described the relation between volume scattering phase function and Stokes matrix. The other one shows the relation between albedo and scattering section. These formulas connect the T-Matrix Method and the Invariant Imbedding Methods and put them work together for simulating the mechanism of light transfer in suspended sediment water body. The results of numerical simulation coincide with in-stitu data. We found the monotone relations between the physical parameters of suspended sediment and the spectrum of remote-sensing reflectance. The monotone relations mean that retrieving physical property from spectrum is feasible.

articleTitle: Fast acquisition of GPS signal in low SNR environments
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, to improve the performance of GPS receiver in low SNR environments, a method based on matched filter bank and FFT is proposed. The method aims at improving SNR by means of accumulation effects, coherent and non-coherent integration. Before FFT spectrum analysis, the method uses windowing techniques to reduce the degradation and the leak of the spectrum. Simulation results demonstrate the proposed method has the detection sensitivity −185dBW.

articleTitle: Research on visualization techniques for web usability analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A main method to analyze the usability of web site is observing and analyzing users' action, collecting the relevant data. Yet the huge amount data make it difficult to find problems. This paper introduces web usability firstly, and then discusses visualization techniques for web. According to the need of website usability analysis, we developed a assistant tool named SUAT to help the usability experts finding usability problems. Using this tool I carried out a research based on a lot of websites and selected many users randomly to confirm the effect. The result shows that using SUAT can help usability expert effectively find the usability problems that are prone to be overlooked otherwise, what's more it can improve the efficiency and make the judgment more accurate.

articleTitle: Visual servo control in Massage robot
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Tracking Massage position is an important issue in robot massage, and tracking accuracy is an important indicator. In this paper, a method using visual servo was presented to track massage position. This method is multiplexed control technology based on Kalman filtering. The result of simulation shows that tracking accuracy in visual servo of the robot has been improved and the tracking error is mainly caused by the delay of system processing delays. In the end, the experiments prove the effectiveness of this control system.

articleTitle: Transportation feature oriented multi-dimensional navigation data model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are three functional requirements that a transportation network data model for dynamic navigation must meet, which are spatio-temporal representation of dynamic traffic information, muiti-scale representation of road network, and carriageway-based representation of topological and transportation relationships of road network. However, existing models, including some navigable data models, GIS-T linear data models, and GIS-T spatio-temporal data models, rarely support these three well. In this article, Transportation feature oriented multi-dimensional navigation data model is presented.

articleTitle: Curvilinear displacement-based locally constrained deformation for digital images
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an extension of locally constrained deformation for digital images. The new method consists in fixing curvilinear displacement constraint on a point in the image and ensuring their satisfaction through the deformation. It permits the users to interactively adjust the deformation with direct manipulation. Experimental examples show that the new method is flexible, simple and fast, and that a subtle warping effect can be achieved.

articleTitle: A new 2D-DoA estimation approach based on dimension-degraded model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A two-dimensional direction-of-arrival (2D-DoA) estimation approach based on radial basis function neural networks (RBFNN) is proposed in this paper. With the spatial cone angle, two RBFNN estimation models of two line-arrays of L-shape array are built respectively, which can estimate the spatial cone angle, namely dimension-degraded model. The intersecting line of two half-conical surfaces,which is corresponding to each spatial cone angle, is the arrival path of the unknown signal. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the training set, and the complexity of model building, it also has very high resolution, and effectiveness for future application.

articleTitle: Research on LQR control optimized by elitist preserving genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It's critical to select weighing matrixes of Q and R when designing Linear Quadratic Regulator(LQR). This paper put forward a method of LQR control whose weighing matrixes are optimized by elitist preserving genetic algorithm, the best individual which enter directly into the next generation replaces the worst one during the copy process of genetic algorithm, the direct entering guarantees it won't be destroyed by the following processes, including crossover and mutation, so the fitness of the best individual of each generation increase or at least keeps the same as the step of evolution goes by, the weighing matrixes are optimized each generation. The last part of the thesis gives an example for simulation which testifies the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: The conditional fault tolerance of (n,2)-star graph
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Conditional connectivity and conditional faulty diameter have been proposed as two important parameters to estimate the fault tolerance of connect networks. In this paper, we consider the conditional connectivity and conditional fault diameter of (n,2)-star graph. we arrive that the conditional connectivity of (n,2)-star graph S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n,2</inf> is n-1, and the conditional fault diameter of S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n,2</inf> is 5.

articleTitle: Research for current cloud computing and cloud security technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the concept, development, key features, applications of cloud computing. The difference to grid computing is discussed. Eight kinds of typical open source cloud computing projects are described, the security reference models of cloud services are given. Cloud computing security challenges and countermeasures are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: A simulation study of fuzzy control system of Triadic Heating Furnace
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper is introduced structures and characteristics of Triadic Heating Furnace, and designed a two-dimensional fuzzy controller to carry on the control to the heating furnace and draws support in the MATLAB software conducts the simulation research. The simulation result has confirmed that the paper designs the two-dimensional fuzzy controller for temperature control of the heating furnace is extremely effective.

articleTitle: The application of the improved BP algorithm in the project investment prediction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional BP learning algorithm converges slowly, and obviously depends on the step size. The paper has proposed a step-size rule using to improve BP algorithm. In the network training, it can search a relatively reasonable step length in each iteration, so it can reduce the impact of the choice of step length on learning speed greatly. The simulation results of project investment prediction show that the new algorithm is better than the traditional in the iteration time and times.

articleTitle: Design and implementation to intelligent online exam system for course Information Resource Management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with the traditional exam, online examination system can greatly enhance the evaluation capacities, reduce the human input and improve the work efficiencies. So it has considerable economical efficiency and broad prospect. Examination is used in course Information Resource Management in order to solve the problems in evaluating. An intelligent online exam system is developed and the examination library of Information Resource Management is established. By using this system, teachers are able to check the student's knowledge of the Information resource management better. This is helping to improve the quality of teaching. The exam system can also be applied to examination of other subjects.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Solar building heating energy saving optimal analysis and empirical study
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analyzing complexity of enterprise IT capability based on CAS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed the complexity of enterprise information technology (IT) capability. By using complex adaptive system (CAS) theory, the author elaborated the CAS characteristics of IT capability. The results show that the enterprise IT capability is a dynamic adaptive capability, and thus has complexity. These results will be helpful to further research of enterprise IT capability.

articleTitle: An empirical investigation of product innovation and costomer loyalty in telecommunication industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the review of the relevant researches in the field of product innovation and costomer loyalty, this research analyzed the relationship between product innovation and costomer loyalty, developed a theoretical model, and gave an empirical test. A sample of 282 costomers in telecommunication industry was used to test the model we presented. The result indicates that product innovation has a positive effect on costomer value, costomer satisfaction and costomer loyalty. At the same time, costomer value and costomer satisfaction play important roles in building and sustaining costomer loyalty.

articleTitle: Analysis on the application of sketchup software in architectural design teaching
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to help the students of architecture out of the errors of studying architectural design, we should make them truly understand the origin of architectural design and master application skills of Sketchup software. Based on the description of the current lack of architecture education and the feature of Sketchup software, such as keenness in generating program, convenience in modifing the program, flexibility in dealing with environment and so on, we expounded how to organically integrate the software into teaching of architecture to guide the students to focus on the form and space design in the design process. Through thorough understanding of the content of the architectural design, students will enhance their professionalism.

articleTitle: The research in digital photograph visibility device system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The observation automation of cloud, energy, and sky is a principal issue to solve in the modern meteorological observation field. The results of most of the research yet done show that: it is possible to achieve the observation automation of cloud, energy, and sky, since the theory and technology is basically prepared, and some of the technology is actually very mature. In the late 20th century, scientists have started to develop a kind of digital visibility automatic monitor, which has adopted advanced digital photographic technology and image recognition technology, based on the definition of visibility and fully imitating the human eye observing visibility principle. Undoubtedly, the digital visibility automatic monitor is the best instrument to replace the manual observation of visibility. This article briefly introduces the methods of visual and instrumental observation of visibility, and elaborates the basis of the Digital Photograph Device System, its latest development, and the comparative results between Finnish Vaisala visibility instrument and manual observation. In the end, the article reaches an error analysis conclusion and discusses about the problems and further improving measures.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Business after the financial crisis should be of strategic cost control method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: First-principle study of V-Si-N nanocomposite thin film structure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: First-principles pseudopotential method based on density functional theory have been used to calculate total energy and lattice constant of VN lattice supercell, which optimizes the structural model of VN lattice. Where Si atoms diffuse into VN lattice is studied. The calculated results reveal that Si atoms transfer to the VN lattice boundary or occupy the V atom sites when V-Si-N nanocomposite thin film is in the stable state.

articleTitle: Research of geomagnetic effect on FOG north-finder
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the principle of FOG north-finder is introduced briefly, geomagnetic effect on FOG north-finder is pointed out and existence of magnetic sensitivity axis is analyzed theoretically and validated by experiments. Reasons of FOG sensitivity on geomagnetism and relations between FOG output and magnetic sensitivity are analyzed in detail. Finally, improved methods are put forward from the aspects of FOG produce process, assembly methods and software arithmetic of FOG north-finder. It is obvious that geomagnetic sensitivity of FOG is reduced effectively and thus further improved precision of FOG north-finder.

articleTitle: Application of computer simulation technology for part die casting process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The computer simulations of die-casting process of aluminum alloy part were discussed. The distributions of temperature and solidification time in the filling process were numerical analyzed. Based on the simulated results and the Niyama criterion G/√R, the distribution of defects in the process of casting were accurately forecasted, which are conducive to the improvement of dies and perfection of foundry technologies thus avoiding the meaning less dies modification, increasing the success rate of dies tests and controlling the product quality.

articleTitle: Study on Fault Diagnosis for radar's transmitter based on Bayesian network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fault Diagnosis for radar's transmitter is very crucial, yet very difficult. Transmitter is complex electrical equipment whose units are full of uncertain factors and information. The paper puts forward a new fault diagnosis method based on Bayesian network for the transmitter. The cause-result graph of transmitter is gained by analyzing its structure firstly, and then the fault model based on Bayesian network is built. The next step is to study its parameters by using certain algorithm. Finally the fault model is tested, and the experiment results show that the proposed method is very effective for diagnose the faults of transmitter.

articleTitle: The database design and relationship model evaluation for the enterprise storage grid
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Grid server is the heart of The Enterprise Storage Grid system. It has main functions as shown below: metadata management, storage resource management, files content management and service etc. In this paper, the conceptual design, logic design, relation model of evaluation of grid server database system were discussed in detail. The related technique and methods have been verified in our actual software system.

articleTitle: Research on quantificational performance evaluation of staff members in institutions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, more and more institutions pay more attention to performance evaluation of staff members. Full-circle appraisal is suitable for performance evaluation of staff members in institutions because of its merits. For the indicators of performance assessment of staff members are mainly qualitative, institutions often fail to assess staff members' performance objectivity and make some staff members feel unfair. Taking full-circle appraisal for example, this thesis analyses the application of analytical hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method in performance appraisal of staff members in institutions and conclude that the application of quantificational method helps to improve the effect of performance evaluation of staff members in institutions.

articleTitle: Spatial autocorrelation analysis of increment of per capita net income in rural areas in provinces of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Spatial autocorrelation is one kind of spatial statistics, which is used to disclose the spatial structure of regional variable. The article analyzes the increment of per capita net income in rural areas in the periods of 1988∼1998 and 1998∼2007 in each province of China. And by the national and local statistics analysis, the authors find out the increment of per capita net income in rural areas wholly takes on a significant spatial positive correlation in China, but in three regions of east, central and west, it shows different spatial association structures. Furthermore, this essential spatial structure is not changed, but tends to strengthen by developing more than twenty years. The paper will offer an important reference when analyzing the spatial structure of regional economy and making decision.

Author Keywords: per capita net income in rural areas

articleTitle: A NIIE-BLP model for network isolation and information exchange system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For solving information confidentiality problems in the network isolation and information exchange system, a NIIE-BLP model is proposed based on the BLP model. This model incorporated the new concept of the planar-classification function, which combined the classification of the sub-network and the classification of object. The security level of the sub-network was divided in the system and the communication between subjects was controlled by the function. The verification of formal methods showed that this model is reasonable and safe, which can reflect the safety requirements and solve information confidentiality problem in the network isolation and information exchange system.

articleTitle: Unpacking the paradox on the evolutionary force of the industrial clusters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Industry cluster, a synonym for the region with high productivity and intense innovative activities in the past twenties, is a complex economic phenomenon exhibiting obvious features of evolutionary process underpinned by its inherent force while triggered by external one. The present literature and conclusions on its evolutionary force are rather confusing, full of controversies and disputes among them. This paper reviews the current literature on industrial clusters from perspectives of top-down and bottom-up approaches, irrespectively, on its evolutionary force, in an attempt to revealing the limitations and the connection among them. As a result, this paper argues that it is the researching perspectives at odds and the differentiated definitions on key resources that result in such chaos. Only with the systematic and multidisciplinary approach can we unpack this paradox.

articleTitle: A study of wavelet transform in the identification of fracture of Formation Micro-Resistivity image logging
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Formation Micro-Resistivity (FMI) is an emerging logging technology in recent years. Although fracture can be directly illustrated in FMI, there is a great subjective factor for the identification of fracture. This paper focuses on the difficulties of avoiding the subjective factor in the fracture identification of FMI using wavelet transform. The resistivity curve of FMI is decomposed by wavelet transform, and we make a research in the relationship between decomposed signal and fracture. Using signal decomposition of wavelet transform adjusts the fracture identification of FMI to identify fracture more accurately.

articleTitle: Study on single input-single output of CMAC neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering of the real question in the conventional Cerebllar Model Articulation Controller (CMAC) neural network, a single input-single output CMAC (SISO CMAC) algorithm is studied in this paper. The direct weight address mapping techniques are used in the algorithm, and the relation between the inputs and the weights is established by taking the quantification of input x as their weight address, and the generalization capability of network is enhanced by input x normalized. The study of network uses random sample, so the network has characteristics of simple study and quick convergence and high accuracy of function approximation, etc, and implement in single chip microcomputer. In the end, it is showed the algorithm is validity by theory proved and simulation experiments.

Author Keywords: cerebllar model articulation controller neural network

articleTitle: Optimization model of bid evaluation on ELECTRE-III method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The core issue of the engineering project bid evaluation is how to adapt equitable and scientific strategic to optimize and select the limited bidding schemes. On the basic of ELECTRE-I and ELECTRE-II, this essay introduced concepts such as threshold and valued outranking relations, constructed optimization model of the project evaluation on ELECTRE-III, and verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the model by applying examples.

articleTitle: A novel sybil attack detection scheme in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In WSNs, due to the restrict of sensor nodes, sybil attack is a harmful threat which is difficulty to be detected. After study of the sybil attack, a hierarchical grid-based scheme for sybil attack detection is proposed. According to the attribution of changing IDs of sybil nodes, the sybil attack is detected by determining preliminary location using hierarchical grid-based, furthermore, identities are certified using key encryption technology in grid. The simulation results show that sybil attack can be detected effectively by this scheme, storage, networks extention and conectivity are suit for WSNs.

articleTitle: PC platform trustworthiness evaluation based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Chain of Trust based on TPCM (Trusted Platform Control Module) is the core technical mechanism to ensure the trustworthiness of PC platform in China national trusted computing standards. The factors and their relations in PC platform that implements Chain of Trust based on TPCM are analyzed. Model of PC platform trustworthiness is established based on Bayesian Network. And two applications of the model in trustworthiness evaluation and factors detecting influencing trustworthiness are discussed.

articleTitle: Construction of Information Security Insurance in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of information technology not only provides people with convenient and low-cost communication, but also brings about the issue of information security. This paper points out that great uncertain factors threat the information security, so the development of Information Security Insurance is necessary and feasibility, and put forward several proposals for the development of Information Security Insurance in China.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on Chinese university graduate student independently “establish a business” problems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: DeviceNet master research based on embedded system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analyzing several commonly used DeviceNet networks, this thesis proposes the master application system based on embedded system. The system's embedded platform is made up of ARM9 and WindowsCE.Net, it implements the driver program of the DeviceNet communication interface, the application program of network management and scanner. The system built for modern breeding environment monitor successfully; thereby an easy, high reliable and low-cost fieldbus solution is achieved.

articleTitle: N-S flowchart analysis and applications in algorithm description
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Nassi-Schneiderman (N-S) charts are similar to flowcharts, but are more concise and have built-in support for common operations like decisions and loops. It has simple structure elements, but its ability of describing algorithm need further study. In this paper the normalization analysis of N-S flowchart is discussed with its rules of hiberarchy, neighbour, connotation, and its extensibilities, including inclusive term, semantic planning, and specification, are presented. Experimental examples indicate that it has some advantages with N-S flowchart applications in algorithm description.

articleTitle: Using multi-discipline knowledge to balance educative effect and entertainment effect in educational games design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In educational games design area, how to design educational games with both good educative effect and good entertainment effect is always a hot issue. To solve this problem, we propose the following viewpoints: first, we argue that we should pay more attention to learning tasks and instructional design in educational games. Second, if we would like to make learning enjoyable, we should pay attention to alleviate learning burdens. Third, we summarize research fruits of multiple disciplines that is relevant to solve this problem. Finally, we propose how to apply these multi-disciplinary fruits in educational games design, namely, transferring these multi-disciplinary fruits into educational games design rules to display knowledge(knowledge input) and apply knowledge(knowledge output). Though the number of areas we listed is limited, and the solutions are not perfect, we have paved a road for the future researches.

articleTitle: A modified algorithm for fingerprint features extraction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Features extraction is crucial for fingerprint recognition, which reflects the superiority and decides the results of algorithm largely. An improved algorithm of fingerprint features extraction is proposed using wavelet transform and coefficient of variation. The coefficients are collected from the different scales and orientations in wavelet transform, and restrained the scales discrepancy owing to the coefficient, which strengthen the discrimination of eigenvectors. The k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) recognition is adopted in the simulation of the proposed method. The recognition rates of modified algorithm are much higher, which shows that the proposed method is effective in terms of a small-scale fingerprint recognition database.

articleTitle: A study on the current status and strategy of tour guides impression management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The so-called impression management refers to the process of one interactive aspect working upon and controlling the other aspect through a certain way, and thus forming its own expected impression. Based on interviews with tourists and tour guides, open-ended questionnaires and questionnaires of impression management strategies, combining with previous studies experience, this study discusses the impression management strategies, in order to enhance the overall image of the guides, establish a good interactive relationship between guides and tourists and improve the satisfaction and loyalty of tourists.

articleTitle: Study on common mode EMI suppression method in NC machine tools
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Conducted electromagnetic interference in numerical control machine are introduced at first. PWM motor drive system is widely applied to numerical control machine tools. However, owing to power converter adopts pulse width modulation, which inevitably causes conducted common mode EMI. Common mode EMI generated by voltage source PWM inverter and the essences of its adverse effects are investigated in the paper, and common mode EMI reducing methods are also presented. Finally, the common mode EMI suppressing methods are expounded.

articleTitle: A converged-service creation method based on BPEL and supporting service component
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a converged-service creation method which is based on BPEL and supporting service component. This method extends BPEL based on its extension mechanism and enables BPEL to invoke Web Services of Internet and telecom domain and conveniently integrate SCUs which encapsulate underlying telecommunication network capabilities. In this way, this method provides great support to rapid creation of colorful converged services.

articleTitle: The evaluation and analysis of college entrepreneurship education vector
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: College entrepreneurship education carrier can be divided into two types of theoretical teaching and practical operation by the way of teaching. By means of students receiving knowledge of entrepreneurship education, it can be divided into three types of virtual learning and classroom learning and practice. Every vector of entrepreneurship education has its positive side, but the negative side as well. As universities and students individuals, we should have a focus and organic integration when we make the teaching arrangements of entrepreneurship education, because of objective condition. So we can obtain a good effect of entrepreneurship education and learning at the same time.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Best practices for Scrum agile software development in the student projects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The optimization of network protocol based on multi-scale DWT analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The optimizing strategy of network protocol is presented in this paper based on the multi-scale DWT analysis. Aiming at the characteristics of long range dependence and instability of the self-similar traffic flow, a forecasting model is established on FARIMA to carry on the analysis and prediction to the behavior properties of traffic flow with the estimation of Hurst parameter, then the abnormal trends are adopted in AQM algorithm to form the caution and response scheme, which can improve the effectiveness of dynamic traffic control and achieve the optimization to network protocols. Simulations show that this scheme can guarantee the implementation of congestion control, exhibiting favorable properties with stability and scalability.

articleTitle: Research on synergy effects of domestic hotel groups
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Synergy Effect is an overall effect or collective effect produced by the interaction of a large number of subsystems in the open system, embodying operational synergy, management synergy, financial synergy, etc. Taking the domestic hotel group as the research object, it describes the specific working forms of the synergy effects, and puts forward several measures to optimize the synergy effects in hotel groups.

articleTitle: Research on partnering project partner choice based on group rational behavior
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A scientific and practical decision-making model for choice of partner in the partnering project renders as an important guarantee for the success of partnering project. Aiming at the decision-making problem of partner choice of partnering project, this paper advances a group decision-making model on the basis of group rational behavior and the construction of a new multi-attribute evaluation index system. Based on the fact of policy-makers preference existing in decision-making and in order to narrow and reduce the phenomenon of great error brought by decision-makers' preference, the thought of group decision-making is adopted in this paper to forms a group of rational preference through extracting the personal preferences pertinently providing that decision-makers are rational. And then, evaluation values are calculated and the decision is made‥ Eventually, the feasibility and practicability of the model is verified by the example.

articleTitle: On research of evaluation index system based on “white plus black” old cement concrete pavement
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to “Black Plus White” pavement bearing trength, it chooses old pavement evaluation index on the basis of “Black Plus White”, builds a blur arrangement synthetic evaluation model and methods to evaluate the old pavement synthetically. By virtue of application of actual projects, the evaluation system is convenient and flexible and it offers quick and efficient standards for the old pavement' reconstruction.

articleTitle: The research on E-Government GIS platform based on RIA/SOA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the concept of SOA, a new platform structure is present using RIA technology as the presentation layer. Contrast to the traditional E-Government GIS platform, this new mode improves in three fields: the integration of graphics and form, the visualization of structured data and the diversification of thematic map. From the standpoint of technical advantage, platform frame and function realization, this paper prove that the new model can effectively solve the three problems above.

articleTitle: Study on remote sensing radiation transfer model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to perform the remote sensing models' collaborative retrieval through different medium and different bands, the deep relationship of Radiation Transfer Equation (RTE) in different medium should be understood in advance. Therefore, the author deduced the “classical RTE” on the basis of the radiation transfer theory, and then analyzed the hidden relationship among the RTE in the atmosphere, soil, and water body. The results reveal that the difference of different medium's RTE mostly derives from the mathematical descriptions about their optical properties, and that these equations have great relevance with each other. Due to this, the “classical RTE” is just like an inner “bridge” to link different equations together.

articleTitle: Improved algorithm for network topology discovery based on STP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Topology discovery is an important foundation for network management. The existing algorithms get spanning tree status information of each switch by SNMP. This paper proposes an improved physical topology discovery algorithm realized by Perl language. The algorithm does not require that the FDB information of each bridge is complete. Meanwhile, it can find backup link and equipments that do not support SNMP such as hub and dump switches. Experiments show that the algorithm is an accurate, comprehensive topology discovery algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Electromagnetism pronounce instruments and wavelet betake chirp and language soundwave curve fabricate in application of language research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Audio sonic watermarking algorithm based on double DCT transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on double DCT transform, an audio sonic watermarking algorithm was proposed. After the first DCT transform, coefficients of low frequency were chosen for the second DCT transform. Though the method of modifying the coefficients of double DCT transform domain, the watermarking was embedded with large capacity. Experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm has good hidden effect, and it is very robust to 30% resample and MP3 compression attacks, and to a variety of other distortions in Stirmark Benchmark for Audio.

articleTitle: Research on estimated method of project duration based on design structure matrix
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In product development project, there were many kinds of connections among activities like sequence, concurrent and Iteration. Between the various activities, there were some links through the material, data or information transfer. Design structure matrix could describe and analyze coupling relation between activities. On the basis of considering the interval and overlap between activities, estimation method of project duration was put forward, which could estimate project duration more efficiently and accurately. A product development example was given to verify the feasibility of principle.

articleTitle: Analysis on the contribution rate of China's regional high-tech industry sectors
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the statistical data of some provinces or cities of China from 2003 to 2007, this paper conducted an empirical analysis on the contribution rate of regional high-tech industry sectors. The differences of contribution rate mainly show that the development of China's regional high-tech industry should focus on the leading sectors according to regional advantages, and the specialization strategy should be implemented to form the high-tech industry clusters with regional characteristics.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The remote monitoring system of urban rail construction based on ArcGIS Server
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation of Series Dynamic Voltage Regulator based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The approach of harmonic voltage detection has an important role in the research of APF. The Series Dynamic Voltage Regulator can compensate the harmonics distortion caused by voltage type harmonic source This paper presents a new approach of detecting harmonic voltage in dq0 coordinates, based on the generalized instantaneous reactive power, and used in the series dynamic voltage regulator successfully. It is demonstrated by theoretical analysis and simulation results that the proposed detecting method of harmonic voltage is correct and valid.

articleTitle: Study on competency model for construction project management team members
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The study compiles the competency questionnaire of the construction project team members. 345 valid questionnaires of construction projects of medium and large state-owned construction enterprises are collected, and the competency structure model of the construction project team members is built by the use of exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis, the results show that the competency model of the construction project team members has three-dimensional structure, which is namely personal attributes, interpersonal skills, management skills. This study provides a new theory for human resource management of construction project.

articleTitle: Visualization of the water dispatching decision support system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the article the meaning and main content of visualization were introduced and the concrete application in water allocation decision support system was analysed including the visualization system's portal frame construction, the functional design, the visualization environmental construction and the human-computer interaction technology, It can provide the reference for the three-dimensional visualization technology in the water conservation profession's application.

articleTitle: A fog-removing treatment based on Gaussian Filtering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to retinex theory and exponential relationship between the degradation of the image and the depths of the scene points, it puts forward a fog-removing treatment based on Gaussian Filtering. Firstly, change the image from time domain to frequency domain by Fourier transformation, secondly, as in the image fog mainly distribute in the lower frequency part, remove the lower frequency part of the damaged image through Gaussian Filtering. The simulation results shows that this algorithm can effectively improve the visual effect scene under the condition of mist.

articleTitle: Study of equivalent axle-number coefficient of cement pavement with asphalt overlay
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Applying finite element program, changing the value of structure-layer parameters such as layer thickness and modulus etc and the wheelbase of wheel load, the axle-number coefficient in the axle-load exchange formula for rigid-base asphalt pavement is calculated in this text under the two different conversion guidelines of pavement deflection and stress under rigid base. Through analyzing the results, the recommended axle-number coefficient formula is given and comparisons are made with design methods of AASHTO and China.

articleTitle: Study on differential pricing decisions for the product with multiple warranty periods for free replacement policy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Warranty service has an important role in the product transactions. The price is related to length of warranty period of product. Considering the reality, based on the consumer utility theory, assuming free replacement policy and the product failure with Weibull distribution function, this paper studies the differential pricing issues for the product with multiple warranty. This paper analyzes the optimal pricing strategy, and verifies the validity of the model through the numerical analysis and analyzes the difference between differential pricing and single pricing. Then this paper analyzes the impact of the consumer shift flexibility to the benefits of manufacturers.

articleTitle: Modeling time-triggered mechanisms using MARTE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In real-time and embedded systems, time is a very important feature, and time-triggered architecture is a strong candidate platform. However, because UML is built on event-triggered mechanisms, it is not suitable for time-triggered mechanisms. This paper introduces UML profile for MARTE, and presents some modeling mechanisms which describe the time-triggered features based on MARTE. Finally, the paper also elaborates on the application of these mechanisms through a real case.

articleTitle: Use digital photography to measure ground cover —a case study of Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a key indicator of vegetation, ground cover is an important parameter for Remote Sensing inversion. Researchers often employ visual methods to estimate ground cover, but these approaches may be prone to observer bias. An innovational method based on color features was presented to analyze digital photographs of vegetation to quantify percent ground cover as part of a study in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. The k-means clustering algorithm was used to classify after processing the image pixel by pixel, and then calculate the ground cover. Compared the result with Supervised Classification, the difference between the two methods was fewer than 5%. Moreover, some approaches of improving accuracy of classification were discussed by analyzing the result image.

articleTitle: The effect of directed forgetting on post traumatic stress disorder peddlers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traumatic memory of post traumatic stress disorder peddlers can affect competition performance, and even avoid competition. The paper explored the effect of directed forgetting on post traumatic stress disorder peddlers. The results showed that:(1) directed forgetting affected explicit and implicit memory of post traumatic stress disorder peddlers whose remember items were better than forget items. The findings showed directed forgetting can intervene post traumatic stress disorder peddlers;(2) the mechanism of the effect of directed forgetting on post traumatic stress disorder peddlers should be retrieval inhibition.

articleTitle: Knowledge-based FEA system for combinatorial jib of portal crane
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To realize intelligent analysis and knowledge reuse for combinatorial jib of portal crane, an expert system for finite element analysis was developed based on knowledge engineering. According to the research on the knowledge of finite element modeling and analysis process, the function design, flowage structure and implementation methods were studied in particular. The expert experiences, theories, design standards and other related knowledge used in the stage of finite element analysis were categorized and described. Then, the knowledge base was constructed based on rule-based expression and object-oriented method. The reasoning mechanism based on case-based reasoning and rule-based reasoning was presented. Practice has proved that the system can significantly increase the efficiency of analysis, and has good reliability.

articleTitle: Based on Location Quotient of recognition and analysis on the industry cluster in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the Location Quotient (LQ) method, this paper selected datas of Statistical Yearbook from 2001 to 2008, and calculated the LQ of all sectors of industry in Xinjiang, finding three industries has the phenomenon of clustering, namely Extraction of Petroleum and Natural Gas industry, Oil Processing, Coking and Nuclear Fuel Processing industry and Processing of Ferrous Metals Ores industry. The cluster degree of all sectors has also been calculated, sorted and analyzed. In addition, changes of cluster degree from 2001 to 2008 in clustered industrial sectors was described and reasons for, and some suggestions on the industrial cluster development has been put forward of this region.

articleTitle: Target location method Based on Neural Network for eggplant Picking Robot
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the sake of overcoming the shortcoming of binocular stereo vision method such as algorithm complexity and big computational burden, a binocular stereovision method for locating target based on neural network was developed for eggplant picking robot. The G-B gray level image was segmented by means of threshold segmentation on account of the brightness. To meet the vision requirement of the picking robot, the object's characters, such as outline, area, center of mass, enclosing rectangle and the point to cut off, are distilled. A three layers BP neural network was structured to locate the eggplant. The input variables of the neural network were image center coordinates obtained by two cameras and the output were space coordinates of picking point. The improved BP algorithm was used to train the parameter of the neural network. The effective parameter was achieved after 182 times of training. Experiments showed that the average rms error of the space coordinates of eggplant was 14.7mm and the average time consumed was 0.96s. The target location method Based on Neural Network for eggplant Picking Robot owns good intelligence and wide adaptability and it can meet the demands of the eggplant picking robots.

articleTitle: Economic analysis and countermeasure research on inefficiency of government decision-making
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper theoretically analyze the inefficiency of government decision-making from the perspective of Economics, and get the conclusion that government decision-making, which contains public goods' characteristics, has very much low efficiency in the process of public choices and public supplies. In order to solve this problem, i.e., improving the efficiency of government decision-making, we give some ideas based on the third part sector theory and division theory.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The verification of the factors of production staffing needs of the manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of a Feature Importance Based Structural Correspondence Learning algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In traditional text classification, training and testing text are assumed to be Independent and identically-distributed. With emerging product reviews on E-commerce websites, text classification applied to these domains no longer obeys the IID assumption. At the same time, many transfer learning algorithms are proposed to solve this problem. This paper proposes a framework focusing on feature importance study, which a representative transfer learning algorithm is embedded into. The experimental results show that this frame can significantly improve the transfer learning performance of the embedded algorithm, and feature importance study has a potentially important role in transfer learning. By studying the impact of FIB-SCL between the A-Distance, FIB-SCL was found to reduce the A-Distance between the source and target text.

articleTitle: Study on integrated marketing communication about Luocheng Town
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Boat-shaped Street is rarely seen in the world,which is at Luocheng Ancient Town in Qianwei County, Leshan City of Sichuan,being of great value to develop. But it's lack of systematic planning for marketing communication,weak in turism brand,as well as in the shadow of Emei Mountain and Leshan Great Buddha for long time,which are famous tourism spot around the world. The author determined the targeting market for Luocheng Ancient Town through analysing the questionnaire of Sichuan tourist. At the same time,the author put forward a proposal for its tourism image positioning and choising commanicating medium,which may help Luocheng Ancient Town to develop its tourism.

articleTitle: Research on the effective strategies of motivating Chinese corporate employees
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Building on the assumption that human resources are the important resources of a company and the key factor for a company's development, the article defined the motivation and described its attributes using the induction method. Then, the author analyzed the main problems in motivating corporate employees via the survey and case analysis methods. Based on the above analysis, the author explored the effective strategies of motivating Chinese corporate employees. The article is of great help to provide some ideas of managing and motivating Chinese corporate employees.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Network integrated experimental platform construction of finance and economics subjects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Can the futures market reveal the risk of inflation?
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The dynamic relationship between the commodity futures index and CPI in both china and USA is empirical studied in this paper, by using Granger causality test and the ARDL bound test. The results showed that: CRB commodity futures index can guide the CPI of USA, which can be an early warning indicator of inflation; while the Nanhua Futures Index (NFI) can not yet play a guiding role in Chinese CPI movements.

articleTitle: The analysis based on BP and GARCH combination model in volatility of the securities market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to fully exploit the volatility inherent principle in the return of the securities market, describing asymmetry volatility and heteroscedasticity of the securities market by GARCH method, and combining nonlinear approximating and generalization capability of the neural network, respectively set up GARCH(1,1) and GARCH-BP models for empirical analysis return rate of Shanghai stock index. The results demonstrate that, two models have significant fitting capability, but the latter is more accurate.

articleTitle: A temperature and humidity sensors data fusion method based on fuzzy set theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To deal with the problem of obtaining the status of temperature and humidity in industrial environment, this paper proposes a fuzzy set-based approach for multi-sensors data of temperature and humidity fusion. Firstly, the hardware architecture of temperature and humidity monitor system is presented. Then, based on fuzzy set theory, the paper describes the fuzzy synthetic evaluation model and proposes a novel algorithm for choosing the weight assignment proposals. A multi-sensors data of temperature and humidity fusion approach, which is based on fuzzy synthetic evaluation, is finally presented. An example is also showed for demonstrating the approach presented in this paper. The experiment results identify that the approach can eliminate the impact of incorrect data on evaluating the temperature and humidity status, and thus make sure the data fusion result is objective and correct.

articleTitle: Identifying the source of complexity in industrial clusters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The different sources of complexity in industrial clusters are discussed in detail by considering and recognizing the different issues such as the boundary, the inner structure, the diversity of and interactions among agents of the industrial cluster in the context of the general hypotheses usually applied in theories, before arguing that it is the diversity of and the dynamic interactions between agents that result in the complexity in the industrial cluster which evolve toward unpredictable long-term outcomes. Sights are gained and the suggestion that the use of complexity theory as a frame of reference to deal with such phenomenon are proposed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on interference analysis and hardware treatment measures of ECG acquisition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The application of ADS8344 in the trajectory detection system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
