abstract: The universal problem of the ballistic detection system DSP chip is that the acquisition accuracy of A/D converter is not high, putting the method of improving the acquisition accuracy with external 16 A/D converter (ADS8344) into the ballistic detection information processing system, can fulfil the requirements of high accuracy, high dynamic data acquisition and processing. Experiment shows that this method reduced the redundancy of DSP program, and it is suitable for real-time data acquisition and processing of the missile attitude solution.

articleTitle: Establishment and analysis of drop simulation experiment platform of landing gear based on ADAMS/Aircraft
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Establishment of drop simulation experiment platform has important significance for design and research of aircraft landing gear. Taking on a strut type of main landing gear as an example, a drop simulation experiment platform of main landing-gear is established with ADAMS/Aircraft. And it simulates drop of main landing gear. The result shows that the platform established with ADAMS software can simulate the situation of true drop experiment and is consistent with the theory.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of Large-Scale Gyms and Stadiums based on BOT mode
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) is a modern project-financing pattern in the world. On the base of analysis of the venture resource and structure in BOT projects, fuzzy math and the theory of AHP are combined to set forward a fuzzy overall evaluation model, which is used in the research of venture evaluation in Large-Scale Gyms and Stadiums based on BOT mode. This model is a method of Large-Scale Gyms and Stadiums based on BOT mode risk distinguish, evaluation, in which subjective and objective analysis are combined. Furthermore, the model is applied to a practical example of case.

articleTitle: Research on factors of pension replacement rate
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the definition of average pension replacement rate and previous researches, the paper divided five systematic modules that can affect pension replacement rate. Then authors analyzed the factors and concrete index of the five modules respectively, and discussed the real factors of pension replacement rate by using mathematical analysis, and researched how these index influence pension replacement rate.

articleTitle: Analysis on government induced investment for China's marine industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article has conducted an empirical research on the dynamic correlation effects between the government investment and the fluctuation of marine economic cycle through the method of quantitative analysis. Empirical results indicate that the influence of the government investment is effective on the fluctuation of marine economy during the earlier stage, but this effect will show a trend of continuous diminishment with the passage of time; Moreover, the fluctuation of marine economy results more from its own impact , the government investment has a powerful influence on the economic fluctuation of marine industry and shows longterm continuity. This paper holds that the government should not only focus on the investment scale, but also value the investment efficiency and the investment effect during the regulation and control of the operation of marine economy through investment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Lending statistics and analysis of readers in the libraries of updated universities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on selection a target business in M&A of coal companies in Xinjiang based on AHP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The selection of target business is the key point to success or failure for M&A. From the purpose of M&A, this paper selects five indexes and three target companies, and uses combining qualitative evaluation and quantitative evaluation, and gives an example that a domestic large coal enterprise annexes a coal company of Xinjiang, and then deals with more detailed analysis the application of AHP. The result shows that AHP can be used in the processing of M&A to some extent.

articleTitle: System simulation model of lottery sales
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on system analysis principles, by reviewing relevant theory and literature, got the lottery sales impact factor system. Draw out the lottery sales system causal feedback map by using system dynamics, and on this basis, established the lottery sales system flow diagram simulation model. This model can be used to simulate and analyze the various factors of the lottery sales; managers can provide to the lottery industry and increase lottery sales by using the optimization of the scientific basis.

articleTitle: The comparative study on International Competitiveness between China and ASEAN in Service Trade
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Service Trade becomes increasingly important in country's economic growth. The International Competitiveness in Service Trade is as an influential part and a basic feature in countries and regions. In this paper, we studied the development status in China and ASEAN countries, and analyzed China and ASEAN countries' International Competitiveness in Service Trade by Export market share, Trade competitiveness, Revealed Comparative Advantage and Development potential index, then proposed some suggestions in Service Trade between China and ASEAN.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Validation study of the efficient frontier portfolio based on Matlab
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Control of electric louver based on wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In intelligent building, both lighting and artificial illumination system are very important. In this paper, a daylight monitoring system has been designed. The distribution of daylight is detected by using the wireless sensor network, according to these data, a prediction model about illumination and state of louver will be established. For reaching the requirement of the indoor's illumination, a control system of louver is used to control the lowering length and leaves angle. The purposes of this design are to improve the comfort degree of the users and to decrease the artificial illumination, so, the energy can be saved and the consumption can be reduced.

articleTitle: A multi-agent-based model of intelligent tutoring system for virtual experiment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To carry out virtual experiments in schools can stimulate student's interest in learning, and help students bring up their exploration spirit and innovation ability. Virtual experiments can effectively overcome a lot of difficulties in practice teaching in schools. This paper analyzes the characteristics of the virtual experiment, discusses a number of issues on intelligent guidance in virtual experiment, and designs a multi-agent based model of intelligent tutoring system for virtual experiment. This model can effectively solve the drawbacks of experimental teaching, to achieve a personal and intelligent teaching guide.

articleTitle: Research on improved tracing algorithm based on related matching
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An improved related tracing algorithm was advanced to resolve trace problem of dynamic target with complex background. Related tracing algorithm introduced in this paper conquers shortcomings of large amount of calculation, poor timing and low identification precision. firstly, predicting location of targets, and then utilizing improved relating algorithm on portion targets, which could decrease amount of calculation and search for location of targets. MATLAB simulation shows that algorithm has virtue of quick velocity and fast response to variable targets. Simultaneously, improved relating algorithm could meet the requirement of timing and accuracy of system.

articleTitle: Spatial analysis based on GIS in the application of construction of urban underground rail
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The monitoring of construction for metro is an important procedure of guaranteeing construction safety and engineering quality, but the current monitoring data processing, analysis and transfer methods are unable to meet the need of safety management. Based on requirement investigation in metro companies, This paper puts forward a method with application of GIS software ArcGIS9.3. The functions of which such as map editing, data management, spatial analysis and three dimensional simulation carried on the analysis and processing can bc carried out to the subsidence data monitor for subway construction. It has been indicated in practice that new method provides the visual technical support and decision-making references vividly for the project managers and workers.

articleTitle: The research and realization of the GPS module tame the local VCXO
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the design of time calibrator, time calibrator can be achieved on a higher stability, because of the highest stability of constant-temperature crystal oscillator highest stability, but as time goes on, the stability and the frequency stability of constant-temperature crystal oscillator will gradually decline, it will affect the measurement accuracy. In light of the above issues, we purpose a new method to obtain higher stability for it long time work. First, generate the frequency signal by voltage-controlled constant-temperature crystal oscillator; Second, get the signal 1S from the time GPS module; Third, comparison the above tow signals, thus, a error signal is generated; Finally, converter the error signal by digital-to-analog module, and then, use it to control the voltage-controlled constant-temperature crystal oscillator to achieve the purpose of automatic tame.

articleTitle: Research on diagnosis technology of NC machine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with a NC machine system containing displacement sensor and angle sensor, and measures TE(transmission error) data indirectly. This study uses an improved FFT algorithm based on linear interpolation to carry on spectrum analysis for TE data, determines the position of error source, and analyzed the origin of this error source. Experiment shows the efficiency of this algorithm improves about 4.7% than FFT algorithm's.

articleTitle: Study on power distribution network topology model based on GUID
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The code design is the key of maintenance distribution network topological structure in the spatial database. This paper has analyzed the characteristics of distribution network topological structure, discussed the problems of traditional level type code in describing power distribution network topology, and designed a new distribution network topology code based on GUID (global unique identifier). That code generates automatically by the system. It can build and maintain distribution network topology in the spatial database, realize various of Web search. Practical examples show that web search based on the code can be stable and efficient used in distribution network GIS computing and analysis.

articleTitle: Research and realization of modeling method for virtual geographic scenes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This essay discusses about the methods of creating geographic scenes in a virtual scene touring system, proposing some specific methods to create scenes related to sky, terrains, buildings on earth surface as required with actual practice of various designs.

articleTitle: Narrowband interference suppression for UWB system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The impulse response of pulse shaper affects the Power Spectral Density (PSD) of transmitted signals in UWB system. In this paper, we present a new design method of pulse shaper based on chebyshev function approximation and Remez algorithm. An arbitrary real or complex-valued impulse response may be approximated and notch is designed flexibly with proposed method. The novel pulse shaper can support dynamic avoidance of narrow-band interference better. Matlab simulation results showed that the PSD of the pulse based on chebyshev function approximation meets the power constraint of the objective spectral mask. The comparison were presented for the bit error rate performance analyses of the pulse position modulation time hopping ultra wideband impulse radio communication system employing the pulse and the second derivative Gaussian pulse in the additive white Gaussian noise channel. The performance of the pulse is better than the second derivative Gaussian pulse.

articleTitle: The research of high resolution image classification based on object-oriented — To Changping District, Beijing City
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of aviation and aerospace industry, high spatial resolution data is increasing continuously, using the traditional pixel-based object recognition software cannot make full use of the information contained in images, promoting the development of object-oriented classification techniques. Changping District, Beijing City, as the research object in this paper, using the original image data SPOT5 as data source and object-oriented classification software eCognition8.0 for the appropriate partition parameters setting, choosing good features and attributes to establish the membership function or using the nearest neighbor classifiers achieved the extraction of different objects. The research data shows that the object-oriented classification method has the characteristics of short time-consuming, high-precision and effective.

articleTitle: Research on early warning system of water quality safety based on RBF neural network model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Water quality safety early warning system is the key point of ensuring the water resources safety and sustainable use. This paper describes early warning system of water quality safety by using RBF (Radical Basis Function) neural network model. The system consists of four parts: water quality monitoring, early warning of water quality evaluation, early warning signal identify of water quality, and decision management. The study is applied to determining and analyzing the hazard degree of water quality safety in Songhua River Basin. Results show that the degree of water quality is in grade four, which is at serious alert. The practice and the result of the fuzzy evaluation method prove that it is feasible and scientific that the study combining RBF model with early warning system of water quality safety, and good effect is achieved.

articleTitle: An investigation on performance of private enterprises social responsibility
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since China reformed and opened up to the world 30 years ago, private-owned enterprises have experienced an unprecedented development. Nowadays, there are many serious social problems in environment, ecology, employment, equity, etc. Under this circumstance, the general public has high expectations to private enterprises and asks them to undertake corporate social responsibilities. However, through the survey to the private enterprises in Jinan City of Shandong Province, we found that there are many deficiencies in the fulfillment of corporate social responsibility. For example, the sense of responsibility is weak; the employees lack legal rights; the private enterprises ignore the legitimate rights and interests of consumers; their contribution to community is inadequate. In view of this situation, this paper proposes a series of countermeasures to strengthen private corporate social responsibility

articleTitle: Improvement and realization of association rules mining algorithm based on FP-tree
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional FP-growth algorithm adopts FP-tree structure to express association of item sets in transaction sets and finds all of frequent item sets recursively. The algorithm increases the time complexity and the space complexity in calculating conditional pattern base, because it backtracks the same paths many times. As to the above defects, a FPIFM algorithm is presented in the paper. The algorithm stores all of precursor nodes of every node in the node domain, then the sub-condition pattern base of every node are calculated. Finally, sub-condition pattern base are combined and ergodic nodes are released. Experimental result shows that FPIFM algorithm is superior to the traditional FP-growth algorithm.

articleTitle: A DSP lock-in amplifier based on simulink
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of mid-infrared gas detection, a high-precision DSP lock-in amplifier is designed with MATLAB/Simulink and DSP. By using Target for TI C2000 toolbox which integrates Simulink with TMS320F2812, the automatic generation of C code can be achieved and the programming time can be saved enormously. An AD correction module is added in this paper to ensure sampling accuracy. The high-precision lock-in amplifier design is implemented skillfully by modularized design in Simulink. The experimental results show that the designed DSP Lock-in Amplifier possesses low error(<0.5%) and high stability.

articleTitle: Forced oscillations conditions in relay feedback control systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the relay feedback system shown in Figure 1, when the magnitude of the forcing signal is larger enough, the phenomenon of forced oscillation occurs, that is, the system synchronizes itself automatically with the frequency of the external signal. However, the minimal magnitude of the forcing signal for forced oscillation occur can not be obtained easily. An aim of our research work was to determine the minimal magnitude of the external forcing signal in order to enforce forced oscillation in the loop. In this paper, we examined the necessary and sufficient conditions for forced oscillation and led to a solution. Simulation showed that the solution was the desired minimal magnitude of the external forcing signal for forced oscillation in a special limit range. Although the solution was not a general solution, it did give the accurate result in some degree and most real systems were within the special limit range then our result can be used.

articleTitle: The study of human wireless monitoring system in supervision place
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Monitoring special people in supervision place of hospital, drug rehabilitation center or prison is a significant and difficult task. In this paper we present a novel wireless monitoring system for human body information surveillance by using the cue of location and time regularity in supervision place. We achieve a high reliability of monitor result through the improvement of industrial wireless technology. We setup the actual experiment and compared proposed wireless monitoring system with the Zigbee, the result verifies that the proposed system significantly improves the reliability of data transmission in normal monitoring case.

articleTitle: Fish-eye stereo based on the Taylor model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a method of fish-eye stereo base on the Taylor model is proposed. The fish-eye stereo cameras are first calibrated based on the Taylor model. Then, the mapping between the pin-hole perspective view and the distorted view of fish-eye camera is deduced and the fish-eye images are expanded to the perspective images, the intrinsic parameters of ideal perspective camera are also acquired. The extrinsic parameters are calculated accurately using a planar pattern placed in the common field of views of two fish-eye cameras, and stereo rectification is proceed based on these extrinsic parameters. Experimental results show that the proposed method is simple, flexible and effective.

articleTitle: Degradation Modeling of Biodegradable Medical polymer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this article is to establish a mathematical model for the degradation process of biodegradable medical polymer materials. In order to making biodegradable polymer materials can be applied to the medical field successfully, an study about its degradation process is carried out. A sub-regional, sub-time degradation model is established according to the phenomenon that chemical reaction mechanism of surface and internal is not the same. The calculation is performed to solve the degradation model which we have established. In this article, we apply this model into the calculation of plate degradation. By the comparison of the calculation results, the experiment values and the calculated values of Pan's model, a conclusion that this model is closer to experimental results compared with Pan's model, and that this model is reasonable to experiment.

articleTitle: Load balancing in the integration of WLAN and cellular network based on fuzzy logic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Recently, the integration of WLAN network and cellular network is one of the most important research contents in wireless communications, and load balancing is the main technique and research highlight of such network. Compared with game theory, policy algorithm, gray analyses, fuzzy logic algorithm fits for the problem of multiple in multiple out in load balancing and enhance system robustness as well. Hence, in this paper, fuzzy logic algorithm is used to solve the load balancing problem, considering the following aspects: the bandwidth of the WLAN and cellular network that can still be used, the speed of the terminals and the changeable download rate. Simulation results show that fuzzy logic algorithm can allocate the bandwidth flexibly and achieve the goal of load balancing in WLAN and cellular heterogeneous network.

articleTitle: Study on the forming mechanism and safeguard procedures of Electrical Fast Transient Burst
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Electrical Fast Transient Burst(EFT/B) has characteristics such as short rise time and duration, high amplitude and repeat frequency. It can interfere the microcomputer protection system in the transformer station. This is a difficult problem and is hard to conquer. Based on the Mechanism of EFT/B when the no-load transformer switching-off, build the extinguish and restrike model of the isolating switch voltaic arc and got the according voltage waves. Because most integrating circuit for resisting transient disturbance have no-effect level of the pulse train, the safeguard procedures are adopted such as metal-oxide varistor, the RC protection, phase-controlled switch to test the ability of resisting EFT/B in the primary loop. Based on the analysis, a comprehensive method of resisting EFT/B which overcomes the above drawback is proposed.

articleTitle: The analysis of simulation trade protection policy in Jiangxi Province based on CGE model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the environmental and trade effects of tariff changes, we have established 13 agents static CGE model and build the Social Accounting Matrix (SAM) in Jiangxi that includes resources, environment and trade, with 5 scenarios of simulation programs solution impact on the economy trade and environment from the tariff rates changes. Model simulation shows that it is beneficial to economic growth and population welfare when the tariff rate increase within 20%, but high tariffs will ultimately reduce the level of economic growth and welfare of the residents, and its negative impact on the import and export of all but short-term beneficial environmental levels. Meanwhile, by introducing an energy tax, we find that an energy tax in addition to short-term negative economic growth, but the effects of welfare, trade and environmental were better than tariffs. So in period of economic recovery, trade protection is not an optimal choice.

articleTitle: A self-adaptive reliable transmission algorithm for Wireless Video Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the high demand on the bandwidth, energy and packet loss rate, the reliability of video transmission is a big challenge of Wireless Video Sensor Networks (WVSN). Based on the status of every path in the network and the broadcast nature of wireless sensor networks, we propose a self-adaptive reliable transmission algorithm for Wireless Video Sensor Networks in this paper. The algorithm generally includes the following two main parts: Self-adaptive Multi-path Throughput Allocation mechanism (SMTA) and Signal-path Congestion Avoidance Mechanism (SCAM). The simulation result shows that the algorithm this paper proposes not only improves the reliability of transmission significantly, but also prolongs the network lifetime.

articleTitle: The method of estimating the length of linear cyclic code based on the distribution of code weight
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The definition and matrix description of linear cyclic code is introduced in this paper first. Then the distribution of code weight is analyzed. The distance of code weight distribution is defined according to distance of vectors. The theoretic probability of code weight of random sequence is ratiocinated. The method to estimate code weight distribution of actual sequence is established and the code length and start are estimated by the distance between the code weight distribution. The capability of abiding error code of this method is analyzed. The results of simulating experiment to different length code show that this method can estimate code length and start effectively when BER is 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup>.

articleTitle: A study of wireless channel on GSM-R network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: GSM-R is a railway communication system based on the GSM technology. With the widely develop of high-speed rail, the GSM-R quality of service (QoS) is becoming much more important than ever. We analyze GSM-R by measuring field coverage and radio field coverage model, deducing the Doppler frequency offset, giving the upper and lower limits of overlap in handover at different speed, and studying the data-transmitting error rate of GSM_R network. We propose that increasing the space of two neighbor cells does not significantly weaken the quality of field coverage, but can reduce the chance of ping-pong handover and other network performance. We also discover that the Doppler frequency is decreasing gradually and the error rate is decreasing shakingly when the train is becoming closer to the base station. All the data we used in this paper is comes from drive tests on JJ-DPL and W-G DPL, China.

articleTitle: Improved joint direction of arrival and frequency estimation using propagator method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An improved algorithm on joint direction of arrival and frequency estimation for uniform linear array is presented in this paper. On the basis of propagator method the frequencies are estimated by the eigenvalues of a constructed low dimension matrix. The arrival angles are then estimated by the direction matrix with Vandermonde characteristics and the estimated frequency. Simulation shows that the proposed algorithm has better performance and a little high computational complexity than the algorithm [6].

articleTitle: Colored petri net based multi-agents dynamic task allocation modeling and analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Task dynamic allocation is the key in the Multi-agents System's realization, an important problem is how to simulate the task allocation process dynamically and visually. Based on contractor Network Protocol and Colored Petri Nets, a task dynamic allocation model among multiple agents is constructed, by simulating the model on software platform, the related conclusions concerning boundness, deadlock-free, and liveness are obtained. Then, the model of task dynamic allocation is proved correct and reasonable. This formal and visual simulating method and model evaluating method have not been realized by other validating methods by far.

articleTitle: Prediction of soluble solids content in navel orange using Laser-Induced Fluorescence Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging is a non-contact, non-destructive technique that combines spectroscopy and imaging to extract information from a sample. This technology has recently emerged as a powerful technique for food analysis. In this study, the potential of Laser-Induced Fluorescence Spectroscopy (LIFS) to predict navel orange Soluble Solid Content (SSC) was investigated. The relationship between SSC and LIFS of navel orange were analyzed via partial least squares (PLS) regression. PLS regression model was used to predict SSC in navel orange. The correlation coefficient (Rc) and root mean standard error of calibration (RMSEC) for SSC in calibration set were 0.9006 and 0.5355, respectively, Rp and root mean standard error of prediction (RMSEP) for SSC in prediction set were 0.8410 and 0.6870, respectively. It is verified that the combination of LIFS and PLS model can be used to provide a technique of convenient, nondestructive and rapid analysis for prediction of SSC in the wavelength range of 481.4–780.23nm.

articleTitle: An analysis of the minimal effective detector set based on the adjustable fuzzy matching negative selection algorithm of immune
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analyses the coverage space of detector set created by the adjustable fuzzy matching negative selection algorithm, aims at the phenomenon of matching each other between detectors in detector set, this paper brings forward an algorithm of creating minimal effective detector set. This algorithm uses fuzzy thought to determine matching threshold and eliminates redundancy phenomenon in detector set effectively. Simulation results show that space coverage ratio of detector set created by this algorithm is increased obviously, realize using smaller detector set to detect non-self action in bigger range, increase detecting ratio and capability of system.

articleTitle: Mashup service for distributed geospatial data service
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mashup is a new web method combining data or functionality from two or more external sources to create a new service. This paper proposed to use mashup technique to integrate OGC specification compliant geospatial services in distributed environment to form a new overall service.

articleTitle: Analysis of E-government service platform based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, the e-government tends to take service as its core, while cloud computing has the characteristics of providing information technology in the way of service. This paper presents that e-government system can take advantages of cloud computing to change its function towards service, promote the industrial upgrading and push forward the green technology. We provide detailed analysis of the values and issues about the government, society and environment after the e-government system is moved to cloud computing environment. At the end of this paper there are the conclusions and expectation to e-government service platform based on cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Complex-valued genetic algorithm for function optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The genetic algorithms (GAs) can be used as a global optimization tool for continuous and discrete functions problems. However, a simple GA may suffer from premature and can't find the global minimum value. In this study complex number encoded mode was introduced to GA in order to expand the search region and avoid getting into the local minimum. Experiment results showed that it was useful for function optimization.

articleTitle: Research on integration of enterprise ERP and E-commerce system based on Web environment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, there exist many coordination problems in the construction of E-commerce and ERP, especially the conversation and integration between two systems. Based on the WEB environment, this pape analysis the necessity and benefits of E-commerce and ERP system integration for enterprises. with XML and SOAP technology, discusses the key technology of data transmission in E-commerce and ERP system integrating. Finally, the pape puts forward several important problems that should be paid attention to in two system integration process, such as operation flow, data sharing, software and hardware reconstruction, etc.

articleTitle: Analysis on graduate student employment stress after financial crisis investigating on Tianjin polytechnic students
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Investigating, using sources of stress questionnaire, coping style questionnaire, easy flow adjustment center depression scale and statistical analysis, to polytechnic students in universities of Tianjin will find out the status and characteristics of graduate employment stress, stress coping styles and negative impact. In order to help student successful, we should analyze the objective and subjective reasons of graduate employment pressure, explore the impact of their own factors on employment stress, study coping style on job stress, analyze the negative impact on students caused by Employment Pressure, and thus raise the strategy for stress of the employment.

articleTitle: Insertion heuristic algorithm for dynamic vehicle routing problem with time window
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to effectively solve the dynamic vehicle routing problem with time window, an insertion heuristic algorithm was proposed. In this algorithm, in order to reduce the time of searching routes, before searching all of the current routes, a set of candidate paths were selected by using GIS buffer analysis function under the new demand points. Meanwhile, the average satisfaction degree of customers, the traveling distance and the waiting time of vehicles are considered synthetically to optimize the increase of total cost caused by new customers. Finally, an example was presented to show the validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Experimental evaluation on government portal website's usability to 11 government websites of Zhejiang province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Human-oriented is the core concept of China's current public service and serving public became the ultimate purpose of government portal websites. In order to increase public use and improve public satisfaction of government portal website, it is of crucial importance to make sure that the website is built user-centered. As a new methodology on web design, usability perfectly expresses the concept of user-centered design. Based on prior research on usability, this paper presents an experiment method in understanding usability. It also introduces usability metrics on government portal websites and puts them into practical application by using them in an experiment. Through the experiment, the paper identifies particular usability problems of the given websites and finally proposes several practical advices for the further improvement of government portal websites.

articleTitle: A concept-based approach to video semantic analysis and coding
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose a concept-based approach to video semantic analysis and coding for video retrieval. The proposed approach is aimed at bridging of the gap between the low-level video features and high level of semantics of video and providing a convenient and efficient way to create semantic descriptions and retrieve video. In the paper, we built an ontology model of the video semantic objects and described the basic relations (part-of, kind-of, instance-of and attribute-of) among these concepts. According to the human concept response of video, we propose a scalable video encoding. Compared to feature-based indexing and retrieval, the proposed concept -based coding presents better results in several kinds of videos.

articleTitle: Analysis on the employment effects of FDI in logistics industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the underlying reasons that the entry of foreign direct investments impact on the employment effects of logistics industry. And it constructs the employment model of FDI that based on the Cobb - Douglas production function. The conclusions are that the direct employment effects of FDI in the logistics industry decreased gradually, while the indirect employment effects strengthened gradually and FDI also show some negative effects in the high-end market of the logistics. Therefore, we must improve the quality of our logistics personnel and encourage domestic logistics enterprises to enter the high-end market in order to expand the quantity and quality of logistics jobs. And more domestic logistics enterprises enter in the high-end market will facilitate exchange of talents, which is an important way to improve the employment effects of FDI.

articleTitle: A dynamic clustering framework for target tracking in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we describe a dynamic clustering framework for target tracking. The clustering process is divided into three phases: a) prediction, the cluster head predicts where the target will be; b) new cluster head selection, if the prediction result implies that the target will move out of the cluster, then a new cluster needs to be formed, and firstly a new cluster head is selected; c) new cluster forming and taking over the tracking task. We study this dynamic clustering problem and give our solutions composed of a Taylor-series based prediction algorithm and other algorithms and steps for cluster head selection, which is based on the proportion of node's residual energy and its initial energy, and the new cluster size's determination which is based on some restrictions such as the scaping probability restriction and the energy restriction.

articleTitle: Establish of the basic information platform for petroleum exploration and development based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of GIS, digital oilfield construction based on GIS becomes a hot research area. On the basis of reservoir description project, this paper carries out the exploratory research on the application of GIS in oilfield exploration and development, and builds the basic information platform for exploration and development. Basic data and geological maps are stored and managed in spatial database through spatial database engine. The platform realizes three information query means including querying from graph to attributive, querying from attributive to graph and querying from graph to graph, and achieves a high-efficiency graphic editing function. The platform also supplies automatic or semi-automatic thematic mapping functions for well section, distributive maps of reservoir property and sedimentary microfacies, etc. Taking into account the daily needs of geological work, the platform also offers data analysis and processing tools for reservoir property calculation, single well production analysis, etc. Simultaneously, on the basis of spatial analysis functions of GIS, the platform realizes aid decision support capabilities for petroleum exploration and development, such as drilling virtual well, generating arbitrary reservoir profile, etc.

articleTitle: Design and performance research of 10 gigabit campus network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increasing application of multimedia communication, campus network being designed or upgraded to 10G Ethernet is unstoppable. Since devices of 10G Ethernet are expensive, the cost of construction should be fully considered. This paper firstly analyzes the characteristics of 10G Ethernet, then considers the concrete implementation plan of 10G Ethernet in the campus network and analyzes the performance of the network, finally presents a more appropriate solution for the large campus network.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Book Conveyor based on RFID
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the problems existed in library management and service work, we designed a RFID Intelligent Book Conveyor using Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology and embedded technology, we also exploited GUI using Qt integrated development environment. This book conveyor is a portable equipment with complete functions, friendly interface and convenient operation. It can greatly improve the work efficiency of librarians and the service quality of the library.

articleTitle: Using GIS to analyze and forecast the Chinese Crime rate
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The change of Crime rates is closely related to the macro-economic development since the China's reform and opening up, the crime rate is predicted from the econometrics view in the article. The change of crime rate is a nonlinear time series. According to the complexity and non-linearity of change in crime rate, the Markov chain, that is the important forecast model of GIS, is used to study the crime rate. In which the group are divided by the sample mean - standard variance, the transition probability matrix are established by the transition probabilities of the various states, and the “Markov property” is verified by seeking the marginal probability. It is shown that they are consistent between the actual change and the forecasting change of the Markov chain model in the results.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor data fusion for underwater target recognition under uncertainty
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The nonlinear, dynamic and random in underwater environment result in uncertainty in process of underwater target recognition. In order to exactly recognize underwater target type under uncertainty through lots of corrupted dynamic sensory information comes from different underwater sensors, we propose a dynamic information fusion framework, which is based on discrete dynamic bayesian network (DDBN) that provide a coherent and unified hierarchical probabilistic framework to represent, integrate and infer various target characteristics from dynamic sensory information of different modalities. The proposed framework can provide dynamic, purposive and sufficing information fusion particularly well suited to the underwater target recognition under uncertainty. Furthermore, we enhance inference efficiency and allow computation at various levels of abstraction suitable for underwater target recognition by distributed computation. Finally, The experimental results demonstrate the utility of the proposed framework in efficiently modeling and inferring dynamic events.

articleTitle: Connected dominating set and network coding based broadcast in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Broadcast is very important for delivering messages in wireless sensor networks. Reducing redundant retransmission to save network resource is a critical problem for broadcast. In this paper, a broadcast method basing on connected domination set and network coding is proposed. The simulation results show that the method can reduce the retransmission and save network resources efficiently in broadcast.

articleTitle: Reseaching of adaptive Traffic-Aware in wireless sensor networks MAC protocol
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The main objective of MAC protocol design is introduced, and the typical S-MAC protocol in wireless sensor networks is analyzed. Then, this paper proposes a MAC protocol called the Traffic-Aware Medium Access Control (TA-MAC), a contention-based Medium Access Control protocol for wireless sensor networks, aimed to the defects of the use of fixed window when S-MAC carrier sense. In order to create a trade-off between the energy consumption and latency in some time-critical applications, TA-MAC adaptively adjusts the contention window size, based on some relevant network statistics. NS2 is used to simulate TA-MAC, which has proved that new TA-MAC achieves the best tradeoffs between latency and energy-efficiency according to this dynamic adaptation of contention window-sizes. Especially, TA-MAC's performance improved significantly, compared with fixed contention window size of S-MAC protocol in the wireless sensors network having a larger load change.

articleTitle: Comparison between intrinsic time-scale decomposition and Hilbert-Huang transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper introduces a new non-stationary and nonlinear signal processing method: intrinsic time-scale decomposition (ITD). The ITD method can self-adaptively decompose a complex signal into a set of proper rotation components (PRCs) with really physical meaning and one monotonous trend; it constructs the piece-wise linear baseline signal between successive extrema and computes the instantaneous amplitude and frequency based on the piece-wise wave of each PRC. First, the ITD method is presented. Then, it is used to analyze a simulation signal and good results are obtained. Finally, the ITD method is compared with the Hilbert-Huang transform method and the comparison shows that the ITD method has some clear advantages in preventing overshoots and undershoots, reducing the boundary effect and increasing the computation efficiency.

articleTitle: Schedulability analysis for real-time messages over switched Ethernet with EDF scheduling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To overcome the drawback that switched Ethernet can not meet the real-time requirements in industrial communications, an improved message transmission model in which switch and the end-nodes control the real-time traffic with Earliest Deadline First (EDF) scheduling was proposed. In addition, a distributed admission control method for periodic messages which is performed by the source and the destination nodes without the modification of the operational features of Ethernet switch was presented. Moreover, a more general schedulability condition for real-time periodic message over switched Ethernet was given and proved by using real-time scheduling theory.

articleTitle: Fast FEC synchronization for 10G Ethernet receiver
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The synchronization duration is longer in 10G Ethernet application compare with previous ones due to higher performance and reliability requirement. In worse case, a 2112-bit FEC block in 10G/40G/100G Ethernet applications needs around 9 million bit cycles to achieve synchronized status. This paper introduces a faster method to synchronize the FEC block. Add a smart shift to drop less frame bits and re-use FEC decoder components can help to reduce the synchronization time to 26% compare with traditional way.

articleTitle: 3D GIS interactive editing method: Research and application in glaciology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Although the theory and method of 3D GIS interactive editing is scarce and primitive, the need to develop it has become gradually urgent. Editing in 3D environment by a digital control plane, the method can deal with some geometry efficiently, such as point, line, and polygon, etc. Moreover, based on Open GL, a 3D GIS editorial system in t he form of COM plug2in embedded in Arc GIS 3D environment is developed. The result indicates t hat t he met hod is easy and feasible, and can support much work greatly in geographical field.

articleTitle: Application of mathematical model in wastewater treatment optimal control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A mathematical model for activated sludge system was constructed based on ASM2. State Point Analysis was used to analyze the condition of the Secondary Settling Tanks of the Yinchuan wastewater treatment plant. And the predicted results accorded with the actuality. In addition, we changed the MLSS and the ratio of the circumfluence in order to improve the quality of the effluent. Mathematical simulation of activated sludge system model has certain effects for operation management and technological transformation.

articleTitle: Three-dimentional visual design of rural buildings based on OpenGL
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The impacting action of flood destroyed dramatically the buildings, which caused the vast people and economic losses. It is important to analyze and design the rural buildings to resist the flood. In this paper, considering basic characteristics of rural building structures, the three dimensional models of rural building were built, with the help of windows operating system, MFC framework of VC++ and OpenGL graphics technology, during this process the parameters were input by parameter dialog box. And then the three dimensional model under flood impacting was displayed to show the physical variables of rural housing construction. The drawing of the model on the screen can be scaled, so a friendly Man-computer interactive interface can come true with changing the interactive observation position in 3D space. It is proper to analyze directly and generate the simulation model of rural buildings, and convenient for analyzing and designing software of flood acting on rural buildings.

Author Keywords: the simulation model of rural buildings

articleTitle: Hole filling algorithm based on contours information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new rapid hole filling algorithm based on image boundary contour information is presented. Firstly, the image inside and outside contours are traced, stored, and also distinguished, then the scan line filling method is applied to fill the inside contours(hole regions' contours). The new algorithm only deals with the internal contour information, which needs little complicated computation about the whole region, and avoids too much duplication of operations. So it is fast, easy to program and effective for many arbitrary shapes.

articleTitle: The design of GPS/GPRS navigation and monitoring system based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vehicle Monitoring and Navigation System (VMNS) is the result of the rapid development of science and technology, which developed into a certain stage. This system, which integrated with Geographical Information System (GIS), Global Position System (GPS) and Wireless Communication Technology, has been widely used in many fields, like public security, fire-fighting, finance, transportation, tourism and etc. This paper successfully worked out the design scheme of VMNS through integrated with GIS, GPS and General Packet Radio Service (GPRS). Systematically and in-depth researched the technology of VNMS and related areas, which after surveyed and analyzed the current domestic and abroad situation in term of the development and use of this system. Particularly take Commercial Bank of China, which in Huhehot, Inner-Mongolia as an example, further interpreted the design scheme of this system, including the selection of hardware, the selection of communication way, the design of monitoring interface, finally, successfully proved the general frame of VNMS.

articleTitle: The research on automatic generation of testing data for Web service
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To get the QoS, the third party UDDI registry need to test Web services automatically. Right now, the most existing researches of Web service concentrate on source of testing data, and few focus on the structure and relations between testing data. From parameters structure and relations perspective, this paper provides an in-depth study about the generation of testing data and proposes the testing data structure with composite pattern and describes core algorithm of testing data generation. At last, we validate the research through the results of experiment under a Web service test tool frame.

articleTitle: MapReduce based query of structural engineering experimental data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Structural Engineering Cloud Platform (SECP) is a resource sharing platform oriented to structural engineering domain, and the share of structural engineering experimental data is one of its main functions. In SECP, there are two kinds of experimental data, which are Experimental Description Data (EDD) and Experimental Result Data (ERD). The model of EDD was built based on OWL ontology for shielding the heterogeneity of experimental data from different experimental sites. With the increasing of data scale, the query of EDD has been a bottleneck of the whole management system in SECP. Based on MapReduce, this paper designed and implemented a EDD query system (EDDQS). EDDQS supports query based on SPARQL and there are four core modules named Data Splitter, Query Generator, Job Generator as well as Job Executor. Furthermore, the algorithm of job generation from SPARQL query and job execution algorithms are presented. Finally, the results of our experiments reveal that our MapReduce based query system can handle large amount of EDD efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on graph-based recognition of undercut features from molded part
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new graph-based recognition method of undercut features from molded part is proposed. Attributes of node and edge in Face Adjacency Attribute Graph (FAAG) are extended to form Extended Face Adjacency Attribute Graph (EFAAG). Based on these theories, concave, convex and through undercut features are defined accordingly and sub-graphs of the undercut features are recognized from EFAAG of the molded part by graph matching. Feature orientation of each recognized undercut features is determined by visibility map and optimization parting direction is chosen from these feature orientations. The case study shows that the proposed method is available in recognizing the undercut features and improves the efficiency in undercut feature recognition.

articleTitle: An interfere coincidence processing algorithm for two-dimensional curve offset
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Contour processing is a common machining method. People usually differentiate subring direction after offsetting boundary, if the direction of subring is the same as the parent ring, it is retained, else it is removed, but this algorithm can handle only a finite number of intersection interference problem, there are infinite points of intersection interference problem can not be processed. According to this problem, a contour line along the processing part of the overlap of the interference method. Based on this algorithm, it can solve the bias ring and the islands within the outline of the bias ring and the outer islands of the outer ring of the interference problem. The method has been successfully applied to CAD / CAM module of a certain type of software.

articleTitle: Controller design for networked control systems based on neural network prediction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To the networked control systems in which network-induced delay is time-vary and less than one sample time, a neural network predictive control method is presented to compensate the random delays in this paper. Genetic algorithm is used to optimize parameters. Neural network is introduced to do prediction and optimization calculation. And the uncertainty of the delay is transformed to parametrical uncertainties. Simulation result shows that this control method can evidently improve the control quality with increasing time delay, and has stronger adaptability.

articleTitle: A research of listed companies' financial early-warning system based on the Logistic Mode
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we first used principal component analysis to extract the main financial risks affecting the financial indicators based on spss17.0. And then construct the corporate Financial Early-warning Model through the use of Logistic Model. We selected a total of 60 companies as our sample of listed companies financial forecast Empirical Logistic model include 30 ST companies and 30 non-ST companies as comparison.

articleTitle: The multi-dimensional data model and application research of space induced rice mutant
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-dimensional data model of genome - phenotype and proteome - phenotype is established from the research of the relation of special gene, protein, and phenotype in the space environment, by using data warehouse technology. Based on the model created, the relationship of the data is visualized by YALE. This paper presents a method to analyze large experimental data of gene, proteome and phenotype.

articleTitle: Design of link layer controller for high speed serial bus
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper designs a link layer controller for a serial bus that based on the IEEE 1394 standard. The design is compatible with the interface of physical-layer chips, and able to work at up to 400Mbps in asynchronous transmission mode. Fig. 1 shows the structure of the controller. Based on the analysis of the function of PHY-interface, Fig. 3 shows the control FSM of the PHY-interface. A speed auto-adaptive and no latency CRC, which could improve the transmission reliability, is proposed and it is implemented as shown in Fig. 4. The communication protocol between the link layer controller and the host CPU is also defined. Finally the link-layer controller is described in verilog HDL, and implemented on FPGA. The experimental results show preliminarily that the controller we designed works well in an asynchronous high speed data transform network systems.

articleTitle: Research on routing protocol apply in WSN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The routing protocol apply in WSN (Wireless sensor networks) is researched.WSN used in temperature monitoring system is designed, which is composed of three levels: the control center, the main network and the sensor sub-network, the network topology can be changed in accordance with environment needs. The routing path of WSN is multi-hop, the routing protocol that can choose the routing path adaptively. The WSN is deployed and running steadily, It proved that the routing protocol are reasonable.

articleTitle: A VSM-based data mining engine for geoscience documents
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of information technology in geosciences, enormous data and documents can not be processed by ordinary methods. Furthermore it is difficult to precisely search the target document quickly. In this paper, we propose the use of vector space model (VSM) for automatic date mining of geosciences documents, and a VSM-based search engine system is designed and implemented, which includes three main components: 1)a word segment structure with two hash tables managing the first and the last words of a geo-item and a Trie tree containing the rest of words; 2) a linear space composited by all related documents which need the calculating of similarity; 3) a vector space module mapping documents to multi-dimensional vector space and comparing keywords with features of documents to decide the similarity. This system can make it convenient in geodata sharing and improves the work process efficiently.

articleTitle: Analysis on forest fire in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Forest fire statistics from 1950 to 2008 indicates a decreasing trend whereas catastrophic forest fire shows a waving curve that fluctuates during this period. It is essential to manage the forest fire risk efficiently since forest is such valuable asset to society and it can bring the benefits of ecosystem. As a result, managing the risk of forest fire starts with identification of the hazards from six regions of China. The next step is to find the factors of forest fire and to evaluate the risk based on the probabilistic model. The final step is to finance the risk through setting up an insurance preventive measure.

articleTitle: Development of Knowledge-based System on Aircraft Assembly Drilling Process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An knowledge-based system (KBS) on aircraft assembly drilling should be develop because that assembly drilling requires much experience about process parameter, Tools, Equipments and fixtures to drill precisely and efficiently and the knowledge may update rapidly to suit the improvement of process. This paper lists the influence factor of aircraft assembly drilling which includes fastener, structure type and material. A Hierarchical case representation model presents to resolve the problem level by level in order to simplify the complexity. After discussing the Knowledge base (repository), Architecture of KBS and inference method, the KBS implement is introduced to explain its use.

articleTitle: Application of genetic algorithm in tracking convective cloud images from Chinese FY-2C satellite
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is significance to identify and track convective clouds using satellite data in nowcasting and severe weather warning. This article uses genetic algorithm to match and track convection clouds identified from infrared channel images of FY - 2C satellite. The preliminary results suggest that the genetic algorithm need set up enough group size & genetic algebra, and can select appropriate proportion of genetic operations. The results also show the feasibility & characteristics of genetic algorithm in cloud tracking and provide reference of genetic algorithm application in other related research areas.

articleTitle: Improved RCE neural network and its application in human-robot interaction based on hand gesture recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RCE neural network has been applied in lots of areas because of its advantages, such as less training time, easy to study patterns, and never dropping into local minimization, especially in image segmentation. In this study, we conduct an adjustment algorithm for the traditional RCE neural network. The new RCE neural network runs faster and performs better in anti-noise than the traditional one. Then, in accordance with three stages of hand gesture recognition, we suggest a new method for static hand gesture recognition. Firstly, we apply the improved RCE neural network to hand image segmentation. Secondly, we use Freeman chain code to extract the distance from hand edge to the palm-center as feature vectors. Finally, we use those feature vectors as the input of RBF neural network and train the RBF neural network. Experiment results show this method is efficient and feasible. We develop a scissors-paper-stone game between human and humanoid robot using this method.

articleTitle: The comparison and analysis of classification methods for psychological assessment data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mental health is currently subject to extensive social concern. Applying the psychological assessment to determine the individual psychological characteristics has already become an important method for early psychological intervention; therefore, the efficiency of Psychological assessment data classification is an important measurement for the effect of psychological evaluation. To address the problem, the author has researched the psychological assessment data through experiment based on the evaluation of 455 students of China University of Mining and Technology. Because the psychological assessment data is characterized as higher dimensions, form discrete and uneven sample distribution, this article has compared and analyzed several common classification measurements, and then put forward the improved methods to suit the characteristics of the data sets.

articleTitle: Design and realization of GIS based urban logistics distribution system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the logistics distribution principles systematically and the application of GIS in logistics industry, from the angle of the integration of urban GIS system and logistics distribution, the article adopts C#+SuperMap Objects components to conduct secondary development, working out the logistics distribution system based on GIS. The system integrates the analytic function of GIS spatial information and logistics distribution information, makes the distribution system more visual and concise, and then helps logistics on auxiliary policy. She changes the management and distribution modes for logistics enterprises, enhances the efficiency of logistics distribution, and brings more benefits for enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on the resisting multipath decline technique and its application in mine CDMA mobile communication system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The multipath decline is severe in limited space (such as in tunnel, in laneway and in building), so the quality of mobile communication in it drops sharply. The abilities of spread spectrum communication technique and diversity reception technique to resist multipath decline are studied firstly, and then the techniques are used synthetically in mine Code Division Multiple Access (CDMA) mobile communication system. Finally, a mine CDMA mobile communication system forward link-simulating model is built, a bit error curve of the model is got and the simulating result demonstrates that the performance of the system to resist multipath decline is improved awfully.

articleTitle: The study of Range Doppler Algorithm in focusing Bistatic SAR
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Comparing to monostatic SAR, Bistatic SAR has specific advantages, such as the reduced vulnerability in military systems, additional information about the target and characteristics of signal. Nevertheless, it brings the complication of processing algorithms because of the range history of a Bistatic target is the sum of two hyperbolic range equations, which give a double square-root term in the range equation, and the traditional RD algorithms using in monostatic SAR can not apply for processing Bistatic SAR. This paper obtained the point target signal by establishing the echo signal model, then derived the approximate two-dimensional spectrum of echo signal by using POSP, and a Range Doppler Algorithm suitable for Bistatic SAR is presented. The algorithm is validated by the simulation experiments of point targets.

articleTitle: Electric control system of inverter air-conditioning based on fuzzy control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fuzzy controller of temperature was designed in the inverter air-condition with dual purpose both cold and hot. The control system of inverter air conditioner was divided two parts, that is, indoor machine and the outdoor machine. The frequency control of indoor and outside machine was realized by control software in the foundation of hardware circuit design. Fuzzy control program was selected, two-dimensional temperature controller was designed. PID fuzzy controller suitable for real-time control was proposed in this paper. Finally, the practicability of self-adjust PID fuzzy controller was confirmed by simulation curve. It was shown that self-adjust PID fuzzy controller had a better control performance than conventional fuzzy control methods.

articleTitle: Super-resolution ultrasonic NDT imaging system based on micro-scanning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ultrasonic imaging technology is a remarkable new technology in modern nondestructive testing (NDT). However, at present, the main problem is that its resolution is lower, thereby directly affecting the application value of ultrasonic image. In this paper, the issue of how to improve the resolution of ultrasonic imaging is studied, the method of super-resolution techniques with applications to ultrasonic imaging is proposed. Firstly, the method uses micro-scanning imaging technology obtain low-resolution image sequences with sub-pixel displacement, then through the super-resolution image reconstruction methods obtains high-resolution ultrasound images. Based on the way of thinking, an immersion ultrasonic imaging experimental platform was established, the experimental platform has both ultrasound scan imaging functions, but also has the region of interest (ROI) for micro-scanning imaging functions. And some experiments are studied, the results showed: the method of super-resolution ultrasound imaging based on micro-scan is operational and original, and it is excellent reference material to improve the resolution of Ultrasonic imaging equipment.

articleTitle: 2D to 3D video conversion based on interframe pixel matching
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new method for 2D to 3D video conversion based on motion information. This method exploits the different relations of pixels matching after motion estimation to generate depth map of the 2D video. On the edge of moving object, pixels matching degree is utilized to judge that the pixel belongs to foreground or background. The contour of moving object will become more distinct. Furthermore, to the pixel which hasn't get correct matching, corresponding approach is given according to the object motion. The experimental results show that the sawtooth effect of depth map significantly reduced by proposed method. The quality of 3D video is improved.

articleTitle: Study on face recognition with combined of fisher algorithm and support vector machine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the face recognition, the combined algorithm of Fisherfaces and one-against-rest classifiers based on support vector machine is proposed in the paper. First the wavelet transform is used to compress the image dimension and shorten the time of training. After reducing the dimension with PCA algorithm, the Fisher linear discriminative rules are adopted to extract the optimal features of face. Then the one-against-rest classifiers of SVM are built with the features of the training sample face, which we can use to recognize the face images. The experiments are implemented on ORL and Yale face databases, and the results show that the accuracy rates are respectively 97.75% and 97.80% and the average recognition time is 9.8ms, which also demonstrates that the Fisherfaces algorithm is superior to Eigenfaces one on feature extraction.

articleTitle: Image retrieval method based on color feature of diagonal sub-image in DCT domain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image retrieval method in discrete cosine transform (DCT) compressed domain, which based on the color feature of diagonal sub-image by extracting the dominant color information from DCT domain directly, is studied in this paper, the simulation shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis of the potential function of knowledge-sharing system of enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of an overivew of knowledge-sharing system of enterprises, this paper analyzes the relationship among the knowledge-sharing subject, object, technology and management, puts forward the potential function of knowledge-sharing system of enterprises, and explores the evolution mechanism of knowledge-sharing system of enterprises based on the potential function, so as to arrive at the relevant conclusions of the evolution of knowledge-sharing system of enterprises.

articleTitle: A web service selection model using multi-agent negotiation and planning
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Among the exchange of e-business, how to make users exactly and full search demanded commodities is an important research question, and the web services for searching commodities are the keys. In the process of searching commodities, users can gradually use many kinds of the attribute values of the commodities to invoke relevant web services and get demanded commodities. In existing methods, users can only one by one invoke web services according to having been appointed the route of the commodities' attributes, but when it exists some the routes of the ones, users cannot negotiate and select the attributes, find a best the route of the ones, thereby invoke corresponding web services sequence. On basis of automatic negotiation based on agent, this paper proposes a web service selection model, negotiating selection algorithm and negotiating discount algorithm for common goal by using multi-agent negotiation and planning, which makes user agents negotiate and select web services corresponding with their demand in the light of the commodities' attributes such as price, brand, credit and quality in some existing service agents' workflow templates for searching commodities, compose a new service workflow, and invoke demanded services. Finally the process and results of the algorithms are briefly illustrated, and it shows better applied effect.

articleTitle: Plant leaf modeling based on modified DLA model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, according to summarized and contrast the usual plant leaf visualization techniques, we present a method of plant leaf modeling and rendering based on the modified DLA model and botanical theory. In this approach, we modify the traditional DLA algorithm based on the botanical principles, so that it can simulate the leaf details such as venation more reality. We extract the leaf outline by using the marching square algorithm and generate the leaf venation as leaf skeleton by using the modified Diffusion limited aggregation (DLA) model and the botanical theory which leaf veins growth is related with auxin and leaf blade shape automatically. The leaf was triangulated uniformly by using the optimization algorism of Delaunay mesh. Finally, with the leaf vein node as the control point, the 2D leaf mesh was deformed by using Laplace iterative method to simulate the natural curved plant leaves. Our method provides a good method with leaf modeling, especially the leaf venation can generate automatically based-on the modified DLA and highlighted the importance of leaf skeleton for triangulation and leaf deformation.

articleTitle: Research on emergencies information platform of sudden environmental events
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
