publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An automatic-threshold-based target identification method of eggplant fruit picking robot is proposed for to improve the intelligence and real time of the vision system. A conclusion is drawn that EXG color factor is the most favorable for eggplant fruit image segmentation through experiment and statistics of the color features of the eggplant fruit in growing environment and their surroundings. Automatic-threshold method is adopted to segment EXG gray scale images. The mean value of the image gray scales is selected as the estimated value of the initial threshold, which is continuously iterated until satisfactory result is achieved. Laplace operator is used to extract the eggplant fruit image edges. According to the requirements for the vision system of fruit-vegetable picking robot, such features are extracted as the contour, area, circumscribed rectangle and cut-out point of the fruit target. In is shown by the experiments that the segmentation efficiency is greater than 81% respectively and the average time used is 0.12s, meeting the requirements of fruit-vegetable picking robot for the vision system.

articleTitle: Image retrieval based on optimal matching with block histogram
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm for content based image retrieval using color characteristics. The algorithm takes the Euclidean distance of color histogram between two images as the image similarity and consists of the following steps. First, it segments image into several blocks with the same size, and calculates the Euclidean distance of the color histogram between two arbitrary image blocks respectively belonging to two different images. Next, a weighted complete bipartite graph is constructed. The value of similarity for two images equals to the total cost of minimum cost perfect matching for the constructed graph. Then, the retrieval algorithm outputs the image sequences ordered by the value of similarity. Finally, a novel ideal is developed based on the faster speed of the histogram algorithm to reduce the computational complexity. As a result, compared with other color histogram-based algorithms, it shows that the presented retrieval method has better retrieval efficiency and is robust to rotation, translation and local distortion.

articleTitle: A blind watermarking algorithm based on lifting wavelet transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a kind of blind watermarking algorithm based on lifting wavelet transform. According to the peculiarities of human visual system, the important coefficients first principle is adopted in the proposed algorithm. The algorithm selects high-frequency coefficients adaptively, and modifies these coefficients according to the watermark values to make the defined eigenvalue in different sub-zone. The watermark can be extracted blindly according to the locations of eigenvalues. And this method is proved to have a good sightlessness and have a good robustness and identifiable characteristic under many kinds of assaults by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A new combined method for UCD and software development and case study
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The final goal of software development is to deliver an application that match user's expectation to a larger extent. In order to understand user's requirements more accurately, User Centered Design (UCD) is introduced into software development for a while. But this cooperation still can't satisfy market-oriented software implementation due to problems such as delivery delay and nasty conflicts. As to solve the low efficiency of communication between UCDs and developers, we bring up this new combined model, Inter-combined Model as we called. This model also aims to shorten the knowledge transfer from designers to developers. In this paper, we describe the working process of Inter-combined Model and illustrate it with a project. Our experience confirmed that Inter-combined Model has positive effect on human resource arrangement and cost reduction.

articleTitle: In-vehicle navigation system based on dynamic traffic information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed a spider-web punctual road network model and a dynamic traffic information model suitable for use in the in-vehicle navigation system. Based on these models, the dynamic traffic information can integrate with the embedded GIS efficiently. The in-vehicle navigation system designed in this paper can realize the display and query of dynamic traffic information in real-time, and the optimal dynamic routing according to dynamic traffic information can avoid traffic jams automatically. The application experiments showed the feasibility and effectiveness of the road network model and the dynamic traffic information model.

articleTitle: Implementation of DTTB SRRC filter based on FPGA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the design of SRRC roll-off filter used in DTTB system, a FPGA implementation method of using DA combined with the switch structure of multi-phase decomposition is proposed in this paper. The theoretical analysis and MATLAB simulation are adopted to verify the feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of operations management model in batch-wise manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compare with the discrete manufacturing industries, operations management research has paid very little attention to batch-wise process manufacturing enterprises. In this work, operations management models for batch-wise considered manufacturing enterprises were proposed. It first discussed an inventory control strategy to meet the needs of demands uncertainty and minimize the inventory cost by analyzing sale forecasting models. Considering the contract-oriented production, we illustrated the calculation methods of the planned and total production requirement amounts. Then, a batch considered material requirement calculation model is described. Methods of how to calculate the actual production volume, total material requirements volume, intermediate product volume and percentage of theoretical yield in one of production stages are discussed. Case study shows that the presented operations management method is an effective solution for batch-wise manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Modern agriculture logistics' function elements and its systematic operational management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on modern agriculture's objective demand to logistics service, according to generalized concept of logistics and the characteristics of the logistics function, in this paper, we will analyze the function elements and service contents of modern agriculture logistics, put forward the “ theory of 12 functions”, construct the innovative model of modern agriculture logistics and the systematic operation of the supply chain, and elaborate the new operational management ideas of modern agriculture logistics.

articleTitle: A modified RAND algorithm for multi-buyer joint replenishment problem with resource constraints
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on the multi-buyer jointed replenishment problem with resource constraints. The paper first establishes the general mathematical model for this jointed replenishment problem, and then modified the existing heuristic algorithm—RAND algorithm—to solve the problem, by the Lagrange Multiplier. At last, the paper also tests the feasibility of the new modified algorithm via numeric experiments and compares the efficiency of Lingo and the new algorithm.

articleTitle: Low-complexity high-performance LDPC decoder for CMMB
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A low-complexity semi-parallel low density parity check (LDPC) decoder for China Mobile Multimedia Broadcasting (CMMB) system is designed based on the structure of LDPC codes. The designed decoder utilizes turbo decoding message passing algorithm. A new memory compressing strategy for message updating was proposed, which can reduce more than 50% memories. By using them appropriately, two different code rates can reuse memories without increasing any hardware resource. The decoder is implemented on FPGA of Altera Stratix II. The throughput of the LDPC decoder is up to 40Mbps under CMMB work point, which can fulfill the request of real time decoding.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of static stresses and deflection in vacuum glazing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Stresses and deformation are important parameters in the vacuum glazing design. Since the symmetry of the vacuum glazing, the unit cell finite element model was established. Stresses and strain of the glazing and the supports was calculated. Maximum contact stress and tensile stress of flat glass occur at the contact areas. Maximum vertical deformation of the unit occurs at the center. The stress of support is not evenly distributed, but increases with the radius of support.

articleTitle: Application research of HGML in geo-browser
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the applications and implementations of HGML technology in geo-browser side of G/S mode which is a new type of spatial information network access mode. First, on the basis of HGML technology research, pointed out its role in the geo-browser, and then summarized many advantages of using HGML as the core by analyzing the operating mechanism of the geo-browser, also pointed out that the support of HGML on the client aggregate services. At last, this paper cited the practical application of the geo-browser using HGML in many fields.

articleTitle: A DWDM-ROF system base on frequency interleaving and SSB modulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A frequency-interleaved DWDM-ROF system was designed to improve the optical spectrum efficiency. Meanwhile, a possible demultiplexing (DEMUX) schemes using arrayed-waveguide grating (AWG) was proposed. In the experiment, 25-GHz-separated four-channel optical single sideband signals modulated by a 60-GHz millimeter-wave carrying 2Gbit/s data were optically multiplexed by the frequency interleaving. Over 50-km standard single-mode fiber transmission, the results showed that interchannel-crosstalk had little effect on the system, and verified the feasible of designed demultiplexer.

articleTitle: Research on parameter identification and PI self-tuning of PMSM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) as a multi-variable, nonlinear, time varying, strong coupling controlled-plant, the variation of the motor parameters has significant impact on the dynamic and static performance of the system. The dynamic parameters of the motor and load inertia will vary because of the change of the working conditions for the vector control of PMSM, but the traditional PI regulator is incapable of self-tuning its parameters. The subject presents using robust adaptive sliding mode variable structure (SMVS) motor parameter identification, model reference adaptive motor moment of inertia identification, and real-time self-tuning the PI regulator parameters to improve the parameter identification efficiency and accuracy of PMSM and enhance the adaptive servo control ability and robustness of PMSM.

articleTitle: A hierarchical parallel algorithm of ant system and local search for TSPs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ant colony optimization algorithm is an important swarm intelligence algorithm. It has been applied to many fields of combinatorial optimization because of its parallel, distributed computing and running speed. But, ant colony optimization algorithm has some shortcomings. For example, searching process may stagnate. Local search is a good method when cooperate with other algorithms. But hybrid algorithm of local search and other methods will increase the running time. This paper devises a hierarchical parallel algorithm of ant colony optimization and local search for TSPs and computes the hierarchical parallel algorithm with 4 processors. Computation results show that the hierarchical parallel algorithm can improve the running time about 2.5 times.

articleTitle: Human face detection based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To overcome feature redundancy in the construction of human face detector with AdaBoost algorithm, an improved human face detection method is proposed. First, eight new rectangle feature types are proposed and AdaBoost algorithm is used as a feature selector to make rough selections. Then genetic algorithm with strong search ability is introduced to optimize those selected features and their parameters to build a system that can search out most human faces in images with lower false positive rate and less number of weaker classifiers. Simulations show that compared with existing AdaBoost algorithms, the proposed method can effectively remove feature redundancy, reduce false alarm rate and achieve a higher detection speed with much more accuracy.

articleTitle: Project integrated management based on quality earned value
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional earned value method widely used currently, this article established a quality earned value model, and built up the project quality evaluation system, considering the quality factor. This model can improve and perfect the existing Earned Value, and coordinate the three project control objectives, quality, cost and schedule, based on fuzzy membership. It can comprehensively measure and reflect the actual situation of the overall project progress, thus ensuring integrated management of the project objectives of quality, cost and schedule.

articleTitle: Research on a class of shape-preserving quasi-interpolation functions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the essential relation between the basis function of shape-preserving quasi-interpolation function and the quadratic B-spline basis function, constructs a class of new shape-preserving quasi-interpolation functions, and provides the conditions this class of functions satisfy when they hold the property of linear reproduction, the monotonicity and the convexity of original data, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive subdivision algorithm based on the triangle mesh segmentation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: One problem existing in the triangle mesh subdivision is the number of facets growing exponentially with every subdivision step, and the number of the subdivision surface facets is usually huge and the scheme is difficult to manipulate in post processing. To solve this problem, this paper puts forward an adaptive subdivision algorithm based on triangle mesh segmentation. This algorithm puts forward a new segmentation method for initialization based on meshes region growing, and divides control meshes into several areas connected. Algorithm is mainly divided into four stages, namely analyzing facets, initializing segmentation, computing segmentation center, and vertex segmentation. Experimental results show the algorithm, not only holds ideal smooth surface with fewer facets, but also overcomes the shortcoming of uniform meshes.

articleTitle: Study on record/playback mechanism in Linux
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: GUI library of Linux has not unified standards and this is not the same as that of Windows. So there are a variety of Linux desktop operating systems, and it is a difficult problem for the development of the testing tools in Linux. For solving the problems presently, this paper proposed a general record/playback technique based on X11 in Linux. By this technology, you can record the user's operations, and then be able to automatically playback them in testing. This technology has been used in the development of a platform for performance testing of domestic software.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of remote heart rate monitoring system based on GSM and MCU
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper researches into a remote monitoring system for monitoring the abnormal electrocardio signals and transmitting data automatically through mobile phone messages. Such system utilizes the GSM MODEM and fully-developed GSM network to accomplish data transmission, resulting in great reduction in costs for monitoring and alarm, smaller volume of monitoring apparatus as well as more convenient and reliable operation. This paper introduces the system hardware circuit consisting of heart rate sensor, MCU, interface circuit and MODEM, presents the design for system software realized through GSM based AT command program. Such system adopts the AT89C52 MCU with abundant internal resources to meet the requirements of the system for low power consumption and convenient operation.

articleTitle: Empirical study on focus technology based on Top-level domain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With Internet technology developing rapidly and information massively growing, Internet information has become more and more important resources and cannot be ignored, which contains a lot of information and technology related. In this paper, we propose idea analyzing focus technology and development direction in future using national domain name in Top-level domain based on Internet information. Using the hierarchical clustering method, through comparing countries in one group and between groups, we can discover various countries current universally concerned focus technology and technology development direction in future.

articleTitle: The motion control of profile milling flying saw based on controller MC206
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The profile milling flying saw is able to achieve cut-to-length on moving circular and square pipe, this article highlighted the specific application of the controller MC206 in controlling the motion of the profile milling flying saw and completed the design of the corresponding program using Motion Perfect2 software, which is supported by the controller. Introduce the controller MC206 to the control system of profile milling flying saw is not only be able to achieve the continuous cutting on moving pipes with various shapes, but also increase the cutting speed and accuracy.

Author Keywords: Controller MC206 “S” shape curv Radial Motion

articleTitle: Research of Tugboat operation scheduling problem based on hybrid evolutionary strategy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to Tugboat operation, this paper describes a special parallel machines scheduling problem based on flexible operation route and special process constraint. The schedule model whose objective is to minimize the maximum completion time is created. A Hybrid algorithm based on ES is employed, in which a coding method in accordance with the tugboat number is designed, which shows the quality of satisfying the process constraints automatically, two point crossover operation is used, Multiple Bit with random selection mutation is used to maintenance of population diversity. A local search algorithm based on exchange operation is set up to avoid sticking at local optima, according to the individual code. Finally, the validity of this algorithm was verified by an illustration.

articleTitle: A novel chaos discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm for test suite reduction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at providing the more measure of coverage with the least number of test cases for software regression testing, this paper presents a novel chaos discrete particle swarm optimization algorithm(CDPSO) for test suite reduction, which combines discrete particle swarm optimization (DPSO) with a chaos searching strategy. In the algorithm, particle swarm is initialized by chaotic series, and the position of the particle is produced by stochastic algorithm. Moreover, it introduces chaos to DPSO, making every particle select a suitable search direction from PSO search mechanism and chaos search mechanism, to avoid PSO getting into local best and appearing premature convergence. Finally, the classic example is used to illustrate the performance of the proposed algorithm. The experimental results indicate that the CDPSO algorithm can achieve higher performance, faster speed than PSO, GE, H and GRE, and has nothing to do with the initial value‥

articleTitle: A measurement method on the roundness error based on computer vision system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Precision measurement methods or tools have many applications in the field of measurement, especially for subminiature parts that traditional tools cannot measure. In this paper, a novel measurement system using computer vision equipment is proposed to detect the sizes and roundness errors of taper bore holes in subminiature parts. This measurement system consists of computers, photoelectric microscopes, and CCD cameras. For images taken from ambiguous micro-environments, the Canny edge detection algorithm based on bilinear fuzzy enhancement is used to obtain the edge information of the holes of the taper bore in the subminiature parts. The experiments indicate that the computer vision method is a highly precise approach that eliminates the need for contact and can easily be automated.

articleTitle: Ground penetating radar imaging algorithm of targets located in unknown subsurface environment based on compressive sensing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new GPR(ground penetrating radar) imaging algorithm based on CS(compressive sensing) technique is presented in this paper. It aims at imaging of targets located in unknown subsurface environment. Firstly, a compound objective vector is constructed, including both unknown targets vector and unknown dielectric parameter of background environment. Secondly, the scattering and imaging model is formed based on GPR electromagnetic scattering principle and CS framework. Thirdly, the compound objective vector is obtained by solving a convex optimization problem. Experimental results of GPR simulation data show the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: A new adaptive hierarchical routing protocol in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is an important part of the Internet of Things, The design of routing strategies is very important as well in WSN just like in Ad hoc. The paper firstly describes the characteristics of WSN routing protocols; Secondly analyzes in details the AODV which is the typical on-demand routing protocol in Ad hoc, transplants it into WSN and proposes the transition method of adaptive clustering routing and routing transition; and finally scheme out a new adaptive hierarchical routing transition protocol BCRP of high efficiency and integrity. After doing simulation test, it is found out the adaptability and extensibility of BCRP significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on customer classification rule extraction base on RFM model and rough set
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, the competition between supermarkets is becoming increasingly fierce, and which urges all supermarkets to be constantly innovation in getting and maintaining their customers. In this paper, based on rough set data mining technology, the RFM model was applied to the classification of the supermarket customers, which provide decision support to enterprise marketing programs.

articleTitle: A performance analytical model for NoC with VoQ router architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An analytical model which can be used to analyze the NoC (Network-on-Chip) performance is proposed. More precisely, given the related parameters, the model can analyze the packets sojourn time in each VoQ (Virtual-output-Queue) and then calculate the average packet latency in NoC. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of the model by simulation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the influence of changing rotation rate on the general circulation of the Earth's atmosphere
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By using the second version of the Community Atmosphere Model (CAM2) of NCAR, the general circulations of the Earth's atmosphere were simulated under different rotation rates conditions. The results imply that the intensity of three-cell circulation turn strong when the rotation rate turn slow. Furthermore, under slow rotation rate, for annual mean temperature field, there exist the negative anomalies in the Northern Hemisphere and positive anomalies in the Southern Hemisphere. The region of negative anomaly and that of positive anomaly are divided by 15°S. The annual mean zonal wind field has positive anomaly and negative anomaly when the roattion rate is changed. The positive anomalies and negative anomalies are cross. Compared with summer and autumn, in spring, the changes of geopotential height field, temperature field, meridional wind field in the stratosphere and vertical velocity field are opposite under different rotation rates. Compared with annual mean result, the situation of these three fields is reverse. The westerly in mid-latitude are all strengthened in four seasons under slow rotation rate. The change trends of the zonal wind in two Hemisphere are opposite in spring and autumn. The changes of physical quantities have significant seasonal difference. The change in autumn is the biggest. For monsoon, there are three regions of the linear response - African, Middle East and temperate zone and Frigid Zone.

articleTitle: G/S mode design in digital China technical architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In 1998, the concept of “digital earth”, is the ideal goal of “the earth is loaded into the computer”, unity with digital means to deal with the problems of earth, unity and coherence, in order to maximize the use of information resources. With Google Earth as a representative of the new generation digital Earth technology rapid development and wide application, so we have to rethink the “digital China” technical architecture and the development status and gain enlightenment and new knowledge. This article aims to “digital China” from the Angle that G/S mode, the basic connotation, system framework and realize G/S mode, and points out that the concept of spatial information network access will realize from the current C/S and B/S structure to new G/S structure of the cross.

articleTitle: An improved analytic hierarchy process model on Software Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With new global demands for better quality of software products, effective and efficient SQE (Software Quality Evaluation) becomes necessary and indispensible. Existing methods of SQE are as it is, however, subjective, non-quantitative and uncompleted to some extent. In this paper, we introduce a novel method, an improved AHPM (Analytic Hierarchy Process Model) incorporated traditional AHPM and some quality characteristics from ISO/IEC 9126, which attempts to propose a better method of software quality evaluation that is relatively objective, quantitative and completed. On this basis, current software can be well assessed as well as future products can be well predicted.

articleTitle: The construction of protein-protein interaction network based on machine learning method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are central to most biological processes. Although efforts have been devoted to the development of methodology for predicting PPIs and to construct protein interaction networks, the application of most existing methods is limited because of less and incomplete information. In the present work, we integrate multi-databases which contain protein information and apply for PPI prediction and construction of the interaction network. This process was based on several protein databases and a learning algorithm-support vector machine. The result suggests that the integrating multi-databases could be applied to the exploration of networks for any newly discovered protein with unknown biological relativity. In addition, supplementary experimental information can be added into the multi-databases and enhance the constructing ability of interaction network.

articleTitle: Research on capacity planning problem in MTO enterprises group
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A capacity planning problem is described in MTO operation environment for the enterprises group. The orders are accepted by the group and then are allocated to the enterprises for the maximum net revenue. Capacity planning problem is discussed. Order processing and allocating problems are discussed in the enterprises group. An capacity planning model is proposed. Batch production is considered. Then a mathematic model is presented to solve the problem. An application case is presented to testify the model with the algorithm of Genetic Algorithm.

articleTitle: The application of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and Topsis approach to selection of optimum underground mining method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Usually, the optimistic method of underground metal mines is selected by some mathematic methods, empowered the safe, technical and economic indicators with weight. Due to make the selection of mining method more scientific and rational, Firstly, the Safe indicator is considered separately based on the perspective of corporate social responsibility and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) method is used on the initial selection stage. Secondly, Entropy method is adopted to determine the weight of the related indicators on the final selection phase in case that the subjectivity of determining the weights happens. Finally, Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) method is applied in selecting the optimistic method thorough an example and the results show it is scientific and effective.

Author Keywords: Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution

articleTitle: Trusted full disk encryption model based on TPM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of information technologies and the rapid spread of information systems, security of data storage has become an important issue in information systems. This paper introduces the data encryption technologies of encrypting file system (EFS) and traditional full-disk encryption (FDE), and points out the problems of data encryption of EFS and FDE. Combined with the features of trusted plateform module (TPM), this paper constructs a trusted full-disk encryption (TFDE) based on TPM. In the model, the hard disk is divided into four partitions, and each partition is encrypted with different keys, and the data of different users is encrypted with different keys too. The model can not only ensure that the data can't be stolen when the disk is lost or stolen, but also ensure that the data can't be leaked between different users. Finally the security of the model is demonstrates in depth.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation and analysis of listed port companies in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to provide investors information about the listed companies of China ports, and help those enterprises find their development vulnerability, deep analysis and evaluations are needed. Therefore, the undertaken paper was conducted to evaluate and analyze the performance of 13 listed port companies in China based on performance evaluation theory. The financial performance evaluation system on the basis of Chinese accounting standards of listed companies was established to analyze the different aspects of the company's performance. Hence, factor analysis of multivariate statistical analysis along with SPSS statistical software were used to analyze and process the data obtained from the company's annual report. And then several scores reflecting those companies' performance were obtained. Based on the scores, the investors can access company's performance information to help them make better decision, and the companies can adjust their management skills.

articleTitle: Artificial neural network management system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses imitation of a biological neural network and its applications. From the BP and the RBF network technologies, it is proposed a schema of bionic neural network model based management system (ANN MS), pointed that the system component level (model) development of practical value, and discussed the basic applications of the system: modeling classification, model mining, the detection and diagnoses, and so on.

articleTitle: Understanding the standardization strategies in China from the perspective of Actor-network Theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since Actor-network Theory (ANT) provides a suitable approach to examine the actions of various participants that align their interests around the standardization, this paper investigates the process by which an indigenous standard is created and promoted in a developing country and seeks to explain the phenomena from the perspective of ANT. It concludes that the various endeavors in standardization has mirrored China's ambitions of its manufacturing products to gradually progressing from “made in China” to “innovated in China”; from “the product maker” to “the rule maker”. This government-oriented standardization strategy can be observed distinctly in the process of translation.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Impacts of website factors on after-90 college students' online consumption decision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because of the huge consumption potential, college students born after 1990 have become the market that can not be ignored by the companies. Through empirical study on college students who born after 1990's using behavior of online media we found that product information, website credibility, update speed of the website, online advertisements and website operational have significant correlation with the college students' intention of online purchase who born after 1990. To the corporate who focus on the target market towards college students, website design which fit to the characteristics of college students who born after 1990, the sense of security on the internet, personalized online media marketing strategy, implantable online advertising and customized services can improve the willing of purchase, and make the company to grasp better of the potential market, at last make more revenue for company.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of electric power data acquisition card
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The accurate and high-speed measurement of electric power parameters has an important impact on the realization of automation of power network management. Aiming to the request of the electric power data acquisition, this paper proposed a design of data acquisition card based on PC/104 bus. The utilization of PLL (Phase Locked Loop) realizes the multi-channel and synchronous data acquisition. The application of the FIFO (First In and First Out) resolves the problem of data loss in high-speed data acquisition. The timing control of PC/104 bus and logic control are implemented by CPLD (Complex Programmable logic device). The application shows that this design is perfectly applicable to the electric power data acquisition.

articleTitle: Optimization of continuous dynamic facility layout problem with budget constraints
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The dynamic facility layout problem is concerned with the design of multi-period layout plans. From a realistic perspective, one may have to consider the limited budget to cover the cost of changing the layout. In this research, a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) formulation is presented for the dynamic facility layout problem with unequal-area departments and budget constraints. To deal with the complexity of the problem, a genetic algorithm combining the laying approach addressed in the paper is applied to the construction of a good solution. Experimental results have illustrated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The WTAS Framework: A Petri net based wearable task assistance system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We introduce the so-called WTAS-Framework to support the development of wearable task assistance system for industry applications, such as assembly line production and equipment inspection and maintenance. Based on a hierarchical and reconfigurable architecture, the WTAS framework features the ability to use available sensor sources to perceive the user's physical-environmental context as well as the change of the context intelligently, and to provide the user with appropriate context-oriented service accordingly.

articleTitle: The detection of cable tension based on ERA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The frequency domain analysis is one of the most widely used methods for tension cable test. A new method is put forward in this paper to extract the modal parameters from the vibration signal of tension cables. The ERA algorithm is used as the core of the new method. And the comparative analysis between ERA method and traditional method is also demonstrated. To detect cable tension by using ERA, more accurate and stable fundamental frequency of corresponding vibration signal of tension cable will be obtained. The new method is applied to some cable-stayed bridges of Ningbo City. The experimental and calculation results indicate that the new method can extract the domain frequency of tension cable more accurately, stably and effectively.

articleTitle: Study on informatization operation countermeasures for convention and exhibition enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development level of enterprises' informatization marks their competitive force. With the rapid growth of convention and exhibition in China, informatization construction becomes one of important approaches for enterprises engaged in convention and exhibition field to enhance their overall strength and competitiveness. The paper presents three countermeasures for informatization operation according to the characteristics of convention and exhibition activities. These three measures include the principle of trinity, concept of project unit and mode of information technology as a fulcrum.

articleTitle: Asymptotics for the finite-time ruin probability and empirical analysis in the dependent risk model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A dependent general risk model with constant interest rate is investigated, where the claim sizes are a sequence of upper negatively dependent random variables, and the claim arrival process is a general counting process independent of the claim sizes. The asymptotic behavior for the finite-time ruin probability is derived. With the large claim data from PICC (Peoples Insurance Company of China) Property and Casualty Company Limited in the year 2008, some empirical analysis of the finite-time ruin probability is conducted.

articleTitle: A comprehensive evaluating method of service trust based on the multi-level weighted strategies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the trust relationships in different periods and under different backgrounds, some concepts of service trust are discussed in details. Moreover, a comprehensive service trust value is given by the computing scheme of multi-level weighted strategies. As a unique evaluation, the final result provides a definite and overall trust description of a certain trusted agent in all transacting activities. It can be selected as the trading decision basis for the trusting agents. An example is also given to show that the comprehensive evaluating method of service trust is convenient to be implemented in the practice of business intelligence.

articleTitle: Scalable Parallel IP Address Lookup Architecture based on 2D-Torus network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: IP address lookup is a key issue in modern high performance router design. In order to improve the efficiency and scalability of IP address lookup, a novel Scalable Parallel IP Address Lookup Architecture (SPALA) based on 2D-Torus interconnection network is proposed. As an application of Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) technology, IP address lookup, a complex task, can be completed by a great deal of simple Lookup Engine (LE) nodes, using a highly scalable interconnection network, 2D-Torus, as their communication fabric. The main design issues of SPALA architecture is presented in this paper, including the IP address lookup task partitioning policy, IP address lookup algorithm, and load-balanced routing algorithm for 2D-Torus network. Simulations of proposed architecture are conducted with a SystemC-based test bench. The results show that, with the scale of the size of the 2D-Torus network, the performance of IP address lookup can also scale well.

articleTitle: Fuzzy evaluation of metropolitan public transit system based on matter-element model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of metropolitan public transportation system, a comprehensive evaluation system was established which consisted of indexes of governor benefits, transportation operator benefits and passenger benefits. Then a matter-element evaluation model of metropolitan public transit system is presented by means of extensible engineering method. In the model, the evaluation grades of metropolitan public transportation system is given by using fuzzy subordination degree theory, then the grades and indexes of the comprehensive evaluation system are regarded as matter-elements. The correlation function is established based on the grades, and then the grade of metropolitan public transportation system can be judged from calculating the synthetic correlation degree. Thereafter, it is applied to the evaluation of urban public transit system of YinChuan in the light of survey datum. Some positive results are obtained, and some innovative measures to improve the service level of YinChuan's public transit system are put forward by the results. The example shows this model is valid in public transportation system evaluation.

articleTitle: Customer lifetime value model based on customer satisfaction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper first introduces a basic CLV model of individual customers, and then uses the degree of customer activity links word of mouth and customer satisfaction, finally import word of mouth and customer satisfaction into the model to construct a new CLV model. When identifying customers` value, enterprises can simply and practically use this new CLV model, and conveniently make the most valuable customers as right object to maintain, and promote the successful implementation of customer retention strategy.

articleTitle: Delay-Bounded Multicast routing with low complexity and low cost
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the category of multicast routing problems, one of the most important is delay-bounded Steiner tree problem. The problem of computing such a constrained multicast tree is NP-complete. A heuristic DBMA(Delay-Bounded Multicast routing Algorithm) to solve such a problem based on minimum delay path set and minimum cost path set is proposed in this paper. We prove that multicast trees found by this algorithm satisfy the delay constraint while the complexity is low. Simulation results further demonstrate that it is a delay constrained algorithm with low time complexity and low cost.

articleTitle: Hardware realization and optimized of lifting wavelet transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Lifting algorithm doesn't depend on the Fourier transform, reduces the computational complexity, and it's very suitable for hardware implementation. The hardware realization of lifting wavelet transform is introduced in the paper. It optimized the algorithm, and saved the Hardware resources more than 20% at the situation of speed priority and area priority, and also saved time.

articleTitle: The analysis of product placement marketing's operation and evaluation system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, product placement, as a new and effective marketing method, gets a rapid development and arouses more and more attention. The Product placement has advantages of strong information concealment, well permeate sex, weak brand characteristic, and accept on one's own initiative and so on that it will certainly become the development trend of the Advertising Industry. However, because of the imperfection of market operation system and deletion of the value evaluation system, its development will certainly be seriously affected. This paper aims at analyzing the development and dissemination features of product placement, as to make some research of its market operation and evaluation system's develop and consummate.

articleTitle: The study of financial fragility of different years in China based on clustering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Financial crisis originated from the financial system fragility. To prevent the financial crisis, this article used the hierarchical clustering analysis to determine the classification of China's financial fragility. Firstly, seven micro indexes have main effect on financial fragility through analysis of the financial system in China. Secondly, seven micro index data from 1998 to 2009 are listed according to official figures in China. Lastly, financial fragility of 1998 ∼ 2009 in china is classified through above data based on clustering method. According to the clustering results, conditions of China's financial fragility during the 12 years are classified four types. 2007 is dangerous state. 1999, 2000, 2001 and 2002 is attention period. The situation of 1998, 2004 and 2008 is normal. The last years' is safe. This kind of the analysis method provided reference to China's economic development.

articleTitle: A integrated-extraction method of peaks and saddles based on hill structure subdivision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Both peaks and saddles are parts of the most important terrain feature points. The method for extracting these structure points based on DEMs is of significance in geomorphologic morphology research. In this paper, an integrated-extraction method based on hill structure subdivision is proposed.

articleTitle: A parallel chaotic cryptosystem for dual-core processor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a parallel encryption scheme based on the logistic map in order to meet the dual-core processor. The chaos-based cryptosystem is generated by the logistic map in high-precision floating-point arithmetic. The parallel algorithm is designed with a master/slave communication model with the Message Passing Interface (MPI). The experimental results show that the parallel algorithm provides more enhanced performance against the serial execution of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Spatial query and analysis of tailings management based on GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is popular that new energy resource of the tailing is developed in mining field. This paper discuses the need of tailing management and mainly introduces the tailing resource management system based on GIS of the city of Tangshan, which applies the way of component integrated with Arc Engine and C# computer language. The system makes it possible to build a visual spatially management platform of GIS for tailing resource by means of the combination of spatial data and attribute data. It has some function of spatial querying and spatial analysis for the information of tailing resource on the spatially visual management platform. It is so quick, economical and visual while the user find some tailing information on this platform, which is more efficient in tailing management and can provides a new way for the decision analysis of utilizing tailing resource reasonably.

articleTitle: Research and development: Two-freedom electromyography prosthetic hand
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this research and development, 3-channel surface electromyography(SEMG) signals are acquired from the amputee stump, then, the signal power spectrums is applied for classifying hand motions pattern. The signal processing and controlling circuit which takes Single Chip Microcomputer (SCM) as core processor accomplishes the bionic real-time control of two degree of freedom electric prosthetic hand. The experimental results indicate that the two degree of freedom electric prosthetic hand which based on SEMG signals has a fast response, reliable motions, good manipulation and ideal recognition.

articleTitle: Land use and water quality response in the northern region of Changxing County
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, taking the northern region of Changxing County for example, with ammonia nitrogen as a pollution assessment index, we used an improved export coefficient method for estimate polluting load of non-point source pollution (NSP) and the social pollution survey data in the study area to estimate point source pollution. By comparing the total pollution output and the national surface water environmental quality standards find that the whole study area achieves the second water quality standard. However, Jiapu Township exceeds the water quality standards seriously because of the superfluous point source pollution. The water quality of other Townships is good. Further analysis showed that different types of land use and proportions in the northern region of Changxing County have a significant impact on the non-point source pollution, the general law is farmland contributes the largest share of the non-point source pollution output, followed by residential area and bare land, besides, with the increase in the proportion of forest and the decrease of farmland and residential area, the non-point source pollution reduces gradually.

articleTitle: A method of dynamic experts' information aggregation based on fuzzy complementation matrix
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is a very common and widely used method in multi-attribute group decision-making to achieve the result by ranking the decisions and building the judging matrix explanation according to the weighs achieved by comparing every two ones. In this study, a method is provided to achieve the final decision in the situation that the number of experts is changing dynamically, using the way of giving the experts information through fuzzy complementation matrix and gradually concentrating experts' preferences. Actually this method conforms to our mental habits and the model established is much easier to be commanded and used.

articleTitle: A sort of fast matching algorithm of Auto Rack Girder Detection System
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Auto Rack Girder Detection System based on image mosaicing technique for aerial images were studied. Phase correlation method is used to complete Rack Girder image mosaicing. With Fast Fourier Transform of images, the phase information in frequency domain is used to realize image mosaicing. Considering a lot of Sequence Images having features need to be real-time stitched, improved Fourier field stitching algorithm is put forward in the paper. At first large region is restricted within overlapped areas of image, and then two-dimension pulsing signal is gotten after cross-power spectrum is counted. Registration parameters are gained through maximum of pulsing signal. To bundle image, a new weighting image smoothing algorithm based on Canny is put forward. To the extent, the algorithm has general adaptability to some factors such as lamination variation and noise and so on. The algorithm suits a lot Sequence Images fast stitching as the fast speed of stitching because of fast speed of stitching. The analytic conclusions indicate that the algorithm is adopted to fast stitch a lot of sequence images, and it has general adaptability to some factors such as lamination variation, noise and so on.

articleTitle: Assessing and discussing the efficacy in high-resolution aerosol optical depth using HJ-1 data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Atmospheric aerosol, which is an important parameter required for climate change studies, local air quality monitoring, global aerosol transport modeling, atmospheric correction and global aerosol characterization, decreases seriously regional air quality and may have a negative impact on public human health. Because aerosols had complex sources and the short lifetime, it is difficult to study the particles directly. Remote sensing satellites provided the best ways to characterize spatial field and regional characterization of aerosol particles. The study presents a prototype method for extracting high resolution aerosol optical depth (AOD) in eastern China using remote sensing satellites data. An AOD derivation experiment by HJ-1 CCD data was carried out in Zhejiang province, China, in April 22th, 2010. NASA's aerosol retrieval algorithm was introduced in the study which was developed Robert C. Levy and Lorraine A. Remer based on the Dark Dense Vegetation(DDV) algorithm of Kaufman. The Look-up Table was computed from the 6S RT model. The results had been validated by MODIS atmospheric aerosols production suggesting that the HJ-1 data works well for atmosphere particles detection under complex land characteristic of eastern China, especially in Zhejiang province. Such investigations are expanding satellites for AOD detection, as well as exploring the potential capability for air quality monitoring for HJ-1 data. A very large potential for HJ-1 as an efficient satellite data to retrieve aerosol products was also demonstrated in the study.

articleTitle: The routing algorithm based on reliable path and efficient energy in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In wireless sensor network (WSN), the reliability and energy consumption of nodes are very important parameters to extend the lifetime. This paper proposes a concept that balances reliability and residual energy to control the success rate of message transmission. By formulating the weights of the reliability and remainder energy, the reliability-energy metric is designed to measure routing path and an efficient algorithm is developed based on Dijkstra algorithm to search a reliability-energy disjoint path set. The simulation shows the proposed algorithm is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Research and development of the campus landscape plant systems — A case study of Guangzhou University
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper takes Guangzhou University as the study area, by using GPS and total war instrument, combining with 3S (GIS, GPS, RS, technology to investigate and collect the geographic coordinates and feature of the Landscape Plant from the campus area in Guangzhou university. With the repeatedly development of GIS by using C # + SuperMap2008 platform to develop the Campus Landscape Plants System for realizing functions such as data management, the map shows, information query, and map output, the paper provides reference of efficient, standardized and modernized campus afforestation management for universities. Meanwhile, it illustrates issues such as significance, design, structure, functions and manufacturing processes of the Campus Landscape Plants System.

articleTitle: The design of semantically interconnecting model for ubiquitous multimedia services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the paper, we introduce the semantic web into the generation system of ubiquitous multimedia services, and propose the semantically interconnecting model for ubiquitous multimedia services. In the model, we use the ontology represents the concept model of ubiquitous multimedia, use OWL describes the interconnecting relations of multimedia concept, and define the inference rules and operation for multimedia service generating. Then, we propose the algorithm of ubiquitous multimedia service generating based on virtualization approach. Finally, we demonstrate how the model can be generated the efficacy, stability and personalization of ubiquitous multimedia services on convergent network environments.

articleTitle: Using RSS with difference method in localization algorithm for sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we present a scalable range-free algorithm for localization in wireless sensor network. Accurate and distributed localization algorithms are needed for a wide variety of wireless sensor network applications. Our algorithm finds neighbor nodes by comparing RSS and estimates the location from these neighbors' location. We also provide an evaluation of our algorithm on a simulated sensor network.

articleTitle: An interpolation method for lack of DEM data area in tidal creeks based on neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper researches an interpolation method for lack of LiDAR DEM data area in tidal creeks. The study area is tidal flats in the yellow sea radial sand ridges eastern China. Based on a large of tidal creeks surveying data, combined with topography and geomorphology laws, this research focuses on an interpolation method for lack of LiDAR DEM data area in tidal creek by neural network. The interpolation model structure is 2 hidden layers, 6 neurons in every layer. The calculated terrain of tidal creek that is lack of DEM data is very similar to the actual surveyed terrain. RMSE is 0.117m. R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is 0.716. Residual distribution is normal. The study value is creative to repair the terrain where is lack of LiDAR DEM in tidal flats.

Author Keywords: the yellow sea radial sand ridges

articleTitle: Numerical simulations on a dumpling fog event and analysis on the reasons of its engendering under the complicated topography
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: USA, the regular meteorological observational data in the Northeast Hemisphere and the observed data of the Automatic Monitoring Weather System on the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway, in this paper, WRF V2.2 (The Weather Research and Forecasting Model for version 2.2), a non-static meso-scale numerical forecast model with high temporal and spatial resolving power, was used to simulate a typical dumpling fog weather event occurred on the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway from 03:00 (BJT) to 09:00 (BJT), October 26th in 2007. In order to ascertain the influence of terrain and landforms on the engendering and dissipating of dumpling fog, the sensitivity tests on the terrain and the water system were carried out and a DEM (digital elevation model) in ArcGIS9.3, a software of geographic information system, combined with some topographical data was used to the spatial analysis of the dumpling engendering under the complicated geographic undergrounds. The results were showed as follows: The numerical simulations of a dumpling fog event indicated that: (1) The Zhenjiang section of the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway bas been easy to appearing some dumpling fog weathers. The beneficial engendering conditions of a dumpling fog event were the stable atmospheric environment, the ground surface radiation cooling at night, and the cooling of the warm and wet flow from the southern regions moved through the cooler ground surface. (2) When two branches of airflows from the different directions of the north and south converged in the western part of the Expressway, it was favorable to the standstill of wet air and aerosol particles and it also was one of the main reasons for the developing and maintaining of the dumpling fog weather. (3) The dumpling fog dissipated rapidly when short-wave radiation warmed the air closed to the ground after sunrise. (4) The sensitivity tests of terrain and water system displayed that the distribution of terrains and landforms in the fog area were sensitive to the formation of dumpling fog. The undulating terrain and the environmental water system had certain effect on the engendering of dumpling weathers.

articleTitle: Proximity-based ranking of biomedical texts
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Biomedical decision making and research often require relevant evidences in the huge and ever-growing biomedical literature. Retrieval of the evidences calls for a system that accepts a natural language query for a biomedical information need, and among the large number of texts retrieved for the query, ranks relevant texts higher for access or processing. However, state-of-the-art text rankers have a weakness in dealing with biomedical queries, which often consists of several correlating concepts and prefers those texts that talk about the concepts completely. In this paper, we present a technique PRE (Proximity-based Ranker Enhancer) that measures contextual completeness of query concepts appearing in a nearby area in the text, and based on the contextual completeness, assesses the term frequency (TF) of each term in the text. Therefore, those rankers that consider TF in ranking may be supplemented with PRE, without needing to change the algorithms and development processes of the rankers. Moreover, PRE is efficient to conduct the TF assessment, and neither training process nor training data is required. Empirical evaluation shows that PRE significantly improves several state-of-the-art rankers, and is better than several state-of-the-art techniques aiming at improving rankers.

articleTitle: Research on farmer desire and behavior characteristics in farmland circulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this study is to verify farmer desire and behavior characteristics in farmland circulation. Methods of questionnaire survey and statistical analysis were employed. The results indicate that the farmland circulation interests many farmers in mountains, and the supply outweighs the demand in the farmland circulation. The farmers mainly think about land income of farmland circulation, moreover, governmental support is very important for improving farmland circulation. For the farmers in mountains, land assurance function outweighs economical function. Farmland circulation takes on these characteristics that farmers circulate land spontaneously, and the relationship of farmland circulation is unsteady, and the behavior of farmland circulation is irregular. It is concluded that nowadays many farmers in mountains have desire of participating in farmland circulation, and it is premise for driving farmland circulation forward to raise benefit of agriculture, and it is assure for driving farmland circulation forward to establish and improve social security system in urban areas, and it is key for driving farmland circulation forward to strengthen the governmental function.

articleTitle: A novel evaluation method based on individual advantage value parameters with multi-hierarchy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel evaluation method is put forward. Firstly, it is a breakthrough for uniform weight evaluation patterns; it evaluates each evaluated object with the weight vector highlighting the relative advantage characteristic from individual viewpoint; Secondly, it puts forward a depict structure expressional form of one's individual advantage characteristic; thirdly, it evaluates each object according to each evaluated object's advantage value parameters, because different evaluation methods may result in different sort orders, evenness method is adopted to increase accuracy of the comprehensive evaluation. Lastly, relying on cluster analysis of individual advantage structure weights, the behavior pattern can be identified. The calculation example proves that the method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: The strategies ‘discussion about telecom operators charge control the proportion of value-added service’ income in the total value
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Value-added service' proportion in total income is gradually increasing with customer' demand diversification. The user's churn rate is relatively less with the telecom operators support more value-added service. However, the higher value-added services are likely to make service provider and content providers to pressure the telecom operators and drop the telecom operators' competitive value. The paper analyzes the influence of telecom operators' competitive value on the basic of value-added service' increasing. The paper constructs mathematical model about telecom operators charge control the proportion of value-added service 'income in the total value, and mentions that the maximum proportion of value-added service 'income in the total, which can solve the problem of high case of the users' churn rate and ensure the enterprise competitive at the same time.

Author Keywords: the proportion in the total value

articleTitle: The empirical analysis on the effectiveness of Chinese monetary policy to contain inflation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Whether the Chinese monetary policy can contain the inflation effectively, domestic theorists did not have a definitive conclusion until now. This article uses Akaike info criterion ADF examination, Johansen cointegration test, Granger cause and outcome test to analyze the effectiveness of China monetary policy in restraining the inflation in the period July 2005 to July 2008. The results show that inflation inertial RMB appreciation pressure offset china monetary policy effectiveness.

articleTitle: Information disclosing and cooperation in public goods game with punishment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The results of a number of laboratory experiments indicate that costly punishment can uphold cooperation in public goods game. However, studies also suggest that high cooperation does not necessarily imply high earning in experiments with punishment. In this paper, we investigate the impacts of information disclosing on cooperation and then welfare when punishment is available. We report an experiment in which different kinds of information disclosing mechanisms are introduced into the standard public goods game. In one treatment, players' identities are revealed along with their historical contribution information to allow them to built up a system of reputation, while in another treatment, players' historical decisions on both contribution and punishment are revealed along with their identities to permit them an opportunity to revenge. Results show that, contributions and overall earnings are marginally significantly improved when only identities is revealed with their contribution information. However, the results change to significant when both information on contribution and punishment as well as players' identities are available. These results imply that information disclosing helps to promote cooperation and thus wealfare.

articleTitle: Research on the development of hotel experience products in terms of the theory of semiotics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The essence of tour is pursuing experience. At the same time, tour is also a paradigm of symbol. Hotel functions as an important part of the tourism, so the development of experience hotel products plays an important role in guiding tourists. Based on the theory of semiotics and combining the relative theories, such as tourist experience and symbol appreciation, the experienced development of hotel can be considered as a systematic process of symbolic operation. This paper clarifies the relative concepts of symbol, discusses the composition of experience hotel products, analyzes the process of customers' appreciation of experience hotel products and constructs the symbolic operation model of the development of experience hotel products with a core of “symbolic value”.

articleTitle: A study on single-item inventory control model for hazardous materials based on ARIMA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The cost of hazardous materials inventory is one of the most important factors should be considered when optimizing inventory control in supply chain management. A inventory control model based on ARIMA (Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average) for hazardous materials is introduced with the characteristics of demand. Through iterative calculation, the optimal order point and the best order quantity is worked out to achieve the target of minimize the cost. In the end, through a concrete example, the usability of the model is verified.

articleTitle: An efficient earth mover's distance algorithm for shape context feature
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Shape context is not rotation invairent as a local visual feature. Using earth mover's distance (EMD) for similarity comparison can make the feature rotation invairent but its computational cost is expensive. In this paper, based on the property which the feature histogram's angel dimansion circle shifts when image rotates, a fast and efficient method is presented to compute EMD between two shape context features for point matching problem. The analysis shows the time complexity is much lower and the experiments show the effective and efficiency of new method.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic changes of Zoige plateau landscape
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Zoige wetland is the source of Yangtse River and Yellow River. Its dynamic changes are studied mostly before year of 2000 based on MSS and TM images. This study selects TM and CBERS images to obtain the landscape structure of typic region of Zoige plateau. The results show that: (1) the grassland is the primary landscape of study area. The next are bared soil, woodland and farmland. (2) Wetland area decrease from 1316.37km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 303.22km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with decrease rate of about 72.36km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/a since 1994. (3) Farmland area increased between 1994 and 2001, but decreased since 2001. High coverage grassland area decreased, middle coverage grassland area increased, low coverage grassland area increase, snow and bared soil area decreased since 1994. (4) The wetland spectral characteristics are distinctive in bands of the fourth, fifth and seventh with lowest pixel values. (5) The wetland is converted into grassland, bared land primarily. (6) The landscape indexes of wetland show that the wetland patches are getting smaller and fragmentized in shape, and more disperse in distribution since 1994. Therefore, the degradation of wetland in Zoige plateau is much more severe and should be attach importance to for protection and management.

articleTitle: A migration model for grid job based on context-awareness
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The distributed, dynamic and heterogeneous nature of grid brings higher requirements and challenges to the job migration. Existing research can not solve the problems that exist in the grid job migration. A new migration model for grid job is present in this paper, which is based on grid information context-aware. On the basis of deeply analyzing the relevant migration technology, a better migration strategy was put forward in this paper, which takes migration occasion, job and destination into account.

articleTitle: Research on statistics data classification by introducing spatial distance into SOM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are two main limitations in Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and other traditional statistical methods: firstly, these methods only examine similarity among objects based on their attribute data, but ignore the spatial relationship among them, which means regions of geographical proximity often have similar features that can not be completely described by only a few economic attributes. Secondly, the information included in data may be incomplete because of the shortcomings in collecting process, but the missing information must be complemented in some way for obtaining more accurate results. So in this paper, the authors proposed to introduce spatial distance into traditional statistical methods to overcome these two defects, and chose a neural network method for making improvements to analyze civilian-owned economic statistics data of Sichuan province in 2007, and finally worked out a series of classification results for different spatial distance weight values. Based on these classification results, the authors discussed the reasonable range of spatial distance factor, and interpreted the meanings of this improvement from the point of view of the economic geography. It is proved that the classification results are consistent with the actual situation in this research. How to determine the distance factor is the key of successful application of this method.

articleTitle: Choas biolodical immune algorithm and its global convergence
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel choas biolodical immune algorithm (CBIA) was proposed by combining the immune algorithm (IA) and the chaotic optimization. Taking advantages of the ergodic and stochastic properties of chaos Logistic Equation, an adaptive chaos mutation operator is designed by the combination of prior knowledge of antibody and evolution iterations. The operator can avoid blind research and enhance the convergent speed effectively. Being the restriction of Homogeneous Markov chain theory, the pure probability method and iterative formula are applied to analyze the global convergence of the proposed algorithm. This method makes the convergence study greatly simplified and laid the theoretical foundation for the practical application of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A new Bayesian reliability assessment scheme based on D-S evidence theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The sizes of experiment samples are usually small in the reliability evaluation of comprehensive new products. In this case, Bayesian statistical method is generally more suitable than the classical methods and has thus been widely used in the process of reliability assessment. In order to express and apply the uncertain prior information better, we present a new Bayesian reliability assessment scheme based on the D-S evidence theory.
