The estimation for reliability index of exponential distributions is studied for the non-replacement fixed failure number test samples. At the same time, we propose two reliability assessment methods. One is a comprehensive evaluation by integrating the posterior distributions of reliability indices. The other is one by integrating the posterior confidence intervals. Numerical examples show that the proposed methods are prudent and reasonable.

articleTitle: A knowledge base maintenance system for fault diagnosis expert system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of inherent insufficiency of traditional fault diagnosis expert system in the aspect of knowledge representation, together with the characteristics of fault tree, hierarchical model and expert system, this paper puts forward a knowledge base maintenance approach based on Object-Frame knowledge representation, in which domain specific knowledge is expressed by combinations of the relevant objects' states. Object Frame knowledge representation and knowledge management are discussed. Algorithms are proposed for integrality verification of five inconsistencies among Object Frame knowledge: contradiction, redundancy, subsumption, circulation, and reclusion. The techniques such as management of dynamic data structure, interface and display of inference pathway are also described. VC++ and Access are adopted in developing the system. Experimental results demonstrate that this method has the characteristics of simple process, low computation complexity and strong adaptability.

articleTitle: Sdudy on stability and prevention and cure project of Dangjiaba landslide in Xunyang
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dangjiaba landslide in Xunyang under natural condition is stable, whose surface locally exists shallow slipping signs. Currently, the slope toe is excavated because of real estate development. So, many tensile cracks are produced from these artificial engineering actions. Cracks existing at both sides of slope surface tend to cut-through, which illustrates the critical situation of the landslide. Then, the emergency measure such as weighting at toe of slope and sealing these cracks is taken. And the surveying, stable estimation and prevention-cure design are done. This landslide is typically triggered by human being, whose slip mode is pull-type. There exist the important power and communication facilities on the slope, so the anti-slip pile is considered. Aiming to be taken warning by hither engineering in this area.

articleTitle: Object segmentation based on accurate disparity estimation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Object segmentation is an important issue in computer vision. In this paper, we present a new object segmentation algorithm based on accurate disparity map. First, the accurate disparity map is available by a stereo match algorithm including initial matching cost estimation, mismatched pixels checking, plane estimation and self-adaptive hierarchical belief-propagation. Then, self-adaptive threshold segmentation is performed on the result that is achieved from the first step. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is an effective object extraction method suitable for stereoscopic static scenes and image sequences with unitary global motion.

articleTitle: Cryptanalyses and improvement of identity-based strong designatured verifier signature schemes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with ordinary digital signature, the strong designated verifier signature (SDVS) scheme makes it possible for a signer to convince a designated verifier that he or she has signed a message in such a way that the designated verifier cannot transfer the signature to a third party. Recently, Bao et al. proposed two ID-based SDVS schemes by use of bilinear pairing. In this paper, we show both of these schemes are insecure against active attack, that is the attacker can forge signature without signer's private key. Combining with the Schnorr signature scheme, we also provide a new efficient ID-based designated verifier signature scheme.

articleTitle: Research on human resources allocation based on the contribution of professional type's value
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the core issue of HRM, human resource allocation is both the start and the end of HRM, It includes quantity deployment, quality deployment and structural deployment. Optimization of the structure of human resources is very important when there is a setting number of a human resources quantity. This paper mainly studies the optimization of the structure of human resources from the angle of contribution of professional type's value. The human resource's structure optimization is mainly used for balancing the proportional relationship of various professional categories in the enterprise. It can enhance the enterprise's overall achievements by balancing professional ability of various professional categories.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on statistical service method of production cost based on “MBO” model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Decomposition and clustering analysis for students modeling in intelligent E-Learning system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Students learn in many ways. There are all kinds of Teaching methods. When a student's learning style is compatible with the instructor's teaching style, the assumed learning outcomes will be obtained. So a good intelligent E-Learning system needs adjust teaching style according to the students' learning style. In the paper, students' modeling in intelligent e-learning system is considered. The models are based on the learning styles dimensions of the Felder & Silverman model. Students are divided into groups by decomposition and clustering method. The process is under the control of parameters such as distance and maximal number of groups. Experimental results show that a effective students' modeling can be obtained by the method.

articleTitle: Multi-layer rendering based Chinese Ink-Wash Painting styled 3D generation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the idea of components and multi-layer rendering, a Chinese Ink-Wash painting styled 3D rendering algorithm is put forward which covers the simulation of brush styles and painting composition styles. We abstract some special renders, and each of them represents a kind of special art effect. Components of the input object model could be rendered and blended by multiple renders. During the whole rendering process the Chinese painting pigments model and particular diffusion algorithm are combined and implemented. The experimental results indicate that this algorithm generates the effects successfully with minimum user interaction.

articleTitle: Design of color night vision system based on Nios II
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The design to Altera's FPGA chips EP2C35F484C8 Cyclone ┚ series as the core development platform, design and implement of a hardware circuit, Introduced a development platform for the design of each circuit module. The hardware platform combined with Altera's Nios ┚ processor enables analog video signal acquisition, processing, video transmission and recovery. Experimental results show that the system low power consumption, gray image processing is better color, real-time strong.

articleTitle: Model construction of safety occupational aptitude
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By reviewing relevant theories, the definition and research object of competency in safety occupation aptitude research has being cleared. Then, by introducing the competency theory in human resource management into the research of safety occupation aptitude, and drawing on the establishment and inspection method of competency model, this paper provides a new method and theoretical basis for establishing special industry safety competency model.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation studies on the environment emergency response activity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, some numerical simulation studies on long distance transport of hazard materials from an accident of a nuclear powerstation have been showed with the Hysplit-4 model of Air Resource Laboratory, NOAA, USA. Two kinds of studies have been done : 1) A verification study shows that the Hysplit-4 model has successfully simulated the long distance transport process of radioactivity materials from Chenobyl accident site in 1986 to Munich. 2) the focus of attention of the differences of the geographic distribution of the radiactivity concentration fields between winter seasons and summer seasons has been made in case that the severe accident of Qingshan like Chenobyl would occur based on the historical meteorological fields in January or in July from 1992 to 2001. Furthermore, by making averaging of the simulated data of the concentration fields of cases separately in January or in in July, we obtain two groups of the geographic distribution of the concentration fields of hazard materials in 24 hours, 48 hours and 72 hours. The results show us that the effect region and the intensity of hazard materials are larger in winter than in summer.

articleTitle: Research on assessment of CDM projects' influence on China's sustainable development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper firstly introduces the CDM's flexibility mechanisms and the issues of sustainable development. Then it further studies methodologies on the assessment of the influence of CDM projects on sustainable development and a set of indicators to evaluate non-carbon benefits of CDM projects on the environment, development, and equity, and demonstrate show how these indicators can be used in practice by looking at case studies of CDM project candidates in the energy sector from china. Finally, it makes some suggestions such as promoting sustainable development and indicators can be a necessary tool to assure that sustainability impacts of CDM projects are taken into consideration.

articleTitle: The construction of valuation system of financial support on industrial transfer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article starts from the function of financial market of amassing, allocating, regulating and reflecting and explores the mechanism of financial support on industrial transfer. It finds out that the financial support takes effect in four ways: filling the capital gap, guiding the transfer direction, building the transfer environment and reducing the transfer risk. On this basis, constructs an evaluation index system of financial support degree on industrial transfer. With this system, you can prepare the comprehensive index of financial support degree of different areas or industries and find out the existing problems. So that can improve the efficiency of supporting, promote industrial transfer and realize the optimization of industrial structure.

articleTitle: SDP based pulse shaping method to compensate for antenna distortion in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to expand the application of wireless sensor networks (WSN), ultra-wideband (UWB) technique is approved as one of the physical layer of IEEE 802.15.4a standard. Theoretical analysis shows that the performance of UWB system is affected by the transmitted pulse waveform, and pulses with high power efficiency can improve the signal to noise ratio (SNR) significantly. Hence, pulse with high power efficiency is desired in UWB systems, and the semi-definite programming (SDP) method can provide the pulse with highest power efficiency by far. However, most pulse shaping methods did not consider the antenna distortion which cannot be neglected in UWB communication systems compared with conventional systems. In this paper, a SDP based pulse shaping method to compensate for antenna distortion is proposed, and simulations show that the proposed method can be used to achieve compensation for antenna distortion, and higher power efficiency can be obtained for the pulse transmitted by the transmitting antenna.

articleTitle: A study of electrical energy meter production line based on statistical process control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional production mode involving too much manual operation can no longer to adapt to the trend of the development of science and technology which requires highly automatic production lines of electrical energy meter with electronics. The application of scientific control methods in production lines not only conforms to the tide of history but enhances the efficiency greatly. In this paper, statistical process control is applied to the production line of electrical meters by thorough analysis of the whole electrical meters line.

articleTitle: Research on the externality of operational safety in urban underground space
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As an important part of the urban space, urban underground space has the characteristics of public space. Its operational safety has obvious externality. Based on the externality, this article analyzed the externalities of operational safety in urban space underground, the causes and the solutions to make a reference for the safety management of urban underground space.

articleTitle: Research on spatial decision support system for porous groundwater management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Author researches and designs Business modules of spatial decision support system for porous groundwater management (SDSSPGM). The business modules are basing on groundwater management activities. According to each business module and the feature of SDSSPGM, author designs function of each business module. The conceptual models of porous groundwater are Build base on points, polylines, polygons and volumes. Author proposes a technology roadmap for auto extract hydro-geological parameters. The roadmap is supported by spatial analysis function of GIS. Later, Author designs architecture and implementation plan of SDSSPGM, takes Wujing district as study area and builds the system. Experimental results reveal SDSSPGM combines porous groundwater computation with visualization. SDSSPGM can provide reasonable decision support for experts to manage groundwater and make reasonable groundwater pumping plan.

articleTitle: Research and design on active firewalls with immune function
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional firewalls are static and passive and they have been unable to meet the security requirements of the increasingly complex network environment. According to the biological immune principle, we present an active firewall model with multi-layer based on immunological principle and introduce the method and technique used on each layer of the firewall. The firewall will protect the computer security through collaboration with each other.

articleTitle: The study of Pairwise Condition Covering test technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multiple Condition Coverage (MCC) is a very strong test criterion in the white-box test, but as it requires much more test cases, it is not useful in practices. We now propose a new method: Pairwise Condition Covering test, which simplified MCC, but inherited the advantage of MCC, meanwhile it needs only a few numbers of test cases. Compare to the widely used Modified Condition/Decision Coverage (MC/DC), it will use less test cases when there are quite a lot of conditions; besides it can discover the deficiencies which MC / DC could not identify.

articleTitle: A kind of Amplitude Adaptive Predistorter Design based on Sinusoid for High Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a kind of Amplitude Adaptive Pre-distorter Design based on Sinusoid for High Power Amplifier (HPA). On the one hand, constraints are increased in the pre-distorter, and the efficiency, maximal export power and linearity into account at the same time; on the other hand, the ideal gain can be identified intelligently; and then, in order to resolve the problem of complicated algorithms realization and slow convergence, the pre-distorter is predigested, in which RLS is used directly. Finally, simulation testing based on the predigested model is carried out, and the results show the advantages of the technology.

articleTitle: The application of IGBT driver MC33153
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Base on the further research of the IGBT driver MC33153, there is a typical application of MC33153 in UPS proposed in this paper, moreover, analyzing and improving its external circuit.

articleTitle: Method for universal combat platform simulator based on domain component model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method for universal combat platform simulator development based on domain model and component technology is proposed. On the high abstraction level, domain model can be used to obtain demand model in the special domains, based on which different business objects should be mapped to different components. Basic Framework describes the combat platform commonness and provides its variety extensions in which corresponding components can be integrated into the simulator. In this way, all kinds of combat platform simulators can be developed. This method is capable to capture domain commonness and control variability successfully. For this reason, the reusability and interoperability of a military simulation software are both greatly improved.

articleTitle: The design of electricity-hydraulic servo system in windows XP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The overall design of computer control system is put forward based on Electro-hydraulic servo control system, the mathematical model of symmetric asymmetric cylinder valve control is established, dead-beat control for electro-hydraulic position servo control system is designed, precise timing of real-time control in Windows XP is effectively handled for the virtual driver, the experiment result show that the method, which is proposed in this paper, is effective.

articleTitle: Research on analysis technology of Internet Public Opinion based on topic cluster
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Network has become the main vector of information dissemination, and, the information stored and transmitted in Internet can be reflected Internet Public Opinion in period. The Sensitive topic mining study on the Internet helps us understand the Internet public opinion trends. This paper studies method about search data cluster of Internet users with K-nearest neighbor and shortest path approaches. We first build an association search net, then, provide shortest path. It will help us analyze Internet user's search behavior and characteristics. Finally, we will discover the information dissemination pattern and guide Internet public opinion trends correctly.

articleTitle: A new flexible array self-calibration method for short baseline hydroacoustic passive localization system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A real-time sensor array self-calibration method is presented in this paper to reduce the ship-based flexible array element coordinates uncertainty in short baseline passive localization system. Six composite sensing elements are deployed to form the flexible array. Three of them emit direct spread spectrum DPSK pulse to measure the distance between six elements. Coordinates of these elements were then calculated based on these distances. Lake experiment data are used to validate this method. The source distances and bearing calculated using the calibrated sensing elements coordinates agree well with the GPS data.

articleTitle: Supplier selection based on scatter-degree—Extension theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to practical needs of supplier selection in the supply chain, this paper uses matter-element model, theory of extension set and scatter-degree to establish dependent function and extension judgement model reflecting the inherent laws of supplier selection, and verifies the validity of the model by example.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Passivity-based control strategies of doubly fed induction wind power generator systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Passivity-Based Control Strategies of Doubly Fed Induction Wind Power Generator Systems"
by Qian Ping, Xu Bing
in the 2010 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering (ICISE), December 4 – 6, 2010, pp. 395 – 399

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper contains significant portions of original text from the paper cited below. The original text was copied with insufficient attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"Adaptive Passivity-Based Control Strategies of Doubly Fed Induction Wind Power Generator Systems"
by Hua Xue, Yufei Wang, Fan Yang
in the 2010 2nd IEEE International Symposium on Power Electronics for Distributed Generation Systems (PEDG), June 16 – 18, 2010, pp. 731 – 734


Nonlinear control strategies of variable speed constant frequency(VSCF) wind power generator systems, especially passivity-based control(PBC) methods, have been a focus in the literature. The main purpose of this paper is to develop a control algorithm that forces the wind driven doubly fed induction generator(DFIG) to track reference flux and speed trajectories with time-varying load torque. To achieve this, an adaptive PBC method based on Euler-Lagrange(EL) system is developed. PBC combined with current estimator scheme not only reserves the advantages of PBC such as nonexistence of singularity, but also repressed the harmonic current tracking error caused by resistance and inductance variation. This leads to a simple control structure and enhances the robustness of the control system. The reasonability and validity is testified by the experimental results based on dSPACE.

articleTitle: Positive analysis of the stock option pricing model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper not only introduces binomial tree model and Black-Scholes model of pricing stock option, but also adjusts the two model to real-world data. Through the close price data of the Disney Stock, we estimate the parameters in the two models, price the option of the Disney Stock with the software of Excel and Matlab. At last the advantages and disadvantages of the two models are compared and advice will be given how to use the two models to price different options.

articleTitle: A GIS-based system for regional planning and its application in Chengdu, China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The regional planning is to find an area's functional position and set goals for development in order to promote accelerated development in the area. This study used ArcEngine 9.3 and Microsoft Visual Studio 2008 as system development platform to construct a universal regional planning model system and apply it on Chengdu to help making decision. This GIS-based system contained 5 models which played different role in calculating and spatializing regional planning indexes and solve problem from spatial angle. All the modules were concealed in dlls which could easily embed in the Main Form of the system. Because its flexibility, the models could be easily used in other region and help decision making in other place.

articleTitle: Analysis of characterization for difference vegetation index in relation to land surface temperature in arid oasis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper compares the fraction of vegetation (FV) and normalized different vegetation index (NDVI) as indicators of oasis surface vegetation condition in Landsat imagery by investigating their relationships with the land surface temperature (LST). Landsat Thematic Mapper (TM) and Enhanced Thematic Mapper plus (ETM+) data were used to estimate the LST in 1999 and 2009 for three different oases in the south marginal zone of the Tarim Basin, China. The FV were generated using a normalized spectral mixture analysis of Landsat TM imagery in September 1999 and 2009. Liner regression model was used to quantify these relations between LST, FV and NDVI. The results indicate there is a relatively strong linear relationship between LST and FV for both years, whereas the relationship between LST and NDVI is stronger than FV

articleTitle: Application of combined forecasting method to prediction of demand for the special purpose vehicle in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper predicts the demand of the special purpose vehicle for the next few years based on the actual data of special purpose vehicle production in China since 1998. In order to improve the accuracy of forecasting, it establishes two kinds of combination forecasting model through the introduction of weight, according to the different methods to handle error. The composite models integrate the advantages of three single forecasting methods: the exponential smoothing, growth function and the GM (1, 1) model. Optimal combination forecasting model, which is determined by minimizing the sum of squared errors, makes the forecast more accurate. The predictive result will play an important guiding role in coordinating the supply and demand of special purpose vehicle and avoiding the mistakes in investment decision-making caused by out of control.

articleTitle: An exploratory study of the Management Dimensions of customer-based Brand Performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to manage and measure brand performance better and raise the level of brand management, this paper made an exploratory research on Brand Performance Management Dimensions. On the basis of literature review we emphasized that brand performance management dimensions must base on the perspective of consumers. Used of questionnaire survey, and with the help of SPSS factor analysis, finally, we discovered the brand performance which based on customer perspective have 5 management dimensions and named them: brand reputation, brand satisfaction, brand trust, brand loyalty and brand of tolerance. The results show that they can sort out the brand performance management dimensions' hierarchy more concisely and clearly, and they not only enrich brand management theory, but also make the enterprises in brand management with strong guidance.

articleTitle: Study on rotary of backoe-loader based on the MATLAB
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the stability in rotation of excavating device of backoe-loader, Its structure is presented, rotation motion is analyzed, constraints is established, the rotation stability is judged and the effect factors which can affect the stability is found, The MATLAB/SIMULINK is used to imitate the dynamic characteristic to improve backhoe-loader characteristic of rotation process through optimizing important parameter. The simulation results show the reliability of the designing method.

articleTitle: GIS-based rapid loss assessment on flood disaster: June 21 flood of Fuhe basin being a case
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In consideration of the serious loss of floods in our country, this paper established the method for assessing the water depth and duration of flood referring to the venerability curve of hazard bearing body, based on the concept of rapid flood loss assessment and from the perspective of regional disaster system theory. A model of rapid assessment on the loss of hazard bearing body was set up. The method for assessment of induced factor was established after analyzing the data acquirability. The venerability curves of hazard bearing bodies were summarized, and then models for rapid assessing the hazard bearing bodies were built up using the overlay method of GIS. Taking the “6·21” flood of Fuhe basin as an example, this paper assessed the loss of crops, the damage of buildings and the affected population. The assessment results are basically in accordance with the reported data from investigation.

articleTitle: Freshpoint-based and load-aware failure detection for Web services
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To satisfy the requirements of reliable Web services, the mechanism of adaptive failure detection for Web services in the dynamical network environment is studied. A framework of hierarchical failure detection is presented firstly, then an algorithm based on freshpoint and load awareness is presented. It considers the factors including the frequency of message delivering and the message loss probability so as to enhance the adaptability to the network context and to improve the quality of detection. Simulation results show that the algorithm can guarantee the correctness of detection as well as obtain the tradeoff of rapidness.

articleTitle: Study on energy consumption effects of residential buildings from building orientation and window type
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analyze the effects of residential buildings energy consumption from a combination of residential buildings and different types of windows by using DeST-h in Chongqing. The purpose is to provide the basis for the design of building orientation and selection windows The results show that the building energy consumption is also different, when the building orientation and window type is different, and the energy consumption is minimum when the window towards the north. the window's visor coefficient is smaller, the air conditioning season cold load target is smaller; the window's heat transfer coefficient is smaller, picks the warm season heat load target to be smaller.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: International technology transfer effectiveness analysis and policy indications of transnational company
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The experimental research of chaos-based secure communication based on drive-response synchronization method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we talked about the method of chaotic synchronization. Basing on the drive-respond synchronization method presented by Pecora and Carroll, we realized the chua's chaotic circuit. A theoretical analysis is made for the feasibility of encryption communication by using chaos, and designed experimental circuit of chaos-based secure communication. The experimental results indicated that: when ƒ ≥ 8kHz, the effects of encryption and decryption are good. The research result in this paper laid a theoretical foundation for the further research work.

articleTitle: Research on the evolving model of software product warranty network under outsourcing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper based on the theory and method of product warranty, applies complex networks which is one of the important research tools of complex system to software outsourcing network, and establishes a dynamic evolving model of software outsourcing product warranty network, which takes into account both vertex fitness and the upper limit of vertex weight. By the numerical simulation, the distributions of vertex weight and link weight of the network are studied. The result which obeys the scale-free distribution demonstrates that in the software outsourcing product warranty network, large numbers of software enterprises only possess fewer assuring relationships with others, while a few core enterprises own lots of assuring relationships. These core enterprises play a critical role in the network and directly affect the stability and development of the network.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation of spatially modulated imaging fourier transform spectrometer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The simulation of remote-sensing sensor is a useful tool for a variety of tasks such as the design of systems, the understanding of the image formation process, and the development and validation of data processing algorithms. Based on the analysis of the principle of SMIFTS(Spatially Modulated Imaging Fourier Transform Spectrometer), a model for simulating the image progress of SMIFTS had been developed. The aim of this model was to study and evaluate SMIFTS system, and to use it as a tool in technical duel simulations. The simulation progress mainly includes four modules, namely: interference module, the MTFs module, noise module and quantitative module. The simulated image had been got and analyzed by realizing four modules.

articleTitle: Extracting water information from QuickBird images based on object-oriented method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional classification and extraction of information about remote sensing is based on spectral information of remote sensing images with man-made interpretation method. Because of the existence of the same objects with different spectrums and different things with same spectrums and the subjectivity of the man-made interpretation, the classification accuracy of this method is low and inefficient. However, the classification technology based on objects adopts the method of multi-scale segmentation to produce the image objects, using the spectral characteristics of remote sensing images. Then, based on the geometric features and topological relations of images objects, the rules of classification are established which are used to extract the information of the images. Studies have shown that this method has better results. In this paper, extraction of water baby information in XiaoTangShan area, as an example, confirms the truth of this method.

articleTitle: Research on time synchronization apply in WSN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The principles, algorithm and error source of time synchronization in WSN are researched. Consult TPSN and FTSP, an improved time synchronization algorithm based on transmit/receive pair-wise time synchronization mechanism and Flooding time synchronization protocol is proposed, the synchronization error between the nodes and synchronization error of the WSN are estimated. The algorithm proposed is moderate in synchronization precision and energy cost, meets the demand of WSN in synchronization precision, scope and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Techniques and Architecture of DSS based on Innovation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of decision analysis for complex problem solving, the consistency of innovation theory and Decision support in problem solving methodology, this Knowledge system of innovative theory will be used to build design support system in this paper. We explore structurized attribute method of complex problem, model representation of conflicts and model method of conflict resolution in the design of decision solution program. Then we study the Techniques and Architecture of DSS based on Innovation, and use agricultural development planning DSS prototype to verify the feasibility of Design Support System (DSS) based on Innovation.

articleTitle: A study on combined nonlinear dynamic prediction model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By using a combined nonlinear dynamic system model, a simulation forecast about the sunspot number inflexion for 22nd and 23rd cycle is performed. It is based on a hybrid methodology that combines both Logistic chaotic attraction points and artificial neural network (ANN) models. At first, to calculate the Logistic chaotic attractor according to falling and total solar cycle length for 1610–1986. Aiming at the shortcoming that chaotic time series can not fit the actual fluctuation of small sample discrete data very well, especially for long-term forecast errors, BP neural network is used to predict the fitting errors above, and to correct the final results based on the neural network prediction. The results indicate that prediction accuracy has been improved significantly.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the factors impacting learning teams' performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of extant literature and research hypotheses, we built a conceptual model of the relationship between learning teams' capability and their performance, and proposed some hypotheses about the capability and performance. To test the hypotheses, we designed a questionnaire, and conducted a survey in Xidian University. We used SPSS13.0 to analyze the collected data. We found that among other eight capabilities the invention capability is often neglected, which impacts the performance significantly. The reason is that team members only focus on completing their tasks mechanically but not think much of their invention capability. Besides, the capability to build database has a forecasting effect on the team performance. Besides, the capability to build database has a forecasting effect on the team performance.

articleTitle: Fuzzy neural network based on rectangle functions and its application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fuzzy neural network (FNN) based on rectangle functions is constructed by partitioning input space into many disjoint hyper-cubes with the same size. FNN is constant in each of the hyper-cubes. If and only if an input sample drops into a hyper-cube would the corresponding sample be memorized through coding. Moreover, FNN can generate fuzzy rules automatically. For the control of a nonlinear system, a theorem about static error shows that static error can be decreased for small enough partition of the input space. Simulation example shows that result is satisfactory.

articleTitle: Empirical Bayes estimation of the parameter for logarithm gamma distribution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this study, the empirical Bayes (EB) estimators of the parameter are constructed for logarithm gamma distribution in the case of independent identically distributed samples. It is shown that the proposed EB estimators are asymptotically optimal with convergence rates can arbitrarily close O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−½</sup>) under suitable conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis of theoretical error of phase-discrimination capacitive sensor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since being introduced into domestic measurement field during the 1980's, grating-shape capacitive sensors have played an important role in due to their high accuracy and low cost compared to ordinary capacitive sensors and grating respectively. To better arrest the error of this sensor, we primarily employ Matlab to analyze theoretical error in order to calculate optimum ratio of reflecting electrode and emitting electrodes. Based on our analysis, we are able to find out that the optimum ratio is 1.5∶1 and thus several structural designs of capacitive sensor are given in this paper. Simulations indicate that theoretical error concerned in this document is better reduced by our designs than that by classic structure.

articleTitle: Vehicle targets classification by acoustic signal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigated feature extraction and classification methods for vehicle targets recognition by acoustic signals. The experiment data is acquired on a bitumen road, on which there are sufficient types of vehicles and an appropriate traffic density. We extract feature vector in many ways, including MFCC, LPCC, Wavelet et al, and compare the results using Support Vector Machine as classifier. The classification of three types of vehicles is realized, which are car, motorcycle and truck. This paper also investigates the effects of the normalization of the feature vectors and the decimation of the signal on the classification accuracy. The best result is obtained from MFCC, which is over 86 percent.

articleTitle: RS-based dynamic inspection and analysis on the invasion of Spartina alterniflora in Chongming Dongtan national nature reserve, Shanghai
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The dynamic inspection on plant invasion is a basis for the study of the influence of plant invasion on the carbon cycle of the ecosystem in the invaded area. This paper, with Chongming Dongtan Birds Nature Reserve as the research place, Spartina alterniflora as the invasive plant and Landsat TM and SPOT as the major data source, conducted quantitative analysis on the invasion dynamics of Spartina alterniflora and its influence on the vegetation distribution patterns in Chongming Dongtan Birds Nature Reserve from 2003 to 2009. The research result indicated that the Spartina alterniflora community has covered 1485.348 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> by 2009 and its spread rate was much higher than the indigenous Phragmites australis and Scirpus mariqueter, ranking a predominant vegetation in Chongming Dongtan; the invasion of Spartina alterniflora shall effect great influence on carbon cycle of Chongming Dongtan Birds Nature Reserve ecosystem and biological diversity and carrying capacity of the migratory birds there.

articleTitle: Exact controllability for the nonlinear Burgers-KdV equation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using the Leray-Schauder fixed point theorem and the theory of dissipative operators, we first consider the solution of the linear Burgers-KdV equation. Second we find the control function h by using some inequalities, the theory of monotone operators and division integral theory. Finally we prove the exact controllability for the Burgers-KdV equation, that is to say, for suitable T > 0, for any given initial state u<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> ∈ H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sup> and terminal state u<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sup> ∈ H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sup>, we can find an appropriate control function h which drives the solution u for Burgers-KdV equation to satisfy u (x, 0) = u<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup> and u (x, T) = u<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sup>.

articleTitle: Web-assisted teaching of English Reading based on constructivism
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of computer network technology, the web has become an important virtual place for learning English. Compared with the traditional teaching methods of English reading, web-assisted teaching has significant advantages. We can use the network technology to solve some problems such as reading little and reading outdated material. It can stimulate students'reading interests as well as improve students'reading abilities. The thesis begins with CALL (computer assisted language learning). Takes the teaching of English reading as the topic, using constructivism theory The thesis gives examples to illustrate that under the teacher's guidance, web-assisted English reading can stimulate students' enthusiasm and creativity. It is a beneficial way for students to apply a correct reading strategy to improve their efficiency and ability.

articleTitle: On the secure model of multimedia hashing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Robust multimedia hash is widely used in database search, digital watermark and multimedia authentication. A multimedia hash is a randomized compact representation of multimedia content. In applications, the security issue is particularly important. We measure the security level of multimedia hashing from the Shannon's unicity distance. Using a recently proposed video-hashing scheme as representation, we analyze quantitatively the security of the scheme. Some analyses show that the secret hashing key can be estimated when reused number of the key exceed the calculated unicity distance.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of roadway geological sketch picture drawing system based on MapGIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the components of roadway geological sketch pictures (RGSP) and designs the drawing flow of RGSP based on MapGIS and the component modules of the drawing system, according to the management business requirements of the metal mining and survey data. The object-oriented thought is used in this thesis to analyze the component spatial entities of RGSP and the topological relations of these spatial entities, and then the spatial data model and logic model of RGSP drawing system are established. RGSP drawing system is realized based on MapGIS platform and component based development technology, which provides application basis and practical experience for the information construction of mine geological map (MGM).

articleTitle: Michigan-based variable-length encoding of genetic algorithm for k-anonymization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: K-anonymization is an effective method to protect personal privacy issues. Recently, genetic algorithm-based clustering approach has been successfully applied to the problem of k-anonymization. However, traditional genetic encoding has low efficiency and large information loss. This paper proposed a Michigan-based variable-length coding genetic algorithm, and the proposed approach adopts various heuristic strategies to select genes for crossover operation. Experimental results show that this method can further reduce the information loss and it is a new way to resolve the problem of k-anonymization.

articleTitle: A framework of virtual collaborative network - Improving of SC visibility
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Enormous pressures have been imposed on SCM to reduce cost and improve operation efficiency, and importantly to support information visibility throughout an integrated interoperable organization network. Advanced P2P MANET technologies promise to enable the capabilities necessary to meet these challenges and spur innovation in SCM. In this paper, we propose an interoperable virtual collaborative network infrastructure based on multidimensional structured P2P MANET to improve supply chain visibility. At last, we list issues that worth investigation in further research.

articleTitle: Executive control of multi-channel operation in seismic data processing system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A large number of functional modules are involved in seismic data processing, only under unified control of the execution control system such a complex systematic project with these functional modules in seismic data processing can be completed, and pipeline technology in existing computer operating system can support the control of single channel operation, but can't realize the control of multi-channel operation. This paper presented an execution and control method of multi-channel operation based on named pipe and redirection technology, which realized the control of complex multi-channel operation, and implemented the processing of multiple data streams in PBS through the combination of PBS with execution and control procedures. The application experiment results show that this method has strengthened the capability of system to execute and control operations, and improved the efficiency of seismic data processing.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligence techniques with modern logistics applications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the reliability, high-performance, accuracy and real-time of the modern logistics system, intelligent logistics system has become the trends of modern logistics system. The artificial intelligence technology is the core technology of intelligent logistics system. This paper firslyt introduces the concept and the characteristics of intelligent logistics system and then focus on artificial intelligence technology and its application in logistics, finally points out the direction for further development.

articleTitle: Applied study based on OMAP Digital fingerprint encryption method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Biological authentication technology is an important product of the information age. Although all kinds of biometric technology applications have become increasingly mature, there are many unsatisfactory aspects about the number of fingerprint identification and transmission security in many embedded system applications. Therefore, the encrypted transmission of digital fingerprints has become one of the important problems in the study of embedded system application. In this paper a digital fingerprint algorithm has been used on the structure of the OMAP application, according to the applications in some of the actual situation. The authors put forward a digital fingerprint encryption embedded and decryption integrated software structure by considering the application platform and transmission on a confidential basis.

Author Keywords: the integration in fingerprints embedded and decryption (IFD)

articleTitle: The evaluation and countermeasures for the interactivity of government website in Chongqing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through building the evaluation model on the interactivity of government website, the level of the interactivity of government website in Chongqing is evaluated. Based on the evaluation conclusion, this paper analyzed the problems faced in the interactivity of government website in Chongqing. Some advices are given for the future development of government website in Chongqing.

articleTitle: Study on town ecological carrying capacity based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Artificial neural network is a frontier theory of complex non-linear science and artificial intelligence science. It was widely applied in ecological ecosystem research. However its application in regional ecological carrying capacity (ECC) field is still rare. Based on the basic principle and method of neural network, as well as the theory of ECC, the BP neural network model of town ECC was established, with a view to predict the evolution law of regional ECC in the future. Then take Yiwu city as study area, its ECC points in the past and future were calculated and predicted by using these methods, respectively. According to the assessment results and the realities of study region, the accuracy of the method was further analyzed. Results showed Yiwu's ECC scores were between 60 point and 80 point from 2000 to 2007, however it increased a little from 2008 to 2020. The neural network model designed could better predict the regional ECC, and it was an effective method to study ECC. using BP neural network

articleTitle: Service and cloud computing oriented web GIS for labor and social security applications
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The service and cloud computing oriented architecture is a very promising architecture for practical implementation of the next generation geographical information systems. This paper investigated the service and cloud computing oriented architecture for constructing a distributed and web service enabled geographical information platform for labor and social security applications. The spatial cloud computing applies geographical information systems to the cloud computing paradigm. It provides dynamically scalable geographic information technology, spatial data, and spatial applications as a web service. GIS web services were designed to provide the hosted spatial data and GIS functionality to integrate the customized GIS applications to perform basic geo-processing tasks, such as address matching, map image display, and routing, without maintaining GIS tools or the associated geographical data. The system architecture, functions, system integrations, and some key technical problems are investigated. It has an important application prospect in for labor and social security application systems.

articleTitle: Measure identification of classifier performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the current wide-used measure identification of classifier performance--accuracy and error rates. However, in unbalanced data set, semantic-related multi-class, different costs for different misclassification type and other classification problems, there are many defects when accuracy and error rates are used to measure the classifier performance. In order to solve the above problems, precision, recall, mistake, omitting F-measure ratio and classification cost matrix, loss function are integrated used to measure the performance of classifier.

articleTitle: Study of image sonification based on gray variable
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the sonification research areas, multi-dimensional mapping of continuous data become the focus of current research, it is difficult to solve. Sonification research on one-dimensional data or discrete signals are now doing more. For the multi-dimensional signal, the choice of mapping variable should be very careful because of its need to find a suitable intermediate mapping variables. Few people involved in the in this area and also very little literature can be found. In this paper, we choice two-dimensional signal (Medical Images) and select gray as an intermediate mapping variables to study on Two-dimensional images.

articleTitle: Analysis on the configuration efficiency of E-government information resources
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is decided by the economic characteristics of E-government information resources to dispose E-government information resources effectively. This paper analyses the connotation and conditions of configuration efficiency from the competitive and cooperative E-government information resources, and further studies the measures of improving configuration efficiency of E-government information resources.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of urban public safety based on AHP and TOPSIS method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we established the urban public safety risk monitoring index system, using AHP to determine the varying degrees of the evaluation quota and using TOPSIS to standardize the value of the evaluation quota. We collected the data in Beijing in 2008, evaluated the Beijing public security risk in quantitative. This method combines TOPSIS with AHP effectively and makes the evaluations means widely applied, and meanwhile it also makes the evaluation means easily used and to evaluation results more objective and more accurate.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of real-time monitoring system of sand-wind activity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper discussed the possibility to construct a real-time monitoring system of sand-wind activity by combining communication technology, database technology and GIS technology, and made significant research on the technology course, database design and function realization. The study has been conducted from two aspects— theory design and practical application, and introduced a new method to make an real-time system to monitor sand-wind activity by using apparatus.

articleTitle: A case study on client demand analysis of Uncoded Knowledge Transfer in software outsourcing enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, China's software outsourcing has become an important direction of software industry. Undertaking international software outsourcing benefits the growth of software enterprises of China. As we all known, Software enterprises are knowledge-intensive companies. Uncoded Knowledge management, especially the Uncoded knowledge Transfer management, is considered as the key factors which influence the success of software outsourcing project. On the basis of Uncoded knowledge Transfer literature study this paper analyzes software outsourcing enterprise Uncoded knowledge Transfer in the implementation process and effect combined with the practical software outsourcing enterprise case. Finally, the paper puts forward some suggestions to software outsourcing business.

articleTitle: An adaptive algorithm for cardiac MRI image segmentation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the modern medical image processing community, the medical image segmentation has been a challenging and vital problem. Accurate diagnosis of the diseases and other follow-up treatments rely much on the accuracy and effectiveness of segmentation algorithm. Based on the investigation on human heart MRI image, an adaptive heart segmentation algorithm with improved Mean Shift transformation has been proposed. First, the image contrast was enhanced by using gray stretch transformation, then the image was segmented based on improved Mean Shift transformation. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can segment the heart image accurately and it is also robust to noise.

articleTitle: Research and implementation on Remote Disaster Recovery System of SOE's key data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Starting with analyzing present Status and trends of SOE's mass key word, this paper compares three kinds of advanced Remote Disaster Recovery technologies. Design and Implementation of SOE's Remote Disaster Recovery System are emphasized especially from application layer, database management layer and data storage layer, which make a significant contribution to many SOEs such as China telecom, SG Corp. of China, China Tobacco and so on.

articleTitle: Research on factors affecting SMEs' development of information through e-commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper constructs a model of affecting SMEs' development of information through e-commerce based on diffusion of innovation theory and the theory of planned behavior, presenting five countermeasures on the development of electronic business from “raising awareness, providing policy, improving the environment, marketing strategy, strategic planning”. Conclusion of the study could help government fully understand our current situation of SMEs' e-commerce, and assist SMEs in realizing both their environment and the significant economic benefits of e-commerce for implementing and managing and promoting SMEs' e-commerce effectively in the condition of the context of network economy.

articleTitle: Research service design based on product life cycle for service-oriented manufacturing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses the development and characteristics of service-oriented manufacturing, based on this proposes the concept of service based on product life cycle. According to the general service design process, develops a process for service based on product life cycle. Finally, this paper proposed service model based on product life cycle.

articleTitle: A method of USIM anti-cloning in LTE/SAE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the status of mobile phone user card security. This article analyzes the security mechanism of SIM and USIM. Aim at some cloning methods of SIM cards, after studying the actual usage of cloning card. A solution is proposed based on the location to judge which can identify the user's USIM card is cloned or not. This method both for the user to reduce losses, but also to protect user privacy, and basic process changes to existing communications smaller, it has many purposes.

articleTitle: Risk assessment and management decision-making of project duration
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the theoretical basis of risk assessment and management decision-making, AHP and utility theory were introduced during the project construction. Combining with example, index system of risk factors was established, and AHP was used to do the risk assessment in order to identify a greater impact on the duration of several risk factors. Then utility theory was proposed to do the management decisions effectively by analyzing the utility value of each risk factor.

articleTitle: A new method of ascertaining Attribute Weight based on discernibility matrix
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Attribute Weight Determining (AWD) for multi-attribute evaluation and decision-making is a hot and difficult problem. According to the existing weight method based on rough sets having some deficiencies, A new measurement attribute importance and attribute weight determining methods are proposed on the basis of the literature review, which is discernibility matrix-based methods to determine the weight matrix. The method takes into account the has considered can handle nuclear for empty decision table, and can guarantee all the weights of attributes are not for zero, an example shows that the method is effective and correct‥

articleTitle: Superficial view on the impetus of the Internet to the development of China railway
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the late 1990s, the Internet entered commercial to promote economic development in the world today as an important information infrastructure, spreading in manufacturing and transportation industries rapidly, and to promote the development of China railway. In this paper, I use Xi'an Railway Bureau and ShenYang Railway Bureau to illustrate how the Internet as an important information infrastructure to promote the development of China railway and stress the importance of strengthening the construction of Internet security. Finally, I discuss the future direction of the China railway and the existing problems based on the “tickets online” which proposed in the future by the Ministry of Railway.

articleTitle: QAR based data-cube mining algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The QAR (Quick Access Recorder) records immense amounts of aircraft flight data which reflect the performance of every parts of aircraft. This paper describes the importance of analyzing QAR data in flight safety. We proposed a novel data-cube based method to process a large number of QAR data and extracts association rules about the parameters of aircraft engine which is useful for engine diagnostics and health management.

articleTitle: Model of P2P traffic control based on neural networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To improve the recognition accuracy and raise the detecting speed, a new model of P2P traffic control based on neural networks is proposed in this essay. The model is divided into several small-scale neural networks according to the characteristics of various existing types of P2P traffic, and every sub-neural network is divided into several smaller models in order to reduce the storage space and improve the detecting speed. The experiment results demonstrate that the new model indeed upgrades the detecting speed, reduces the misdeclaration rate and the omission rate, and to a great extent improves the recognition rate of new P2P traffic.

articleTitle: Assessment system of emerging technology maturity level based on CMM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Emerging technology maturity level is the basis of emerging technology assessment, with special characteristics. Based on existing assessment on new technology maturity level, assessment system of emerging technology maturity level is builded combined with software capability maturity model (CMM), through Dephi, expert consultation, forums and interviews and other methods, and the reliability of indicators.

articleTitle: Startup compensation for fiber optic gyro based on RBF neural networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the excellent performance of the RBF neural networks, the RBF neural networks are used in the startup compensation of high-precision FOG. In this paper, the startup of the high-precision FOG is analyzed in detail. Actual experimentation results demonstrate that: after the compensation, the bias stability of the gyro can reaches the nominal accuracy; the bias repeatability of the gyro can be improved dramatically. Therefore, this method proposed in this paper has an important value in practical application.

articleTitle: SFIM based IHS image fusion scheme
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a novel remote sensing image fusion method was proposed based on IHS transform and brightness adjustment using QB multi-spectral data and high-resolution SPOT data combined SFIM algorithm. First, the traditional HIS fusion algorithm and the combination of wavelet and HIS fusion algorithm were analyzed; Secondly, according to the shortage of traditional HIS fusion, this paper proposed a remote sensing image fusion method based on IHS transform and brightness adjustment; Finally, two experiments were conducted to compare the three methods, three indicators: the information entropy, root mean square error and peak signal to noise ratio were used to evaluate the capability of the three methods mentioned above. Experiments result showed that the improved algorithm used in fusion performance is better, and the complexity of the algorithm reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Correlation methods of base-level cycle based on wavelet neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A method of wavelet neural network (WNN) for correlation of base-level cycle is given. Wavelet neural network is introduced first. Then, a new method of Vectored of well logs is proposed. Through the training which causes the wavelet neural network memories the cycle pattern characteristic of the curve, and using the trained wavelet neural network to identify the memory cycle pattern of the well vectored group to be processed, thus realizes the contrast between the well cycles. Real application indicates that it is highly efficient and reliable in base-level cycle correlation.

articleTitle: Analytical solutions for evolution equations of three-level Raman transitions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It analyzed the evolution equations of the interaction between three-level atioms and Raman laser in this paper and gave the analytical solutions of the equations transformed into linear differential equations with substitution. The results conformed the degenerating two-level evolution equations approximatively.

articleTitle: A novel quadrature low spur direct digital frequency synthesizer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A quadrature low spur direct digital frequency synthesizer (DDS) based on amplitude compensation technique is presented in this paper. In the proposed DDS architecture the spur caused by phase truncation error can be submerged in the background noise caused by amplitude quantization error, the capacity of ROM can be decreased remarkably by using two multipliers. The proposed DDS architecture is implemented in an Altera Cyclone FPGA and the spurious performance is compared with conventional DDS architecture.

articleTitle: The ponder on supervision of rural cooperative financial institution in the post-financial crisis era
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This Since outbreak of the U.S. subprime crisis, the crisis caused losses in U.S. and around the world are not to be ignored in either U.S. real economy or volatility of Global financial market. The crisis has undoubtedly brought a lot of inspiration to China's rural cooperative financial institutions. Because they are still at the initial stage, the supervision systems are very imperfect. The paper discusses firstly the necessity of the supervision of rural cooperative financial institution in the post-financial crisis era, then analyzes the main impact to supervision of rural cooperative financial institution, and finally puts forward countermeasures and suggestions about supervision.

articleTitle: Research on quantificational appraisal of commercial banker's Competitive Power
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, Ningbo has attracted more and more commercial banks to enter and be stationed in because of its good environment for financial development, and competition among commercial banks in Ningbo has become fiercer and fiercer. This thesis makes quantificational appraisal with six major commercial banks' competitive power from nine aspects such as market share of loans, rate of non-performing loan, growth rate of assets and so on. By applying gray relational analysis, this research ranks the competitive power of the major six banks. Competitive power of Ningbo Branch of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China ranks the first among the six, and it strengthens competitiveness mainly by diversified operation and optimizing its assets business structure. Ningbo Branch of Construction Bank of China ranks the second in competiveness, and it improves competiveness mainly by strengthening exposure management and innovating product services. Ningbo Branch of Bank of China ranks the third; it enhances competiveness briefly by optimizing credit structure and expanding liabilities business.

articleTitle: A petroleum underground multi-parameter acquisition and monitoring system based on power line carrier
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper introduces a petroleum underground multi-parameter acquisition system that consists of slaver systems, host systems and signal transmission systems. The system is used to responsible for the oilfield underground temperature, pressure, vibration, and leakage current and other parameters of real-time monitoring. It must use power line carrier technology that use three-phase power supply cable as the electrical signal transmission channel and the power supply line because the submersible pumps can not provide a dedicated channel signal transmission and power supply lines under actual working conditions.

articleTitle: Promoting the higher education based on the service quality gap model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A gap model of higher education service quality is introduced, which is based on the primary characteristic of higher education service quality. In the model, the reasons which forming these gaps are analyzed in detail. And then, some suggestions are given about how to promote the quality of higher education service quality.

articleTitle: Study on identity-based proxy blind signature scheme and application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, based on Cha and Cheon's signature scheme and identity-based proxy blind signature and combination of proxy signature, an identity-based proxy blind signature scheme is presented, its security analysis made. Moreover, the scheme is applied for electronic money, which its problems are solved.

articleTitle: Study on ‘information system analysis and design’ project educational model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Project-oriented teaching model achieves the combination of classroom teaching and project practice, and the synchronism of knowledge delivery and practical application. When students start the project, they generally change the passive reception to the active absorption study by combining the required knowledge and teaching contents. And finally, students will clear the objective of study and learn for accomplishing the task of project. It's very important to select a topic in the project-oriented model. It requires teachers clearly grasp of the course and carry out an all-wave analyze, then summarize the practical experience in development projects and teaching experience to determine a project topic.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between intellectual property right and enterprise competitive advantage
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the narrow sense, intellectual property right mainly refers to patent right, trademark right and copyright, in which more valuable for enterprise are the patent right and trademark right. The empirical result indicates that the patent-based core technology and the trademark-based brand have a positive impact on the formation of enterprise competitive advantage, it can provide effective support for enterprise to obtain sustainable competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Small-large ratio based Multi-subjected clustering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: After the discussion of Multi-subjected clustering problems, a small-large ratio based multi-subjected clustering algorithm was purposed to solve this kind of problems for transactions data.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of the senior managers' compensation incentive on business performance in listed companies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: From the empirical point of view, the paper analyzes deeply the relationship between the executive compensation incentives and the corporate performance in 2009 Shanghai and Shenzhen listed company of wholesale and retail trade. And the paper analyzes corporate performance, executive pay, firm size and board governance structure, then it proposes 5 hypothesis. Through the correlation analysis and regression models, the paper draws some conclusions and makes relevant suggestions based on analysis results.

articleTitle: Design of improved-type predictive Smith fuzzy-PID controller
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Some industrial processes control systems are characterized by large inertia, pure time-delay and parameters time-varying. It is hard to meet the technological requirements with conventional control method. An improved-type smith predictive fuzzy-PID composite control method was therefore presented, which is based on PID controller combined fuzzy logic and smith predictive controller. The new system has been tested on a lot of simulated plant models and demonstrated to have marked improvements in the control performance by comparison with the conventional system.
