articleTitle: Study on the theory and practice of university library student's volunteers human resource management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of introducing university library human resource management status, the significance and function of library management with the participation of university student volunteers were discussed in this paper. On the premise of reducing students economic burden, the pressure of library staff was relieved, the overall quality of staff was improved, the vigor and vitality of library were brought. The approach of library working with the participation of student volunteers by gratuitous practice and part-time job was illustrated. The experience of library working with the participation of student volunteers was introduced. The measures include pre-post training, strengthening management and reasonable arrangement and so on. At last, the bridge and link between readers and staff were formed with the participation of university student volunteers, it is beneficial to further development of library work.

articleTitle: Double path coding method for mode decision based on low complexity in H.264
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional method of mode decision of low complexity is to compare the SAD cost of all the modes and choose the best mode with the smallest one. A new method for mode decision that is based on the result of quantization result is proposed for the DSP project design. This method is very useful in hardware designing project. In the analysis of the test result, the bitrate will reduce about 5%–25% with the same QP.

articleTitle: DRC:An efficient dynamic region code for XML
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is an important part to determine the structural relationship of nodes in XML queries. With a numbering scheme for XML data, the structural relationships of nodes can be quickly determined. Most of the numbering schemas for XML data are static and they cannot number XML data which are updated frequently. Some numbering schemas that are dynamic consume more storage space. So it is a challenging research area to design an efficient dynamic numbering schema. This paper presents an efficient dynamic region code, called DRC, for XML tree numbering based on decimal. The experimental results show that DRC consumes less storage space and is more steady than other dynamic numbering schemes.

articleTitle: The study on organization support to job satisfaction based on OCB and organization commitment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Organizational support show positive relationship with job satisfaction, however, how organization support impact job satisfaction is unknown to us. This study used a sample of 317 participants from IT industry, and selected regression to test the mediation of OCB and moderator of organization commitment. From the regression, the mediation role of OCB and moderator of organization commitment are be test. Organization support influence the job satisfaction by mediation of OCB and is moderated by organization commitment‥ Individuals with high organization commitment are more likely to feel job satisfaction, while individuals with lower organization commitment are not to do so. At last, author give some suggestion to management practice.

articleTitle: Research on network search engine performance appraisal system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To make the evaluation of search engine performance more scientific and systematic, this paper uses the Analytic Hierarchy Process method to build the search engine performance appraisal system. The paper presents the key indicators which impact the performance of Web search engine. By constructing discriminate matrix, computing the relative weighting and verifying the consistency we determine the index weights, and then calculates the search engine performance evaluation result. Finally, the article is validated through the application of the evaluation system, the result shows that the appraisal system is more scientific and rational, and it has a certain value.

articleTitle: Application of gray ANN model in products demand forecasting for the Fabless
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fabless market demand is a multi-factors and complex time-varying nonlinear link with a high degree of uncertainty, this uncertainty makes it difficult to predict. In this paper, a grey artificial neural network model is put forward, and the model is combined with grey system theory and artificial neural network theory. Using annual sales of the certain type chips between 2002 and 2009 of a Fabless company in shanghai, to simulate and predict the last five years' wafer annual sales of the certain types of chips the company, the results show that the maximum relative error between predictions and actual value is 0.28%, indicates that the model predictions approach to the actual values considerably. When the model is used to forecast the IC product and describe the development and changes of the product accurately, it will be helpful for the enterprise to make decisions.

articleTitle: Development of a School-based curriculum: Introduction to Zhejiang Business Culture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To improve student's cultural tastes and humanities, while cultivate their entrepreneurship and innovation, we developed a school-based curriculum: Introduction to Zhejiang Business Culture. Development program, ideas, content, and features of the curriculum were first introduced. Then effectiveness was evaluated by questionnaire investigation after the implementation of the curriculum. Results show that more than half of the students felt their employment ability was improved greatly. 47% students agreed that their entrepreneurial inspiration was inspired. 50% students agreed that their rational thinking was enhanced; 48% students think it raised their entrepreneurial knowledge. 58% students believed that the curriculum trained their self-confidence, self-improvement, self-reliance of the entrepreneurial spirit. Practice shows that School-based curriculum is a useful supplement to planning curriculums. It is advantageous to achieve school's philosophy and characteristics by using local cultural resources to educate students.

articleTitle: Research on distributor segmentation of brand clothes enterprise based on customer value
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Distributor the important bridge between brand clothes enterprise and its customer, reselling product as commodity, play an determined function. After introducing the development trend of brand clothes enterprise, this paper analyzes the characteristic of final customer and distributor. Then, basing on analyzing the value of distributor from three aspect including current value, potential value and sustainable value, distributor of brand clothes enterprises are subdivided, so that an advice for brand clothes enterprise to evaluate customer value efficiently and to develop and sustain valuable customer is given.

articleTitle: The study of human face recognition based curvelet transform and 2DPCA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the wavelet transform cannot well represent curve singularity of human face images, this paper proposes an new algorithm based Curvelet and 2DPCA. For face images, we firstly perform the curvelet transform and get low frequency coefficients, which contain almost energy. Further we introduce 2DPCA with a exponential decay factor to reduce the dimensions and extract the feature vectors. Finally, the face recognition is realized according to the assembled matrix distance. Experimental results on ORL and Yale face database show that the proposed algorithm has high recognition rate and short recognition time. It is also robust to the change of pose, expression especially illumination.

articleTitle: An evaluation method of knowledge push' effect based on AHP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge push provides users a timely and active mode of knowledge service. How about the QoS of knowledge push is may depend on the evaluation of knowledge push's effect by users. Furthermore, the following update is according to the result of the evaluation. Firstly, an evaluation index system about knowledge push's effect coming from early research achievement is introduced. Then, based on AHP, an evaluation method of knowledge push's effect is presented, which includes the calculation of index's weight by AHP and the calculation of evaluation value. Moreover, the application of the proposed method is illuminated via the example.

articleTitle: Finite-time ruin probability for Erlang risk model with exponential claims
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, under the conditions that the claimsize is exponentially distributed, a simple asymptotic of ruin probability for Erlang risk model within finite time is obtained. The result contained the classical Cramer-Lundberg model as special case.

articleTitle: Internally FDI analysis and prediction of construction based on the BP neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the financial crisis after the arrival of the era, more and more international investors start to focus on financial crisis in the mainstay in the China market, more and more international capital inflows into China. From the perspective of internal FDI, choose the construction industry, through the analysis of engineering industry in recent 10 years, internal FDI data collection and analysis to the development of China's construction industry. First we analysis this industry data, this paper uses the the BP neural network algorithm, and through Matlab software realize the future of the industry of FDI data.

articleTitle: Rake angle measurement of inclined slotting cutter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses the blade shape, the parameters of rake angle of slotting cutter. The theoretical analysis process of a novel rake angle error measurement is introduced, which is built on the theory that the rake face of the inclined slotting cutter is a flat surface. For the systematic errors is caused by inaccurate measurement, the paper give in-depth analysis in various situation. By testing in the GD40-type CNC Gear Measurement Center, the accuracy testing results validate the correctness of the method.

articleTitle: Research of quantitative Distance Education teaching quality assessment methods
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of Distance Education (DE), the teaching quality of DE has become a focus in China. This paper introduces a quantitative DE teaching quality assessment method, which uses fuzzy comprehensive judgment based on AHP to analyze and process the qualitative information. By applying this method, we can get better results in DE teaching quality assessment.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of coupling based on MSC.patran
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The coupling plays a key roles in the process of the shaft parts torsion. Membrane is a key component of the coupling, membrane damage is the main form of coupling failure. In order to meet the design requirements, through solid modeling of the membrane, use to MSC.patran as the analysis platform for modal analysis, through the finite element method to verifies. The results showed that: the target membrane can meet the design requirements. Modal analysis is a means of structural dynamic analysis, by analyzing the dynamic characteristics of engineering structures, the structure could be established in response to dynamic excitation conditions, predict the actual work of state structures in the work of behavior and its impact on the environment.

articleTitle: Statistic analysis of fatigue test by HHT method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By using the method of HHT signal decomposition to deal with the statistics of the length of standard segment, the information about frequency and amplitude of the statistics will be obtained. Through the contrast of frequency and amplitude of the standard segment length at different stages, the positive degree of the structure can be judged. With practical experience to further set up the positive scope of frequency and amplitude, more guidance can be applied to real projects.

articleTitle: WEB user interest extraction and applied research in universities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During the information age, as far as teachers and students in colleges and universities are concerned, more and more learning, research and entertainment are realized by way of network. There are many user behavioral models and habits in the weblog. This thesis, based on web text mining, puts forward an interest mining system for university campus network user. Firstly, it introduces the system structures. Secondly, it puts emphasis on the introduction of the key techniques of this system. Finally, it introduces the practical effectiveness of this system. The experiment indicates that this method can do a good job on the mining of the distribution of the interest concerning university campus network users and has important reference value for university reforms and individual commercial services.

articleTitle: Agricultural knowledge service model in a network environment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Agricultural knowledge service is a new component of agricultural information development in the knowledge economy age. This article first explores and specifies the meaning of knowledge services and on that basis defines the concept of agricultural knowledge services. The authors then analyze the current state of China's agricultural knowledge services and the basic conditions and involved in their launch in China. Second, the authors propose innovations for China to establish a standardized service platform for agricultural knowledge services in a network environment, and suggest that we should cooperate in the development of shared resources to the greatest possible degree, develop an agricultural warehouse, and implement personalized services. With these proposals as a model, the authors describe some specific forms for agricultural knowledge services to develop into. Finally, the authors propose some strategies and measures to guarantee the realization of agricultural knowledge services.

articleTitle: The study of agricultural product export deals with the green barrier strategy in China under the environmental protection
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the globalization, the internationalization, the economization and the politicization of the environment question, the developed countries has been established all sorts of green barriers for the purpose of protecting the domestic market in the reason of protect the domestic market. As a major exporter of agricultural products, green barriers have become the bottleneck restricting China's exports of agricultural products. The report has been depth analysis of the status and the deep reasons of green barriers that China's agricultural exports faces, and propose effective measures to break through the green barrier in the context of environmental protection.

articleTitle: Study on industrial agglomeration and economic growth—The evidence of Yangtze Delta Area
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We investigate the linear or non-linear relationship between industrial agglomeration and economic growth in Yangtze Delta Area by adopting the analytical method of Brulhart & Sbergami(2009) and using Theil Index and urbanization as indexes of agglomeration. We find evidence that supports the “Williamson hypotheses”. The main findings are:(1) the relationship between industrial agglomeration and economic growth is changing with economic development, rather than simple linear; (2) the relationship between industrial agglomeration and industrial growth is non-linear; (3) urbanization boosts economic growth.

articleTitle: Studying on state prediction for radar transmitter using GM(1,1)
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through analyzing the importance of component modules of a kind of radar transmitter, both the cathode current of multiple-beam klystron and the ripple voltage of high-voltage power supply are selected as the prediction signals. By studying on their characteristics, a improved GM (1,1) is proposed to predict the state of transmitter, where the idea of metabolism is applied to make the parameters of GM (1,1) on-line change. Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) is used to select the best prediction dimension. The performance of the proposed method is tested, and the experiment results show that the proposed method has better prediction capability than the popularly used ARMA model, and then it provides technical support for preventive maintenance.

articleTitle: Improved segmentation algorithm of pixel texture used in complex image
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When Image feature extracted from the sub-block in image is used in object segmentation, it can cause object boundary inaccurate. Texture feature extracting algorithm based on every pixel is purposed in the paper. After the pixel texture feature is standardized and reduced dimension by PCA, it is clustered by hierarchical method. Improved segmentation algorithm segments the complex image into different objects. Compared with the traditional methods such as threshold method, Sobel method and so on, the segmentation boundary is accurate, and the phenomenon of under-segmentation and over-segmentation also reduce significantly.

articleTitle: Eddy current sensor mode building based on polynomial basis functions artificial neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method used to the eddy current sensor modeling based on a polynomial basis functions neural network to settle its non-linear problem. The principle and algorithms of weight values of neural network are introduced. In this method, the non-linear model is set up by polynomial basis functions neural network according to measurement data. The results show that the sensor modeling has the character of strong robustness and on-line modeling compared with the sensor modeling of least square method. The maximum nonlinearity error can be reduced to 0.036% by using polynomial basis functions neural network. However, the maximum nonlinearity error is 0.075% using the least square method.

articleTitle: Image segment based on seed and region growing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to segment bubbles in floatation image, a segmentation method combined seed area with region growing is proposed. Firstly extracting seed region on the top of bubble according to image color feature, then formulating the seed boundary of each bubble, thirdly finding bubble boundary conditions. Each bubble grows from its seed boundary outwards and stops at its boundary. The method segments each image object rather than the whole image, the segmentation results is more accurate.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design and development of Poyang Lake Area flood control GIS based on ArcObjects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Climatic suitability of single-season rice and its changes in Anhui Province in latest 50 years
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The temperature suitability, sunlight suitability, precipitation suitability model and climatic suitability model of single-season rice are set up by using Fuzzy mathematics theory and referring to former study, and the temperature suitability, sunlight suitability, precipitation suitability and climatic suitability of different growing periods have been calculated separated with the model and related data during 1960–2009 of Anhui Province. The results show that temperature suitability and sunlight suitability are relatively big, and precipitation suitability is small in Anhui Province. Climatic suitability and temperature suitability of single-season rice have decreasing trend, and the sunlight suitability has a downward trend.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The choice of accounting policies and value in listed companies__Data from listed steel companies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A parameter estimation method for polyphase codes using time-frequency distribution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the desirable performance, polyphase codes have been widely used in low probability of intercept radar. By analyzing the characteristic of the time-frequency distribution of polyphase codes, a new parameter estimation method based on time-frequency distribution is proposed. Simulation results show that this method have good estimate precision even in low signal-to-noise ratios.

articleTitle: A QoS scheduling mechanism for overlay aggregate traffics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a control mechanism in SON(Service Overlay Network)[7] architecture to provide delay guarantees of different aggregate traffics over IP network. Since diverse multimedia flows have different delay requirements in service overlay network, queuing delay in service gateway is another critical QoS parameter in addition to bandwidth provision of aggregate traffics. To assure the delay requirements of aggregate flows in service overlay network, we present a simple but effective adaptable control mechanism, which consists of two-queues with exhausitive service in cyclic order and characterizes the abilities to ensure delay requirements of various aggregate flows according to their burstiness. Moreover, Associated performance is analyzed by the Markov chain and probability generation function, and simulations validate this analysis.

articleTitle: Bionic neural network group model and its application in vehicle identification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bionic neural network group is designed based on the model of ecological balance, its establishment and evolution are guided by the ecological model of rules. Its application in vehicle identification is proved that it is more precise than the traditional neural network; evolution rules are similar with the eco-system model‥The model and its experiment results provide some basis for the unified theory of neural networks integration and the research of neural network computer studies. All experiments are completed in simulation environment of matlab6.5.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of MPPT and simulation of PV grid-connected system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A simulation model is established to track the maximum power point of solar array in Matlab/ Simulink,which can verify the effectiveness of different algorithms. Using the method of Perturbation and Observation(P&O) and Incremental Conductance(INC) track the maximum power point of a solar-array under different illumination intensity and panel temperature. Analyzed the influence of disturbance step length for tracking precision or response time and the influence of A/D sampling frequency for the tracking stability. Proposed a method to select appropriate disturbance step length and sampling frequency according to the scale of photovoltaic array.

articleTitle: Implementation of migration based on static analysis tool OINK
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: OINK is a C and C++ static analysis tool for Unix-like platform. It can be used for programmers to analyze and understand code, or can be used for software testers to test code and protect software quality. In addition, it is good at data flow analysis, and can be convenient to be re-used. This paper analyzes the implementation process of OINK in detail at first, and then studies the software migration skills in order to extend the application of OINK. Windows platform is widely used but quite different from Unix-like platform, and this paper also studies how to migrate the OINK from Unix-like platform to Windows platform.

articleTitle: Data compression MMSE multiuser detection based on FAPI subspace tracking algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the subspace tracking algorithms that only track the subspace basis, a data compression MMSE multiuser detection (DCMMSE-MUD) is proposed by the data compression method. Its computational complexity is O(NK). FAPI subspace tracking algorithm can tracks the subspace bisis, and has the advantages of simple construction, better orthgonality and lower computational complexity (O(NK)). The results of DCMMSE-MUD's simulations based on FAPI subspace tracking algorithm show that the performance of the detection method is perfect.

articleTitle: The development status and prospects of cloud computing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The emergence of cloud computing was the result of the development of parallel technology, software technology, network technology. Cloud computing ultimate goal was to service users. Cloud computing could provide users with on-demand computing power, storage capacity and application service capability. As a new model of Internet applications, cloud computing could be the dominant mode to get services and information for us. At present there was no accepted definition of cloud computing, the paper described the definition of cloud computing from the user's point of view. And the paper generally introduces the current cloud computing platforms, the development, prospects and challenges of cloud computing.

articleTitle: The model of duopoly location-then-price game under introduction of rent cost
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By introducing rent cost into Hotelling model, this paper studies duopoly's location-then-price game problem. The conclusions of this paper differ from that of Hotelling model's ‘minimum differentiation’ location. When the ratio of rent cost rate and transportation cost rate meets certain condition, we find that in equilibrium: (i) firms locate in two ends of the market in the condition of linear rent cost function (i.e. ‘maximum differentiation’ location); (ii) firm's location only depends on the ratio of rent cost rate and transportation cost rate in the condition of quadratic rent cost function.

articleTitle: Algorithm research on automatic layout of automatic test system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a new automatic layout algorithm of circuit diagram applied to automatic test system. With combining the characteristics of diagram, the algorithm implements model optimization and grading optimization of those equipments by using functions and connection information. In this paper, we use Subordination Location Algorithm based on least cross line to determine the Subordination of equipment groups and calculate the drawing geometric position of those equipment models by using Geometric Relationship Location Algorithm based on correlation information. The diagrams which are drawn out have clear hierarchy and reasonable structure.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Gene model and the process of evolution of enterprise IT control capability
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper develops the Gene structure of the enterprise IT control capability, and analyzes the evolution process of the enterprise IT control capability based on the Biological Evolution and Evolutionary Economics.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the economic zone of west coast public employment trains mechanism
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design of automobile motion parameters stored testing and measuring system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A design scheme is given for the automobile motion parameters stored testing and measuring system. The system include velocity and acceleration signal processing circuits, the low pass filter of acceleration signal, the sampling and storing circuits, the data reading circuit and so on. The accelerators ICS3002-002 and ICS3255-100 are used to measure the automobile acceleration after the analysis of automobile motion parameters characters. The velocity signal processing circuit is universal for different types of automobile velocity sensors. The methods of data sampling and storing are put forward. The optimization for the system is given as well.

articleTitle: A tag recommendation algorithm based on SCOT tag ontology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Responding to the problem of tag ambiguity and lack of tag semantics, we propose a new recommendation algorithm based on SCOT tag ontology. The algorithm utilizes rich semantics provided by SCOT ontology to expand tag co-occurrence and eliminate tag disambiguation based on tag semantic similarity for candidate tag sets, aiming to eliminate ambiguity tags and recommend semantic related tags, thereby improving the quality of recommendation. Experimental results show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of corporate claims
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The basis of the model is the Cox,Ingersoll,Ross(1978) partial differential equations for the value of an asset. This equation is itself the result of combining the Black-Scholes model with the assumption that the pricing function for securities is consistent with rational expectations. The model is used to analyze the financing and investment strategies of a hypothetical firm. In this paper, a numerical solution algorithm by explicit difference schemes is given for the equations. We also draw graphs of numerical solution of hypothetical firm using Matlab software.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between fiscal revenue and GDP based on panel data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: GDP and fiscal revenue are two key indicators of many economic ones. They are the ‘barometer’ and ‘Monitor’ of comprehensive economic strength and development level of a region. In this paper, we have made panel data model based on that of fiscal revenues and GDP of 31 provinces (municipalities and autonomous regions) from 2001 to 2007 in China. The conclusion shows there is long-term stable relationship between China's GDP and fiscal revenue, namely, the cointegration relationship.

articleTitle: A simulation model of solar array based on Matlab
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Established an engineering model of solar array which can reflect the real-time output voltage and current, the maximum power point voltage, the maximum power point current and the maximum power point in any light intensity and temperature of solar arrary. A simulation model is established in Matlab/Simulink and proved the engineering model correctly and reliability. Using the method of Perturbation and Observation(P&O) and Incremental Conductance(INC) track the maximum power point of a solar-array under the reference standard of these output elements, and found out the pursuit gain around the reference standard oscillation and further to validate the model reliability.

articleTitle: The research on the affect of product-harm crisis upon the multi-branding products
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many enterprises imply the multi-branding strategy. The product-harm crisis of some brand will have the influence on other branding products. This article examined the influence of product-harm crisis on similar products and the different kind of products separately through the empirical study under the multi-branding strategy.

articleTitle: Multiple carrier frequency offsets estimation and compensation for distributed MIMO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A multiple carrier frequency offsets (CFOs) estimation algorithm for MIMO-OFDM systems based on multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm is proposed in this paper. The structure of training sequence (TS) and sub-carrier-band method is also described. Method of spectral peak searching by major step and minor step could improve estimation precision and reduce calculation. At the same time, average spectral function can reduce the effect of random peak. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show CFOs estimation MSE and BER performance of system at different SNR.

articleTitle: Lorentz adaptive prior based FastICA BSS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It was well known that an appropriate selection of the nonlinear contrast function was the key for achieving successful blind source separation through FastICA algorithm. In this study, it was first suggested that the estimation of the nonlinear contrast function could be implemented by the way of adjusting the prior densities of the sources from the data; it was then discussed how to apply the Lorentz prior model into the FastICA to estimate the contrast function adaptively; it was finally testified in the experiment that the Lorentz adaptive prior based FastICA is more effective than the conventional one with fixed prior.

articleTitle: The design of Nearing Infrared Laser Spot Detection System
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The design of Nearing Infrared Laser Spot Detection System is studied in the paper. Giving the feature of laser spot image, Wiener filter and Wavelet denoise are combined to give a feasible method to diminish the noise, this method effectively weakened the harmfule affect to following image process, which may cause checking error. The system can identify the laser spot and get its centrobaric. The result of practical project shows that the system is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Study on inventory control of coal enterprise based on system dynamic simulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The inventory cost reduced is very important for coal enterprises to improve their effectiveness. However, some companies have to depend on demand plan made by many subordinate units just for demand forecasting difficulty, so “bullwhip effect” cannot be afforded, it is obvious that the key of inventory control is to improve the precision of predicting. Material demand generally has no law to follow, as to the method of demand forecasting, this paper provided the system dynamic simulation based on Monte Carlo simulation of demand data. The empirical study showed that the inventory cost reduced obviously, it also means that management cost reduced, because the material demand plan just only depends on its history data, and a large number of human resources used in demand forecasting have been saved.

articleTitle: Research on promoting the intervaction of teachers and learners in Virtual Leraning Community—In view of Distributed Cognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the development and application of information technology and network technology in education, Virtual Learning Community as a new network platform of education has become an effective complement to classroom teaching, including how to effectively interact with students and learners to improve the quality of distance learning has also been more and more attention. Based on the discussion of Distributed Cognition perspective in Virtual Learning Community for teachers and learners with teaching strategies.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of safety management in oil depot based on FTA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on FTA of safety-system engineering and analysis of risk or hazard factors of oil depot, the fault tree factor table of fire and explosion is determined and the fault tree is established. By means of Boolean algebra simplification, the minimum path sets of the system are achieved. And major hidden troubles of fire and explosion in oil depot are found out on the basis of the analysis about structure importance degree of each basic event. According to the minimum path sets of the fault tree, the control solutions are proposed to prevent the oil depot from fire and explosion. In the end, the most optimizing decision of safety management in oil depot is made on the basis of the costbenefit assessment of each solution.

articleTitle: Research on the improvement of FP-growth based on hash
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: FP-growth is a typical algorithm which will not generate candidate itemsets in association data mining. However, in the process of building FP-tree, each node will compare with the original, which greatly affected the efficiency of the algorithm. Based on the analysis of the process of building FP-tree, an optimization method based on hash was proposed in this paper, which can save more time of locating the new item by using a hash table and a hash function. The following experiment proves that the latter algorithm is better than the former one in performance.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Confirmative study of the conspicuous consumption motives of China's one-child generation and their effects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Bifurcation of periodic Solution for Rosenzweig-Macarthur system with time delay
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This By using some analysis techniques and the bifurcation theory, this paper studies Hopf bifurcation problems of a kind of Rosenzweig-Macarthur system with time delay. A condition is obtained for the existence of a Hopf bifurcation of periodic Solution of the following Rosenzweig-Macarthur system with time delay: equations where all parameters R , c , d , e , α , β are positive constants.

articleTitle: Dynamic change of Yellow River Delta wetland nearly 20 years
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The authors interpret four remote sensing images using of EDARS8.5 based on field trips and previous data, then get the wetland resource database of the Yellow River Delta in 1985,1996,2000,2004. Carried out in Arcview3.3 overlay analysis, we calculate the 1985–2004 Yellow River Delta wetland transition probability matrix, then analysis the spatial structure changes of the Yellow River Delta wetland. Compared wetlands and non-wetland area changes of the Yellow River Delta during 1985–2004. We calculate wetland change rate used to land use dynamics, analyze evolution of the time and space of the Yellow River Delta wetland in recently twenty years.

articleTitle: Path planning of mobile robot in local unknown environment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on path planning of mobile robot in local unknown environment, a new method which combines the benefits of global and local path planner is proposed. The global path planner uses A*algorithm to generate a series of optimal nodes to the target node, and cut some redundant of which to generate global guide path with more exact guiding direction. And the local planner makes full use of the real-time local environmental information detected by the robot and the path planning is optimize on-line under the conduct of global guide path. This method combines global guiding and local optimization in an effective way and so it is well suitable for local unknown environment.

articleTitle: An empirical study on financial risk conduction of financial holding groups—Analysis made based on Delong Group
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Resource allocation and risk transfer are the basic functions of financial holding group, so blind spot in financial supervision can be seen in the exploration of financial risk movement rule in financial holding groups. the paper follows the logical train of thought from financial risk monitoring indexes, risk value, risk pool to risk conduction quantity of financial holding groups, and poses the measurement methods for risk conduction of financial holding groups. The financial risk and conduction quantity of Delong Group are measured by utilizing the financial statement data related to Delong Group. The study indicates that in the case of industry and finance combination of Delong is the representation; affiliated transaction is the channel; the allocation imbalance of financial monitoring right is the external environment and the final result is the random financial risk conduction under the misconfiguration of financial resources.

articleTitle: Standard of small enterprises based on internal control from the accounting information point of view
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with the large and medium enterprises, accounting information of small enterprises is produced by circumstances of inadequate internal control. The reasons are that the quality of accounting of small enterprises is impacted by internal control, and then the inadequate internal control is a reasonable choice of the small enterprises based on the costeffective principle. The demanders don't require the adequate accounting information for small enterprises. So, from the point view of accounting information, the standards of small enterprises should be such enterprises that do not require adequate internal control.

articleTitle: Study of the key technologies for a virtual crime scene reconstruction system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, crime types and modus operandi changes constantly. With the continuous development of virtual reality technology, Application of virtual reality technology in crime scene reconstruction has become a research hotspot. This paper focuses on design of a VCSR (Virtual Crime Scene Reconstruction) system based on virtual reality technology, and discusses its key technologies, such as collision detection and geometric modeling. The VCSR overcomes the lack of traditional crime scene reconstruction methods, and improves the efficiency and effectiveness of the crime scene reconstruction.

articleTitle: Study on basic farmland and reserve cultivated land system design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Now the traditional manual mode has already cannot satisfy modern management requirements for basic farmland and reserve cultivated land, Using computer technology, GIS technology can offer more convenient management tools and methods for land resources professionals. This paper, according to the principles of data standardization, technology modernization, scientific management, application of integrated technology, using the software design method, through in-depth analysis of basic farmland and reserve cultivated land management functional requirements, the basic farmland and reserve cultivated land management information system's overall architecture, database structure and functional structure were designed. It provided a platform design methods and ideas of inquiry, statistics and analysis system, in order to establish a platform with GIS and Web technology.

articleTitle: An applied research of programmable controller remote diagnosis and maintenance system based on 3G network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper provided a solution on how to use latest 3G(3rd-Generation) network technology to build the remote diagnostic and maintenance system for PLC, on the basis of research and practice. With an example of Siemens S7 series PLC, the paper had a detailed discussion on the network topology, the working principle and the technical methods of the system. This solution can effectively improve remote controllability, rapid responsiveness and security of the programmable control system; and provide the new technical guarantee for the remote online diagnosis, uploading and downloading procedures and online programming. The paper also focused on how to use the IPsec protocols and VPN technology to provide security guarantees of industrial data transmission in the Internet.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The competitiveness of chinese companies in the global market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Differential evolution algorithm based on CUDA and its application in unorganized points data registration
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Automatic 3D unorganized points data registration technique, which maps data clouds measured from multiple viewpoints into a common coordinate space, is an key teclinical on reverse engineering. In order to improve the matching speed of large amount of data, a detecting method with parallel diffrential evolution algorithm based on CUDA architechure was proposed. Firstly, evolution strategy was proved, to avoid premature convergence and improve optimizing speed, the probabilities of crossover and mutation were adaptively adjusted by means of adaptive algorithm, Secondly, parallel-DE-matching algorithm model was designed according to feature of GPU. The comparison experiments show that this method is effective and efficient for aligning large number of three dimension clouds data.

articleTitle: Numerical research on chaos control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the numerical simulation method is applied to investigate the control for a given chaotic system. In order to obtain a better understanding of the relationship between the Lyapunov exponents and evolution of chaos, a stable Duffing system is examined. By way of adding a pulsing perturbation of the resistance coefficient, the pulsing control method is applied to control the chaotic motion of Duffing system. This control method is equivalent to impulse control, so the pulse intensity, positive pulse duration, pulse period and other control parameters on the results of chaos control are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the thixotropic plastic forming process for mobile parts
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The thixotropic plastic forming process of the mobile intermediate shaft screw plug of n-SiC<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</inf>/AZ61 composites was simulated by deform-3d software. The distribution of stress field and strain field in thixotropic plastic forming process was obtained and the simulation results were compared with the experimental data, which provided theoretical guidance for the thixotropic plastic forming technology.

articleTitle: Development of Integrated Simulation Curriculum for high vocational students of civil engineer major
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Employment-oriented vocational education reform draws increasing attention in China. In order to train students master the basic core competencies and key professional capacity, and to prepare best entry into the enterprise and maximize the fitness of the jobs, we developed an Integrated Simulation Curriculum for high vocational students of civil engineer major. After students completed the basic courses and specialized courses, we set aside one semester for comprehensive training, including application of theoretical knowledge, professional skills and professionalism. Development principle, ideas, and features of the curriculum were also introduced. The practice of the curriculum achieved following results. First, it stimulated the consciousness and initiative of students. Second, it solved difficulties of practical training for civil engineer. Third, it shortened the time to adapting the post jobs. Fourth, it eliminated the conflict between the authenticity and controllability of professional training environment.

articleTitle: Commercial bank's development strategy under low-carbon economy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The low-carbon economy as one scientific development way is becoming the choice to achieve sustainable development. In recent years, our country's low carbon economic development brings a series of changes in social and economic field; it also causes corresponding changes in financial sector. Commercial banks as the main form of financial institutions implement low carbon strategy too, but there are still some problems. This article through the present situation analysis of implement the low-carbon strategy to our country Commercial bank, proposes the development strategy of commercial banks under the low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of meandering river geological knowledge database
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the data sources, data content, data format of geological knowledge database and the relationship between meandering river geological entities, designs the data model and data structure of geological knowledge database. Using SQL Server and VC++, the meandering river geological knowledge database system is designed and developed. The System has four functional modules: data management module, data query and statistics module, empirical formula module and training image module. Using the system, geological knowledge data of meandering river could be managed, queried and analyzed effectively.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of fuzzy immune controller of fin stabilizer-passive anti-rolling tank integrated stabilization system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aims at the mathematical module of ship integrated stabilization system, combines immune feedback mechanism with fuzzy control to design a fuzzy immune PID controller. Uses Fuzzy reasoning to approach the nonlinear function faintly in fuzzy immune controller and adjusts proportion gain of controller real-time, at the same time, uses general fuzzy controller to adjust integral and differential time constants of controller on line. Through simulation of the integrated stabilization system, it can be seen that using fuzzy immune PID controller can obtain better control effect than general PID controller, the integrated stabilization effect increased obviously.

articleTitle: Research of multi ingredients system control method based on fuzzy support vector machine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed shortcomings of multi ingredients control methods. The four-group Ingredient system of certain marked cement was adopted to prove that, improper proportional control of each ingredient will lose quality. Aimed at solve the problem of limited samples, strong real time, unstable flow speed of raw meal, through reforming the mouth of input of raw meal, adding the control valve and using fuzzy support vector machine to predict and control the flow speed of raw meal, the result was better. Algorithm was proved and contrast experiments were applied with ANN and common kernel functions in this paper. Results give some kind of guide for similar questions.

articleTitle: Classification of remote sensing image data fusion considering spatial information
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Classification is an important application in remote sensing image process, but classification accuracy about non-normal distribution of samples is lower when using traditional methods of probability and statistical. Evidence theory can combine certain and uncertain information of multi-source remote sensing images to achieve effective identification of the images. Taking the results which go through training of neural network as evidence can combine the neural network with the evidence theory, and then integrate their advantages to get better classification results. In the paper, we proposed the classification of remote sensing image decision-level data fusion considering spatial information, and took the panchromatic image with plentiful spatial information into classification decision to reduce uncertainty, and to improve the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of FIR digital filters in complex domain by complex-valued neural networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Complex-valued neural networks, whose inputs, weights, and outputs are all complex numbers, can be used in signal processing fields such as communication, speech recognition, and image processing. In this paper, we propose an algorithm based on complex-valued neural networks for the design of complex-coefficient FIR digital filter with arbitrary amplitude-frequency response. Examples of optimized design of the FIR low-pass filter and band-pass filter based on the complex-valued neural networks are also presented. Simulation results show that the complex-valued neural network is more natural and effective for the design of FIR filter, has higher training speed and has stronger generalization ability, than real-valued neural networks.

articleTitle: Trustworthy Service Scheduling Framework for QoS garantee of composite service
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Interoperability-centric and loosely-coupled distributed computing environment brings forward a new challenge on trustworthiness of service computing, at the same time, user puts more and more pressure on system's non-functional requirements such as real-time, availability, security, cost and so on. Therefore service's QoS should be guaranteed trustworthily. In this paper a Trustworthy Service Scheduling Framework (TSSF) is presented to guarantee composite service's QoS requirement. The overall QoS requirement of the entire composite service is satisfied with the method of planning and guaranteeing the QoS of each atomic service. Our approach is to decompose the QoS requirement for the composite service into separate ones for the atoms; and then TSSF delivers expected QoS for each atomic service with adaptive trustworthy service scheduling mechanisms based on Dynamic Service Entity Group (DSEG); finally experimental results indicate good performance of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Darboux transformation and multi-soliton solutions of (1+1)-dimensional dispersive long wave equations for water waves
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the aid of symbolic computation, (1+1)-dimensional dispersive long wave equations is proved to possess the Painlevé property by using the WTC method and Kruskal simplification, then based on the constructing Lax pair, the Darboux transformation with multi-parameters for (1+1)-dimensional dispersive long wave equations is presented. As an application, new explicit (2N − 1)-soliton solutions of (1+1)-dimensional dispersive long wave equation are obtained. When N = 2, the properties for three-soliton solutions are graphically studied, which might be helpful to understand the propagation of water waves.

articleTitle: Study for function requirement modeling of 4PL Platform based on UML
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, study and application on the Fourth Party Logistics and information technology are still in initial stage in China. The models of case, behavior and object for the software system function requirements of a Fourth Party Logistics Platform have been studied and completed in this paper, by combining the application requirements, operation process and management method of the Fourth Party Logistics based on UML and the object-oriented design method.

Author Keywords: Unified Modeling Language (referred below as UML)

articleTitle: Research on the security of IEEE 802.1× authentication mechanism in wireless LAN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with wired networks, wireless LAN sets up flexibly, and is easy to move conveniently. It can greatly compensate for the lack of wired networks. But the convenience and flexibility makes wireless networks face with the network eavesdropping, identity counterfeiting and unauthorized access and other security threats. In order to ensure the normal network data transfer and access, it must use some measures, such as authentication technology, access control and data encryption and so on. It might greatly improve the security of the 802.1× by analyzing the principles and the design flaws of the 802.1× authentication protocol which may be subject to attack and applying authenticable high EAP authentication protocol to Wireless LAN.

articleTitle: Image edge detection based on improved PCNN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the shortcomings of the traditional edge detection algorithm easily lead to the brink of fracture and discontinuous, a new improved Pulse-coupled neural network (PCNN) is proposed to image segmentation and edge detection. Using Gaussian filter pre-processing, gray image is segmented into binary image. Based on this binary image, the edge detection is accomplished using improved PCNN, which can increase contrast of image and enhance the edge of image. Compared with correlative result using Canny operator and others in the existing references, simulation results show that our methods have both preferable results of gray image edge detection and fine applicability.

articleTitle: Entermorpha prolifera disaster monitoring using satellite remote sensing images
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the eve of the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games, the outbreak of entermorpha prolifera in Qingdao offshore areas threatened the hosting of Olympic Sailing Games directly. With the aid of the TERRA/AQUA satellite data, we realized the entermorpha prolifera disaster monitoring. In this paper we will introduce the method and the flow of entermorpha prolifera monitoring. There are mainly three steps: 1)analyze the spectral characteristics of the entermorpha prolifera and the background water; 2)utilize the Vegetation Index Model and GIS(Geographic Information System) to extract the green alage information; 3)get the statistics of the information of entermorpha prolifera distribution, polluted area variations, etc. This method realized the estimation and prediction of the influencing region and the time trends of entermorpha prolifera, thus provided adequate decision support for the control of entermorpha prolifera.

articleTitle: Design of Distribution Network Vulnerability analysis system based on Multi_Agent
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A Multi_Agen based Distribution Network Vulnerability analysis system was proposed, aiming at the requirements of distribution network vulnerability assessment and control. The architecture, components, features, communication mechanisms and risk assessment process of distribution network based on multi-Agent vulnerability analysis system has been studied. The system assessed each element of the system power independentiy by risk assessment algorithms and coordinated the assessment information between layers by commuciation Agent. Eventually, the system achieved the purpose of information sharing and distribution network to achieve the overall vulnerability assessment coordination.

articleTitle: A new image matching algorithm based on multi-scale segmentation applied for UAV navigation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image matching is an important UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) navigation method. Traditional area-based image matching methods have high accuracy but are sensitive to scale and rotation variations. In order to matching images which have geometric and illumination variations quickly and robustly, a new image matching algorithm based on multi-scale segmentation is proposed in this paper. In our method, we first extract stable image objects which have rich and reliable statistical information by object-oriented convexity model based multi-scale segmentation. Next, shape features like invariant moments and shape curves are extracted and used in local object matching. Afterwards, similar triangles criterion based global object matching which can match objects in spatial relationship is done. Finally, the centroids of matched objects are used as control points to register the real time image. Many experiments have proved that the proposed method is fast and robust.

articleTitle: Simulation model on emergency rescue VRP based on improved ant colony optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to realize practical vehicle route problem in the emergency rescue event, this paper improves traditional ant colony algorithm and constructs route model. Through analyzing practical issue about material shipping route, saving factor is added into probability. In the improved ant colony algorithm, the paper adopts search strategy, and at the same time, the range of possible pheromone trails on each solution component is limited to a maximum-minimum interval. Simulation on the plat of Matlab and its result present the feasibility and validity of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and visualization of pollutant distribution in Bohai Bay using GIS and hydrodynamic models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Eutrophication of coastal waters has gained increasing attention during the recent decades. In the present study, the spatio-temporal representation of coastal water environment is described, and a tidal flow and pollutant transport numerical model, coupled to GIS, is established to simulate PO4 concentration in Bohai Bay, China. The result shows that linking GIS with simulation model enhances communication of relationships and trends of hydrodynamic and pollutant transport in both spatial and temporal context.

articleTitle: Sensitivity analyses of motor car suspension parameters' impacts on vehicle performance based on ADAMS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper had research on a motor car, established the whole car model on ADAMS, and had research on the impacts of suspension parameters on vehicle performance by attributing suspension points coordinate as design parameters, in other words, sensitivity analyses. According to the situation that the vehicle had a good handling performance but bad riding stability, this paper elected proper hard-point parameters to coordinate, and perfected the vehicle a good handling performance and riding stability.

articleTitle: The interactive relationship between the level of technology in FDI and technical progress of the host country
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The important effect of foreign direct investment on the technical progress and economic development in the developing countries is self-evident, however, there are varying influences allowing for various technical levels. In recent years during the process of introducing FDI into developing countries, more and more attention is paid to the selection of the technical level of FDI introduced and the constant improvement of the technical entrance standard of FDI. On one hand, with higher technical level, FDI can make a higher technical spillover and play a relatively larger role in the technical progress of the host country. On the other hand, the technical progress of the host country will also affect the selective absorption of FDI in terms of technical level. This paper takes China as an example to carry out the empirical analysis, which is based on the analysis method of VAR model, on the relationship between the technical level of FDI in China and China's technical progress using the related data during 1985–2008. The test results show that: FDI with high technical level influences the technical progress in China significantly, but the conditions of Chinese current technical progress go against the improvement of FDI level in terms of technology. On the basis of the conclusion, some relevant policy suggestions are put forward in the last part of the paper.

articleTitle: Estimating whole life environmental cost of construction projects based on CS and GM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, environment protection investment measurement of construction projects are discussed, aiming at providing decision support for estimating accurately on environment protection investment of construction projects. An example of highway construction project is settled to study the measurement and analysis technique of the whole life environmental investment benefit. Admittedly, the CS (Cost-significant) and GM (Grey Model) (1, 1) are introduced. CS theory can largely simplify the estimating processes among the similar projects and locate the CS's items of similar projects. GM(1,1) model is used to predict and has a higher accuracy when there are few historical statistics. This paper focuses on the whole life environmental investment estimate prediction technique from prophase of the construction projects to the disposal pay-back period.

articleTitle: The design of component-based workflow management system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Workflow technology can quickly adapt to changes in needs, providing great flexibility for the software system. Component Technology implements the code reuse by certain encapsulation, being regarded as one of the key factors of software reuse. The research work of this paper provides a theory by component technology and workflow technology combining, illustrating that component-based development of workflow system not only simplify the complexity of the process definition but also maintain the flexibility of the system.

articleTitle: An approach of tool paths generation for CNC machining based on CUDA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new tool paths generation method for CNC machining based on GPU-CPU fusion calculation. CUDA, a general purpose parallel computing architecture, was provided by NVidia to resolve problems of mass data parallel computing. The new tool paths generation algorithm based on isoparametric method was redesigned to use CUDA. The final comparison experiment tests the running performance of the conventional isoparametric method and new improved method. Results of experiment show that the improved method based on CUDA can significantly improve running efficiency of tool paths generation method.

articleTitle: A new method for evaluating DSB communication quality using envelope detecting technique
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: DSB communication has been widely applied into the military communication. At the same time, the jamming technique to the DSB communication was studied in many countries. Through studied the modulation recognition and analyzed the envelope detecting technique, this paper present an new feature based on the envelope information. The efficient method to evaluate the DSB communication was proposed. The results of simulation test show its good performance.

articleTitle: Path planning algorithm of maze based on Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Searching optimal path is an important function of the maze question. For the shortage of the traditional algorithm to solve the maze problem, this paper at first analyzes the characteristic of Ant Colony Optimization(ACO) and designs the algorithm of dynamic path planning based on ACO. Secondly, after running the programs coded c#, this paper records the time complexity, space complexity and operating results of the algorithm based on ACO and the Dijastra algorithm. As the conclusion,this paper compares them qualitatively and quantitatively, and describes the next work in future.

articleTitle: Industry structure convergence and local government behavior in Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The convergence of industrial structure in Yangtze River Delta increased internal competition between regions and waste of resources, the further development of regional economy was then hindered. These consequences ,to a considerable extent, caused by the local government behavior. Based on the calculation and analyzing of similarity coefficients of industrial structure of the Yangtze River Delta, This paper combed the mechanism of industrial structure convergence and put forward countermeasures and proposals.

articleTitle: Study on trade of bamboo and rattan products of China, Japan and Korea
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Bamboo and rattan are two very important NWFPs and the export and import of global bamboo and rattan products increase dramatically in recent years. This study deals with China, Japan and Korea, the three countries' trade status of bamboo and rattan products and the degree of dependence on trade. The conclusion shows that, China is one of the biggest export countries of bamboo and rattan products and Japan is one of the biggest import countries of bamboo and rattan products; The three countries have a very high degree of dependence on trade in the trade area, and China is the primary import country of Korea and Japan.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of distributed temperature wireless monitoring system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the complex wiring and poor reliability in traditional distributed temperature monitoring, microcontroller and wireless data transmission circuit were used to design a distributed temperature monitoring system. The method and principle of interfaces between microcontroller and peripheral circuits was analyzed. The interactive data comparison between master microcontroller and slave microcontroller was used to enhance the reliability of data transmission. The program language Visual Basic was used to develop the graphical interfaces to display the curve of temperature, to store the temperature data and to alert when temperature exceeds the limits. The experimental results show that the system works stably and it's temperature resolution can get to 0.0625 °C. Without wiring, the system is especially suitable for realizing distributed temperature on-line monitoring in large-scale industrial and agricultural production.

articleTitle: Study on maintenance level decision-making and continuous data discretization for aero-engine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solove the aero-engine maintenance level and costs optimization, it analyzed the practical monitoring performance data of aero-engine and proposed a method to mine maintenance decision-making rules by the rough sets theory. In the process of data mining, a self-organizing maps neural network(SOM-NN) was used to the continuous data discretization and obtained better effect. CF6-80C2A5 is illustrated to mine the relevance and decision-making rules between maintenance levels and condition parameters based on its monitoring performance data. The case study indicates the acquired maintenance decision-making rules are possessed of obvious practical value for airlines engineers by the method proposed herein.

articleTitle: Efficient screening of petroleum-degrading bacteria under high salt acclimation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Four strains of bacteria that can grow with petroleum hydrocarbon as sole source of carbon and energy, were isolated from petroleum-contaminated soils in Shengli oil field. Petroleum-hydrocarbon degradation can rate up to 78.6% after the strain has grown on inorganic salt medium with 500mg/L petroleum-hydrocarbon concentration at 30°C for 5d(NaCl 1%). Meanwhile acclimating the four bacteria in high salt condition to make them reach a high degradation in inorganic salt medium with 500mg/L petroleum-hydrocarbon and 100g/L NaCl. The strain Y-1 which was identified as Staphylococcus haemolyticus can reach the highest rate of degradation 54.4% with 100g/L NaCl. The microorganisms which can survive in petroleum hydrocarbon waste water with high salt have great potential in treating oilfield wastewater.

articleTitle: Study on early-warning system of pork price based on BP neural networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to predict pork prices and its trend, early-warning model based on the BP neural networks was established to protect the interest of producers of pigs and consumers. The programming of C# and MATLAB 2008b was mixed in implementation early-warning system of pork prices. C# realized man-machine interface of early-warning system and database operation, the training and simulation data of neural network self-learning can be added or imported to database. When the neural network was trained and simulated to predict pork price, the BP neutral network model which was designed by MATLAB was called in the background, and certainly the performance, training status, and regression chart of neural network model can be illustrated by MATLAB. Combined with regulation plan about preventing pork price fell excessively which was jointly issued by relevant state departments in 2009, when the pork price fluctuations is over 15% or ratio of pork price and grain price is less than 6,early-warning system will send out early-warning information. If price index parameters of other animal can be determined, the pork price early-warning would be expanded into other animal's price early-warning. Early-warning of animal price can provide the basis for government administrators and guide animal productions, the economic loss will be avoidable by reducing price fluctuation.

articleTitle: Study on trains' anti-slide simulated system based on ARM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The construction and principle of trains' anti-slide system and the design purpose of the simulation anti-slide device are presented. According to the diversity of the anti-slide strategies, an anti-slide simulation system is designed based on the semi-hardware simulation and embedded ARM embedded design platform. The detailed illustration of the overall construction of the anti-slide simulation system, which includes the hardware construction of the ARM embedded controller and the host PC, the human-computer interaction software programmed in LabVIEW and the embedded control software and procedure mainly in C programming language. In the meantime, tests were performed on the designed anti-slide device, which have indicated the effectiveness of the system. The stored data can be used to analysis the anti-slide strategy efficiently, which is supportive for trains' anti-slide system.

articleTitle: New ideas of the mechanical creative design based on the logical study on the evolution of institutional
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: the innovation of the mechanical equipment depends on the mechanism innovation, especially the breakthrough of body's major function.
