From the perspective of structuralism, this paper tries to analyze and induce the effect on the form of evolution regularity of various types of mechanical structures that four-bar linkage have, thus the ‘shape sequence’ figure reflecting the progress of mechanical internal evolution may be clear and straight. It also exemplifies various volume type fluid machinery evolutions, hoping to provide a reference for the mechanism innovative design with the evolution pedigree of the compiling.

articleTitle: The juncture structure and statistical analysis of Tibetan Amdo dialect
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper summaries juncture structures of syllable, semi-syllable, phone, diphone, triphone in XiaHe words and has a detailed statistical analysis of their composition types and frequency according to actual pronunciation of Tibetan Amdo and XiaHe dialect. The research achievements of this paper provide basic data for exploring coarticulation and reference for the design of continuous speech corpus.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis method based on Modified Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents fault diagnosis method in aluminum electrolysis based on Modified Elman Neural Network. According to the mechanism of fault occurring in aluminum electrolysis, time and type of fault is determined by neural network. Simulation results show that the fault diagnosis method based on Modified Elman Neural Network can predict fault during aluminum electrolysis rapidly and accurately. And it has a certain value in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Assimilation of multi-time radar observations with WRF-based Ensemble Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Weather Doppler radar can provide high spatial and temporal resolution observations, but most observations are discarded during data assimilation. Only the radar data observed at assimilation time are used in operational prediction. In this paper, the radial velocity observation that not only at the assimilation time but also at some earlier and later time are all assimilated with Ensemble Square Root Kalman Filter (EnSRF) based on WRF model. Result shows that the new scheme produces better analysis than the traditional scheme which only uses radar observations at the assimilation time. The improvement is especially clear in the first several assimilation cycles and then decreases with following assimilation cycles generally.

articleTitle: The atomic decomposition for a class of banach-space-valued martingale with respect to complex measure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the atomic decomposition of a class of Banach space valued martingale with respect to complex measure with stopping time method, the result is generalization of non-negative measure martingales.

Author Keywords: martingale with respect to complex measure

articleTitle: Text and position ranking algorithm based on sample weighted
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To effectively solve results ranking of Meta- Search Engine problem, a text and position ranking algorithm based on sample weighted is proposed. On the full consideration of the structural information, the PageRank score is transformed into weight. Combined with text information and its position in the result list, adjustment of the local similarity is implemented, and relevant score of the result position is standardized. The algorithm presents two definitions of entry matching degree and entry relevancy. The experimental results illustrate that this algorithm is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Study on Urban Heat Island effect of Beijing based on HJ-1B IRS data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To study the distribution and seasonal variation of the Urban Heat Island (UHI) in Beijing, Land surface temperature (LST) was retrieved by the single channel algorithm, which developed by Jiménez-Muňoz and Sobrino, based on the HJ-1B IRS data in 2009. The LST was normalized and scaled into 5 grades to represent the different UHI intensity. The results show that the UHI effects is obvious in Beijing for all seasons, especially in summer and autumn. In addition, the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) was calculated to analyze the correlation between the LST and the vegetation cover. The results suggest they have an obvious linear and negative correlation.

articleTitle: Discussion on optimization design of a high-temperature refrigerator in north area
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper analyses and discusses the feasibility without heating devices and spare compressors in high-temperature cold storage at north area in winter by inspecting and researching the design, construction and operation of a high-temperature refrigerator in Harbin.

articleTitle: Research on task scheduling algorithms of grid computing based on multipled QoS constrain and genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In grid computing, task scheduling is a NP-Hard question. Currently most of the existing algorithms cannot combine multiple QoS constrains with genetic algorithms to improve the user satisfaction. In this paper we propose a resource scheduling model based on multiple QoS constrains. A model of satisfaction optimization is introduced to seek the satisfactory goal, based on which a MQoS-Genetic-Algorithm is employed as the scheduling algorithm. The experimental results illustrated that our algorithm outperforms in the aspects of efficiency and user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Generation and analysis of GMW sequences in ADS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the generation of GMW sequence based on trace function, and presents a GMW sequence generator in ADS (Advanced Design System) 2005A software. Then we study the cross-correlation of the generated sequence, and found that variations of the primitive polynomial lead to small cross-correlation, while variations of the trace function parameter lead to large cross-correlation.

articleTitle: Embedded controller system of parallel inverter system based on OOP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem about design methods of embedded systems in some complex power electronic devices. By using object oriented programming method, the embedded system of parallel inverter systems can be designed according with requirements, such as reliability. The UML model is also given in this paper, by which the parallel inverter system can be provided with high scalability and redundancy.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between foreign direct investment (FDI) and capital flight in China: 1992–2008
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Firstly, the paper analyses the relationship of capital flight and foreign direct investment. The premise of their relationship has been put forward, and 1992–2008 of capital flight was estimated to provide an empirical base for analysis of the determinants of Chinese capital flight. Secondly, the paper discussed the relationship of capital flight and foreign direct investment under different calculating methods. And finally, the paper employed econometric analytic methods to investigate the relationship between capital flight and foreign direct investment in China. The research results indicate that there is a positive correlation with strong significance between them. The paper investigates the causes of the different results. The research results manifest that the main driving factor to cause the domestic capital flight from China does not consist in the worsening of the investment environment, but to a large degree from the discriminatory policies between domestic capital and foreign capital.

articleTitle: Study on collaborative biohazard risk assessment system integrated with mobile GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article summarizes related factors about biohazard events, and extracts the main factors to determine the main parameters of agent spread model and hazard assessment model. Mobile terminal (PDA) is used for data acquisition and model calculation, in the mean time a variety of methods are adopted for collaborative communications with server station, ensuring the consistency of models and datas. The map of national administrative divisions, rivers and other relevant factors are incorporated to realize the dynamic visualization of models, and establish the whole system of biohazard risk assessment models. This system improves emergency response capacity of biological hazards, and runs steadily and powerfully during working.

articleTitle: Application of GIS technology in the emergency monitoring of sudden air pollution accident
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Emergency Monitoring is a very important step in response to dealing with sudden air pollution accident; however, the traditional monitoring methods sometimes appear passive in practice, owing to the lack of techniques. Through analyzing the emergency monitoring process of sudden air pollution accident, this paper sums up its spatial problems which are difficult to handle by the traditional methods, and proposes a GIS-based technical solution to solve the spatial problems. Integrating GIS technology and air pollution diffusion mathematical models, this technical solution applies GIS spatial expression, query, analysis and other means into emergency monitoring process, so that the location of accident, the spatial query of environmental sensitive points, the definition of dangerous zones, the layout of monitoring points could be more scientific, rational and efficient. Based on the e-map to express spatial information, this GIS-based solution could locate the accident and query the environmental sensitive points nearby rapidly, and mark them highlighted on the map. It could also define the danger zone and the risk level through spatial discretization of the accident area firstly, and calculating the dynamic concentration of pollutants of the discrete points. According to the spatial layout of monitoring points, this solution applies charts and contour curves to express and process the on-site emergency monitoring data dynamically. It provides guidance for the disposal of sudden air pollution accident. The result shows that comparing with traditional methods, this research helps to respond sudden air pollution accident more rapidly for the emergency monitoring staff.

articleTitle: Study on the internal supply chain integration model based on IT
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with the changes of economic form, enterprises face with increasing pressures of cost and competition. Integrating the internal supply chain is important to improve the operation efficiency. Using information technology, specially building information platform, can eliminate the “bullwhip” effect producing in the information transmission. This will improve the connection of information flow, material flow, fund flow and business process, and then increase the efficiency of enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the effects of isostasy in gravity gradient map modelling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The current method of gravity gradient map modelling is based on digital elevation model, the effects of isostasy in gravity gradient map modelling are researched and analyzed in this paper, and a novel method of modelling gravity gradient map was presented. The current isostasy theory shows that the density of crust changes with elevation, so assigning a constant value to landform's density is not accurate enough. At first, two kinds of isostasy model are analyzed, and on the basis of isostasy model, the gravity gradient map is modeled by using improved landform density model. Then experimental results shows that Pratt model impose on much more effects on gravity gradient map than Airy model. Consider the two models' effects in gravity gradient map modelling, Pratt Model could correct an average error of 2.0% in the ocean area, Airy Model could correct an average error of 0.000085% in the land area.

articleTitle: Dynamical performance analysis of vehicle active suspension based on adaptive fuzzy method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The dynamical performances of vehicle are regarded as control aims. With the nonlinearity of the road-vehicle system, a fuzzy control algorithm which fuzzy control rule table can be obtained with the numerical calculation is advanced. Because the algorithm can adjust the rectification factor of fuzzy controller, it not only can reflect the advantage of fuzzy logic in nonlinearity system but also can improve the disadvantage of common fuzzy control method. For two degree-of-freedom vehicle model, vehicle dynamical performances are studied; its results show the fuzzy controller can reduce the acceleration of the sprung mass. According to the experiment study of vehicle model, the results further prove that the active suspension system with adaptive fuzzy method can control effectively acceleration of sprung mass in concerned frequency band. The algorithm can effectively control the vibration of vehicle system.

articleTitle: Study on system architecture and key technology of digital city
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Digital city is the basic unit of digital earth and China, and upwards controls sky, downwards controls underground, will become the nerve center of complex giant city system. This paper analysis the connotation and significance of digital city, discuss the system architecture, and compares with the composition of geographic information system from hardware, software, data and staff, finally studys key technologies of digital city, hoping to will benefit from the establishment of digital city.

articleTitle: A crack recognition way thru images for natural gas pipelines
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An algorithm for recognizing cracks through images is presented for detection of any crack in inner wall of long-distance natural gas pipeline under complicated environment. This algorithm has low requirement on the image quality, simple pre-processing procedure, takes single continuous image areas as individual part, and carries out fuzzy judgment on cracks by multiple threshold values and crack approaching factors. Experiments showed that the algorithm is simple, of high recognition efficiency and accurate judgment.

articleTitle: Adaptive regularization with Lorentzian norm for image superresolution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Super-resolution reconstruction (SRR) is an effective approach for improving spatial resolution of image, which does not need change the original imaging system hardware. By introducing appropriate regularization term in the image SRR, the edge of the reconstructed image can be preserved while noise amplification being restrained. In addition, the choice of error term is important for SRR. However, how to construct a suitable cost function and regularization parameter had been an open question. In this paper, we propose an improved SRR method with Lorentzian norm combining adaptive regularization. The adaption of Lorentzian norm can resolve outlier problem and preserve edge of image. Furthermore, by adaptively selecting regularization parameter in the proposed method can avoid the randomness of trial and error method. Experimental results are on standard images show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Adaboost face detection algorithm based on correlation of classifiers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to enhance the ensemble of the traditional Adaboost algorithm and reduce its complexity, two improved Adaboost algorithms are proposed, which are based on the correlation of classifiers. In the algorithm, Q-statistic is added in the training weak classifiers, every weak classifier is related not only to the current classifier, but also to previous classifiers as well, which can effectively reduce the weak classifier similarity. Simulations result in CMU (Carnegies Mellon University) show that the algorithms are of better detection rate and lower false alarm rate, compared with traditional Adaboost algorithm and FloatBoost.

articleTitle: A method based on septrogram and pitch for biometric authentication
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The performance of speaker recognition (SR) system may deteriorate seriously due to the different speaking conditions, especially mismatch recording channels. In this paper we propose an effective approach to conduct the SR task more reliable. This method is based on spectrogram and pitch, in which spectrogram (visual displays) of speech signal uttered from different persons is used as the identified feature. We illustrate the pith (fundamental frequency) is also important for speaker recognition. Furthermore, we address some fundamental pitch tracking techniques, based on time autocorrelation and average magnitude difference function.

articleTitle: A study of the innovation of incentive pattern for the intellectual staff
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the era of knowledge economy, intellectual staff determine the future of enterprises, particularly the future of enterprises hinging on science and technology. How to effectively and fully inspire the enthusiasm and creativity of such staff members is becoming more and more important for the survival and development of an enterprise. In this paper the author analyses the personality and requirement of intellectual staff, as well as the long-standing misconception on incentive mechanism for intellectual staff in Chinese-funded enterprises. Meanwhile in this paper the author puts forth and elaborates an effective incentive pattern for intellectual staff.

articleTitle: Research of the trust model in P2P based on ranked feedback mechanism
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In Peer-to-Peer networks, there is no trustworthy central-point, so nodes can't build the trust relationship between each other. To resolve this problem, paper gives a trust model based on ranked services feedback mechanism, which references the blur theory, takes account of real qualities of all aspects of the network services, and divides all services to different ranks. In this model, different rank has different weights, and also the time relativity and punishment mechanism are introduced, so the accuracy and sensitivity are improved. At last the simulation system proves that this model has advancement compared to traditional models.

articleTitle: Research of urban greenbelt monitoring based on GPS and RS data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban afforesting and greening construction is the basic strategy for landscaping and ecological optimization. Based on 7 scenes of TM imagery covering Fengrun district, Tangshan city during 2001 and 2009, after relative raster preprocessing like geometric correction, image clipping and enhancement, band combination is conducted by means of calculating the principal component of TM image and correlation coefficient of the normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI); in addition it is confirmed that unsupervised classification method can extract greenbelt information more quickly and accurately after comparing both the unsupervised classification and supervised classification method for greenbelt information extraction in the research area.

articleTitle: A wavelet and PDE method for optical image interpolation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image interpolation occurs anytime you resize or remap (distort) your image from one pixel grid to another, it works by using known data to estimate values at unknown points. In this paper, aiming at improving the sharpness and removing the sawtooth at edges, a novel method based on integration of wavelet and PDE is proposed. In order to get an initial magnification result, wavelet interpolation method is used to resample the image. After that, a so-called self-snake PDE model is introduced in post-processing of the interpolated images. In this paper, we compare the results of this method with other popular methods. Edge sharpness and structure similarity are used as a quantitative measure of images' quality. The experiments show that our method based on wavelet and PDE has a better performance than others.

articleTitle: Extending and analysis of digital image authentication watermarking scheme
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Digital watermarking is an effective way to protect and identify the authenticity and integrity of digital image. Combining with the characteristics of image authentication watermarking, three methods of extending gray image self-recovery watermarking to color image are proposed. They are a single component embedding, three-component embedding independently and three-component embedding dependently. This paper also investigates and compares the properties of three methods, including the visibility, tamper detection performance, ability against forgery attack and time efficiency. Experimental results show that the three-component embedding dependently has better performance of security and tamper detection.

articleTitle: Integration rendering expression in Taihu Lake pollution multi-source data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, the field from different three-dimensional geological data of the scalar field and vector data visualization is relatively mature, and it realized various visualization methods based on the different data sources and data formats. However, this form of visualization technology is monotonous. It can not reveal the process of development of things that under the influence of multi-source data. So this text presents a fusion of the integrated method of visualization to achieve a more realistic display which depended on the existing multi-source vector and scalar field data representation method. This paper practice the method used of Multi-source pollution data in Taihu Lake region. By combining the lake wind field, flow field, contaminant concentration and the underwater DEM, we establish a unified three-dimensional data field, and using dynamic three-dimensional view to expression of the Taihu Lake region the spatial distribution of pollutants parameters and internal attribute information. Test results show that the integration of data from multiple sources visualization can meet the needs of simulation and decision support.

articleTitle: The study on multi-factor causal correlation degree and its application in seawater corrosion behavior
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Grey systems theory is a new type of systems theory which can give particular descriptions for some system with incomplete information and it also can make predictions and decisions or even impose controls for the system. Grey incidence analysis is one of its main contents, which accomplishes calculation and analysis with the aid of grey incidence degree. But, up to now, grey incidence degree can only be used to analyze two dataset's close extent, and it needs further research for analyzing some dataset with complex causal correlations. Then, causal correlation degree dataset analysis model is proposed in this paper for analyzing the multiple-factor's impetus strength to a main behavior's increasing, and the factors can be ordered subsequently according to their impetus strength which can be expressed by using their analyzed causal correlation degrees. Thus, the main impetus factors can be found, and this can raise working efficiency and save time for industrial production and people's daily life. In addition, the suitable application scopes of grey incidence degree and causal correlation degree are elaborated, moreover, we find that it is more convenient to analyze some dataset by using both of them. In the end, causal correlation degree is used to analyze the corrosion behavior dataset of 3C steel under different seawater environment. The corresponding environment factors are ordered according to their causal correlation degrees, and this order at the same time presents every factor's influence extent for the 3C steel's corrosion. This provides important reference for studying the long period corrosion law of metallic materials in seawater.

articleTitle: A high performance bandgap voltage reference design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on SMIC 0.18um N well CMOS process, a bandgap voltage reference of power circuit with high performance is designed. By means of the conventional bandgap reference, a cascade current mirror is used to increase power supply rejection and decrease the influence of circuit noise. The bias voltage of the cascade current mirror is provided by an op-amp and hence the independence of bandgap voltage on the power supply. The simulation of such a power circuit is performed by Spectre, when operating at a 3.3V power supply within the temperature range −20°C∼100°C, the results lead to a temperature coefficient of 5.223ppm/°C. Power supply rejection of the circuit can reach −81.78dB. Within the power supply ranging from 3.0V∼4.5V, it outputs a voltage of 1.1975V ± 0.5mV.The dissipation in the bandgap reference circuit is less than 0.2mW.

articleTitle: Advertising on Preferred Reporting Items for Patient-Reported Outcome instrument development: The PRIPROID
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Objective: The report of Patient-Reported Outcome (PRO) instrument development plays an important role in the validity assessment for researchers and clinicians, thus, we propose the Preferred Reporting Items for PRO Instrument Development (PRIPROID) to improve the quality of report. Methods: Accorded to the related guidelines and the report items in several famous questionnaires, and based on the research advances worldwide, the PRIPROID was identified. Results: 23 items affiliated to 7 sections were included: title and structured abstract (affiliated to Title and Abstract), rationale, objectives (affiliated to Instruction), intended application, criteria, primary conceptual framework and domains, items selection, response options, scores, times, administration mode, burden evaluation, properties evaluation, and statistical analysis (affiliated to Methods), participants, main results, and additional analysis (affiliated to Results), summary of evidence, limitations, clinical announcements, and conclusions (affiliated to Discussion), item pools or final form (affiliated to Appendix), funding (affiliated to Funding). Conclusion: The PRIPROID contains many facts in the instrument development which can help the researchers to report their achievement more strictly and access the quality of report. To adopted by the editing system, more advice from the experts all over the world are expected.

articleTitle: Comparison of dynamic performance of laterally loaded hollow pile with solid pile
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to compare the similarities and differences between hollow pile and solid pile when they are subjected to dynamic loads at the top of pile, the dynamic performances of hollow pile and solid pile under lateral dynamic load were analyzed using composite stiffness principle and double-parameter method in this paper. The deflection, bending moment, rotation angle, shear and soil resistance were respectively calculated for solid pile and hollow pile with the same diameter and with the same sectional area by changing the cross-section shape and size of pile. The results of this research show that the hollow pile has many advantages compared with solid pile. For example, the deflection and rotation angle at the top of hollow pile is smaller, and the bearing capacity per unit volume of hollow pile is higher. The research of this paper provides a theoretical basis for the application of hollow pile in engineering.

articleTitle: Collaborative design team formation method based on three-phase comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How to select members to form the design team is the first important issue in collaborative design projects. This paper presents to form the collaborative design team using a three-phase comprehensive evaluation method, which including preliminary evaluation, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, and dynamic adjustment. Based on the method, an evaluation index system is also proposed. The effectiveness of the method is verified in an engineering case at the end of the paper. The result shows that the method has the characters of high flexibility and can be widely used in the collaborative design team formation process.

articleTitle: The game theory based on government guide the development of western low-carbon economy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of low-carbon economy in western region of China will help the western develop from traditional extensive economy to resource-saving and environment-friendy economy. In this paper, symmetrical evolutionary game model is applied to calculate the extent cost for the adopted low-carbon economy, the penalties for enterprise environmental pollution ,the courage and reward for the enterprise using low-carbon technology, all of which are directly related to whether the enterprise use low-carbon technology. Finally,the game will be evolved to the enterprise will use low-carbon technology consciously ,and the government don't need to increase financial subsides intensity to enterprise for low-carbon technology, meanwhile, both the government and the enterprise will achieve a win-win to realize the low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: Building universities undergraduate teaching management mechanism based on self-organization theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: During the system evolution, self-organization is that elements coordinate action and form ordered structure when there is no external force driving. According to self-organization theory, the paper analyzes the self-organization characteristics of undergraduate teaching management, giving suggestion to build self-organization teaching management mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on game model of statistics and surveillance of graduates' employment rate at colleges and universities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Employment rate of college graduates reflect market demand for education, it is also an important indicator to measure universities. At present, there is a great deviation between the statistical data of graduate's employment rate and the real data, thus it loses the meaning of employment statistics. Establishing a reasonable, effective and practical monitoring mechanism is an essential and important part in employment statistics. Game theory model is used, the optimal choices of both statistics and supervision sides are derived, impact factors of probability of monitoring and reporting false data is analyzed, Methods and recommendations of reducing the probability of false statistics are proposed. It is a guide in establishing statistical monitoring system for China's current statistics of university graduates' employment rate.

articleTitle: Applied research of Bit Interleaved Coded technology based on Decision Feedback Equalizer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a hard Decision Feedback Equalizer (DFE) Bit-Interleaved Coded Modulation (BICM) system with adaptive equalizer under the Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) channel. The Bit interleaver of this system changes the burst error into random error which overcomes the error extension of DEF, and it has the capability to estimate and trace the channel quickly and adaptively, and it is also extensible. The simulations made in typical ISI channel module show that the system has the ability to equate the ISI and have nice anti-BER performance with iterative decoding.

articleTitle: Dissemination technology research of large size of satellite meteorological data based on distributed FTP architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the dissemination technical architecture design of large size satellite meteorological data for China Integrated Meteorological Information Service System(CIMISS) that assumed by National Meteorological Information Center(NMIC). In CIMISS project, it has two levels, one is national center, the other is provincial center. As the national level centre, NMIC assumed the responsibility of data collection and dissemination. Comparison to common material and data, Satellite files are usually much bigger especially when FY-3A satellite data be transmitted this year. If using existing communication system's architecture, the timeliness for provincial level to get satellite data could not be satisfied. In order to improve timeliness and reduce occupation of network bandwidth as much as possible, this paper designed a distributed ftp technical architecture which could combine with existing communication system well.

articleTitle: Three machine learning approaches in the epitope prediction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: B-cell epitopes are important in both fundamental biological research and the clinical application. Here we get through three most widely used machine learning approaches (Naïve Bayesian Classifier, Support Vector Machine and the Artificial Neural Network) in the epitope prediction of both continuous and discontinuous types. As the prediction for conformational epitopes are still new in the epitope prediction, feature selection is especially analyzed. Some comparisons and the discussion about the advantages and disadvantages are made about the three methods.

articleTitle: The hill-shading method for plain ladder terrain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In plain area, the fluctuation of terrain is flat, and the difference of elevation is less. Now, using contour line or TIN to display this flat area is not fit for mapping or digital terrain analysis. Especially it would take some mistakes about these applications. This method is established in vector data of plain area, through a ladder terrain expression, could visually show microtopography of plain. This paper could offer a kind of idea or reference for plain area mapping.

articleTitle: Study of real-time expert system in the central Air-conditioning system of the special ship
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study focuses on the air-conditioning system operation characteristics of the special Ship, relying on the modern computer technique to establish a real-time expert air conditioning control system. Control requirements of the air conditioning system for real-time expert system and temperature and humidity control strategies were discussed. By analyzing the hardware and software design requirements of the real-time expert air conditioning control system. The real-time system shows that it not only have the real-time monitoring function, but also have the data management, printing, status display and alarm functions. This system has the real-time fault diagnosis function, and can evaluate many functions in special circumstances. It is important for improving the reliability of the central air conditioning system operation, extended equipment life, reduce energy consumption and protect human safety.

articleTitle: Management subsystem design supporting reliable data transmission for future networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to ensure the user's normal call which rely on the soft-switch platform in future network, we designed an experimental system to intercept DOS attack. In this paper, based on SNMP protocol, we designed the management subsystem of the experimental system to control the operation of every subsystems of the coordinate system. Firstly we designed the overall framework and the module function of every subsystem, secondly, on this basis, the implementation of the management subsystem will be given, which is mainly through the expanded MIB and the corresponding SNMP operations. The management subsystem designed in this paper ensure proper operation of the entire system in the actual development, especially, we made innovation of the SNMP protocol in data transfer between subsystems, which is of certain theoretical practice.

articleTitle: Application of artificial neural network in wastewater treatment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Some characteristic features of wastewater treatment processes were discussed, and according to its characters of time-varying, nonlinearity, complexity and uncertainty, it was presented that intelligent control was an effective method that could be used to achieve the automatic control of wastewater treatment system. The present developing situation of artificial neural networks in wastewater treatment at home and abroad was reviewed. In combination with the developing trend of the researches at home and abroad, further researches of artificial neural networks in wastewater treatment need to do in the future are also prospected.

articleTitle: A reconstructive genetic algorithm in portfolio selection under concave transaction costs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we propose a hybrid algorithm allocated with genetic algorithm with branch and bound method for calculating a portfolio selection problem under concave transaction costs constraints. We study the multi-period investment and employ the absolute deviation of the rate of return of the portfolio as the measure of risk. In every period we solve linear programming subproblems by introducing linear underestimating function for concave transaction cost functions. Numerical experiments show that the algorithm solves this kind of problems efficiently.

articleTitle: Process reengineering of manufacturing information and performance evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the pillar industry of national economic development, manufacturing industry plays an important role in our national economic development. Through comprehensive analysis of the current process of manufacturing industry informatization, this paper proposed integrated information management theory based on supply chain management and e-commerce platform to solve the software incompatible problems and information conflicts in multi-system, established the evaluation index system based on the integrated information system, and finally verified the idea by using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The conclusion of this paper will provide reference to manufacturing enterprises for information construction.

articleTitle: Study on integration model of the internal supply chain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with the changes of economic form, enterprises face with increasing pressures of cost and competition. Integrating the internal supply chain is important to improve the operation efficiency. The two typical integration models of supply chain are based on information technology and BPR thought, but both of them have problems in practice. By analyzing the typical models, this paper puts forward an integration model of supply chain based on market chain and provides the procedures of building the market chain.

articleTitle: Expression recognition based on bidirectional 2DPCA and PSO
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the sake of increasing the expression efficiency, this paper proposed an approach based on the 2DPCA and PSO(Particle Swarm Optimization). Firstly, use the amplitude of the expression images after Gabor wavelets transform as original features; then use the bidirectional 2DPCA to extract the main features; at last, use a novel evolutionary algorithm PSO to search coefficients of the features to optimize the features. The experiments based on the JAFFE database perform excellent recognition results, and in comparison, the approach presented by this paper is superior to many other methods.

articleTitle: Study on eliminating methods of projection length distortion in high mountain areas
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper studies the two main factors for the projection length distortion, presents the solving methods of eliminating projection length distortion value in high mountain areas when the projection length distortion value is bigger than 2.5cm/km. Including concentric reference ellipsoid method, map projection zone transformation method and compensating projection plane method. Engineering practice shows that the methods can effectively eliminate the errors brought by the projection length distortion.

articleTitle: Product quality incentive of online seller based on advertising price discount
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The incentive implemented by e-commerce platform to improve product quality of online seller under asymmetric information is discussed. The product quality improvement of online seller will cause the quality costs, and the product quality supervision by the e-commerce platform will cause the supervision costs. As rational persons, online seller and Internet presence provider maximize their own interests, which leads to the product quality of e-commerce is not very good. Linking the advertising costs of online seller on trading platform with the quality of product provided by online sellers, this paper proves that establishing the contracts that advertising price discount positively correlated with qualified product rate can encourage online sellers to improve the product quality, and also proves that the contract is a win-win for both online sellers and e-commerce platform.

articleTitle: GIS-based study on the relationship between accessibility and population distribution
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The relationship of population and transportation has been an important research issue of population geography and transportation geography. Based on the basic topographic map data (1∶10000), the fifth census data, the population data of townships in 2000, this paper calculated accessibility at the county (city, district) level in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China using cost weighted distance algorithm. The relationship between the accessibility and population distribution is further analyzed based on time cost raster map in GIS and SPSS software. The result shows that the county accessibility in Guangxi is at medium level as a whole while the accessibility in the ethnic minority areas is relative low. It is most affected by railway and highway. The accessibility is remarkably positively correlated with the population density. The maximum distance of influence between the accessibility and population density is a 2-hour traffic circle. The results can provide a scientific basis for making better decisions in the transportation planning and guiding the redistribution of population in Guangxi, China.

articleTitle: The application of spatial information technology in modern flood and disasters control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Our country is a country which has more flooding disasters. The affected area is broad, the affected time is long, and the loss is grave. Flood and disasters control will be a long-term and difficult assignment. The research on flood and disasters control needs bring in advanced scientific technology means urgently. It is necessary to improve the flood and disasters control work through the high and new technology. At present, the remote sensing technique, geographic information system and global positioning system (3S) have got rapid development. The spatial information technology with the framework of 3S has been used widely in the flood and disasters control field. This article mainly focuses on the function of spatial information technology, and forecasts the application trend of spatial information technology in modern flood and disasters control.

articleTitle: Fault tolerance property analysis for asymptotically minimal node-degree topology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Scalable routers can satisfy the urgent demand of rapid traffic increase on the Internet. However, link and node failures happen frequently thus fault-tolerance must be considered in the research and implementation of scalable routers. In this paper, we model fault-tolerant mechanism inside the scalable routers based on P2i (Plus 2∧i) topology of our prior work. P2i makes a tradeoff between performance and expansion cost. And it can expand at the minimal granularity while maintain the growth of scalable network diameter at O(log n). Based on this property, we provide a Fault-Tolerant Eigen Path (FTEP) routing algorithm. Using FTEP, we model the link and node failures of P2i and result shows that 100% throughput can be achieved when the speedup ratio equal to (k+2)/2 and k as the number of link failures.

articleTitle: Sample size design and empirical research based on PPS and stratified sample survey
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the significance of appropriate researchment selection of the sample size, introduces the basic concept and the organizations of the PPS and stratified sample survey, combines with the factors affecting sample size, sampling error, confidence and survey funds, which to design the sample size of the PPS and stratified sample survey. Through the empirical analysis of a large-scale survey of a province, the paper draws the sampling error and confidence can be only considered to the design of the sample size for survey in practice. It also shows that the province adopted 5,000 samples for survey is scientific rationality.

Author Keywords: sampling with probability proportional to size

articleTitle: Developing accessible e-learning content
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There exist various guidelines for facilitating the design, preparation, and deployment of accessible e-learning applications and contents. However, such guidelines address accessibility in a rather technical sense, without giving sufficient consideration to the cognitive aspects and issues related to the use of e-learning materials by learners with disabilities. The paper sketches the methodological guidelines of a design framework based on involving the users with disabilities, as well as pedagogical experts, in the e-learning content development process. The underlying objective is to increase the potential to realize learning systems that better meet different user needs and that provide a more satisfying learning experience.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the international trade effect of foreign direct investment in Fujian province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The application research of micro-strip filter in millimeter-wave frequencies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Micro-strip filter is a filter widely used in microwave circuit, but in millimeter-wave frequencies, some problems as performance degradation and impossible processing will appear on model and design of conventional type. The thesis gives an example of making EHF frequency band-pass filter through the modified stub line's filter model, and provides stimulation optimization process and test result, it proves the accuracy of the design and expands the application scope of micro-strip filter in millimeter-wave.

articleTitle: The cross-layer optimation research on wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on layered system analysis, cross-layer optimization of WSN is concluded as two strategies: information based cross-layer and function based cross-layer. The former is mainly controlled by signaling or the establishment of a third entity, and the latter is the fusion of two or more traditional function layers To some extent, the whole network has been optimized by these two strategies.

articleTitle: The performance evaluation study of rural public goods synergic supply based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Synergic supply of the rural public goods is an effective way to improve the performance of the supply of rural public goods, so the purpose of this paper is to try to mobilize the enthusiasm of the multiple operators involved in the supply and to raise the performance of the synergic supply. Based on value orientation of performance evaluation of rural public goods synergic supply and the theory of the stakeholders to construct the indicator system, of synergic supply of rural public goods, then taking the construction of village A's road in Heilongjiang Province for example, it uses the analysis of fuzzy and synergic evaluation methods, the evaluation results show that the indicator system can reflect the performance level of the synergic supply of rural public goods truly.

articleTitle: A GIS based simulation on the potential climate productivity a case study in Gansu Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Gansu Province lies in-side of mainland,its landforms are complex and changeable, and climate types contain dry weather, half dry, half humidity,high altitude and so on,which made it a natural template of observing and researching the tendency and influence of climate. According to the each station's year-average temperature and rainfall materials during 1965∼2000, the paper adopts the model of Miami and Thomthwaite to simulate the climate productive potentialities of Gansu Province. It shows:the average range is 1296.94∼57.85 g · m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> · a<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>estimated by Miami Model or 1155.68 ∼ 32.96 g · m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> · a<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>estimated by Thomthwaite Memorial Model during last 35 years, the gap between them isn't too large; the regional differentiation characteristics of the land climate productive potentialities which is high in the east and low in the west, it is unanimous on the whole with the distribution of the local agricultural ecoclimate and hot-water situation; It is complicated that the characteristic of muti-time scale of climate productive potentialities, the cycle change per five years is prominent both in 3-large land potential areas. so it draws the regional differentiation characteristics of the land climate productive potentialities which is high in the east and low in the west, and spatial-temporal dynamic changing tendency during 35 years.

articleTitle: Synthesis evaluation of teaching software quality based on principle of information diffusion
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Firstly, we analyze abroad software quality evaluating status quo, put forward a fuzzy synthesis evaluating model based on the principle of information diffusion, with teaching software's specific condition, synthesis consideration and evaluating criteria's special instance. This method not only can educe scientific, accurate, objective evaluating results quickly and conveniently, but also overcomes traditional method's disadvantage of information distortion effectively, so that it has good using effectiveness in practical application of the simulating teaching software evaluating electronic business.

articleTitle: The effects of government environmental regulations on enterprise technological innovation under the pressure of carbon tariffs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Now China is facing the great pressure of carbon tariffs. Chinese government increases the intensity of energy saving gradually, strengthens the low-carbon regulations and appeals to the low-carbon economy in order to get rid of it radically. The industries of high energy consumption and high carbon emissions can only deal with government environmental regulations through making technological innovation, improving energy efficiency and developing new energy. Based on the background of low-carbon economy, this paper analyzes the effects that government environmental regulations have on the technological innovation. Such effects are testified in this paper through constructing R&D input-output function with the panel data of 36 industries from 2000 to 2008. The empirical results show that government low-carbon regulations play a positive role in technological innovation, which is more obvious in the lagged period. In addition, the promotion is seriously different among various industries.

articleTitle: Research of bridge health remote real-time monitoring and alarm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Costly bridge construction is closely related to people's livelihood. Therefore, it is imperative to enhance the bridge health monitoring studies in order to ensure the rational design of the bridge, scientific conservation, safe and durable. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> This paper makes a research on the bridge health assessment, damage detection theory and time series, advances that the raw data acquisition of bridge health monitoring systems should be processed into the characteristic parameters, so as to carry out further data mining and resource sharing. On this basis, a long-distance and real-time monitoring is developed and installed to monitor and alarm the situation of the railway bridge. The health monitoring systems generally include information acquisition, analysis, diagnosis, evaluation, feedback and safety. It enables the timely realization of the function of data acquisition by the curve and numerical methods, alarms are sent by cell phones or e-mail, historical information enquiries on a variety of ways and other functions are available. It has proved that the method and software have a great value to be promoted in regard to the long-range real-time monitoring of landslides, groundwater, and building construction.

articleTitle: Coordination mechanisms in a dominant-retailer supply chain with asymmetric information and disruption
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Coordination mechanisms are proposed in a supply chain consisting of one supplier and one dominant retailer with asymmetric information in a regular scenario firstly. After supplier's cost disruption has occurred, coordination mechanisms for revising production plan are developed. Impacts of supplier's cost disruption on retail price, wholesale price and retailer's as well as supplier's expected profits are investigated through analytical and numerical analyses.

articleTitle: Refinery supply chain based on planning and scheduling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Refinery supply chain starts with crude and feedstock selection, includes scheduling, blend planning and scheduling and finally distribution. So it is very important. Distinguishing features of refinery supply chain are illustrated. The activities of refinery supply chain based on planning and scheduling are presented such as crude feedstock selection, crude scheduling, refinery operations planning and scheduling, product blending planning and scheduling. Trends of refinery supply chain are discussed in details.

articleTitle: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor changes in hippocampus and striatum in rat after exercise-induced fatigue
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) is a member of the neurotrophic family, which promotes neuronal survival and repair during the development and after central nerve system (CNS) injury. This study was aimed to investigate BDNF expressions after fatigue swimming in rats and discussed their neurobiology function of exercise-induced fatigue. Rats were divided into control group (CG) and exercise group (EG); CK&BU were measured to value the animal model setting up. The streptavidin-biotion-peroxidase complex (SABC) method was performed to detect BDNF protein expression in hippocampus and striatum, using optical density (OD) and area density (AD) as two indexes to value the protein expression. After exercise-induced fatigue, cells arrange shows foul-up and loosen in cone district of hippocampus. Some cells crinkle, strut and chip. There are BDNF expression both in hippocampus and striatum in CG and mainly in the cell body; in 24EG expression of BDNF increased significant (P <0.05). After fatigue exercise the expression of GFAP increased significant (P <0.01). Exercise-induced fatigue promotes the increasing expression of BDNF; they may attend the neuron modulation during exercise-induced fatigue and influence striatum neuron discharge.

articleTitle: Determination of case factors similitude weight in CBR high-speed machining database system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Case-based reasoning (CBR) is an available approach for developing high-speed machining database. In the case-based reasoning high-speed cutting parameter database system, the determination of cases factors similitude weight plays a great role in the process of case retrieval, case rewriting and case saving. The weighting factors affecting the high-speed cutting parameter determining were researched and the similitude weights of the different case factors were obtained by using two stages fuzzy comprehensive evaluation based on the scores of several experts. The various factors affecting expert's judgment were full considered and the opinions from each expert were well combined in this way. It was applied in the case-based reasoning high-speed cutting database system for the auto panel dies manufacture and proved to be effective. The case similarity was more accurate calculated by using the factor similitude weights and the case retrieval result was more feasible in the application.

articleTitle: A new transmit diversity method based on waterpouring principle in multiple antennas systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose a new transmit diversity method which combines Fast Frequency Hopping and MIMO technologies. This transmit diversity method could provide full spatial diversity in multiple antennas systems under the assumption that the transmitter has known the channel state, and it could bring frequency diversity gain at the same time. In this method, a judicious design of frequency hopping pattern allows the receiver the down converts the signals transmitted via one down converter. Then we evaluate its performance in fading environment through Monte Carlo simulation and compared it with common diversity methods. Results show that this new method functions effectively in combating fading and noise.

articleTitle: Application of multilevel fuzzy comprehensive evaluation in safety assessment of chemical production conditions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the hazard of the raw materials and products, the complexity of the production process, the seriousness of the accident consequences in chemical enterprises, the reasonable and objective safety evaluation is particularly necessary on the production conditions of chemical enterprises. First, the evaluation hierarchy model is constructed by analyzing the key factors influencing safety production. Then, the index weight of all levels is determined by using the analytic hierarchy process methodology. The multilevel fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is proposed. Finally an application of the method in an ethylene project verifies its feasibility and rationality.

articleTitle: Belief inducing and anchoring effect: A lab experiment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper reports results from a two-stage experiment designed to examine anchoring effect of induced beliefs. In stage 1, we induce subjective belief of one's ability by randomly assigning wage for task performance. Results show that low wage individuals exhibit lower expectation on their performance. In stage 2, participants take part in a bargaining game, we find depressed individuals have significantly lower reservation price than others. We conclude that initial settings anchor individual's expectation thus have more profound impact on one's economic behavior and outcome.

articleTitle: Design of physiotherapy monitor and control system based on embedded system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the problems of present physiotherapy system, the paper presents a system framework of physiotherapy monitor and control system which using embedded system as hardware platform that based on high performance ARM processor AT91SAM9263, and Windows CE 5.0 as embedded operating system. Embedded Visual C++ 4.0 is used as software development environment for physiotherapy monitor and control system. Some techniques of Windows CE are employed, such as multi-threading technique, that is used for serial communication with physiotherapy controller and the message and event driven mechanism, that is used for real-time state display of physiotherapy controller. The system also has good scalability, supporting for remote authorization access and charging function and be able to meet different requirements of users.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of mobile-assisted localization scheme experiment based on indoor environment for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The localization for wireless sensor network is one of the most key technologies. First, a Mobile-assisted localization (LA-GRID) is introduced in this paper. Then, the experiment for the scheme is proposed by means of LA's range defined by the threshold of RSSI value. The design and implementation of the experiment based on indoor environment are described in detail. The experiment result shows that the indoor localization precision is more than an order of magnitude lower compared with theoretical values. It is clear that the scheme is limited in indoor applications.

articleTitle: Research on the risk identification and evaluation of real estate development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the risk connotation of real estate development in reviewing the relevant theoretical literature, builds its recognition model from three angles and evaluation model by fuzzy theory from three dimensions, and finds the development risk of G802 block of a real estate enterprise as an example to, come in a “high” rating through the recognition and evaluation. The model can be used in other industries and enterprises to identify and evaluate business risk.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Ulungur ancient large lake based on DEM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Measuring altitude on GPS with the field survey by our study team members, the spatial distribution and altitude of the remained topographic information of ancient large lake sediment in the study area has been identified. By using GIS's spatial analysis functions, and based on Digital Elevation Model (DEM), Ulungur ancient large lake has been reconstruction. And the three-dimensional display of Ulungur ancient large lake has also been available. The study reveals that Ulungur ancient large lake level is higher than nowadays scientifically, which provides indirect evidence to study the geological history of the region's climatic and environmental evolution. This research demonstrates that DEM method has proved to be a powerful tool in ancient large lake reconstruction and evolution studies, and has the potential to improve our knowledge of lake evolution and environment change significantly.

articleTitle: The certain equipment recognition system based on LabSQL and IMAQ vision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article introduces the certain equipment recognition system based on LabSQL and IMAQ. The hardware includes CCD camera, image acquisition card and PC; The Software includes image collection, image processing and image analysis, several key areas. For different types of equipment realize recognizing them eventually.

articleTitle: The empirical study on the relation between internal motivators and job performance of knowledge workers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To any company, it is a new challenge to manage and motivate the knowledge workers. We believe internal motivators including work authority, supervisor support, promotion opportunity and person-organization fit and constructs the model to describe the relation between internal motivators and performance of knowledge workers, which will be tested by empirical study. It can help to achieve the goal of the organization and improve the organizational performance to learn about internal motivators influences on job performance. <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Feature extraction for urban vegetation stress identification using hyperspectral remote sensing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban vegetation is commonly in stress state, due to environmental contaminations, poor soil, water and other human activities and intervention. This article took the principal means by vegetation abundance extraction, studies based on Hyperion hyperspectral image of east Guangzhou urban district, went through the steps: hyperspectral image preprocess — feature extraction — SMACC pixel unmixing, to extract 6 kinds of vegetation abundance images. Forward further purified these vegetation abundance images by PPI iteration, and then extracted seven kinds of endmembers from vegetation health characteristics differences, to obtain the index image of different vegetation stress intensity levels. We through on-site investigation to check out the circumstances around stress site, to analyze the vegetation stress causes. Combined with vegetation spectrum analysis between vegetation abundance and stress. This investigation has more accuracy than vegetation indices calculation, provides accurate material for the urban green space investigation management.

articleTitle: A formal meta-model of software process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software process play an important role in improving the quality of software products. Formal software process model is conducive to the accurate description of software processes. A software process meta-model is a formal tool used to define software process models. In this paper, a software process meta-model SPMM is designed. Firstly, five important properties in software processes are discussed. Furthermore, based on CSP and Hoare Logic, the definition of SPMM and the rules to build software process models are proposed. In SPMM, not only are the important components, e.g. tasks, activities and software processes in software processes, formally defined, but also the five important properties of software process are embodied. Therefore, SPMM can model software processes at different abstract levels. Thus, the basis to simulate, control, analyze, measure and improve software processes is established.

articleTitle: Application of anti-jam antenna based on space-time signal processing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The technology of space-time signal processing can analyze the property of input signal in special and time-domain. Space-time configuration can greatly promote the freedom of the array antenna in order to raise the number of anti-jam without increasing the number of element of antenna. Especially, it improves capability of satellite receiver for suppressing broadband interferences. Paper puts forward a space-time least-mean-squares (STLMS) algorithm based on space-time signal processing. The algorithm can adaptively estimate the weighting vector of elements of antenna with a low computational complexity. The result of simulation demonstrates the STLMS algorithm can well reject the interferences and protect satellite signal.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A study of the perceived career success of enterprises middle managers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The evaluation of the integrated ecological environment status of Shizuishan City based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Distinguish the importance degree of the elements affecting the ecological environmental status of ShiZuishan City by expert scoring, establish the evaluation index system and calculate the weight of each element contributing to affect the quality of the ecological environmental status based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process. The analysis result shows that the most important four elements affecting the ecological environmental status of ShiZuishan City are as follows: vegetation cover condition, geomorphological Characteristics, soil erodibility and pollution status. Sketch out the integrated geographical union using the remote sensing image, endow the attribute to every integrated geographical union according to the basic materials, and then, make the attribute values being dimensionless, assort the attributes into several classifications, finally, use the modeling tool in Arctoolbox module of the ArcGIS9.2 software to build weighted comprehensive evaluation model, draw the final evaluation map of the integrated ecological environment status of Shizuishan city by stacking the four elements weighted. The ecological environment status of Shizuishan City is graded into four ranks, excellent, good, general and worse. Based on the comprehensive evaluation result, putting forward some suggestions to Shizuishan City on promoting sustainable development of economy and society, for example, suggest Shizuishan City to accelerate the closing of the high water consumption, high energy consumption and high pollution enterprises, lay the development emphases on PingLuo country, construct tourism facilities around the lakes and wetlands within limited, prohibit exploiting the nature reserve on the Ho-lan Mountain and cancel the coal mines out in the nature reserve.

articleTitle: A generic framework for design of hierarchic components platform under coupled architecture
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An effective strategy of platform-based product family design needs to carefully balance between platform commonality and its incurred over-designs. It is further argued that a feasible design of product platform is constrained by the coupling scenario of the baseline architecture in realistic applications. This work attempts to present a generic framework capable of handling the optimal design problem of hierarchic platform under coupled baseline architecture. Flexible commonalities are applied to the involved components, and scenarios of coupling and interfacing are analyzed to identify the hidden cost drivers of the product family.

articleTitle: AnyLogic-based simulation analysis of queuing system at container terminals
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the container terminal, the container ships, berths, containers, quay cranes and container lorries form a queuing service system. In this paper, we use the operations research's queuing theory to analyze the container terminal's service process; and simultaneously use the AnyLogic-based simulation to do modeling. Through the calculation of key indicators, we analyze advantages and disadvantages of the simulation modeling in container terminal logistics application. By changing the ratio of the number of critical facilities, we come up with an effective method to enhance the utilization of port equipments.

articleTitle: The effect of positioning error and noise on the accuracy for spindle rotation error measurement with three-point method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the bases of studying the effect of the misalignment of probes, setting-up eccentricity of standard ball and noise on the accuracy for spindle rotation error measurement with three-point method. From the characteristics of error signal, we establish the simulation error data models of roundness error, spindle rotation error and noise signal. Then using Matlab and VC++ joint programming, take full advantage of the powerful computing of Matlab and the fast implementation, user-friendly features of VC++ to analysis the analog error data. This makes up the deficiencies of previous studies, and also provides a good foundation for further improving the accuracy of three-point method.

articleTitle: An method for demodulation from non-stationary ampltitude modulated broad-band signal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional Dectecion of Envelope Modulation on Noise (DEMON) method is difficult to obtain the modulation characteristics when the signal modulation frequency or depth changes with time. For non-stationary modulation characteristics, a modified method ‘HDEMON’ based on Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) is given. HDEMON is available for non-stationary mudulation due to its adaptivity and applicability to non-stationary signals. Simulated data and actual radiated noise data analysis show that, HDEMON can extract non-stationary broadband amplitude modulation characteristics, which could suport both modulation source for the target classification and motion analysis.

articleTitle: Research on storage policy of intelligent network disk cluster
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Intelligent network disk (IND) is a novel idea of storage architecture. IND cluster is a new way for mass storage. As a mass storage system, the storage method and its algorithm design are discussed in the paper. First, in order to prevent IND load from overloading and decreasing delay of high concurrent read requests, a buffer is allocated to store duplicate of file which is accessed frequently. Second, according to the condition of busy and idle, IND handling capability and storage capacity in system, an optimal IND selected for writing file is found so that rational distribution of files is attained among INDs. Finally, aiming at load status that vary with time, the method can adjust load of each IND to system's average load ratio to improve storage efficiency as a whole. Practice show that the system can run under normal conditions through using this storage policy. A mass storage system which can operate efficiently and stably is very important and beneficial to high performance computing.

articleTitle: The effect of the jumps in price and volatility on dynamic portfolio choice
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
