abstract: Based on the double-jump diffusion model with the affine structure in the state variable, this paper applies stochastic control method to obtain the analytical solution of dynamic portfolio choice, which maximizes the expected power utility of portfolio terminal wealth, and studies the effect of jumps in security price and volatility on dynamic portfolio choice. Analysis shows that the state variables in portfolio model both have no “market timing” for power utility investor; the jumps in price and volatility make the dynamic portfolio problem to blend a standard dynamic problem with a static buy-and-hold problem; jumps in price make the investor not only never take a leverage or short position on the risky asset but also never invest all of his wealth on the risky asset in dynamic portfolio; the jumps result in positive or negative jump hedging demand, which depends on that the direction of jumps in price is upward or downward, at the same time, the jumps in volatility will in further enhance or weaken the magnitude of jump hedging demand. This study demonstrates that jumps in price and volatility change the standard dynamic portfolio problem in several important ways, and should be considered in the context of dynamic portfolio choice.

articleTitle: River water level forecast based on spatio-temporal series model and RBF neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: River water level prediction is not only an important part of hydrological forecasting, but also a hot topic. It is a challenge to river water level prediction, for its level fluctuation, time and space variability, multidimensional, dynamic and uncertainty. Considering the temporal and spatial information of river water level, this paper proposes a method based on spatio-temporal series model and RBF neural network, then predicts river water level of Xiangjiaba Station with the method. Moreover, the obtained results are compared to other forecast method. The experimental results show that the forecast method based on spatio-temporal series model and RBF neural network has the excellent performance of higher prediction precision.

articleTitle: A Sequential Pattern Mining algorithm with time constraints based on vertical format
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An improved algorithm called MSPVF (Mining Sequential Patterns using Time-Constraint based on Vertical Format) based on Apriori is presented. Time constraints is added on Apriori algorithm in order to enhance users' satisfaction,. Meanwhile, a new five-tuple list object is used by the MSPVF algorithm to store data in vertical format to simplify the mining process. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm MSPVF is more efficient than the improved GSP algorithm based on AprioriAll.

articleTitle: Optimization model and simulation analysis of wavelength-shared WDM-PON
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wavelength-division-multiplexing Passive Optical Network (WDM-PON) is the developing trend of next-generation optical access network in future. As an important direction of WDM-PON, wavelength-shared technology gets much attention in recent years. In this paper, wavelength optimization model was established in order to configure wavelength resources properly. The average queuing delay in wavelength-shared WDM-PON is simulated and analyzed as well.

articleTitle: The correlations between human capital and industrial structure adjustment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper uses Granger causality test to figure out the correlations between human capital and the adjustment of industrial structure with the empirical data of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei areas. The results show that the rising of human capital level has effectively promoted the adjustment and upgrade of industrial structure, while the adjustment of industrial structure is not the reason of the level of human capital raising. Based on this, we take panel data analysis on the effect of human capital of primary industry, secondary industry and tertiary industry in Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei on the adjustment of industrial structure, which reveals differences affection of the level of human capital on the adjustment of industrial structure. The paper also makes an analysis on the reasons behind the facts and puts forward some proposals and countermeasures as well.

articleTitle: Research on technology of transforming Abstract Syntax Tree of JAVA Language to Implementation Layer of Procedure Blueprint
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the process of reverse-engineering software systems and then transforming information extracted into Procedure Blueprint models, the process of transforming Abstract Syntax Tree to Implementation Layer of Procedure Blueprint is the key. In this paper, we propose the technology of transforming Abstract Syntax Tree of JAVA Language to implementation layer of Procedure Blueprint. We specify the mapping rules of the transforming process with first-order logic, and then we prove the consistency and validity of the process. We show an example of this process and assess the practical application of the technology.

articleTitle: Research on aging and life management system of Reactor Pressure Vessel of nuclear power station
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Reactor Pressure Vessel (RPV), which is the only unchangeable component of nuclear power plant, is the main barrier to prevent the radioactive leakage of nuclear power plant, its life determines the life of nuclear power plant directly . RPV has been accepted as the focal point of aging and life research all the time. In this paper, the aging and life management system of RPV of nuclear power plant is presented, the function reference model of aging and life management is discussed, the systematic goal are particularly introduced and the system function in detail. The development system has been already put into operation in nuclear power plant which builds the good foundation for the aging and the life management of RPV. Many previous problems have been resolved effectively via the RPVALMS.

Author Keywords: aging and life management system of reactor pressure vessel (RPVALMS)

articleTitle: Research on knowledge modelling for the automotive fault diagnosis system based on Ontology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper catches the knowledge of the automotive fault diagnosis domain, provides a common understanding of the domain knowledge, determines the common vocabularies which are recongnized by the domain, and gives explicit definition of the relations between the vocabularies from different levels of formal module. Using Protégé builds the domain knowledge module, using RacerPro checks the module, and makes the module as the semantics basement of the system. Using Jena API analyses the Ontology module, and combines SPARQL and Rules to query and reason it.

articleTitle: GIS based crime risk analysis and management in cities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For decision makers, crime's pattern and its risk distribution in space are very important information for crime prevention. In this paper, we investigate crime patterns and hotspots in Beijing with GIS based techniques. The crime locations are projected on the map and their patterns are studied with Nearest Neighbour Index (NNI). The findings showed that crimes are not distributed randomly in space, but clustered as hotspots. Using Kernel density algorithm, the hotspots of the crime in space are identified, and the results are analyzed combined with the environment backcloth. The research in this article demonstrates that GIS could make great contribution to spatial crime risk analysis and prevention management.

articleTitle: Supply chain coordination with partial buy-back and target rebate contract under effort and price dependent demand
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the coordination of a two-level supply chain facing stochastic demand which is dependent on both retail price and sales effort. Since single buy-back contract or sales rebate contract fails to coordinate such a supply chain, we combine the two types of classic contracts and create four new types of combined contracts. Then we respectively analyze the conditions that parameters of each combined contract should satisfy to achieve supply chain coordination. We prove that only partial buy-back and target rebate contract with reasonable parameters can coordinate the supply chain and allocate supply chain's profit arbitrarily by adjusting the parameters.

articleTitle: Dynamics of energy-related co2 emissions in Guangzhou City
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article calculated the amount of carbon emissions due to energy consumption in Guangzhou City from 1992 to 2007, using the calculation methodology and carbon emission coefficients adopted by the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories. The main results were listed as follows. The total and per capital carbon emissions increased year by year, but carbon emission intensity decreased continuously, from 4.19 tons Per 10,000 Yuan in 1992 falling to 2.75 tons Per 10, 000 Yuan in 2007, with the annual average reduction rate of 2.28%. The energy consumption structure of Guangzhou city was not improved obviously. The result of correlation analysis showed that the growth of population and economic were the main influencing factors of carbon emission growth, while the reduction of energy intensity presented as the increment of carbon emission apparently. Therefore, we can decline the carbon emission by controlling the population, adjusting the industrial structure, promoting technical progress, declining energy intensity and enhancing energy utilization efficiency and so forth.

articleTitle: Application of genetic algorithms in the facility layout design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Genetic algorithm is a kind of global stochastic research method that simulates biological evolution process to achieve optimal results. The result shows that genetic algorithms can not only get excellent near optimal solutions, but also have high computing efficiency and practicability.

articleTitle: The real-time monitoring system based on fuzzy algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The control system coordinated the B-type thermocouple with the AD1674 to realize multi-point temperature acquisition of the sintering furnace, which achieves the purpose of nonlinear compensation by the method of look-up the table. The system uses C language as the module programming. Compared with the traditional PID, it increases the control precision up to ±0.1°C, enhance the robustness and improve the dynamic performance of the system by introduces the Fuzzy-control methods. All of the merits are prove by the process of the simulation analysis based on the MATLAB/Simulink and the practical operation.

articleTitle: Positive analysis on the impact of foreign direct investment in services in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, foreign direct investment has become a global trend toward service industry. This paper demonstrates the impact of FDI in Chinese service sector. The results show that the amount of foreign direct investment in services is in the increasing volatile growth from 1998 to 2009. But there are a smaller contribution degree and contribution rate and a lower elasticity of FDI in service industry to the total FDI. Cointegration results show that there is a long-term stable equilibrium relationship between FDI in service industry and overall growth of services??and FDI can contribute to the overall growth of service industry in China. However ?? it is not significant correlation relationship between FDI level and service industry value added, which only show the added value of the service industry is the Granger cause of FDI in services, there is no Granger causality in the opposite direction.

articleTitle: Developing dynamic capabilities in Chinese Hi-Tech companies a case study of Huawei
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How firms achieves and sustains competitive advantage is critical to strategic management. While some emphasize the significance of industry structure and core competencies, there is an increasingly attention to how firms create and improve their competences to match the changing environment in recent years. In this paper based on the dynamic capabilities perspective, we conduct a case study to explore how Huawei, a Chinese Hi-Tech company, developed and regenerated its resources and capability to adapt to the changing technological environment. We conclude by discussing implications for theory, practice and future research direction.

articleTitle: The application of remote sensing technique in land resource investigation and management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The information that from ground observation made by using remote sensing technique is a kind of electromagnetic reflection and radiation. The images obtained by remote sensing technique can comprehensively, objectively, truly record the surface landscape and ground objects, showing their respective shape, size, pattern, color and so on. In this paper, through the two applications for detailed analysis of remote sensing technique in land Resource investigation and land resource management, and illustrates the importance of the remote sensing technique in improving the efficiency of land resource investigation and land management capabilities. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of remote sensing technique are pointed out.

articleTitle: Urban vegetation coverage information extraction based on improved linear spectral mixture mode
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to monitor urban vegetation coverage more accurately using remote sensing technology, a new model, which is fit for the extraction of urban vegetation coverage, is presented. In this model, TM image was decomposed by linear spectral mixture mode and then the vegetation component of TM image was amended by the high-resolution satellite image. Afterwards, an example of application was given to verify this model. Although errors and confusion exist, this method shows satisfying results with an overall accuracy of 95.1%. Compared with the traditional and improved dimidiate pixel models respectively, this model is more suitable for quantifying vegetation coverage in urban regions. Based on what have been mentioned above, the model has a very high practical value.

articleTitle: Modifying RUP (Rational Unified Process) to comply with CMM(Capability Maturity Model) levels 2&3
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analysis how RUP (Rational Unified Process) supports the goals defined by each KPA according to CMM (Capability Maturity Model) levels 2 and 3, and then it gives a modification of RUP in order to comply with CMM levels 2 and 3.

articleTitle: Research on key techniques for intelligent prediction of fault in safe running of complex electromechanical equipment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The intelligent prediction of fault is an important and difficult modern technique in our world, and the Technique can assure the safe running of key equipment and improve the working condition of it. The Technique is mainly based on large and complex electromechanical equipment, research and disclosure the new methods and technique on intelligent prediction of fault based on data mining. Through the characteristic of fault data of electromechanical system, the acquisition methods of fault prediction based on data mining will be found out; the flow of fault prediction based on data mining will be set up; the fault prediction system and relative engineering application software will be made based on data mining. The test shows: the key technique for intelligent prediction of fault in safe running of complex electromechanical equipment can improve the efficiency of fault prediction for large electromechanical equipment.

articleTitle: A travel time prediction method: Bayesian reasoning state-space neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the prediction model of neural network training methods to slow convergence speed, training for a long time and difficult to control the complexity of weights updating, this paper puts forward Bayesian reasoning state-space neural network, using termination conditions control its training and the confidence interval restrained by control factor standard the results. Using this method can accelerate convergence, shorten the training time and maintain stability. With traffic data by Bin He road of Shenzhen in September 2007 to verify this model, the experiments show that this model can shorten the time of training, and has good robustness and accuracy.

articleTitle: A formal definition of the structural semantics of Domain-Specific Modeling languages
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a Model-Driven Development methodology (MDD) for the specific domain, Domain-Specific Modeling (DSM) has been widely and successfully used in system design and analysis of specific areas. In spite of its general important, due to informal definition of Domain-Specific Modeling Language (DSMLs), the structural semantics of DSMLs cannot be strictly described and the properties based on it also cannot be analyzed and validated. In response, the paper proposes a formal definition method of the structural semantics of DSMLs. Firstly, a formal definition of domain indicating structural semantics of DSMLs based on algebra is presented to unify DSMLs and its models in the domain, secondly, a mapping mechanism from domain to the corresponding first-order logic system is established to finish analysis and validation of properties of domain such as consistency based on first-order logical inference, based on this, the method of formalization and consistency analysis and validation of structural semantics of DSMLs based on first-order logic is presented, finally, the formalization automatic mapping engine for model and metamodel is introduced to show the application of formalization of structural semantics in analysis and validation of properties of models.

articleTitle: Influence of cloud computing on educational informationization of China rural areas
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The informationization is an important support to promote the balanced development Chinese compulsory education, however, it was restricted seriously by existing problem of lacking infrastructure, teachers deficiency, lacking information technology personnel and so on. Therefore, through analyzing the informationization of Chinese rural education, this article proposed that the development and application of cloud computing can play an important role in solving these problems.

articleTitle: The multi-level fuzzy evaluation model of college students' comprehensive quality
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper, according to the statistical data of a survey for nearly two thousand college students in a university, introduces the method of multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to make the criterion of students' comprehensive quality. Data from our survey indicate that comprehensive quality of college students is generally in a good level. Specifically, the results illustrate that the psychological adaptability of students is excellent, whereas their social practices, practical ability and innovation ability perform well, however the fundamental knowledge of undergraduates is lacking. These conclusions could be used to guide university administrators and government officials to establish more effective methods to help college students obtain more developmental opportunities for employment. In order to make this assessment more objective and accurate, the evaluation methods of questionnaire and multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method for the corresponding algorithms are improved.

articleTitle: Virtual Web Service and its application in E-commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper firstly discusses the problems of Web services application, proposes a method to address these problems to apply Virtual Web Services (VWS) which is an Integration of XML, Ontology, OWL-S, WordNet and other technologies, and then describes VWS mechanism, function and operation process. VWS can dynamically call real service and provide a unified service interface to the service requestor to meet the needs of users. VWS adopts double service matching engines to support more accurate and flexible service discovery. Finally, the paper describes eight core modules in detail to elaborate VWS system design and implementation process in E-commerce field.

articleTitle: Real-time ocean wave motion simulation based on statistic model and GPU programming
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper will discuss the method of simulating ocean waves basing on statistic model and GPU programming. In the method, the ocean surface is viewed as a height field, which is obtained by Phillips spectrum and 2D FFT. In order to realize the realistic scene, we take full advantage of the extended functions of GPU during the real time rendering, such as multi-texture mapping, cube mapping, vertex shader and pixel shader. The optical reflection and refraction of wave surface are rendered by cube mapping and the caustics underwater are implemented by multi-texture mapping. The experimental results show that the proposed method acquires satisfied effects in real-time and reality.

articleTitle: A data fusion scheme with delay constraint in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the QoS performance of traditional data fusion scheme which generally only consider the energy consuming problem and network lifetime, in this paper, we propose a model of wireless sensor network under delay constraint. In this model, we prove that optimizing power in WSN can be regarded as the NP problem. So we present the optimal data fusion scheme BSPT algorithm under QoS constraint based on balancing minimum spanning tree and shortest path tree. Finally, According to simulate and compare the other algorithms under several constraints in traditional network with SPT, it proves that the SPT data fusion algorithm has better performance in delay, complexity of algorithm and energy saving.

articleTitle: Green government construction to promote the construction of Shenyang environmental model city
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the research background of green government building in Shenyang, explaining the role of Shenyang green government in promoting the ring environmental model city construction. To create work for the green government affect, effectively play the government role of management functions; continuously promote the model city building process.

articleTitle: The research of performance warning mechanism and deviation control in Earned Value Management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In application of Earned Value Management (EVM), compared with Planed Value (PV), there is always deviation in Earned Value (EV) or Actual Cost (AC). It is proved that correction project depending on deviation will increase unnecessary spending rather than profit. This paper aims at the effects of deviation of deferent task for project, and conducts an investigation into the warning mechanism and the method of deviation control for EVM.

articleTitle: The implementation of a intrusion detection system model based on particle swarm reduction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A intrusion detection system model based on particle swarm reduction was proposed in this paper. Though the experiment of this model, it turns out that the improved algorithm of quantum particle swarm can get the minimal reduction, improve particle convergence and make particles trapped into local minima more difficult. The algorithm is faster than GA and has a high rate of network intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Fluctuation and cycle of pork retail price in China based on wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Prices of animal products are influenced by many factors including supply and demand, growth cycle, grain yield, circulation of animal products, agricultural policies, technical progress, and unexpected event or contingency shock (for example, epidemic situation and, natural disasters). In order to minimize the effect of contingency factors and understand variable characteristics of pork retail price in China deeply, the authors first used wavelet de-noising to discriminate the signal from noise, took a linear regression model, and rated the variation to study the periodicity of retail price of pork products between January 2000 and January 2009 in this paper. Based on this intuitional analysis, a strict numerical analysis using period-gram was applied on these samples. It was found that, pork retail price, which shows a rising trend, is affect significantly by contingency shocks or emergent events. Between January 2000 and January 2009, the fluctuation of pork retail price went though two complete and one un-complete cycle approximately. The average length of a cycle is 54.3 months in the period, which present as a short cycle. Moreover, the reasons for the fluctuant retail price of pork products were explained. In this paper, the wavelet analysis theory and methods were mainly used to develop a new approach for the research on fluctuation in prices of animal products in practice, which provides a scientific basis for planning animal production.

articleTitle: Study on the optimized computational model of carrying capacity of water resources based on water efficiency and welfare level
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Starting from the definition, this paper, has established the optimized computational model of carrying capacity of water resources. It elaborates the relation between the carrying capacity of water resources and available water capacity, water efficiency, welfare level, etc. Besides, concrete analyzing diagram and solution model is worked out. The results of the case study indicate that GDP water consumption and domestic water use efficiency must be improved to meet the economic and social development goals in the Beibu Gulf Economy Zone Guangxi. During 2005–2030, the annual water consumption 10 000 Yuan GDP decreases at an average rate of 7.2% and the per capita domestic water consumption decreases at a rate of 1.7%.

articleTitle: Study and application of SQLite embedded database system based on Windows cE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The SQLite is an open source embedded database engine. For its advantages of small core, fast and high efficiency, stability and reliability, portability and so on, SQLite is widely applied in the data management of embedded environment, such as mobile phone, PDA, industrial control, etc. In this study, the features, architecture and development technology of SQLite are discussed. We proposed a detailed porting process for SQLite to Windows CE platform, and we also introduced an C++ unicode encapsulation for SQLite. In the end, we presented an application of SQLite in embedded system that is about the data recording system which based on ARM and Windows CE 5.0. The experiment shows that it is high performance embedded database and is suitable for embedded system.

articleTitle: Research on permutation generation algorithm based on sorting
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The generation algorithm of permutation based on sorting makes the Series of permutations have some special features. The features guide the next generation under the current permutation, so the algorithm can effectively control the process of generating permutation. And the extended permutation generation algorithm based on sorting can meet some special requirements of clustering.

articleTitle: Forecast on Hebei electronic information industry based on modern industrial system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Modern industrial system is the internal requirement for the fulfillment of Hebei's industrialization and scientific development. The forecast of the development of the electronic information industry will play an important role in formulating the developing strategy and planning, and in supporting the construction of modern industrial system. Due to the characteristic of the electronic information industry, which involves not only some departments in the secondary industry, but also some departments in the tertiary industry, this research selects the added value of secondary industry, the added value of tertiary industry, per capital annual disposable income of urban households and the number of internet users as the predicting indexes. Then, based on the calculation of the degree of grey incidence and the selection of the indexes with closer relevancy, the relevant multivariable grey model is established for the forecast. Through a case study, it is found that this model is of better predicting accuracy, and through the grey model fitting, the credible predicted value of the electronic information industry is obtained.

articleTitle: The detection of unusual events in video based on Bayesian surprise model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Automatic detection of unusual events in video surveillance has proven to be a difficult task. It is shown that surprise is an important cue for the direction of human attention to unexpected events. Aiming to the difficulty of the definition and description of abnormity in videos, we present the use of Bayesian surprise, introduced in computer vision, for detection of certain types of unusual events. Multiple local monitors which collect low-level statistics (velocity or direction) are placed over the image. With the monitors' observation and a set of reference measurement previously acquired, a pixel-wise surprise trigger is computed using Bayesian probabilistic inference techniques. Once the surprise value exceed by a preset threshold, the monitor outputs an alert. These alerts are integrated to a final decision regarding the existence of an unusual event. It was tested on a variety of real-life crowded scenes. The results show that the proposed method localized the regions of anomalies in the abnormal frames successfully, thus demonstrating the practical applicability of the scheme.

Author Keywords: Model of Bottom-Up Saliency-Based Visual Attention

articleTitle: Multi-channel video capture based on DirectShow
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-channel video capture based on DirectShow was put forward, which was realized to synchronously read video data from two USB camera and conduct MPEG-4 codec. This method is not only Simple structure and convenient maintain, but also an excellent research platform of video surveillance.

articleTitle: A new DSP real-time operating system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of microprocessors, DSP has already started to become mainstream in the field of embedded system development. By the DSP real-time operating system, the multi-task achieve concurrent processing, thereby improving its performance. Real-time operating system in DSP multitask processor system can effectively reduce the difficulty of system development, improve system reliability and scalability. This paper first briefly introduces DSP/BIOS real-time operating system, then focuses on the real-time operating system based on PORTOS research, descript its super-task scheduling mechanism. Finally contrast the two examples and describe the using methods and characteristics of PORTOS.

articleTitle: An obstacle detection method based on machine vision
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To develop a quick obstacle detection algorithm for the image-based autonomous vehicle (AV) or computer assisted driving system, this paper presents a real-time method for road barriers recognition and obstacle height calculation. It adopts two similar cameras with different pitch angles, which can perform real-time monitoring for the front area of the vehicle with different coverage areas. The vehicle will move at even speed on a flat road, cameras will sample images at a given rate and the images will be analyzed simultaneously. Focus will be on the virtual window area of the image which can be converted to the actual distance and speed to the vehicle. Counting of the blackened virtual sub-area will be able to differentiate an obstacle with a height with a shadow on the ground. Experiment applying this method proves the effectiveness of obstacle detection.

articleTitle: Optimal dividend payments in classical risk model with capital injections and solvency constraints
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with the optimal control problem for the classical risk model with solvency constraints. The objective of the corporation is to maximize the cumulative expected discounted dividends payout minus the equity issuance with solvency constraints. It is well known that under some reasonable assumptions, optimal dividend strategy is a barrier strategy, i.e., there is a level b* so that whenever surplus goes above b*, the excess is paid out as dividends. However, the optimal level b* may be unacceptably low from a solvency point of view. Therefore, some constraints should imposed on an insurance company such as to pay out dividends unless the surplus has reached a level b<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> > b*. We show that in this case a barrier strategy at b<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is optimal.

articleTitle: ICA-based Rasta-PLP feature for speaker identification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A robust approach that unifies independent component analysis (ICA) feature selection in connection with speaker identification (SI) is proposed. In the feature extraction stage, ICA offers an alternative to discrete cosine transform (DCT), to select relative spectral transform-perceptual linear prediction (RASTA-PLP) feature. ICA provides statistically independent basis that spans the input space of corrupted speech, then the selected independent components are applied to a vector quantizer (VQ) for speaker identification purpose. The performance of the method is demonstrated with the database prepared in laboratory environment. Experimental results show that the proposed approach is more effective in the corrupted speech case.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of the 3-D campus Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of the computer science and application of the Geographic Information System (GIS), the 2-D GIS can not meet people's needs in many areas. Therefore, the development of the 3-D GIS is an inevitable trend. Using the 2-D map of one university, the elevation of each building and other basic data, the 2-D GIS is built. After the processing of Google Sketch up, 3D Max, and ArcGIS, the 3-D is implemented. The system has the foundation of display, query analysis, target location on the electronic map and navigation or browsing in the 3-D space.

articleTitle: The attitude-measuring and positioning system based on GPS and electronic compass
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Considering the problems such as gyro error accumulating with time and GPS poor reliability in dynamic environment, the attitude-measuring and positioning system based on GPS/electronic compass was proposed and designed. C8051F021 single chip machine (SCM) was used as the central processor, HMR3300 digital electronic compass and iTrax02-03 GPS receiver to provide position and attitude information. The navigation information can not only be displayed by LCM1602 LCD module, but also can be sent through RS232 serial port to the host computer in digital and graphic ways. The results of practical sports car experiment show that the system can correctly and reliably complete the attitude and position measurement of movement vector in real-time, it has important value for many practical applications.

articleTitle: Spatial information integration of earthquake disaster prevention and reduction based on SOA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Improving the ability of disaster prevention and reduction is a major task which our society faces. When a disaster occurs, the freely flowing of the heterogeneous distributed spatial information and the efficient integrated sharing are the important guarantee of disaster prevention and reduction. In this paper, a new integrated idea and proposal is proposed, which is based on the Service Oriented Architecture (SOA)-based spatial information integration of earthquake disaster prevention and reduction. Through some experiments, the SOA integration and loading of various clients is verified, which demonstrates the integrated application of the spatial data-sharing function of the earthquake disaster prevention and reduction, and the validity of the proposed model and schema.

articleTitle: A correlational research of regional crude oil pipe networks' spatial dimension and regional crude oil production-consumption in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on regional crude oil pipe networks in China, this paper calculates fractal dimensions of weighted length-radius with the help of the software of Arc GIS. Then this paper analyzes the correlation between crude oil pipe networks' fractal features and crude oil production-consumption upon Z-score data normalization and Pearson's correlation coefficient with the help of the software of SPSS. In sum, the amended results revealed: (1) There is an obvious differentiation of the networks between east and west China in terms of density from the fractal dimensions of weighted length-radius. Meanwhile, the density of networks of northeast, north and east China are relatively higher than northwest and south China. (2) It is primary of crude oil consumption to promote the process of crude oil pipe networks' construction and the Pearson's correlation coefficient between networks fractal features and crude oil consumption is 0.878 (high correlation). On the contrary, the correlation between networks fractal features and crude oil production is so low that the Pearson's correlation coefficient between them only reaches 0.076 (non-correlation). (3) For all the regions, there is such a condition of “high networks density, high crude oil consumption” between east China's networks fractal features and her crude oil consumption. However, here is another condition of “low networks density, low crude oil consumption” between northwest and south China's networks fractal features and her crude oil consumption.

articleTitle: Fuzzy matter-element model for selection of ocean trawler special refitting sites
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Selection of ocean trawler refitting sites problem in wartime, is affected by a variety of technical factors and other factors such as organization, planning, management, etc. A fuzzy matter-element model is built up in view of the fuzziness and incompatibility of the indexes, combining quantitative analysis with qualitative analysis, with quantifying the qualitative indexes by linguistic variables and fuzzy numbers, and with quantitative analysis on the former. The grey relational analysis theory is used to calculate the value of index weights, to reduce the subjective randomness. The multi-objective selection problem is transformed into the single-object decision by Euclid approach degree. The example shows that the method is very practical and the result is objective.

articleTitle: Japan financial system, the bubble economy and the economic management of the Japanese government
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the Japanese development pattern, especially the Japanese financial system will be discussed. Financial systems can be classified into two types: bank-oriented type and market-oriented type. The traditional Japanese system is a bank-oriented one; the US and the UK take the market-oriented one. The role of the Japanese financial sector in supporting its real economy is indispensable. This property of the financial system is also one of the most important reasons for the bubble economy during the late 1980s. After the collapse of the bubble economy, the Japanese authority failed again to adjust the production-orientated and consume-depreciated industrial development style. Japanese economy experienced a long-term economic recession and did not recover until recent years. In 1990s, after the burst of the bubble, as risks were concentrated in the commercial banking, Japanese banks were allowed to take time to write off their non-performing loans under a bank-oriented system. Until recently, most observers saw Japan's response to its last crisis as a failure. But now, we also can find out some good points while comparing with the global financial crisis.

articleTitle: Fuzzy sets decision-making theory and its application in reallocation of replaced water of the Yellow River
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Reallocation of replaced water of the Yellow River is regarded as a complicated problem of multi-area and multi-objective decision-making, which has not only quantitative indexes but also qualitative indexes. Based on assigning the index system of water reallocation, in view of the deficiencies of analytical hierarchy process (AHP), unit systematic theory of the fuzzy sets decision-making can solve this problem effectively. A case study shows that this theory fully takes account of the influence of reallocation of replaced water of the Yellow River on every index and people's experience knowledge. The decision is rational and reliable.

articleTitle: Comparison between ETM+ imageries and ICESat-GLAS waveforms for forest classification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a method for classifying Light Detection And Ranging (LiDAR) full waveform data, using an artificial neural network (ANN) approach. The ANN classifier used was a multilayer perceptron trained through the generalized predefined learning rule functions. Compared with the unsupervised classification based on Landsat 7 ETM+ (Enhanced Thematic Mapper Plus) images, the ANN classifier was suitable to better represent the nonlinearity in the LiDAR waveforms dataset. The multilayer perceptron neural network has proved to be a very effective tool for the classification of waveforms data. The classification results show that forest classification accuracy for broadleaved forest and needleleaved waveforms using ANN classifer is better than the classification accuracy of ETM+ image based-unsupervised classifer. Whereas, the overall classification accuracy of testing datasets using ANN classifier with using waveform data without a prior class probabilities is lower than the unsupervised classifier based-image.

articleTitle: An alternative to internet - The next generation broadcasting Networks standard
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The next generation broadcasting Networks, the so-called NGB, is China's next generation broadcasting network standard, which is going to serve as an alternative to Internet. This paper tries to bring aware of the standardization activities of NGB in China and thus presents this novel broadcast standard beyond Internet for the first time by describing the features of NGB and the architectures of NGB. By looking into both the standardization development and the technical specifications of NGB, this paper serves as both an introduction and an overview to the newest developments of this novel standard which could be potentially the next generation network standard. This paper is concluded with influences of NGB upon the network standards development.

articleTitle: Application of tunnel monitoring measurement information feedback in surrounding rock dynamic classification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The subsurface engineering of highway (railway) tunnels etc are concealed work, because of the effects of environment and outlay, it is impossible to prospect accurately, and rock and soil is complex and multivariable, thus master project planning and scheduling document and lining structural design, that is preliminary design, are blindfold. Accordingly NATM has been widely used in the underground works, through the site monitoring and measurement alters design, adjusts supporting parameters and construction technique, so insure the tunnel construction's safety. The key of monitoring measurement Information feedback design is determination the level of the surrounding rock, which was judged mainly based on engineering experience in the past. According to the monitoring and measurement information of perimeteral convergence, surrounding rock pressure and internal force of parapet grille reinforcement in some highway tunnel, through statistical regression analysis on masses of monitoring data, acquires the statistical average of monitoring data when surrounding rock go to stable condition, which can be used for the basis of surrounding rock dynamic classification; adopt entropy method; give the calculation procedures of surrounding rock dynamic classification; according to the monitoring results of some tunnel, give a example to show the quantitative method of surrounding rock classification is feasible and accurate; which provides a new meaning and theoretical basis for the NATM.

articleTitle: An empirical study on growth of the Small and Medium Listed Enterprise in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we did an empirical analysis on growth of enterprise and relevant financial indicators by using the latest annual report of the Small and Medium Listed Enterprise panel data. Regression results show that the total assets on return and earnings per share are positively related to company's growth; the current ratio and the fixed assets ratio are significantly negatively related to the company's growth. The Small and Medium Listed Enterprise (SME)'s growth is closely affected by profitability, followed by debt paying ability.

Author Keywords: the small and medium listed enterprise

articleTitle: Research of improved IF-IDF Weighting algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It does not consider how similar words are distributed in the text that the traditional algorithm of the VSM characteristic weighs - TF-IDF. For solving the problem, from the semantic view and combined optimization techniques, a improved IF-IDF Weighting algorithm is proposed. This algorithm can effectually reduce the subjective factors of faceted classification, and further improve the effect of current most text clustering algorithm that based on Vector Space Model (VSM). By experiments, the algorithm is feasible and effective, and to some extent, the precision ratio and recall ratio of text clustering is enhanced.

articleTitle: Construction and simulation of resettlement systems dynamics model in Yunnan reservoir region of baise hydropower
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Construction and simulation of systems dynamics model is one of the important contents of the sustainable living and productive system assessment. Based on the sustainable living and productive system of resettlement, this paper construct the resettlement systems dynamics model. According to the simulation result of systems dynamics model, the living and productive system of resettlement in Yunnan reservoir region of baise hydropower is sustainable. And the capability for sustainable development of the system can be enhanced by the reasonable exploration and utilization of resource in resettlement area, application of loose population policy, promotion of the employment non-agricultural population, improvement of population quality of the resettlement, as well as encouragement of the sustainable consumption.

articleTitle: Binocular measurement model of locating fruit based on neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem of locating fruit by using binocular system under natural condition, an implicit 3D measurement model of binocular system based on neural network was proposed to locate fruit. The model used two Ward network to associated work and simulate geometric localization model of binocular system based on parallax computation. The method needn't take account into some localization procedures including image correction and error modification. The results showed that maximum absolute error in horizontal, vertical and depth direction of trained model is less than 10mm in effect viewing field of 223 mm to 1183 mm. Positioning reliability can reach 88.584 percent when resultant error in horizontal, vertical and depth direction is limited within α5mm. Real tests of locating tomato showed that the precision of localization is acceptable.

articleTitle: The selection of spread and the application in engineering of GRNN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The algorithm of the generalized regression neutral network (GRNN) is introduced. Compares and analysis with superiorities and characteristics between GRNN and BPNN. The effects and choices of spread are discussed. It is very important to confirm the value of spread. Appropriate value of spread is searched out from all specimens based on the LOO across validate method. A simple example is given to prove the accurate value of spread can improve the generalization ability of the network. The method of GRNN is applied to the examples of slope stability evaluation, it is concluded that GRNN modeling is simpler and more accurate than BPNN in prediction and analysis of slope stability. Artificial neural network algorithm has been widely used in engineering, and GRNN will be accepted for engineers more easily as a means of more advanced algorithms. It will play an increasingly important role in the non-linear calculations.

articleTitle: Study on the models of open access resources
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper states the implication of open access journals and related items and probed into the route to the open access, think that the copyright problem, operating outlay, quality-controlling problem. Finally, the paper pointed out that open access, as the potent opponent to the traditional publishing model, will make great progresses under the attention paid by the peers both domestic and abroad.

articleTitle: Knowledge push technology based on group characteristics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because Knowledge Management System (KMS) has large amounts of data and updates frequently, knowledge push technology is becoming more and more important. But the existing knowledge push technologies only considered individual characteristics. By analyzing the interested information of each KMS users' group and then extract the characteristics of every group, this paper, based on Ontology, introduces a push technology, which considered the users' group characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on simulated three-dimensional map service from two-dimensional city building data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Most of the 3D's data acquisition for buildings is a huge project, while the existing 2D data has not been fully exploited. This paper puts forward a method based on the existing 2D vector data to construct the simulated 3D map service. The key technique is to introduce the city 2D building's attribute “height” as elevation data, then based on the elevation data and the 2D geometric data, the simple 3D model can be constructed. After that, using the projection transformation and shear transformation to convert the simple 3D models to 2D data which have 3D visualization effect. Finally drawing the processed building data in 2D plane to achieve the 3D viewing effect. The proposed method is rapid flexible simplify and enhances people's sense of geospatial cognition.

articleTitle: Improved fittings for distribution of vehicles' velocity in intelligent transportation systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To find out the approximations for the probability distribution functions (PDF) of vehicles' speeds during different periods of time respectively is one of the most important targets to analyze a transportation system. Nevertheless, the distribution of the velocity generally does not consist with the normal (Gaussian) distribution. In this article, two statistic models for fitting are investigated, which are Generalized T (GT) distribution and the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). Maximum likelihood Estimation (MLE) rule is used in the optimization of the models' parameters through Genetic Algorithm. For simulation, data from NGSIM is utilized, and the result manifests that both of the two proposed models are better than Gaussian model. GT performs better in maximum likelihood, while GMM has better performance in MSE.

articleTitle: Knowledge sharing and new business development in engineering consulting firms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Engineering consulting firms are knowledge-intensive. The knowledge management and sharing are extremely significant to their maintenance and improvement of comprehensive competitiveness, which is the prerequisite for the development of new business. This paper focus on the content and forms of knowledge sharing in those firms and finds out a framework which illustrates the positive effects that knowledge sharing has on the development of new business in engineering consulting firms.

articleTitle: Novel parallel interleaver based on Chinese Remainder Theorem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the lower decoding latency and better channel coding performance, parallel decoding method has broad application in decoding turbo codes. However, memory collision issue is a troublesome problem during parallel processing. In this paper, by combining with the modulus property of punctured codes, a novel parallel interleaver based on Chinese Remainder Theorem is proposed. It is shown by computer simulations that our proposed parallel interleaver can achieve preferable BER performance and decrease the complexity.

articleTitle: Speech feature extraction method of improved KPCA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel speech feature extraction method using kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) based on kernel fuzzy K-means clustering. First, all frames of speech signal are divided into a given amount of clusters by kernel-based fuzzy K-means clustering and then features are extracted by KPCA, as a result of which the storage and computational complexity can be reduced and the original signal can be well represented. Moreover, the proposed method has effects of reducing noise and eliminating tedious information by mapping original eigenvector to a lower dimension space. Simulations show that compared with the existing speech feature extraction methods, the proposed method has a real-time performance, a high speech recognition rate and a better robustness in noisy environment.

articleTitle: IP-based Connectivity with IEEE 802.11 embedded networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Most existing embedded networks require custom gateways and tools to connect to the Internet. IP provides end-to-end communication between devices, without intermediate protocol translation gateways. IP-based embedded networks will provide scalable and interoperable communication mechanism for embedded devices, and they can get access to the Internet easily. This paper shows how to integrate Wi-Fi technology into smart embedded devices, the formation mode of wireless Wi-Fi monitoring system and the system design for wireless embedded networks. It provides a feasible solution for embedded devices' remote data transmission and wireless monitoring.

articleTitle: Online advertising identification techniques and implementation using text classification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Online advertising web pages identification has been cuurently a challenging topic in online advertising mornitoring. An improved forward maximu character string match algorithm based on advertises-word-base is introduced by employing weight selection, text feature representation, weight calculating, text classification and text simularity. With text classification and Chinese word segmentation techniques, an online advertising pages recognition method is developed and the proposed method is applied to the development of online advertising monitoring system. The system operation practically achieved satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Using 2DGabor values and kernel fisher discriminant analysis for face recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novelty method of 2DGabor-KDA(kernel Fisher discriminant analysis) for face recognition is proposed. First of all, every facial image is segmented into several sub-areas according to the five particular face parts and then the features of five key parts are extracted through 2DGabor wavelet, average values are calculated from feature vectors gained from the corresponding pixel of each test sample and then the eigenvectors are gained, in the next place, KDA is applied to kernel-process the gained eigenvectors, and then SVM(Support Vector Machine) is adopted to recognize the face images. The numerical experiments on face database of ORL demonstrate that this method achieves better results of face recognition than other methods and shows stronger robustness to changes of illumination, expressions, poses and so on.

articleTitle: ArcGIS-based data processing method for applications system of metro monitoring
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data processing is the foundation of subway construction monitoring system, it would be no practical significance leaving data. This paper taking the processing course of subway construction map for CAD format as an example, which is important while developing a subway monitoring application system, introduce the GIS-oriended data processing course, treatment methods, and key issues which should be noticed of the monitoring data from data collection to data storage and then propose specific methods for dealing with the problems.

Author Keywords: Data of subway construction monitoring system

articleTitle: Research and improvement of face detection algorithm based on the OpenCV
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article describes functions and advantages of the OpenCV library, and explains the meaning, development status, applications, and difficulties of face detection technology, analysis the idea of Adaboost classifier algorithm, and achieves the detection procedures for face using OpenCV, and proposes the improved method based on the the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Satisfiability of artifact lifecycle in business process model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: One of the new trends in BPM is data-centric. Business artifact is a data entity which records the business process. The approach based on artifact becomes a focus in the research of BPM. Lifecycle is a key character of artifact. Whether a business process can satisfy the defined artifact lifecycle is an important property to be checked out. In this paper, artifact lifecycle is defined by the reachability tree in Petri net. Then an artifact states tree is extracted from the business process model. To decide the satisfiability is transformed to the question of tree path inclusion and the algorithm is given.

articleTitle: A shape preserving rational cubic interpolation spline
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An explicit representation of a C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> piecewise rational cubic spline has been developed, which can preserve monotonicity and convexity of the data set. The explicit representation is easily constructed, and numerical experiments indicate that the method produces visually pleasing curves. Furthermore, an error analysis of the interpolant is give.

articleTitle: Design of a reliable cache based on grouped checking and data reloading
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Reviewing some past research<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1–4]</sup>, we have come to believe that SEU (single event upset) is the main reason for fault or even failure of satellite-borne computer. This paper proposes a reliable cache structure which is based on grouped checking and data reloading. In this structure, data and tag domain are divided into several groups to check. If there have some errors during checking, the cache accessing is identified to cache missing and to reload the right data from memory. The experimental results show preliminarily that the Longteng-FT1 microprocessor we designed is reliable and can tolerate SEU up to 300 Krads (Si).

articleTitle: On optimization of auction mechanism in the military logistics based on the game Theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and society, it brings significant challenges to the State and military construction, but also produces a broad cooperation prospect and space. The integration between military and civilian is apparent, and the industry boundaries have become more blurred. Cooperation in all walks of life has become an irresistible trend. The paper, explains the importance and feasibility of cooperation between the military and civilian based on the game theory, analyzes the roles of auction mechanism in the military logistics, optimizes the auction mechanism to solve the problems of improving bidding prices and cheating. It also guides to select cooperators correctly.

articleTitle: Uncertainty of GIS-based Multi-Criteria Evaluation with Ordered Weighted Averaging method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Uncertainty can occur in specifying the relation between the evidence and the decision set, which state the degree to which the evidence suggests the presence of the set. Thus Dempster-Shafer theory is appropriate. The Dempster-Shafer rule of combination provides an important approach to aggregating indirect evidence and incomplete information. In some instances, decisions may be based on a single criterion, but commonly several criteria are required to define the decision set. Ordered Weighted Averaging (OWA) is a relatively new Multi-Criteria Evaluation (MCE) method. In GIS-based OWA method, both criteria weights and order weights are considered. Calculation method of order weights based on Orness, and construction method of comparison matrix for criteria weights based on analytical hierarchy program (AHP), are introduced; uncertainty of this method is investigated. As an example, GIS-based OWA method is applied to Tangshan City, and three images of belief, plausibility and belief interval are obtained based on Dempster-Shafer theory. The results are analyzed, and some advice is proposed.

articleTitle: The logistics finance model and its application in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of logistics, the firms on the logistics chain, especially the Chinese small and medium enterprises, find it very difficult to get the financial support from the bank, the launch of the logistics finance paves the road for the integration of the logistics firms and finance sectors to a certain extent, and is popular at home and abroad nowadays. Based on the previous study and practice of logistics chain finance, this paper puts forward the bank oriented model, logistics firm oriented model, discusses their advantages, disadvantages, and their application, and generalize the two models finally, the results may benefits the Chinese enterprises on the logistics finance chain and financial sectors as well.

articleTitle: Mediating effect of person-organization fit on the relationship between organizational socialization and employee performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on samples from the Enterprises of South of China, this paper investigates the relationships among organizational socialization, person-organization fit and employee performance. The result showed that: organizational socialization had positive impact on person-organization fit; organizational socialization had positive impact on employee performance; person-organization fit had positive impact on employee performance; person-organization fit acted a partly mediator between organizational socialization and employee performance. At the end of this paper, we discussed the practical significance of this study, in order to put some suggestions for improving the employee performance by organizational socialization management and person-organization fit management.

articleTitle: Making of the simulation system for the force of the current-carrying circular coil in non-uniform magnetic field
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the current-carrying circular coil in non-uniform magnetic field, its force was shown as three-dimension effect with two-dimension plane. A new method had been put forwarded. First of all, the three-dimension model had been built. The second stage was based on the methods of limit analysis and vector analysis. The method of limit analysis was suit for getting the angle between the direction of the current element in the current-carrying circular coil and the direction of its magnetic induction. The method of vector analysis was suit for obtaining the angle between the direction of the force of the current element and horizontal plane. The force was Ampere force and it was calculated by Ampere's law. The component of the force in the horizontal plane had been calculated. The finally stage was very important stage. In the stage, the simulation system had been developed by Multimedia ToolBook. In the system, the relative size and the direction of the force for the current element could be shown as three-dimension effect at once when the mouse entered into the current element. The users could drag the current-carrying straight wire in horizontal direction. The coordinate values in the central position of the current-carrying circular coil and the radius of the coil could be changed by users. The simulation system had good effect and the high degree of intelligence.

articleTitle: Study on the compressibility for municipal solid waste with higher content of organic matter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By using a new developed large scale compression testing instrument, the compressibility for municipal solid waste with higher content of organic matter have been studied. The municipal solid waste is divided into three parts: the material that is easy to be biodegraded, reinforced material that is difficult to be biodegraded and incompressible solid material. The proportions of these three parts are 80%, 5%, and 15%, respectively. Laboratory test has been performed by applying this instrument for these test samples under different pressure. The testing results show that the compression strain is increased by the pressure applying on the testing sample, and the strain is about 85% under the pressure 800kPa, and it is a very high strain for the proportions of municipal solid waste, and the strain is gradual coming to stable with the time expand under the same pressure. The relationship between initial void ratio and the logarithm pressure is linear, and the compression index is 1.63. The relationship between initial void ratio and the pressure is a typical curve as curve of the traditional soil, and the compression coefficient is 3.87.

articleTitle: A sensor less brushless DC motor controller based on Actel Fusion mixed- signal FPGA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the Actel Fusion mixed-signal FPGA development board, this paper introduced a kind of brushless motor sensorless controller based on the Actel Fusion FPGA, with the three-phase BLDC drive circuit, achieving the continuous tone rate and jitter-free starts and stops of DC motor of the sensorless brushless, the controller has much benefits includes high integration, performance, stability and anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Design and research on the motion target detection and tracking algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the common technique used in the monitoring system, Motion Detection Technology generally conducts tracking by finding motion trace of targets through the analysis of video frame sequence, however, the high efficiency and validity of target pattern matching can not be guaranteed. By means of the characteristics of Gaussian distribution and scaling density functions, this paper has studied and designed a kind of algorithm for detecting and tracking moving target, which can realize foreground detection on the moving target, achieve background update of Gaussian distribution model by updating weights, mean values and variance, and then extract foreground object by the noise reduction preprocessing for collecting image and the histogram equalization method, to determine the minimum Euclidean distance based on the space distance target tracking algorithm and thereby achieve the detection and tracking for the moving targets. Based on the experimental data, it is shown that the algorithm designed by the system can achieve the detection and tracking for the moving targets under the condition that the hardware is at rest.

articleTitle: Tourism impact perception research related theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with tourism deepening and tourism scale's unceasing expansion, tourism brings for destination economic impact, environmental impact and socio-cultural impact is increasingly clear that these effects form residents tourism impact integrated perception. The destination resident's support or not has pivotal significance to tourism sustainable development, tourism plan and tourism management. Article introduces tourism destination resident's tourism impact perception related theory.

articleTitle: Design of real-time single object tracking system under complex background
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper develops a new real-time single object tracking system under camera rotation freely. Optical-flow and color information are combined and it proposes a simple and feasible method by updating the feature point to update the template. By capturing the corner and combining with pyramid-optical-flow the problem of real-time tracking in optical-flow is solved. The rotation and tracking under partial occlusion are settled through introducing the color probability distribution and recapturing the feature points. It is proved by experiment that this system is insensitive to the environment and shows a good performance.

articleTitle: Approach civil Integrated Modular Avionics Airworthiness Certification by Iterative Incremental Certification Process
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper discussed the main difficulties of the Integrated Modular Avionics Airworthiness Certification, analyzing the disadvantages of the traditional airworthiness certification. On the basis of incremental acceptance of IMA, Iterative Incremental Certification Process (IICP) are introduced to resolve the gaps between certification methods and development practice under the situation that Open IMA are now wildly used in civil aircraft.

articleTitle: Service economy and the transition of economic development mode in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The newly adjustment in the industrial structure in China is in line with the transition of economic development mode. In developed countries, service sector accounts for more than seventy percent of GDP. However n China, the share of service sector is comparatively small. This means that China has great potential for developing service economy in the future. And both Chinese local governments and enterprises can accomplish much in the field of service economy.

articleTitle: Application research of Arithmetic Coding
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Through the use of accurate models,Arithmetic Coding becomes a excellent compression technology, its main advantage is that code can be arbitrarily close to the entropy. First of all, analy arithmetic coding theory and method through specific examples, and then given an efficient algorithm to achieve arithmetic coding, analy optimization theory and methods.

articleTitle: A Survey on Intrusion Detection of Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of Wireless Sensor Network, the security of WSN becomes a very important issue. In this paper, The Intrusion Detection of Wireless Sensor Network is presented in detail. An overview of intrusion detection of WSN including detected objects, the current techniques of intrusion detection, and their advantages and disadvantages are presented. Finally possible new directions of intrusion detection of WSN are also stated.

articleTitle: Research on the time quota of transmission gear based on MOD
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Because the motion time of manufacture time quota is difficult to accurately estimate in Chinese Mainland, the calculation for time period and process costs are not accurate in contemporary railway transportation equipments manufacturing industry. On the basis of traditional calculated method of time quota, this paper formulates motion time quota exploring Modular Arrangement of Predetermined Time Standard of Industrial Engineering, calculates the normal time, considers the time allowance and then determines the standard time of time quota scientifically and reasonably. An example is presented about formulating the time quota of a transmission gear in a locomotive and rolling stock enterprise.

Author Keywords: Modular Arrangement of Predetermined Time Standard (MOD)

articleTitle: Research on credit index system and evaluation of construction enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The establishment of the credit evaluation system of construction enterprises is the key to establishing the credit system of construction market. How to build a scientific and reasonable credit evaluation model is of critical importance.
