In this paper, we fist apply Delphi method to identify construction enterprises' credit evaluation index and refines each index into various sub-items. Then, we adopt questionnaire survey to identify the weight of each evaluation index and sub-item. After that, we create the calculating model of construction enterprises' credit evaluation. At last, we make a brief illustration of the application direction of the credit evaluation model.

articleTitle: The study of the cut-off point about the two-stage discounted cash flow model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When we evaluate the value of the enterprise by using two-stage discounted cash flow model, it is difficult to divide the period of rapid development and the period of stable development, lots of factors affect the cut-off point, so the cut-off point is uncertain. The purpose of this paper is to settle the uncertain cut-off point. We combine the fuzzy theory with the two-stage discounted cash flow model; the uncertainties of the cut-off point are fuzzified by the trapezoidal fuzzy number. Finally, we get the modified discounted cash flow model.

articleTitle: Modeling and performance analysis of frequency hopping spread spectrum communication system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: First, we build a frequency hopping system model with BFSK modulation in matlab. Then, we analyze the bit error rate performance in FH/BFSK communication system with noise jamming and narrow-band jamming. Analysis showed that the artificial noise jamming only effects in the large error rate conditions (when the error rate is above 0.1), when the error rate is below 0.1, it is ineffective than noise jamming. Finally, we compare the system performance of theoretic numerical results with Monte Carlo analysis, to show that the two scheme's results are consistent to some extent.

articleTitle: A hardware implementation of texture encoder based on MPEG-4 protocol
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A texture encoder based on MPEG-4 encoding and decoding protocol is proposed, which consists of the DCT/IDCT, Q/IQ, the intra-frame prediction and the scanning modules. The encoder is designed in terms of Verilog code and some simulations are carried out in tools of the VCS simulator. The experimental results show that the texture encoder designed in this paper can perform correct logic functions and can achieve a real-time encoding for MPEG-4 Core Profile.

articleTitle: The analysis of the Northwest Energy Pipeline Competitive Strength Factors based on AHP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on AHP, this article analyzes the Northwest Energy Pipeline Competitive Strength Factors, and establishes the corresponding evaluation system. It also reaches the sort results of those factors according to the importance of achieving the overall goal. And finally, it proposes some relevant suggestions to the three types of Factors, which provides reference basis for the Government to plan and make industrial policies of the Northwest Energy Pipeline.

articleTitle: Effects of China-U.S. energy cooperation on rebalancing trade
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the two largest countries of energy consumption in the world, China-U.S. energy cooperation has been taken place to respond the climate change. And as the important foreign trade partners each other, the bilateral trade imbalance impedes their economical relation. So in this article the ways of effects of China-U.S. energy cooperation on rebalancing trade are studied firstly. Secondly the VAR model is founded and the road and degree of effects of China-U.S. energy cooperation on rebalancing trade are studied positively with impulse response function (IRF) and variance decomposition.

articleTitle: Research on application levels of inter-organizational information systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Inter-organizational information systems (IOS) are the expansion and extension of Intra-organizational information system. The application level of IOS depends on the development stage of the partner's IS capability. The paper first divides the organizational IS levels into 4 development stages as, functional, inter-functional, process and inter-processes. Then in accordance with the corresponding relations divides the IOS into consultation level, cooperation level, coordination level and collaboration level. The level of dedicated IOS application is resolved by the organization with the lowest capability among partners. Increasing the overall application level of all business partners will have impact on the business performance of organizational collaboration.

articleTitle: Construction and practice of education technology evaluation standard for normal students
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper is based on “The primary and secondary school teachers education technology ability standard (tentative)”, Combined with the practice of local universities, and based on the the analysis of the normal students for education and technical skills, discussed the technical skill evaluation system and evaluation standard of these students. Finally, this paper designed four tasks, as the principle of testing and evaluating the situation of the students' skill of education technology.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the effective management of the intellectual staff members' psychological contract
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation approach of power quality based on neural network ensemble and subordinate degree
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the standards of power quality in China, a neural network ensemble (NNE) model was constructed for comprehensive evaluation of power quality. Back Propagation (BP) neural network with same topology structure were applied to all subnets of this ensemble model. The number of ensemble subnets are 20 respectively, determined with the incremental method. A large number of samples based on the random-distribution theory were produced to train these networks, and the NNE output results were analyzed according to the subordinate degree rule. The simulation test result shows that the generalization ability of NNE is superior to simplex BP neural network. Meanwhile, the model was applied to analyzing the power quality for a 0.38kV distribution network. The results show that the proposed method can evaluate the PQ grade correctly and help find out the key factor which impacts the power quality.

articleTitle: A cointegration analysis of export and economic growth
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on nanjing export and GDP data from 1992 to 2009, This paper uses cointegration, Granger causality test and impulse response to analysize empirically the relationship between export and economic growth. Then the results show that nanjing export growth and economic growth have long-term cointegration relationships, but export growth is not the cause of economic growth. So the paper proposes some policies and proposals to enhance the export role for economic growth.

articleTitle: Vegetation chlorophyll inversion of coal mining area based on MODIS data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vegetation indices of NDVI, VIgreen, VARI, EVI were used to establish the one-dimensional linear inversion model combing with field vegetation canopy reflectance and canopy chlorophyll content. By comparison of the results, the model accuracy of NDVI is much higher. But the model established by the 4 indexes has the highest accuracy with the correlation coefficient of 0.503 and root mean square error of 0.3969mg/g. There is a good linear relationship between model predicted chlorophyll value and measured value, the coefficient of determination is 0.546. Surface reflectance products of MOD09A1 (Year 2009) is used to get chlorophyll spatial distribution and to analyze the regional and seasonal characteristics of chlorophyll variation.

articleTitle: Design and realization of Mechanical Environmental TDM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the effective storage management and rational utilization of much testing experimental data during mechanical environment test, a mechanical environmental testing data manage system (TDM) is designed and Implemented in this paper. TDM uses SQLServer as backing warehouse, VC++ as development tool, ADO as object for database connectivity, B/S three-layer as structure and disposes in local area network. It defines and sorts the experiment data centralized and unified. The data analysis and processing approaches are also integrated in it. The design and implementation of TDM makes Mechanical Environmental test data management and analysis much more efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of government information security outsourcing based on principal—Agent theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on principal — agent theory, this paper establishes the principal — agent model of government information security outsourcing that has uncertainties but can be supervised and the principal—agent model that has uncertainties but can not be supervised. It analyses the risks and benefits, the participation constraint and incentive compatibility constraint in the principal—agent process. The paying incentive mode, the cost incentive mode and the trust incentive mode are devised in this paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Weights of evidence method for copper prospecting in Rigaze region, Tibet
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of city land conservation and intensive utilization— A case study of Hefei City
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper analyzed and did research to the city land intensive land use, and took building project of the new Hefei station (high-speed railway station) passenger terminal and Binhu century city for examples, discussed the detail mode of city land intensive use, and got economical and social results.

articleTitle: Study on four-objective integrated optimization of engineering management based on Combination Weighting
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Project controls over cost, time, quality and resource leveling is an important issue in project management. The systematic analysis and integrated optimization of the four elements play important roles in improving comprehensive benefits of project. Combination Weighting Method is applied in the project optimization and a new integrated optimization model is built in Combination Weighting Method with the multiple attribute decision making theory. In the model, chain ratio method is used in subject weight while maximum deviation in objective method. Finally, an example is given to verify the feasibility and practicality of the model.

articleTitle: ARIMA model for traffic flow prediction based on wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the traffic flow has the features of nonlinear and strong interference, it has different characteristics in different time-frequency spaces. Firstly, this article uses the wavelet analysis method, decomposes a group of original traffic flow signals containing summarized information into series of time sequence signals that have different characters, then makes use of good linear fitting ability of the ARIMA model processes the wavelet analysis time signal through the ARIMA model. Using matlab and SPSS, the measured traffic flow data were analyzed verified. Experiment results show that the way of combining the wavelet analysis with ARIMA model can reduce the prediction error effectively, and improve the forecasting accuracy by about 80%, this way has high feasibility.

articleTitle: A point cloud segmentation method based on vector estimation and color clustering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For automatic processing of point clouds, the segmentation is a key but difficult step. Many researchers have tried to develop segmentation methods including edge-based segmentation, surface-based segmentation and color-based segmentation, and so on. In this paper, we present a point data segmentation method based on normal vector estimation and color clustering. The main workflow of this method is made by calculating point normal vector, transforming vector into color, clustering color point and segmenting the raw points set at last. The proposed method combined the advantage of geo-metrical segmentation and color-metrical segmentation. It has been applied to LiDAR point data obtained by ALS (airborne laser scanner), the experiment result show that the segmentation method is promising.

articleTitle: Web services clustering using SOM based on kernel cosine similarity measure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: with the rapid growth of Web services and the need of quickly finding the right services, automatically clustering Web services becomes exceedingly important and challenging. The performance of Web services clustering relies closely on services representation, the similarity measure, and the clustering algorithm. This paper first presents a WordNet-VSM (W-VSM) model for Web services representation which not only enriches the conventional VSM feature vectors' semantic information but also reduce their dimension and sparsity. Then a set of kernel cosine similarity measures are proposed to well estimate the similarity of the Web services. Furthermore, an unsupervised SOM neural network algorithm based on aforementioned kernel cosine similarity measure (KCSOM) is presented to automatically cluster Web services. Finally, the preliminary experiments using real-world Web services demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Inspection of rail surface defect based on machine vision system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An inspection system based machine vision technique for rail surface defects is presented. Automatic detection of noised cracks on surface is analyzed by means of image processing. Image enhancement, denoising and feature extraction are applied in processing the images of track. The region of defect is extracted on the adaptive threshold. Based on morphology of cracks, dynamic template is designed to detect continuous crack boundary, and then length of cracks can be estimated.

articleTitle: Cost-efficiency code generation approach of software pipelining for FPGA architectures
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software pipelining is an optimization algorithm, which is unrolling iteration to improve the executive efficiency by loop-unrolled technology. As the loop is unrolled by more times, we will get large bigger codes that we need the hardware resource sharply increased. To solve the problem which needs large hardware resource because of unrolling the loop, we propose a new approach which is reconstructing state to share state resource and establishing the finite state machine model of software pipelining. It is the cost-efficiency code generation approach of software pipelining. The model can fulfill to reuse hardware resource and need less hardware resource by using the FSM to control the reusing of kernel codes of the pipelining technology.

articleTitle: An empirical research of the forming process of Firm inter-organizational e-business capability: Based on the supply chain processes
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the supply chain, the forming process of firm inter-organizational e-business capability has already become the key problem focused by enterprises and academic circles. From the research perspective “firms' collaboration”, this paper, combining with the theory of RBV and with e-commerce process view, demonstrates the forming mechanism of firm inter-organizational e-business capability in up-stream and down-stream. We find that the integration of IT resources is the base of the creation of e-business capability and the internal e-business capability promotes the creation of e-business capabilities in supply chain processes. This study is expected to help managers in planning internal and external resources and make contributions to the research perspective on e-business capability.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of transmitting and interchanging medical information based on HL7
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Objective To research and implement transmitting, interchanging and sharing medical information. Methods By parsing HL7 message structure, using HAPI as supportive toolkit and based on object-oriented programming, HL7 Client and HL7 Server are constructed through adopting C/S mode to accomplish transmitting and interchanging HL7 medical information and high degree of sharing medical information. Results Lots of HL7 messages are tested by transmission test, all of which can achieve sharing patient demographic, laboratory analysis and other relative therapy information. Conclusion Constructed HL7 client and HL7 server can fully meet the demand, which not only enhance efficiency for physicians to diagnose patients and strengthen the construction of hospital medical digitalization, but also support telemedicine and regional healthcare with auxiliary.

articleTitle: The study of MovingTarget tracking based on Kalman-CamShift in the video
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the process of target tracking, the direction and velocity information of the target is not used in CamShift algorithm so that the tracking is always failed when the target is covered or rotated, while Kalman filter can predict velocity and position of target accurately. For this reason, the paper proposed a novel approach combining CamShift algorithm with Kalman filter for moving target tracking. Firstly, use Kalman filter to predict the possible position of the target in the next frame, and then search and match the target in the corresponding areas using CamShift algorithm. The approach reduces the calculation work greatly because of the smaller searching area. It has a reliable tracking. When the target is rotated or covered, we can also get a well tracking result and the tracking is reliable. The experiment shows that the approach is effective and accurate.

articleTitle: Citrus canker detection based on leaf images analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Citrus canker is a quarantine disease which may cause huge damage to citrus production. Effective and fast disease detection methods must be undertaken to minimize the losses of citrus canker infection. In this paper, a new approach is presented to detect citrus canker from leaf images collected in field. Firstly, a global canker lesion descriptor is used to detect citrus diseased-lesion from leaf-background. Then a zone-based combined local descriptor is proposed to identify citrus canker disease from other similar diseased-lesions. Thirdly, a two-level hierarchical detection structure is developed to identify the canker lesion and AdaBoost is adopted in feature selection and classifier learning. Finally, evaluation of the proposed method and its comparison with other approaches are discussed, and the experimental results shows that the proposed approach achieves similar classification accuracy of human experts.

articleTitle: Research on ranging accuracy based on RSSI of wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RSSI ranging technology is a low-cost distance measurement technique, featuring on low communication overhead and low implementation complexity, it's very important to wireless sensor network with limited power. We analyze the theory of ranging based on RSSI, and designed the ranging experiment with the chip of CC2430, proposed the approach that beacon nodes determine the parameters and Gaussian fitting ascertain the value of the RSSI measurements ranging. Experiments show that the method can improve anti-interference ability, 20 meters ranging precision can reach 1.5 meters.

articleTitle: A novel UWB Wilkinson power divider
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A novel UWB power divider formed by installing one overlapped butterfly radial stub on each branch is proposed. Such structure makes branch line shorter and circuit's size smaller compares to power divider with single radial stub. It's also achieved a compact size of 18 mm by 16 mm. The simulation and measurement results of the UWB power divider are presented and shown good agreement.

articleTitle: Sensorless speed control of the switched reluctance motor using extended Kalman filter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is important to use non position sensor controlling strategy to improve the performance of switched reluctance drive system. A novel method that estimates the speed and rotor of switched reluctance motor using extended Kalman filter is introduced. By the algorithm and method, the non position sensor controlling strategy of switched reluctance motor is realized. The simulated results show that the method has better forecast, emendation, as well as precise track of position and speed of switched reluctance motor. In addition, the method can solve the problem of system parameter variation and system interfere, and measure the effect of observed interfere.

articleTitle: Research of MMSE and LS channel estimation in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) technique has received a lot of interest in mobile communication research lately. For wideband mobile communication systems, the radio channel is usually frequency selective and time variant. Hereafter, in OFDM systems, the channel transfer function of radio channel appears unequal in both frequency and time domains. Therefore, a dynamic estimation of the channel is necessary for the demodulation of OFDM signals. The channel estimation methods for OFDM systems based on pilot-aided are investigated. In view of the contradiction of LS and MMSE estimators between performance and computational complexity, two simplified estimator for LS and MMSE were presented. The simulation results show that the LS estimator algorithm has preferable performance and lower complexity. The simulation results also show that comparing to the LS channel estimation algorithm, the MMSE estimate of pilot signals algorithm provides better performance and requires reduce the computations.

articleTitle: Study on design and maintenance methods of CIM-based spatial database for distribution network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As CIM subset, GIS data model of distribution grid was constructed by the relevant classes and relationships which were extracted from the CIM packages. The packages include Core, Topology, Wires, Meas, et al. Meanwhile, the spatial data exchange model of distribution network was discussed in this paper. Relational database technologies were applied to implement the spatial database, and generalization, aggregation and association relationships were converted to the relations of primary key and foreign key. The generalization mapping methods proposed by this paper can avoid the relationships of total model to fall on the leaf nodes, and then lower the relation's complexity among objects. Using object-oriented technology, the classes of GIS data model were extended by adding operations (Create, Update, Delete and GetProperties) and the necessary attributes. The above operations were utilized to generate commands which can maintain the data and relationships of spatial database. The Mount and Unmount operations were added to ConductingEquipment class, which can establish topological maintenance commands to maintain electrical relationships of conducting equipment. The approaches of class extending adopted by this paper make objects have responsibilities to sustain distribution network topology, and then cut down the maintenance difficulties of spatial database.

articleTitle: Modeling of rock structural plane destabilizing process based on cellular automata
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to model rock mass fracturing and destabilizing along various structural planes, in this paper, a cellular automata (CA) model is set up, and a CA evolution algorithm mainly considering energy propagation is developed. A computing program is put forward on Matlab, the evolution process of rock structural plane fracturing and destabilizing is studied, which shows the complexity of rock structural plane destabilizing process.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm based on AdaBoost for vehicle recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An Improved algorithm based on AdaBoost is proposed to solve the problem of much time consumed for training AdaBoost classifier as well as the problem of performance and storage space based on SVM (Support Vector Machines) and NN (Neural Networks) classifiers in vehicle recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach has better performance than the traditional methods and has less time consuming in training process than traditional AdaBoost algorithm and shows promising perspective.

articleTitle: Implementation of GSM SMS remote control system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A design of a GSM SMS(Short Message Service) remote appliance control system based on FPGA is completed in this paper. The paper based on the original telephone remote control system, mainly designs a remote appliance control system using the GSM SMS to finally achieve the dual-mode control of phone and SMS control, which makes the remote appliance control system more perfect. As the control core, FPGA enables this system to be nimble to dispose and have an extended function. The main works completed in this paper include hardware module design (GSM SMS module, RS232 interface module, and the temperature monitor module), FPGA logic design, and system board-level verification. The testing result indicates that the designed long-distance electrical control system meets the designing goal and has application potential.

articleTitle: PAPR reduction of uplink for carrier aggregation in LTE-Advanced
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Carrier aggregation is one technique in LTE-A system can extend the bandwidth up to 100MHz and increase the downlink and uplink spectral efficiency. In particular N-x-SC-FDMA has been agreed as the uplink bandwidth extension scheme. Nevertheless, the PAPR remains an important issue for a UE because it determines the PA efficiency and equivalently the coverage when multi-carrier transmission is employed. The LTE-A system seems as LTE when only one component carrier has been aggregated. Several scenarios of different component carriers for carrier aggregation has been analyzed by a combined method, and the simulation results show that the performance of PAPR improved 2dB approximately.

articleTitle: A research paper recommender system based on spreading activation model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the progress of digital technology and the development of the web, digital library need to provide on-line services to meet the diversified demands of individual patrons and to offer more personalized services. A personalized research paper recommender system is proposed in this paper. It constructs user profile based on concept tree to overcome the drawbacks of the traditional vector space model. A spreading activation model is employed to search for user community with similar interests. Finally, its accuracy and availability is verified based on data extracted from the database of National Science and Technology Library.

articleTitle: Point cloud segmentation through spectral clustering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Spectral clustering is a powerful technique in data analysis. We extend the spectral clustering method to point cloud segmentation. By connecting each point with its neighbors and assigning the edge a weight that describes the similarity, the point cloud can be represented as a graph. Then segmentation problem can be turned into a graph min-cut problem, which is NP hard. If we cut this graph into p parts, spectral clustering provides a relaxed solution in space R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n×p</sup>. A novel approach is presented to find the neighbors of a point in the point cloud, which is adaptive to the sampling density of point cloud and is more accurate than the k-nearest neighbors on close-by surface sheets. A bilateral filter is used to guarantee that only the close points with similar normal directions having high weights. By removing redundant eigenvectors from the spectral domain, the segmentation solution is found in a lower dimensional space. We prove that this method is theoretically reasonable and experimental results show the efficiency.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of induction motor based on chaotic ant swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Chaotic ant swarm algorithm is a novel optimization method, which has the ability of global optimum search. This paper proposes a new parameter estimation method for induction motor based on chaotic ant swarm algorithm. The problem of induction motor parameter estimation is converted to a problem of parameter optimization which could be solved via chaotic ant swarm algorithm. A numerical simulation on the test motor is conducted. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective in parameter estimation of the induction motor.

articleTitle: A new streetlight monitoring system based on wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a remote streetlight monitoring system based on wireless sensor network. The system can be set to run in automatic mode, which control streetlight according to Sunrise and Sunset Algorithm and light intensity. This control can make a reasonable adjustment according to the latitude, longitude and seasonal variation. Also this system can run in controlled mode. In this mode, we can take the initiative to control streetlights through PC monitor terminal. In addition, the system integrates a digital temperature-humidity sensor, not only monitoring the streetlight Real-time but also temperature and humidity. The system is equipped with the high-power relay output and can be widely applied in all places which need timely control such as streets, stations, mining, schools, and electricity sectors and so on.

articleTitle: A research on the deployment of sensors in Underwater Acoustic Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The coverage and connectivity are important standards of the sensor deployment strategies in Underwater Acoustic Wireless Sensor Networks(UWSNs). In this paper, we mainly research on the deployment of underwater sensors in UWSNs. The advantages and disadvantages of some existing algorithms are analysed and an improved algorithm is provided, which can achieve the complete coverage and connectivity. Further more, combining with the problem of localization, we deliberate a new deployment programme, which is of complete coverage and connectivity, localization available and scalable. We measure the performance of the programme by extensive simulations using the OPNET network simulator.

articleTitle: Gas concentration detection using ultrasonic based on wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this article, a low power consumption wireless sensor for binary gas mixtures real-time quantitative analysis is presented. This small size wireless gas sensor, which is developed based on an improved time-of-flight (TOF) method, can evaluate target gas in gas mixtures with high resolution. And the wireless sensor network system reduce power consumption using a power control IEEE802.15.4 standard, which can provide an effective mechanism for improving energy efficiency by decreasing the transmitting power directly. In contrast with some other gas analysis techniques, it avoids the problem of the secondary pollution and the short sensor life of using chemic sensor, and the high power consumption problem of traditional TOF methods, makes ultrasonic wireless gas sensor available. Currently, this gas quantitative analysis system consists of several Wireless Ultrasonic Gas Sensor nodes (WUGS) and a master node. The WUGS hardware consists of a microcontroller for obtaining measuring data from the ultrasonic channel, and a Zigbee transceiver for transmitting the data sets to a master sensor node. Furthermore, an environmental monitoring chamber was designed for testing this WUGS using sulfur hexafluoride (SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>) and hydrogen (H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) mixed with air respectively. The resolutions of the tests were within 30µV/V and 500µV/V, respectively. The power cost of the WUGS during the detection period is lower than 90mW. The main advantages of this gas concentration measurement are high accuracy to the gas of which molecular weight is different largely from air, low power consumption and ease of network setup. The sensors have shown good stability for more than three months in a high-voltage substation, for an SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> leak alarm system test.

articleTitle: Novel CMOS static ternary logic using double pass-transistor logic
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new static ternary double pass-transistor logic (TDPL) has been developed with some favourable properties: perfectly symmetrical structure, full logic swing and the maximum possible noise margins, the use of the standard CMOS process without any modification of the thresholds, the less complex structure, and no static power consumption. The proposed scheme consists of complementary inputs/outputs and is thus a dual rail ternary logic. HSPICE simulations using 0.3µm CMOS technology and a 3V power supply demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design approach.

articleTitle: The design of E-commerce system architecture based on Struts2, Spring and Hibernate
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Combined with the latest developments of Java open source framework, a lightweight multi-level E-commerce system architecture based on Struts2, Spring and Hibernate has been designed in this paper, and the three frameworks' integration methods and strategies have been discussed as well. The MVC (Model/View/Controller) design pattern of Struts2, the IoC (Inversion of Control) management of Spring and the O/R (Object/Relation) mapping function have been adopted comprehensively in this architecture.

articleTitle: Design of an experimental indoor position system based on RSSI
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, although the position theory and algorithm of WSN(Wireless Sensor Network) have been widely researched, however, the real application of WSN position technology is just on the initial stage, in response to which, this paper designs an indoor experimental position system based on RSSI, which selects trilateral ranging method as position method and utilizes CC2510 chip as wireless node. Meanwhile, this paper designs an experimental model for implementation. In the end, this paper analyzes the experiment data and proposes several suggestions for future work, such as improving position algorithm, which is quite meaningful for further research. Moreover, the result of the experiment shows that the absolute error is around 2 meters, which demonstrates that this system has a high degree of accuracy.

articleTitle: A fast super-resolution algorithm with despeckling for multi-frame sonar images
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To obtain a high-resolution sonar image from a set of shifted and decimated low-resolution sonar images, a fast super-resolution algorithm with despeckling is proposed in this paper. According to the sonar imaging model, low-resolution images can be viewed as speckled and downsampled versions of the high-resolution image. Based on L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> norm minimization, original high-resolution sonar image can be obtained by non-iterative data fusion. Then the high-resolution sonar image is despeckled in Curvelet domain to get the final high-resolution image. Without iterative operation, the proposed algorithm is fast. Final simulation results indicate that the proposed algorithm is superior to other super-resolution methods.

articleTitle: An ultra-low input voltage DC-DC boost converter for micro-energy harvesting system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present a special ultra-low start-up voltage DC-DC boost converter that allows it to boost input voltage as low as 40mV to provide multiple regulated output voltages (4.1V and 5V) for low power wireless sensors applications by adopting different ratio of transformer and connection modes. Furthermore, the measured prototype can successfully drive a wireless humiture sensor node load when the humiture sensor transmits signal.

articleTitle: Digital mine design based on Data Warehouse and GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The theories and technologies involved in digital mine are the forelands of current information technology development. How to effectively integrate the “technical” and “commercial” systems is the key point that concerned the sustainable development and standardized management in mining industry. Based on the existing mining information, we propose a six layer digital mine model, which is composed of Positioning, Sensing, Condition Monitoring and Control System, Network/Telecommunication Platform, Data Acquisition Platform, Data Warehouse Platform, Application/Analysis Platform, Mine Enterprise Information Portal. The illumination of its main framework and detailed discussion of its certain key points of the system, such as Data Acquisition, Data Warehouse, Data Application/Analysis, are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Wireless sensor networks for forest environmental monitoring
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we present an in-depth science-centric 20-day wireless sensor network deployment at Purple Mountain area, a forest located near city of Nanjing, for real-world forest environmental surveillance. A micro monitoring system is developed which cover the node hardware design, sensor network layout, and the capabilities for remote data access and analysis. The currently network consists 18 nodes deployed in two areas within Purple Mountain area flowing forest surveillance information into a database. This application serves for further work in a new means to monitor forest environmental using this wireless sensor networks (WSN) technology.

articleTitle: Implementation of DTTB LDPC encoder based on FPGA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: QC-LDPC code is used as the inner channel code in DTTB. In this paper, FPGA implementation of QC-LDPC code based on SRAA is introduced according to the features of QC-LDPC generator matrix. At the same time, the results are verified in the Altera Stratix device.

articleTitle: Effective keyword search for High Frequency LCAs over XML documents
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of effective keyword search over XML documents. We begin by introducing the notion of HFLCA(High Frequency Lowest Common Ancestor) to accurately and effectively answer keyword queries over XML documents by the meaningful trees rooted as HFLCA. Then, with the help of the DTD document, we propose an optimization strategy for speeding up the computation. We have conducted an extensive experimental study and the experimental result show that our proposed approach archives both high efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for license plate recognition based on improved edge detection and Mathematical morphology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the advantages and disadvantages of current vehicle license plate location algorithms. To problems of inaccurating in Location of the vehicle plate, a method of image segmentation and extraction based on improved edge detection and Mathematical morphology was presented. In the first place, a series of color images were changed into gray images, secondly, through calculates the difference of each pixel and neighborhood pixels to buildup images' edge, and it can make the license plate stand out; once again, by adding the original image of the the results map which enhanced edge image, and it uses Sobel operator to extract the edge of objects in image; then the algorithm applies the dilation and erosion mathematical morphology of binary images to get the the image smooth contour; finally, from locating the position area alignment in the X and Y directions to locating license plates, meanwhile, using the median filter and the dilation and erosion mathematical morphology, and template matching algorithm to recognize the license plate character. Because of the accuracy of the plate region extraction, the character can be extracted exactly from the plate region. It can improve the accuracy rate of the characters recognition. From the results of simulation, it is found that the new method proposed in this thesis is efficient.

articleTitle: Research on BP algorithm based on conjugate gradient
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper uses the conjugate gradient method to optimize the calculation and achieve rapid calculation on the network weights and thresholds, simulates the traditional gradient descent and conjugate gradient algorithm of BP neural network, and discusses the training speed, fault-tolerant generalization ability of the method. The goal is to variously verify the superiority of conjugate gradient algorithm. The simulation results highlight the substantial increase in training speed. In particular, for the generalization ability of damaged network after training, using linear regression method to simulate can also obtain satisfaction result, which supports the conjugate gradient BP algorithm from the new angle.

articleTitle: Geometric process analysis of a two-unit series system with repairman vacation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies a two-dissimilar-unit series system with single repairman vacation. It is assumed that the working time of the two units obeys exponential distributions, and the repair time and the vacation time obey general distributions. And it is also assumed that unit 2 after repair is as good as new while unit 1 after repair is not. By using geometric process, the method of supplementary variable and Laplace transform, some main reliability indices of the system are obtained which contain the availability, the reliability and the asymptotic failure frequency of the system, along with the idle and the off probability of the repairman.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral data classification via sparse representation in homotopy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Sparse representation has significant success in many fields such as signal compression and reconstruction but to the best of our knowledge, no sparse-based classification solution has been proposed in the field of remote sensing. One of the reasons is that the general optimizers are extremely slow, time consuming and needs intensive processing for l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-minimization sparse representation. In this paper, we propose a fast sparse representation using l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>-minimization based on homotopy for the classification of hyperspectral data. This method is based on the observation that a test sample can be represented by train samples from a pool of large number of train samples i.e the sparse representation. Hence the sparse representation for each test sample is achieved by the linear combination of the train samples. This proposed method has the advantages that learning on the training samples is not required, both model selection and parameter estimation are not needed, and low computational load, by which a bagging algorithm is introduced to increase the classification accuracy via voting. A real hyperspectral dataset (AVIRIS 1992 Indiana's Indian Pines image) is used to measure the performance of the proposed algorithm. We compared the accuracy results with state-of-the-art SVM and general purpose linear programming solvers. We also presented a time comparison between our approach and general LP solvers. The comparisons prove the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A niche genetic algorithm with population migration strategy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A niche genetic algorithm with population migration strategy (PMGA) is proposed in this paper in order to solve the multi-modal function optimization problem. This algorithm draws lessons from the migration phenomenon of human society. Through analyzing the validity of using PMGA to solve the multi-modal function optimization problem, testing three standardized one-dimensional multi-modal functions and comparing the experimental data of the PMGA with the data of relevant literatures' algorithms, we finally validate that the PMGA proposed in this paper has advantages in precision of calculation and maintenance of population's diversity.

articleTitle: Extended Euclid algorithm and its application in RSA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: RSA, which based on the great difficulty of integer factorization, is the most widely-used public-key cryptosystem used in electronic commerce. Euclid algorithm and extended Euclid algorithm are the best algorithms to solve the public key and private key in RSA. Extended Euclid algorithm in IEEE P1363 is improved by eliminating the negative integer operation, which reduces the computing resources occupied by RSA, hence has an important application value.

articleTitle: Simulation research of crime scene based on UDK
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The sence simulation is an important part of virtual reality system, it provides powerful methods support to the research of forensic science. First, we research the mainstream virtual engine and choose the UDK (Unreal Development Kit) for simulation, which is fully functional and easy to be used. Then, the prototype system of three-dimensional reconstruction for crime scene was established. The flow of virtual reality simulation, scene management, model and texture were discussed. Finally, this paper takes murder case as an example and finds a solution for the problem of scene investigation and reconstruction, which can promote the development of criminal technology, observe the crime scene from Multi-angle and improve the efficiency and the accuracy of judgment.

articleTitle: Research on SEO strategies of university journal websites
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: University Journals are an important platform for universities' resource sharing and management, so far the construction of University Journal Websites developed rapidly. After the establishment of the sites, University Journals facing the problem of how to promote the sites, and search engine promotion is a good choice. But then we should consider how to do search engine optimization(SEO). In this paper, consindering the features of university journal websites, doing the SEO strategies from those aspects: directory structure, keyword strategy, URL pseudo-static, code optimization and inbound links.

articleTitle: Analytical model for intrinsic carrier concentration in (101)-biaxially strained Si
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By analyzing the band structure of strained Si/(101) Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>, the relationship of whose intrinsic carrier concentration (ni) between Ge fraction (x) and temperature were obtained. And then, the model for the intrinsic carrier concentration of strained Si/(101) Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> was established. The results show that increases significantly due to the effect of the strain in strained Si/(101)Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>, the density of state effective masses decrease with increasing Ge fraction (x), and is directly proportional to temperature.

articleTitle: Design of GPS data acquisition and processing system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the problem that GPS output information is much larger than the practical needed, the data acquisition and processing system based on FPGA+GPS+FLASH was opposed. FPGA simulates UART port, acquiring and abstracting the GPS latitude, longitude, altitude and velocity, simultaneity, store data in real time by use of FLASH. The corresponding experiment shows that the system can quickly and accurately transfer, acquire and store GPS data; it is strongly suitable for various platforms of storage-type integrated measurement systems.

articleTitle: Implementation of FIR filter on FPGA using DAOBC algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper present circuit architecture for 16-order FIR filter on FPGA. First, It introduce the principle of Distributed Arithmetic (DA) and DA-Offset Binary Coding (DA-OBC). Second, The circuit design of FIR low-pass filter base on DA-OBC algorithm is proposed and synthesized under the integrated environment of maxplus 2. The simulation results shows that the implementation works well and meets requirements.

articleTitle: The image process technologies in face recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Biological characteristic recognition is a kind of identification technology that used the human's special physiology or behavior characteristic. It provided a kind of high reliability, good stability approach to identity appreciation. Face recognition is very popular branch of the biological characteristic recognition. And also is a very active subject in the fields of the computer vision and the pattern recognition. This paper divided face recognition system into modules, and introduced the functions of each module in detail, mainly introduced the image preprocessing module, including facial image graying, facial image histogram equalization, facial image enhancement, and the facial image binarization etc. The image pre-processing module plays a crucial role in the face recognition system and the results of image preprocessing directly affect on the face identification.

articleTitle: Illumination invariant color model selection based on genetic algorithm in robot soccer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present a new approach to color recognition which is used in semi-autonomous robot soccer. Firstly, the new illumination invariant color space is defined based on the dichromatic reflection model. Secondly, we determine the most discriminating color model among a multidimensional set of color models by means of the genetic algorithm. Finally, we make use of the Gaussian model method for image segmentation. We successfully apply our new approach to semi-autonomous robot soccer game for the robot recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves the high object recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: A hybrid PSO/ACO algorithm for land cover classification
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For several decades the remote sensing image classification methods for depicting land cover have gained a great achievements, but with the more multi-source and multidimensional data, the conventional remote sensing image classification methods based on statistical theory have exposed some limitation. So in recent years, artificial intelligence techniques have being applied to remote sensing image classification, the purpose of which is to reduce the undesired limitations of the conventional classification methods. Ant colony optimization (ACO) and Particle swarm optimization (PSO) as the two main algorithms of swarm intelligence, and because of the self-organization, cooperation, communication and other intelligent merits, they have great potential in remote sensing image processing. This paper introduces remotely sensed image classification using the hybrid ACO/PSO algorithm. The experiment results show that ACO/PSO algorithm has provided a new method for remote sensing image classification.

articleTitle: A lower complexity QRD-M algorithm based on VBLAST for MIMO-OFDM systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a lower complexity QRD-M algorithm based on VBLAST for MIMO-OFDM systems. The proposed algorithm (SQOC) firstly uses the sorted QR decomposition (SQRD), then chooses a center point and its neighboring points for candidate points by looking up the points table, combining with the ordered serial interference cancellation (OSIC) for selecting the survival points. The proposed algorithm can significantly reduce the complexity comparing with the conventional QRD-M algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves the performance nearing to the Maximum likelihood detection (MLD) algorithm, obtaining a better tradeoff between complexity and performance, and is convenient for hardware implementation.

articleTitle: The research of method of short-term traffic flow forecast based on GA-BP neural network and chaos theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and precision of short-term traffic flow forecast, for the traditional BP neural network that has such shortcomings as slow convergent speed and easy convergence to the local minimum points, this paper adopts genetic algorithm to optimize BP network structure and sets up a forecast method combining chaos theory with neural network, and the methods of traffic flow forecast based on chaos theory and neural network theory are researched. According to the results of forecasting research of actual traffic flow data by adopting chaos BP neural network forecast method and chaos GA-BP neural network forecast method, it is effective to apply chaos neural network forecast algorithm to short-term traffic flow forecast and improved chaos GA-BP neural network forecast algorithm can improve the precision and timeliness of short-term traffic flow forecast.

articleTitle: Fuzzy analysis of color images of fruits
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an efficient automatic analysis of fruits using fuzzy logic in a rule-based expert system. The analysis is based on digital images of a large number of fruits taken on an assembly line before packaging. The approach consists of two steps: (i) preprocessing to calculate the key indicators (color, texture, and size), and (ii) fuzzy processing of rules provided by the experts concerning how fruits are picked. The application is given in accessing the quality of cherries that is used in the determination of prices and the export destination.

articleTitle: Real-time temperature monitoring system for High Voltage Switchgear based on infrared wireless transmission
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the temperature real-time monitoring system for High Voltage Switchgear (HVS) was introduced. Applying contact measuring method, the temperature of switch contacts were directly measured by digital temperature sensors. The power supply for data acquisition and processing was provided via the current transformer of bus bars in HVS, and the wireless transmission was solved through infrared wireless technology to guarantee the voltage isolation between the high and the low potential. At the same time, structure and functionality of the system were described as well as hardware and software design in the paper, and the experiment result was presented finally. The system enables real-time temperature measurement and display, temperature rise analysis and alarm. It was provided the system have low power dissipation, convenient installation, high accuracy and strong anti electromagnetic capability by experiment.

Author Keywords: the voltage isolation between the high and the low potential.

articleTitle: Certificate-based blind signatures from bilinear pairings
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Certificate-based public key cryptography was introduced to remove the use of certificate to ensure the authentication of the user's public key in the traditional public key cryptography and to overcome the key escrow problem in the identity-based public key cryptography. Blind signature has the anonymity and plays a central role in applications such as electronic voting and electronic cash systems. Combining the concept of certificate-based cryptography with the concept of blind signature, in this paper, we propose an efficient certificate-based blind signature scheme assuming the hardness of Computational Diffie-Hellman Problem.

articleTitle: Extract the aluminum alloy MIG welding pool edge with Otsu threshold selection based on the genetic algorithmic
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is one of the important methods to detect the image edge of the molten bath for gain the characteristic information including the maximum width of molten bath, the half length of the molten bath and the rear angle of the molten bath etc. It is one of the important methods to achieve automatic control for welding process that the visual sensing technology is used to gain the pictorial information of molten bath and make processing. This paper introduced the structure of experimental system and algorithm, uses the Otsu to realize the detection of aluminum alloy MIG welding molten bath edge, and compared with the Sobel operator and the Canny operator molten bath edge detection result, the experimental result indicated that it is completely feasible using genetic algorithmic to realize the detection of welding pool edge based on threshold value selection, and the molten bath edge information obtained is smooth, continual, without the break point and the noise.

articleTitle: An area-efficient IDCT architecture for multiple video standards
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a unified 1-D IDCT architecture for a video decoder supporting multiple standards including AVS, VC-1, MPEG-4 and H.264. The low-cost architecture is implemented by the method of matrix decomposition and sharing resources such as adders and shifters as far as possible. We make use of the coefficients in AVS and VC-1 to reduce the complexity of IDCT based on MPEG-4 greatly. And multipliers are replaced by shifters and adders, which are much more area-efficient. Researching on the relationship of coefficients among AVS, VC-1, and MPEG-4, we propose a low-cost hardware sharing architectures requiring lower hardware cost than that of the individual and separate implementations.

articleTitle: Group purchase: A win-win combination of social networking services with e-commerce typical representative—Nuomi.com
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As a new shopping way, group purchase have rapid development in China during the first half of 2010. In this paper, Porter Forces Model and SWOT tools are used to analyze the model of current mainstream group-purchase network combining SNS, and the role of SNS networks is described in detail in group-purchase mode. Finally, taking the first group-purchase network- Nuomi.com combining SNS with e-commerce as an example, group purchase's operation situations is discussed.

articleTitle: Research about improvement of LEACH protocol
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studied the typical clustering Routing Protocol-LEACH protocol, analysed its deficiencies and proposed improved ideas. N-LEACH protocol improved the election process of LEACH cluster head node while the remaining energy as the basis of election cluster head node,and increased the process of choosing root node in all the cluster head nodes. It was root node that collected data then sent them to the base station,which reduced the number of cluster head node who communicated to base station, increased the energy efficiency, extended wireless sensor networks' lifetime.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research of Floating-Point Exceptions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article analyzes the definition of exceptions in IEEE STD 754 and specific implementation standards of them from the perspective of circuit design. Besides, handling principles and methods of exceptions in different floating-point operations are proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Detecting faults in technical indicator computations for financial market analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many financial trading and charting software packages provide users with technical indicators to analyze and predict price movements in financial markets. Any computation fault in technical indicator may lead to wrong trading decisions and cause substantial financial losses. Testing is a major software engineering activity to detect computation faults in software. However, there are two problems in testing technical indicators in these software packages. Firstly, the indicator values are updated with real-time market data that cannot be generated arbitrarily. Secondly, technical indicators are computed based on a large amount of market data. Thus, it is extremely difficult, if not impossible, to derive the expected indicator values to check the correctness of the computed indicator values. In this paper, we address the above problems by proposing a new testing technique to detect faults in computation of technical indicators. We show that the proposed technique is effective in detecting computation faults in faulty technical indicators on the MetaTrader 4 Client Terminal.

articleTitle: Design and application of a new IOT reader
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The application of the Internet of things (IOT) in industry and mining enterprises is analyzed in this paper. A new type of IOT application layer reader with functions of RFID and data transfer by wireless sensor is designed, according to the characteristics of the Internet things of industry and mining enterprises. This reader can perceive information from people, machine and environment of industry and mining enterprises. Hardware structures, system composition and the main characteristics of the reader is described and analyzed, which lays the foundation for the application of IOT in industry and mining enterprises and obtains good results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fuzzy PID controller's application in constant pressure water supply system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By introduction multi-level control of pumps and variable-frequency speed governing of constant pressure water supply (CPWS), this paper provided a method to prove the precision and reliability of control system of the “Constant pressure water supply with changing load in large range” system. A adaptive FUZZY-PID controller is designed to against the characteristics like multi-parameters, nonlinear, big delay, etc. of CPWS. The controller can effectively adjust the water pressure of the system. The System has strong robustness and good stability by applying the fuzzy controller. The practical operation result has verified the validity and feasibility of the methods proposed

articleTitle: A location-aware recommender system for Tourism mobile commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With rapid development of the mobile commerce, exploring new applications and services for mobile environments has become a hot topic. In this paper we propose a location-aware recommender system for tourism mobile commerce service platform. Specifically, we integrate GPS into the recommender system to create a location-aware recommender system. The location-aware recommender system can recommend attractions to the customer with the customer's rating of attractions and the customer's sensitivity to location. We present the constructed approaches in this paper.

articleTitle: Concordance measures of a new class of bivariate Copula
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We study the concordance measures Kendall's σ and Spearman's ρ of a new class of bivariate Copulas. Taking the relief factors of debris flow of drainage height difference and cutting degree for the example, we calculate the concordance measures σ and ρ of the two relief factors, with the relationship of them can be better prepared to that of the new class of Copulas. Furthermore, the value ranges of σ and ρ in the values of the four parameters are discussed to set out a few specific Copulas, which can be better fitting to the dependence structure of drainage height difference and cutting degree.

articleTitle: Analysis for the composition of information flow security properties on Petri net
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The analysis and verification of complex systems are often encountered by researchers. The best way of solving this problem is using some simple or small systems to compose the complex system and the characters will be preserved. However, because the definition of information flow security properties are based on different semantic model, it is difficult to carry out a systematic discussion of composition. We analysis three security properties which have been defined on the unified model of Petri net and give the conditions in which the property will not be changed. And we give the proof of these conclusions. Because there are too many compositions for Petri net, the task will be huge if researchers discuss each of them. Therefore, we put these compositions under a unified framework which can improve efficiency. In this framework, the compositions of Petri net are classified into two types and the conditions which can keep the security properties of original net are given.

articleTitle: ECG signal base line filtering and power interference suppression method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: ECG signal is non-stationary, base line drift and power interference are the important factors influencing ECG signal extraction in high accuracy and directly determine the accuracy of ECG signal extraction and performance of analyzing and processing ECG signal. Adaptive filtering method can realize effective extraction of non-stationary signals without knowing a priori knowledge about signal and noise, this paper presents an adaptive noise cancellation system for ECG signal base line filtering and power interference suppression, constructs an iterative time LMS algorithm combining variable and fixed step size, which effectively solves the problems of filtering SNR and convergence rate. The experiment results show that this method improves 26.36dB in SNR, eliminates base line drift and power interference effectively, extracts ECG signal accurately and converges quickly, has important practical value in medical clinical diagnosis.

articleTitle: An adaptive BCI system for virtual navigation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A brain computer interface (BCI) builds an additional pathway between the brain and external devices. This paper introduces a BCI system combined with virtual reality (VR) technology that allows users to navigate in the virtual apartment by motor imagery. Since performance in online sessions is sometimes found to decrease due to non-stationarity of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, we proposed a method based on adaptive probabilistic neural network (APNN) to overcome this phenomenon. Online experiments were carried out using the BCI system and offline analysis was conducted to make a comparison among different methods. Online results demonstrated that most subjects were able to perform well on the system, and offline analysis showed that the APNN was comparatively predominant.

articleTitle: FFT-based matching pursuit implementation on CUDA platform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Matching pursuit adaptively decomposes signals in a redundant dictionary to achieve some sub-optimal non-orthogonal sparse representations. However, due to the redundancy of the dictionary, MP is usually very time consuming. FFT-based MP implementation runs significantly faster than greedy MP implementation, yet it still may take days to decompose an image on some dictionaries with high redundancy. This paper presents an implementation of FFT-based matching pursuit algorithm on CUDA platform for sparse decomposition of images. We found that FFT based MP presents strong data parallelism, thus suited for implementing on CUDA platform and executed in a parallel way on CUDA-capable GPU devices. Experiments results show that several dozen times of speedup ratio can be easily achieved.

articleTitle: Adaptive Niche Genetic Algorithm based on gradi-optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To deal with low efficiency and low convergence speed in searching the global optimum, and only gaining several the optimum while it is used in multimode-function-optimization, an adaptive Niche Genetic Algorithm (NGA) based on gradi-optimization is proposed in this paper. The adaptive crossover operator and mutation operator are used to guarantee the population diversity, improve the global optimum search and accelerate the convergence speed. The gradi-optimization is used to improve the precision of the optimum. Simulation results in the Shubert show that this method is nice at improving on the global optimum search, convergence speed and its superiority in precision.

articleTitle: Webs ranking model based on pagerank algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the development of the PageRank algorithm both domestic and international, expounds the practical application and development of the algorithm. On this basis, the dissertation analyzes the thinking of the traditional PageRank algorithm, sums up the advantages and disadvantages, and introduces several important PageRank improved algorithms and their thinking. The paper provides a time-feedback PageRank algorithm improvement for the shortcoming of the traditional PageRank algorithm focus on the old websites. Adding a feedback factor in the traditional PageRank algorithm can accelerate the old and useless Webs sinking, the new Webs rising, and taking into account the old and important webs not sink. Implementing the PageRank value is plus or minus with the time of webs. On the basis of theoretical research, implements the rank model based on the PageRank algorithm, the model contains the traditional web ranking system model and improved web ranking system model. Experiment on this model, contrasting the experimental results. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm can improve the satisfaction of the user's search results.

articleTitle: Implementation and analysis of networking protocols for low earth orbit satellite formation network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the key IEEE 802.11 optimization techniques, which are aimed at extending the terrestrial wireless network to space to realize the communication among the satellite formation, are mainly investigated. Optimization approaches such as IEEE 802.11 inter-frame re-definitions, the integration of smart antennas with the MAC protocol and the adapting minimum contention window are proposed in this paper. Formation flying presented in this paper and the key technologies such as orbit distribution, coverage of constellation and the variable inter-satellite links are also analyzed.1

articleTitle: Research on economic models with contract management mechanism in grid
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Grid Architecture for Computational Economy (GRACE) is a model, which uses for reference the competitive market mechanism in human society to manage the resource. However, in the model, once the trade is set up, there is no way to monitor whether the seller (i.e., resource owner) has provided the services or the buyer (i.e., user) has accepted the services according to their commitment. Thus a new Grid Market Architecture based on Contract Management(CM) with According to Lower is proposed in this paper. The whole process of market transactions is constrained by CM. The components and the workflow of CM are discussed in detail in this paper. The simulation experiments show the significance of our proposed new architecture.

articleTitle: Spectral clustering algorithm based on K-nearest neighbor measure
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analysing the defect on different similarity matrix in spectral clustering, we propose a new algorithm—Spectral clustering algorithm based on K-nearest neighbor measure. The K-nearest neighbor measure focuses on using data points between the common number of nearest neighbors to measure the degree of similarity, and avoids the degree of similarity is large and unstable by contrast. The experiment results show the efficiency and performance of the algorithm. Meanwhile, the algorithm effectively resolves the problem that two data points belonging to different clusters are close. It possesses the advantage of discriminating the clusters with variable density, and also has the advantage of clustering in a sample space of any shape.

articleTitle: Application of support vector machine for identifying single corn/weed seedling in fields using shape parameters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This study is conducted to present an application of support vector machine (SVM) method and image processing techniques for corn/weed seedlings in the fields.
