The original images obtained from the field are used to be preprocessed by a space transform and image processing techniques at first. Corn seedlings or small weeds are segmented by H channel using OTSU method. We found that H channel is better to reduce the effects of illumination changes. Four shape parameters extracted from the objective are used in the recognition procedure. SVM and back-propagation neural network classifiers are employed to identify single corn/weed seedling. Experimental results show that SVM classifier gives a better classification effect. SVM method with RBF kernel function achieves the highest detection accuracy of 96.5%. Using the same testing set, back-propagation neural network classifier only gives a recognition rate 83.2%.

articleTitle: Segmentation of the breast region in mammograms using marker-controlled watershed transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Extraction of breast contour is a crucial first step in computer aided diagnosis of mammograms. It has the advantage of allowing the search for abnormalities to be limited to the region of the breast without undue influence from the background and also provides a reference for the alignment of views when two views are being compared. Breast region segmentation is difficult because of the tapering nature of the breast. This paper presents a marker-controlled watershed method for breast region segmentation on mammograms. It mainly consists of computation of the segmentation function and the internal and external markers. The segmentation function is determined on the smoothed morphological gradient image by morphological reconstruction, and markers are determined on basis of a developed Otsu method. Results are evaluated by comparison with manual borders drawn by radiologist for a set of 120 mammograms, comparing with other three segmentation methods. The mean ± std of the values of the area overlap metric for our method is 0.93 ± 0.03. The experimental results indicate that the breast regions extracted by our method accurately characterize the corresponding ground truth images.

articleTitle: Does entrepreneurship education matter students' entrepreneurial intention? a Chinese perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This research examines the impact of entrepreneurship education on entrepreneurial intention based on the mediating role of entrepreneurial self-efficacy (ESE) in the context of China. Our results indicated that entrepreneurship education has positive impact on students' entrepreneurial intention and the impact among three types of education benefits is different. Learning and inspiration has the positive impact on entrepreneurial intention through the mediating role of ESE, while incubation resources have the direct impact on entrepreneurial intention.

articleTitle: Compact ultra-wideband printed monopole antenna with a trapezoidal radiator
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A compact ultra-wideband (UWB) printed monopole antenna with a trapezoidal radiator is proposed and investigated. The size of the antenna is 15×15mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, only 0.15λ square at 3GHz. The conducting ground is defected to achieve better impedance matching over the entire UWB frequency band. The proposed antenna is fed by a 50 microstrip line. The parameters which affect the performance of the antenna are investigated and optimized values are obtained. The frequency band of the proposed antenna is 2.2GHzߝ18.4GHz for voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) less than 2, which is about 157% with respect to the center frequency of 10.3GHz. The radiation patterns of the proposed antenna are relatively stable over its operating band and the H-plane patterns are all omnidirectional.

articleTitle: AJAX-based applicable framework research and design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The browser/server mode (B/S model) has become the mainstream technology enterprise application development. It has the traits of the lower response and weaker interactivity for the both of client-side and server-side use the “request-wait-response” method to communicate. As a technique that has realized with server asynchronous communication, Ajax has successfully solved this problem to make up for the deficiency of B/S model. But Ajax development has the certain difficulty. Based on analysis of the Ajax principle foundation, this article proposes an available framework applicated in the laboratory system developing. It reduces the difficulty of development, provides the development efficiency and obtains the very good actual effect‥

articleTitle: Ground nephogram classification based on textural feature extraction and neural networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The problem of ground nephogram classification using textural feature extraction and neural networks is considered in this paper. For cloud recognition, we use feature extraction based on co-occurrence matrices, and neural network classifiers for identifying cloud types in test images. This exhaustive testing gives us a better understanding of the strengths and limitations of different feature extraction methods and classification techniques on the given problem.

articleTitle: Surface water quality forecasting based on ANN and GIS for the Chanzhi Reservoir, China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Artificial neural network (ANN) based on Arc Engine (AE) of GIS is used to predict surface water quality in the Chanzhi Reservoir, Qingdao, China. The results can reflect the water quality change trends with less than 10% average relative error. Using MS SQL Server database technology combined with Geodatabase, the system achieves the fundamental geographic information and hydrological data management, and water quality prediction. It uses GIS component technology to build an efficient and stable platform which can apply to general surface water quality prediction. This software has good information extraction and query functions to help decision-makers to manage water resource better.

articleTitle: Study and implementation of rural distribution network fault location method based on Bayesian reference
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Degree of automation in rural distribution network is very lower, so the fault location work mostly depends on analysis about trouble call information. The paper analyzes uncertain factors in trouble call information and fault inference process, applies Bayesian inference to build fault location reasoning model, design the reasoning algorithm. The algorithm is implemented in rural distribution network GIS system. Lots of simulation examples to the actual networks show that the algorithm is efficient. Bayesian reference can be used in rural distribution network's fault location.

articleTitle: A mobile tourist guide system based on mashup technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of 3G networks and the tourism industry, enriched travel information is provided on the Internet. However, a problem is shown that tourists are usually hard to get travel information timely and efficiently, when they are away from PCs (personal computers). In this paper, we propose architecture of mobile tourist guide system that is able to provide tourism information to the mobile end-users conveniently. The system takes advantage of light-weighted mashup technology that can combine more than one data sources to create value-added services, while overcomes the limitations of mobile devices. Firstly, we present the architecture of the system, and then elaborate on the main components of the mashup server. Finally, we present the communication protocols and working flow of the system in detail.

articleTitle: On practical teaching of the environmental art design and its management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Nowadays the aim of practical teaching of environmental art design is to find out an important link between environmental art design teaching and practicing, and make them promote each other with the help of theoretical instructions and practical verifications. The key task of the practical teaching reform of environment art design is to apply educational, practical, and innovative modes of teaching and management into developing and guiding students' abilities in independent practicing and creative thinking, and finally meet the aim of fostering society-oriented, creative and applied talents. Besides, based on analyses of the construction of teaching staff, the calculation method of teaching hours, and the normalization of teaching steps, this paper also points out that enhancing the management of relevant practical teaching and improving the management system of practical teaching are the only way of achieving the practical teaching goals of environmental art design subject in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on the trustworthiness of software
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of researches on trusted computing and software's trustworthiness was presented in this paper. The definition of trust was given and proposed a widely accepted definition of software's trustworthiness. And then proposed the multi-properties measurable space for the trustworthiness of software evaluation, through which the evaluation model and approaches were established.

articleTitle: Neural network predictive control of vehicle suspension
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Smooth traveling and comfort ride are the basic evaluation criterions for a ground vehicle. This paper attempts to establish the vibration control technology based on neural network predictive control, use these predicted values to determine control input to optimize the future performance of the vehicle and improve the smooth and comfort ride of vehicle. The dynamic model of vehicle suspension system is discussed, and the linear passive suspension model and nonlinear spring suspension model of the vertical acceleration are compared. Because of the great advantages of the neural network in dealing with the nonlinear property of the spring suspension system, a BP neural network predictive controller is designed and implemented to predict the vertical acceleration of the vehicle suspension system. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the neural network predictive controller with application to vehicle system.

articleTitle: A conceptual modeling approach to quality management in the context of diary supply chain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Chinese milk scandal 2008 revealed a serious problem in supply chain quality management practices. In this research, conceptual modeling approach is used to represent entities and relationships in this field. The model is expected to provide an innovative perspective to supply chain quality management. With it, intelligent system can be designed to support quality information sharing between agents in the whole milk supply chain, and real time quality problem (e.g. causation of heavy metal residual) detection is feasible.

articleTitle: Land-use/land-cover change detection by using the extended change-vector analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Detecting land-use/land-cover (LULC) changes in rural-urban fringe areas (RUFAs) timely and accurately using satellite imagery is essential for land-use planning and management in China. Although traditional spectral-based change-vector analysis (CVA) can offer an effective method of LULC-change detection in many cases, it encounters difficulties in RUFAs because of deficiencies in the spectral information of satellite images. To detect LULC changes in RUFAs effectively, this paper proposes an extended CVA approach that incorporates textural change information into the traditional spectral-based CVA. The extended CVA was applied to the Haidian District, Beijing, China. The results demonstrated the improvement of the extended CVA compared to the traditional spectral-based CVA: overall accuracy increased from 90.67% to 95.33%, and the kappa coefficient increased from 0.81 to 0.91. The advantage of the extended CVA lies in its integration of both spectral and textural change information to detect LULC changes, allowing for effective discrimination of LULC changes that are spectrally similar but texturally different in RUFAs. The extended CVA has great potential to be widely used for LULC-change detection in RUFAs, which are often heterogeneous and fragmental in nature, with rich textural information.

articleTitle: Link interference prediction-based topology control algorithm for 3-D wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the spatial characteristics of nodes and the links interference of Three-dimensional wireless sensor network, we propose a link interference prediction-based topology control algorithm for three-dimensional wireless sensor networks. The algorithm uses the interference factor to predict the interference probability of different links, taking into account the residual energy of nodes to estimate the link equality; we determine a new link selection criterion. Theoretical and experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce network interference while balancing the network energy consumption and prolong the lifetime of networks.

articleTitle: Application of AHP to the comprehensive later evaluation of petrochemical project
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the comprehensive later evaluation of petrochemical project involves many quantitative indicators and the dimensionality of theses indicators is different, this text adopts AHP to evaluate the comprehensive later evaluation of petrochemical project. The comprehensive later evaluation is divided into four steps: the first step is to design the index system of the comprehensive later evaluation. The second step is to give the evaluation value for every indicator and process the normalization of evaluation value. The third step is to apply AHP to define the weight of every level indicator. The forth step is to arrive at the result of the comprehensive later evaluation based on counting destination layer's score. The text gives an example of the evaluation last.

articleTitle: A new average quantized watermark for audio signal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Embedding watermark to audio signal has two affections, if the embedded signal is too light, it can't be extracted, if the embedded signal is to heavy, it's easy to feel the distortion. A new average quantized watermark is realized, firstly, watermark signal is scrambled by Arnold transform, secondly, audio signal blocked N blocks and analyzed by discrete Fourier transform (DFT), average operations is processed on the energy signal, thirdly, it quantizes the average signal and embeds scrambled watermark. Experimental results show that this algorithm has strong robustness, and can counteract attacking.

articleTitle: Matrix selection of saddles for pursuit/evasion differential games
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The uncertainty of terminate time in pursuit/evasion differential games (DG) makes it difficult to solve using usual numerical solution methods, what is more seriousness, the first order necessary condition can not be obtained in some pursuit/evasion DG. Matrix selection of saddles is proposed to solve this problem. This selection method is similar to the cooperative coevolution in genetic algorithms, it proceeds from the saddles of DG directly, transferring the pursuit of different goals for cost function to the selection of elements in matrix which is maximum in its column and simultaneously is minimum in its row, furthermore genetic algorithms are used to obtain the saddles of DG. The matrix selection method is verified by a practical pursuit/evasion DG.

articleTitle: Global supply chain equilibrium network dynamics with stochastic exchange rate volatility
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Fluctuant exchange rate has impact on global supply chain network equilibrium transactions. In this paper, by modeling various fluctuation trends of exchange rate, different exchange rate levels are used to characterize the advantageous or disadvantageous influence on transaction costs and risks between every pair of decision-makers, which is more practical for real-life global supply chain scenarios. Based on the idea of network integration, a global supply chain network equilibrium model with stochastic exchange rate volatility can be transformed into a supernetwork that integrates a supply chain transaction network with a currency network. With a two-stage prediction-correction method, we perform numerical simulation and sensitivity analysis to demonstrate the effectiveness of our equilibrium model.

articleTitle: Interpolation of missing hydrological data based on BP-Neural Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The elevation of hydrologic station is the key point of hydrologic analysis. This paper will adopt BP-Neural Networks to set up a model of interpolation about the missing elevation data of hydrologic station. The data set of hydrologic station is about drainage area in the middle and lower reaches of Yellow river, or in some branches of Yellow river such as Wei river and Jing river. The result of training shows, when we choose a data set that position of longitude and altitude is close by the missing data, or we choose a data set in the same river, accuracy of prediction that using this model is good.

articleTitle: Target detection based on coupled shape priors
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We proposed a method for target detection based on coupled shape priors. We resorted to a detection based shape priors, watersheds and coupling in this research. We adopt the watershed to segment image into many cells and formed super-pixels. There is a shape prior of target for the image and the prior is used to evaluate the validity of the formed segmentation. At last, we detected target through searching the optimal coupled region between edge of super-pixels and shape priors.

articleTitle: Selection of City's entrance and exit based on node important degree
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: City entrance roads have the double function of urban roads and external traffic. With the development of city's economy and City entrance; Fuzzy clustering; Node important degree acceleration of regional integration, the traffic volume of urban road is growing in a high speed, entrance road is also faced with unprecedented traffic pressure as a constraint to the development of urban transport. Therefore, planning and designing the road entrances into the overall urban planning become an important aspect. Node important degree is analyzed in this paper and applied to the selection of the city entrance City entrance; Fuzzy clustering; Node important degree.

articleTitle: Application of the enhancement algorithm based on fuzzy set theory in monitoring high-voltage transmission lines
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper expatiates on the principle, process and key technique of the enhancement algorithm based on fuzzy set theory. In the algorithm, the critical point g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> is determined via the Otsu algorithm based on the two-dimensional histogram, and then the fuzzy set of an image is determined via the exponential function, and then the fuzzy set is transformed for enhancement via a recursive operator, and eventually the enhanced image is attained via an inverse transformation from the transformed fuzzy set. Acting as an application to the image of high-voltage transmission lines, the experimental results of not only the transformation of histogram equalization but also the expatiated algorithm are given. The experimental results show the latter is more efficient than the former. One of main characteristics in the expatiated algorithm is that g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf> is determined via the Otsu algorithm based on the two-dimensional histogram instead of the others.

articleTitle: RS-GIS based landscape pattern change and its effect on urban thermal environment in main urban area of Kunming, China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The urban eco-environmental effect was generated in the process of urbanization. Urban thermal environment is a comprehensive embodiment of environmental effect of urban landscape ecosystem. Landsat TM/ETM+ data, Modis data and the real-time meteorological data were used to study the effect that landscape changes caused to the urban thermal environment. Fragstats, a famous landscape metrics calculation software, was used to calculate the landscape metrics in the class-level and the landscape-level. Erdas Imagine, a famous RS soft has been used to build model to extract land surface temperature. Modis data and meteorological data at the satellite pass were used to testify the validity of Landsat TM/ETM+ Band6. Annual variation and seasonal variation of thermal environment were revealed. The result showed that the building area increased quickly through occupying land. As a result, land deceased sharply during year 1992 to 2008. The building area changed from 5163ha in year 1992 to 11425ha in 2008. The urban expansion also occupied the forest and grassland. There was 1123ha grass land in 1992, but it couldn't be identified on the Landsat TM images in 2008. Through three periods in 1992, 2000 and 2008, NP(number of patches) was 1283, 1952, 2566 respectively. The largest patch type changed from land to building area and LPI (the largest patch index) increased from 29% to 66%. Six higher LST areas and two lower LST areas were found on 4 Landsat images in year 2000 to 2001. Meanwhile, five same higher temperature areas which weakened at some extent and two new areas with higher LST were founded on Landsat image in 2008. The biggest high temperature area was located in Liangting Village and the higher temperature area of building area moved outside gradually from year 1992 to 2008

Author Keywords: Main Urban Area of Kunming City

articleTitle: Minmum-cost of road network planning based on max-min ant algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the road network planning problem by using the ant colony algorithm. The road network considered by this paper is modeled by graph with edge weights and node weights, and a central node and a spanning tree are determined according to performance index. The road network planning problem is a complex optimization and combination problem, which are very difficult to obtain optimal solution. To solve minimum cost road network planning problem, a max-min ant colony algorithm is proposed, which may be more effective and avoid the premature convergence compare with the normal ant algorithm. Finally, the simulation results also show that the max-min ant colony algorithm is effective to solve the road network planning problem.

articleTitle: Research on a single intelligent platform for network management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the discussion of existing network management architectures and its technologies, an intelligent network management platform is proposed in order to mingle with OSS/J and conventional interface protocols. Its data-driven oriented features and functionalities are analyzed based on the component design idea. Result from part implementation of the platform components shows its high intelligent capability.

articleTitle: Color reproduction system implementation from display to the projector based on look-up table
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the color inconsistencies between the projector and the display, this paper, through a method of look-up table, proposed a color reproduction conversion from the display to the projector design, which based on the FPGA technology. Make use of the characters of human visual, we matched 9 different colors displays between projector and monitor, each frame is calculated the corresponding conversion value R'G'B' of all the possible of the pixel RGB in the PC, then transmitted the value to the color reproduction device and deposited it into the three look-up tables within the FPGA. When using, the output video signal from the PC is as the address to read the information of the look-up table, then weighted sum of the final output and displayed it on the projector, which enabling the color reproduction from the display to the projector. The effectiveness of the program has been verified by the measurement of the hardware system.

articleTitle: Design of single flyback converter power based on SG6841
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Design of the DC/DC switching power supply is introduced in this paper. The high frequency inverter main circuit of the DC/DC switching power supply is composed of power MOSFET; The controlling signal of the main circuit is generated by the PWM chip SG6841; Experiment proves, Its input voltage range is 18 ∼ 36VDC, output is 5V/6A, It is steady, reliable.

articleTitle: Reputation evaluation in internet application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Reputation evaluation is an important problem in internet application. An new reputation evaluation method is presented in this paper: the reputation of every peer is presented as belief(b),disbelief(d),uncertainty(u) and b,d,u can be calculated by beta distribution. To simplify the calculation of beta distribution we proof that beta distribution can be approximated by normal distribution.

articleTitle: Automate discovery of deep web interfaces
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid increase of web sources, more and more deep web databases become available. The information in these databases can only be accessed by submitting queries to back-end databases. However, the traditional search engine interfaces resemble extremely deep web interfaces. Therefore, it is difficult to distinguish them and to find deep web interfaces. This paper proposes a novel method of discovering deep web interfaces. We introduce a page division method to divide pages into separate parts. After that we remove the parts which don't contain search interfaces. At last we construct topic-specific queries to obtain results and distinguish deep web interfaces by analyzing the results. Experiment result shows that this method is effective and stable.

articleTitle: Formal analysis and improvement of IKEv2 protocol
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: IKEv2 is the new version of Internet Key Exchange protocol. Despite of its several advantages, it is still susceptible to some attacks, such as man-in-the-middle attack and replay attack. The protocol is analyzed based on BSW logic formally, then an improved scheme is proposed and proved by extended BSW logic. The improvement can achieve the identity authentication in advance, resist man-in-the-middle attack and replay attack, and fulfill the authentication, secrecy and integrity of this protocol.

articleTitle: Research to knowledge service model for oil production decision based on keyword net
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article contributes a knowledge service model for knowledge-driven oil production decision. The core component of the model is the supporting environment construction for knowledge reasoning, which supports various assistant decision applications. The knowledge structure supporting relational data reasoning in the environment is proposed and it consists of three layers—meta-vocabulary layer, oil production fact layer, and decision strategy and design action layer. The formal definition and description of the knowledge structure is conducted. The evidence-production status reasoning mechanism is described. Following the mechanism, current oil production status is reasoned by analyzing the facts concealed in oil production information. The assistant decision system for oil-field dynamic development is developed by following the model.

articleTitle: Research on multiple attribute group decision-making approach for construction programme choice
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The construction programme choice is the basis for programme management. A scientific and practical choice and decision-making model of construction programme renders as an important guarantee for the success of choice and management of construction programme. This paper advances a new multi-attribute group decision-making model aiming at the decision-making problem of construction programme choice. First, the entropy theory for data mining to determine the attribute weights is introduced in this paper based on the decision matrix information of decision-makers; then, the minimizing deviation principle to determine the group decision-makers' weights is proposed based on the analysis of the group decision-makers' attribute weights information; finally, a decision is made after the identification of the group synthetic attribute values of subprojects in combination of the decision-making matrices of decision-makers, the attribute weights and the group decision-makers' weights. Eventually, the feasibility and practicability of the model is verified by the example.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of Zhonggong tunnel through coal seam
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Xiamen-Chengdu expressway is “the 16th horizontal stroke” of the national reticulated highway system called “7918” which is planned by the country. Ruijin-Ganzhou expressway is a part of Xiamen-Chengdu in Jiangxi province, also a part of “the 4th horizontal stroke” of the main framework highway reticulation called “Three vertical and Four horizontal” in south of Jiangxi. Zhonggong Tunnels is located in Yudou county of Ganzhou City, and near by Shijing village of Hefeng town, which left the tunnel length 4180 m, Right tunnel 4185 meters long, and is the longest highway in Jiangxi Province in the construction of the tunnel. During construction, the tunnel through a coal formation, the emergence of rock instability, severe vault settlement. This paper analyzes the deformation caused by soft coal Tunnel reasons that topography, geological structure, lithology, water's role and initial support is to generate strong enough deformation of soft ground Tunnel major factor.. The use of the basic principles of mechanics, the establishment of the weak seam digital simulation model of the tunnel; proposed digital simulation of deformation of soft coal Tunnel approach, an example to verify the digital simulation of soft ground tunnel surrounding rock deformation method is correct sex.

articleTitle: Study on personalization of the search engine and its design
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Personalization of search engine is a subject studied by various search engines, and is a new tendency of search engines development. In this paper, from the perspective of personalized information retrieval service, key technologies on the personalized approach is studied, and an architecture of a new personalized search engine system is built. Simulation tests proved that such personalized approach can improve search results effectively, and have good adaptability.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The application of Fuzzy Synthesis Evaluation Method based on AHP in information technology of construction enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the Creative Industries Cluster' forming factors and development strategies based on Porter's Diamond Model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Starting from an analysis of Guangzhou creative industries cluster, this paper analyzed the formation of Guangzhou Creative Industries Cluster based on Porter's Diamond Model. We discussed the four key factors including production factors, demand conditions; related supportive industries; corporate strategy, structure, and rivalry as well as two additional factors including government and chance which influencing Guangzhou creative industries cluster based on Porter's diamond model. We further explored the restrictive factors affecting the development of creative industrial cluster. Finally, suggestions on developing Guangzhou creative industrial cluster are given based on the analysis above.

articleTitle: A hole filling algorithm for medical imaging
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Surface integrity of 3D medical imaging is crucial for surgery simulation or virtual diagnoses. However, undesirable holes often exist due to external damage on bodies or accessibility limitation on scanners. To bridge the gap, the paper proposes an algorithm of filling holes for 3D medical image data based on moving least squares (MLS) method. In the algorithm, medical data is classified into two types and procedure is designed according to the classification. The procedure consists of two steps, namely hole detection and hole completion. In completion part, the detected hole can be automatically filled by interpolation with known surrounding points. Moreover, a threshold is used to constrain the density of the completed surface, so the sampling rate on reconstructed area complies with the original data. We test our algorithm on two types of medical data and the results indicate a robust solution.

articleTitle: Research of information resources integration model based on grid service
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basis of grid services technology, this passage proposes a distributed heterogeneous information resource integration model. The information resources are regarded as grid services which are registered to the service registry and provided services to the outside in the model. Thus the model can achieve the purpose of integration of information resources in the form of grid services. At the same time, the model Introducts Qos grid services evaluation which selects a more appropriate grid service according to each Qos properties and Qos attributes of each user preference. The model can be used to access the heterogeneous information resources.

articleTitle: The problems and developing countermeasures of Liaoning management consulting industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We have known that duing the development of Liaoning management consulting industry there were problems such as weakness of consulting ideas, small size of management consulting enterprises, low influence of brands, deficiency of management consulting talents and imbalance of area distribution, etc. through the analysis on the development status quo of Liaoning management consulting industry. Some development countermeasures were put forward such as improving enterprise and public awareness of the consulting, intensive management, training composite consulting talents, developing specialty management consulting companies, and balance the area distribution of management consulting companies correspondingly.

articleTitle: Influence on grid frequency caused by restriction of PFR
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: All of the synchronize and close sets can take part in whack frequency modulation when the active power of system unbalance. However, some area's unit of the grid is being in the repairing period or many water area are in the dry season etc., these reasons have limited the capacity of PFR. Since hydropower plants and thermal power plants have their own unique characteristics, so when the primary frequency capacity is restricted, the frequency characteristics of grid is different. In addition, differences in plant location which determines the nature of its load in the region. This article analyzes the influence on grid frequency caused by restriction of PFR and the relationship between the frequency response and the capacity of PFR.

Author Keywords: volume to weight ratio of PFR

articleTitle: Potential support vector machine based on the reduced samples
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When the training dataset is very large, the learning process of potential support vector machine takes up so large memory that the training speed is very slow. To accelerate the training speed of the potential support vector machine (PSVM) for large-scale datasets, a new method is proposed, which introduces PSVM based on the reduced samples. The new method removes most non-support vectors, and keeps the samples on and near the boundary, which may be the support vectors, as the new training samples. This method is more suitable to large-scale datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed method performs well to decrease the consumption of computer memory, and accelerate the training speed of PSVM.

articleTitle: Application research on demodulation system based on neural network technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Demodulation system is very important in modern communication technology and has a variety of applications. With the surge of the information quality and the need of high-speed information transfer, it is necessary to break through the traditional technology and further improve the performance of demodulation system. The paper introduces a demodulation system based on artificial neural network (ANN), and researches the system performance. ANN demodulation system has completely different inner structure and processing flow. Parameter and relative performance are gained by itself in course of studying so it has intellect, and the anti-jamming performance is better than that of traditional system; parallel processing method means the speed of ANN demodulator is faster than that of traditional method; specially, the ability that ANN demodulator can demodulate different signals by the same receiver shows a new thought for modern communication security Technology.

articleTitle: Dynamic research of Shandong province talented volleyball reserve training efficiency
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The Reserve Training is essential for the construction of sports teams, and currently has attracted attention at all levels of sports teams. However, the efficiency of Reserve Training is not aroused sufficient attention, which is precisely reflecting the sustainability of building for construction. Based on the study of Shandong province talented volleyball reserve training efficiency, The paper mainly discussed the contribution rate of reserve forces, grade distribution, levels and other important indicators of the trend curve over the past decade, at the same time, the system modeling has been made for the up-level efficiency and the basis contribution rate. Studies suggest that the current basic rate of contribution of the second-tier team is higher than the national average rate by 7 percentage points, and third-tier 3 percentage points. The basic rate of contribution of the three troop shows that the number of the children participated in amateur athletics volleyball training in Shandong Province is declining. Shandong sports athletes are line up to grade level of the basic balance, and the first-tier put the first-line athletes as the main training target while the second-tier view the second-line athlete as the main training target. Volleyball team in Shandong province should fully estimate the reality and development needs of the first-tier, then made out middle to longterm personnel training program to make sure the supply of the first-line players is protected.

articleTitle: Study and implementation of agent-based grid resource monitoring model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Grid is a promising infrastructure which enables scientists and engineers to access geographically distributed resources. Grid computing is a new technology which focuses on aggregating various kinds of resource (e.g., processor cycles, disk storage, and contents) into one computing platform. The realization of grid computing requires a resource agent to manage and monitor available resources. Based on study of past models, this paper presents a new agent-based resource monitoring model whose main feature is multi-layered monitoring architecture, which enhances the ability to monitor related resource efficiently. In the meantime, the new model has been implemented in the development of a resource monitoring module integrated within a academic grid project.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of IEC 61850 communication protocol for smart grid
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Due to the development of the worldwide smart grid, IEC 61850, as a major standard in the future smart grid area, will bear more and more important role. This paper introduces the traditional development method of IEC 61850 and its main problems, such as complex modeling, long development cycle and high development cost. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a new development method of IEC 61850 protocol, and skips some complex parts in the traditional development method of IEC 61850. In this paper the messages meeting IEC 61850 protocol are obtained, after they are analyzed and tested, the client-side and server-side software based on IEC 61850 protocol are developed, which makes the base for embedding the IEC61850 into intelligent electronic devices.

articleTitle: The design & implementation of IGRS-and-UPnP-based DMA-SDK & its application in digital photo frame software
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of the 3C integration technology and the increasing popularity of Consumer Electronics, the new products continue to emerge. In recent years, consumer electronics based on the standard of home networking are rapidly developing. IGRS and UPnP protocol have primary and deep effect on the application of family media in our country. In order to develop digital home terminal product efficiently, this article proposes the design and implementation of an IGRS-and-UPnP-based DMA-SDK. The application developers can reuse the relevant modules provided by DMA-SDK effectively, and focus on the interface development and specific need-oriented modules. Thereby, it can greatly improve the developing efficiency of DMA application, and increase the product velocity.

articleTitle: LBE based real-time rendering of stain on cloth
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The effect of stains on the cloth is one of the most common effects in animation and virtual world. Based on the in-depth study of the various characteristics of fabrics and dirt, a real-time simulation algorithm for stain on cloth is proposed. The LBE method is used to simulate surface flow, while the inner fabric transmission applied the Poiseuille viscose flow law. As rendering arithmetic, we use GPU to implement this arithmetic to guarantee real-time simulation. The experimental results demonstrate that we obtain a good effect for simulating of the fabric stains forming process.

articleTitle: Statistic analysis of relationship quality and its impact on the quality of financial reports
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many factors that influence the quality of financial reports, whether are fit to relationship quality theory, which is widely used in relationship marketing and supply chain management, is appropriate for the study of relationship between the accounting rules maker and business enterprises. This article conducted an exploratory study by theoretical analysis and a questionnaire survey. The study indicated that six dimensions, which are trust, satisfaction, commitment, authority, stability of relationship and quality of accounting rules, can reflect the relationship quality between the accounting rules maker and business enterprises, and the six dimensions of relationship quality can affect the quality of financial reports, but each dimension has different degree of influence on the reliability, relevancy, timeliness and clarity of financial reports.

articleTitle: Enhanced beamforming scheme for MIMO downlink transmission
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates an enhanced beamforming scheme for MIMO downlink transmission. The proposed scheme combines transmit beamforming with space-time block code (STBC), which has the advantages of both techniques. The scheme uses dual antenna array groups to achieve stable performance and utilizes the uplink direction of arrival (DOA) to perform transmit beamforming. Do the simulation to compare performance of the proposed scheme with the traditional beamforming approach. It is shown that the enhanced scheme provides better BER performance than the traditional beamforming techniques under the same simulation environment.

articleTitle: A performance evaluation model on corporate social responsibility based on ANP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the principle of Analytic Network Process (ANP), this paper firstly constructs a model which is used to evaluate the performance of corporate social responsibility (CSR) and is particularly suitable for large-scale state-owned enterprises in China. Secondly, a set of evaluation index system is built up. Finally, M Group is illustrated to check the model. We hope this study will help to promote the launching of corporate social responsibility movement in China.

articleTitle: Evaluation system for the government's role of regional independent innovation system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Participating in regional independent innovation is an important government action in today's world. This paper researched the government's role of regional independent innovation system with the factor analysis method, and made an empirical research on Anhui as an example by comparing with the other ten provinces and cities synchronously. Attributed eighteen evaluation indicator variables into four main factors and determined these actual meanings. Through empirical conclusions, the article found the existing problems of the government's role of regional independent innovation system in Anhui and gave related countermeasures.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between the fund managers' characteristic and fund performance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the relationship between fund managers' characteristic and fund performance in China. It does an empirical research with the method of OLS, according to the data of the stock and the mixed type open-ended securities investment funds, which operates more than one year by the end of 2009. The study results shows that: Tenure, age, certifications of CFA \ FRM \ CPA, fund managers origin from fund managers and fund managers assistants significantly positively related to the fund performance of profitability; While, the experience of securities, MBA (EMBA) degree as well as team size of fund managers significantly negatively related to the fund performance of profitability, other variables' influence aren't significant. Meanwhile, the personal characteristics of fund managers don't affect the fund risk.

articleTitle: A SOA-based design and implementation for seismic data management system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Recent developments in web service technologies have shown promise for developing large scale data management system. Web services can significantly add some desirable characteristics such as openness, interoperability, scalability, implementation-language independent etc. This work proposed an efficient system architecture prototype for seismic data management, which is organized as four different layers based on service-oriented software engineering. This architecture was used on a prototype system developed for the Exploration and Development Research Institute of PetroChina Changqing Oilfield Company, which has shown some salient advantages over the former system.

articleTitle: Apply 3D software in web games
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Visual effect of pictures play a very important role in the competition between different web games. High 3D quality and space sense of pictures can promote the visual effect. 3D software is the best choice to achieve perfect visual effect. However, it costs a lot of system resources, which is not acceptable for most of the web games. A synthetically way proposed in this paper, which composed Flash and Maya, a 2D software and a 3D software, approaches good visual effect with limited system resources.

articleTitle: Steady state electromagnetic analysis of the forward problem for Magneto-acoustic tomography
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Magneto-acoustic tomography is a new EIT technology, which combines the traditional Electrical impedance tomography and Ultrasound Imaging, can provide high-spatial-resolution information. This paper expounds the steady state electromagnetic forward problem based on reciprocity theorem for Magneto-acoustic tomography. The FEM numerical simulation with a two-dimensional imaging model demonstrates the reasonability of the forward problem, improves the theory of Magneto-acoustic tomography, and also provides the theoretical foundation for the impedance reconstruction algorithm of Magneto-acoustic tomography. Furthermore, it does research on the impact of electrode placement on sensitivity of measured signal. This paper will give useful reference to further research on experiment setup of Magneto-acoustic tomography.

articleTitle: Database design of urban land prices and intensive use
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper firstly studies the stratification and organization of the urban land prices and intensive use data, in order to design data model based on Geodatabase for the city land use and intensive use; Secondly, designs a four in one database structure for basic information database, analysis and evaluation databases, information release databases and meta-databases; finally, studies the database establishment methods, and establishes the urban land price and intensive use database for Zhengzhou City.

articleTitle: An ID-based broadcast encryption scheme for hierarchical wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Most WSNs are organized in hierarchical topology, in which broadcast communication is the most efficient way to send messages. Since broadcast communication using public channel, it is important to protect the broadcast message using cryptography. We proposed a practical broadcast encryption scheme stIBBE by combining HIBE and secret sharing scheme. The proposed scheme is proved IND-sID-CPA secure in random oracle model. Compared with related broadcast encryption schemes, stIBBE has advantage in both computation and communication cost.

articleTitle: The statistical characteristics of internet topology models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the exponential growth of the Internet size, the Internet topology structure become more and more sophisticated. Recently, the complex network theories provide many new approaches, especially the power-law, to the research of Internet topology models, such as Waxman, BA, GLP and PFP etc. These theory models with intrinsic subjective assumes need proper metrics to evaluate their resemblance to the realistic Internet topology. In this paper, many metrics, like degree distribution, clustering, and rich-club, based on statistics and structure are tested with aforementioned models using Matlab tools. By deliberately comparing the models with each other, some proper analytical results are achieved.

articleTitle: Research on highly-precise algorithm for time-delay difference estimation of wideband signal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In short base line (SBL) underwater acoustics (UWA) positioning systems, positioning accuracy depends mainly on the precision of time-delay difference estimation. This paper presents a highly-precise algorithm for time-delay difference of wideband signal, which provides strong practicality for underwater cooperative targets positioning. This algorithm employs phase difference of main lobes of peaks of correlation function to modify the value of time-delay difference, which improves precision of the time-delay difference estimation. Simulation and experiment results indicate that this method has good advantages.

articleTitle: Fault detection of Inter-turn Short-circuit in Rotor windings based on hybrid programming of MATLAB and VC++
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analyses the mechanism of detecting the Inter-turn short-circuit in Rotor winding fault with detecting coil, extracts the signal feature with wavelet transform algorithm. Hybrid programming of MATLAB and VC++ used in this paper directly embed MATLAB M document into the VC environment and make them run normally without MATLAB. The signal collecting, system frame constructing and interface drawing can be carried out by adopting VC++ graphical interface as the front-stage, while with MATLAB as the back-stage, the Inter-turn Short-circuit in Rotor windings fault can be judged through the data analysis and calculation. The results shows that the system has a good effect in practical application.

articleTitle: Enterprise informationization essence study on advanced orbital traffic equipment manufacturing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Domestic and foreign research actuality of enterprise informationization and advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing industry were analyzed, it was for introduced China emphatically about the informationization on the advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing industry policy development environment. First, the Informationization layer model, gradation model and contribution model to advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing industry were built. Fusion stage model based on the stratagem, operation, fusion degree between technology and advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing industry were proposed. Information in advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing industry evaluation index system was built. Then their evaluation index system of hierarchical model was choice. On the base of this, information technology and advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing integration measures was promoted, for example, between the competent authorities at all levels of Information and advanced orbital transportation equipment manufacturing, coordination mechanisms should be the established.

articleTitle: Talking about how to shape enterprise culture from the human resource management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The research of enterprise culture from human resources management has become one of the important topics of the modern enterprise management. Shaping enterprise culture from the human resources management, can not only better quality, suitable for the development of the cultural ideas, but also play a key role to improve the economic efficiency of enterprises. This article from the definition of human resources management and enterprise culture and the meaning of human resources management from the mold starting with the significance of enterprise culture, the interaction and the confliction of human resources management and enterprise culture. Interaction, including to promote human resources management of enterprise culture; the promotion of enterprise culture for human resources management. Confliction, including the confliction of timeliness of human resources management and long-lasting of enterprise culture; the confliction of model of human resources

articleTitle: A B-spline collocation method for solving non-linear singular boundary value problems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We propose a new collocation method for the solution of non-linear singular two-point boundary value problems by using B-spline functions. The quesilinearization technique is used to reduce the given non-linear problem to a sequence of linear problems. Picking the equidistance collocation points, we transform the systems to some sparse algebraic equations which are easy to be solved. At last, we give some numerical illustrations from physical model problems to demonstrate the efficiency of the presented method.

articleTitle: Research on the constraint in SIFT point matching
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Establishing reliable point correspondences between two images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. This work focus on the evaluation of candidate correspondences in matching points based on SIFT features, which is one of the most popular local descriptor of feature points. We introduced a novel concept of ambiguity measure (AM), and proposed several AMs based on study of the typical “distance ratio between the nearest neighbor and the second”. We also studied the AMs theoretically and experimentally. It is shown that the capacity of AM depends on whether the matching degree between the putative correspondence points are included in AM effectively. This research are helpful both for understanding the available method NNDR, and for designing more effective methods.

articleTitle: A modified histogram bit synchronization algorithm for GNSS receivers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper modifies the histogram bit synchronization algorithm. The expressions on probability of both synchronization and false alarm of histogram method have been deduced, and the quantity of measured bits as well as thresholds with best performance is acquired. Compared with results from relational literature, the average time of bit synchronization has almost been shortened by 40%.

articleTitle: Horizontal crustal movement in the world obtained from the combined GPS velocity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper data has been collected in published regional GPS velocity of the results in journals worldwide. Based on this GPS data by different combination of data, established nearly 20 years in uniform reference frame ITRF2005 global level under the velocity field; the velocity field results are in with the global IGS stations show good agreement.

articleTitle: The analysis of FDI's impact on regional innovation capability of China's provinces and cities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this essay, the panel data is China's 30 provinces and municipalities (excluding Tibet) from 2000 to 2008; independent variables are the gross domestic product (GDP) of per capita, foreign direct investment (FDI), research costs, the technology market turnover; patent applications is the measure of regional innovation capability. This essay uses the methods of econometric analysis analyzing the variables' impact on the regional innovation capability, and focuses on researching the FDI's role of regional innovation capability. The results show that, for a part of the provinces and cities, FDI has a effect of technology spillovers, enhancing regional innovation capability. But for other provinces and cities, FDI doesn't mean that. As a result, we can find that FDI's regional innovation capaci ty for all the provinces and cities is differences.

articleTitle: The research of forest growth monitoring based on remote sensing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The forest growing condition is an important index of vegetation monitoring. Mastering this information timely can help us to man-age the forest resource, and predict and control the forest pest effectively. The development and application of remote sensing technique provides a new approach for the growing condition monitoring. This paper using the vegetation information which is obtained from the remote sensing, described the monitoring method and index. Furthermore, we proposed a monitoring model based on NDVI, and the design, operation principle of ANN — CA monitoring and prediction model. At the last of the paper, some existing problems of the growing condition remote monitoring were discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the mechanism for economic growth of introducing FDI in Jilin province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: From studying the influence of foreign direct investment (FDI) on economic growth, foreign and domestic researchers find that FDI is an important factor to improve economic growth. Based on the panel data of nine regions in Jilin province from 2003 to 2007, the paper uses quantitative methods to study impractically the mechanism for economic growth of introducing FDI in Jilin province. The outcome of study shows that FDI is a factor to promote economic growth in Jilin province, and the most significant mechanism for FDI to promote economic growth in Jilin province is capital effect and foreign trade effect.

articleTitle: Two modifications in tracking high dynamic GNSS signals using extended kalman filter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes two modifications in tracking high dynamic GNSS signals with extended Kalman filter. One is used to estimate the amplitude of signals better, while the other is used to eliminate the phase error of correlator outputs. Simul-ation results show that the variance of estimation and BER of navigation data are both reduced highly.

articleTitle: Improved fuzzy clustering segmentation algorithm research based on wavelet transform for sport graphics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, linking with the basic principle of FCM (Fuzzy c-means clustering) algorithm, on the basis of theory research, a method of the cluster analysis of improved FCM based on wavelet transform is proposed. Firstly, the approximate optimal solution obtained by the improved FCM algorithm is taken as the original value, then combined with intensity-texture-position feature space in order to produce connected regions shown in the image. The final segmentation result is achieved at last. The experiment results prove that in the view of the sport image segmentation, this algorithm provides fast segmentation with high perceptual segmentation quality.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of decision support system for urban industrial restructuring
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is a prerequisite to keep an optimal and efficient industrial structure for urban socio-economic development. In order to development a scientific, standardized and efficiency decision support system (DSS) for the diagnosis of urban industrial structure optimization, this paper conducts an integrated study on design and implementation of DSS for urban industrial restructuring. It mainly contains following four aspects: the design of the DSS's function, the design of the DSS's structure, the design of the DSS's module and the use process of the DSS. The DDS can provide decision-making support for identifying the degree of urban industrial structure optimization scientifically, guiding effectively the upgrading of urban industrial structure and promoting sound and fast development of urban economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of urban heat island effect using k-means clustering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The characteristics of the urban heat island effect were often examined using urban heat island intensity (UHII). We collected daily mean, maximum and minimum temperature data from the Kaifeng Weather Station in the Kaifeng City and Huibei Station in the surrounding rural area for 2004–2008. Daily UHIIs calculated from daily mean, maximum and minimum temperature were regarded as components of vectors in a 3-D space and they clustered using the k-means algorithm. Clustering results showed that there was usually a slight UHI for most days, while sometimes nocturnal UHI effect was significant. There were very few cases with extremely obvious UHI effect and cooling effect was unignorable. The clustering results confirmed the graphical interpretations. The clustering method presented in this paper provides an alternative way for analysis of UHI effect.

articleTitle: An adaptive retrospective trust region method for unconstrained optimization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new trust region method with the aid of a adaptive retrospective trust region radius update strategy. The radius in the new subproblem adjusts automatically based on g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf>, B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf> and the previously successful one. Local superlinear is analyzed. The numerical results suggest that our algorithm is efficient in practical computation.

articleTitle: Removing multiplicative noise by improved regularization term
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of multiplicative noise removal. Multiplicative noise models are central to the study of coherent imaging systems, such as synthetic aperture radar and sonar, and ultrasound and laser imaging. Classical ways to solve such problems are filtering, statistical(Bayesian) methods, variational methods, and methods that convert the multiplicative noise into additive noise, apply a variational method on the log data or shrink their coefficients in a frame and recover the result using an exponential function. We draw our inspiration from the diffusion tensor. By using a edge-directed enhancing based anisotropic diffusion as regularizer, we can derive a functional whose minimizer corresponds to the denoised image we want to recover. Both theory analysis and numerical results show that the new model has better denoising results than the known SO model with high peak signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Risk metrics method and computer algorithms designed to achieve VaR
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The article firstly analyzes the Markowitz's Mean-Variance Model, with The Monte Carlo method achieving the computer simulation of efficient frontier. Against the shortage of the model, this test allows short selling, using the Zero-Utility to optimize the objective, and improving the model with chance constraints, then using the Risk Metrics way to design the VaR algorithm, realized by computer. Finally, the paper provides a practical example, implementing the practical application of the algorithm. What's more, this study proves that “the high risk, the high payoff” is a character of risk investment. It shows the result is more practical which is optimized by Utility Function. By comparing, we find that the risk aversion coefficient has big influence on the economic benefits of the investors. We can say, VaR provides a powerful basis for the effective selection of investment combination and the assessment of risk and value.

articleTitle: Dynamics of credit risk for listed company in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Referring to the model of KMV, combining the reality of ownership Separability for listed corporations in China, the mathematical frame of default rate forecasting and credit rating for listed corporations and its dynamic version is presented. Applying the model to delisted corporations and listed corporations (not ST or PT), it turns out that this method is powerful in forecasting default rate, especially in recognizing the relative credit quality for the companies. And this method could be applied in practice.

articleTitle: Study on dynamics modeling and simulation of cerebrospinal fluid circulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Intracranial pressure (ICP) monitoring is important for patients with high intracranial pressure, but so far the clinical monitoring of intracranial pressure are almost invasive, so they are extremely limited. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) circulation is the basis for intracranial pressure and hydrocephalus is one of the major reasons for high intracranial pressure. Therefore, using the modeling and simulation methods to study the dynamics theory of cerebrospinal fluid circulation and hydrocephalus is of great significance. In this paper, a dynamics model of cerebrospinal fluid circulation was proposed after the detailed analysis of the various links and constraints. This was proved to be reasonable and feasible by initial tests, it can provide some reference for intracranial pressure monitoring and treatment of high intracranial pressure.

articleTitle: The research and design of the data path In LTE system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When Data goes through the protocol stack, the protocol processes will result to memory applying, releasing, copying and other operations. The data rates of LTE system is very high and the ARM completing all protocol data processes needs a lot of time, so it will affect data transmission in time. In order to reduce processing time, this paper uses the concept of block information, which does not process the ture data but just to record the protocol processing operations. These operation's information with received block information from the upper(lower) layer assembles the block information in certain layer. After analysis, we know that using block information of data blocks eliminates a lot of operations, such as Memory applying, releasing, data copying and so on, which greatly reduces the processing time and improves the instantaneity of data transmission.

articleTitle: Control system for high temperature and high pressure fluid-solid action
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A control system for a high temperature and high pressure fluid-solid action furnace based on the self-revise PID was introduced. The hardware system was composed by an industrial computer, a servo and PLC system. Based on this hardware system the algorithm of the PID tuning was improved. Finally, this system functions were fulfilled of the control, self-revise PID and automatic temperature and pressure distribution. This system is already applied and can achieve the technical requirement.

articleTitle: Research on the influencing factors of fixing domestic tourist attraction fees
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper, after making quantitative statistics and qualitative theoretical analysis of admission fees in domestic tourist attractions, initially determines seven influencing factors that affect the fixing of admission fees, including grade of scenic spot, management system, product type, trade environment, area of tourist attraction, industry environment and social economy. The paper points out the complexity and particularity of the fixing of admission fees and offers related suggestions through positive study.

articleTitle: An integration framework of ecological models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: How to evaluate the accuracy of integration model is becoming more important for studying various complex issues (e.g. ecological issue). The existing integration methods mainly focused on considering the realized technology and integration environment, however, the relations between these sub-models being used in one complex issues and the accuracy of integrated model are not discussed enough. In terms of the idea of Meta-Synthesis and the different relations of each sub-model being used, an integration framework is creatively developed for evaluating the integrated ecological model. The integration framework includes series-wound pattern, shunt-wound pattern, and mix pattern. The evaluation method of each integration patterns among the integration framework is respectively put forward and discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: “Urban Acupuncture” based on digital technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The essence of “Urban Acupuncture” is to develop the method of small-scale urban regeneration to a key sinew of improving the overall urban environmental quality. Through interfering with some very districts, and motivating the potentials, the districts can get a new life and boom, which will make positive effects on lager urban areas. The implement of “Urban Acupuncture” depends on the right selection of mediums, positions and methods. “Urban Acupuncture” based on the medium of “Public Centers” is not just small-scale and incremental in the process of regeneration, it can also create attractive public places to enhance the sense of belonging of the citizens and accelerate the development of urban society and economy. The methods of “Urban Acupuncture” supported by digital technology try to make full use and integrate the technical means such as data record, analysis, transmission, image orientation, Automatic generation provided by GIS (geographical information system), APRS (aerial photography and remote sensing technology), SDM (spatial data mining technique) and VR (virtual reality technology), to get and analyze the accurate data of urban space, and finally ascertain the numbers, positions, scales, shapes and characters of public centers on different levels of urban built environment in a scientific and rational way.

articleTitle: Research on influence of the congruence of consumer self-concept and brand personality on brand trust
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The study adopts a relationship marketing perspective to explore and examine the influence of the congruence of consumer self-concept and brand personality on brand trust through brand attitude. Based on data collected from a large questionnaire sample, the paper use structural equation modeling method analyzes the relationship between variables. The results indicate that brand attitude significant plays a positive driving role to brand trust, the congruence of brand personality and consumer ideal self-concept positive impact brand trust through brand attitude more than the congruence of consumer real self-concept, and also find that the congruence of brand personality and consumer social self-concept has a negative impact on brand trust through brand attitude.

articleTitle: Interface function adaptive channel assignment in multi-radio wireless mesh networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Reasonable channel assignment is one of the key research contents of the multi-channel assignment algorithms. A distributed channel assignment method based on partition of interface function was proposed in this paper. Different channel assigning or switching algorithms for interfaces with different function were used: Channel assigning algorithm based on measuring time to gateway was used for station interfaces while peer-assisted channel assignment algorithm was used for AP interfaces.
