Simulation results show that this method can greatly improve network throughputs under high network loads especially.

articleTitle: Regional landslide susceptibility assessment based on Bivariate statistical analysis and application
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The statistic analysis mothed is used to analyze the region landlside susceptibility in landslide hazard analysis. In the mothod, landslide invetntory and the data of enviromental factors which induce landslides are essential. The Cameron Highlands of Malaysia was selected as the experimental studying area. Based on GIS and the Bivariate statistical analysis mothod, the relationships among landslides and environmental factors were analyzed. Then, Probability Index Model and Distance Evaluation Model were developed. The comparison and assessment of two models show that they have higher prediction precision and universality. The effect of Distance Evaluation Model is better than that of Probability Index Model.

articleTitle: On choices of the securities in the venture enterprise financial governance
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Venture enterprises are featured by high risk and high yield, and faced by the reality of the great disparity between their capital demand and supply, Which make venture capital naturally be the most reliable and effective source of financing. The intervention of venture capital and the particularity of venture capital market make the venture enterprise financial governance watch for a chance, which mainly depends on securities. Hybrid securities have a wide range of applications in the venture enterprise financial governance, because they contain stock rights, obligatory rights and share options which have a strong financial governance effects. In terms of the choices of hybrid securities, venture enterprises usually use a portfolio instead of a single security. In practice, we usually use gold segmentation method to construct hybrid securities.

articleTitle: A 3D models acquiring method for complex surface objects
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method that can acquire 3D models from real objects with complex surfaces is proposed in this paper. This method first gets the source depth images from a TOF-Camera and get the partial meshes of the object after the image preprocessing such as triangulation, segmentation, denoising and smoothing, then aligned these partial meshes using Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm. During the alignment process delete the overlap data to reduce memory usage. After the align process, in order to get an intact model of the object, we combine the portions together and reconstruct the mesh after remove the overlap points of meshes. Experimental results show that the proposed method can obtain models of complex surface objects in a short time and can highly improve the quality of the original data.

articleTitle: Signal processing in attenuation measurement with laser ultrasonics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This research uses laser ultrasonics and signal processing to quantify the frequency-dependent attenuation losses of Rayleigh waves on viscoelastic materials. The high fidelity, large frequency bandwidth, steady output and non-contact nature of laser excitation makes this an ideal method to measure attenuation in these materials. Through the signal process of windows, filtering, FFT and coherent analysis to the Rayleigh signal, the relation between attenuation and frequency is obtained. The obtained results show that appropriate signal processing method is effective to the attenuation measurement with laser ultrasonics.

articleTitle: A new dual-video watermarking algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Research of robust and invisible double digital watermark is one of the hot fields currently, and it has received considerable attention. To change the situation that many methods about watermarking are based on embedding one single watermark, a new double digital watermark algorithm on the basis of discrete cosine transformation and image blocks is presented. The algorithm embeds both robust watermark and fragile watermark to one video sequence by using DCT and multiple embedded methods. The later embedded fragile watermark is served for the early robust watermark. The experiment results verify the algorithm achieves better robustness and imperceptibility.

articleTitle: Application of Vague set to Software rating ascertainment for space camera
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Software rating ascertainment is very important in development of space camera software system. It can guide the software measurement and management, and help designer improve system reliability finally. Fault Tree Analysis is a common method to analyze the danger reason and fix on bottom events. The most significant step is calculating the occurrence probabilistic of top event, namely the occurrence probabilistic of dangerous event. Because software failure cause is anfractuous and available data are hard to get, a modeling method for bottom event is proposed based on Vague set to calculate the occurrence probabilistic of top event. Experimental results show that the new approach of Vague set can guide the Software rating ascertainment which is ascertained using qualitative analysis. The results also show that the new method makes software rating ascertainment have the quantificational evidence.

articleTitle: A novel method of recovering camera parameter from dynamic texture video
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Dynamic texture is a part of the natural scene. Video augmentation is research hotspot in the field of computer vision and even robot research area. Robust camera tracking plays a key role in augmented video. It is an important issue in dynamic texture video augmentation. We propose an efficient and robust approach to structure and motion recovery for dynamic texture video augmentation. First we present an efficient level set method to segment dynamic texture from video. Based on this, a new method of recovering camera parameter is put forward. Experiments show that the proposed method is very efficient in recovering camera parameter in the dynamic texture video and can overcome more error of traditional method.

articleTitle: The study on the Central Part of China's economic development comprehensive strength
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper builds up the comprehensive evaluation system of the economic development strength based on economic aggregate, structure and so on, and uses the method of Principal Component Analysis to analyze the six provinces' comprehensive strength. Finally, some advises based on the economic status have put forward to raise the economic development level of the Central Part of China.

articleTitle: Design and realization of 2.4GHz frequency synthesizer using 0.18µm CMOS technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A PLL (phase-locked loop)-type 2.4GHz frequency synthesizer is designed in the standard 0.18µm mixed-signal and RF 1P6M CMOS technology of SMIC. It integrates a VCO, a dual-modulus prescaler, PFD, a charge pump, a control logic, various digital counters and digital registers onto a single chip. With the help of the linear model of the loop, the design and optimization of the loop parameters are discussed in detailed. The VCO is implemented in the CMOS technology of SMIC. The measured phase noise is −125.3 dBc/Hz at offset frequency 1 MHz from the carrier of 2.466 GHz while the VCO core circuit draws only 720 µW from a 0.4 V supply. The designed VCO can cover the frequency range from 2.28 to 2.48 GHz. The simulated results of the PLL show that frequency synthesizer can be in the locked-state quickly. The layout area is 0.675 mm×0.750 mm. The DC power consumption of the core part is about 20 mW under 1.8 V supply.

articleTitle: Study on the industrial transfer of Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper made an empirical study on the industrial transfer of Shaanxi Province, through the statistical data of 2006 and 2007. It analyzed from the point of the industrial attractiveness and the industrial transfer direction. The industrial attractiveness involves three aspects: the competitive advantage, the comparative advantage, the growth potential; The industrial transfer direction involves two aspects: the transfer scale of domestic and foreign capital, industrial transfer tendency. Integrated the two, it divided the industries to four categories: the pillar industries, the industries need to guide, the industries need to cultivate, and the thin dog industries. Finally, it gave some suggestions.

articleTitle: The development and application of GIS on power marketing and expansion
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper was finished the development and design of the big customer of power expansion system on the basis of mapinfo platform and combining GIS system technology according to the practical problem appeared in area power company traditional marketing and expansion operating mode. The system that power attribute information and geographical graphic information were combined organically was mainly achieved the functions of image layer, zooming graphic, statistical analysis and the localization and fuzzy search of power facilities such as power substation, switching station, and also the application function of GIS system links to the CAD system and SCADA system. Practice shows that: The application of GIS system on power marketing and expansion system, can not only realize the effect of visual display, quick inquiry, and data management and update of power facilities and circuits, but also be connected with other system data, and exist data graphically. The most important function of system is improving the working efficiency, avoiding the repeated investment, and saving lots of resources and operating costs.

articleTitle: Reconstructing continuous population density surface from polygon-based data
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: socioeconomic data such as population are collected and represented as attributes of spatial polygons (census tract). And this representation ignores real internal variance and leads a limitation of the usage of such data. This paper proposes an approach to reconstructing continuous density surface which describes internal variation of each polygon. The approach keeps three rules: 1) The surface is smooth without steps; 2) The volume of each polygon is preserved; 3) The distribution of derived population density coincides with the real population distribution approximately. And an assessment of the approach is given by comparing data got by reaggregation with the census data of some polygons on a smaller scale. The results show the applicability of the approach and an improvement of the precision of the surface. And the surface of the population density can be applied in further researches.

articleTitle: An extended model of Petri net and application in DEDS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The logic supervisor and structural supervisor based on controlled Petri net are difficult to model discrete event dynamic systems (DEDS) when the initial system state is uncertain or illegal. An extended Petri net is provided to solve the problem. The net (Jade-structure) just adjusts basic element of Petri net, and is adopted to model the open loop feedback control systems. The model of DEDS based on Jade-structure, is controlled by control conditions and makes system run in legal state space. The supervisor of Jade-structure based on system state (M-Jade) and the other supervisor based on the transition set of Jade-structure (T-Jade) are formally described, and M-Jade is extended to three extended models. The first extended model based on the subset of the place set, judges part of system current state and adjusts system state. The second based on the restriction inequations set of system state, judges the system current state equation and adjusts system state. The last adjusts system state by negative vectors. The controlled Jade-structure (C-Jade) based on T-Jade and M-Jade, models to DEDS with controlled places and uncontrolled places. When DEDS sets uncertain initial state, the controlled structure uses a set of restriction in-equations to avoid system running into illegal state place without computing the whole state place. If system meets abnormities, C-Jade structure makes system run back to permitted state place by negative vectors. And negative vectors and restriction in-equations also can be set by judging the marking of place subset. An example was modeled and validated by C-Jade, and the characteristics of C-Jade were discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the residents' justice perception of tourism development in world natural heritage area
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This research combined organizational justice theory, tourism perception theory and related analysis tool to explore the major factors that influenced the residents' justice perception of tourism development in world natural heritage in China. Data shows that the interest distribution justice of tourism development is the top concern of local residents, and followed by procedure justice and interactive justice. The factors that influence residents' overall perception of tourism development justice are the interactive justice, procedure justice and interest distribution justice in sequence. This result is comparatively coherent with the result of organizational justice research, which proved the applicability of organizational justice theory and its analysis tool in world natural heritage management research.

articleTitle: Research and application of remote sensing image classification technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Image classification of remote sensing includes choice of classification methods, extract of image features, choice and optimization of testing samples, decision of accuracy indexes etc. The paper will analyze and research these items with TM image of Hefei based on evidence theory and neural network.

articleTitle: Study of WebGIS architechture based on GML and SVG
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The development of the Internet provides a great opportunity to the development of WebGIS, W3C launched GML and SVG standards for the development of WebGIS and opened up new way. In this paper, the system uses GML for data storage and exchange, SVG as a display of spatial data, and develops a GML and SVG file format standards based on systems need; In order to avoid large amount of data to reflect the impact of speed on the spatial data system, Introduced mid-tier database of SOA to raise the browser and operating speed; GML and SVG in the framework of standard documents, to achieve a multi-source heterogeneous data conversion. And we had built a WebGIS applications based on GML and SVG.

articleTitle: Linear adaptive control in the cantilever construction of long-span PC continuous beam bridge
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Linear control is very important in the cantilever construction of long-span PC contiunous beam bridge, which is directly related to the success or failure of the beam bridge project. Long-span PC contiunous beam bridge has a more difficult linear control than generic beam bridge because of the long-span, so an effective linear control method is very necessary. Based on the adaptive control theory, this paper tries to form a linear adaptive control system. It mainly contains model modification subsystem, theoretical calculation subsystem and monitoring control subsystem.

articleTitle: The influence of political connections on the firm value of small and medium-sized enterprises in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The firm value of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) was affected by many factors, such as the shareholders, cash flow, and government relationship. This paper investigated the influence of the political connections on the firm value of SMEs in China. The affect of political connections on the effectiveness of firm value was analyzed by using the empirical data. The results show that political connections are key factors and have negative influence on firm value of SMEs in China.

articleTitle: Marine shafting reasonable alignment design based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Marine shafting alignment is an indispensable part of marine propulsion shafting design and installation. In this paper, the marine shafting reasonable alignment based on genetic algorithm is investigated. The three-moment theory is utilized to analyze the bearing loads at straight alignment and bearing additional loads caused by offsets of bearings and inflections of flanges. An optimization model of reasonable alignment is constructed in which both the maximum and mean of loads for bearings are taken as the objective function while the offsets of bearings and inflections of flanges are all considered. The constrained optimal design problem is solved using real coded genetic algorithm avoiding of the sensitivity analysis. The correctness and validity of the design method are illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Research on project management mode selection and project organization design of manufacturing enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Engineering construction projects usually have characteristics of long duration, large investment, complex technology and high risk. While the majority of manufacturing enterprises in China at present are lack of project management experience and capacity. At the same time, common project management modes usually have their own advantages and disadvantages in current marketing environment in China. This paper innovatively proposes a mixed project management mode and its implementation methods mainly based on the actual characteristics and needs of manufacturing enterprise. It analyzes the key points when the owner is managing and controlling projects under this mode. On this basis it designs the organization structure mode to fit with the special project management mode. Many practices have showed that this kind of design has positive effects on improving the project management capabilities of manufacturing enterprises from two levels of external and internal, and it also ensures the achievement of project objectives.

articleTitle: Demonstration study on EAP management of construction project manager—A case study of project manager in Zhejiang province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of the society, stress management is becoming the focus of enterprises, and the Employee Assistance Program is considered as the most effective way to it. Thus, how to conduct the Employee Assistance Program is the key issue about promoting the constant development of enterprises and ensuring employees' psychological health. This paper selects project managers as the study object, analyzing the effects of the Employee Assistance Program on project manager's stress through the questionnaire research. Based on the statistical analysis, it suggests that precaution take effects as well as promoting project managers' self-adoption.

articleTitle: A column-based self-organizing hybrid storage model for data warehouse
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Storage structures of data are critically important for performance and scalability. In read-mostly analytic applications, column-store exhibits significant advantage over row store. In column-store, one of the most cost-time operations is on-the-fly tuple reconstruction for multi-attribute queries. In this paper we propose a column-based self-organizing hybrid storage model suiting data warehouse workload, also define query relativity between attributes in a relational table. In our proposed model, a given relational table is stored by column first, strongly-relative multiple columns within a relational table are solidified in store device according to users' conventions then. During the system's running, it dynamically tunes solidified multi-columns to adapt physical storage of data to usage convention, i.e. strongly relative multi-columns can be solidified together as in good time as possible so that achieving fundamental performance improvement. The proposed method also automatically removes existing solidified multi-columns being no longer strongly-relative, to avoid excessive expansion of stored data. Finally, we analyze the advantage of our model over alternative storage structures and apply the proposed model to our column-oriented data warehouse management system being developed.

articleTitle: Government green procurement implementation plan in Shenyang
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the Shenyang municipal government green procurement implementation plan, defines the planning goal of government green procurement. Work through the implementation of green procurement, to achieve the objectives of Shenyang government green procurement.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Network on Chip, LAN and Internet
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ever since the inception of Internet, communication has taken a different dimension. As many other communication media are dieing off, more are being explored. In this research work, we were able to explicitly explain and compare communications in Network on Chip (NoC), Local Area Network (LAN) and the Internet. We also looked at the differences and similarities of these different networks based on quality of service, OSI model, fault tolerance, network architecture and routing algorithms.

articleTitle: Research and development of fitness equipment system based on Open Cobalt
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Most fitness equipments are unitary in function, lacking enjoyment and interactive features. To solve this problem, a software system running in treadmill with virtual scene is developed. This paper describes how to implement such kind of system by using Open Cobalt, LDAP and distributed virtual system. Implementation technique include: terrain rendering, sky effects, dynamic timing systems, human-computer interaction and network functions based on Open Cobalt.

articleTitle: Chinese foreign investment strategy based on technological upgrading
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Effective technological innovation and upgrading of enterprises has become the main form and strategic direction of international competition. Chinese MNCs should implement the investment strategies based on the technology upgrading and catch up the technological developments and trends in the world. It is specific for different investment strategies under different technological upgrading, such as Cross-border M & A, Strategic Alliance and Greenfield. The impact factors to technological upgrading include both micro and macro.

articleTitle: Elimination of redundant information for search engine
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The results of search engine usually contain a number of redundant information and how to eliminate it has become technology issues waiting to be explored. This paper proposed an improved elimination algorithm based on best similarity of the results. By analyzing the search results, extracting their key words, comparing the similarities, and clustering the results, the algorithm can eliminate the useless and reduplicate results. The experimental results show that the performance of the elimination algorithm in this paper has been much improved compared to spectral segmentation algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on reservoir stage operation based on the probability combination
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in reservoir stage operation at present, a new method was proposed based on probability combination principle in probability theory, the equal formula of the reservoir flood control standard was given specifically, and the flood-limited water level of each stage was determined by the situation that the reservoir flood control standard is not reduced. Analyzed and calculated results of the example project indicate that the water level for flood control in the end of the flood season can be raised by 1.80m at the most; as a result, the overall efficiency of the reservoir will be increased greatly. The method can provide the reference for flood control optimal operation of the built reservoir.

articleTitle: Performance of Average Differential Transmitted Reference UWB system base on decision feedback
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, An Average Differential Transmitted Reference (ADTR) Ultra-Wideband impulse radio (UWB IR) system is proposed. The proposed scheme has low complexity and is no need to waste resources for transmitting reference signal. The performance of the proposed system conditioned on a multipath channel is analyzed and simulated. The results show that the proposed system gives a better performance than that of Average TR (ATR) system and Differential TR (DTR) system.

articleTitle: Study on selection methodologies and portfolio strategies of enterprises e-commerce models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper summarizes research results and analyzes the existing problems in the enterprises e-commerce models fields. Two main selection methodologies of enterprises e-commerce models based on resource and capability of enterprises and the dynamic competition environments are described. Based on the information system strategic planning theories, a portfolio tactics is proposed to give enterprises the guidance for transformation from only one e-commerce model to models alignment of more than one. This paper makes an attempt at to expand operating and management models of enterprises and e-commerce theory system. In addition, it also can guide enterprises to enhance the anti-risk capability, improve operating models, promote the rapid development of enterprises, and drive e-commerce technologies application to the all enterprises.

articleTitle: New research of forward displacement analysis of 6-link Assur group
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Conformal geometric algebra (CGA) Method is applied in displacement analysis of planar basic kinematic chain to complete forward displacement analysis of a kind of 6-link and 9-pair Assur group. Three geometry constrain equations are obtained by using Conformal geometric algebra (CGA). Second two variables were eliminated through the elimination of linear and Dixon (Dixon) resultant Finally, a 18<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> degree equation contained a variable was properly derived from the resultant, A numeric example is given and 18 groups of solutions are verified explicitly without extraneous roots and miss roots.

articleTitle: Integrating method and modeling tools of multi-platform and interdisciplinary system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This article focused on how to establish an integration model on existed systems and resources. The new method converted the traditional way of information exchanging that conducted at an universal platform to communication directly among resources. It improved the adaptability and extensibility of the integration. Specifically, a multi-platform and interdisciplinary integration method: the SOIDM (Services Oriented Integrated Describe Model), extended from SOA framework, was proposed. The model that stored in XML described tasks, executors, resources and relations among them. A graph editor was developed to help to establish the model. And an example of Virtual Prototype System was given at the last part to demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on supply chain management and optimization models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper mainly discusses distributors' different competitive behaviors and the sensitivity of distribution quantity to the prices so that the order decision of a distribution system is researched. The profit models of producer and distributors are developed respectively. Operational research and game theory are utilized to solve the models and the experimental results show that the algorithm can wonderfully analyze the distribution system.

articleTitle: Analysis on Trendy Characteristics and differences of Environmental Kuznets Curve of Main Pollutants in Chinese big urban area
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the Base of relevant data relationship between economic growth and environment quality are analyzed to show Trendy Characteristics of Environmental Kuznets Curve of Main Pollutants in Beijing and Tianjin Region during 1985∼2008. It is concluded that new type curves which differ form traditional EKC curve are possible. The overall relationship between the environment and the economy in Beijing and Tianjin region has entered a “win-win” stage, while the pressure of pollution control is greater in Beijing. The turning points of major pollutant EKC in Beijing and Tianjin region are slightly lower than that in the developed countries. In addition, the trendy characteristics of the same kind of pollutants are quite similar in Beijing and Tianjin regions.

articleTitle: Dual airport pseudolites backup approach and landing system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Differential GPS is the most promising method to replace the ILS and MLS, however, the integrity and continuity cannot be met all the time. Thus, the backup approach and landing system based on dual airport pseudolites is proposed and correspondent algorithm is studied. The simulation results show that the airport pseudolite signals can effectively correct the INS position errors and provide the landing information met the CATI requirements, hence of great value in practice.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on relation between ODI and foreign trade of China's bulk commodities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the study of Chinese bulk commodities, on the basis of existing research results from home and abroad, with data of China's exports and outward direct investments with major countries in 2003–2008, this paper establishd a panel data model and tested and analysed the relation between outward direct investments and foreign trades. Research showd that China's exports had significant positive effect on Chinese outward direct investment. Their relation is “cooperation” complementary relation and expansion of exports would promote foreign direct investments.

articleTitle: Research and application of stereoscopic display based on viewpoint transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Although conventional stereoscopic display can provide us better lays of graphics, observers in different locations observe the same stereoscopic image so that motion parallax can not be simulated and there is no a strong spatial cognition. This paper describes a new way to realize a stereoscopic display system in which the moving of virtual camera is controlled by the result of visual inspection and stereoscopic images in corresponding positions can be generated. In this way, the motion parallax and visual field changes can be simulated and it makes the virtual reality possess a strong sense of reality. Tested by experiments, this method meets the need of the system and achieves anticipated effect. The method has been successfully applied in Zhangjiagang Science and Technology Museum.

articleTitle: Influential factors of key account maintenance in Xinjiang fixed telecom industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the reconstruction of telecommunication industry, the fixed telecom market has broken monopoly totally and represented competitive situation. Compared with public customers, key accounts of big size and huge demand have become the competitive focus among great operators. The paper specifies the general formation mechanism of key account loyalty, explores the main reasons of customer retention, and proposes a model of customer retention. From the theoretical perspectives, the paper empirically validates the model based on the samples of China Unicom. Lastly, this paper proposed management practice, limitations, and future research directions.

articleTitle: FMRI image registration based on normalized maximum mutual information & genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the research of brain and cognitive science based on fMRI, the subject needs to be measured many times during the functional imaging experiments. There is a slight head-movement inevitably during the experiment, so the fMRI images must be registered precisely. An fMRI image registration approach was proposed based on normalized maximum mutual information, Simplex and genetic algorithm. In the algorithm, we utilize normalized maximum mutual information as the similarity measurement; genetic algorithm and Nelder-Mead's simplex method are respectively responsible for the global approximate optimization and local accurate search of image translation and rotation parameters. According to the registration analysis of the time series fMRI images, this algorithm is proved to be a precise, fast approach compared with the traditional direct search method and genetic algorithm. The experimental results show that the registration precision is improved while maintaining robustness.

articleTitle: New method for ranking fuzzy numbers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the fragmentation of fuzzy numbers is defined as new sort indicators Based on the Centroid and fragmentation of fuzzy numbers, paper proposes a new ranking method of fuzzy numbers which can overcome the shortcomings of some ranking method to some degree. At last, paper illustrates the practicability of the proposed method by the analysis of examples.

articleTitle: The review of methods on the domestic calculation of Logistics Parks' scale
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The scale of Logistics Park in all regions affected by the level of local economic development and various factors, so it must be scientifically and rationally calculated and planned. But the reality is that the blind construction of Logistics Parks began to emerge, which can't decrease the cost, or stop the loss of state assets. Therefore, we must sum up the experience all over the Logistics Parks and the scientific methods of academic research; determine reasonable Logistics Parks' scale to avoid the problem of blind construction and expansion. This paper describes and comments in recent years, domestic methods for determining the scale of Logistics Parks, hoping to determine the size of the Logistics Park has a guiding role.

articleTitle: Study on the kinetic process mechanism of purifying SO2 and NOx simultaneously from flue gas by liquid catalyzed oxidation-microbiological method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A study on the kinetic process mechanism of the SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> removal simultaneously from flue gas by liquid catalyzed oxidation-microbiological method, which could greatly improve the SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> purification capability of biotrickling filter, was studied in this article. Chemical catalyzed oxidation process and biological oxidation process were mainly included in the experimental systems of biotrickling filter which performed desulfuration and denitrification purification process. The findings of kinetic process suggested that the biochemical degradation reactions of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> in biofilm were both first-order reactions. The biochemical reactions of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NO were both the fast-rate reactions. To promote the purification process rate could by accelerating the mass-transfer rate of SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> from main stream of gas flow to the surface of moist microorganism membrane.

Author Keywords: flue gas desulfuration and denitrification simultaneously

articleTitle: Predicting short-term coke price by nonlinear semiparametric regression method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To improve short-term coke price prediction accuracy, a semiparametric regression idea and linear and Nonlinear semiparametric regression models are specified in this Article, on the basis of the coke consumption characteristics, the coke consumption market data for January 1997 to April 2009, as well as the regression analysis method. In the linear estimation results, the parameters of semiparametric regression model are the price of cast iron, nonparameters are coke output. Cross Valuation Method is applied for choice of optimum window frame. Parabola kernel is chosen for kernel function. Semiparametric model prediction method is lease square estimation method. The cases of coke>40mm indicate that Nonlinear semiparametric regression estimation is more accurate, it's an effective tool for predicting short-term coke price.

articleTitle: Study about construction of secondary vocational schools' teachers group in sichuan province in policy system perspective
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Construction of secondary vocational school's teachers group in Sichuan Province has made great development in the past 30 years, which benefited from educational policies. The thesis talks about process of policy system of construction of secondary vocational school's teachers group in Sichuan Province, and represents the achievement of construction of secondary vocational school's teachers group with policy system supporting in Sichuan Province. Then come to the inspirations of construction of secondary vocational school's teachers group in Sichuan Province in policy system perspective. Here are some inspirations, educational policies' laying down and perfection is new demand for talents with social development; educational policies are the important conditions of teachers group construction; educational policies should be clearly oriented and solve the prominent problems in different eras; educational policy system can better ensure the implementation of the education policy and promote education develop rapidly and healthily; effect is the touchstone of educational policy system.

Author Keywords: Secondary Vocational School's Teachers Group in Sichuan Province

articleTitle: Landscape pattern change of land use in the typical area of the Hanjiang River Basin
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With remote sensing data and GIS, the classification system of land landscape in the typical area of the Hanjiang River Basin is established. Using the indexes of the landscape pattern index and the ecological value index (EVI),this article presents the dynamic change of the landscape pattern from 1986 to 2006. The results showed that: (1)There is a dramatic staggered change. From the year of 1986 to 1996, the absolute change extent obey the following sequence: no use land > forest land > build land > cultivated land> water > grassland; and from 1996 to 2006, no use land > build land > forest land > cultivated land> water > grassland. Over the past 20 years, no use land > build land > forest land > cultivated land> water > grassland.(2)The landscape of the Basin tended to become more fragmentized. From 1986 to 1996, the landscape of Hanjiang River Basin tended to become more fragmentized. The patches, in general, became smaller, more even, and less complex. The Ecological Value Index (EVI) of the whole catchment grown upon from 6661 to 6687. From 1996 to 2006, the catchment landscape became more fragmentized as before, and the amount of patches increased, and the average size of patches increased. The patches became more complex with Ecological Value Index rising from 6687 to 6783, as shows that the ecological situation of the catchment was being improved.

articleTitle: An analysis of information technology and logistics distribution models in E-commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Logistics is a key factor in E-commerce in that it plays a vital role of fulfilling virtual transactions in the real world. Distribution plans and operations are eventually based on information technology and system, which is an important feature of e-logistics. The selection of distribution models should be considered from various angles. E-commerce and distribution are interdependent and mutually reinforcing with each other. China's logistics distribution companies shall seize the opportunity of business model innovation, facilitate the transportation and storage technology and information technology and improve the professionalism of the whole industry in the context of e-commerce era.

articleTitle: The study of modeling experiment in loading properties for super-long single pile in over-wet loess
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to explore the loading properties for super-long single pile in over-wet loess, a modeling experiment was designed in modeling basin in-door, in which displacement sensor was used to detect the displacement of pile top and camera and dial gauge were used to detect the displacement of pile bottom. The conclusion from the experiment was drawn as following. Axial force of piles decreased in a nonlinear way along the pile body, and the stronger loading was, the more obvious the nonlinear was. Axial force of hollow bottom pile decreased quicker than that of solid bottom pile. Lateral friction of foundation soil gradually acted with the loading increasing and the maximal lateral friction position likely moved down with the loading increasing. When reaching the maximal loading, the maximal lateral friction position was nearly at the 2/3 position of pile. That's the lateral friction of about 2/3 of pile reached the limit, and then the whole pile reached the limit. The relation curve between the lateral friction and displacement of the solid pile was mostly three lines type, while that of the hollow pile showed slow changing feature.

articleTitle: A new fast and strong robust recognition algorithm for strain gauge
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Strain gauge's fast and effective recognition places a great importance in industrial applications. In actual application, the absorption position of the strain gauge is not unity and the strain gauge is quite light and thin, which cause the absorption of the strain gauge of the mechanical arm produce much revolves and translates. The traditional Wavelet moment algorithm can well reflect the regional information of image and is invariant to rotation, scale and offset, but for the industrial production, the operand is big, which is not suitable for the fast request. To address this shortcoming, this paper uses the multi-criteria decompose of the wavelet under the polar coordinate algorithm to extract wavelet moment of the low frequency sub graph, then uses PCA to do the recognition. Experimental results obtained by our methods demonstrated that the wavelet moment combined with PCA algorithm can obtain 100 percent of the recognition rate and c an massively reduce the strain gauge's recognition time, which can be well used in industrial applications.

articleTitle: Attribute reduction in MADM problems based on triangular fuzzy numbers
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an attribute reduction algorithm of fuzzy MADM problems based on triangular fuzzy numbers is introduced. The purpose of this algorithm is to look for order-preserving attribute subsets (O-reducts) of the original attribute set, therefore simplify decision making process. For real life applications, there are always many attributes in the multiple attribute decision making problems, when we use order-preserving attribute sets instead of the original attribute set, not only the efficiency would be increased, but also time and money used in obtaining data and deriving ranking orders are reduced. To further demonstrate our algorithm, a numerical example with several feasible O-reducts is illustrated.

articleTitle: The project duration risk analysis based on earned value measurement
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The project duration risk analysis has become more and more important with project management raised the duration requirement. Most of the existing analysis methods lack the linkage analysis of cost risk, aimed at this disadvantage, this paper proposes a new analysis method to project duration risk based on earned value measurement, discusses the different possible risk types under different earned value indexes, then divides the severity of duration risk into five different levels which will be convenient for project managers to take measures. Furthermore, an example is given behind in detail expressly illustrated the analysis process.

articleTitle: The research on stock price forcast methods
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to effectively predict the stock price in Chinese security market, this study establishes GM and SVM model; it analyzes the influence of financial indicators on listed companies and compares different stock price forecast methods. The research takes Chinese listed companies in shanghai A-stock market as sample, pretreats and introduces the financial indicators into the models, and finally compares the prediction effects of different models. As have been present in the thesis, different forecast methods should be used in different economic cycles, due to the demand for perfect predicting effects and results.

articleTitle: Power customer credit rating based on FCM and the differential marketing strategy research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Electric power customers are strategic center of power supply enterprise. The timely recovery of electricity charge and other receivables are the main sources of achieving operating efficiency and obtaining power grid construction and maintenance costs. So how to assess power customer's credit rating and carry out credit risk management become important to the operation of electric power companies. The FCM method could analyze and classify the customer credit which provided the quantitative basis for characteristics analysis of the customers and obtained the satisfactory customer clustering and classification. The differential marketing strategies based on power customer credit rating were put forward to make better applied to real work.

articleTitle: The design of the unified Vulnerability Scanning system based on SOA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vulnerability Scanning is an important detection method to enhance the information security. At present, for some reasons of independence and incompatibility among the Vulnerability Scanners, we can't accomplish the management and analysis of the unified scanning in actual networks. According to this problem, this paper introduces a unified system of the vulnerability scanning based on the framework of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and expounds the structure of the system and key technique for implementing the integration deeply. Thereby the analysis of Vulnerability information and the management of equipments' vulnerability in the networks administered by the system can be fulfilled.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Define some related concepts in tourism research
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Multi-factor analysis based on enterprise's knowledge management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper analyzes the interaction between knowledge management and multiple factors, i.e. information technology, human and technological innovation, based on the characteristics of enterprise knowledge management. The paper comprehensively researches the knowledge-based, human-oriented knowledge management that relies on information technology as the carrier and interprets reasons, intension, category and the development trend for the formation of the three theories. The paper also clarifies that knowledge management is not equal to information technology but information technology is a necessity in order to realize knowledge management, and people play a critical role in knowledge management.

articleTitle: The analysis of effect of the government regulation on the polluting behavior of enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid economic development in China, the industrial pollution emission seriously threatens our living environment. Due to the lack of external constraints, enterprises may not consciously control polluting and protect environment. So it is essential for the government to implement regulation on the polluting behavior of enterprises. The reason of environmental pollution is the externality of the polluting behavior. After introducing the principle and the objective of government regulation in the control of pollution, the paper analyzes the influence of government regulation on the polluting behavior of enterprises on the basis of game theory. The conclusion is that the effective punishing measures must be taken to give full play to the role of government regulation.

articleTitle: Crystallizer non-sinusoidal oscillation electro-hydraulic servo system design and PID simulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Along with the development of steel continuous casting, Crystallizer oscillation technology becomes an important measure to increase productivity and improve product quality. In this paper, based on the advanced hydraulic servo technology, a servo oscillation system is set up by electro-hydraulic servo valve, servo cylinder and so on. Digital models are then built according to actual production parameters. The improved PID control method is also introduced. Finally, MATLAB is adopted to simulate and analyze this system. The system is proved to be quick, accurate, stable and highly feasible.

articleTitle: Applying fuzzy sets and linear programming for measuring total duration in a project network with fuzzy activity duration
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the traditional CPM/PERT model, the durations of activities are either represented as crisp numbers or drawn from the beta distribution to estimate the task durations. However, the operation time for each activity is usually difficult to define and estimate precisely in a real situation. The aim of this paper is to present an analytical method for measuring the total duration of a project network with fuzzy activity times. The method is mainly based on the linear programming (LP) formulation and Zadeh's extension principle. In the last, an example illustrates that the proposed approach is able to find the membership function of the total duration time.

articleTitle: A backbone communication network security situation prediction method
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The central position of backbone communication network determines that its security situation awareness is important and the large scale capacity of backbone network determines that its security situation prediction can not copy the method which is used in user network. Aiming at the large scale capacity and regular traffic characteristic parameters of backbone communication network, this paper presents a backbone communication network security situation prediction method. This method first chooses key flow characteristic parameters, and then forecasts the traffic characteristic parameters, finally predicts the backbone communications network security situation. Prediction results using real network traffic data show that this method can effectively predict backbone communications network security situation, which provide the basis for security decisions.

articleTitle: Study on the co-opetition of eco-industrial chain members by system dynamics methods
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The competition and cooperation relationship is the key factor that maintains the stable development of Ecological Industry Chain. This paper uses the system dynamics vensim software to simulate the enterprise competition and cooperation relationship in the hybrid Ecological Industry Chain. Based on the data collected from Sino-Singapore Eco-park, the waste material flow is transferred into power which is then quantified. The mathematic model and dynamic development are combined through the vensim software. The competition and cooperation relationship development of the whole ecological industry chain is simulated. So did the competition and cooperation relationship among core enterprises and between the core enterprises and supplementary enterprises, which could provide bases for decision making.

articleTitle: The symmetric compact finite difference method for nonlinear two-order boundary value problems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper a symmetric compact finite difference method is presented for solving nonlinear two order two point boundary scheme of the form y″ = f(t, y) with boundary conditions y(a) = A, y(b) = B. The corresponding finite difference scheme with tridiagonal matrix is given by replacing the exponent terms by Padé approximation. Meanwhile, the error estimates of the method are established. Compared with other traditional methods, the advantages of the method are compact and simple. Several numerical examples are also given to show the validity and applicability of the method.

articleTitle: Curriculum construction in bilingual education for future practitioners of tourism industry: From the perspective of subject matter
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The objective of this study was to explore the subject matter in curriculum construction of bilingual education (BE) for majors of tourism management (MTM) in Chinese tertiary education (CTE). Data (n=157) were collected from school administrators, BE teachers, MTM, and insiders of tourism industry via self-administered questionnaire. The subject matter of BE was elaborated based on Joseph Schwab's notion of four commonplaces—the subject matter, the learner, the teacher, and the milieu in curriculum construction. The results of this study showed the criteria in selecting BE courses, their linkage and continuity with other relevant units, terms and time allocation for BE courses, teaching pedagogies and classroom teaching-learning process design. Moreover, a unique process evaluating effectiveness of the subject matter for MTM was posited in line with Ralph Tyler's concept of curriculum continuum. The implication of this research is also discussed at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Study on the incentive strategies of knowledge employees
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the era of the knowledge economy, corporate survival and development is closely related with the knowledge employees. The output of knowledge employees depends largely on the quantity and quality of enterprise incentive for them. In view of the current problems of knowledge-based business in staff motivation, this paper puts forwards several proposals from aspects of incentive mechanism, incentive intensity, incentives measures, social security system, human resource development, and performance appraisal feedback mechanism.

articleTitle: A method for classifying network security threats
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to detect and evaluate network security threats more pertinent, a method for classifying network security threats is proposed based on the analysis of the technology challenges for classification theory and the limitation of related work. On the basis of multi-dimension structure, detailed hierarchical subdivision is given. This method can defines network security threats accurately because of its good universality and expansibility. This study guiding the identification and detection of threats faced by networks has laid a foundation for the research on countermeasures for network disaster tolerance.

articleTitle: Empirical studies on the effect of financial crisis on the bilateral trade between Yunnan and ASEAN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of economic globalization and cross-border division of labor, It increases economic interdependence of national economies across the world through a rapid increase in cross-border movement of goods, service, technology and capital. On one hand, the international trade promotes the economic growth of ASEAN, on the other hand, the financial crisis gave the great negative impact to the export of ASEAN, the economic growth declined. Through the empirical studies, it is found that the trade between Yunnan and ASEAN suffered the great negative impact from the financial crisis, the volume of trade declined obviously. But the impact on different countries are different, the trade between Yunnan and Vietnam as well as the trade between Yunnan and Singapore declined more, meantime, the trade between Yunnan and the other eight countries got less impact. Finally, the suggestions to the development of the trade between Yunnan and ASEAN have been put forward.

articleTitle: Study of graduates' function in cooperative management model to graduates
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the continuous increasement of the number of graduates in higher institutions in China, it is difficult to manage all the graduates only by graduates management of the higher institutions, so some management models,such as double-level management system and three main quality management model, are raised. These management models can improve the efficiency of management, but they treate the graduates as the object of the management, and neglect the graduates' function in the management. This paper showes the collaboration management model, raises a manage model, i.e. improving the graduates' function in cooperative Management, and gives a count for how to improve the graduates' function in the manage model.

articleTitle: Application of optimized wavelet neural network to the evaluation of coal seam-roof stability based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Roof stability prediction features randomness, complexity and instability, and precise prediction places much value on theoretical and practical application. In light of the latest research, this paper, according to complicated nonlinear mapping relation between various influence factors and stability of intensity, turns out that the GA-WNN model of roof stability prediction, with optimized wavelet neural network based on genetic algorithm, is constructed. This method overcomes some drawbacks of BP algorithm, such as local minimum and over-fitting. The Practical simulation results show that GA-WNN model can effectively increase the diagnostic accuracy of the network and improve the speed of convergence. This model applies to estimation of coal roof stability.

articleTitle: Emergency logistics programming in natural disasters
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Logistics programming in natural involves dispatching commodities to distribution centres in disaster areas as soon as possible so that relief operations are accelerated. In this study, three planning models are to be integrated into a natural disaster logistics decision support system. The system readily decomposed into three problems the first one being fuzzy clustering disaster grades by historical data, the second one showing the grade distinguishment of new disaster areas based on fisher discrimination procedure, the last one giving plan incorporating relief commodities and equipment distributing in proper sequence in disaster areas. In emergency logistics context, supply is available in limited quantities at current time period but commodity demand is known with uncertainty at the time. So how to make grate use of the limited commodities under the uncertainty information, that is of great value. The mathematical models describe setting are considerably different than other conventional vehicle routing problem articles in the world. It suggests that macro adjustment is needed in emergency logistics programming in natural disasters, and it will drow more attention to this field in the near future.

articleTitle: A novel S/H circuit based on clock-controlled neuron-MOS transistor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new sample and hold (S/H) circuit using clock-controlled neuron-MOS transistor is presented. By employing a threshold compensation cell, the problem of threshold loss between the input voltage and the output voltage of a single neuron-MOS transistor-based source-follower, is solved, and thereby the accuracy of the circuit is improved. Due to applying threshold compensation technique, the proposed S/H circuit is suitable for low-voltage operation. Besides, by utilizing a high-functionality clock-controlled neuron-MOS transistor, the proposed S/H circuit has considerable simpler structure and achieves higher power saving than conventional implementations. The HSPICE simulation results using TSMC 0.35µm double-polysilicon CMOS technology validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Finally, a comparison is being made between the proposed circuit and previously reported ones.

articleTitle: Over-all supervision of deputy construction project based on contract WBS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On the basic of contractual agreement, firstly, work task will be dispersed in the application of work breakdown structure (WBS) to specify person liable and allocated resource of every working package. Further, their streamlining task need to be established to make overall work carried out under the instruction of this clear process. Finally, the whole process management of DCP will become a reality.

articleTitle: The application of improved Empirical Mode Decomposition Algorithm algorithm to the intelligent mechanical ventilation bed
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To forecast precisely the time series to the intelligent mechanical ventilation bed online, the improved Empirical Mode Decomposition Algorithm was introduced novel EMD algorithm (NEMD) was gotten in this paper by using piecewise power function to generate envelope curves and extending their end points. The improved EMD was utilized to decompose the de-noised data, Next, the BP Neural Network (NN) and Least Square Support Vector Machines (LSSVM) were used to predict the low frequency items and high frequency items of the decomposed sequence data. The modeling and simulation results indicate that the algorithm that the improved EMD algorithm was introduced in realized online can forecast the time series precisely.

articleTitle: Evaluation on structural changes of peasant's income growth in Heilongjiang reclamation area based on projection pursuit model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of diversity and complexity of elements of structural changes of peasant's income growth, in this paper, by using projection pursuit model to analyze the changes of peasant's net income changes in Heilongjiang reclamation area from 2004 to 2008, we found that on one hand policy shift income has been the new growing element for peasant's income growth in Heilongjiang reclamation area, on the other hand the wage income and the income from household business has been still the main part of peasant's net income, but their contribution to peasant's income growth in Heilongjiang reclamation area has been weakened. The research shows that the peasant's income growth needs not only the external environment support, i.e. policy, but also the development of the internal potential.

articleTitle: The distribution network reconfiguration based on spanning tree
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The genetic algorithm of intelligent optimization algorithm is important in the distribution system reconfiguration. Aiming at genetic algorithm, exact penalty function based fitness function is proposed in this paper. Introducing avoid cycle method decode chromosome produced by Grefenstette code and generate dendritic-shaped distribution network. The decoding process is as following: First, forming branch sets, one of sets is composed by the order of network branches, the other sets is composed by the order of cycle network branches. According to the rules that distribution network can't be isolated operation and loop-net operation, at last generate dendritic-shaped distribution network. On this basis carrying on genetic evolution and then finding the minimum value of distribution network active loss. In order to evaluate algorithm performance, this paper propose optimization rate evaluation index which the probability of genetic algorithm find the global optimal solution. Three typical IEEE distribution systems are analyzed, and then we can obtain that the algorithm optimization ability has significantly improved, it is validity for different system.

articleTitle: Application of EPC system in inland shipping
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of inland shipping, the key elements related to inland transportation, e.g., ships, cargoes, ports, ship companies, have strong demand on interconnection and information exchange. Thus, to some extent, interconnection and information exchange of relevant elements of the inland shipping have become a constraining bottleneck in the development of inland shipping informationization. Electronic Product Code (EPC) system is a promising solution to address above problems. In this paper, we propose an inland shipping EPC system based on Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology. Firstly, we introduce the conception of RFID technology and EPC system. Secondly, we exhibit the whole architecture of inland shipping EPC system. Lastly, we discuss the data model and implement details of EPC Information Service (EPCIS), which is a key component of inland shipping EPC system.

articleTitle: Research on the effects of reference group on impulse buying behavior
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on Fisher & Rook's studies in 1995, this research establishes a model, choosing reference group's number (one person or multi-people) and reference group's proposal (encouragement, discouragement or neutrality) as independent variables, and analyses the effect of those independent variables on impulse buying through the normative evaluation. This research makes use of scenario planning to collect data, carries out the empirical study on the survey of 286 undergraduates and utilizes SPSS13.0 to analyze the collected data. The findings test and verify that normative evaluation has moderating effect between impulse buying intention and impulse buying behavior, and find that reference group's number and reference group's proposal can affect significantly normative evaluation and affect impulse buying through the mediating effect of normative evaluation.

articleTitle: Impact of knowledge management and corporate social capital on firm performance—Taking firms in Xinjiang region as an example
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Focused on the concept of knowledge based view (KBV), and based on the 116 firms in Xinjiang region, the paper outlines the impact of two types of firms resources (knowledge resources, corporate social capital) on firm performance (strategic and financial ) direct, relevant and coordinated effects. Although the results show that the two resources are likely to improve firm performance, but also knowledge management is the main driving force to enhance strategic and financial performance. In addition, the domestic and multinational enterprise ownership plays a moderating effect role.

articleTitle: Risk analysis based optimization of water distribution system under uncertainty
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Mathematical modeling of water distribution systems is a crucial planning, design and operational activity. The vast majority of mathematical models in engineering use deterministic approaches to describe the behavior of water system. However, all real life problems incorporate reliability, risk and uncertainty in one way or another. There could be uncertainty in measurement, in parameter estimation, in which processes one should include in the model etc. Such contradiction between mathematical determinism and natural uncertainty can seriously affect the reliability of the results of modeling and optimization. New methods were developed for including risk and uncertainty into the water distribution system optimization process, with both single and multiple objectives. The methods were applied to a number of case studies for optimal design of real life water distribution systems.

articleTitle: Non-API oil tube thread types and its failure analysis by CAE technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the sealing and strength requirements of the casing, tubing, and down-hole tools in Shengli oil field, Non-API thread are adopted, which include VAM-TOP thread and FOX thread. The types and advantages of the particular thread are introduced in the paper. The features and sealing design of the special threads are discussed. These two kinds of special threads are applied in about 50 wells of the Shengli oilfield, and the overall effects are good. However, the casing strings of 4 wells failed to seal in the recent operations, which caused serious damages to the productions of these wells. The finite element model of the VAM-TOP thread and FOX thread are developed by the CAE(Computer Assistants Engineering) technology in the paper to find the reasons of failure. The calculating results show the reason of the thread sealing failure is the thread button does not accord with the standards.

articleTitle: An introductory study on the transfer calibration of MICROTOPS II hand-held sunphotometer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Transfer calibration method is one of the principal calibration methods, but there is still lack of the calibration for MICROTOPS II hand-held sun photometer with this method by domestic scholar. The article makes transfer calibration and accuracy verification for MICROTOPS II hand-held sun photometer by using CE318 sun photometer which has been calibrated accurately. The verification result shows that both the absolute errors and relative errors of the aerosol optical thickness (AOT) on each channel are small. Among these errors, the peak of the AOT average absolute error is 0.0105, additionally, the calibration error of the principal instrument CE318 is 0.01, so the final calibration error is 0.0205 which shows a satisfactory accuracy of the calibration.

articleTitle: The application of the monitoring system of water environment based on overlay network technology in the cold and arid region
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of computer network technology, overlay network technology is increasingly widely concerned. Aiming at many problems encountered in water environment monitoring, this paper mainly discusses the methods how to efficiently achieve the water environment monitoring and warning in the area of the special geographical environment and climate by online real-time monitoring system of water environment based on overlay network technology. Especially, we integrate the ETL process with the spatial database to analyze and process the complex heterogeneous data. Furthermore, we design a new network topology of the sensor node according to the characteristics and area of the water in Wuliangsuhai for the efficient application of real-time monitoring system of water environment based on overlay network technology in cold and arid region. Subsequently, this framework and network topology has been put into use in Wuliangsuhai for the on-line real-time water monitoring tests. The results show that the overlapping network architecture is feasible, network topology of the sensor node plays a key role for data acquisition and on-line analysis and early warning of heterogeneous data is efficient. Henceforth, we will further research on how to construct the more practical data analysis model of multidimensional cloud calculation and extended the applications.

articleTitle: Automatic coastline extraction in remotely sensed images using improved watershed algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents new application of a improved watershed algorithm in extraction of coastlines. The proposed algorithm uses a single queue and conditional neighborhood comparisons for processing 3_3, 5_5 neighboring pixels to reduce computational complexity while compared to the conventional watershed algorithm. The results compares with the conventional algorithm of coastlines extraction, the proposed algorithm has a clear and simple result including muddy coastlines, which needs less post-processing working.

articleTitle: The role of human resource information system among township enterprises in the West China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The impact of globalization and technological advancement has greatly promoted the adoption of human resource information system among township enterprises in the West China. This paper, based on a three-dimensional model comprising external environmental factors, technological factors as well as organizational factors, examines the roles that HRIS plays in increasing the competitive advantages of township enterprises, and discovers that the top managers' low perception on the importance of human resource information system, the human resource staff's lack of technological capabilities and changeable external environment have hindered the development of HRIS among township enterprises in the West China.

articleTitle: Implementation of publication system of geological data using open source GIS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
