abstract: the geological data system of the Central Asia is built to share the multi-sources, heterogeneous geological information on-line. The authors design the overall frame, the architecture and a functional module of general structure for the system. It uses PostgreSQL and PostGIS as the background spatial database, and uses Java, JavaScript as programming language to implement the system based on GeoServer in secondary development method. The goal of providing and sharing geological data is achieved so that users can browse these data through web interface easily. It facilitates researches on earth science.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Neural Network in mix design of high-volume fly-ash concrete
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the method of Artificial Neural Network, a strength prediction model for high-volume fly-ash concrete was built upon the experimental data and a software system for mix proportion design of high-volume fly-ash concrete had been developed by visual C++ 6.0. The problem of modular ambiguity in high-volume fly-ash concrete, the nonlinear influence of every composition on concrete performance, the multiple random factors have been solved. The experiment results show the method above mentioned is effective and feasible. It will avail to the massive application and utilization of high-volume fly-ash concrete because the model for the strength prediction is handy for operating, high precision in prediction and strong adaptability.

articleTitle: Biosorption of Pb(II) from aqueous solution by biomass of Neosartorya hiratsukae(M7): Equilibrium and kinetic studies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The biosorption characteristics of Pb(II) from aqueous solution using freeze-dried biomass of Neosartorya hiratsukae(M7) were investigated as a funtion of pH, contact time and initial concentration. The optimal pH for adsorption of Pb(II) was determined bo be 6.0. The pseudo-second-order kinetic model was found to be well suited for the adsorption process. Langmuir model fitted the equilibrium data better than Freundlich isotherm. The maxium adsorption capacity of M7 according to Langmuir isotherm was 42.55mg g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> at pH 6.0 and 30°C. FTIR analysis of M7 showed the possible functional groups of M7. Responsible for the lead biosorption were carboxylic, hydroxyl and amine groups etc. SEM analysis demonstrated the microporous structure of the biosorbent while EDX analysis confirmed the adsorption of Pb(II) on the biomass of M7.

articleTitle: Study on selection and optimization of life cycle warranty cost driver based on value engineering
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Basing on research background and status quo of cost driver's selection and optimization theory, the model of warranty cost driver selection which include design phase warranty cost driver, production phase warranty cost driver, after-sale service stage warranty cost driver is building in the paper with Value Engineering theory. The paper also expatiates on judgmental methods aiming at computing results and optimization methods of warranty cost drivers in different stages. The model releases from selecting pattern of warranty cost drivers rely on complex calculations and simple empirical judgment. The scientific practical warranty cost drivers management means are introduced, and they are more suitable to enterprise's actual operation.

articleTitle: A metadata generation method for massive data in distributed databases
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Being advertisements for source data, metadata is the very portal through which distributed-massive-data applications find data, but metadata generated by traditional methods cannot be automatically updated the time its source data changed. Generally speaking, it is just the data changed that users pay far most attention. So these methods cannot satisfy real-time navigating and instantly providing data requirement from the above applications. To solve the problem, a new method based on database triggers is presented to generate metadata dynamically, also design for data access engine based on metadata is introduced, in which both navigating and monitoring functions of metadata are applied, and it justified that dynamical generation of metadata can satisfied instantly finding and supplying data requirement from real-time distributed-massive-data applications.

articleTitle: Objective programming approach to supply chain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the pressure of global financial crisis, enterprises tend to enhance ability of Supply Chain Manegement (SCM) and their own advantages can be developed in the competition. A decision making model of multi-product multi-stage supply chain consisted of single manufacturer and single supplier is proposed in this article. The model is proved to be superior and efficient through application example. Reasonable decisions are suggested by analyzing the solution of dual problem. The decisions could help members of supply chain get more profits.

articleTitle: Spatial and temporal variations of landscape pattern in the northern of Qinghai Lake -taking the Gangcha county as an example
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the remote sensing image for information source, by using the methods of landscape index, from the county scale in north Qinghai Lake, to engage in the spatial-temporal analysis for the landscape change during 2000–2007. The result showed that: the degree of landscape fragmentation in north Qinghai Lake increased clearly in nearly 10 years, the separable degree had an upward tendency. The human activity is the main reason for the spatial and temporal variation.

articleTitle: Cluster analysis of entrepreneurial developing level of Chinese cities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The article selects the 24 cities from the 2007–2008 GEM survey as the research objects. By using “the number of private enterprise or self-employed household per ten thousands persons”, “the proportion of private economy in GDP”, “the entrepreneurial support service conditions”, “the entrepreneurial fundamental support service conditions” and “ the entrepreneurial atmosphere support conditions” as five cluster variables, the article assesses the entrepreneurial developing level of these 24 cities by applying the cluster analysis methodology. The article also analyzes four types of entrepreneurial city features and suggests the ways for the entrepreneurial environment improvement and enhancement.

articleTitle: Power spectrum analysis of maize based on wavelet de-noising
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to study the basic characteristics of maize signals, maize signal was decomposed through coif3 wavelet at 5 scales, de-noised and reconstructed. Then, power spectrum of the reconstructed signal was analyzed by Fast Fourier transform (FFT).The result showed that the strength of maize electrical signal was µV level and the distribution of frequency was below 2Hz. The 60% of the total energy in power spectrum of the signal was below 0.4Hz.

articleTitle: The computation and application of random consistency index
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is a method frequently used in mathematical modeling. Its consistency must be tested, after the positive reciprocal matrix of paired comparison is constructed. The formal test results of random consistency indices were of lower order. In practical application, for various factors are often involved, the computation of the test results of random indices of higher order is often complicated. Using Matlab software, we resolved the problem that positive reciprocal Matrix of any order be generated at random, thus we solved the problem that how to calculate random consistency index of high-order the better. The method is also applied to “the mathematical modeling of coal-mining safety alarm system”, with ideal results.

articleTitle: Recommendation strategies analysis in E-commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of personalized recommendation research, it has become increasingly important that how to select proper technology to set up recommendation system. In this paper, a few familiar personalized recommendation technologies are introduced briefly at first, while their characters are also analyzed. Then, corresponding strategies are put forward according to characteristics of products and guests. Structures of personalized recommendation system are suggested and their work principles are analyzed.

articleTitle: Based on grey correlation degree of spatial and temporal evolution of the response of infrastructures on the scale of Oasis city in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzed the Grey response of infrastructures on the scale of Oasis cities in Xinjiang by Comprehensive Grey Relation Degree method with city date in 1978–2007. The results showed: (1) Grey Response Degree(GRD) of infrastructure on cities comprehesive scale are middle response type.(2) Cities have the same minimum GRD of infrastructure, which stabilized about 0.5. But the maximum GRD of infrastructures are different. (3)The variations of GRD of temporal belong to declined, stability and ascending type.

articleTitle: Research on Ad Hoc network QOS multicast routing based on ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Ad Hoc network has the characteristics of Construction of the independent network, decentralization, dynamic changes in network topology, limited bandwidth and energy, etc. The introduction of multimedia services proposed QOS multicast routing needs for Ad Hoc network. Most of existent Ad Hoc network QOS multicast routing protocols use determinate routing, which has poor adaptability to dynamic changes of network topology. In this paper, after deep study the basic ant colony algorithm, the improved ant colony algorithm is applied in the establishment and maintenance of network multicast routing process. A new Ad Hoc network QOS multicast routing protocol based on ant colony algorithm is proposed in this paper. NS-2 Simulation results show that the protocol can effectively choose the path according to link quality, create and maintain the multicast tree, thus achieving the aims of low latency, balanced flow and reducing congestion.

articleTitle: Performance simulation and tap number selection of fractionally spaced DFE
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to select the tap number of feedforward filter of a fractionally spaced decision feedback equalizer (FS-DFE), the relationship between the order and the equalization performance was studied. Under the known channel characteristics, in variant signal noise ratio and order of feedforward filter, the optimal tap coefficients of FS-DFE was calculated with given algorithm, then the bit error rate performance was simulated using Monte Carlo method and compared with that of symbol spaced decision feedback equalizer (SS-DFE). Finally a method of how to select the order of FS-DFE feedforward filter based on simulation result was proposed and it could be taken as a reference of FS-DFE engineering design.

articleTitle: Infrared face recognition based on DWT and BP neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An efficient infrared face recognition method by combining discrete wavelet transformation(DWT) and BP neural network was proposed. Firstly, to get the principle information and reduce the dimensions of face, each infrared face image was decomposed into DWT coefficients by using two-level DWT. Then, the DWT coefficients was used to extract the useful features. Finally, based on the useful features extracted by DWT coefficients, the recognition result was getten by training of the BP neural network. The experiments conducted illustrate that the method proposed in this paper has better performance.

articleTitle: Congestion control research of underwater acoustic networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Congestion control is the key technology to ensure quality of network service. In underwater acoustic communication networks an important research area is how to control network congestion. Once detect the network congestion, we should take measures to solve congestion and make network return to normal data transmission. In this paper, we use congestion controller to solve network congestion problems. The simulation is done by software platform of OPNET and the results show that the mechanism we studied is feasible. It can resolve the network congestion effectively, achieve higher network throughput and less data packet delay.

articleTitle: Internal factors about performance of e-commerce
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Performance of e-commerce activities can decide success or failure; the internal factors affect the performance of e-commerce activities need to be found out. By regulating factors into four categories including supply chain management, market management, additional value of the customer experience, utilization of human resource, a common solution can be founded that is to each enterprise need to set a matched model of different power coefficient.

articleTitle: Remote Monitoring System of Construction Machinery transmission scheme for data compression algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The traditional lossless compression algorithms are aim for higher compress ratio, but they cannot meet the requirement of the Monitoring System of Construction Machinery. This paper raises an adaptive algorithm with adjustable compression ratio by requirements to meet the requests of different. The practice and experimental result shows that the improved algorithm is more efficient than the traditions one in the process of the Monitoring System of Construction Machinery.

articleTitle: Simulation of the temperature field of annulus multiphase flow in foam drilling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The physical property parameters and theological characteristics parameters of annular multiphase flow in foam drilling are sensitive parameters of temperature. Temperature distribution of annular multiphase flow affects its velocity field and pressure field directly. According to the realistic condition of foam drilling, this study, by use of Fluent simulation software, a mathematical model is established between vertical borehole and formation temperature field basing on flow dynamics and thermal conduction theory. So the temperature field of annular multiphase flow is simulated and the temperature field distribution of annular multiphase flow also is analyzed.

articleTitle: Effect of strong electric field ionizing radiation on physiological and biochemical indexes of rice seedlings
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to study the influences of the strong electric field ionizing radiation on the growth and development of rice seedlings, seed of rice SHENYOU-97125 were radiated with different excitation voltages in the same time or with the same excitation voltage in different times. It was found that compared with the control groups, the fresh weight of shoots and roots changed slightly, the root activities increased significantly, malondialdehyde (MDA) content of rice seedlings were all in the low level. After the seed were treated with excitation voltage of 130V in 10 seconds or excitation voltage of 100V in 25 seconds, the activities of α-amylase and transaminase of rice seedlings increased notably, the activities of catalase(CAT) and peroxidase (POD) decreased significantly. The results showed that these two kinds of radiation treatments could promote the growth and protein synthesis in rice seedlings, had made rice seedlings decrease injurant substance producing of reactive oxygen species, and had not caused the membrane detriment of cells.

articleTitle: Measurement of contribution ratio of forestry science and technology progress and countermeasures in the duration of twelfth five-year plan period in Ningxia Province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Contribution ratio of forestry science and technology progress is one of the key questions in forestry economics and policy. In this article, on the basis of statistic data in many yearbooks, contribution ratio of forestry science and technology progress, which is 51.17%, is measured and analyzed in Ningxia Province by Solow Equation. In addition, forestry in Ningxia gained scale effect in the period. Improvement of industrial structure and economic advancement play a role in the development of forestry. In the end, the counter measurements are proposed to improve management of forestry science and technology in the 12th Five-period.

Author Keywords: contribution ratio of Science and Technology Progress

articleTitle: The research and application of a spatial transverse mining algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: this paper proposes an algorithm of spatial association rules mining based on orientation frequent, which is suitable for mining transverse spatial association. The algorithm uses the method of orientation frequent item set to generate frequent candidate items by down-up strategy, which is able to efficiently reduce repeating computing and redundant operation to improve the efficiency of algorithm. The algorithm is applied to Grid Visual Manage System based on GIS to analyze Grid Malfunction, which is able to efficiently improve the efficiency of system.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive utilization of cornstalk in Jilin province
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cornstalk is a precious renewable resource, has high utility value. However, Cornstalk is burned in situ or abandoned in the field by farmers to harvest and avoid trouble, which become a nuisance. It is significant to increase farmers' income in the major corn producing areas and develop modern agriculture by extending the cornstalk industrial chain and improving the comprehensive utilization of cornstalk.

articleTitle: Area-efficient implementation of low bit-depth motion estimation algorithms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the processing requirements of real-time low-complexity video compression, this paper proposes an area-efficient low bit-depth representation based full search block motion estimation engine. The source pixel based linear arrays(SPBLA) is adopted for the system-level architecture. Furthermore, towards system bottlenecks which are ROM-based systolic cell and redundant data memory organization, optimized structures are presented. Compared with the hardware in former literatures, the proposed hardware can achieve significant improvement in area and no throughput is lost. Implementation results on Xilinx XC2VP30-7 FPGA show that, at the cost of 6.78% and 6.62% extra consumption of LUTs, ROM and BRAM are no longer needed and 93.75% DP-RAM can be reduced.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation analysis of load-bearing structure of surrounding rocks of roadway under the influence of fault
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The fault destroyed the continuity of rockmass. Near the fault stress distribution is changeable, that's the primary cause of roof fall about stope and tunnel. Articles by numerical simulation analysis of stress distribution, displacement and deformation characteristics of roof under the influence of fault, conclusion is that near the fault the plastic zone of roadway similar to suspended, the displacement and the stress in the faults have undergone mutation, it can be seen the yieled zone, the displacement and the stress are subjected to the fault shielding because of the interaction of the interface with the crack of fault for both cases above. and thus get tunnel support structure of the location and characterics; Those results provide the theory basis for control of roadway under influence of fault.

articleTitle: Ecological carrying capacity evaluation of Shijiazhuang city based on ecological footprint
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The regional sustainable development objectively requires the ecological carrying capacity evaluation, which could provide scientific basis for the reasonable arrangement of industrial layout as well as urban and rural land use. This paper based on the shijiazhuang city as an example, uses the method of ecological footprint to evaluate land carrying capacity of Shijiazhuang city. Using the method of ecological footprint calculates the ecological footprint, ecological carrying capacity and ecological deficit of Shijiazhuang in 1996 and 2000 and 2006 during 1996 to 2006, Besides, do the comparison with other areas at home and abroad. The results shows that the ecological carrying capacity of Shijiazhuang decreased from 0.3616hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cap to 0.3227hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cap in 11 years while the ecological footprint increased 2.4893 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cap to 4.690 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cap, Compared with other areas, the ecological footprint and ecological deficit far exceeds the national average in most areas.

articleTitle: Research of illumination invariant for color image in Mirosot of Robot Soccer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The color feature recognition of the object is used in Semi-autonomous robot soccer system in FIRA. However, the color feature of the object changes when the illumination varies in the environment during the competition. In this paper, different color models are analyzed and compared, such as normalized rgb model, HS model, normalized yuv model etc. They have different recognition performances of color feature. A new color model HSv' based on dichromatic reflection model is proposed. Trace criterion which is constructed by within-class scatter matrix and between-class scatter matrix is adapted to evaluate the recognition performance of the color model. Experiments have been carried out in Mirosot(Micro Robot World Cup Soccer Tournament) which is a platform for semi-autonomous robot soccer. The results of the experiments show the new color model achieves a high recognition ratio for the object recognition.

articleTitle: Lower-bound performance of Erasure Error Correction for reliable real-time wireless multicast
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A General Architecture of Erasure Error Correction (GA-EEC) under strict delay constraints was proposed to guarantee the reliability requirement of real-time multicast services over wireless networks. To optimize the parameters of the GA-EEC, an upper-bound for evaluating its Packet Loss Ratio (PLR) performance was also proposed before. For judging the tightness and the precision of the upper-bound, in this paper, a lower-bound of evaluating the PLR performance of the GA-EEC is proposed. The analysis results show that both the upper-bound and the lower-bound are nearly identical when the average link PLR is very small. It indicates that both of them are very tight and accurate for evaluating the PLR performance of the GA-EEC in case of real-time multicast scenarios with small average link PLR. Furthermore, it is found that: the stronger the ability of error correction of the GA-EEC is, smaller the gap between the upper-bound and the lower-bound is. This result is very meaningful: lower the target PLR requirement is, tighter and more accurate the upper-bound is. It hints that the upper-bound is very suitable for designing the optimum parameters of the GA-EEC for guaranteeing very low target PLR requirement of real-time multicast services over wireless networks.

articleTitle: Design and development of operation and visualization system for HDF remote sensing images based on IDL
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to facilitate HDF data conversion, reading and writing, a system which can read, write and complete HDF file operations is designed and developed using a large number of functions and tools of IDL interactive language. Some functions include including reading all the HDF attribute name, reading a particular variable information and writing data, global properties and variable attributes to the file. Furthermore, the visualization system is designed to achieve basic operation of remote sensing images and simple remote sensing image processing functions using IDL language.

articleTitle: The study on security evaluation of mass transit information system in Shanghai
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Urban rail transits across Shanghai and more these transportation systems will be constructed in this city in the future. The security of these systems needs to be extensively considered. In this paper, we analyzed the factors that impact the security of the urban rail transits information systems and evaluated them from the security side on the basis of an indicator system. The result shows that the current urban rail transits systems are quite better. Based on the study, a suggestion and possible solution to improve the current transportation systems were proposed.

articleTitle: Segmentation and tagging of the Shang Oracle-Bone Inscriptions based on lucene and dictionary
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To segment the Oracle-Bone Inscriptions correctly based on the grammar and the dictionary of the Shang Oracle-Bone Inscriptions, is the prerequisite and basis for the establishment of the corpus of the Shang Oracle-Bone Inscriptions to realize Computer Aided textual explanation about the Shang Oracle-Bone Inscriptions. This paper takes the technology of modern Chinese word segmentation, combination of mechanical word segmentation and Characteristics scanning. In the experiment, 200 pieces of the segmentation of the Shang Oracle-Bone Inscriptions are the experimental samples. By experts, the correct rate of the segmentation result drawing from the experiment can reach above 90%. So, whether the correct rate and the segmentation efficiency is good. The technology of combination of mechanical word segmentation and Characteristics scanning to segment the Shang Oracle-Bone Inscriptions is an efficiency method.

articleTitle: Bioinformatics analysis of LeNAC protein
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: LeNAC protein, consisted of 301 amino acid residues, was analyzed by bioinformatics tools. The results showed that LeNAC belongs to the NAM superfamily transcription factor, and it was a hydrophilic protein which contained 18 potential phosphorylation sites, One N-Glycosylation potential sites.

articleTitle: Fusion design between beidou satellite communication technology and sliding force remote monitoring warning system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, the landslide disaster monitoring methods are mainly based on surface displacement monitoring, rock stratum tilt monitoring, rainfall capacity monitoring and so on at home and abroad. However, displacement and tilt are necessary rather than the sufficient conditions to produce landslide, sliding force is necessary and sufficient condition. According to the above principles, sliding force remote monitoring and early warning system based on GSM network communication platform is developed, and has been applied in 9 areas all over the country, which successfully forecasted landslide 3 times, and has achieved remarkable social and economical benefits. However, due to the landslide mostly in remote mountain, GSM network signals are weak and some areas are even in dead zone, in order to further promote the data transmission capacity of the system, according to the comparison among the existing remote data transmission modes, Beidou satellite communication technology is selected as the remote data transmission link of the system, which has no dead zone, low power consumption, and can expand the application fields of sliding force remote monitoring system.

articleTitle: Study on a single chip computer controlled multi-wheel intelligent-surmounting obstacle vehicle model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studied the mechanism of a multi-wheel intelligent-surmounting obstacle vehicle and its principal controlling technical routine with single chip CPU. The model vehicle mounted many wheels with gear transmission; the controlling system use Freescale 16 bites MC9S128 single chip CPU as the core controlling unit, some touching switches used as obstacle detection sensor. By effective signal treatment, the basic function of the vehicle, such as steering engine turning, rod lifting, wheel backward retraction and return after over obstacle is performed correspondingly. The experiment shows that this model vehicle can realize automatic surmounting obstacle without moving direction change through multi-wheel coordination.

articleTitle: A GIS based study on the landscape pattern changes of rural settlement of county-level
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this thesis, JingZhou county is served as the area studied. According to the database of resent land usage in 1990 and 2005, by the means of MAPGIS, from the following points: the scale of the land usage, per capita land area, spatial distribution of rural settlement, It study the law of the change of the spatial distribution in JingZhou rural settlement from 1990 to 2005 and research the relations between the traits of distribution and terrain, the county, the roadways and the rivers.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on structure dimensions of service employees' innovation behavior
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to working characteristics of service employees, their innovation behavior has four-dimensional structure, namely innovation orientation, innovation ideas generation, innovation ideas implementation, innovation ideas practice. Based on home and abroad study, the paper designs service employee innovation behavior scale, collects many questionnaires for empirical analysis, tests service employee innovation behavior's four structure dimension through exploratory factor analysis‥

articleTitle: Research on revenue-sharing contract for a three-level supply chain with consideration of influence of order time
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper first reviews a traditional three-level supply chain with revenue sharing contract which can coordinate the entire supply chain, then studies a revenue sharing contract with consideration of the influence of order time with the profit maximization as its decision-making optimizing targets. Meanwhile, manufacturer, distributor, retailer and the whole supply chain's profit model have been established. We analyze the optimality and equilibrium of this model and demonstrate the availability of channel coordination in a three-level supply chain with revenue sharing contract. Finally, through numerical analysis we discuss the impact of the changes of ordering time, salvage value and the mean of market demand on the optimal order quantity and profit of the supply chain system.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on agricultural sustainable development ability of Hunan Province based on DEA
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using DEA model, This paper takes agricultural sustainable development ability of Hunan Province as the study object, which combines tightly with Hunan's current situation of agricultural development. Through perfecting evaluation index system, the paper evaluates its present situation of sustainable development. Based on the analysis, the paper tries to find out the differences on sustainable development ability between different cities of this region and puts forward some related policy proposals.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of listed smart grid companies with principal component analysis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper takes 21 listed smart grid enterprises as samples, analyzes and evaluates their performance in 2009 with principal component analysis. The results show SIEYUAN and RXPE get higher comprehensive scores, which shows the two companies have stronger comprehensive strength, meanwhile the comprehensive performance of GWE and NEE are worst.

articleTitle: Price analysis on environment production factor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Since the concept of environment production factor proposed, it has been widely concerned. However, it is lacking for the study on its supply, demand curve and price setting model. Several questions have been discussed in this paper. First, we analyze the supply curve without considering reserved self-using. Second, according to its concept and characteristics, we get its “vertical ladle” supply curve in practice. Finally, combine the demand curve of environment production factor; we get its equilibrium price under condition of perfect competition.

articleTitle: Lithofacies paleogeography maps of Paleogene System at Shahejie Formation 3rd Middle sub-member in Jizhong depression
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The stratum of Paleogene System at Shahejie formation 3rd Middle sub-member in Jizhong depression is universal distribution. On the base of the welldrilling, core and quake data etc. as characterization and quantification, the lithofacies paleogeography maps of Paleogene System at Shahejie formation 3rd Middle sub-member in Jizhong depression are compiled with the single factor analysis and multifactor comprehensive mapping method proposed by Feng Zengzhao Prof‥ The stratum of Paleogene System at Shahejie formation 3rd Middle sub-member mainly develops some sedimentary facies including alluvial fan, stream, (fan) braided river delta, sublacustrine fan in shore and lake. The result of research shows that the sequence stratum mainly develop umbrella alluvial fan-stream-(fan)braided river delta-lake sedimentary system. Jizhong depression of Paleogen System had gone through the two phases of sedimentary evolvement for the deposit (SQ3) of fault expansive up to the chin age for basin in earlier Eocene Series.

Author Keywords: single factor analysis and multifactor comprehensive mapping method

articleTitle: Study on the gross error of horizontal angle in a connecting traversing and its influences
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the reason of horizontal angle gross error occurring in a connecting traverse was discussed firstly. The relationships of coordinates between forward and backward direction calculation were derived and analyzed. Furthermore the utility of the method is investigated using the results of an example. Finally some suggestions to avoid gross error were proposed.

articleTitle: A combination of direct cell count and fluorescein diacetate hydrolysis to evaluate the viability of algae cell
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowing the algae cell viability would be helpful in answering ecological or physiological questions. In this study, the direct cell count was combined with fluorescein diacetate hydrolysis to evaluate the of viability algae cell. The direct cell count was performed under light-field by a microscope equipped with CCD camera, and then an image processing program was used to calculate the cell count. Fluorescein diacetate is hydrolyzed into fluorescein by nonspecific intracellular esterases, and the fluorescence of fluorescein was simultaneously measured by spectrofluorometer. A linear regression analysis was used to determine the fluorescence intensity slope against time. Finally, we have chosen to use the ratio of fluorescence intensity slope and direct cell count result to make an evaluation of algae cell viability. The result shows that the combination of direct cell count with fluorescein diacetate hydrolysis can provide a sensitive and rapid method to detect algae cell viability.

articleTitle: Fingerprint matching based on multi-stage validation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an fingerprint matching method based on multi-stage validation is proposed. The prosess mainly includes: (i) measuring the similarity between every two Orientation_based Minutia Descriptors (OMD) to receive the Coarse Corresponding Set (CCS), the two OMDs are from input and enrolled fingerprint respectively; (ii) validating each minutiae pair in CCS by using Local Minutiae Topological Structure (LMTS) to obtain the Refined Corresponding Set (RCS); (iii) for minutiae pair in CCS but not in RCS, constructing its LMTS with the minutiae belonged to RCS to validate it again, after that, merging the passed minutiae pairs and minutiae pairs in RCS to the Final Corresponding Set (FCS) . Experiments prove the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Analysis on correlation between information capacity of NDVI and fractal dimension at different landscape zones
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-spectral information of remote sensing offers a variety of spatial and temporal scales vegetation indexes for the surface environmental of the earth. Normalized vegetation index (NDVI), which is known as the best instruction factor of vegetation, is most widely used now. Information capacity based on multi-dimensional histogram is an evaluation model of grayscale digital image quality. Its size is connected with the meaningful gray level of image. While the meaningful gray level of NDVI image corresponds to the space complexity of the regional land cover. This paper studied the scientific connotation of NDVI information capacity, and analyzed the relationship between the regional land cover characteristics, NDVI information capacity and fractal dimension of remote sensing image by establishing experimental plots; explored the spatial pattern of NDVI information capacity, taking the spatial variation characteristics of NDVI Information capacity in different regions as a starting point. The results show that the four indicators—NDVI, TM information capacity, NDVI information capacity and fractal dimension reflect the complexity of the surface environmental, vegetation and other information of different areas, and a new factor— NDVI information capacity can be used for the study of spatial structure of regional landscape, thus it is useful to deepen the application of remote sensing data.

articleTitle: Research of data acquisition and display system for flow instrumentation verification equipment
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the need of verification of gas meter measurement accuracy on gas meter verification equipment, the methods that the gas meter's display data can be acquired by utilizing pick of the reading value image of gas meter, image process and pattern recognition technology, and also the concerning measurement errors of the gas meter can be discriminated by the data analysis and comparison on the controlling PC are researched. The relevant required data can be displayed through the combined design of data display functional components. Then the fitness of the gas meter can be verified. The designed data acquisition and display system can meet the functional requirements of gas meter verification.

articleTitle: The evolutionary process of multinational companies' entry mode in Chinese market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the evolutionary process of Procter and Gamble (P&G)'s entry mode in China. The reasons of this process are analyzed from five aspects: marketing environment, government policies, changes in investment structure, multinational companies' (MNCs') cross-border accumulation of knowledge and experiences, and the constraints of joint ventures as well. The positive and negative influences towards Chinese market are also described in the paper. The paper concludes with recommendations for the Chinese government and enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of virtual reality technology in the information system of the campus's underground pipe network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This essay has introduced the process of developing the system of the virtual campus's three-dimensional underground pipe network with soft Creator modeling and Vega Prime rendering models and the implement of the key functions of this system. The system has displayed the intricate topology structure of the underground pipe network from the threedimensional(3D) visual perspective and realized the 3D interactive operation. This system can inquire about the attributes of 3D pipe network objects and is convenient for the visual operation and the informational management of the pipe network.

articleTitle: Research on collaborative supply chain management of automotive manufacturing industry based on value net
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The model of the value-based management of China's automobile manufacturing industry is based on value chain, but with the network development of the supply chain, a simple value-chain management model has does not apply to the value-based management of automotive manufacturing supply chain. So we must upgrade to the mesh thinking mode: value network thinking. This paper analyzes the network value-added process of supply chain of China's automobile manufacturing industry from the traditional value-based management model of China's automobile manufacturing industry. Analyzing the supply chain collaboration-benefit of the vehicle manufacturers, it demonstrates the necessity and urgency of the establishment of the supply chain collaborative operating mechanism of China's automobile manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: From reducing uncertainty to feedback
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: System control theory and economic analysis concluded that the evidence with each other very well. Feedback control of the implementation of socioeconomic system is the system output in order to achieve a stable result. This can be achieved by negative feedback mechanism. According to the microeconomic evidence, the equilibrium production to achieve profits existed same requirements of insufficient elasticity in the production process. For simplicity, we set up a general model with multiple input factors in short-run equilibrium analysis, for example, the introduction of non-perfectly competitive market structure. At this time, we must consider the market demand changes by the impact of price variations. However, the related elastic analysis gives some market convergence conditions, which will be useful to make economic choices or the system design.

articleTitle: A survey on broadcast in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are much attractive in military applications, environmental applications, health applications, and other commercial applications. In wireless sensor networks, broadcast is an important operation used for delivering control message, emergent data, alarm and route discovery. In this paper, the progress of the broadcast algorithms is surveyed, and the key mechanisms and characteristics of the algorithms that are among the most representative of this research area are analyzed. Then the algorithms are classified and compared. Finally, the problems which need to be further studied are proposed.

articleTitle: Financial performance, social responsibility and enterprise sustainable development
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This essay presents a framework on the basis of the stakeholder theory for the analysis of financial performance, social responsibility and enterprise sustainable development, and applies this framework to examine the case of Mengniu Dairy. The analysis concludes that social responsibility and financial performance are not mutually exclusive, and that, in the long run, fulfillment of social responsibility will not affect a company's financial performance or competitiveness, but enhance its value and sustainable development.

articleTitle: DCI - a routing decision making matrix for supporting Delay Tolerant Mobile Ad-hoc Networks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a framework for investigating opportunistic routing in Delay Tolerant Mobile Ad-hoc Networks (DTMANETs). It introduces a novel concept of Opportunistic Confidence Index (OCI). The OCI enables multiple opportunistic routing protocols to be applied as an adaptive group to improve DTMANET routing reliability, performance, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Model choice of rural labor transfer and public finance input system in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently, transfer employment of rural labor is an important avenue for increasing farmer's income and rural economy development, and also a crucial factor of realizing integration between urban and rural areas. The smooth and orderly transfer mainly depends on transfer model and public finance investment. Based on introduction of western theory of labor transfer, as well as analysis of some special factors limiting rural labor transfer in China, this paper finds that it is infeasible to adopt “dual theory model” that advocated transfer from countryside to large and medium city. The best solution is to rely on urbanization, develop down economy and modern agriculture. From the perspective of integrating employment into public needs, this paper further studies functions and effectiveness of fiscal investment policy in promoting rural labor transfer employment.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the relationship between regional finance development and economic growth under structure change A case study of Inner Mongolia
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: By constructing a vector error-correction model with a structural variable employing data from 1952 to 2008 of Inner Mongolia, the paper investigates the relationship between finance development and economic growth in this region, and the influence of system transition on this relationship. Our main results are that finance development doesn't support economic growth strongly in the region, however, economic growth promotes finance development remarkably. Meanwhile, system transition imposes significant influence on the relationship.

articleTitle: Schedulability analysis of multi-processor real-time systems using Uppaal
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multi-processor execution platforms are being more and more commonly adopted in various real-time systems. In some systems, real-time tasks are generated at runtime to be executed under time constrains, e.g. interruptions triggered by events should be handled preemptively within their deadlines. Besides some other system verifications, checking whether all the real-time tasks can be finished within their deadlines, i.e. schedulability analysis is a very critical step in the design phase. In this paper, we break down a typical multi-processor real-time system into the follwing modules: the hardware environment, the task system, and the multi-processor execution platform. Then we develop a general model capturing the independent and interactive behaviors of these modules by modeling them as timed automata using the model-checking tool Uppaal, which enables us to perform formal verifications and schedulability analysis under one framework. We present verification results on small systems with a fairly small number of tasks and processors and it proves a general and flexible model which system designers can customize according to a certain system specification.

articleTitle: Studies of computer simulation of water transport in plants
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The pattern of water transport in plants is an important part in ecology study and is the theoretical basis of water conservation of plants, which have gotten more attention worldwide. The paper reviews the past studies of the computer simulation of water transport in plants and discusses the simulation models of water uptake of plant root systems, water transport within plants and canopy transpiration in plants. Based on the review and discussion, several areas most concerned about studies of the computer simulation of plants water transport are pointed out: (1) The study shall pay more attention to the microcosmic mechanism of water transport within plants. (2) The fact of growth of plants should be considered while the water transport model of plants is established. And the water transport models of plants and the growth models of plants should be interconnected and matched simultaneously in space and time. (3) Combined with soil-plant-atmosphere continuum, the mutual interaction of plant growth and plant water transport in different areas should be considered to study plant water transport.

articleTitle: Research on characteristics of China's economic structural imbalance and warning system —Based on view of liquidity
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Economic structural imbalance troubled China's macro economy. With monetary liquidity as tracker, economic structure changes can be followed, and the structure and mechanism of imbalance can also be dissected dynamically by the method of path analysis. Based on view of liquidity, warning system is designed by the way of grey theory and fuzzy evaluation. Finally, regard injecting and leading liquidity as basic idea, complete set of policies and suggestions have been proposed.
