articleTitle: Welcome
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On behalf of The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering (ICISE2010), it is my great pleasure to welcome you to the conference. This annual international event has attracted a great number of academies, scientists, engineers, postgraduates and other professionals from a large range of countries. ICISE2010 will provide a unique forum to discuss a large array of Information Science and Engineering issues including intelligent computing, cloud computing, internet technology, geographic & remote sensing, bioinformatics, data mining, software engineer and virtual environments, etc.

articleTitle: Author index
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Research on spectrum detection algorithms based on data fusion in cognitive radio systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the property of highly spectrum detection performance, a novel spectrum detection algorithm based on data fusion was presented. In this paper, the expression of log-likelihood ratio function about received data in fusion center and the number of secondary users confirmed that primary users being was studied firstly. The secondary users' number was referred ahead including tow parts, one is correct decision and the other is false-alarm decision. Then, the detection performance in fusion center was derived according to the statistical characteristics. Simulations show that the proposed scheme outperformed traditional algorithms, such as the schemes of “Logic-And” and “Logic-Or”. Compared with single cognitive radio detection scheme, the performance of proposing scheme improved evidently.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on the real estate industry bidding problems of state-owned land
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Review on the websites and virtual tourism of World Heritage sites in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The virtual tourism, as a new form of tourism, caters to the needs of tourists in internet era, and has become a focused issue. Virtual tourism has been used in the websites of tourism scenic spots. World heritage sites in China are world famous tourist attractions, in their websites the virtual tourism developed is symbolic and representative, and it is important for advertising and protecting the heritage resources. The Article analyzed the websites construction and virtual tourism application in the 38 World Heritage sites, and divided the virtual tourism showed in World Heritage websites into four types.

articleTitle: Reserch on application of data mining technology in decision of underground relic
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Using computer information technology and data mining technology can automatic identification of underground abnormal body. Comparing the Correlation algorithm of advantages and disadvantages, take a small area of archaeological sites in the magnetic data as the sample data, the training model using fuzzy clustering algorithm, and then modified with the actual situation. A large area of the site use K nearest neighbor algorithm. The method of classification results according with the experts explain and match the actual excavation. The efficiency of the identification and work has been improved significantly. Data mining techniques applied to archaeological exploration geophysical data processing is the future of intelligent data-processing development trend.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of University Timetable Problem based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A method for OFDM synchronizations using cyclic differential PN sequences
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A new method of OFDM synchronizations is presented. The proposed method is based on two training PN symbols that are cyclic differential in time domain and frequency domain, with which we can not only obtain symbol-timing estimation, carrier frequency-offset estimation and channel estimation, but also the uncertainty caused by plateau in S&C method be removed. The point is that the time symbol-timing estimation can be kept even though the SNR is specially low, so the merit makes the proposed method useful for OFDM synchronizations in bad communications environment.

articleTitle: A study of stability of inter-organization relationships between enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The thesis discusses the nature of generative whole of the inter-organization relationships between enterprises. The logical and historical points of whole originate from division and collaboration. The social activities of human being derive from division and collaboration, the organizations of an enterprise are cooperative relation system built on division and collaboration, and the inter-organization relationships between enterprises are the cooperative relation system of the organizations of enterprises. On the base of examining the theory of division and collaboration, the study proposes that the mechanism of division and collaboration is the core factor for the stability of the inter-organization relationships between enterprises, and further points out that the inter-organization relationships between enterprises, as a generative whole, have a stable mechanism that sustains the internal balance within the organization system.

articleTitle: Research of GIS services mode based on SaaS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The present GIS developments have little focused on providing open and smart processing service. To solve this problem, the paper studies and establishes a distributed GIS sharing system based on SaaS. Analysis the reason of the open GIS system platform cannot continuous operation. Design the spatial data model and rules and strategy for SLA. Finally provide a continuous operation mechanism of the xinjan corps's GIS platform.

articleTitle: An empirical study of Service Innovation's Effect on Customers' Re-purchase Intention in Telecommunication Industry
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the review of relevant researches in the field of repurchase intention as well as the field of service innovation, this research analyzed the Service Innovation's Effect on Customers' Re-purchase Intention in Telecommunication Industry, and developed the theoretical model. And 198 users of mobile telecommunication were chosen for our investigation. The result shows that service innovation made by the operators in telecommunication industry has important effect on users' intention when they are in need to repurchase the mobile telecommunication.

articleTitle: Early-warning platform for food security supervision based on multi-dimension information integration
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The precondition for passive supervision being upgraded to initiative supervision for food security is to collect multi-dimension information of food security accurately and timely. Based on system theory, this paper presents a design of platform for food security information which consists of consumer charging, collection of examined data of food supervision, RSS subscribing information and media information. Based on this information collecting platform, and combined with early-warning program of food security, a systemic integrated platform for food security supervision and early-warning is built.

articleTitle: Extraneous risk, heterogeneous beliefs and the equity premium with jump-diffusion uncertainty
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We think stock price is decided not only by fundamental uncertainty but also by market nonfundamental (extraneous) uncertainty. Extraneous risk arises from agents heterogeneous beliefs about extraneous uncertainty. We provide a dynamic equilibrium model in the continuous-time pure-exchange economy where extraneous uncertainty is modeled by Poisson processes. We find that the stock's market volatility is correlated with the dispersion of disagreement about extraneous jump risk and expected returns can also be explaned by heterogeneous beliefs about extraneous jump risk too.

articleTitle: DC double-loop speed control system design and simulation
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to analyzing the basic principles of DC double-loop speed control system, introduced the design method and established mathematical simulation model of the system through the MATLAB software. Through the analysis of the results of the simulation, not only is confirmed the theoretical design method validity, but also raised students' theoretical analysis and engineering design ability. Stimulated students interest in completing the follow-up experiments and curriculum design, achieved better teaching results.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Monitoring model of application-specific LAN
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Innovation capital and endogenous economic growth model
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider the nature of knowledge-based economy is innovation, and innovation capital is the key to the promotion of enterprise development, socio-economic growth is also the first capital. Innovation can be as innovative capital, its effective use to improve the productivity of factors of production to achieve epitaxial growth changes to the endogenous of economic growth. Innovation capital contribution, innovation and capital by the aggregate production function under determination. In order to fully establish the meaning of economic growth mode, we also need to build an innovation-based economic growth under the conditions of capital mechanism, and to play the role of macroeconomic regulation and control policy in this respect.

articleTitle: The management database platform construction for high consequence areas (HCAs) of oil/gas pipelines
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To establish a management database for HACs of oil/gas pipeline is one of the important tasks in our country. A large amount of data are needed to recognize and manage the HAC of pipeline's, including pipeline design, construction, operation, maintenance etc. Here, database's composition and requirements are analyzed. As a part of HCAs management software, the database enables the software to achieve some functions better such as HCAs distinguishing, evaluation and management of oil and gas pipeline. Therefore, the scientific decisions for the daily management and failure treatment of pipeline are provided to the related function departments.

articleTitle: Program comprehension: A method of generating visualized UML class diagram
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Program comprehension is an important research content of software engineering. This paper presents a Program comprehension visualization method of using UML class diagram. This method has two parts, first, The program source code is abstracted into database table, the form used to summarize and express program structure and key information, Then, the table was transformed into UML class diagrams, The class diagram can be effective to help understanding program structure and other key information.

articleTitle: Supplier numbers optimization based on risk theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is important to choose the number of suppliers in supply chain risk management. Too small number of suppliers will make the supply risk increasing, and excessive number of suppliers will increase the company's purchasing costs. This paper first transforms the supply risk of suppliers into supply system reliability. Then it quantitatively analyses the relationship between the number of suppliers and purchasing cost and reliability. It establishes a multi-objective optimization model for the number of suppliers. Finally, combining with a numerical example, the paper verifies the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of state-owned enterprise' senior managers based on industry cycle index
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on DEA model, this paper discusses the influence of state of economy in different industries on the senior managers' operating performance and excludes the influence of various uncontrollable factors on senior managers' operating performance by mathematical methods, which makes the new evaluation method more fair and reasonable. This new method is proved to be effective and practical by evaluation and comparing the senior managers' performance of 22 SASAC listed companies, which provides a more effective method for evaluation the senior managers' operating performance objectively and fairly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design of Small pumping station control system for alpine crop irrigatio
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Numerical calculation and comparative analysis with field test of a unbonded prestressed cylindrical water treatment cistern
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design of TCU for vehicle six-speed automatic transmissions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In modern times, the characteristics of lots of control variables, complex control strategies, high real-time control requirements and hard working conditions in the six-speed automatic transmission (6AT) control system increase the difficulty of transmission control unit (TCU) designing. Based on high performance microcontroller MC9S12XET256, the design of hardware and software of TCU was completed in this paper. By using modular design and reliability design, it improved the stability and practicality of TCU.

articleTitle: Basic mode of supply chain finance, risk and target detection
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The supply chain finance is one kind of financial innovation service product. This paper discusses the supply chain finance's risk from supply chain finance's fundamental mode, and establishes the basis of statistics index system, with a view to financial risk detection of the supply chain and providing the appraisal reference.

articleTitle: Feature extraction study of an automatic target recognition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Automatic target recognition (machine recognition) finds wide application in many fields, which is of important value in the civil and military application. Feature extraction of target information is researched such as the demodulation line spectrum feature, power spectrum feature and low-frequency line spectrum feature of ship radiated-noise, which is key technique of ship target recognition. Furthermore, software design question of the ship target recognition system is analysed.

articleTitle: Research on raster-based modeling technology of three-dimensional mine area
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of mining prospecting and mining data, mine area three-dimensional model includes ground-based model, the exploration line profile model, the scope of mining model, mine body model, mining roadway model, reserve calculation block model and goaf model. This paper presents a kind of mine area modeling technique based on scanned raster images. This technology can collect data and establish three-dimensional model of the mining area rapidly based on “old data”, to realize three-dimensional visualization of the mining area and the dynamic management.

articleTitle: An algorithm of Web usage mining based on attributes number set
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As large session pattern are saved in Web server log, aiming at the character that these pages attribute is Boolean quantity, this paper proposes an algorithm of Web usage mining based on attributes number set, which is suitable for mining session pattern containing many visiting pages. The algorithm turns session pattern of users into binary, and then uses the way of number descending to generate frequent candidate item sets. The algorithm computes support by attributes number set dimensions in order to scan once session pattern of users, and then the efficiency of Web usage mining is efficient improved. The experiment indicates that the efficiency is faster and more efficient than presented algorithms.

articleTitle: Dynamic algorithm for semi-online warehousing entry problem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: High efficiency of stock position optimization decision plays an important role in material handling and insuring of delivery times. concerning on the warehousing entry problem in the storage production integration, a mathematical model considering the minimum of goods shuffling numbers is build based on the formulation of semi-online A-shape bin packing problem through analysis. A heuristics strategy named Dynamic Stacking Strategy (DSS), which in view of vacant workload of overhead cranes between the adjacent incoming goods, and together with stacking constraints embedded in bin packing heuristics is designed to solve the suggested model. The numerical experiments show the validity of the DSS strategy.

articleTitle: Attribute reduction based on interval-valued formal contexts
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The interval value is frequently used when describing the problems of uncertainty. The attribute reduction of concept lattice refers to the minimal set of attributes that consistently maintain a certain characteristic sought under the condition that the object set is maintained unchanged. Through the study of the interval value and the nature of Galois connection, this paper is to provide a pair of Galois connection in the context of an interval form to generate an interval concept. Moreover, an interval concept lattice whose form and context are identical with the original interval value is constructed. And then this paper is to study the theories and methods of the reduction of the attribute value vector of the interval concept lattice.

articleTitle: The research of health insurance fund management based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Effective management of health insurance funds is the key to the safe operation of health care system. This paper takes Xi'an as an example, analysis the factors of health insurance fund and the relationship of causal and feedback between the variables. Through the use of system dynamics equations to describe these causal and feedback relationships, build system dynamics model. Finally, based on the simulation of the model, forecast the fund income and expenditure, and propose countermeasures.

articleTitle: Action research: Information technology class as life
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In underdeveloped Chinese middle schools, Information technology instruction, first class should be concerned is the teaching content whether take students as the main body of IT learning, whether pay more attention to students' real experience and participation, to cultivating their practical problem-solving abilities. This paper discussed the situations above, and tried to find out an appropriate active way to make information technology class as a real life in the underdeveloped areas, so as to seek a further reformation of information technology curriculum, and provide practical experience for them.

articleTitle: Calculations about premiums of joint life insurance under dependent conditions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Das, S (2003) found the method to calculate the pure premium of joint life insurance, which means when we suppose the life is independent, using actuary theory we can have the calculating results. In some practical problems, this result is useful. However, the lives are dependence in the real world. Therefore, we give a different method to calculate the payment of different premiums and endowments by Frank's Copula Model and Common Hazard Model, which are the relative calculations of joint life statuses. In the mean time, we consider the way to divide premiums. Our method is better and more practical.

articleTitle: Research on the integration of equipment manufacturing industry and productive service of Beijing
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper make a study of the integration of equipment manufacturing industry and productive service based on the data of Beijing 2007 Input-Output Table. At first we calculate and analyze the direct consume coefficient, complete consume coefficient, influence coefficient of every industry department. And then get more knowledge about the situation of interactive development between the two industry. Finally, we give suggestions about how to improve the further integration.

articleTitle: Application research on Bayesian Network Classifier in the cognitive diagnosis
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Classification is a basic task in data analysis and pattern recognition that requires the construction of a classifier, that is, a function that assigns a class label to instances described by a set of attributes. Naive Bayesian Networks Classifier is one of the Bayesian Classifiers. Due to its simple structure and powerful reasoning ability in solving nondeterminant problems, Naive Bayesian Network Classifiers is attracting more and more attention of the researchers.

articleTitle: Contrast on city tourism between Guilin and Leshan
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cities have been hot tourist destinations in recent years. How can medium-sized cities share tourist markets in competition? Compared Leshan with Guilin, the both cities were rich in tourism resources and economic bases. Guilin has developed into a mature city tourism destination and achieved the goal as an international tourist city in last three decades. City tourism promoted city economy development. However, Leshan city tourism has experienced ups and downs; city tourism had little impact on city economy. At last, the successful experiences from Guilin city tourism were drawn and could be reference to other medium-sized cities.

articleTitle: Risk management for water sources switch of urban water supply system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Analysis on the various risks faced on water supply system has increasingly become the focus these days. Based on the general definition of risk, the risk of water sources switch for urban water supply was defined and classified. The connotation and characteristics of the risk of water sources switch for urban water supply were discussed, and its functional expression was given. Then, based on the definition of risk management, the connotation as well as the process and the methods for risk management of water sources switch for urban water supply was expounded. Furthermore, the framework for water supply safety guard with water source switch was designed and its further development was prospected. The mathematical models for risk analysis are summarized.

articleTitle: A two-warehouse inventory model with price-sensitive demand under delay in payments at the reorder point
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: When suppliers promote new product, they often allow that retailers can pay at the reorder point. So this paper is based on permissible delay in payments at the reorder point, and this paper studies a two-warehouse inventory model when the demand is linear trend with the sales price. Then, the retailers' inventory system is investigated as a profit maximization problem to determine the optimal ordering policy. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the validity of the model.

Author Keywords: delay in payments at the reorder point

articleTitle: Simulation study on mutualism behavior of automobile industry chain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper adopts the concept and mechanism of mathematical ecology theory, researches the revolutionary of automobile industry chain by setting up mutualism model of two species. Results of simulation show that automakers are more sensitive to the change of environmental resource. Automakers depending on suppliers excessively will increase the structural risk of the industry. Suppliers must make efficient utilization of the system resources; otherwise they inhibit the growth of automakers.

articleTitle: Evaluation system of service enterprise innovation-Based on method of GA-BP neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The existing theories mainly focus on technological innovation of manufacturing enterprises. Compared with manufacturing enterprises, service enterprises pay more attention to satisfy customer demand and the accumulation of knowledge in the innovation process. This paper establishes evaluation index system of the services enterprises innovation on the basis of service sector innovation index (SSII), and makes an empirical test of the index system which is based on the data of service enterprises in China‥

articleTitle: A technological innovation game analysis on marketcompetition of domestic enterprise with foreign enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: After entering WTO, omestic enterprises are facing more and more fierce competition with foreign enterprises' entry, and technological innovation has become the important way for enterprises to build competitive advantages. On the view of the existing technical standard and technological innovation investment, a static game of complete information model is founded for domestic enterprises competing with foreign enterprises on technological innovation. A conclusion is that: if foreign enterprise pursues large market share, domestic enterprise has to make technological innovation as the only choice.

articleTitle: An extensible framework for application exception handling
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional approach for exception handling has no good reusability and scalability, the source code will be changed when faced with unpredictable exception handling. Based on reflection and XML configuration technology, an extensible framework for application exception handling is presented in this paper, experiment indicates an encouraging effect in case of unpredictable exception handling compared with traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on the development strategy of China com-service management in transition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Under the new situation of current economic and social transformation, the existing problems in government management have become the bottleneck to restrict the further economic and social development. However, it will be the important way to ease the partial in-depth contradictions and problems in reform development to promote the government management innovation and improve the com-service management. This paper reviews the theoretical origin of com-service management by use of literature retrieval method, analyzes the actual dilemma and practical misunderstanding in China's com-service management with the empirical analysis method, and puts forward that the public, democratized, market-oriented and diversified development strategies must be adhered to in com-service management in accordance with the successful experience and reform practice of developed countries. The results of this paper have certain reference value for boosting the administrative system reform and the com-service management development.

articleTitle: Soil erosion analysis based on DEM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The soil erosion model of the study area is constructed according to the data of DEM. Factor R, factor K and another four factors of the study of soil erosion are acquired by using remote sensing techniques. Soil erosion is analyzed and calculated by using the soil erosion model.

articleTitle: The fourth error contamination mechanism in numerical simulation studies
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, it has been put forward a viewpoint which there exists the fourth error contamination mechanism in numerical weather forecasting models. In order to verify the existence of the mechanism, a non-uniform continuousity (NUC) index has been defined. The geographic distribution of the NUC have been calculated based on both the data of the real field and simulated field of the geopotential height at 500 hPa by T213 model of European Center of Mediuam range Weather Forecasting (ECMWF). The results show us that although the T213 model of ECMWF has a good performance on the prediction of the geopotential height field at 500 hPa with high accuracy, the changes in essence have happened: The area of non-uniform continuity in the simulated field is remarkably less than the real fields especially for those regions located at high pressure ridge and low latitude belt.

articleTitle: On the implementation of ERP in process industry enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, through analysis the enterprise information status of a chemical company, provides the enterprise solution of implementing ERP. It is a certain reference on the implementation of ERP in process industry companies.

articleTitle: GPS integrity monitoring algorithms based on tightly-coupled GPS/INS integrated system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A two-step fault detection theory, which consists of residual Chi-square Test and velocity detection based on robust differentiation via sliding mode, is presented. Simulation indicated that with this method excellent detection results were achieved, when step fault or slowly growing slope fault occurs within GPS signal.

articleTitle: Monetary non-neutrality: Theory and empirical research in China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on the data from 1978 to 2009, this paper selects variables such as money supply, real GDP and CPI as well as builds time series to prove that quantity of money has a certain impact on both the actual output and the nominal price level, while the impact of the former is stronger than that of the latter. All of the above analyzes are based on co-integration analysis, Granger Causality Test, VAR model and pulse analysis. In the end, we can reach the conclusion that Chinese currency appears non-neutral in the long run.

articleTitle: Construct new lattices based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Inspired by the theory of rough sets, this paper studies formal contexts from the viewpoint of approaximation operators. Firstly, a pair of approaximation operators are proposed based on a formal context, and the corresponding concept latices are constructed. Then, the relationship among these two lattices and the original concept lattice, the concept lattice of the complement of the original formal context, the object oriented concept lattice and the property oriented concept lattices are also studied.

articleTitle: Targets integral optimization and analysis of gear reducer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Establish the optimal design mathematical model of involute standard cylindrical gear single-stage reducer. The optimum design system is developed by using Visual Basic6.0, Visual FoxPro6.0 and Visual LISP. Based on the optimization example, it is analyzed that the number of teeth, tooth width coefficient and helix angle have influence on the objective function. The number of teeth must be positive integer, and modulus must be discrete positive. These lead to the discontinuity and extremum properties of objective function. It is most possible to get optimal solution by using integer optimization method in field of definitions.

articleTitle: The properties of time-delay gene transcriptional regulation system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We introduce two deterministic models of time-delay gene transcriptional regulation system, and research the properties of the two systems by computational modeling. The time-delay positive feedback system has multistability, gene switch and staircases. The platform of staircases is narrower with shorter delay, in contrast, the platform is wider with longer delay. Moreover, the system has memory property and echo phenomena emerging. These properties are caused by stimulation responding to time delay. On the other hand, the time-delay positive-negative feedback system can elicit oscillations and staircases. Bifurcation diagram demonstrates oscillation region enlarging and amplitude increasing compare with no time delay system, furthermore, the transcription rate can adjust oscillation amplitude, and the platforms width are in accord with delay times. Oscillations and staircases can indicate that delay increases instability.

articleTitle: Research on the maximal throughput for layered multicast
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the maximal achievable multi-rate throughput problem of a layered multicast session at the presence of network coding. Firstly formulated is the maximal achievable throughput problem with the assumption that the data layers are independent and layer rates are static. It is proved that the problem in this case is NP-hard. Meanwhile an upper bound of maximal achievable multi-rate throughput is presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of changes of Hong Kong's service trade
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: with the technological revolution triggered an important adjustment of global industrial structure and institutional arrangements of trade liberalization, international service trade shows a booming trend and becomes a new area that each country attends trade competition as well as a new bright spot of world economic growth. Hong Kong economic system is based on service, service trade promotes Hong Kong's economic development and makes Hong Kong become an important service center of the world. This thesis used recent relevant data of Hong Kong's service trade; it did comprehensive and systematic analysis of Hong Kong's service trade. It analyzed changes of industry structure of service trade and did prediction of development trend, and summarized successful reasons of Hong Kong's service trade development.

articleTitle: Profit distribution policy of construction supply chain
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the factors which have weight impact on profit distribution in construction supply chain. The performance level, the risk factor and the resource factor are taken into account in profit distribution among member companies. Mathematical methods, such as Shapley value, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and AHP, are used to calculate profit distribution coefficient and the weight, in order to establish profit distribution model for construction and make distribution results more reasonable.

articleTitle: Applying Karnaugh map to design complex software branch conditions
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: It is illustrated that Karnaugh map can be an intuitive method to reduce the complexity of branch conditions in software design, and it can be used to verify the combination coverage among branch conditions.

articleTitle: Analysis for non-stationary road surface roughness regarding four-wheel vehicles using Hilbert-Huang Transform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper uses the Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) to analyze the non-stationary road surface roughness, pointing at the non-stationary characteristics of the road surface roughness. First, the non-stationary road roughness is obtained by the simulation of the light bus of SY6480 running on the C-class road with variable speed; then it is decomposed using the HHT and the Hilbert marginal spectrum is acquired. The results indicate that the road surface roughness imposed on the four wheels has the rather similar spectrum structure and its energy mostly focus on the several harmonic waves of low frequency, which can guide the design of active suspension, the control of vehicle vibration and the analysis of vehicle ride comfort when vehicles run with variable speed.

articleTitle: Dynamical analysis on evolution of enterprise Competitive alliance systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to understand the mechanism and control of the Competitive alliances systems evolvement, this thesis have explored the drive of it. It is drived by inside factors and outside factors and behaviors of systems factors. The relations are osculation between them, different inside factors lead to systems behaviors, different outside factors lead to different evolvement path, and the behaviors of systems factors lead to the whole course. In this perspective, the influence mechanism of dynamic of the evolution of alliance systems is the resource sharing-knowledge sharing -capacity up and its coupling about.

articleTitle: Application of multiple fuzzy attribute decision to evaluation of distributors
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, Fuzzy Set Theory and cluster analysis is used to build a Comprehensive Evaluation Model for choosing distributor. In this model, descriptive variable will be converted to numerical variable by triangular fuzzy numbers firstly. Then the selected experts will be assigned to groups according to their group appraisal and given weight by cluster analysis. Finally, an example can prove that the construction of multi-attribute evaluation model can conveniently be used for choosing distributors.

articleTitle: Application and implementation of UCPS based on HDMI interface
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: UCPS (UCPS, Unified Content Protection System) specification has been used in HDMI(High-Definition Multimedia Interface) interface in terms of software and hardware. Based on UCPS technical specification, the paper deep analyses how the technical specification can been used in HDMI Interface. We design the hardware circuit and the authentication drivers, based on HDMI chips (sil9013 and sil9024), and also do experiment to prove that authentication drivers are right and HDMI interface has the ability to authentication.

articleTitle: A study on establishment of scientific and research team at university
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The colleges and universities should focus on improving their innovative ability of science and technology to be successfully transferred into a research university. This paper made a discussion on what the establishment of colleges and universities scientific and research team means to a research university, and pointed out the characteristics of the team and the focal point of work when establishing the scientific and research team with high efficiency.

articleTitle: Does company reputation have wealth effect—Empirical evidence from the Chinese security market
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The effect of company reputation on its market value is an important issue of foreign reputation research. Based on the characteristic of Chinese capital market, this paper use the method of event studies, examined whether Chinese listed companies' reputation has wealth effect. And the conclusion is none. One of the main causes is the low efficiency of our capital market, and the other cause is the low effectiveness of reputation punishment and the weakness of the investor protection.

articleTitle: Backtracking Ant Colony Algorithm for the 0ߝ1 Knapsack Problem
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The 0ߝ1 Knapsack Problem is of a class of typical combinational optimization problems and is NP-hard. It has important practical significance to study it. Based on the characteristics of the 0ߝ1 Knapsack Problem, we design a binary coding directed graph which makes the Ant Colony algorithm suitable for the Knapsack Problem. In addition, we also adopt the concept of backtracking from the Nested Partition(NP) algorithm and apply it to the Ant Colony Optimization(ACO) for strengthening the Ant Colony algorithm of local search ability to solve the 0ߝ1 Knapsack Problem. Numerical tests on typical instances show the efficiency and advantage of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Government venture capital fund for high-tech industries to guide the development of countermeasures
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The first part focused on answering the question ‘what are government venture capital funds and high-tech industries’. Then it pointed out the two basic kinds of the government venture capital funds and analysised of the government venture capital funds to promote the development of the mechanism of high-tech industry, On this basis, it proposed a standard to guide the use of government venture capital funds to promote the development of countermeasures for high-tech industries.

articleTitle: The study of logistics service integration platform from the point of industrial cluster view — A case study of household electrical appliances industry in Cixi
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper took the cluster of household electrical appliances industry in Cixi as a study case. By surveying the features and current running situation of logistics in Cixi, a conclusion was made that integration and specialization levels of logistics service were low, as well as its scale, totalization and informatization. We proposed the objectives and content of integration of industrial clusters' logistics service and finally established its service platform.

Author Keywords: household electrical appliances industry in Cixi

articleTitle: Management, monitoring and process design of energy-saving chain of Chinese construction enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In view of the serious gap in the energy-saving management of Chinese buildings, author of this paper analyzed the relation between management and process and constructed the management and monitoring process of energy-saving chain of construction engineering which are closely hooked by two main lines, “technology and cost” under the energy-saving management mode of Chinese building. Interlocking forced monitoring approaches are adopted to prevent the occurrence of gap in construction energy-saving as much as possible.

articleTitle: Research on secure MDS-MAP location algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Precise and secure node localization is one of key problems for applications based on wireless sensor networks. Recently multidimensional scaling-based localization algorithms made a great achievement in performance, but this algorithm is without security design. This paper analyze the security weaknesses of the MDS-MAP location algorithm basic on introducing the theory of multidimensional scaling-based localization algorithms and propose a secure MDS-MAP scheme to effectively withstand the typical sybil attack. Simulation results approve it to be effective.

articleTitle: A study of inter-organization of relationships of enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: According to the problems in the so called “the third economic organization” between enterprise and market, the thesis theorizes a complete framwork to solve them. It makes clear the existing diverse forms of the inter-relationships of enterprises and gives a systematic and unified explanation of them from the perspective of organization theory. The research technical route is taking division of labor and coordination of work as a rationale, the project studies the evolutionary process, path depandence, and choice of pattern of the inter-relationships of enterprises; and on the basee of it, it further constructs a theoretic framework of the inter-organization of relationships of enterprises, and makes a systematic study of the formation mechanism and evolution mechanism.

articleTitle: A watermark algorithm of H.264 to counter attack on DCT level
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces a digital watermark algorithm based on H.264. This algorithm controls the number of symbols of the DCT coefficients for 4×4 block to resist the attack, especially for the symbols attack. Through the experiment results, under the condition of no obvious increase in complexity and no obvious change of PSNR, BITRATE changes in less than 10%. The attack on level can be 100% detected with no error detection and leak detection.

articleTitle: Blind separation and joint calibration of IQ imbalance and carrier offset
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To solve the carrier offset and the inherent IQ imbalance problem of the popular radio receiver architecture receiver named direct-conversion receiver, a joint calibration method with blind source separation based on whitening and non-linear decorrelation theory is proposed. Simulation results verified the feasibility and validity of the algorithm mentioned above upon dealing with the joint calibration problem of the IQ imbalance and carrier offset.

articleTitle: Remanufacturing supply chain management information system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper analyzes current Logistics Process of a auto product company A and advances BPR program based on information technology. A new organization structure is produced. And an integrated information system including all activities of forward and reverse supply chain is designed.

articleTitle: The algorithm design to get the shortest path of city traffic using multi agent
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The complexion of the road in the city changed with the time, the shortest path will be changed when the vehicle is running. The paper analyses the shortcomings of traditional shortest path algorithm, then provides a model of real-time shortest path under the dynamic environment based on multi agent cooperation. Single agent state information and a multi agent negotiation algorithm are designed in the model. It can be adapt to changes in real-time traffic environment. It can be concluded from the simulation of Dalian partial sections that the algorithm is more adjustable and timely when the network node is changed.

articleTitle: Study on information integration management system project based on agent system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Effective communication information,collection and integration of information is one of the major challenges for agent project. This paper points out that it's importance for information exchange and communication to an agent project on behalf of application of information integrated management system, analysis of information collection to agent project, construction of information integration management platform for the project's overall implementation framework under the agent management model based on the characteristics of agent.

articleTitle: Research on the growing of Knowledge Workers in Chinese Private Small and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the coming of knowledge economy era, Knowledge Workers becomes the most important resource of Private Small and Medium Enterprises. Knowledge workers in Chinese Private Small Enterprises of and Medium growth direction can be divided into: Lengthways growth, Horizontal growth and Core. At present Knowledge Workers in Chinese Private Small and Medium Enterprises Growth of the main obstacle: Management mechanism under-developed; The salary management problems; Limit decision ability of Knowledge Workers; The very small opportunity of training and education; The work challenge shortage. To bring up how to manage the Private Enterprises knowledge workers, such as: Adopt the forerunner's management principle; Leading overall salary system; Let Knowledge Workers more participation management decision; The perfect training mechanism; Provide personal development challenge space, and so on.

Author Keywords: Chinese Private Small and Medium Enterprises

articleTitle: Dispatch algorithm of flash memory system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on EDF basic principle DVS, this paper proposes a dynamic voltage dispatch algorithm. Through the appointment chain that tables the execution time to depress for each duty reservation cable telegram, this dynamic voltage dispatch algorithm may arrange the use energy conservation edition the running time, if the appointment time is enoug. On the other hand, since the actual duty execution time is smaller than the worst execution time, the reservation time possibly has surplus. As a result, t this time renews the appointment chain table and arranges running time that applies energy conservation edition. The experiment indicats ethat this algorithm can achieve a good energy conservation goal.

articleTitle: Design of large aperture primary mirror and the support based on FEM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of high stiffness, strength and thermal dimensional stability for large aperture mirror, material selection, lightweight pattern and the design of support were taken into account in the design of Ф1130mm primary mirror of a Cassegrain space telescope. A new design with flat and opened back, triangular combined with honeycombed hole light-weighting structure is proposed. Three major points support and multiple points assistant support structure could keep both high rigidity of structure and fine thermal dimensional stability of the primary mirror. By adopting computer aided engineering (CAE) technique, the static and dynamic stiffness as well as thermal character of the primary mirror component were analyzed. Analysis results indicate that the surface accuracy reach to λ / 8 PV, λ / 30 RMS (λ = 632.8nm) under gravity and 4°C uniform temperature change, the first order frequency of the primary mirror component is 210 Hz, which can meet the requirements of space application.

articleTitle: Influences of innovative culture to economic growth and the research of its mechanism
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper explains the inherent relationship between innovative culture and economic growth by theoretical analysis of the theory of endogenous economic growth, then proposes corporate innovative culture and the innovation capability matching model. The innovative culture as the introduction of non-factor endogenous growth model, constructs the operating mechanism model and mathematical model. This paper systematically analysis the bump function when culture of innovation as the independent variable and economic growth as the dependent variable. Propose innovative cultural power concept, in order to explain why the innovative culture will produce different results to economic growth. Come to the conclusion that the effectiveness of enterprise innovation culture system must be on the basis of human resource management and knowledge management.

articleTitle: An obstacle-avoidance path-planning in robot soccer based on Refined Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An intelligent obstacle-avoidance algorithms in robot soccer based on Refined Genetic Algorithms is introduced in the paper and this method is used to plan the path of the robot in robot soccer based on Microsoft Robotics Simulation Platform. The genetic algorithms display a better obstacle-avoidance effect from the data based on Microsoft Robotics Simulation Platform 11 VS 11. Because of high fidelity robot car of the platform, the algorithms can be used in the real robot soccer and it is practically significant to achieve victory and reduce the loss of robot cars in competition.

articleTitle: Design of balance monitoring system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Improvement of balance function in relation to motor function and the degree of recovery of daily activities<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Balance monitoring system can be quantitatively and objectively assess balance function in patients' body. By this system, doctors can diagnose patients and develop appropriate rehabilitation programs. This paper presents a set of balance function testing and rehabilitation training as one of the balance monitoring system with Bluetooth wireless transmission. Paper describes the measuring principle of the system and the specific implementations of software and hardware in detail. The results show that the system run stably and reflect human balance function effectively, also the virtual reality (VR) technology is applied to the rehabilitation training part, as a result, the graphic interface becomes friendly and vivid, and patients' motivation can be actuated.

articleTitle: Trilateral game analysis on supervision of PPP project corporation tender
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Today, PPP is an important financing mode and gets more and more applications. As an important part, PPP project corporation tender is of great significance to the entire project's success. This paper analyse the characteristic of PPP project corporation tender and it's supervision. On the basis, introduce game theory to the this study, analyse the relationship between various participants in the tender process, establish regulatory compliance game model between the government and bidders and rent-seeking game model between the government and the executor, which provide a theoretical basis for government supervision in the bidding process. Accordingly, propose some targeted recommendations at last.

articleTitle: Design of GDSII pattern conversion system
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The maskless lithography technology based on Digital micromirror Device is a new way to achieve the goal of large-scale, rapid, flexible lithography. In order to meet the needs of maskless lithography system, Reading and digitization of GDSII file was studied in this paper, the system of pattern conversion was developed, so as to the layout of GDSII can be converted to a digital lithography pattern on DMD. The core layer and interactive layer of system were designed based on the UML method in J2EE. The core layer realized the reading and display of GDSII file. Interactor offeres friendly user interface for core layer.

articleTitle: The case study on the price-fixing of China stock index futures
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The quantitative analysis on the 1 minute high frequency data of China stock index futures live trading shows that the price has presented the unusual fluctuations because it's manipulated, this has largely affected the price discovery function of the stock index futures. The Patterns and characteristics of price-fixing include cross-market manipulation, control and direct manipulation of maturity. The main reason is that the relevant regulations and trade system are imperfect, and the lack of multi-level structure of a wide range of investors. Therefore, the key measure to ward off the manipulation of stock index futures prices should be: law improvement, investor structure optimizing, and set-up of the early warning system on the stock index futures price manipulation.

articleTitle: An improved pathfinding algorithm based on sorted linked list and indexed array
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A* algorithm is a famous heuristic algorithm in artificial intelligence. It is mainly applied to path planning in game programming. One important characteristic of A* algorithm is there are two lists in it. One is open list, the other is close list. By analyzing operating type, operating times of the two lists, and the complexity of several data structure when implementing the two lists, this paper represents the open list and close list by cooperative sorted linked list and indexed array. Cooperative sorted linked list and indexed array make full use of respective advantage of sorted linked list and indexed array. Comparing with indexed array, it saves about 10% time.

articleTitle: About the application of knowledge management in the educational informatization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge management is a popular term in 21 century. It has great meaning to enterprise growing and developing, and the idea behind it can direct the building of educational informatization. This article first describes the definitions of knowledge management and knowledge management technology, then talk about the meaning of applying knowledge management technology in the education.

articleTitle: A study of the structure of inter-organization relationships between enterprises
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the logic system of structuralism, any component of the whole does not exist in an isolated form, it exists as a relationship with the others. The nature of the whole is not determined by the external factors, it is determined by the internal inter-dependent relationships of the whole. Therefore, starting from the concept of relationship enables us to hold the relation among every part that composes the whole, and further to hold the over all structure. The paper focuses on the key concept of relationship with the approach of ontology to discuss the inter-organization relationships and to define the practical relationship as organization, that is the inter-organization relationship, and it has further defined the inter-organization relationships between enterprises. The significance of the study lies in its taking inter- relationships between enterprises as organization and makes the research of inter-organization relationships between enterprises into a new field of theory.

articleTitle: Practical analysis on rural consumption credit supply of China
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many shortages in consumption credit market, the emerging capital market in our country after development for more than 20 years. During the process of enlarging domestic demand, it is urgent for upgrading the rural consumption structure and economic development to develop the rural consumption credit. After the economic and practical analysis on the influence of policy effect to the supply of consumption credit, the formal financial institutions need to offer credit support for the rural production goods and consumption goods which are suited for the local production requirement according to the local production condition. A well operated financial system is the prerequisite for developing rural consumption credit. In order to satisfy the need of validity and make full use of the existed rural financial resource, the traditional rural formal financial institutions are still the driving forces as the supply of rural consumption credit. This paper sets up the rural consumption credit system and risk management system in our country through emphasizing the financial development level and outer condition of the consumption credit supplied by rural formal financial institutions.

articleTitle: Anti-rotation image matching algorithms based on hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Algorithm for rotated image matching was slow, inefficient and standard genetic algorithm (SGA) in image matching was not high in accuracy, this article introduce a fast anti-rotation image matching algorithm based on hybrid genetic algorithm. The algorithm combines GA and hill-climbing algorithm in an efficient way and performs fast both in global search and local search. The algorithm use circular and ring template instead of rectangle template, and use the histogram of the template to calculate the fitness of the individual in the hybrid genetic algorithm. The speed and accuracy of the Algorithm was proved by the experiment.

articleTitle: New opportunity of developing nuclear power under the low carbonized economy
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Facing the low carbonized economy's development model, the electric power profession became a row of new force of reducing, this article has analyzed the low carbonized characteristic of the nuclear power, the international nuclear power development situation and the present situation of our country's nuclear power, proposed that the nuclear power will become the focal point which the 21st century world energy most focused attention on, will open its new aspect of vigorous development.

articleTitle: Improved uncertain type of AHP algorithms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly makes research on the uncertain type of AHP. The concept of judgement matrix of uncertain type of AHP theory is introduced and some kinds of algorithms are summarized. A new algorithm for the acquisition of the judgement matrix is improved. Steps of applying the new algorithms in the process of the fellowship's choosing in Supply Chain are presented, and it is proved that the improved algorithm of AHP is more simple and effective than the original one.

articleTitle: Research on concepts & characteristics of inter-organizational information systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Inter-organizational information systems (IOS) is established between the different organizations of a long-term, stable communication mechanisms and formal channels of communications; focused on the goals of the inter-organizational cooperation; information exchange and sharing co-exists with organizational cooperation issues; is a series of information technology-based application portfolio. The paper has explained the differences between IOS & e-commerce (EC); distinguished between various traditional closed networks to current and open networks, and mentioned that the application models may vary from cooperation levels.

articleTitle: Extracting of remote sensing information of wetland in Hangzhou Bay Area in Zhejiang Province based on multi-layer classifying technique
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking Hangzhou Bay Area in Zhejiang Province as the study area and using Landsat TM images as the data source, this paper brought forward the multi-layer classifying technique on the basis of spectral and spatial characters analysis of all types of features. Firstly, the Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI) modal was used to extract the water bodies. Then, the unsupervised classification technique and the interactive interpretation technique according to the shape character and spatial distribution of the features were used to extract all other types. The results showed that the total precisions of the three periods of images were all above 90%.

articleTitle: Dual markets competition in supply chain based on a weakest traditional retailer
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The existence of both traditional market and electronic market complexities supply chain competition. Based on a weakest traditional retailer which buys product from manufacturer 1, who contend against manufacturer 2 in electronic market. This paper finds out their optimal decisions, and the conditions in which supply chain coordinates. After that, it analyses how manufacturers' product costs affect three enterprises' optimal revenues, and the paper also finds out some managerial inspirations.

articleTitle: Research on the assemblability evaluation method of part based on extension methodology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The assemblability evaluation method has become an important tool in DFA. The paper analyzes the five factors that influence the DFA, deduces the matter — element model and correlation function, and constructs an evaluation model based on the extension theory and priority degree evaluation method. It also discusses the application and evaluation procedure of the assemblability evaluation method based on theory research and case study. As a combination of qualitative and quantitative approaches, this evaluation method has also proved being extensible, advanced and practical.

articleTitle: The research of multimedia data mining in digital library
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Data mining and knowledge discovery provides us a new way to resolve the problem that we can't make the best of increasing huge data. Data mining is the key technology in digital library. People need not only to retrieve the information of text but also to manage and retrieve video information. It makes the multimedia data mining the hotspot of research. Multimedia Data Mining is the technique to be used to discover the implicit, effective, valuable and intelligible pattern from a large amount of multimedia data by analyzing the feature of seeing and hearing, and then to discover knowledge and obtain the tendency and association among the events. And it can also provide us the ability of decision-supporting to resolve the problem. This paper discusses the basic theories of Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery and presents the process, methods and data representation of multimedia data mining. Then it analyze the feature of information retrieval and multimedia mining engine(MME).

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Automation system of the Yellow River Delivery large pumping station based on DCS
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The analysis and simulation of wireless sensor networks routing protocol
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSN), which is made by the convergence of sensor, nested computation, networks and wireless communication technologies, is a new research area of wireless communication and computer science technology and has a wide application future. It is so important to design the suitable routing protocols because wireless sensor networks is confronted with many difficulties, such as limited communication ability, limited resources and mobile networks, etc. Up the foundation of the structure of wireless sensor networks, this paper firstly analysis and compares a few routing protocols of wireless sensor networks. Then compare directed diffusion to multicast and flooding in energy data from the theories. The results which simulated on the NS2 show that Directed diffusion is an ideal routing mode for WSN. In the last, we have a summary on the thesis, and look into the prospect of future research work.

articleTitle: Image compression based on p-tree
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Many mature approaches to lossy compression of digital image have been proposed. In this paper, we present a novel lossless compression approach to digital image based on p-tree<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. We apply our algorithm to encode and decode 2 randomly selected images using VC. The experimental results demonstrate that the approach based on p-tree is efficient in compressing the binary images corresponding to the significant bits in the bytes. What's more, the principle of the encoding and decoding is very simple and the operation is timesaving.

articleTitle: Research to the information coding of agricultural products quality traceability
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: At present, the agricultural product quality safety problems, quality of agricultural products traceability system of agricultural products quality system is an important element. In this paper, the quality of agricultural products related to the concept of fast traceability system based on the definition put forward by the only coding, data collection and convergence to achieve agricultural production was the quality of agricultural products fast traceability system model, thus achieving higher level business information islands connection, from a higher level abstraction, general flow of the process of agricultural units. The quality of fast traceability system model needs a unique code to complete structural design.

articleTitle: Collaborative design system of remanufactured product based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper studies the whole life cycle cooperated design of remanufactured products' based on knowledge management. Using scientific decision methods, the design process of remanufactured product supported by knowledge sharing platform was analyzed according to whole life cycle design thought in different regions and different sectors. The task of this research is to describe degree requirements of design technology in remanufacturing project using knowledge management and comprehensive evaluation. Some improving measures in product design were proposed in the last part.

articleTitle: A business-independence administrative model for role-based access control
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: For the various business functions and complicated authority settings in different information system development, resources are wasting in rewriting the permission management model. This paper proposed a kind of general permission management module based on an improved RBAC, which described the inheritance relation between the roles and the composition relation of the modules based on hierarchical namespace, using function mask to separate permission controls from concrete business, using logic expression to limit data sets to be permitted operated to achieve the purpose of fine-grained control. The application examples show that this model can realize fine grained access control effectively and has more general.

articleTitle: A function point analysis model based-AHP
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Function point analysis is a method of software size measurement. It has become the mainstream software measurement methods in software engineering. Traditional function point analysis method makes adjustment to the results by generic system characteristics. But it exist limitations. In order to improve it, this article presents an approach based on AHP software function point analysis model.

articleTitle: On the existence of inertial and reversal effects in China stock market of the post share structure reform
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Contrarian and Momentum are the strongest and most puzzling asset-pricing anomalies in stock market. We investigates the performance of winner and loser portfolio in China stock market after the share structure reform in this paper. The results reveal that there is the contrarian effect only in loser portfolio; while the momentum effect is observed only in winner portfolio.

articleTitle: Automatic detection of moving human head region
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: An automatic detection algorithm of moving human head region is proposed to slove false and missed detections in intelligent monitoring system in this paper. This algorithm is based on the gray feature of the human head. At first, the dual-threshold method is improved, then, the moving region of the hunan head is detected using the modified dual-threshold method, finally, the hunan head is segmented using the region growing method. Experimental results show that this algorithm has an effective and efficient detection of moving human head region in intelligent monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on information synergetic platform construction and agile supply chain of discrete manufacturing enterprise
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Information synergy is the linchpin of agile supply chain for the discrete manufacturing industry. This paper discussed the synergy of the Agents in supply chain and the strategies that how to improve supply chain agility. A multi-Agent discrete manufacturing-oriented information synergetic supply chain model (ISSCM) is proposed. And this model is applied to design and realize of information synergetic supply chain platform (ISSCP). With a practical example, simulated the ISSCM using Swarm techology, and formulated the construction process and functions of the ISSCP based on ISSCM, which deduced the using value of the model to improve the agility of supply chain.
